move.effect: Targets All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: The foe gets tangled in a fine silk string shot by the user. This silk can also be used to make fine clothes.

move.name: Stun Spore
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Powder Move. Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A cloud of paralyzing pollen that affects the nerves and cramps the muscles of those who inhale it.

move.name: Bug Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. If the target Pokemon is holding a berry, the User eats it and gains its effects.
move.description: The Pokémon nibbles at their foe in hopes of finding something tasty to snack on.

move.name: Rage Powder
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 2. Powder Move. All of the Foe's Physical and Special Moves will Target the user if able. Duration 1 Round.
move.description: The Pokémon releases an irritating powder that itches and enrages its foes into full-attack mode.

name: Duskull
description: They wander at night. They can make themselves invisible and they follow travelers all night until dawn breaks. It loves the crying of little children; they can be seen scaring kids who misbehaved during the day.

abilityOne.name: Frisk
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon can see the items others may be carrying, even if they are hidden.
abilityOne.effect: When this Pokemon enters the battlefield, Storyteller must reveal its trainer the held item of one foe.

abilityTwo.name: Levitate
abilityTwo.description: The Pokemon floats to move around without ever touching the ground.
abilityTwo.effect: This Pokemon has immunity to Ground-Type moves and effects active on the battlefield such as Terrains and certain Entry Hazards.

move.name: Astonish
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe.
move.description: The user sneaks behind their target to jump scare them.

move.name: Shadow Sneak
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1.
move.description: The user sneaks through the darkness and strikes by coming out of the target’s shadow. The Pokémon is able travel freely through the shadow realm.

move.name: Night Shade
move.effect: Single Target. Roll Ghost-Type Damage Dice according to the User's Rank: Starter 1 Die / Rookie 2 Dice / Standard 4 Dice/ Advacned 6 Dice / Expert 8 Dice / Ace and forward 10 Dice. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The user casts a dark and frightening mirage surrounding the foe to give them a panic attack.

move.name: Mean Look
move.effect: Single Target. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: An intense and ever-vigilant stare that surveils all possible paths the foe has to escape.

move.name: Foresight
move.effect: Single Target. The Foe cannot Evade Moves performed by the User. User ignores Ghost-Type immunity to Normal and Fight-Type Moves and vice versa.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their honed senses and mental agility to predict the next movement of their foe.

move.name: Hex
move.effect: Single Target. *If the Target has an active Status Condition, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move.
move.description: The user casts a terrible hex over the target, the effects will be greater if the target is already burdened by an ailment.

move.name: Leer
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The vicious glare of a predator that triggers the flight response of their prey.

move.name: Disable
move.effect: Single Target. Disable the last Move performed by the Target. Only one Move may be Disabled at a time.
move.description: The Pokémon finds the right nerve to pull that will render a foe useless to perform their best Move.

move.name: Confuse Ray
move.effect: Single Target. Confuse the Target.
move.description: The user flashes a sinister ray of bright light that others cannot help but go straight into it.

move.name: Pursuit
move.effect: Single Target. *If a Target hit by this Move is recalled, attempts to Run Away, uses a Switcher Move or is the Target of a Switcher Move, Deal 2 Typeless Damage to it. Outside of battle, aid in catching a fleeing target.
move.description: The Pokémon is relentless in its pursuit of their target, striking it just as it believed it had escaped.

move.name: Curse
move.effect: Single Target. Roll half of the User's HP as Typeless Damage Dice to itself, ignoring defenses. The Target will remove 1 success from all of their Rolls until the Curse if lifted.
move.description: The user mutters an evil incantation, misery will befall into the foe at the cost of the user’s soul. To get rid of the curse, perform an exorcism or get help at a Pokémon Center

move.name: Will-O-Wisp
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target. Using this Move against the same Target increases the Burn Degree.
move.description: The user calls upon an eerie blue flame made with the souls of the departed. They appear harmless until they have you surrounded.

move.name: Shadow Ball
move.effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: Dark matter and shadows are used as a projectile against the foe, bringing out memories of their deepest fears.

move.name: Payback
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move if the User has already received Damage from the Target this Round.
move.description: Some say the best revenge is a successful and happy life, but not this Pokémon.

move.name: Future Sight
move.effect: Single Target. This Move's damage is dealt at the beginning of the next Round. Ignore Shield Moves, Force Field, Cover & Substitute. If the target restires or switches out from battle, the damage will be dealt to the next opponent or to one of its allies.
move.description: The Pokémon foresees something terrible happening. Although when it tries to see their own future, the images are ever changing.

move.name: Icy Wind
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Wind Move. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: Polar winds sweep through the arena. Everyone starts to shiver and embrace themselves, trying to preserve a bit of warmth.

move.name: Spite
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Will to 1 point. Reset any effects it got from spending Will Points.
move.description: The target feels overwhelmend by feelings of dread.

move.name: Wonder Room
move.effect: Target the Battlefield. Everyone on the Battlefield will have their Defense and Sp. Defense calculated with Insight instead of Vitality. If using Insight as Sp. Defense optional rule, swap the calculation. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The battlefield is now a space that puts the mind to the test. A resilient mind will be a resilient body, but if the mind is weak the body will feel frail and feeble.

name: Wynaut
description: Its face always appears to be happy, but Wynaut can be deceitful. You can only discern its true emotions through its tail. They live together in caves and bump into each other to gain strength.

abilityOne.name: Shadow Tag
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon can physically take a hold of shadows to make them act on their own or capture their victims.
abilityOne.effect: All Targets in Range become Blocked. Ghost-type Pokemon are immune to this effect. Pokemon with the same ability are immune to this effect.

abilityTwo.name: Telepathy
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon can communicate using telepathy. It can send messages to other minds but it cannot receive messages back.
abilityTwo.effect: This Pokemon won't receive damage from Moves performed by its allies.

move.name: Charm
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce Target's Strength by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon engages their foe in a charming interaction to reduce their aggressive intent.

move.name: Splash
move.effect: Target Self. No effect.
move.description: Oh, for the love of Arceus...

move.name: Safeguard
move.effect: Target User's side of the Field. Force Field. Those affected are immune to all Status Ailements/Conditions. Previously inflicted Status Ailments/Conditions remain. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A force field covers half of the battlefield and filters out all impurities and ill intentions coming from the other side.

move.name: Counter
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 5. Can only be used if Target's last Move on User was a Physical Move. For damage, roll dice equal to Target's last damage pool rolled against the User plus 2 dice. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The Pokémon strikes back at their foe. Showing they can take a hit and punch even harder.

move.name: Mirror Coat
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 5. Can only be used if Target's last Move on User was a Special Move. For damage, roll dice equal to Target's last damage pool rolled against the User plus 2. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The user gathers the harmful energies around themselves and bounces them back to their source.

move.name: Encore
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 3. The Target will repeat the exact same action sequence it had last Round. Target must have had an action sequence. Duration 1 Round. If used on the previous Round, this move fails. See more on p. 529.
move.description: The Pokémon makes a standing ovation at their target, prompting them to repeat everything they just did, exactly the way they did it.

move.name: Destiny Bond
move.effect: Target Self. If the user faints this Round due to damage frm a Physical or Special Move, the Pokemon who dealt the damage is dealt damage equal to their remaining Hp. This Move will fail if it was used the previous Round.
move.description: Through a mystical bond, everyone who brings disgrace to this Pokémon will suffer the exact same fate.

move.name: Hold Hands
move.effect: Single Target. The battle may end at the Storyteller's discretion. Target may resist rolling their Will Score against the Accuracy of this Move. Out of battle, aid to reduce hostile intent.
move.description: The user offers their hand in friendship, if the other Pokémon holds their hand they’ll be very happy and become good friends.

name: Sandslash (Alolan Form)
description: These Pokémon make their burrows in Alola's ice caverns, hidden in plain sight. Careful with its spikes; any puncture into the skin and you can get severe frostbite. They can't stand high temperatures.

abilityOne.name: Snow Cloak
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon's skin blends well with the surrounding snow and hail, you can barely see it.
abilityOne.effect: While Hail/Snow Weather is active, this Pokemon can use the Evasion Maneuver up to 5 times per Round. The Pokemon is immune to damage from Hail/Snow weather.

abilityTwo.name: Slush Rush
abilityTwo.description: The Pokemon is used to run and hunt on icy terrain, moving swiftly through the snow during blizzards and ice storms.
abilityTwo.effect: While Hail/Snow Weather is active, increase the Dexterity Attribute of this Pokemon by 1. The Pokemon is immune to damage from Hail/Snow Weather.

move.name: Ice Ball
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Projectile Move. Successive Actions. *If all 5 actions land successfully, add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of the last hit of this Move. If the Pokemon used the Move "Defense Curl" in the same round, this Move's base Power becomes 2.
move.description: The Pokémon rolls into a snowball, getting bigger and bigger as they keep rolling

move.name: Chip Away
move.effect: Single Target. Ignore Cover & Substitute decoys. Ignore Defenses. Remove effects that increase Evasion Actions from the Target (ie Moves like: Double Team, Minimize. Abilities like: Sand Veil)
move.description: Bit by bit the Pokémon finds an opening though all layers of defense their target has until there is nothing left to protect it from a direct strike.

move.name: Scratch
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their sharp claws to scratch the enemy. Nothing fancy but it works.

move.name: Defense Curl
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 1. Increase by 1 the Power of the Moves "Ice Ball" & "Rollout".
move.description: The user curls into a ball to protect themselves when they feel threatened.

move.name: Powder Snow
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Roll 1 Chance Die to Freeze those affected.
move.description: A light layer of snow flakes covers the foes, as the layers pile up the possibilities to be trapped into the snow increase.

move.name: Icicle Spear
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Successive Actions.
move.description: A barrage of icicles shot against the target. They are small but sharp and pointy

move.name: Rapid Spin
move.effect: Single Target. Increase the User's Dexterity by 1. Remove Entry Hazards, Terrains (ie Grassy Terrain, Misty Terrain), Ongoing Damage and Leech seed from the User and/or their side of the field.
move.description: The Pokémon makes a swift spin to strike at the foe and in the process everything laying close to the user is scattered out of the battlefield.

move.name: Metal Claw
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 1 Chance Die to Increase the User's Strength by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon uses the foe as a whetstone.

move.name: Fury Cutter
move.effect: Single Target. Successive Actions. Cutter Move.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their claws or scythes to rapidly cut as if shredding paper.

move.name: Metal Burst
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 5. Can only be used if Target's last Move on User was a Physical or Special Move. Roll dice equal to Target's last damage pool rolled against the User plus 2 Dice. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: Those who live by the sword will die by the sword, or, in this case, by an explosion.

move.name: Fury Swipes
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions.
move.description: With their sharp claws, the Pokémon will swiftly scatch their foe, leaving its face full of small cuts.

move.name: Swift
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Never Miss.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a burst of star-shaped sparkles at a blinding speed.

move.name: Crush Claw
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Reduce the Target's Defense by 2.
move.description: With a crushing grip against the foe, the user manages to break their armor.

move.name: Slash
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical. Cutter Move.
move.description: The Pokémon uses the sharpest part of their body as a blade to tear and slash with vicious intent.

move.name: Iron Head
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon charges to cure the foe’s iron deficit.

move.name: Hail
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Activate Hail Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The skies turn gray, and loud thunder rumbles, but what falls is not a gentle drizzle, but an endless stream of ice shards coming down at high speeds. Find shelter!

move.name: Iron Defense
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
move.description: Iron body, iron will. This Pokémon is unbreakable.

move.name: Night Slash
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical. Cutter Move.
move.description: The user looks for a weak spot, tearing the soft flesh apart with a single vile slash of its claws.

move.name: Swords Dance
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Strength by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon dances with strong steps and a fierce attitude as a ritual to prepare for battle.

move.name: Blizzard
move.effect: All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Wind Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Freeze those affected. *Sunny Weather increases to Low Accuracy 4. **Hail/Snowy Weather remove Low Accuracy and adds the effect "Never Miss".
move.description: The user summons a turbulent and gelid wind that feels like ice daggers. A pleasant day may make it difficult to call upon, but beware if the temperatures go below zero.

move.name: Gyro Ball
move.effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of this Move for every point on Dexterity the Target has that surpasses the User's. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a projectile. Correction: the Pokémon IS the projectile.

move.name: Steel Roller
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Can't be used if there is no Active Terrain (Grassy Terrain, Electric Terrain, etc.) on the Battlefield. Remove any active Terrain on the Battlefield.
move.description: The Pokémon rolls into a wheel, destroying anything in their path. Buildings come crashing down, forests are swept away and the soil is left as a blank slate.

move.name: Steel Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Recoil.
move.description: A concentrated ray of light that is capable of melting even the thickest steel plates. Unfortunately, the user is also made of steel.

move.name: Triple Axel
move.effect: Single Target. Triple Action. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage of the 2nd hit and 2 Extra Dice to the Damage of the 3rd hit. **Second hit has Low Accuracy 1. ***Third hit has Low Accuracy 2.
move.description: A series of cold-blooded kicks that break bone as they would break brittle ice.

name: Poliwrath
description: It's not common to find it in the wild. Most sightings take place when it is on land. Once it is inside the water, it will swim far away. This Pokémon is an outstanding swimmer, capable of beating any human.

abilityOne.name: Water Absorb
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon's body is mostly made of water, it stores water inside itself and uses it for nourishment.
abilityOne.effect: When this Pokemon is hit by a Water-Type Move, you may restore 1 HP instead of receiving damage. Water-Type Moves do not deal damage to this Pokemon.

abilityTwo.name: Swift Swim
abilityTwo.description: The Pokemon will move faster in water than on land, even a puddle-covered roadway will allow it to use its full speed.
abilityTwo.effect: While Rain Weather is active, Increase this Pokemon's Dexterity Attribute by 2.

move.name: Hypnosis
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Put the Target to sleep. Dark-Type Pokemon are affected by this Move.
move.description: By staring at an hypnotic pendulum, the target is suggestioned to feel tired and close its eyelids.

move.name: Dynamic Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Fist Move. Confuse the Target.
move.description: A punch to a vital pressure point on the foe to disrupt their sense of balance

move.name: Counter
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 5. Can only be used if Target's last Move on User was a Physical Move. For damage, roll dice equal to Target's last damage pool rolled against the User plus 2 dice. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The Pokémon strikes back at their foe. Showing they can take a hit and punch even harder.

move.name: Water Sport
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Physical & Special Fire-Type Moves have Power 0. Pokemon weak to Fire-Type Moves won't receive Super-Effective Damage from them. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A single drop of water can’t put off a raging fire, but what is the ocean but a collection of drops.

move.name: Water Gun
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The fastest water gun in town. No enemy will remain dry

move.name: Bubble
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: Dozens of bubbles are sent floating through the battlefield. The foes can’t resist the temptation to burst the pretty bubbles, only for the bubbles to explode for real when they do.

move.name: Circle Throw
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy -1. Late Reaction 1. Switcher Move for the foe.
move.description: Using their best sumo moves, the Pokémon throws the foe 60ft. out of the battlefield.

move.name: Rain Dance
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Activate Rain Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The Pokémon performs a peculiar dance in the middle of the field, everyone thinks it silly until the first thunder rumbles.

move.name: Submission
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Recoil.
move.description: The Pokémon wrestles their foe to subdue it, but the foe will put up a fight before they let it happen.

move.name: Body Slam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The user charges against the foe using ther body to slam it down, leaving the target stunned.

move.name: Earth Power
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: The user sends out a subterranean wave that bursts the ground below the target. It’s as if the earth bends to the user’s will.

move.name: Seismic Toss
move.effect: Single Target. Roll Fight-Type Damage Dice according to the User's Rank: Starter 1 Die / Rookie 2 Dice / Standard 4 Dice/ Advacned 6 Dice / Expert 8 Dice / Ace and forward 10 Dice. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The foe gets launched up to the sky, then falls face-first into the ground making it tremble. The stronger the user, the higher the launch.

move.name: Bubble Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 1.
move.description: A powerful stream of foamy bubbles shot straight into the foe

move.name: Wake-Up Slap
move.effect: Single Target. *If the foe has the Sleep Status, Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool. Wake up the foe after dealing damage.
move.description: Wakey wakey, sleepy head!

move.name: Belly Drum
move.effect: Target Self. Roll half of the User's HP as Typeless Damage Dice to itself, ignore defenses. Increase User's Strengt by 3.
move.description: With an angry war cry the user hits their belly as drums of war.

move.name: Mud Bomb
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Projectile Move. Roll 3 Chance Die to Reduce 1 success to all Accuracy rolls of the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a ball of mud to burst on their victim’s face in an attempt to blind them.

move.name: Hydro Pump
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2
move.description: Water works best under pressure.

move.name: Double-Edge
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil.
move.description: Without regard for their own safety, the Pokémon does a reckless attack against their foe.

move.name: Icy Wind
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Wind Move. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: Polar winds sweep through the arena. Everyone starts to shiver and embrace themselves, trying to preserve a bit of warmth.

move.name: Coaching
move.effect: Target All Allies in Range. Increase by 1 the Strength and Defense of all Allies targeted. The User cannot target itself.
move.description: This Pokémon allies form a line and start doing squats and push-ups while the user corrects their form and gives them tips and a confidence boost to win this match.

name: Spoink
description: They are always bouncing with their tail. If they ever stop, their heart wouldn't beat anymore. Spoinks balance a pearl from Clamperl on their head; if it's lost, they won't be able to control their psychic powers.

abilityOne.name: Gluttony
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon eats all day long, it is always carrying food and has no problem to find food sources since it's not a picky eater. It, however, doesn't share.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon can eat any type of food, medicine or herbal medicine with no negative. This pokemon may have up to three berries as held item instead of just one. The berries must not be of the same effect.

abilityTwo.name: Own Tempo
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon will do everything at its own pace, peer pressure will be ignored. Its behavior reflexive and calm... maybe too calm.
abilityTwo.effect: This Pokemon is not affected by the Confused Status Condition.

move.name: Psywave
move.effect: Single Target. Roll Psychic-Type Damage Dice according to the User's Rank: Starter 1 Die / Rookie 2 Dice / Standard 4 Dice/ Advacned 6 Dice / Expert 8 Dice / Ace and forward 10 Dice. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: A powerful mental wave assault’s the target’s brain directly. Everything, from forgotten memories to the secrets of the universe bombard its mind in just a few seconds.

move.name: Growl
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Reduce by 1 the Strength of those affected.
move.description: Either through a menacing attitude or an adorable demeanor, the foe will hesitate to attack the user at full power.

move.name: Psybeam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Confuse the Target.
move.description: The foe’s mind isassaulted by a mental ray, afterwards they may suffer from hallucinations.

move.name: Splash
move.effect: Target Self. No effect.
move.description: Oh, for the love of Arceus...

move.name: Odor Sleuth
move.effect: Single Target. The Foe cannot Evade Moves performed by the User. User ignores Ghost-Type immunity to Normal and Fight-Type Moves and vice versa. Out of battle, Add successes of this Move to any roll for Tracking targets.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their keen sense of smell to corner the foe and find it when it tries to scurry away

move.name: Psych Up
move.effect: Single Target. The User gets the same Attribute/Trait Increases and Reductions the Target has.
move.description: The Pokémon mentalizes themselves stronger than anyone. They feel good. They can win. They. Can. Do. This!

move.name: Confuse Ray
move.effect: Single Target. Confuse the Target.
move.description: The user flashes a sinister ray of bright light that others cannot help but go straight into it.

move.name: Magic Coat
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 4. Support Moves that would target the user or its side of the field are inflicted to the foe performing the Move or that foe's side of the field instead.
move.description: Through a swift mind trick the Pokémon trick the foe into pouring their ill intent on itself.

move.name: Zen Headbutt
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses both their mental and physical prowess in a questionable yet effective “psychic” strike.

move.name: Power Gem
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: With a crystal gem, the Pokémon will always save the day!

move.name: Psyshock
move.effect: Single Target. This Move is resisted with the Target's Defense instead of its Sp. Defense.
move.description: The shock is mental, the blow is real.

move.name: Payback
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move if the User has already received Damage from the Target this Round.
move.description: Some say the best revenge is a successful and happy life, but not this Pokémon.

move.name: Signal Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Confuse the foe.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a buzzing beam that leaves makes the foe head towards bright lights like a dazzled moth.

move.name: Rest
move.effect: Target Self. Complete Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Put the User to Sleep.
move.description: Yeah, this seems like a good spot to take a nap.

move.name: Snore
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. If the user is not asleep, this Move fails.
move.description: While the Pokémon is asleep they start snoring so loud it startles the foe.

move.name: Role Play
move.effect: Single Target. Replace the User's Ability with the Target's. Whole Scene Duration. Unique Abilities can't be copied.
move.description: The Pokémon is a great actor. Their impersonations are really good! ...maybe a bit too good.

move.name: Bounce
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Thunder / Twister / Sky Uppercut / Gust / Hurricane / Smack Down. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon jumps at least 30 feet in the air before landing with a mighty stomp on top of the foe. While in the air it is safe from most treaths but its still vulnerable to bad weather.

move.name: Psychic
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: The most iconic Psychic attack, the foe starts floating in the air and its swayed around by telekinesis as their mental barrier crumbles.

move.name: Simple Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Change the Target's Ability to "Simple". Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon.
move.description: A weak mental beam that doesn’t hurt or confuse the target but it does change their view of life as they start to take a simpler apporach to things.

move.name: Mirror Coat
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 5. Can only be used if Target's last Move on User was a Special Move. For damage, roll dice equal to Target's last damage pool rolled against the User plus 2. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The user gathers the harmful energies around themselves and bounces them back to their source.

name: Chewtle
description: It uses its horn as its primary weapon, but it has a reputation as a biter. Apparently its gums are itchy and the only way to soothe them is biting and chewing on stuff. It is kinda cranky but relatively harmless.

abilityOne.name: Strong Jaw
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon's strong jaw gives it tremendous biting power. Its teeth can tear through almost anything.
abilityOne.effect: Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of all Bite Moves.

abilityTwo.name: Shell Armor
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon's shell protects its vulnerable spots from its opponents.
abilityTwo.effect: Whenever a foe lands a Critical Hit on this Pokemon, it won't get Bonus Damage Dice for that attack.

hiddenAbility.name: Swift Swim
hiddenAbility.description: The Pokemon will move faster in water than on land, even a puddle-covered roadway will allow it to use its full speed.
hiddenAbility.effect: While Rain Weather is active, Increase this Pokemon's Dexterity Attribute by 2.

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Water Gun
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The fastest water gun in town. No enemy will remain dry

move.name: Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe
move.description: The user lands a vicious bite, leaving an ugly bruise.

move.name: Protect
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokemon would receive from a Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Moves that target the user.
move.description: A mighty energy shield materializes in front of the user to to deflect attacks and dispel ill effects.

move.name: Headbutt
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Out of battle it may cause a Random encounter when hitting trees and make objects drop from high places.
move.description: The Pokémon rams against their foe with their head. This Move is perfect to shake down trees when looking for berries, but beware of wild Pokémon nesting at the treetops.

move.name: Counter
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 5. Can only be used if Target's last Move on User was a Physical Move. For damage, roll dice equal to Target's last damage pool rolled against the User plus 2 dice. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The Pokémon strikes back at their foe. Showing they can take a hit and punch even harder.

move.name: Body Slam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The user charges against the foe using ther body to slam it down, leaving the target stunned.

move.name: Dragon Tail
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Late Reaction 6. Switcher Move for the Foe. In the wild, the battle may end.
move.description: The Pokémon sends their opponent flying up to 100ft in the air with a strong flick of their tail.

move.name: Rain Dance
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Activate Rain Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The Pokémon performs a peculiar dance in the middle of the field, everyone thinks it silly until the first thunder rumbles.

move.name: Skitter Smack
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Special by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon stalks and strikes the foe, usually from behind bushes or any sort of cover.

move.name: Gastro Acid
move.effect: Single Target. Negate any effect the Target's Ability would have. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The user spews their gastric juices on the foe. It’s so disgusting the foe can only concentrate on getting cleaned ASAP

move.name: Ice Fang
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Bite Move. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Freeze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon bites their foe with sharp teeth and a geli breath to chill their bones directly

move.name: Jaw Lock
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Blocks both User and Target. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The user will capture its foe in a crushing jaw grip. It won’t let go no matter how much you try to separate them. The only way it will release its victim is if one of them faints.

move.name: Liquidation
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Reduce the Target's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon strikes while bursting a full-force blast of pressurized water. The water may cut or dent through the target’s armor.

move.name: Super Fang
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Bite Move. Roll Normal-Type Damage Dice equal to Half of the Target's remaining HP. Up to 10 Dice may be rolled this way. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The Pokémon jumps to bite a chunk off their Target with their mighty fangs. After each bite there’s less and less foe to take chunks off.

move.name: Dive
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Scald/ Surf/ Whirlpool/ Freeze-Dry/ Sheer Cold. Out of battle allows the Pokemon to move underwater carrying someone without risk of drowning.
move.description: Just look at the world around you right here on the ocean floor, such wonderful things surround you. What more are you lookin’ for?

name: Gible
description: It digs tunnels and follows prey while burrowed underground. If you see the fin on its back coming out of the ground, it means it is about to attack. It's very aggressive but kind of clumsy. Beware of its big jaws.

abilityOne.name: Sand Veil
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon's body is easily concealed by sand particles in the air.
abilityOne.effect: While Sandstorm Weather is active, this Pokemon can use the Evasion Maneuver up to 5 times per Round. The Pokemon is immune to damage from Sandstorm weather.

abilityTwo.name: Rough Skin
abilityTwo.description: Use protection on your hands when touching this Pokemon. Its body is covered by sharp scales or barbs that get hooked into the skin.
abilityTwo.effect: If this Pokemon is hit with a Non-Ranged Physical Move choose one: - Deal 1 Neutral Damage against the attacker. - Roll 2 Dice of Typeless Damage against the attacker.

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Dragon Rage
move.effect: Single Target. Set Damage. Deal 2 Dragon-Type Damage to the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon focuses their inner rage and makes it not-soinner anymore.

move.name: Take Down
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Recoil.
move.description: Through a reckless grapple, the Pokémon smashes the foe into the ground, usually falling along with it.

move.name: Dragon Claw
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses its strong claws to deliver a fierce tearing blow.

move.name: Dig
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Earth Power/ Earthquake/ Fissure/ Magnitude/ Stomping Tantrum. Out of battle allows the Pokemon to burrow and make underground tunnels.
move.description: The user digs a tunnel on the ground and attacks by coming out from below its target. This move has been used to escape caves and gain access to highly surveiled places.

move.name: Dragon Rush
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon rushes to charge against their foe. Unlucky victims end up crushed into the ground.

move.name: Scary Face
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: When a Pokémon looks at you like THAT, you know you gotta thread carefully around them.

move.name: Draco Meteor
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. lethal. Reduce User's Special by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon summons a meteor to fall from the sky directly into their foes, dealing a brutal amount of damage. An impressive display if power that demands a lot of energy.

move.name: Iron Head
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon charges to cure the foe’s iron deficit.

move.name: Sand Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce by 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.
move.description: Sand to the eyes! A dirty tactic in more ways than one.

move.name: Sand Tomb
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Ranged. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion.
move.description: The Pokémon creates a pit of shifting sand around the foe to bury it alive. The poor victim struggles for air as the sand keeps sinking it lower and lower.

move.name: Bulldoze
move.effect: Area Move. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: The user stomps and flattens the ground, pushing all the rubbish and leaving the surface ready for construction.

move.name: Dragon Breath
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A mystical flame breath that feels strengely cold to the touch. It doesn’t burn in a conventional way.

move.name: Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe
move.description: The user lands a vicious bite, leaving an ugly bruise.

move.name: Sandstorm
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Wind Move. Activate Sandstorm Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A fierce sandstorm starts raging all around the battlefield. Cover your eyes, nose and face! The rough sand will hurt you!

move.name: Slash
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical. Cutter Move.
move.description: The Pokémon uses the sharpest part of their body as a blade to tear and slash with vicious intent.

move.name: Earth Power
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: The user sends out a subterranean wave that bursts the ground below the target. It’s as if the earth bends to the user’s will.

move.name: Outrage
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
move.description: The true nature of dragon-types unleashed. The user is consumed by a primal fury that won’t stop until everything has ben razed to the ground. Afterwards the Pokémon is confused.

name: Applin
description: As soon as it's born, this tiny lizard Pokémon burrows into an apple to protect itself from flying Pokémon and predators. The apple serves as its food source and the flavor of it will determine its evolution.

abilityOne.name: Ripen
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon can ripen fruits and berries in no time to make them Extra sweet and delicious, healing berries will have their effects boosted.
abilityOne.effect: Moves that use berries for Added Effects will have 2 Extra Dice on their Damage Pool (i.e. "Natural Gift" etc.) Increase the Healing properties of Berries at Storyteller's discretion.

abilityTwo.name: Gluttony
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon eats all day long, it is always carrying food and has no problem to find food sources since it's not a picky eater. It, however, doesn't share.
abilityTwo.effect: This Pokemon can eat any type of food, medicine or herbal medicine with no negative. This pokemon may have up to three berries as held item instead of just one. The berries must not be of the same effect.

hiddenAbility.name: Bulletproof
hiddenAbility.description: The armor on this Pokemon's body protects it from projectiles and small explosions.
hiddenAbility.effect: Reduce by 1 all damage from Ranged Physical Moves dealt to this Pokemon. Reduce by 1 all damage from Special Moves with the words: Ball, Blast, Bomb, Cannon, Octazooka, Puff, Shot, Sphere, and Wrecker on their name.

move.name: Withdraw
move.effect: Target Self. Increase User's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon withraw into their shell for increased protection and to avoid unwanted interactions.

move.name: Astonish
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe.
move.description: The user sneaks behind their target to jump scare them.

move.name: Defense Curl
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 1. Increase by 1 the Power of the Moves "Ice Ball" & "Rollout".
move.description: The user curls into a ball to protect themselves when they feel threatened.

move.name: Rollout
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions. *If all 5 actions land successfully, add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of the last hit of this Move. If the Pokemon used the Move "Defense Curl" in the same round, this Move's base Power becomes 2.
move.description: When the foe sees this Pokémon rollin’ they’ll be hatin’.

move.name: Recycle
move.effect: Target Self. The Pokemon reuses an Item (Berries, Potions, Full Heal, etc.) that has already been spent during the battle on any side of the battlefield. Recycle can't be used more than 3 times per battle by the User.
move.description: One Pokémon’s trash is another one’s treasure.

move.name: Sucker Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 6. *This move can only be used as a Late Reaction; and only if the Target used a Physical or Special Move, otherwise it will fail.
move.description: The Pokémon takes advantage of their foe preparing to attack to unleash a dirty surprise blow.

name: Wurmple
description: It uses the spikes on its rear to peel the bark from trees and feed on their sap. Their feet have suction pads to climb easily. Wurmple are plentiful and live in forests, but they are often attacked by bird Pokémon.

abilityOne.name: Shield Dust
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon constantly generates specs of dust to shield and protect itself.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon is not affected by any effects triggered by Chance Dice of foes.

abilityTwo.name: Run Away
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon is a master of escape. It will be difficult to catch as it can squeeze through the tiniest gaps to get away.
abilityTwo.effect: This Pokemon cannot be Blocked. It may also obtain bonus dice to escape from battle, Pokeballs or captivity at Storyteller's discretion.

move.name: String Shot
move.effect: Targets All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: The foe gets tangled in a fine silk string shot by the user. This silk can also be used to make fine clothes.

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Poison Sting
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
move.description: A tiny stab that causes big troubles.

move.name: Bug Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. If the target Pokemon is holding a berry, the User eats it and gains its effects.
move.description: The Pokémon nibbles at their foe in hopes of finding something tasty to snack on.

move.name: Electroweb
move.effect: Target All foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: An electrified web is shot towards the target, shoking and tangling them at the same time.

move.name: Snore
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. If the user is not asleep, this Move fails.
move.description: While the Pokémon is asleep they start snoring so loud it startles the foe.

name: Starmie
description: This Pokémon has been given the nickname 'the gem of the sea.' It swims through water by spinning its star-shaped body as if it were a propeller on a ship. The core at the center glows with different colors.

abilityOne.name: Analytic
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon will never charge recklessly, it will take a moment to think about the best decision to make in any situation.
abilityOne.effect: If this Pokemon has a lower initiative than its target, Add 1 Extra die to all of their Damage Pools.

abilityTwo.name: Natural Cure
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon's body will generate substances to heal itself. They can be used to create medicine.
abilityTwo.effect: At the end of the Round, if this Pokemon has a Status Ailment or Condition, Roll 3 Chance Dice to heal it.

move.name: Water Gun
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The fastest water gun in town. No enemy will remain dry

move.name: Swift
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Never Miss.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a burst of star-shaped sparkles at a blinding speed.

move.name: Rapid Spin
move.effect: Single Target. Increase the User's Dexterity by 1. Remove Entry Hazards, Terrains (ie Grassy Terrain, Misty Terrain), Ongoing Damage and Leech seed from the User and/or their side of the field.
move.description: The Pokémon makes a swift spin to strike at the foe and in the process everything laying close to the user is scattered out of the battlefield.

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Harden
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 1.
move.description: When life gets hard, do the same.

move.name: Confuse Ray
move.effect: Single Target. Confuse the Target.
move.description: The user flashes a sinister ray of bright light that others cannot help but go straight into it.

move.name: Spotlight
move.effect: Target One Ally. Reaction 3. All of the Foe's Moves will Target the Chosen Ally if able. Duration 1 Round.
move.description: The user points a focused light onto one of their allies. The ally can’t help but catch everyone’s attention into itself.

move.name: Psybeam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Confuse the Target.
move.description: The foe’s mind isassaulted by a mental ray, afterwards they may suffer from hallucinations.

move.name: Surf
move.effect: Area Move. If a Target is out of range due to the Move "Dive", this Move hits anyways. Out of battle, allows the Pokemon to travel the sea for long distances.
move.description: The Pokémon calls forward a large wave of seawater to ride, most Pokémon get washed out as they did not bring a surfboard.

move.name: Minimize
move.effect: Target Self. The User can now make up to 5 Evasions per Round. Reduce the User's Height and Weight in half. The user is now Vulernable to: Stomp. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The Pokémon compacts their body. Becoming a much smaller target to be difficult to hit. But a well placed stomp may leave them squished on the floor, though.

move.name: Light Screen
move.effect: Target the User's side of the field. Force Field. Activate a Force Field against Special Damage. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A barrier of light is created over half of the battlefield, all energy trying to go trough dissolves as it crosses it.

move.name: Recover
move.effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their energy to quickly mend wounds, their regenerative powers are beyond the imagination.

move.name: Cosmic Power
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon elevates their cosmos to enhance their physical and mental fortitude.

move.name: Power Gem
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: With a crystal gem, the Pokémon will always save the day!

move.name: Psychic
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: The most iconic Psychic attack, the foe starts floating in the air and its swayed around by telekinesis as their mental barrier crumbles.

move.name: Hydro Pump
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2
move.description: Water works best under pressure.

move.name: Expanding Force
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. *If Psychic Terrain is active, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move and you may add another target to it.
move.description: Psychic energies form a bubble of light to damage the foe. Under Psychic Terrain, the energy is so big it turns into a tall pillar that crushes anyone inside.

move.name: Shock Wave
move.effect: Single Target. Never Miss.
move.description: A series of lightning bolts rise through the floor towards the sky, it is impossible to predict where they are coming from.

move.name: Meteor Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Increase the User's Special by 1 the moment it begins charging.
move.description: The user overflows with galactic energy while summoning a small meteor to impact the foe. A theory suggests this move might have caused the extintion of prehistoric Pokémon.

name: Bellossom
description: They are plentiful in tropical areas. The beauty of the flowers on its head depends on how stinky it was as a Gloom. Lots of sunshine will make the skirt leaves swirl in a beautiful and rhythmic dance.

abilityOne.name: Chlorophyll
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon synthesizes sunlight to get energy, if it's kept in a sunny environment it will rarely need to eat.
abilityOne.effect: While Sunny Weather is active, Increase this Pokemon's Dexterity Attribute by 2.

abilityTwo.name: Healer
abilityTwo.description: The Pokemon has healing powers, and will use them without hesitation to aid others.
abilityTwo.effect: If an Ally on the battle field has a Status Ailment, at the End of the Round this Pokemon rolls 3 Chance Dice to heal it. Outside of battle it can heal Status Ailments by spending 1 Will Point.

move.name: Mega Drain
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The user absorbs a big amount of vital energy and nutrients from the target to feed from.

move.name: Teeter Dance
move.effect: Area Move. Confuse those affected.
move.description: The Pokémon dances with wobbly movements and erratic spins. The spectators don’t know what to make of these modern choreographies.

move.name: Swords Dance
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Strength by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon dances with strong steps and a fierce attitude as a ritual to prepare for battle.

move.name: Drain Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: A solid punch that weakens the foes and revitalizes the user with each hit.

move.name: Absorb
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The user takes nutrients from the nearest source of life they find.

move.name: Growth
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Special. If the Sunny Weather is active, increase by 2 Instead.
move.description: The Pokémon makes their body grow in size. They’ll get bigger and stronger in just a few seconds.

move.name: Sweet Scent
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Those affected cannot Evade Moves. Out of Battle, it will attract wild Pokemon.
move.description: The Pokémon releases a sweet aroma that lulls their enemies into a false sense of security

move.name: Acid
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Roll 1 Chance die to Reduce by 1 the Sp. Defense of those affected.
move.description: The Pokémon spits an acidic gunk into the foe that immediately gives burning sensation. Keep away from the eyes and wash with abundant water.

move.name: Poison Powder
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Powder Move. Poison the Target.
move.description: A cloud of noxius powder that immediately sends the target’s immune system into overdrive.

move.name: Stun Spore
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Powder Move. Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A cloud of paralyzing pollen that affects the nerves and cramps the muscles of those who inhale it.

move.name: Sleep Powder
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Powder Move. Put the Target to Sleep.
move.description: The Pokémon spouts a cloud of somniferous pollen to know out their foe, the only problem is that the foe must inhale enough of the pollen for it to take effect.

move.name: Moonlight
move.effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Night Time and Sunny Weather increase it to Complete Heal. Rain, Sandstorm and Hail Weather reduceto Minor Heal of 1 HP.
move.description: The Pokémon uses the moon’s power to heal their injuries.

move.name: Quiver Dance
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Dexterity, Special an Sp. Defense.
move.description: A mystical and beautiful dance that increases a Pokémon focus in combat.

move.name: Toxic
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Badly Poison the Target.
move.description: This burning acid dissolves skin to enter the bloodstream directly. The poor victim feels like they are melting from the inside out. The clock is ticking.

move.name: Sunny Day
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Activate Sunny Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The Pokémon will call for the sun to shine brighter, increasing the heat of the arena. This Move doesn’t work at night, indoors, or underground/water.

move.name: Magical Leaf
move.effect: Single Target. Never Miss.
move.description: The user sends out a floating leaf that will pursue the target until it hits.

move.name: Leaf Blade
move.effect: Single Target. High Critical. Lethal. Cutter Move.
move.description: Danger lies not on the material’s toughness but on its edge’s sharpness.

move.name: Grassy Terrain
move.effect: Target User's side of the field. Add 1 Extra Damage Dice to all Physical & Special Grass-Type Moves. Everyone on the User's side of the field heals 1 HP at the end of each Round. Spend 1 Will Point t activate. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A patch of grass grows in the area surrounding the user, through it nature grants her many blessings.

move.name: Grassy Glide
move.effect: Single Target. *If Grassy Terrain is active, this Move has Reaction 1.
move.description: A single leaf can hold the entire weight of the Pokémon. When moving, it appears to glide over the grass.

move.name: Leaf Storm
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Reduce the User's Special by 2.
move.description: A furious onslaught of sharp leaves blasting against the target. The user gives their all in this attack.

move.name: Moonblast
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Reduce Target's Special by 1.
move.description: The user becomes a champion of lunar justice. In the name of the moon, they will right the wrongs and triumph over evil!

move.name: Petal Blizzard
move.effect: Area Move. Ranged. Wind Move.
move.description: A raging blizzard of petals and leaves sweeps through the entire area, leaving a pleasant floral scent and destruction in its wake.

name: Exeggutor
description: Originally from tropical areas. Exeggutor's heads grow larger with strong sunlight. Each head thinks independently. They are friendly and provide their shade to other Pokémon.

abilityOne.name: Chlorophyll
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon synthesizes sunlight to get energy, if it's kept in a sunny environment it will rarely need to eat.
abilityOne.effect: While Sunny Weather is active, Increase this Pokemon's Dexterity Attribute by 2.

abilityTwo.name: Harvest
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon will naturally produce edible fruits in a short period of time, if fed with berries it will start growing them too.
abilityTwo.effect: If this Pokemon uses a berry as a held item during a fight, the berry will grow back at the end of the battle.

move.name: Hypnosis
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Put the Target to sleep. Dark-Type Pokemon are affected by this Move.
move.description: By staring at an hypnotic pendulum, the target is suggestioned to feel tired and close its eyelids.

move.name: Seed Bomb
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Projectile Move.
move.description: A giant seed is hurled against the target, the hit is not what knocks them down, the tree that explodes suddenly out of the seed is what does.

move.name: Stomp
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Die to Flinch the Target. Targets under the effects of the Move "Minimize" are vulnerable.
move.description: Stomping the foe with strong feet. Perfect to squish nasty little bugs.

move.name: Uproar
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Sound Move. This Effect Targets the Battle Field: Pokemon will be cured of the Sleep Status. Duration 1 Round.
move.description: Shouts, screams, and loud music... What does a Pokémon have to do here for a peaceful night of sleep?

move.name: Absorb
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The user takes nutrients from the nearest source of life they find.

move.name: Leech Seed
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Spend 1 Will point to activate. At the end of each Round, Roll 2 Dice of Typeless Damage against the target ignoring defenses. The User heals 1 HP for every damage dealt this way. Grass-Type Pokémon are immune to this Effect. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The foe is infected with seed saplings taking root on their body. As the saplings grow, they'll absorb the vital energy of the foe and send it back to the user.

move.name: Bullet Seed
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Successive Actions. Projectile Moves.
move.description: The Pokémon starts shooting seed as if they were a machine gun.

move.name: Confusion
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Confuse the Target.
move.description: A basic mental assault that makes the foe believe they are being attacked by an invisible enemy.

move.name: Mega Drain
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The user absorbs a big amount of vital energy and nutrients from the target to feed from.

move.name: Psyshock
move.effect: Single Target. This Move is resisted with the Target's Defense instead of its Sp. Defense.
move.description: The shock is mental, the blow is real.

move.name: Egg Bomb
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Ranged. Projectile Move.
move.description: The target can’t take a yolk. Let’s make them laugh with an egg-cellent pun to crack them up.

move.name: Extrasensory
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon alters their target’s senses, making it feel things that aren’t really there.

move.name: Worry Seed
move.effect: Single Target. Replace the Target's Ability with "Insomnia". Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon.
move.description: The user plants the seed of doubt and uncertainty on its foe. The foe becomes such a worrywart that they can’t even sleep at night.

move.name: Giga Drain
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The Pokémon drains most of the foe’s vital energy and feeds on the nutrients it managed to extract.

move.name: Reflect
move.effect: Target the User's side of the field. Force Field. Activate a Force Field against Physical Damage. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: An ethereal mirror-like wall cuts the battlefield in half, bouncing back the impact of most blows.

move.name: Solar Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. If Sunny Weather is active, you skip this Move's Charge action. If performed under Rain, Sandstorm or Hail/Snowy Weather, this Move takes two actions to Charge.
move.description: The Pokémon gathers sunlight but instead of being absorbed it is sot as a devastating beam of light instead.

move.name: Wood Hammer
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil.
move.description: The Pokémon creates a giant wooden hamer and it uses it to smash the foe with such force the hammer also explodes into wood splinters.

move.name: Leaf Storm
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Reduce the User's Special by 2.
move.description: A furious onslaught of sharp leaves blasting against the target. The user gives their all in this attack.

move.name: Terrain Pulse
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool if there is a Terrain active in the Battlefield. Change this Move's Type to match that of a currently active Terrain (ie Electric Terrain, Grassy Terrain, etc.).
move.description: The user shoots a pulse that absorbs the energy flowing in the area to devastate its foes.

move.name: Expanding Force
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. *If Psychic Terrain is active, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move and you may add another target to it.
move.description: Psychic energies form a bubble of light to damage the foe. Under Psychic Terrain, the energy is so big it turns into a tall pillar that crushes anyone inside.

move.name: Ingrain
move.effect: Target Self. The User heals 1 HP at the end of each Round. Spend 1 Will point to activate. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The Pokémon roots themselves to absorb nutrients directly from the ground.

name: Grubbin
description: They tend to gather anywhere Electric Pokémon live to protect themselves from bird Pokémon who may prey on them. When they are ready to evolve they bury themselves underground.

abilityOne.name: Swarm
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon enters a hive mind state when its life is on the line, calling upon a swarm to aid it in battle.
abilityOne.effect: Pain Penalization won't reduce successes from Accuracy or Damage rolls of Bug-Type Moves used by this Pokemon. Bug-Type Moves get 2 Extra dice to their Damage Pool when this Pokemon is at half HP or less.

move.name: Vice Grip
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal.
move.description: The Pokémon traps the foe with its pincers or jaws and applies pressure that will leave a nasty bruise.

move.name: String Shot
move.effect: Targets All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: The foe gets tangled in a fine silk string shot by the user. This silk can also be used to make fine clothes.

move.name: Mud Slap
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.
move.description: A mud ball splatters right into the foe’s face, reducing their field of vision.

move.name: Bug Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. If the target Pokemon is holding a berry, the User eats it and gains its effects.
move.description: The Pokémon nibbles at their foe in hopes of finding something tasty to snack on.

move.name: Spark
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The user engulfs itself with statc electricity then charges with a solid tackle against the foe. Sparks fly, very literally.

move.name: Acrobatics
move.effect: Single Target. *If the User has a Held Item, Reduce 2 Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move.
move.description: The Pokémon is quick and graceful, they cartwheel, contort and make a double back jump before landing onthe foe. Their best perfomance is done when they are unburdened.

move.name: X-Scissor
move.effect: Single Target. Cutter Move.
move.description: The Pokémon uses its scythes or clawa as if they were a pair of scissors to cut through the foe.

move.name: Electroweb
move.effect: Target All foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: An electrified web is shot towards the target, shoking and tangling them at the same time.

move.name: Harden
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 1.
move.description: When life gets hard, do the same.

move.name: Endure
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. If a Physical or Special Move would cause the user to faint, they remain at 1 HP instead, remove this effect afterwards. The effect re-activates on the user's next Turn. Whole Round duration.
move.description: The Pokémon mentally prepares to receive a fatal blow, their spirit is stronger than their body so they endure to keep on fighting for as long as possible.

move.name: Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe
move.description: The user lands a vicious bite, leaving an ugly bruise.

move.name: Sticky Web
move.effect: Target's Foe's Side of the Field. Entry Hazard. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of Foes that enter the battlefield. Pokemon with Immunity to Ground are not affected.
move.description: The Pokémon quickly covers the arena with a sticky web, newly arrived foes will have trouble moving with ease.

move.name: Dig
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Earth Power/ Earthquake/ Fissure/ Magnitude/ Stomping Tantrum. Out of battle allows the Pokemon to burrow and make underground tunnels.
move.description: The user digs a tunnel on the ground and attacks by coming out from below its target. This move has been used to escape caves and gain access to highly surveiled places.

move.name: Crunch
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Lethal. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the foe's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon viciously mauls, tears, and rips apart anything its fangs can come in contact with.

name: Combee
description: It forms hives around trees. It flies all day sipping the nectar from flowers to make honey. It is usually born a male. If a female is born, it will grow into a Vespiquen and start its own hive.

abilityOne.name: Honey Gather
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon produces its own honey, you can get a small barrel of high quality honey every day.
abilityOne.effect: A small barrel of honey can be sold for up to $100. Honey attracts wild Pokemon and feeding a Pokemon with it will make it happy.

abilityTwo.name: Hustle
abilityTwo.description: The Pokemon will perform everything in a hurry, it keeps itself busy, but it can be kind of sloppy when it rushes something out.
abilityTwo.effect: This Pokemon gets an Extra Low Accuracy 1 and adds 2 Extra Dice to the Damage pool for all its Physical Moves.

move.name: Sweet Scent
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Those affected cannot Evade Moves. Out of Battle, it will attract wild Pokemon.
move.description: The Pokémon releases a sweet aroma that lulls their enemies into a false sense of security

move.name: Gust
move.effect: Single Target. Wind Move. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop", this Move hits anyway.
move.description: The Pokémon flaps their wings and strikes the foe with a swirl of wind. Pokémon in the air may get swept away

move.name: Bug Buzz
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce by 1 the Sp. Defense of those affected.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their wings or a part of their bodies to emit distracting buzzes all around.

move.name: Bug Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. If the target Pokemon is holding a berry, the User eats it and gains its effects.
move.description: The Pokémon nibbles at their foe in hopes of finding something tasty to snack on.

move.name: Struggle Bug
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Special of those affected.
move.description: The Pokémon sends a distress signal through its antennae to interrupt the foe’s concentration.

move.name: Swift
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Never Miss.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a burst of star-shaped sparkles at a blinding speed.

move.name: Tailwind
move.effect: Target User's side of the Field. Wind Move. Increase by 2 the Dexterity of everyone on the User's side of the field. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: Flying Pokémon know better than anyone how to use the wind in their favor. Let its draft carry you to victory.

move.name: Ominous Wind
move.effect: Single Target. Wind Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Increase by 1 the User's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense and Sp. Defense.
move.description: The battlefield gets absolutely silent, the only noise is a cold wind draft that gives the target chills and goosebumps. Observing from the shadows, the user rejoices in the fear.

move.name: Endure
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. If a Physical or Special Move would cause the user to faint, they remain at 1 HP instead, remove this effect afterwards. The effect re-activates on the user's next Turn. Whole Round duration.
move.description: The Pokémon mentally prepares to receive a fatal blow, their spirit is stronger than their body so they endure to keep on fighting for as long as possible.

name: Dratini
description: Up until recently its existence was debated as being a mere legend, then a small colony was found underwater. It is still extremely rare to find. It sheds skin and grows larger every day.

abilityOne.name: Shed Skin
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon's body is constantly growing skin anew and molting the old one when it becomes too damaged.
abilityOne.effect: At the end of the round, if this Pokemon has a Status Ailment/Condition, Roll 3 Chance Dice to heal it. If affected by multiple Ailments/Conditons, one will be healed at random.

abilityTwo.name: Marvel Scale
abilityTwo.description: The beautiful scales of this Pokemon will harden when its body is under stress.
abilityTwo.effect: If this Pokemon has a Status Ailment, Increase its Defense Attribute by 2

move.name: Dragon Rush
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon rushes to charge against their foe. Unlucky victims end up crushed into the ground.

move.name: Safeguard
move.effect: Target User's side of the Field. Force Field. Those affected are immune to all Status Ailements/Conditions. Previously inflicted Status Ailments/Conditions remain. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A force field covers half of the battlefield and filters out all impurities and ill intentions coming from the other side.

move.name: Rain Dance
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Activate Rain Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The Pokémon performs a peculiar dance in the middle of the field, everyone thinks it silly until the first thunder rumbles.

move.name: Outrage
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
move.description: The true nature of dragon-types unleashed. The user is consumed by a primal fury that won’t stop until everything has ben razed to the ground. Afterwards the Pokémon is confused.

move.name: Hyper Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge. Lethal.
move.description: A devastating beam, a path of destruction that can extend for miles is the unmistakable proof someone used this Move. Let the user rest before trying to use it again.

move.name: Scale Shot
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged. Successive Actions. *If all 5 actions land successfully, Increase the User's Dexterity by 1, and lower the User's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon’s scales burst out as if they were shrapnel from a grenade.

move.name: Wrap
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion.
move.description: The Pokémon swiftly entangles their foe in a squeezing lock to prevent their escape.

move.name: Leer
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The vicious glare of a predator that triggers the flight response of their prey.

move.name: Thunder Wave
move.effect: Single Target. Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A series of electric waves hit the target, their voltage is too weak to cause much harm but muscles will get cramped for hours.

move.name: Twister
move.effect: Target all foes in Range. Wind Move. Roll 2 Chance dice to Flinch those affected. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop" this Move hits anyways.
move.description: A raging twister embedded with a dragon’s fury. No one wants to be trapped in this fearsome spiral, which almost touches the sky.

move.name: Dragon Rage
move.effect: Single Target. Set Damage. Deal 2 Dragon-Type Damage to the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon focuses their inner rage and makes it not-soinner anymore.

move.name: Slam
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1.
move.description: Everybody get up, it’s time to slam now.

move.name: Agility
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: Swift of body, swift of mind.

move.name: Dragon Tail
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Late Reaction 6. Switcher Move for the Foe. In the wild, the battle may end.
move.description: The Pokémon sends their opponent flying up to 100ft in the air with a strong flick of their tail.

move.name: Aqua Tail
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The user sways their tail to create a pocket whirlpool in which the foe gets sucked in by the spinning motion.

move.name: Dragon Dance
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Dexterity.
move.description: The user performs a vigorous and mystical dance to boost their fighting spirit and reflexes.

move.name: Aqua Jet
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1.
move.description: The Pokémon propels themselves with a jet of pressured water.

move.name: Extreme Speed
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 2. Out of battle, triple the Pokemon's movement speed.
move.description: Gotta go extremely fast.

name: Ludicolo
description: Ludicolo starts dancing at the sound of music. Pokémon and people will dance as well. They are said to appear when children sing. They love festive places and parties.

abilityOne.name: Rain Dish
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon will store rain water for drink and nourishment.
abilityOne.effect: While Rain Weather is active, you may restore 1 HP to this Pokemon at the end of each Round.

abilityTwo.name: Swift Swim
abilityTwo.description: The Pokemon will move faster in water than on land, even a puddle-covered roadway will allow it to use its full speed.
abilityTwo.effect: While Rain Weather is active, Increase this Pokemon's Dexterity Attribute by 2.

hiddenAbility.name: Own Tempo
hiddenAbility.description: This Pokemon will do everything at its own pace, peer pressure will be ignored. Its behavior reflexive and calm... maybe too calm.
hiddenAbility.effect: This Pokemon is not affected by the Confused Status Condition.

move.name: Astonish
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe.
move.description: The user sneaks behind their target to jump scare them.

move.name: Growl
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Reduce by 1 the Strength of those affected.
move.description: Either through a menacing attitude or an adorable demeanor, the foe will hesitate to attack the user at full power.

move.name: Entrainment
move.effect: Single Target. Replace the Target's Ability with the User's. Unique Abilities can't be passed or replaced. Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon.
move.description: The Pokémon trains and teaches their best ability to their target. The target becomes a master of this ability in a record time.

move.name: Absorb
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The user takes nutrients from the nearest source of life they find.

move.name: Water Gun
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The fastest water gun in town. No enemy will remain dry

move.name: Nature Power
move.effect: Single Target. *The Type of this Move is determined by the environment or active Terrain. See more on p. 530
move.description: The Pokémon makes use of the terrain and asks for nature's aid in battle.

move.name: Teeter Dance
move.effect: Area Move. Confuse those affected.
move.description: The Pokémon dances with wobbly movements and erratic spins. The spectators don’t know what to make of these modern choreographies.

move.name: Fury Swipes
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions.
move.description: With their sharp claws, the Pokémon will swiftly scatch their foe, leaving its face full of small cuts.

move.name: Fake Out
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Flinch the Target. This Move will only work on the First Round the User is out in battle. from the Second Round on, it will fail automatically.
move.description: The Pokémon pretends to be getting ready for the battle when they are actually prepairing a surprise attack on the foe.

move.name: Mist
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Targets cannot have their Attributes or Traits Reduced. Previously Reduced Attributes and Traits remain. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A thick layer of mist cloaks a pack of pokémon, those with the intent to trick and weaken them will have to find them first.

move.name: Mega Drain
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The user absorbs a big amount of vital energy and nutrients from the target to feed from.

move.name: Knock Off
move.effect: Single Target. *If the Target is holding an Item, Add 2 Dice to the Damage pool of this Move. The Target loses its Held Item afterwards.
move.description: The Pokémon rudely smacks what their foe was holding.

move.name: Flail
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of this Move for every missing Point of HP the user has. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The user flails around trying to stay alive, as they get closer to fainting, more adrenaline will fuel their efforts of survival.

move.name: Bubble Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 1.
move.description: A powerful stream of foamy bubbles shot straight into the foe

move.name: Rain Dance
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Activate Rain Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The Pokémon performs a peculiar dance in the middle of the field, everyone thinks it silly until the first thunder rumbles.

move.name: Energy Ball
move.effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: Gathering nature’s energy from nearby plants, trees and roots, the Pokémon forms a ball to shoot at the enemy. Sadly, the surrounding plants will be dry afterwards.

move.name: Zen Headbutt
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses both their mental and physical prowess in a questionable yet effective “psychic” strike.

move.name: Giga Drain
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The Pokémon drains most of the foe’s vital energy and feeds on the nutrients it managed to extract.

move.name: Counter
