move.description: Without regard for their own safety, the Pokémon does a reckless attack against their foe.

move.name: Perish Song
move.effect: Area Move. Sound Move. Three Rounds after this Move is used, deal damage to those affected equal to their remaining HP. Removing from battle prevents this effect.
move.description: A song for mourning the departed. Although it sounds beautiful, it fills the heart with grief and despair, making the listeners feel as if they were laying on their death bed.

move.name: Hydro Pump
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2
move.description: Water works best under pressure.

move.name: Icy Wind
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Wind Move. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: Polar winds sweep through the arena. Everyone starts to shiver and embrace themselves, trying to preserve a bit of warmth.

move.name: Echoed Voice
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. This Move can be used many times in the same Round. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage pool of this move for each time you use it. Up to 8 Dice might be added this way. Reset this effect if the user performs another move, evasion or clash.
move.description: The Pokémon yells at the void. Their echo answers. The Pokémon yells louder and louder everytime the echo talks back.

name: Pansage
description: Pansage is a friendly Pokémon. It is good at finding berries and will share them with other Pokémon. The leaves on its head have medicinal properties; if it finds a sick Pokémon, it will offer some to heal it.

abilityOne.name: Overgrow
abilityOne.description: When this Pokemon is hurt, it will grow huge plants on its body to defend itself, these plants are very strong but wither quickly.
abilityOne.effect: Pain Penalization won't reduce successes from Accuracy or Damage rolls of Grass-Type Moves used by this Pokemon. Grass-Type Moves get 2 Extra dice to their Damage Pool when this Pokemon is at half HP or less.

abilityTwo.name: Gluttony
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon eats all day long, it is always carrying food and has no problem to find food sources since it's not a picky eater. It, however, doesn't share.
abilityTwo.effect: This Pokemon can eat any type of food, medicine or herbal medicine with no negative. This pokemon may have up to three berries as held item instead of just one. The berries must not be of the same effect.

move.name: Grass Knot
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Damage Dice for every 50kg of weight on the foe, up to 4 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The user snares the foe’s feet with a grass tangle to make it fall into the ground. The bigger they are, the harder they fall.

move.name: Scratch
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their sharp claws to scratch the enemy. Nothing fancy but it works.

move.name: Play Nice
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Strength by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon starts to play with the foe. They are firendly, respectful, and thank the foe for the fun time. The foe does not want to fight, they want to keep playing.

move.name: Leer
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The vicious glare of a predator that triggers the flight response of their prey.

move.name: Lick
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon licks the foe. The foe is deeply disturbed by this creepy display of “affection”.

move.name: Fury Swipes
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions.
move.description: With their sharp claws, the Pokémon will swiftly scatch their foe, leaving its face full of small cuts.

move.name: Leech Seed
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Spend 1 Will point to activate. At the end of each Round, Roll 2 Dice of Typeless Damage against the target ignoring defenses. The User heals 1 HP for every damage dealt this way. Grass-Type Pokémon are immune to this Effect. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The foe is infected with seed saplings taking root on their body. As the saplings grow, they'll absorb the vital energy of the foe and send it back to the user.

move.name: Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe
move.description: The user lands a vicious bite, leaving an ugly bruise.

move.name: Seed Bomb
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Projectile Move.
move.description: A giant seed is hurled against the target, the hit is not what knocks them down, the tree that explodes suddenly out of the seed is what does.

move.name: Torment
move.effect: Single Target. The Target cannot use any of the Moves it used during the last Round. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The Pokémon bullies their foe to the point of torment where they cannot keep using their strategy without feeling bad about it.

move.name: Recycle
move.effect: Target Self. The Pokemon reuses an Item (Berries, Potions, Full Heal, etc.) that has already been spent during the battle on any side of the battlefield. Recycle can't be used more than 3 times per battle by the User.
move.description: One Pokémon’s trash is another one’s treasure.

move.name: Natural Gift
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. The User loes its held berry. *The Type of this Move changes according to the berry used. See more on p. 530
move.description: The user throws their held berry at the foe, the myriad of flavors has surprisingly different results.

move.name: Grass Whistle
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Sound Move. Put the Target to Sleep.
move.description: A soothing and relaxing melody created with the sounds of nature. It is a very subtle tone, so it may be hard to listen.

move.name: Nasty Plot
move.effect: Target Self. Increase User's Special by 2.
move.description: Rubbing both hands and laughing sinisterly the Pokémon rejoices in the evil plans they’ll soon carry out.

move.name: Giga Drain
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The Pokémon drains most of the foe’s vital energy and feeds on the nutrients it managed to extract.

move.name: Vine Whip
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses its body vines to give the foe a good smack. These vines can be as long as 20 feet and quite surdy as ropes.

move.name: Fling
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. *If the User is holding an Item, Add up to 4 dice to the damage pool. User loses its Held Item. See p. 530
move.description: The Pokémon takes their held item, uses it as a weapon and the referee is somehow OK with this. The held item remains in the field and may be recovered after the battle.

move.name: Acrobatics
move.effect: Single Target. *If the User has a Held Item, Reduce 2 Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move.
move.description: The Pokémon is quick and graceful, they cartwheel, contort and make a double back jump before landing onthe foe. Their best perfomance is done when they are unburdened.

move.name: Grass Pledge
move.effect: Area Move. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected. This Effect Targets the Battle Field: Entry Hazard. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of Target's that enter the battlefield. Pokemon with Immunity to Ground are not affected.
move.description: The Pokémon chants to invoke the power of grass, their pledge is heard and the ground crumbles as vegetation grapples and traps everyone in the field.

move.name: Crunch
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Lethal. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the foe's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon viciously mauls, tears, and rips apart anything its fangs can come in contact with.

name: Pinsir (Mega Form)
description: With the power of the Mega Stone, it develops wings and inhuman strength. It can lift foes heavier than itself and still fly with ease. Its mind is in a constant state of excitement and it cannot stay still.

abilityOne.name: Aerilate
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon never touches the ground, a neverending wind current can be felt swirling around it.
abilityOne.effect: Normal-Type Moves that the Pokemon uses will deal damage as if they were Flying-Type, affecting STAB, weakness and resistance. Add 1 Extra die to the Damage Pool of Flying moves.

move.name: Bind
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Increase the Target's difficultty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion.
move.description: The Pokémon uses all their strength to restrain to the foe and keep them in place.

move.name: Bug Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. If the target Pokemon is holding a berry, the User eats it and gains its effects.
move.description: The Pokémon nibbles at their foe in hopes of finding something tasty to snack on.

move.name: Vice Grip
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal.
move.description: The Pokémon traps the foe with its pincers or jaws and applies pressure that will leave a nasty bruise.

move.name: Focus Energy
move.effect: Target Self. All of the user's Physical & Special Moves now have "High Critical". Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The Pokémon concentrates all their focus on the battle to make their attacks much more precise.

move.name: Seismic Toss
move.effect: Single Target. Roll Fight-Type Damage Dice according to the User's Rank: Starter 1 Die / Rookie 2 Dice / Standard 4 Dice/ Advacned 6 Dice / Expert 8 Dice / Ace and forward 10 Dice. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The foe gets launched up to the sky, then falls face-first into the ground making it tremble. The stronger the user, the higher the launch.

move.name: Harden
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 1.
move.description: When life gets hard, do the same.

move.name: Revenge
move.effect: Single Target. *If the User has already received Damage this Round, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.
move.description: Best served cold.

move.name: Brick Break
move.effect: Single Target. *If there is a Force field on the Target's side of the field, destroy it and add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.
move.description: The Pokémon uses a karate technique to chop through tall piles of bricks. No matter how many layers you pile up, they’ll break regardless.

move.name: Iron Defense
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
move.description: Iron body, iron will. This Pokémon is unbreakable.

move.name: Stealth Rock
move.effect: Target Foe's Side of the Field. Entry Hazard. Pokemon entering the battle Receive 1 Rock-Type Damage. This effect does not stack.
move.description: The Pokémon hides a trap of sharp rocks that are launched at the victim before they even realize what even happened.

move.name: Feint Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Never Miss.
move.description: The user approaches inconspicuously, pretending to attack the foe directly, then actually hits the foe from behind.

move.name: Storm Throw
move.effect: Single Target. This Move is always considered to be a Critical Hit and gets the proper Bonus for it.
move.description: The user throws its foe with a special technique, the foe lands right on their weak spot.

move.name: Vital Throw
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 1. Never Miss.
move.description: You don’t need to go to the enemy, let them come to you.

move.name: Double Hit
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Double Action.
move.description: The Pokémon uses the true and tested “one-two”.

move.name: Submission
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Recoil.
move.description: The Pokémon wrestles their foe to subdue it, but the foe will put up a fight before they let it happen.

move.name: X-Scissor
move.effect: Single Target. Cutter Move.
move.description: The Pokémon uses its scythes or clawa as if they were a pair of scissors to cut through the foe.

move.name: Strength
move.effect: Outside of battle, using this move allows the Pokemon to lift double the normal weight it should be able to.
move.description: The Pokemon strains its muscles to go beyond their own limits.

move.name: Thrash
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
move.description: The Pokémon becomes a wild thing and the rumpus has started.

move.name: Swords Dance
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Strength by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon dances with strong steps and a fierce attitude as a ritual to prepare for battle.

move.name: Superpower
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Reduce by 1 the User's Strength and Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon packs all their power in a single crushing strike. All this effort leaves them quite tired afterwards.

move.name: Guillotine
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 5. Deal Damage equal to the Target's Remaining HP, plus 1 Lethal Damage.
move.description: Fueled by the spirit of revolution the Pokémon sentences their foe to be reduced at the neck. This devastating attack requires an emergency trip to the Pokémon Center...and a basket.

name: Seedot
description: They attach to tree branches to suck moisture from them. While immobile, the young are identical to real acorns. They enjoy scaring other Pokémon, especially Pidgey. If they fall, they are at risk of being eaten.

abilityOne.name: Chlorophyll
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon synthesizes sunlight to get energy, if it's kept in a sunny environment it will rarely need to eat.
abilityOne.effect: While Sunny Weather is active, Increase this Pokemon's Dexterity Attribute by 2.

abilityTwo.name: Early Bird
abilityTwo.description: Pokemon with this ability are light sleepers that will easily rise from slumber. They wake up full of energy with just a couple hours of sleep.
abilityTwo.effect: The time this Pokemon would be asleep is reduced by half and it will only need to score 2 successes on its Insight roll to wake up in battle. This effect does not apply for the Move "Rest".

hiddenAbility.name: Pickpocket
hiddenAbility.description: The Pokemon will instinctively steal from others. It takes whatever it can when people are not looking.
hiddenAbility.effect: If this Pokemon is not holding an Item it will steal the held Item of the foe it just hit with a Non-Ranged Physical Move.

move.name: Nature Power
move.effect: Single Target. *The Type of this Move is determined by the environment or active Terrain. See more on p. 530
move.description: The Pokémon makes use of the terrain and asks for nature's aid in battle.

move.name: Sunny Day
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Activate Sunny Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The Pokémon will call for the sun to shine brighter, increasing the heat of the arena. This Move doesn’t work at night, indoors, or underground/water.

move.name: Grassy Terrain
move.effect: Target User's side of the field. Add 1 Extra Damage Dice to all Physical & Special Grass-Type Moves. Everyone on the User's side of the field heals 1 HP at the end of each Round. Spend 1 Will Point t activate. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A patch of grass grows in the area surrounding the user, through it nature grants her many blessings.

move.name: Worry Seed
move.effect: Single Target. Replace the Target's Ability with "Insomnia". Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon.
move.description: The user plants the seed of doubt and uncertainty on its foe. The foe becomes such a worrywart that they can’t even sleep at night.

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Harden
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 1.
move.description: When life gets hard, do the same.

move.name: Bide
move.effect: Single Target. The User will not Evade or Clash the next 2 Physical or Special Moves targeting it. Once all damage has been dealt against the User, roll a number of Normal-Type Damage dice equal to twice the total amount of Damage the Target received. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The user puts up with being hit, waiting for the perfect opportunity to retaliate.

move.name: Absorb
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The user takes nutrients from the nearest source of life they find.

move.name: Astonish
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe.
move.description: The user sneaks behind their target to jump scare them.

move.name: Growth
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Special. If the Sunny Weather is active, increase by 2 Instead.
move.description: The Pokémon makes their body grow in size. They’ll get bigger and stronger in just a few seconds.

move.name: Mega Drain
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The user absorbs a big amount of vital energy and nutrients from the target to feed from.

move.name: Payback
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move if the User has already received Damage from the Target this Round.
move.description: Some say the best revenge is a successful and happy life, but not this Pokémon.

move.name: Synthesis
move.effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will Point to activate. If Sunny Weather is in effect, this Move becomes a Complete Heal. If performed under Rain, Sandstorm, Hail or Snowy Weather, this Move is a Minor heal and only heals 1 HP.
move.description: The Pokémon gathers sunlight to re-energize themselves.

move.name: Sucker Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 6. *This move can only be used as a Late Reaction; and only if the Target used a Physical or Special Move, otherwise it will fail.
move.description: The Pokémon takes advantage of their foe preparing to attack to unleash a dirty surprise blow.

move.name: Explosion
move.effect: Area Move. Ranged. Lethal. The User Faints.
move.description: Through a massive explosion the Pokémon destroys all they can before fainting. Sometimes the only way to get out of a bad situation is in bits and pieces.

move.name: Grassy Glide
move.effect: Single Target. *If Grassy Terrain is active, this Move has Reaction 1.
move.description: A single leaf can hold the entire weight of the Pokémon. When moving, it appears to glide over the grass.

name: Swadloon
description: Preferring dark and damp places, it spends the entire day inside of rotting logs. It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves. It's kind of moody and it likes to remain undisturbed.

abilityOne.name: Leaf Guard
abilityOne.description: The leaves on this Pokemon's body expand with the sun to completely cover and shield it from superficial damage. They may need to be pruned often.
abilityOne.effect: While Sunny Weather is active, this Pokemon can't have any Status Ailments or Conditions inflicted. Previously inflicted ailments/conditions remain.

abilityTwo.name: Overcoat
abilityTwo.description: The Pokemon will have a protective coat surrounding its body that allows it to live under extreme weather conditions.
abilityTwo.effect: This Pokemon won't recieve damage from active weather.

move.name: String Shot
move.effect: Targets All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: The foe gets tangled in a fine silk string shot by the user. This silk can also be used to make fine clothes.

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Razor Leaf
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Cutter Move. Ranged. High Critical.
move.description: The user sends out a barrage of sharp razor-like leaves. “Death by a thousand cuts” would be the best depiction.

move.name: Bug Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. If the target Pokemon is holding a berry, the User eats it and gains its effects.
move.description: The Pokémon nibbles at their foe in hopes of finding something tasty to snack on.

move.name: Grass Whistle
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Sound Move. Put the Target to Sleep.
move.description: A soothing and relaxing melody created with the sounds of nature. It is a very subtle tone, so it may be hard to listen.

move.name: Protect
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokemon would receive from a Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Moves that target the user.
move.description: A mighty energy shield materializes in front of the user to to deflect attacks and dispel ill effects.

move.name: Camouflage
move.effect: Target Self. For the rest of the scene the User changes type to one that fits the terrain/ environment it is in (ie User is in a rocky cave, becoming rock type).
move.description: The Pokémon blends with their surroundings to increase their chances of survival.

move.name: Iron Defense
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
move.description: Iron body, iron will. This Pokémon is unbreakable.

move.name: Seed Bomb
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Projectile Move.
move.description: A giant seed is hurled against the target, the hit is not what knocks them down, the tree that explodes suddenly out of the seed is what does.

move.name: Struggle Bug
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Special of those affected.
move.description: The Pokémon sends a distress signal through its antennae to interrupt the foe’s concentration.

move.name: Endure
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. If a Physical or Special Move would cause the user to faint, they remain at 1 HP instead, remove this effect afterwards. The effect re-activates on the user's next Turn. Whole Round duration.
move.description: The Pokémon mentally prepares to receive a fatal blow, their spirit is stronger than their body so they endure to keep on fighting for as long as possible.

move.name: Bug Buzz
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce by 1 the Sp. Defense of those affected.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their wings or a part of their bodies to emit distracting buzzes all around.

name: Toxel
description: Toxel secrete poison through their skin. The closer they are to evolving, the brighter their skin color becomes. They need a lot of nurturing but are bad-tempered and ill-mannered, so not many take the task.

abilityOne.name: Rattled
abilityOne.description: When this scaredy Pokemon becomes startled or scared it will make haste to get away from danger.
abilityOne.effect: The first time this Pokemon is hit by a Bug, Dark, or Ghost-Type Move, or if a foe has the Ability "Intimidate", Increase its Dexterity Attribute by 1.

abilityTwo.name: Static
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon's body is always ready to let off a jolt of static electricity at the slightest touch.
abilityTwo.effect: When hit by a Non-Ranged Physical Move, this Pokemon rolls 3 Chance Dice to inflict Paralysis on the foe.

hiddenAbility.name: Klutz
hiddenAbility.description: This Pokemon does not understand how to use tools correctly, usually using them in unexpected ways.
hiddenAbility.effect: Held items won't have any effect on this Pokemon. Items that allow the Pokemon to Mega Evolve, use Z-Moves, go Dynamax/Gigantamax or Change type are not affected.

move.name: Nuzzle
move.effect: Single Target. Paralyze the foe.
move.description: The Pokémon gives a cute nuzzle at their target, it looks adorable until you see the sparks.

move.name: Rest
move.effect: Target Self. Complete Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Put the User to Sleep.
move.description: Yeah, this seems like a good spot to take a nap.

move.name: Round
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. *If the user and an ally are able to use Round. Both may choose to do it at the same time. If they do, add 3 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of both Pokemon.
move.description: The user attacks the foe with the power of music, if another one joins the performance, the musical harmony will rock their public!

move.name: Tearful Look
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce by 1 the Target's Strength and Special.
move.description: The Pokémon’s eyes start watering as if it were about to cry, it’s foe is moved by the tears and loses its will to fight.

move.name: Growl
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Reduce by 1 the Strength of those affected.
move.description: Either through a menacing attitude or an adorable demeanor, the foe will hesitate to attack the user at full power.

move.name: Flail
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of this Move for every missing Point of HP the user has. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The user flails around trying to stay alive, as they get closer to fainting, more adrenaline will fuel their efforts of survival.

move.name: Acid
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Roll 1 Chance die to Reduce by 1 the Sp. Defense of those affected.
move.description: The Pokémon spits an acidic gunk into the foe that immediately gives burning sensation. Keep away from the eyes and wash with abundant water.

move.name: Encore
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 3. The Target will repeat the exact same action sequence it had last Round. Target must have had an action sequence. Duration 1 Round. If used on the previous Round, this move fails. See more on p. 529.
move.description: The Pokémon makes a standing ovation at their target, prompting them to repeat everything they just did, exactly the way they did it.

move.name: Belch
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Sound Move. The user must eat a berry or something similar during the Round before using this Move, otherwise it will fail. This effect only works once per berry/food eaten.
move.description: The user shoots a blast of venomous pins that inject venom into the foe, this venom is specially potent against those already compromised.

name: Phione
description: There have been sightings of small groups of similar Pokémon but its existence has never been confirmed. Rumor has it that they are Manaphy's prodigal children.

abilityOne.name: Hydration
abilityOne.description: The body of the Pokemon absorbs water and uses its moisture to maintain a healthy state.
abilityOne.effect: When Rain weather is active, this Pokemon will cure all Status Ailments and Conditions it is affected with at the end of the round.

move.name: Water Gun
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The fastest water gun in town. No enemy will remain dry

move.name: Water Sport
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Physical & Special Fire-Type Moves have Power 0. Pokemon weak to Fire-Type Moves won't receive Super-Effective Damage from them. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A single drop of water can’t put off a raging fire, but what is the ocean but a collection of drops.

move.name: Charm
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce Target's Strength by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon engages their foe in a charming interaction to reduce their aggressive intent.

move.name: Confusion
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Confuse the Target.
move.description: A basic mental assault that makes the foe believe they are being attacked by an invisible enemy.

move.name: Bubble
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: Dozens of bubbles are sent floating through the battlefield. The foes can’t resist the temptation to burst the pretty bubbles, only for the bubbles to explode for real when they do.

move.name: Supersonic
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Sound Move. Confuse the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a series of ultrasonic waves that mess with the foe by making it feel dizzy and disoriented.

move.name: Whirlpool
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion. Duration 4 Rounds. If a Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dive", this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The foe is swallowed inside of a violent swirling whirlpool. Trapping them on the violent currents, barely managing to stay afloat.

move.name: Acid Armor
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
move.description: Highly acidic goop oozes through the pores of this Pokémon. Touching it immediately causes a burning pain. Preventing foes from getting too close.

move.name: Water Pulse
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target.
move.description: The user sends out a pulsing ring of water that blasts the foe with ultrasonic waves. For a while, everything seems as if reflected in the water ripples.

move.name: Aqua Ring
move.effect: Target Self. The User heals 1 HP at the end of each Round. Spend 1 Will point to activate. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The Pokémon coats themselves in fresh water.

move.name: Zen Headbutt
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses both their mental and physical prowess in a questionable yet effective “psychic” strike.

move.name: Dive
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Scald/ Surf/ Whirlpool/ Freeze-Dry/ Sheer Cold. Out of battle allows the Pokemon to move underwater carrying someone without risk of drowning.
move.description: Just look at the world around you right here on the ocean floor, such wonderful things surround you. What more are you lookin’ for?

move.name: Bubble Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 1.
move.description: A powerful stream of foamy bubbles shot straight into the foe

move.name: Moonblast
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Reduce Target's Special by 1.
move.description: The user becomes a champion of lunar justice. In the name of the moon, they will right the wrongs and triumph over evil!

move.name: Take Heart
move.effect: Target Self. Heal any Status Ailment on the User. Increase by 1 the User's Special and Sp. Defense.
move.description: There’s something only you can do so that this blue planet doesn’t lose it’s light. Believe in yourself and show your brave heart.

move.name: Rain Dance
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Activate Rain Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The Pokémon performs a peculiar dance in the middle of the field, everyone thinks it silly until the first thunder rumbles.

move.name: Surf
move.effect: Area Move. If a Target is out of range due to the Move "Dive", this Move hits anyways. Out of battle, allows the Pokemon to travel the sea for long distances.
move.description: The Pokémon calls forward a large wave of seawater to ride, most Pokémon get washed out as they did not bring a surfboard.

move.name: Hydro Pump
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2
move.description: Water works best under pressure.

move.name: Bounce
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Thunder / Twister / Sky Uppercut / Gust / Hurricane / Smack Down. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon jumps at least 30 feet in the air before landing with a mighty stomp on top of the foe. While in the air it is safe from most treaths but its still vulnerable to bad weather.

move.name: Heal Bell
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Sound Move. Cure any Status Ailment on the Targets.
move.description: The soothing chime of a magical bell cleanses all impurities.

move.name: Helping Hand
move.effect: Target One Ally. Reaction 5. The Target Gets 2 Extra Dice on their next Skill Check/Accuracy Roll, and 2 Extra Dice on their next Damage Roll. This Effect does not Stack.
move.description: The Pokémon is the first to come and give a hand to their friend. A true bro.

move.name: Last Resort
move.effect: Single Target. This Move will fail if the User has not successfully performed all of its known Moves at least once during the battle.
move.description: The Pokémon may be out of energy, but never out of options.

name: Sewaddle
description: It is a sweet Pokémon that loves its family. It hides its head in the leaf hood while it is sleeping. The silk they produce is highly valued to make expensive clothing; this makes it a popular pet for fashion designers.

abilityOne.name: Swarm
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon enters a hive mind state when its life is on the line, calling upon a swarm to aid it in battle.
abilityOne.effect: Pain Penalization won't reduce successes from Accuracy or Damage rolls of Bug-Type Moves used by this Pokemon. Bug-Type Moves get 2 Extra dice to their Damage Pool when this Pokemon is at half HP or less.

abilityTwo.name: Chlorophyll
abilityTwo.description: The Pokemon synthesizes sunlight to get energy, if it's kept in a sunny environment it will rarely need to eat.
abilityTwo.effect: While Sunny Weather is active, Increase this Pokemon's Dexterity Attribute by 2.

hiddenAbility.name: Overcoat
hiddenAbility.description: The Pokemon will have a protective coat surrounding its body that allows it to live under extreme weather conditions.
hiddenAbility.effect: This Pokemon won't recieve damage from active weather.

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: String Shot
move.effect: Targets All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: The foe gets tangled in a fine silk string shot by the user. This silk can also be used to make fine clothes.

move.name: Bug Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. If the target Pokemon is holding a berry, the User eats it and gains its effects.
move.description: The Pokémon nibbles at their foe in hopes of finding something tasty to snack on.

move.name: Struggle Bug
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Special of those affected.
move.description: The Pokémon sends a distress signal through its antennae to interrupt the foe’s concentration.

move.name: Endure
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. If a Physical or Special Move would cause the user to faint, they remain at 1 HP instead, remove this effect afterwards. The effect re-activates on the user's next Turn. Whole Round duration.
move.description: The Pokémon mentally prepares to receive a fatal blow, their spirit is stronger than their body so they endure to keep on fighting for as long as possible.

move.name: Sticky Web
move.effect: Target's Foe's Side of the Field. Entry Hazard. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of Foes that enter the battlefield. Pokemon with Immunity to Ground are not affected.
move.description: The Pokémon quickly covers the arena with a sticky web, newly arrived foes will have trouble moving with ease.

move.name: Bug Buzz
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce by 1 the Sp. Defense of those affected.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their wings or a part of their bodies to emit distracting buzzes all around.

move.name: Flail
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of this Move for every missing Point of HP the user has. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The user flails around trying to stay alive, as they get closer to fainting, more adrenaline will fuel their efforts of survival.

move.name: Baton Pass
move.effect: Target Self. Switcher Move for the User. Any Attribute increase on the user is passed on the next Pokemon. The user can't increase its own Attributes again until the end of the scene or until the switched Pokemon faints.
move.description: The Pokémon rallies through the battle, setting up everything for the next companion as they know this is a team effort.

move.name: Camouflage
move.effect: Target Self. For the rest of the scene the User changes type to one that fits the terrain/ environment it is in (ie User is in a rocky cave, becoming rock type).
move.description: The Pokémon blends with their surroundings to increase their chances of survival.

move.name: Silver Wind
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Increase by 1 the User's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense, and Sp. Defense.
move.description: A beautiful but dangerous wind that blows a silver powder against the foe. The performance may give the user a big confidence boost.

move.name: Razor Leaf
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Cutter Move. Ranged. High Critical.
move.description: The user sends out a barrage of sharp razor-like leaves. “Death by a thousand cuts” would be the best depiction.

name: Slakoth
description: They laze around 20 hours a day, barely even eating. Slakoth remain motionless no matter what. It's very rare to see this Pokémon doing anything; most of them never even bother to evolve.

abilityOne.name: Truant
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon is extremely lazy. They won't make even the tiniest effort to do anything even in the heat of battle.
abilityOne.effect: Roll this Pokemon's Loyalty every other turn, and score at least 2 successes. If the roll fails this Pokemon refuses to act. If it is successful it may act normally.

move.name: Scratch
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their sharp claws to scratch the enemy. Nothing fancy but it works.

move.name: Yawn
move.effect: Single Target. *If the Target has not been removed from battle at the beginning of the next Round, put it to Sleep.
move.description: The user yawns, the foe yawns, the trainers yawn... everyone should take a nap.

move.name: Encore
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 3. The Target will repeat the exact same action sequence it had last Round. Target must have had an action sequence. Duration 1 Round. If used on the previous Round, this move fails. See more on p. 529.
move.description: The Pokémon makes a standing ovation at their target, prompting them to repeat everything they just did, exactly the way they did it.

move.name: Feint Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Never Miss.
move.description: The user approaches inconspicuously, pretending to attack the foe directly, then actually hits the foe from behind.

move.name: Amnesia
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Sp. Defense by 2.
move.description: No thoughts. Head empty

move.name: Covet
move.effect: Single Target. The User steals the Target's Held Item. If the User already has a Held Item, this effect fails.
move.description: The Pokémon is attracted to shiny and colorful items. They don’t understand when something is not theirs for the taking so they just take it when no one is looking.

move.name: Chip Away
move.effect: Single Target. Ignore Cover & Substitute decoys. Ignore Defenses. Remove effects that increase Evasion Actions from the Target (ie Moves like: Double Team, Minimize. Abilities like: Sand Veil)
move.description: Bit by bit the Pokémon finds an opening though all layers of defense their target has until there is nothing left to protect it from a direct strike.

move.name: Counter
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 5. Can only be used if Target's last Move on User was a Physical Move. For damage, roll dice equal to Target's last damage pool rolled against the User plus 2 dice. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The Pokémon strikes back at their foe. Showing they can take a hit and punch even harder.

move.name: Flail
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of this Move for every missing Point of HP the user has. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The user flails around trying to stay alive, as they get closer to fainting, more adrenaline will fuel their efforts of survival.

move.name: After You
move.effect: Target One Ally. Reaction 1. The Target will go First in the Initiative Order. If used again, the previous target reverts to their original Initiative order. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The user bows and courteously lets a friend go first.

move.name: Sleep Talk
move.effect: If the user is not asleep, this Move fails. Instead of making a roll to try to wake up, the user may choose to use Sleep Talk instead. Choose a Move on the user's Move set at random and Target Random foe with it. Sleep Talk can be repeated up to 5 times per Round.
move.description: Despite being asleep, the Pokémon keeps dreaming about the battle. They talk incoherences and even sleep walk.

move.name: Slack Off
move.effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate.
move.description: Some Pokémon fight by giving their maximum effort all the time, they are doing it wrong.

move.name: Rest
move.effect: Target Self. Complete Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Put the User to Sleep.
move.description: Yeah, this seems like a good spot to take a nap.

move.name: Headbutt
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Out of battle it may cause a Random encounter when hitting trees and make objects drop from high places.
move.description: The Pokémon rams against their foe with their head. This Move is perfect to shake down trees when looking for berries, but beware of wild Pokémon nesting at the treetops.

move.name: Play Rough
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 1 Chance Dice to Reduce Target's Strength by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon and their foe start a playful wrestle that soon escalates into a furious wrestling match.

move.name: Substitute
move.effect: Target Self. Deal 2 damage to the User. Put a Substitute Decoy with 2 HP and the same defenses as the user. See p. 531
move.description: The Pokémon disappears in a poof of smoke. A decoy identical to the user takes their place in battle. The user keeps attacking from the shadows while the decoy serves as distraction.

name: Eiscue
description: This Pokemon keeps its head cool with ice. It fishes for its food by dangling its single hair into the sea to lure in prey. When they tire of swimming they simply let their ice head be drifted away by the sea.

abilityOne.name: Ice Face
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon's face is covered by a thick block of ice that serves as a cover for its body. If it breaks it will need freezing temperatures to restore the ice block.
abilityOne.effect: The Pokemon has 2 Extra HP when it is on "Ice Face form". If the Ice receives 2 damage, change the Pokemon's form to "No-Ice Form". To restore "Ice Face Form" the Pokemon must be out one whole Round while Hail/Snow weather is active. Unique Ability.

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Mist
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Targets cannot have their Attributes or Traits Reduced. Previously Reduced Attributes and Traits remain. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A thick layer of mist cloaks a pack of pokémon, those with the intent to trick and weaken them will have to find them first.

move.name: Powder Snow
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Roll 1 Chance Die to Freeze those affected.
move.description: A light layer of snow flakes covers the foes, as the layers pile up the possibilities to be trapped into the snow increase.

move.name: Icy Wind
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Wind Move. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: Polar winds sweep through the arena. Everyone starts to shiver and embrace themselves, trying to preserve a bit of warmth.

move.name: Weather Ball
move.effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. *If there is a weather condition on the field, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool. This Move's type will change according to the Weather. Sun/Fire, Rain/Water, Hail or Snow/Ice, Sand/Rock, Wind/Flying.
move.description: A ball created out of the forces of the weather. Today’s forecast is cloudy with a chance of pain!

move.name: Headbutt
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Out of battle it may cause a Random encounter when hitting trees and make objects drop from high places.
move.description: The Pokémon rams against their foe with their head. This Move is perfect to shake down trees when looking for berries, but beware of wild Pokémon nesting at the treetops.

move.name: Aurora Veil
move.effect: Target User's Side of the Field. Force Field against Physical & Special Damage. This move will fail if not performed under Hail/Snowy Weather. Duration 4 Rounds, even if Hail or Snow Weather is over.
move.description: If the weather is cold enough, beautiful aurora lights will cover half of the battlefield, deflecting attacks.

move.name: Belly Drum
move.effect: Target Self. Roll half of the User's HP as Typeless Damage Dice to itself, ignore defenses. Increase User's Strengt by 3.
move.description: With an angry war cry the user hits their belly as drums of war.

move.name: Iron Head
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon charges to cure the foe’s iron deficit.

move.name: Protect
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokemon would receive from a Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Moves that target the user.
move.description: A mighty energy shield materializes in front of the user to to deflect attacks and dispel ill effects.

move.name: Avalanche
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 4. *If the User received damage from the target during this Turn add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool. *If Snowy Weather is active add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.
move.description: The user covers themselves with a heavy snow coat, if anything disturbs the snow, it will fall like a heavy avalanche.

move.name: Soak
move.effect: Single Target. Change the Target's Type to Water. (ie Charizard was Fire/Flying, after this Move their Type will be Water) Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon.
move.description: The foe gets soaking wet, they should stay away from electric outlets and thirsty plants.

move.name: Amnesia
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Sp. Defense by 2.
move.description: No thoughts. Head empty

move.name: Hail
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Activate Hail Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The skies turn gray, and loud thunder rumbles, but what falls is not a gentle drizzle, but an endless stream of ice shards coming down at high speeds. Find shelter!

move.name: Freeze Dry
move.effect: Single Target. Water-Type Pokemon receive Super-Effective Damage from this Move. If a Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dive" this Move hits anyways.
move.description: All moisture is frozen and then subjected to high pressure, evaporating it immediately. Water-type Pokémon suffer this Move the most.

move.name: Whirlpool
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion. Duration 4 Rounds. If a Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dive", this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The foe is swallowed inside of a violent swirling whirlpool. Trapping them on the violent currents, barely managing to stay afloat.

move.name: Icicle Crash
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Lethal. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon creates a big stalactite on top of the foe and lets it fall on top of it. Sometimes they manage to impale the foe to the ground.

move.name: Iron Defense
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
move.description: Iron body, iron will. This Pokémon is unbreakable.

move.name: Agility
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: Swift of body, swift of mind.

move.name: Surf
move.effect: Area Move. If a Target is out of range due to the Move "Dive", this Move hits anyways. Out of battle, allows the Pokemon to travel the sea for long distances.
move.description: The Pokémon calls forward a large wave of seawater to ride, most Pokémon get washed out as they did not bring a surfboard.

move.name: Aqua Ring
move.effect: Target Self. The User heals 1 HP at the end of each Round. Spend 1 Will point to activate. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The Pokémon coats themselves in fresh water.

move.name: Head Smash
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Recoil.
move.description: Pokémon, angry. Pokémon, smash!

move.name: Blizzard
move.effect: All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Wind Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Freeze those affected. *Sunny Weather increases to Low Accuracy 4. **Hail/Snowy Weather remove Low Accuracy and adds the effect "Never Miss".
move.description: The user summons a turbulent and gelid wind that feels like ice daggers. A pleasant day may make it difficult to call upon, but beware if the temperatures go below zero.

move.name: Liquidation
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Reduce the Target's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon strikes while bursting a full-force blast of pressurized water. The water may cut or dent through the target’s armor.

move.name: Substitute
move.effect: Target Self. Deal 2 damage to the User. Put a Substitute Decoy with 2 HP and the same defenses as the user. See p. 531
move.description: The Pokémon disappears in a poof of smoke. A decoy identical to the user takes their place in battle. The user keeps attacking from the shadows while the decoy serves as distraction.

name: Rotom (Mow Form)
description: A lawnmower possessed by a Rotom. It uses Grass powers, mows awful patterns on the grass, and chases people with the blades out. While in this form it can use the move 'Leaf Storm'.

abilityOne.name: Levitate
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon floats to move around without ever touching the ground.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon has immunity to Ground-Type moves and effects active on the battlefield such as Terrains and certain Entry Hazards.

move.name: Thunder Wave
move.effect: Single Target. Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A series of electric waves hit the target, their voltage is too weak to cause much harm but muscles will get cramped for hours.

move.name: Astonish
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe.
move.description: The user sneaks behind their target to jump scare them.

move.name: Confuse Ray
move.effect: Single Target. Confuse the Target.
move.description: The user flashes a sinister ray of bright light that others cannot help but go straight into it.

move.name: Thunder Shock
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance die to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The most basic electric attack, charge, release, and shock! Just don’t point it to any electric device.

move.name: Double Team
move.effect: Target Self. The User can now make up to 5 Evasions per Round.
move.description: The Pokémon moves so fast they create a series of shadow copies of themselves. Trying to guess which one is the real one is a pain.

move.name: Shock Wave
move.effect: Single Target. Never Miss.
move.description: A series of lightning bolts rise through the floor towards the sky, it is impossible to predict where they are coming from.

move.name: Electro Ball
move.effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of the user for every Point on Dexterity it has that surpasses the Foe's. Up to 4 Dice might be added this way.
move.description: An orb of electricity is hurled against the target, the faster the user dashes, the more momentum the orb gets.

move.name: Hex
move.effect: Single Target. *If the Target has an active Status Condition, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move.
move.description: The user casts a terrible hex over the target, the effects will be greater if the target is already burdened by an ailment.

move.name: Discharge
move.effect: Area Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze those affected.
move.description: The user lets out an enormous discharge over the arena. Lightning does not distinguish friend from foe.

move.name: Charge
move.effect: Target Self. Add 2 Dice to the Damage Pool of thenext Damaging Electric-Type Move the User performs.
move.description: The user gathers electricity and stores it to make its attacks more powerful. You may also use them as a living battery for your phone.

move.name: Substitute
move.effect: Target Self. Deal 2 damage to the User. Put a Substitute Decoy with 2 HP and the same defenses as the user. See p. 531
move.description: The Pokémon disappears in a poof of smoke. A decoy identical to the user takes their place in battle. The user keeps attacking from the shadows while the decoy serves as distraction.

move.name: Trick
move.effect: Single Target. The User and the Target switch their Held Item. If only one Pokemon is holding an Item, it gives it away.
move.description: The user controls its target’s mind to make them do a simple non-hostile action, such as walking or handing an item. Although some Pokémon use simple sleigh of hand.

move.name: Thunderbolt
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance die to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A solid electric shock. A discharge of nearly 10,000 volts that can knock out most foes and destroy electrical devices.

move.name: Shadow Ball
move.effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: Dark matter and shadows are used as a projectile against the foe, bringing out memories of their deepest fears.

move.name: Uproar
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Sound Move. This Effect Targets the Battle Field: Pokemon will be cured of the Sleep Status. Duration 1 Round.
move.description: Shouts, screams, and loud music... What does a Pokémon have to do here for a peaceful night of sleep?

move.name: Dark Pulse
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: A haze of dark energy decends on the battlefield preying on those vulnerable to the obscure feelings and fears it provokes.

move.name: Thunder
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target. Rain Weather eliminates Low Accuracy. Sunny Weather increases it to Low Accuracy 4. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce", or "Sky Drop" this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The Pokémon commands the skies to send a giant lightning bolt to a specific point. Difficult to command under clear skies, lethal during a storm. Flying Pokémon are specially vulnerable.

move.name: Nasty Plot
move.effect: Target Self. Increase User's Special by 2.
move.description: Rubbing both hands and laughing sinisterly the Pokémon rejoices in the evil plans they’ll soon carry out.

move.name: Poltergeist
move.effect: Single Target. Can only be used if the Target is Holding an Item or if Items have been used on the Target's side of the field.
move.description: The Pokémon’s spirit possesses an Item and attacks with that cursed object. It is said that if the Pokémon lingers too long possesing an object, it’ll have trouble getting out.

move.name: Volt Switch
move.effect: Single Target. Switcher Move for the User.
move.description: The user shoots a wave of electric rings that allow it to reteat to safety at the speed of lightning.

move.name: Eerie Impulse
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce foe's Special by 2.
move.description: The user radiates electricity around itself so the foe will think twice about attacking.

move.name: Leaf Storm
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Reduce the User's Special by 2.
move.description: A furious onslaught of sharp leaves blasting against the target. The user gives their all in this attack.

name: Eelektross
description: They crawl out of the water and attack anyone on shore by sucking them into their mouths, shocking them, and dragging them back into the ocean. They are aggressive and unpredictable, be very careful

abilityOne.name: Levitate
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon floats to move around without ever touching the ground.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon has immunity to Ground-Type moves and effects active on the battlefield such as Terrains and certain Entry Hazards.

move.name: Super Fang
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Bite Move. Roll Normal-Type Damage Dice equal to Half of the Target's remaining HP. Up to 10 Dice may be rolled this way. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The Pokémon jumps to bite a chunk off their Target with their mighty fangs. After each bite there’s less and less foe to take chunks off.

move.name: Drain Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: A solid punch that weakens the foes and revitalizes the user with each hit.

move.name: Headbutt
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Out of battle it may cause a Random encounter when hitting trees and make objects drop from high places.
move.description: The Pokémon rams against their foe with their head. This Move is perfect to shake down trees when looking for berries, but beware of wild Pokémon nesting at the treetops.

move.name: Thunder Wave
move.effect: Single Target. Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A series of electric waves hit the target, their voltage is too weak to cause much harm but muscles will get cramped for hours.

move.name: Spark
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The user engulfs itself with statc electricity then charges with a solid tackle against the foe. Sparks fly, very literally.

move.name: Charge Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Increase User's Special by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon releases an electric beam, if any charge remains unused, it will make use of it to boost its power.

move.name: Crush Claw
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Reduce the Target's Defense by 2.
move.description: With a crushing grip against the foe, the user manages to break their armor.

move.name: Ion Deluge
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Damage from Normal-Type Moves will be considered to be Electric-Type. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The user electrifies all the particles in the environment with shocking results!

move.name: Bind
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Increase the Target's difficultty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion.
move.description: The Pokémon uses all their strength to restrain to the foe and keep them in place.

move.name: Acid
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Roll 1 Chance die to Reduce by 1 the Sp. Defense of those affected.
move.description: The Pokémon spits an acidic gunk into the foe that immediately gives burning sensation. Keep away from the eyes and wash with abundant water.

move.name: Discharge
move.effect: Area Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze those affected.
move.description: The user lets out an enormous discharge over the arena. Lightning does not distinguish friend from foe.

move.name: Thunderbolt
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance die to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A solid electric shock. A discharge of nearly 10,000 volts that can knock out most foes and destroy electrical devices.

move.name: Acid Spray
move.effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 2.
move.description: Do not point at face or eyes. Keep away from children.

move.name: Coil
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Defense score and Accuracy Pools.
move.description: The Pokémon curls up into themselves. Foes soon realize this is not the position of a prey in hiding, but of a hunter about to spit their venom.

move.name: Crunch
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Lethal. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the foe's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon viciously mauls, tears, and rips apart anything its fangs can come in contact with.

move.name: Gastro Acid
move.effect: Single Target. Negate any effect the Target's Ability would have. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The user spews their gastric juices on the foe. It’s so disgusting the foe can only concentrate on getting cleaned ASAP

move.name: Thunder Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 1 Chance die to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A charged punch to deliver a shocking blow.

move.name: Fire Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 2nd Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: A fist powered by the fiery spirit of combat, the heat of the battle lights of for real as the punch hits the foe right where it hurts!

move.name: Outrage
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
move.description: The true nature of dragon-types unleashed. The user is consumed by a primal fury that won’t stop until everything has ben razed to the ground. Afterwards the Pokémon is confused.

move.name: Wild Charge
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil. Roll 1 Chance die to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon surrounds itself with lightning then recklessly charges against their target.

move.name: Zap Cannon
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 4. Lethal. Paralyze the Target. Projectile Move.
move.description: A dreadful but erratic bombardment of electric explosions, getting hit would be devastating.

move.name: Thrash
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
move.description: The Pokémon becomes a wild thing and the rumpus has started.

move.name: Light Screen
move.effect: Target the User's side of the field. Force Field. Activate a Force Field against Special Damage. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A barrier of light is created over half of the battlefield, all energy trying to go trough dissolves as it crosses it.

name: Lilligant
description: Even veteran gardeners face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom, as it withers with ease. This Pokémon is popular among celebrities due to its grace, elegance and delicious aroma.

abilityOne.name: Chlorophyll
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon synthesizes sunlight to get energy, if it's kept in a sunny environment it will rarely need to eat.
abilityOne.effect: While Sunny Weather is active, Increase this Pokemon's Dexterity Attribute by 2.

abilityTwo.name: Leaf Guard
abilityTwo.description: The leaves on this Pokemon's body expand with the sun to completely cover and shield it from superficial damage. They may need to be pruned often.
abilityTwo.effect: While Sunny Weather is active, this Pokemon can't have any Status Ailments or Conditions inflicted. Previously inflicted ailments/conditions remain.

move.name: Growth
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Special. If the Sunny Weather is active, increase by 2 Instead.
move.description: The Pokémon makes their body grow in size. They’ll get bigger and stronger in just a few seconds.

move.name: Mega Drain
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The user absorbs a big amount of vital energy and nutrients from the target to feed from.

move.name: Teeter Dance
move.effect: Area Move. Confuse those affected.
move.description: The Pokémon dances with wobbly movements and erratic spins. The spectators don’t know what to make of these modern choreographies.

move.name: Sweet Scent
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Those affected cannot Evade Moves. Out of Battle, it will attract wild Pokemon.
move.description: The Pokémon releases a sweet aroma that lulls their enemies into a false sense of security

move.name: Healing Wish
move.effect: Target Self. The user faints. One allied Target restores its full HP and it is cured from any Status Condition. If the chosen Target is not in-battle, it is called out and ready to fight with the same remaining actions as the user.
move.description: In a display of true selflessness, the user makes the ultimate sacrifice for the well-being of others.

move.name: Absorb
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The user takes nutrients from the nearest source of life they find.

move.name: Helping Hand
move.effect: Target One Ally. Reaction 5. The Target Gets 2 Extra Dice on their next Skill Check/Accuracy Roll, and 2 Extra Dice on their next Damage Roll. This Effect does not Stack.
move.description: The Pokémon is the first to come and give a hand to their friend. A true bro.

move.name: Stun Spore
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Powder Move. Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A cloud of paralyzing pollen that affects the nerves and cramps the muscles of those who inhale it.

move.name: Aromatherapy
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Cure Status Ailments (All Burn degrees, Freeze, Paralysis, All Poison & Sleep) on the Targets.
move.description: The Pokémon releases a series of essential oils and herbal scents to refresh themselves and their companions.

move.name: Quiver Dance
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Dexterity, Special an Sp. Defense.
move.description: A mystical and beautiful dance that increases a Pokémon focus in combat.

move.name: Magical Leaf
move.effect: Single Target. Never Miss.
move.description: The user sends out a floating leaf that will pursue the target until it hits.

move.name: Sleep Powder
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Powder Move. Put the Target to Sleep.
move.description: The Pokémon spouts a cloud of somniferous pollen to know out their foe, the only problem is that the foe must inhale enough of the pollen for it to take effect.

move.name: Energy Ball
move.effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: Gathering nature’s energy from nearby plants, trees and roots, the Pokémon forms a ball to shoot at the enemy. Sadly, the surrounding plants will be dry afterwards.

move.name: Leech Seed
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Spend 1 Will point to activate. At the end of each Round, Roll 2 Dice of Typeless Damage against the target ignoring defenses. The User heals 1 HP for every damage dealt this way. Grass-Type Pokémon are immune to this Effect. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The foe is infected with seed saplings taking root on their body. As the saplings grow, they'll absorb the vital energy of the foe and send it back to the user.

move.name: After You
move.effect: Target One Ally. Reaction 1. The Target will go First in the Initiative Order. If used again, the previous target reverts to their original Initiative order. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The user bows and courteously lets a friend go first.

move.name: Giga Drain
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The Pokémon drains most of the foe’s vital energy and feeds on the nutrients it managed to extract.

move.name: Entrainment
move.effect: Single Target. Replace the Target's Ability with the User's. Unique Abilities can't be passed or replaced. Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon.
move.description: The Pokémon trains and teaches their best ability to their target. The target becomes a master of this ability in a record time.

move.name: Sunny Day
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Activate Sunny Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The Pokémon will call for the sun to shine brighter, increasing the heat of the arena. This Move doesn’t work at night, indoors, or underground/water.

move.name: Petal Dance
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
move.description: The Pokémon casts a huge cluster of petals to dance in the wind; they let nature run its course, as the wind will choose who will take the devastating blow.

move.name: Petal Blizzard
move.effect: Area Move. Ranged. Wind Move.
move.description: A raging blizzard of petals and leaves sweeps through the entire area, leaving a pleasant floral scent and destruction in its wake.

move.name: Synthesis
move.effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will Point to activate. If Sunny Weather is in effect, this Move becomes a Complete Heal. If performed under Rain, Sandstorm, Hail or Snowy Weather, this Move is a Minor heal and only heals 1 HP.
move.description: The Pokémon gathers sunlight to re-energize themselves.

move.name: Leaf Storm
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Reduce the User's Special by 2.
move.description: A furious onslaught of sharp leaves blasting against the target. The user gives their all in this attack.

move.name: Light Screen
move.effect: Target the User's side of the field. Force Field. Activate a Force Field against Special Damage. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A barrier of light is created over half of the battlefield, all energy trying to go trough dissolves as it crosses it.

name: Nidoking
description: It is recognized by its rock-hard hide and its extended horn. Be careful with the horn as it contains venom. There are records of one trampling and destroying a radio tower that was being built on his territory.

abilityOne.name: Poison Point
abilityOne.description: The pointy thorns and scales on this Pokemon release a venom that will infect anyone who touches them roughly. Wear gloves when handling them.
abilityOne.effect: If this Pokemon is hit by a Non-Ranged Physical Move, Roll 3 Chance Dice to inflict Poison on the foe.

abilityTwo.name: Sheer Force
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon is only interested in showing off its incredible battle prowess.
abilityTwo.effect: Whenever this Pokemon uses a Physical or Special Move with Added Effects, you may choose to ignore them and add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool instead. Added Effects from Items trigger this effect but do not stack.

move.name: Focus Energy
move.effect: Target Self. All of the user's Physical & Special Moves now have "High Critical". Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The Pokémon concentrates all their focus on the battle to make their attacks much more precise.

move.name: Head Smash
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Recoil.
move.description: Pokémon, angry. Pokémon, smash!

move.name: Poison Sting
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
move.description: A tiny stab that causes big troubles.

move.name: Leer
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The vicious glare of a predator that triggers the flight response of their prey.

move.name: Peck
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: Raise crows and they’ll peck your foe’s eyes.

move.name: Fury Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions.
move.description: The Pokémon attacks in a fury, their attacks are uncoordinated but relentless.

move.name: Toxic Spikes
move.effect: Target Foe's side of the Field. Entry Hazard. Foes who enter the battlefield become Poisoned. Roll 1 Chance Die for them to become Badly Poisoned instead. Pokemon with immunity to Ground-Type Moves are not affected.
move.description: The Pokémon lays a trap of tiny venom-drenched spikes through the battlefield. The battle has not yet begun and the foes are already defeated.

move.name: Double Kick
move.effect: Single Target. Double Action.
move.description: The good old one-two but with a twist.

move.name: Horn Attack
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user has horns. Did you not expect they’ll use them?

move.name: Helping Hand
move.effect: Target One Ally. Reaction 5. The Target Gets 2 Extra Dice on their next Skill Check/Accuracy Roll, and 2 Extra Dice on their next Damage Roll. This Effect does not Stack.
move.description: The Pokémon is the first to come and give a hand to their friend. A true bro.

move.name: Toxic
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Badly Poison the Target.
move.description: This burning acid dissolves skin to enter the bloodstream directly. The poor victim feels like they are melting from the inside out. The clock is ticking.

move.name: Flatter
move.effect: Single Target. Increase the Target's Special by 1. Confuse the Target.
move.description: The user starts flattering and admiring its opponent. It sure makes them feel good about themselves but...why?!

move.name: Poison Jab
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon is set on injecting venom directly into the foe’s bloodstream. They can do it the easy way or the hard way.

move.name: Chip Away
move.effect: Single Target. Ignore Cover & Substitute decoys. Ignore Defenses. Remove effects that increase Evasion Actions from the Target (ie Moves like: Double Team, Minimize. Abilities like: Sand Veil)
move.description: Bit by bit the Pokémon finds an opening though all layers of defense their target has until there is nothing left to protect it from a direct strike.

move.name: Thrash
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
move.description: The Pokémon becomes a wild thing and the rumpus has started.

move.name: Megahorn
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal.
move.description: The Pokémon uses its strong horn(s) to pierce their foe and deal massive damage.

move.name: Earth Power
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: The user sends out a subterranean wave that bursts the ground below the target. It’s as if the earth bends to the user’s will.

move.name: Drill Run
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical.
move.description: The Pokémon holds their claws together and starts spinning as if they were a drill. They can puncture a hole into any surface from walls and floors to their foes.

move.name: Poison Tail
move.effect: Single Target. High Critical. Roll 1 Chance Die to Poison the Target.
move.description: A sharp edge dipped in venom—an attack in bad blood in all senses of the word.

move.name: Horn Drill
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 5. Deal Damage equal to the Target's Remaining HP, plus 1 Lethal Damage.
move.description: The Pokémon stabs the target with a spinning horn, drilling through them until they are critical condition. Hurry to the nearest Pokémon Center.

move.name: Beat Up
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move for every ally Pokemon that spends an action in addition to this Move, up to 3 allies may join.
move.description: The user calls other Pokémon to aid it in battle, together they give a beating to the foe.

move.name: Avalanche
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 4. *If the User received damage from the target during this Turn add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool. *If Snowy Weather is active add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.
move.description: The user covers themselves with a heavy snow coat, if anything disturbs the snow, it will fall like a heavy avalanche.

move.name: Scorching Sands
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the foe.
move.description: The sand around the user heats to scorching temperatures as it is thrown against their foe.

name: Whimsicott
description: Riding whirlwinds, they come and go. These Pokémon sneak through even the smallest gap into houses and cause all sorts of mischief. The tufts of allergenic white fluff it leaves behind reveal its presence.

abilityOne.name: Prankster
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon will always have a mischievous twinkle in its eyes, no one around will be safe from its pranks.
abilityOne.effect: All Support Moves used by this Pokemon are considered to have: "Reaction 1" as Added Effect.

abilityTwo.name: Infiltrator
abilityTwo.description: The Pokemon is very stealthy with its movements, it is naturally harder to detect and can easily sneak in heavily guarded places.
abilityTwo.effect: This Pokemon ignores all Shield Moves, Force Fields, Substitutes and Cover active on the foe's side of the field.

move.description: The Pokémon flaps their wings and strikes the foe with a swirl of wind. Pokémon in the air may get swept away

move.name: Encore
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 3. The Target will repeat the exact same action sequence it had last Round. Target must have had an action sequence. Duration 1 Round. If used on the previous Round, this move fails. See more on p. 529.
move.description: The Pokémon makes a standing ovation at their target, prompting them to repeat everything they just did, exactly the way they did it.

move.effect: Single Target. Reduce Target's Strength by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon engages their foe in a charming interaction to reduce their aggressive intent.

move.description: Flying Pokémon know better than anyone how to use the wind in their favor. Let its draft carry you to victory.

move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Reduce Target's Special by 1.
move.description: The user becomes a champion of lunar justice. In the name of the moon, they will right the wrongs and triumph over evil!

move.description: The foe is covered head to toe in cotton fluff, disrupting its movement.

move.description: The Pokémon grows a lush coat of cotton puffs. The cotton greatly reduces all kinds of impact.

move.effect: Single Target. The User faints. Reduce by 2 the foe's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense, and Sp. Defense. Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon.
move.description: As they take their last breath, the Pokémon leaves behind an imprint of regret on their foe.

move.name: Endeavor
move.effect: Single Target. Roll Dice of Normal-Type Damage equal to the difference between the User's current HP and the Target's max HP. Ignore defenses. Up to 10 Dice may be rolled this way. This Damage cannot make the Target's HP go lower than the User's current HP.
move.description: Through sheer willpower the Pokémon manages to level the conditions of the battle despite their own injuries.

move.description: The Pokémon drains most of the foe’s vital energy and feeds on the nutrients it managed to extract.

move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. If Sunny Weather is active, you skip this Move's Charge action. If performed under Rain, Sandstorm or Hail/Snowy Weather, this Move takes two actions to Charge.
move.description: The Pokémon gathers sunlight but instead of being absorbed it is sot as a devastating beam of light instead.

move.effect: Single Target. *The Type of this Move is determined by the environment or active Terrain. See more on p. 530
move.description: The Pokémon makes use of the terrain and asks for nature's aid in battle.

name: Bounsweet
description: This happy-go-lucky Pokémon produces a delicious aroma that unfortunately attracts predators to it. When it escapes, it looks as if it's happily skipping around so it rarely gets the help it needs.
