move.description: Through a reckless grapple, the Pokémon smashes the foe into the ground, usually falling along with it.

move.name: Guard Swap
move.effect: Single Target. Whole Scene Duration. Switch the User's Defense and Sp. Defense with the Target's.
move.description: The Pokémon enters their foe’s mind to steal its fortitude and implant on them the idea of their own weakness.

move.name: Reversal
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool for every missing HP the User has. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The user gathers their mettle to block away the pain and focus only on hitting harder.

move.name: Cotton Guard
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 3.
move.description: The Pokémon grows a lush coat of cotton puffs. The cotton greatly reduces all kinds of impact.

move.name: Substitute
move.effect: Target Self. Deal 2 damage to the User. Put a Substitute Decoy with 2 HP and the same defenses as the user. See p. 531
move.description: The Pokémon disappears in a poof of smoke. A decoy identical to the user takes their place in battle. The user keeps attacking from the shadows while the decoy serves as distraction.

move.name: Rest
move.effect: Target Self. Complete Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Put the User to Sleep.
move.description: Yeah, this seems like a good spot to take a nap.

move.name: Sleep Talk
move.effect: If the user is not asleep, this Move fails. Instead of making a roll to try to wake up, the user may choose to use Sleep Talk instead. Choose a Move on the user's Move set at random and Target Random foe with it. Sleep Talk can be repeated up to 5 times per Round.
move.description: Despite being asleep, the Pokémon keeps dreaming about the battle. They talk incoherences and even sleep walk.

move.name: Protect
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokemon would receive from a Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Moves that target the user.
move.description: A mighty energy shield materializes in front of the user to to deflect attacks and dispel ill effects.

move.description: Swift of body, swift of mind.

move.effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of the user for every Point on Dexterity it has that surpasses the Foe's. Up to 4 Dice might be added this way.
move.description: An orb of electricity is hurled against the target, the faster the user dashes, the more momentum the orb gets.

move.name: Double-Edge
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil.
move.description: Without regard for their own safety, the Pokémon does a reckless attack against their foe.

name: Blastoise (Mega Form)
description: With the power of the Mega Stone the canon on its back can shoot exploding water projectiles that can pierce through concrete. Its body is incredibly hard and its hind legs root themselves to prevent recoil.

abilityOne.name: Mega Launcher
abilityOne.description: The cannons on this Pokemon's body allow it to fire extremely powerful attacks.

move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The fastest water gun in town. No enemy will remain dry

move.effect: Single Target. Increase the User's Dexterity by 1. Remove Entry Hazards, Terrains (ie Grassy Terrain, Misty Terrain), Ongoing Damage and Leech seed from the User and/or their side of the field.
move.description: The Pokémon makes a swift spin to strike at the foe and in the process everything laying close to the user is scattered out of the battlefield.

move.name: Bubble
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: Dozens of bubbles are sent floating through the battlefield. The foes can’t resist the temptation to burst the pretty bubbles, only for the bubbles to explode for real when they do.

move.name: Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe
move.description: The user lands a vicious bite, leaving an ugly bruise.

move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokemon would receive from a Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Moves that target the user.
move.description: A mighty energy shield materializes in front of the user to to deflect attacks and dispel ill effects.

move.name: Iron Defense
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
move.description: Iron body, iron will. This Pokémon is unbreakable.

move.name: Rain Dance
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Activate Rain Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The Pokémon performs a peculiar dance in the middle of the field, everyone thinks it silly until the first thunder rumbles.

move.name: Zap Cannon
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 4. Lethal. Paralyze the Target. Projectile Move.
move.description: A dreadful but erratic bombardment of electric explosions, getting hit would be devastating.

move.name: Outrage
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
move.description: The true nature of dragon-types unleashed. The user is consumed by a primal fury that won’t stop until everything has ben razed to the ground. Afterwards the Pokémon is confused.

move.name: Hydro Cannon
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge
move.description: Those who fear fire’s destructive power have forgotten that water triumphs over the flames every single time.

move.name: Water Pulse
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target.
move.description: The user sends out a pulsing ring of water that blasts the foe with ultrasonic waves. For a while, everything seems as if reflected in the water ripples.

move.name: Aqua Tail
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The user sways their tail to create a pocket whirlpool in which the foe gets sucked in by the spinning motion.

move.name: Flip Turn
move.effect: Single Target. Switcher Move for the User.
move.description: Charge at the foe as a cannon ball made out of water. The big splash causes bystanders to lose sight on the battlefield. When the splash settles, the user is gone.

move.name: Shell Smash
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 2 the User's Strength, Special and Dexterity. Reduce by 2 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon breaks off their own shell. The foe mistakenly believed the shell was for the Pokémon to protect themselves when it was actually there to protect the foes from what’s next.

move.name: Aura Sphere
move.effect: Single Target. Never Miss. Projectile Move.
move.description: By channeling their own aura, the user launches an energy sphere that causes harm on an spiritual level more than a physical one.

move.name: Flash Cannon
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: Through shiny metal parts of their body, the Pokémon reflects a light beam straight into the foe’s eyes.

move.name: Muddy Water
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 2. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of those affected.
move.description: When you can’t see what creatures lurk inside the water, that’s when you know they are the ones that went fishing.

move.name: Life Dew
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. User and Allies in Range heal 1 HP at the end of each Round. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The user creates a fresh-water dew that restores energy and heals wounds.

move.name: Hydro Pump
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2
move.description: Water works best under pressure.

move.name: Skull Bash
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. While this Move is charging, Increase the User's Defense by 1.
move.description: The user withdraws into their shell, after a few seconds of them not moving, the foe goes to inspect and the user pops their head out in in a devastating strike.

move.name: Water Spout
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Lethal. *Reduce 1 Die from the Damage Pool for every missing HP the User has. Up to 5 Dice may be removed this way.
move.description: This Move alone may be the reason the earth is 70% water.

name: Darumaka (Galarian Form)
description: When forced to live in snow, its fire sac froze and now it generates cold. Darumaka uses low temperatures as energy, making it very energetic in winter. It is playful and likes to throw snowballs.

abilityOne.name: Hustle
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon will perform everything in a hurry, it keeps itself busy, but it can be kind of sloppy when it rushes something out.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon gets an Extra Low Accuracy 1 and adds 2 Extra Dice to the Damage pool for all its Physical Moves.

abilityTwo.name: Inner Focus
abilityTwo.description: The Pokemon is extrmely serious and focused on everything it does. It remains calm and never backs down, even if it's getting severly injured.
abilityTwo.effect: This Pokemon does not Flinch. The Ability Intimidate does not have any effect against this Pokemon. Outside of battle this Pokemon is able to resist intimidation tactics, fear and stress better than others.

move.description: The user covers themselves with a heavy snow coat, if anything disturbs the snow, it will fall like a heavy avalanche.

move.name: Work Up
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Special.
move.description: The Pokémon has spent a lot of time training and doesn’t miss the chance to show off their muscles and fitness. After the battle they share routines and tips with the other Pokémon.

move.description: A large wave of extra-hot air that can set fire to everything it touches.

move.description: The user lands a vicious bite, leaving an ugly bruise.

move.name: Ice Ball
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Projectile Move. Successive Actions. *If all 5 actions land successfully, add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of the last hit of this Move. If the Pokemon used the Move "Defense Curl" in the same round, this Move's base Power becomes 2.
move.description: The Pokémon rolls into a snowball, getting bigger and bigger as they keep rolling

move.name: Yawn
move.effect: Single Target. *If the Target has not been removed from battle at the beginning of the next Round, put it to Sleep.
move.description: The user yawns, the foe yawns, the trainers yawn... everyone should take a nap.

move.name: Ice Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 1 Chance Dice to Freeze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon wears their ice gloves to punch the foe. Yes. Gloves made of ice.

move.name: Uproar
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Sound Move. This Effect Targets the Battle Field: Pokemon will be cured of the Sleep Status. Duration 1 Round.
move.description: Shouts, screams, and loud music... What does a Pokémon have to do here for a peaceful night of sleep?

move.name: Facade
move.effect: Single Target. *If the User has a Status Ailment (Paralysis, Poison, Burn, etc.) Add 3 Extra Dice to the Damage pool.
move.description: The Pokémon puts on a brave face through the most difficult of situations.

move.name: Blizzard
move.effect: All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Wind Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Freeze those affected. *Sunny Weather increases to Low Accuracy 4. **Hail/Snowy Weather remove Low Accuracy and adds the effect "Never Miss".
move.description: The user summons a turbulent and gelid wind that feels like ice daggers. A pleasant day may make it difficult to call upon, but beware if the temperatures go below zero.

move.name: Superpower
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Reduce by 1 the User's Strength and Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon packs all their power in a single crushing strike. All this effort leaves them quite tired afterwards.

move.name: Freeze Dry
move.effect: Single Target. Water-Type Pokemon receive Super-Effective Damage from this Move. If a Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dive" this Move hits anyways.
move.description: All moisture is frozen and then subjected to high pressure, evaporating it immediately. Water-type Pokémon suffer this Move the most.

name: Quaxly
description: Quaxley are known for their tidiness; their feathers are neatly combed and it hates when they get ruffled. Despite their small size, they are capable swimmers with strong legs to paddle their way upstream.

abilityOne.name: Torrent
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon builds up pressure to shoot water streams. When that pressure cannot be held in, it is released through uncontrollable torrents.
abilityOne.effect: Pain Penalization won't reduce successes from Accuracy or Damage rolls of Water-Type Moves used by this Pokemon. Water-Type Moves get 2 Extra dice to their Damage Pool when this Pokemon is at half HP or less.

abilityTwo.name: Moxie
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon is naturally fierce and will try to get to a position of power by defeating the alphas in the pack.
abilityTwo.effect: If a foe faints because of a Physical or Special Move used by this Pokemon, Increase its Strength Attribute by 1. Up to 3 points can be increased this way.

move.name: Pound
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user pounds the target’s head. Simple

move.name: Growl
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Reduce by 1 the Strength of those affected.
move.description: Either through a menacing attitude or an adorable demeanor, the foe will hesitate to attack the user at full power.

move.name: Water Gun
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The fastest water gun in town. No enemy will remain dry

move.name: Work Up
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Special.
move.description: The Pokémon has spent a lot of time training and doesn’t miss the chance to show off their muscles and fitness. After the battle they share routines and tips with the other Pokémon.

move.name: Wing Attack
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: A classic flying technique, the user flies towards the foe and strikes using their wings.

move.name: Aqua Jet
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1.
move.description: The Pokémon propels themselves with a jet of pressured water.

move.name: Double Hit
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Double Action.
move.description: The Pokémon uses the true and tested “one-two”.

move.name: Aqua Cutter
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. High Critical. Cutter Move.
move.description: The User compacts water and shoots it as a pressurized jet. This jet is very sharp and can easily cut through solids.

move.name: Acrobatics
move.effect: Single Target. *If the User has a Held Item, Reduce 2 Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move.
move.description: The Pokémon is quick and graceful, they cartwheel, contort and make a double back jump before landing onthe foe. Their best perfomance is done when they are unburdened.

move.name: Focus Energy
move.effect: Target Self. All of the user's Physical & Special Moves now have "High Critical". Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The Pokémon concentrates all their focus on the battle to make their attacks much more precise.

move.name: Air Slash
move.effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: A compressed wind-slash, the change of pressure knocks out the target momentarily

move.name: Detect
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokemon would receive from a Physical or Special move. Negate the Added Effcts of Any Moves that target the user.
move.description: The Pokémon detects the intentions of the attacker and reacts just in time to minimize the damage.

move.name: Roost
move.effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Remove the User's Immunity to Ground-Type Moves. Duration 1 Round.
move.description: The Pokémon gathers some twigs and builds themselves a comfy nest on the floor to roost and relax.

move.name: Air Cutter
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. High Critical. Wind Move. Cutter Move.
move.description: A sharp wide wave of wind is sent out , everyone can feel it slicing throught their midsection.

move.name: Swift
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Never Miss.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a burst of star-shaped sparkles at a blinding speed.

move.name: Liquidation
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Reduce the Target's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon strikes while bursting a full-force blast of pressurized water. The water may cut or dent through the target’s armor.

move.name: Low Kick
move.effect: Single Target. Add 1 Extra Damage Dice for every 50kg of the weight on the foe, up to 4 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The Pokémon uses a kick to the sheen to throw the foe into the ground. The bigger they are, the harder they fall.

move.name: Helping Hand
move.effect: Target One Ally. Reaction 5. The Target Gets 2 Extra Dice on their next Skill Check/Accuracy Roll, and 2 Extra Dice on their next Damage Roll. This Effect does not Stack.
move.description: The Pokémon is the first to come and give a hand to their friend. A true bro.

move.name: Water Pledge
move.effect: Area Move. This Effect Targets the Battlefield: Add 2 Dice to all Chance Dice rolls of everyone in the field. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The Pokémon chants to invoke the power of water. Moisture in the air bends the light to create a rainbow to bring good fortune. Everyone in the field feels luckier for a while.

name: Chespin
description: A small and curious Pokémon. They are rare to find. Their nests are found inside of chestnut trees. Their heads are covered by spikes and if there's a threat, they'll roll into balls to protect themselves.

abilityOne.name: Overgrow
abilityOne.description: When this Pokemon is hurt, it will grow huge plants on its body to defend itself, these plants are very strong but wither quickly.
abilityOne.effect: Pain Penalization won't reduce successes from Accuracy or Damage rolls of Grass-Type Moves used by this Pokemon. Grass-Type Moves get 2 Extra dice to their Damage Pool when this Pokemon is at half HP or less.

abilityTwo.name: Bulletproof
abilityTwo.description: The armor on this Pokemon's body protects it from projectiles and small explosions.
abilityTwo.effect: Reduce by 1 all damage from Ranged Physical Moves dealt to this Pokemon. Reduce by 1 all damage from Special Moves with the words: Ball, Blast, Bomb, Cannon, Octazooka, Puff, Shot, Sphere, and Wrecker on their name.

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Growl
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Reduce by 1 the Strength of those affected.
move.description: Either through a menacing attitude or an adorable demeanor, the foe will hesitate to attack the user at full power.

move.name: Vine Whip
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses its body vines to give the foe a good smack. These vines can be as long as 20 feet and quite surdy as ropes.

move.name: Rollout
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions. *If all 5 actions land successfully, add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of the last hit of this Move. If the Pokemon used the Move "Defense Curl" in the same round, this Move's base Power becomes 2.
move.description: When the foe sees this Pokémon rollin’ they’ll be hatin’.

move.name: Leech Seed
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Spend 1 Will point to activate. At the end of each Round, Roll 2 Dice of Typeless Damage against the target ignoring defenses. The User heals 1 HP for every damage dealt this way. Grass-Type Pokémon are immune to this Effect. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The foe is infected with seed saplings taking root on their body. As the saplings grow, they'll absorb the vital energy of the foe and send it back to the user.

move.name: Pin Missile
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged. Successive Actions.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a barrage of stingers or spikes that pierce like needles.

move.name: Take Down
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Recoil.
move.description: Through a reckless grapple, the Pokémon smashes the foe into the ground, usually falling along with it.

move.name: Seed Bomb
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Projectile Move.
move.description: A giant seed is hurled against the target, the hit is not what knocks them down, the tree that explodes suddenly out of the seed is what does.

move.name: Body Slam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The user charges against the foe using ther body to slam it down, leaving the target stunned.

move.name: Pain Split
move.effect: Single Target. Spend 1 Will Point to activate. *Deal up to 3 Typeless Damage to the Target, Heal 1 HP to the User for every Damage dealt this way. This Move Fails if the User has more than Half HP rounded down. This Move cannot reduce a Target to less than 1 HP.
move.description: The user channels their pain into the foe to relieve their agony. The foe gets to feel the burn of the damage it has caused.

move.name: Super Fang
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Bite Move. Roll Normal-Type Damage Dice equal to Half of the Target's remaining HP. Up to 10 Dice may be rolled this way. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The Pokémon jumps to bite a chunk off their Target with their mighty fangs. After each bite there’s less and less foe to take chunks off.

move.name: Drain Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: A solid punch that weakens the foes and revitalizes the user with each hit.

move.name: Grass Pledge
move.effect: Area Move. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected. This Effect Targets the Battle Field: Entry Hazard. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of Target's that enter the battlefield. Pokemon with Immunity to Ground are not affected.
move.description: The Pokémon chants to invoke the power of grass, their pledge is heard and the ground crumbles as vegetation grapples and traps everyone in the field.

move.name: Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe
move.description: The user lands a vicious bite, leaving an ugly bruise.

move.name: Mud Slap
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.
move.description: A mud ball splatters right into the foe’s face, reducing their field of vision.

move.name: Bulk Up
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon showcase their muscles through poses that highlight their fitness and bodybuilding discipline.

move.name: Wood Hammer
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil.
move.description: The Pokémon creates a giant wooden hamer and it uses it to smash the foe with such force the hammer also explodes into wood splinters.

name: Stunfisk (Galarian Form)
description: Stunfisk lives in mud with high iron content. Those nutrients turned its body into a Steel Type. Stunfisk's lips are hard to spot in the mud, but if someone steps on it, its jagged steel clamps their prey.

abilityOne.name: Mimicry
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon's body is perfect for camouflaging in the ground. It can sometimes get lost but you will find it if some unfortunate victim steps on it.
abilityOne.effect: If there is a Terrain Move active on the field (i.e. Electric Terrain, Psyichic Terrain etc.) Change this Pokemon's main type to match that of the active Terrain. Restore its original main type if the terrain effects end.

abilityTwo.name: Sand Veil
abilityTwo.description: The Pokemon's body is easily concealed by sand particles in the air.
abilityTwo.effect: While Sandstorm Weather is active, this Pokemon can use the Evasion Maneuver up to 5 times per Round. The Pokemon is immune to damage from Sandstorm weather.

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Mud Slap
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.
move.description: A mud ball splatters right into the foe’s face, reducing their field of vision.

move.name: Water Gun
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The fastest water gun in town. No enemy will remain dry

move.name: Metal Claw
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 1 Chance Die to Increase the User's Strength by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon uses the foe as a whetstone.

move.name: Stealth Rock
move.effect: Target Foe's Side of the Field. Entry Hazard. Pokemon entering the battle Receive 1 Rock-Type Damage. This effect does not stack.
move.description: The Pokémon hides a trap of sharp rocks that are launched at the victim before they even realize what even happened.

move.name: Counter
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 5. Can only be used if Target's last Move on User was a Physical Move. For damage, roll dice equal to Target's last damage pool rolled against the User plus 2 dice. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The Pokémon strikes back at their foe. Showing they can take a hit and punch even harder.

move.name: Mud Sport
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Physical & Special Electric-Type Moves have Power 0. Pokemon weak to Electric-Type Moves won't receive Super-Effective Damage from them. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The user covers the whole field with mud. Electricity can’t flow properly, so Electric attacks will be severely impaired.

move.name: Bide
move.effect: Single Target. The User will not Evade or Clash the next 2 Physical or Special Moves targeting it. Once all damage has been dealt against the User, roll a number of Normal-Type Damage dice equal to twice the total amount of Damage the Target received. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The user puts up with being hit, waiting for the perfect opportunity to retaliate.

move.name: Camouflage
move.effect: Target Self. For the rest of the scene the User changes type to one that fits the terrain/ environment it is in (ie User is in a rocky cave, becoming rock type).
move.description: The Pokémon blends with their surroundings to increase their chances of survival.

move.name: Endure
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. If a Physical or Special Move would cause the user to faint, they remain at 1 HP instead, remove this effect afterwards. The effect re-activates on the user's next Turn. Whole Round duration.
move.description: The Pokémon mentally prepares to receive a fatal blow, their spirit is stronger than their body so they endure to keep on fighting for as long as possible.

move.name: Mud Shot
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 1.
move.description: By shooting a stream of mud at their target, the user manages to impair their movement.

move.name: Revenge
move.effect: Single Target. *If the User has already received Damage this Round, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.
move.description: Best served cold.

move.name: Metal Sound
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 2.
move.description: A horrible screeching sound rumbles in the foe’s ears. Some people will try to convince you that this is good music.

move.name: Sucker Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 6. *This move can only be used as a Late Reaction; and only if the Target used a Physical or Special Move, otherwise it will fail.
move.description: The Pokémon takes advantage of their foe preparing to attack to unleash a dirty surprise blow.

move.name: Iron Defense
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
move.description: Iron body, iron will. This Pokémon is unbreakable.

move.name: Mud Bomb
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Projectile Move. Roll 3 Chance Die to Reduce 1 success to all Accuracy rolls of the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a ball of mud to burst on their victim’s face in an attempt to blind them.

move.name: Bounce
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Thunder / Twister / Sky Uppercut / Gust / Hurricane / Smack Down. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon jumps at least 30 feet in the air before landing with a mighty stomp on top of the foe. While in the air it is safe from most treaths but its still vulnerable to bad weather.

move.name: Snap Trap
move.effect: Single Target. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The user is so flat that you can barely see it in the tall grass. Waiting for an unsuspecting prey to get close enough to use its body as a snare trap. It won’t let go until its prey faints.

move.name: Muddy Water
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 2. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of those affected.
move.description: When you can’t see what creatures lurk inside the water, that’s when you know they are the ones that went fishing.

move.name: Earthquake
move.effect: Area Move. Ranged. If the Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dig" this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The user calls the forces of nature. The earth shakes violently and everything crumbles to the ground.

move.name: Flail
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of this Move for every missing Point of HP the user has. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The user flails around trying to stay alive, as they get closer to fainting, more adrenaline will fuel their efforts of survival.

move.name: Fissure
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 5. Ranged. Deal Damage to the Target equal to its Remaining HP, plus 1 Lethal Damge. If the Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dig" this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The earth rips apart underneath the target and swallows them whole. You’ll need a rescue team to recover the unlucky victim from the deep.

move.name: Magnet Rise
move.effect: Target Self. The User gains Immunity against Ground-Type Moves. Whole Scene Duration
move.description: The Pokémon creates a magnetic field to repel themselves from the ground, allowing it to float for a short period of time.

name: Bellsprout
description: They live in hot and humid places, blending in with the flora. It is carnivorous and will try to eat anything smaller than itself. It digests its prey with an acid substance in its mouth.

abilityOne.name: Chlorophyll
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon synthesizes sunlight to get energy, if it's kept in a sunny environment it will rarely need to eat.
abilityOne.effect: While Sunny Weather is active, Increase this Pokemon's Dexterity Attribute by 2.

abilityTwo.name: Gluttony
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon eats all day long, it is always carrying food and has no problem to find food sources since it's not a picky eater. It, however, doesn't share.
abilityTwo.effect: This Pokemon can eat any type of food, medicine or herbal medicine with no negative. This pokemon may have up to three berries as held item instead of just one. The berries must not be of the same effect.

move.name: Vine Whip
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses its body vines to give the foe a good smack. These vines can be as long as 20 feet and quite surdy as ropes.

move.name: Growth
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Special. If the Sunny Weather is active, increase by 2 Instead.
move.description: The Pokémon makes their body grow in size. They’ll get bigger and stronger in just a few seconds.

move.name: Wrap
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion.
move.description: The Pokémon swiftly entangles their foe in a squeezing lock to prevent their escape.

move.name: Sleep Powder
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Powder Move. Put the Target to Sleep.
move.description: The Pokémon spouts a cloud of somniferous pollen to know out their foe, the only problem is that the foe must inhale enough of the pollen for it to take effect.

move.name: Poison Powder
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Powder Move. Poison the Target.
move.description: A cloud of noxius powder that immediately sends the target’s immune system into overdrive.

move.name: Stun Spore
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Powder Move. Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A cloud of paralyzing pollen that affects the nerves and cramps the muscles of those who inhale it.

move.name: Acid
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Roll 1 Chance die to Reduce by 1 the Sp. Defense of those affected.
move.description: The Pokémon spits an acidic gunk into the foe that immediately gives burning sensation. Keep away from the eyes and wash with abundant water.

move.name: Knock Off
move.effect: Single Target. *If the Target is holding an Item, Add 2 Dice to the Damage pool of this Move. The Target loses its Held Item afterwards.
move.description: The Pokémon rudely smacks what their foe was holding.

move.name: Sweet Scent
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Those affected cannot Evade Moves. Out of Battle, it will attract wild Pokemon.
move.description: The Pokémon releases a sweet aroma that lulls their enemies into a false sense of security

move.name: Gastro Acid
move.effect: Single Target. Negate any effect the Target's Ability would have. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The user spews their gastric juices on the foe. It’s so disgusting the foe can only concentrate on getting cleaned ASAP

move.name: Razor Leaf
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Cutter Move. Ranged. High Critical.
move.description: The user sends out a barrage of sharp razor-like leaves. “Death by a thousand cuts” would be the best depiction.

move.name: Slam
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1.
move.description: Everybody get up, it’s time to slam now.

move.name: Poison Jab
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon is set on injecting venom directly into the foe’s bloodstream. They can do it the easy way or the hard way.

move.name: Wring Out
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. *Remove 1 Dice from the Damage Pool for every missing HP on the target. Up to 4 Dice may be removed this way.
move.description: The Pokémon quite literally squeezes the life out of their foe. But to do this effectively they require to be in top condition.

move.name: Ingrain
move.effect: Target Self. The User heals 1 HP at the end of each Round. Spend 1 Will point to activate. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The Pokémon roots themselves to absorb nutrients directly from the ground.

move.name: Tickle
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce by 1 the Target's Strength and Defense.
move.description: Whoever said laughter is the best therapy lied.

move.name: Weather Ball
move.effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. *If there is a weather condition on the field, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool. This Move's type will change according to the Weather. Sun/Fire, Rain/Water, Hail or Snow/Ice, Sand/Rock, Wind/Flying.
move.description: A ball created out of the forces of the weather. Today’s forecast is cloudy with a chance of pain!

move.name: Strength Sap
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce Target's Strength by 1. Heal 1 HP to the user. If successful, spend 1 Will Point to activate.
move.description: The Pokémon looks for a weak point on its foe, then feeds on its vital energy. The foe is left feeling feeble.

name: Abomasnow
description: There was an old Hisuian legend that spoke of 'The Ice Monster'. Now we know it is a Pokémon that can cover everything with snow. It is usually shy and likes quiet places. Strong, but only attacks if provoked.

abilityOne.name: Snow Warning
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon is able to call a terrible hailstorm at will. Snow will cover the battlefield and sharp ice shards will come plummeting from the sky.
abilityOne.effect: When this Pokemon comes out, it automatically starts the effects of Hail/Snow Weather. The effects end when the Pokemon leaves the battle. (In case of stalemate the Pokemon with higher Will might keep the dominant weather)

abilityTwo.name: Soundproof
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon's body is structured to protect it from noises that might disturb its peace and focus. So it's not ignoring you, it just can't hear you.
abilityTwo.effect: This Pokemon is immune to the Damage and Added Effects of all Sound-based moves.

move.name: Leer
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The vicious glare of a predator that triggers the flight response of their prey.

move.name: Powder Snow
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Roll 1 Chance Die to Freeze those affected.
move.description: A light layer of snow flakes covers the foes, as the layers pile up the possibilities to be trapped into the snow increase.

move.name: Swagger
move.effect: Single Target. Increase the Target's Strength by 2. Confuse the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon’s arrogant and mocking attitude enrage their foe and make it lose focus in battle.

move.name: Ice Shard
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Ranged.
move.description: With extraordinary swiftness, the Pokémon shoots an ice bullet like the fastest gun in the North Pole.

move.name: Avalanche
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 4. *If the User received damage from the target during this Turn add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool. *If Snowy Weather is active add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.
move.description: The user covers themselves with a heavy snow coat, if anything disturbs the snow, it will fall like a heavy avalanche.

move.name: Outrage
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
move.description: The true nature of dragon-types unleashed. The user is consumed by a primal fury that won’t stop until everything has ben razed to the ground. Afterwards the Pokémon is confused.

move.name: Leafage
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged.
move.description: The user throws leaf darts towards the foe.

move.name: Mist
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Targets cannot have their Attributes or Traits Reduced. Previously Reduced Attributes and Traits remain. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A thick layer of mist cloaks a pack of pokémon, those with the intent to trick and weaken them will have to find them first.

move.name: Razor Leaf
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Cutter Move. Ranged. High Critical.
move.description: The user sends out a barrage of sharp razor-like leaves. “Death by a thousand cuts” would be the best depiction.

move.name: Icy Wind
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Wind Move. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: Polar winds sweep through the arena. Everyone starts to shiver and embrace themselves, trying to preserve a bit of warmth.

move.name: Bulldoze
move.effect: Area Move. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: The user stomps and flattens the ground, pushing all the rubbish and leaving the surface ready for construction.

move.name: Rock Smash
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Reduce the Target's Defense by 1.
move.description: A hit powerful enough to destroy rocks and crack armor.

move.name: Grass Whistle
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Sound Move. Put the Target to Sleep.
move.description: A soothing and relaxing melody created with the sounds of nature. It is a very subtle tone, so it may be hard to listen.

move.name: Energy Ball
move.effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: Gathering nature’s energy from nearby plants, trees and roots, the Pokémon forms a ball to shoot at the enemy. Sadly, the surrounding plants will be dry afterwards.

move.name: Ingrain
move.effect: Target Self. The User heals 1 HP at the end of each Round. Spend 1 Will point to activate. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The Pokémon roots themselves to absorb nutrients directly from the ground.

move.name: Icicle Crash
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Lethal. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon creates a big stalactite on top of the foe and lets it fall on top of it. Sometimes they manage to impale the foe to the ground.

move.name: Ice Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 1 Chance Dice to Freeze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon wears their ice gloves to punch the foe. Yes. Gloves made of ice.

move.name: Aurora Veil
move.effect: Target User's Side of the Field. Force Field against Physical & Special Damage. This move will fail if not performed under Hail/Snowy Weather. Duration 4 Rounds, even if Hail or Snow Weather is over.
move.description: If the weather is cold enough, beautiful aurora lights will cover half of the battlefield, deflecting attacks.

move.name: Blizzard
move.effect: All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Wind Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Freeze those affected. *Sunny Weather increases to Low Accuracy 4. **Hail/Snowy Weather remove Low Accuracy and adds the effect "Never Miss".
move.description: The user summons a turbulent and gelid wind that feels like ice daggers. A pleasant day may make it difficult to call upon, but beware if the temperatures go below zero.

move.name: Wood Hammer
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil.
move.description: The Pokémon creates a giant wooden hamer and it uses it to smash the foe with such force the hammer also explodes into wood splinters.

move.name: Sheer Cold
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 5. Ranged. Deal Damage to the Target equal to its Remaining HP, plus 1 Lethal Damage.
move.description: The Pokémon reaches an absolute zero by being freezed from the inside out. Urgent medical attention is required.

move.name: Giga Impact
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge. Lethal.
move.description: The Pokémon strikes with such a brutal force they leave a crater just from the impact. Let them catch their breath afterwards.

name: Carkol
description: It rolls its legs: their heavy weight creates parallel trackmarks that allow them to travel faster through caves and tunnels. In old times, people used Carkol's coal as fuel for they can hold fire for a long time.

abilityOne.name: Steam Engine
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon works as a steam furnace, with a bit of fire and water it can move anything at great speeds. It also loves to eat coal.
abilityOne.effect: The first time this Pokemon is dealt damage with a Fire or Water-Type Move. Increase 3 Points to its Dexterity Atribute.

abilityTwo.name: Flash Fire
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon is capable of consuming other fire sources and adding them to its own. Walking through embers, fire, lava and hell feel like a breeze to it.
abilityTwo.effect: The first time this Pokemon is hit by a Fire-Type move, add 1 Extra die to the Damage Pool of Fire-type Moves this Pokemon uses until the end of the scene. Fire-type moves do not deal damage to this Pokemon.

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Smokescreen
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon covers the foe in a cloud of smoke to impair their visibility to make it easier to hide and/or cover their escape.

move.name: Rapid Spin
move.effect: Single Target. Increase the User's Dexterity by 1. Remove Entry Hazards, Terrains (ie Grassy Terrain, Misty Terrain), Ongoing Damage and Leech seed from the User and/or their side of the field.
move.description: The Pokémon makes a swift spin to strike at the foe and in the process everything laying close to the user is scattered out of the battlefield.

move.name: High Horsepower
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1.
move.description: The Pokémon tramples their foe without mercy. Their powerful body could pull a traction vehicle for very long distances.

move.name: Smack Down
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Remove the Target's immunity to Ground-Type Moves. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop", this Move hits anyways.
move.description: They say it’s great to get two birds with one stone, this Pokémon will give one bird ALL the stones.

move.name: Flame Charge
move.effect: Single Target. Increase the User's Dexterity by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon dashes so fast they leave a trail of fire behind.

move.name: Spikes
move.effect: Target Foe's Side of the Field. Entry Hazard. Pokemon entering the battle Receive 1 Typeless Damage. This effect does not stack. Pokemon with immunity to Ground-Type Moves are not affected.
move.description: Sharp and pointy spikes are scattered around the field, if you don’t watch your step the spikes will dig on your feet.

move.name: Endure
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. If a Physical or Special Move would cause the user to faint, they remain at 1 HP instead, remove this effect afterwards. The effect re-activates on the user's next Turn. Whole Round duration.
move.description: The Pokémon mentally prepares to receive a fatal blow, their spirit is stronger than their body so they endure to keep on fighting for as long as possible.

move.name: Iron Defense
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
move.description: Iron body, iron will. This Pokémon is unbreakable.

move.name: Block
move.effect: Single Target. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: You don’t seem to understand. I’m not blocked in here with you... You are blocked in here with me!

move.name: Will-O-Wisp
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target. Using this Move against the same Target increases the Burn Degree.
move.description: The user calls upon an eerie blue flame made with the souls of the departed. They appear harmless until they have you surrounded.

move.name: Rock Polish
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: Smooth the rough edges, no need to grind about in life.

move.name: Ancient Power
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Increase by 1 the User's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense and Sp. Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon calls forward an energy from the ancient past. This may infuse the user with a primal strength.

move.name: Incinerate
move.effect: Single Target. All Foes in Range. Destroy the held item of those affected.
move.description: A small blast of fire that instantly consumes small flammable objects.

move.name: Stealth Rock
move.effect: Target Foe's Side of the Field. Entry Hazard. Pokemon entering the battle Receive 1 Rock-Type Damage. This effect does not stack.
move.description: The Pokémon hides a trap of sharp rocks that are launched at the victim before they even realize what even happened.

move.name: Heat Crash
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die of Damage for every 50kgs the User is above the Target. Up to 4 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The Pokémon sets themselves ablaze and dives a cannonball against their foe.

move.name: Rock Blast
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged. Successive Actions. Projectile Move.
move.description: A rock shrapnel, the user shoots tiny bullet-like pebbles.

move.name: Burn Up
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. After damage is dealt, the user loses its Fire-Type. If its only type was Fire, it is now Typeless. User's Physical & Special Fire-Type Moves have Power 0. Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the User.
move.description: The User unleashes all of its might through a massive blast of raging fire. Although the damage is devastating the Pokémon is left unable to produce more fire for a while.

move.name: Bulldoze
move.effect: Area Move. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: The user stomps and flattens the ground, pushing all the rubbish and leaving the surface ready for construction.

move.name: Scorching Sands
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the foe.
move.description: The sand around the user heats to scorching temperatures as it is thrown against their foe.

name: Whismur
description: Their timid voice is barely audible, however, if it senses danger, they start crying loud enough to deafen anyone nearby. Their own noise scares them even more, so they cry harder until their ear covers shut.

abilityOne.name: Soundproof
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon's body is structured to protect it from noises that might disturb its peace and focus. So it's not ignoring you, it just can't hear you.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon is immune to the Damage and Added Effects of all Sound-based moves.

abilityTwo.name: Rattled
abilityTwo.description: When this scaredy Pokemon becomes startled or scared it will make haste to get away from danger.
abilityTwo.effect: The first time this Pokemon is hit by a Bug, Dark, or Ghost-Type Move, or if a foe has the Ability "Intimidate", Increase its Dexterity Attribute by 1.

move.name: Pound
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user pounds the target’s head. Simple

move.name: Echoed Voice
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. This Move can be used many times in the same Round. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage pool of this move for each time you use it. Up to 8 Dice might be added this way. Reset this effect if the user performs another move, evasion or clash.
move.description: The Pokémon yells at the void. Their echo answers. The Pokémon yells louder and louder everytime the echo talks back.

move.name: Supersonic
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Sound Move. Confuse the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a series of ultrasonic waves that mess with the foe by making it feel dizzy and disoriented.

move.name: Stomp
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Die to Flinch the Target. Targets under the effects of the Move "Minimize" are vulnerable.
move.description: Stomping the foe with strong feet. Perfect to squish nasty little bugs.

move.name: Roar
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 6. Switcher Move for the Foe. In the wild, the battle may end.
move.description: With a potent roar, to make the foe reconsider their intentions.

move.name: Synchronoise
move.effect: Area Move. Sound Move. Choose one Type (Fire, Poison, Steel, etc.). This move only affects those with that Type.
move.description: Each type of energy is contained by a thin layer of particles. With the right vibration frequency, that thin layer can be shattered like glass.

move.name: Disarming Voice
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Never Miss.
move.description: With a charming but manipulative cry, the user deals emotional damage to their opponent by making them feel guilty.

move.name: Fake Tears
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce foe's Sp. Defense by 2.
move.description: The user stops mid-combat to start crying; feeling incredibly guilty, the foe lowers its guard.

move.name: Snore
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. If the user is not asleep, this Move fails.
move.description: While the Pokémon is asleep they start snoring so loud it startles the foe.

move.name: Astonish
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe.
move.description: The user sneaks behind their target to jump scare them.

move.name: Howl
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Sound Move. Increase by 1 the Strength of those affected.
move.description: If you hear the howl, the pack has already surrounded you.

move.name: Rest
move.effect: Target Self. Complete Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Put the User to Sleep.
move.description: Yeah, this seems like a good spot to take a nap.

move.name: Sleep Talk
move.effect: If the user is not asleep, this Move fails. Instead of making a roll to try to wake up, the user may choose to use Sleep Talk instead. Choose a Move on the user's Move set at random and Target Random foe with it. Sleep Talk can be repeated up to 5 times per Round.
move.description: Despite being asleep, the Pokémon keeps dreaming about the battle. They talk incoherences and even sleep walk.

move.name: Screech
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Reduce the Target's Defense by 2.
move.description: A mighty screech will make the target cover its ears instead of covering its flanks.

move.name: Uproar
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Sound Move. This Effect Targets the Battle Field: Pokemon will be cured of the Sleep Status. Duration 1 Round.
move.description: Shouts, screams, and loud music... What does a Pokémon have to do here for a peaceful night of sleep?

move.name: Hyper Voice
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move.
move.description: The user screeches or sings at such high frequencies that anything made of glass will break. The ears of the victims are left in no better state.

name: Coalossal
description: They are usually calm creatures. If they see you are kind they'll share their warmth with you, but if you enrage one you risk being burned down to ashes. They spit a tarry substance that is very flammable.

move.description: The foe is about to confirm if the Pokémon is thick-boned.

move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon makes a judo maneuver, using its body mass instead of its strength against the target.

move.name: Meteor Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Increase the User's Special by 1 the moment it begins charging.
move.description: The user overflows with galactic energy while summoning a small meteor to impact the foe. A theory suggests this move might have caused the extintion of prehistoric Pokémon.

name: Cinderace
description: They are confident and boastful of their abilities. They take a pebble and light it on fire to create a scorching weapon they kick towards their foes. They can grow arrogant if they feel cheered on.

abilityOne.name: Blaze
abilityOne.description: The inner and outer fire on this Pokemon's body will burn incredibly fierce just before fading.
abilityOne.effect: Pain Penalization won't reduce successes from Accuracy or Damage rolls of Fire-Type Moves used by this Pokemon. Fire-Type Moves get 2 Extra dice to their Damage Pool when this Pokemon is at half HP or less.

abilityTwo.name: Libero
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon always has its mind in the game. It will favor a defensive position and make the best special passes when it finally attacks.
abilityTwo.effect: Whenever this Pokemon is about to roll the Accuracy of a Move, change its type to match that of the Move. If the Move is Physical or Special and deals damage, use the appropriate STAB on the Damage Roll.

move.name: Double Kick
move.effect: Single Target. Double Action.
move.description: The good old one-two but with a twist.

move.name: Headbutt
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Out of battle it may cause a Random encounter when hitting trees and make objects drop from high places.
move.description: The Pokémon rams against their foe with their head. This Move is perfect to shake down trees when looking for berries, but beware of wild Pokémon nesting at the treetops.

move.name: High Jump Kick
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. If the Accuracy roll fails, Roll 5 Dice of Typeless Damage against the user, ignoring defenses.
move.description: The user launches itself up three stories high to pummel down with a brutal kick. Let’s just trust it’s got a good aim from that distance.

move.name: Blast Burn
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Lethal. Must Recharge.
move.description: The Pokémon creates an enormous blast of infernal flames, surviving would be a miracle!

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Growl
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Reduce by 1 the Strength of those affected.
move.description: Either through a menacing attitude or an adorable demeanor, the foe will hesitate to attack the user at full power.

move.name: Ember
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: A basic fire attack, but not any less dangerous. Even a small flame can grow out of control.

move.name: Quick Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Out of battle, double the Pokemon's movement speed.
move.description: An attackas fight as lightning.

move.name: Feint
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 1. This Move ignores the effects of any Shield Move active on the Target and removes their effects for the rest of the Round.
move.description: The user begins their attack, and as their target attempts to protect itself, the user feints the target to break their defense against their true strike.

move.name: Low Sweep
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon crouches and spins with a kick to the foe’s legs. Leaving them with a limp for the rest of the fight.

move.name: Coaching
move.effect: Target All Allies in Range. Increase by 1 the Strength and Defense of all Allies targeted. The User cannot target itself.
move.description: This Pokémon allies form a line and start doing squats and push-ups while the user corrects their form and gives them tips and a confidence boost to win this match.

move.name: Flame Charge
move.effect: Single Target. Increase the User's Dexterity by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon dashes so fast they leave a trail of fire behind.

move.name: U-Turn
move.effect: Single Target. Switcher Move for User.
move.description: A bait and switch move, where the user strikes then makes a sudden u-turn back to safety.

move.name: Agility
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: Swift of body, swift of mind.

move.name: Pyro Ball
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Projectile Move. Ranged. Roll 1 Chance die to inflict 2nd Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon lights a heavy stone on fire and kicks it while it’s ablaze. The hit is pretty heavy already, the fire is just for showing off.

move.name: Mega Kick
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2.
move.description: A mighty kick. This sheer muscle-power strike can turn concrete pillars into rubble.

move.name: Reversal
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool for every missing HP the User has. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The user gathers their mettle to block away the pain and focus only on hitting harder.

move.name: Court Change
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Swap any Force Fields, Entry Hazards and Effects on the Foe's side of the field (ie Tailwind, Grassy Terrain healing, Fire Pledge.) for those on the User's side.
move.description: The Pokémon signals the referee for half-time, the referee complies and both parties swap their sides of the field. Wait... we brought everything with us, right?

move.name: Blaze Kick
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. High Critical. Roll 2 Chance Dice to inflict 2nd Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: Setting their legs ablaze, the Pokémon throws a mighty kick that sears the sides of the foe.

move.name: Counter
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 5. Can only be used if Target's last Move on User was a Physical Move. For damage, roll dice equal to Target's last damage pool rolled against the User plus 2 dice. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The Pokémon strikes back at their foe. Showing they can take a hit and punch even harder.

move.name: Bounce
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Thunder / Twister / Sky Uppercut / Gust / Hurricane / Smack Down. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon jumps at least 30 feet in the air before landing with a mighty stomp on top of the foe. While in the air it is safe from most treaths but its still vulnerable to bad weather.

move.name: Double-Edge
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil.
move.description: Without regard for their own safety, the Pokémon does a reckless attack against their foe.

move.name: Sucker Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 6. *This move can only be used as a Late Reaction; and only if the Target used a Physical or Special Move, otherwise it will fail.
move.description: The Pokémon takes advantage of their foe preparing to attack to unleash a dirty surprise blow.

move.name: Ally Switch
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 3. Switcher Move for the User. If successful, restore the Action this Move costed and the switched ally may use a Reaction when they enter the field.
move.description: The user vanishes just as they were about to be hit, and suddenly there’s another Pokémon in their place. Di-Did the user disappear? Or was it never there to begin with?

name: Meowth (Galarian Form)
description: The coin on its head has rusted. Meowth were taken onto viking ships on long travels over the sea. Living for so long in such harsh conditions toughened it up so much that parts of it have turned to iron.

abilityOne.name: Pickup
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon will often gather objects and keep a small hoard of treasure it may share with you.
abilityOne.effect: If this Pokemon was out of its Pokeball, at the end of the scene see what it found for you at Storyteller's discretion. The higher the Rank of this Pokemon the more valuable the items it will find.

abilityTwo.name: Tough Claws
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon's claws are so sturdy, they can tear through almost anything.
abilityTwo.effect: Add 1 Extra die to the Damage Pool of all non-Ranged Physical Moves this Pokemon performs.

hiddenAbility.name: Unnerve
hiddenAbility.description: It may be its powerful gaze or its menacing presence, but others near this Pokemon become really nervous to the point where they lose their appetite.
hiddenAbility.effect: Foes cannot consume their held berry or recycled berries while this Pokemon is in the field.

move.name: Night Slash
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical. Cutter Move.
move.description: The user looks for a weak spot, tearing the soft flesh apart with a single vile slash of its claws.

move.name: Charm
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce Target's Strength by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon engages their foe in a charming interaction to reduce their aggressive intent.

move.name: Fake Out
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Flinch the Target. This Move will only work on the First Round the User is out in battle. from the Second Round on, it will fail automatically.
move.description: The Pokémon pretends to be getting ready for the battle when they are actually prepairing a surprise attack on the foe.

move.description: The Pokémon uses their sharp claws to scratch the enemy. Nothing fancy but it works.

move.name: Hone Claws

move.description: Sharp claws make for more precise and deadly attacks.

move.name: Pay Day
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. At the end of the battle give Money to your Trainer Equal to their Rank: Starter/Rookie - 100 Standard - 250 Advanced - 500 Ace or more - 1000
move.description: This Pokémon brings good fortune to businesses and trainers alike. Make sure to use some of that hard earned money to buy them a treat.

move.name: Metal Claw
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 1 Chance Die to Increase the User's Strength by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon uses the foe as a whetstone.

move.description: Through tease and mockery, the foe is enraged to the point it stops thinking clearly.

move.effect: Single Target. Increase the Target's Strength by 2. Confuse the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon’s arrogant and mocking attitude enrage their foe and make it lose focus in battle.
