move.description: The Pokémon releases a stream of filthy gases. The foe may try to hold their breath, but for how long?

move.name: Incinerate
move.effect: Single Target. All Foes in Range. Destroy the held item of those affected.
move.description: A small blast of fire that instantly consumes small flammable objects.

move.name: Fake Out
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Flinch the Target. This Move will only work on the First Round the User is out in battle. from the Second Round on, it will fail automatically.
move.description: The Pokémon pretends to be getting ready for the battle when they are actually prepairing a surprise attack on the foe.

move.name: Nasty Plot
move.effect: Target Self. Increase User's Special by 2.
move.description: Rubbing both hands and laughing sinisterly the Pokémon rejoices in the evil plans they’ll soon carry out.

move.name: Flame Burst
move.effect: Single Target. After dealing damage, the User may roll 1 die of Fire-Type Damage against two other targets, ignoring defenses.
move.description: A compact fireball that bursts just as it hits the foe, scattering smaller flames to unsuspecting bystanders.

move.name: Toxic
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Badly Poison the Target.
move.description: This burning acid dissolves skin to enter the bloodstream directly. The poor victim feels like they are melting from the inside out. The clock is ticking.

move.name: Flamethrower
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 2nd Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: The most emblematic fire attack, a seeminly endless stream of fire that reduces everything and everyone to ashes.

move.name: Endeavor
move.effect: Single Target. Roll Dice of Normal-Type Damage equal to the difference between the User's current HP and the Target's max HP. Ignore defenses. Up to 10 Dice may be rolled this way. This Damage cannot make the Target's HP go lower than the User's current HP.
move.description: Through sheer willpower the Pokémon manages to level the conditions of the battle despite their own injuries.

move.name: Taunt
move.effect: Single Target. The Target cannot perform Support Moves (Support Maneuvers may still be performed). Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: Through tease and mockery, the foe is enraged to the point it stops thinking clearly.

name: Roggenrola
description: It is made from compressed rocks, making its body almost as hard as steel. It is blind; what looks like its eye is really an ear. For this reason, it can live in the darkest of caves feeding on rocks to grow stronger.

abilityOne.name: Sturdy
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon's body is extremely resistant to damage, it can withstand almost anything.
abilityOne.effect: The first time this Pokemon would reach 0 HP due to damage from a Move, it will remain at 1 HP instead. Status Ailments/Conditions, Weather, and Self-inflicted damage do not trigger this effect. The Pokemon can only benefit from Sturdy once per scene.

abilityTwo.name: Weak Armor
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon's protective outer layers can come off, allowing it to move freely and be more agile.
abilityTwo.effect: The first time this Pokemon is hit by any Physical Move, Increase its Dexterity Attribute by 1 and Reduce its Defense by 1.

hiddenAbility.name: Sand Force
hiddenAbility.description: The Pokemon controls the particles of sand around the battlefield to give a boost to its attacks.
hiddenAbility.effect: While Sandstorm Weather is active, if this Pokemon uses a Physical or Special Ground, Steel or Rock-Type Move, add 1 Extra die to the Damage Pool of that Move. The Pokemon is immune to damage from Sandstorm Weather.

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Harden
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 1.
move.description: When life gets hard, do the same.

move.name: Sand Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce by 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.
move.description: Sand to the eyes! A dirty tactic in more ways than one.

move.name: Headbutt
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Out of battle it may cause a Random encounter when hitting trees and make objects drop from high places.
move.description: The Pokémon rams against their foe with their head. This Move is perfect to shake down trees when looking for berries, but beware of wild Pokémon nesting at the treetops.

move.name: Rock Blast
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged. Successive Actions. Projectile Move.
move.description: A rock shrapnel, the user shoots tiny bullet-like pebbles.

move.name: Mud Slap
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.
move.description: A mud ball splatters right into the foe’s face, reducing their field of vision.

move.name: Iron Defense
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
move.description: Iron body, iron will. This Pokémon is unbreakable.

move.name: Smack Down
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Remove the Target's immunity to Ground-Type Moves. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop", this Move hits anyways.
move.description: They say it’s great to get two birds with one stone, this Pokémon will give one bird ALL the stones.

move.name: Rock Slide
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch those affected.
move.description: Don’t worry, even if you are not the fastest one in the race, you can still win by a landslide.

move.name: Sandstorm
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Wind Move. Activate Sandstorm Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A fierce sandstorm starts raging all around the battlefield. Cover your eyes, nose and face! The rough sand will hurt you!

move.name: Stone Edge
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Ranged. Lethal. High Critical. Cutter Move.
move.description: Obsidian shards are sent out against the foe. This rock may be brittle but is the sharpest in the world.

move.name: Autotomize
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Dexterity by 2. Halve the User's weight.
move.description: Rotating parts and tiny gears, the Pokémon works like a welloiled machine.

move.name: Lock-On
move.effect: Target Self. The Next Move the User Performs has 2 automatic successes added on their Accuracy Roll.
move.description: The Pokémon’s eyes zoom into a moving target to strike with precision at the next opportunity.

move.name: Magnitude
move.effect: Area Move. Ranged. Before you roll damage, Roll 1 die to determine this Move's Power. If the Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dig" this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The user shakes the tectonic plates underneath the battlefield, trying to find a fault, when they do, this Move is devastating.

move.name: Stealth Rock
move.effect: Target Foe's Side of the Field. Entry Hazard. Pokemon entering the battle Receive 1 Rock-Type Damage. This effect does not stack.
move.description: The Pokémon hides a trap of sharp rocks that are launched at the victim before they even realize what even happened.

move.name: Explosion
move.effect: Area Move. Ranged. Lethal. The User Faints.
move.description: Through a massive explosion the Pokémon destroys all they can before fainting. Sometimes the only way to get out of a bad situation is in bits and pieces.

name: Ponyta
description: It's not very common to see one stay still for more than a few seconds. Soon after it's born, its flames begin to burn. It is weak at first, but soon begins to develop a great speed chasing after its parents.

abilityOne.name: Run Away
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon is a master of escape. It will be difficult to catch as it can squeeze through the tiniest gaps to get away.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon cannot be Blocked. It may also obtain bonus dice to escape from battle, Pokeballs or captivity at Storyteller's discretion.

abilityTwo.name: Flash Fire
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon is capable of consuming other fire sources and adding them to its own. Walking through embers, fire, lava and hell feel like a breeze to it.
abilityTwo.effect: The first time this Pokemon is hit by a Fire-Type move, add 1 Extra die to the Damage Pool of Fire-type Moves this Pokemon uses until the end of the scene. Fire-type moves do not deal damage to this Pokemon.

hiddenAbility.name: Flame Body
hiddenAbility.description: This Pokemon can willingly ignite its body on fire, receiving no harm from it. Objects that come into contact with this Pokemon may catch fire.
hiddenAbility.effect: When hit by a Non-Ranged Physical Move, this Pokemon rolls 3 Chance Dice to inflict 2nd degree Burn on the foe.

move.name: Flame Wheel
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: The user surrounds themselves with fire, then curl into a ball and runs over the target in a fiery spin.

move.name: Take Down
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Recoil.
move.description: Through a reckless grapple, the Pokémon smashes the foe into the ground, usually falling along with it.

move.name: Flare Blitz
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil. Roll 1 Chance die to inflict 3rd Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: A reckless blazing charge against their foe, ends up with an explosive collision

move.name: Solar Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. If Sunny Weather is active, you skip this Move's Charge action. If performed under Rain, Sandstorm or Hail/Snowy Weather, this Move takes two actions to Charge.
move.description: The Pokémon gathers sunlight but instead of being absorbed it is sot as a devastating beam of light instead.

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Growl
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Reduce by 1 the Strength of those affected.
move.description: Either through a menacing attitude or an adorable demeanor, the foe will hesitate to attack the user at full power.

move.name: Tail Whip
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The Pokémon whips their tail in such an adorable way the foes let their guard down.

move.name: Ember
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: A basic fire attack, but not any less dangerous. Even a small flame can grow out of control.

move.name: Flame Charge
move.effect: Single Target. Increase the User's Dexterity by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon dashes so fast they leave a trail of fire behind.

move.name: Fire Spin
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion.
move.description: The user creates a vortex of fire that remains spinning in the battlefield, trapping the foe within.

move.name: Stomp
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Die to Flinch the Target. Targets under the effects of the Move "Minimize" are vulnerable.
move.description: Stomping the foe with strong feet. Perfect to squish nasty little bugs.

move.name: Inferno
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Lethal. Inflict 3rd Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: The user sets their target on fire with unforgiving flames. Abandon all hope.

move.name: Agility
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: Swift of body, swift of mind.

move.name: Fire Blast
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Roll 3 Chance Dice to inflict 3rd Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a giant fireball that explodes as soon as it touches their target. Blasting fire in all directions.

move.name: Bounce
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Thunder / Twister / Sky Uppercut / Gust / Hurricane / Smack Down. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon jumps at least 30 feet in the air before landing with a mighty stomp on top of the foe. While in the air it is safe from most treaths but its still vulnerable to bad weather.

move.name: Morning Sun
move.effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. If Sunny Weather is in effect, this Move becomes a Complete Heal. If performed under Rain, Sandstorm, Hail or Snowy Weather, this Move is a Minor heal only heals 1 HP.
move.description: The Pokémon feels revitalized with the bright sun early in the mornings.

move.name: Double Kick
move.effect: Single Target. Double Action.
move.description: The good old one-two but with a twist.

name: Breloom
description: Their flexible arms and quick footwork can put good fighters to shame. The seeds on their tail and the cap on their head release poison spores. They love humid and hot climates.

abilityOne.name: Poison Heal
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon has an immunity to any poison and also assimilates venom as an energy source.
abilityOne.effect: If this Pokemon becomes poisoned or badly poisoned. It will Heal 1 HP at the end of each round instead of receiving damage. The Poison will be completely absorbed and healed after 3 Rounds.

abilityTwo.name: Technician
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon is meticulous and precise in tasks that everyone else would perform roughly and without care.
abilityTwo.effect: Add 1 Extra die to the Damage pool of all Physical or Special Moves with Power 1 or 2 this Pokemon performs.

move.name: Absorb
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The user takes nutrients from the nearest source of life they find.

move.name: Stun Spore
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Powder Move. Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A cloud of paralyzing pollen that affects the nerves and cramps the muscles of those who inhale it.

move.name: Mega Drain
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The user absorbs a big amount of vital energy and nutrients from the target to feed from.

move.name: Feint
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 1. This Move ignores the effects of any Shield Move active on the Target and removes their effects for the rest of the Round.
move.description: The user begins their attack, and as their target attempts to protect itself, the user feints the target to break their defense against their true strike.

move.name: Headbutt
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Out of battle it may cause a Random encounter when hitting trees and make objects drop from high places.
move.description: The Pokémon rams against their foe with their head. This Move is perfect to shake down trees when looking for berries, but beware of wild Pokémon nesting at the treetops.

move.name: Mach Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Fist Move.
move.description: The user launches a punch so quickly that it’s barely seen.

move.name: Seed Bomb
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Projectile Move.
move.description: A giant seed is hurled against the target, the hit is not what knocks them down, the tree that explodes suddenly out of the seed is what does.

move.name: Fury Cutter
move.effect: Single Target. Successive Actions. Cutter Move.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their claws or scythes to rapidly cut as if shredding paper.

move.name: Thunder Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 1 Chance die to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A charged punch to deliver a shocking blow.

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Leech Seed
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Spend 1 Will point to activate. At the end of each Round, Roll 2 Dice of Typeless Damage against the target ignoring defenses. The User heals 1 HP for every damage dealt this way. Grass-Type Pokémon are immune to this Effect. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The foe is infected with seed saplings taking root on their body. As the saplings grow, they'll absorb the vital energy of the foe and send it back to the user.

move.name: Drain Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: A solid punch that weakens the foes and revitalizes the user with each hit.

move.name: Counter
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 5. Can only be used if Target's last Move on User was a Physical Move. For damage, roll dice equal to Target's last damage pool rolled against the User plus 2 dice. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The Pokémon strikes back at their foe. Showing they can take a hit and punch even harder.

move.name: Poison Powder
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Powder Move. Poison the Target.
move.description: A cloud of noxius powder that immediately sends the target’s immune system into overdrive.

move.name: Mind Reader
move.effect: Single Target. The User has 2 automatic and unremovable successes on the next Accuracy or Evasion Roll against the Target.
move.description: In a split of second, the Pokémon reads the foe’s mind so they know exactly what to do next.

move.name: Worry Seed
move.effect: Single Target. Replace the Target's Ability with "Insomnia". Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon.
move.description: The user plants the seed of doubt and uncertainty on its foe. The foe becomes such a worrywart that they can’t even sleep at night.

move.name: Growth
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Special. If the Sunny Weather is active, increase by 2 Instead.
move.description: The Pokémon makes their body grow in size. They’ll get bigger and stronger in just a few seconds.

move.name: Toxic
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Badly Poison the Target.
move.description: This burning acid dissolves skin to enter the bloodstream directly. The poor victim feels like they are melting from the inside out. The clock is ticking.

move.name: Giga Drain
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The Pokémon drains most of the foe’s vital energy and feeds on the nutrients it managed to extract.

move.name: Dynamic Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Fist Move. Confuse the Target.
move.description: A punch to a vital pressure point on the foe to disrupt their sense of balance

move.name: Force Palm
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A powerful open-palm hit that knocks the foe several feet away and may leave them unable to move.

move.name: Spore
move.effect: Single Target. Powder Move. Put the Target to Sleep.
move.description: A very potent somniferous spore. Dangerous to inhale as it could make you sleep for days.

move.name: Sky Uppercut
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Low Accuracy 1. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop" this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The user attacks with an uppercut, throwing the foe skyward with lots of force. Even flyers are not safe from this attack.

move.name: Substitute
move.effect: Target Self. Deal 2 damage to the User. Put a Substitute Decoy with 2 HP and the same defenses as the user. See p. 531
move.description: The Pokémon disappears in a poof of smoke. A decoy identical to the user takes their place in battle. The user keeps attacking from the shadows while the decoy serves as distraction.

name: Palossand
description: The possessed people shaped this Pokémon into a castle. Buried beneath the sand where it stands are the remains of all its victims. Some say these unmarked graves will give birth to a new Sandygast.

abilityOne.name: Water Compaction
abilityOne.description: The body of the Pokemon can absorb water at an astounding rate, its body hardens as it quickly dries.
abilityOne.effect: The fist time this Pokemon is hit by a Water-Type Move, Increase its Defense by 2. Water-type moves do not deal damage to this Pokemon.

abilityTwo.name: Sand Veil
abilityTwo.description: The Pokemon's body is easily concealed by sand particles in the air.
abilityTwo.effect: While Sandstorm Weather is active, this Pokemon can use the Evasion Maneuver up to 5 times per Round. The Pokemon is immune to damage from Sandstorm weather.

move.name: Harden
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 1.
move.description: When life gets hard, do the same.

move.name: Absorb
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The user takes nutrients from the nearest source of life they find.

move.name: Destiny Bond
move.effect: Target Self. If the user faints this Round due to damage frm a Physical or Special Move, the Pokemon who dealt the damage is dealt damage equal to their remaining Hp. This Move will fail if it was used the previous Round.
move.description: Through a mystical bond, everyone who brings disgrace to this Pokémon will suffer the exact same fate.

move.name: Sand Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce by 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.
move.description: Sand to the eyes! A dirty tactic in more ways than one.

move.name: Astonish
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe.
move.description: The user sneaks behind their target to jump scare them.

move.name: Sand Tomb
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Ranged. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion.
move.description: The Pokémon creates a pit of shifting sand around the foe to bury it alive. The poor victim struggles for air as the sand keeps sinking it lower and lower.

move.name: Mega Drain
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The user absorbs a big amount of vital energy and nutrients from the target to feed from.

move.name: Stealth Rock
move.effect: Target Foe's Side of the Field. Entry Hazard. Pokemon entering the battle Receive 1 Rock-Type Damage. This effect does not stack.
move.description: The Pokémon hides a trap of sharp rocks that are launched at the victim before they even realize what even happened.

move.name: Rock Polish
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: Smooth the rough edges, no need to grind about in life.

move.name: Bulldoze
move.effect: Area Move. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: The user stomps and flattens the ground, pushing all the rubbish and leaving the surface ready for construction.

move.name: Hypnosis
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Put the Target to sleep. Dark-Type Pokemon are affected by this Move.
move.description: By staring at an hypnotic pendulum, the target is suggestioned to feel tired and close its eyelids.

move.name: Mud Shot
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 1.
move.description: By shooting a stream of mud at their target, the user manages to impair their movement.

move.name: Brine
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 3 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool if the Target is at half HP or less.
move.description: A splash of sea water that literally adds more and more salt to the foe’s wounds.

move.name: Giga Drain
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The Pokémon drains most of the foe’s vital energy and feeds on the nutrients it managed to extract.

move.name: Iron Defense
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
move.description: Iron body, iron will. This Pokémon is unbreakable.

move.name: Shadow Ball
move.effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: Dark matter and shadows are used as a projectile against the foe, bringing out memories of their deepest fears.

move.name: Earth Power
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: The user sends out a subterranean wave that bursts the ground below the target. It’s as if the earth bends to the user’s will.

move.name: Shore Up
move.effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. If performed under Sandstorm weather, this Move is a Complete Heal.
move.description: The Pokémon gathers the sand around themselves to restore their body to shape.

move.name: Sandstorm
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Wind Move. Activate Sandstorm Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A fierce sandstorm starts raging all around the battlefield. Cover your eyes, nose and face! The rough sand will hurt you!

move.name: Substitute
move.effect: Target Self. Deal 2 damage to the User. Put a Substitute Decoy with 2 HP and the same defenses as the user. See p. 531
move.description: The Pokémon disappears in a poof of smoke. A decoy identical to the user takes their place in battle. The user keeps attacking from the shadows while the decoy serves as distraction.

move.name: Earthquake
move.effect: Area Move. Ranged. If the Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dig" this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The user calls the forces of nature. The earth shakes violently and everything crumbles to the ground.

move.name: Scorching Sands
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the foe.
move.description: The sand around the user heats to scorching temperatures as it is thrown against their foe.

move.name: Terrain Pulse
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool if there is a Terrain active in the Battlefield. Change this Move's Type to match that of a currently active Terrain (ie Electric Terrain, Grassy Terrain, etc.).
move.description: The user shoots a pulse that absorbs the energy flowing in the area to devastate its foes.

name: Seadra
description: The poisonous barbs all over its body are highly valued as ingredients for making traditional medicine. It will show no mercy if anything approaches its nest. Its back fin has a numbing substance.

abilityOne.name: Swift Swim
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon will move faster in water than on land, even a puddle-covered roadway will allow it to use its full speed.
abilityOne.effect: While Rain Weather is active, Increase this Pokemon's Dexterity Attribute by 2.

abilityTwo.name: Sniper
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon will stealthily locate itself in an advantageous position to strike its foe's weak spots.
abilityTwo.effect: When this Pokemon lands a Critical Hit, it will get 3 Bonus Dice to the Damage Pool of its Move instead of the regular 2.

hiddenAbility.name: Damp
hiddenAbility.description: The Pokemon gathers the humidity in the air around itself. Lighting a spark or keeping a fire on, will be almost impossible close to it.
hiddenAbility.effect: No one in the field will be able to use the moves: Self-Destruct, Explosion, Misty Explosion, Mind Blown, and Burn Up while this Pokemon is in the field. The Ability Aftermath does not activate if this Pokemon is in the field.

move.name: Water Gun
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The fastest water gun in town. No enemy will remain dry

move.name: Smokescreen
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon covers the foe in a cloud of smoke to impair their visibility to make it easier to hide and/or cover their escape.

move.name: Leer
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The vicious glare of a predator that triggers the flight response of their prey.

move.name: Bubble
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: Dozens of bubbles are sent floating through the battlefield. The foes can’t resist the temptation to burst the pretty bubbles, only for the bubbles to explode for real when they do.

move.name: Bubble Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 1.
move.description: A powerful stream of foamy bubbles shot straight into the foe

move.name: Aurora Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce target's Strength by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a beautiful shimmering beam that cools down a hot temper.

move.name: Octazooka
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Projectile Move. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Reduce 1 success to all Accuracy Rolls of the foe.
move.description: A jet of black ink shot straight into the foe’s eyes. This Move is hard to aim but returns the favor.

move.name: Focus Energy
move.effect: Target Self. All of the user's Physical & Special Moves now have "High Critical". Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The Pokémon concentrates all their focus on the battle to make their attacks much more precise.

move.name: Dragon Breath
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A mystical flame breath that feels strengely cold to the touch. It doesn’t burn in a conventional way.

move.name: Agility
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: Swift of body, swift of mind.

move.name: Laser Focus
move.effect: Target Self. If the next Physical or Special Move the user performs gets 5 more successes required on the Accuracy Roll, ignore the Target's defenses on the Damage roll.
move.description: Through its incredible awarenes the Pokémon finds a straight path into a weak point of the foe. The attack that follows is devastating.

move.name: Twister
move.effect: Target all foes in Range. Wind Move. Roll 2 Chance dice to Flinch those affected. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop" this Move hits anyways.
move.description: A raging twister embedded with a dragon’s fury. No one wants to be trapped in this fearsome spiral, which almost touches the sky.

move.name: Brine
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 3 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool if the Target is at half HP or less.
move.description: A splash of sea water that literally adds more and more salt to the foe’s wounds.

move.name: Rain Dance
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Activate Rain Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The Pokémon performs a peculiar dance in the middle of the field, everyone thinks it silly until the first thunder rumbles.

move.name: Dragon Dance
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Dexterity.
move.description: The user performs a vigorous and mystical dance to boost their fighting spirit and reflexes.

move.name: Dragon Pulse
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon sends out a powerful wave of energy through their mouth.

move.name: Hydro Pump
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2
move.description: Water works best under pressure.

move.name: Scale Shot
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged. Successive Actions. *If all 5 actions land successfully, Increase the User's Dexterity by 1, and lower the User's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon’s scales burst out as if they were shrapnel from a grenade.

name: Stufful
description: Despite its adorable appearance it is a dangerous Pokémon. If anyone but its mother or Trainer touches it, it will respond by angrily flailing its arms around. They are popular pets but owners always regret it.

abilityOne.name: Fluffy
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon's fur is so fluffy you could die. So soft and snuggly that it invites you to hug it. Hand-wash only, tumble dry with no heat, do not iron.
abilityOne.effect: Reduce by 2 the Damage dealt to this Pokemon by All Physical Moves. Increase by 2 the Damage dealt to this Pokemon by Fire-Type Moves.

abilityTwo.name: Cute Charm
abilityTwo.description: It may be its twinkly eyes or its rosy cheeks, but other people and Pokemon will try to win this Pokemon's heart.
abilityTwo.effect: If this Pokemon is hit with a Non-Ranged Physical Move, roll 3 Chance Dice to make the foe fall in Love.

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Leer
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The vicious glare of a predator that triggers the flight response of their prey.

move.name: Bide
move.effect: Single Target. The User will not Evade or Clash the next 2 Physical or Special Moves targeting it. Once all damage has been dealt against the User, roll a number of Normal-Type Damage dice equal to twice the total amount of Damage the Target received. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The user puts up with being hit, waiting for the perfect opportunity to retaliate.

move.name: Baby-Doll Eyes
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Reduce Target's Strength by 1.
move.description: The biggest and brightest eyes, spakling with unshed tears, how can you say “no” to that?!

move.name: Payback
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move if the User has already received Damage from the Target this Round.
move.description: Some say the best revenge is a successful and happy life, but not this Pokémon.

move.name: Flail
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of this Move for every missing Point of HP the user has. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The user flails around trying to stay alive, as they get closer to fainting, more adrenaline will fuel their efforts of survival.

move.name: Thrash
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
move.description: The Pokémon becomes a wild thing and the rumpus has started.

move.name: Stomping Tantrum
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move if the User failed the Accuracy roll of the last Move it performed. If the Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dig", this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The Pokémon throws a tantrum and stomps all over the place, it becomes worse if something has previously frustrated them.

move.name: Thunder Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 1 Chance die to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A charged punch to deliver a shocking blow.

move.name: Ice Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 1 Chance Dice to Freeze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon wears their ice gloves to punch the foe. Yes. Gloves made of ice.

move.name: Brutal Swing
move.effect: Target All foes in Range. Lethal.
move.description: The Pokémon starts attacking at full force with its claws, anyone unfortunate enough to be in its path will end up severely wounded.

move.name: Endure
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. If a Physical or Special Move would cause the user to faint, they remain at 1 HP instead, remove this effect afterwards. The effect re-activates on the user's next Turn. Whole Round duration.
move.description: The Pokémon mentally prepares to receive a fatal blow, their spirit is stronger than their body so they endure to keep on fighting for as long as possible.

move.name: Strength
move.effect: Outside of battle, using this move allows the Pokemon to lift double the normal weight it should be able to.
move.description: The Pokemon strains its muscles to go beyond their own limits.

move.name: Take Down
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Recoil.
move.description: Through a reckless grapple, the Pokémon smashes the foe into the ground, usually falling along with it.

move.name: Hammer Arm
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Low Accuracy 1. Reduce User's Dexterity by 1.
move.description: Stop. Hammer Arm time!

move.name: Pain Split
move.effect: Single Target. Spend 1 Will Point to activate. *Deal up to 3 Typeless Damage to the Target, Heal 1 HP to the User for every Damage dealt this way. This Move Fails if the User has more than Half HP rounded down. This Move cannot reduce a Target to less than 1 HP.
move.description: The user channels their pain into the foe to relieve their agony. The foe gets to feel the burn of the damage it has caused.

move.name: Double-Edge
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil.
move.description: Without regard for their own safety, the Pokémon does a reckless attack against their foe.

move.name: Superpower
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Reduce by 1 the User's Strength and Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon packs all their power in a single crushing strike. All this effort leaves them quite tired afterwards.

name: Slaking
description: They spend all day sleeping and eating grass that grows within their reach. Sometimes they live beneath trees, waiting for fruits to fall. They dislike intruders on their territory but rarely do anything about them.

abilityOne.name: Truant
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon is extremely lazy. They won't make even the tiniest effort to do anything even in the heat of battle.
abilityOne.effect: Roll this Pokemon's Loyalty every other turn, and score at least 2 successes. If the roll fails this Pokemon refuses to act. If it is successful it may act normally.

move.name: Scratch
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their sharp claws to scratch the enemy. Nothing fancy but it works.

move.name: Encore
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 3. The Target will repeat the exact same action sequence it had last Round. Target must have had an action sequence. Duration 1 Round. If used on the previous Round, this move fails. See more on p. 529.
move.description: The Pokémon makes a standing ovation at their target, prompting them to repeat everything they just did, exactly the way they did it.

move.name: Feint Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Never Miss.
move.description: The user approaches inconspicuously, pretending to attack the foe directly, then actually hits the foe from behind.

move.name: Slack Off
move.effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate.
move.description: Some Pokémon fight by giving their maximum effort all the time, they are doing it wrong.

move.name: Amnesia
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Sp. Defense by 2.
move.description: No thoughts. Head empty

move.name: Chip Away
move.effect: Single Target. Ignore Cover & Substitute decoys. Ignore Defenses. Remove effects that increase Evasion Actions from the Target (ie Moves like: Double Team, Minimize. Abilities like: Sand Veil)
move.description: Bit by bit the Pokémon finds an opening though all layers of defense their target has until there is nothing left to protect it from a direct strike.

move.name: Focus Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Charge Move. The User Flinches if it is hit while Charging this Move.
move.description: The user must focus on delivering the greatest punch in history, if they succeed they’ll be known as the One-Punch Pokémon.

move.name: Gunk Shot
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
move.description: The target is covered heat to toe in sludge, filth and organic waste. It can’t even cry for help or all of it will go into its mouth.

move.name: Yawn
move.effect: Single Target. *If the Target has not been removed from battle at the beginning of the next Round, put it to Sleep.
move.description: The user yawns, the foe yawns, the trainers yawn... everyone should take a nap.

move.name: Rest
move.effect: Target Self. Complete Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Put the User to Sleep.
move.description: Yeah, this seems like a good spot to take a nap.

move.name: Covet
move.effect: Single Target. The User steals the Target's Held Item. If the User already has a Held Item, this effect fails.
move.description: The Pokémon is attracted to shiny and colorful items. They don’t understand when something is not theirs for the taking so they just take it when no one is looking.

move.name: Headbutt
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Out of battle it may cause a Random encounter when hitting trees and make objects drop from high places.
move.description: The Pokémon rams against their foe with their head. This Move is perfect to shake down trees when looking for berries, but beware of wild Pokémon nesting at the treetops.

move.name: Swagger
move.effect: Single Target. Increase the Target's Strength by 2. Confuse the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon’s arrogant and mocking attitude enrage their foe and make it lose focus in battle.

move.name: Punishment
move.effect: Single Target. *Add up to 7 Dice to the Damage Pool of the Move for every Attribute increase the target has. (ie The target has 2 increased points on Strength, add 2 Damage dice).
move.description: You shouldn’t have done that...

move.name: Counter
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 5. Can only be used if Target's last Move on User was a Physical Move. For damage, roll dice equal to Target's last damage pool rolled against the User plus 2 dice. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The Pokémon strikes back at their foe. Showing they can take a hit and punch even harder.

move.name: Flail
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of this Move for every missing Point of HP the user has. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The user flails around trying to stay alive, as they get closer to fainting, more adrenaline will fuel their efforts of survival.

move.name: Hammer Arm
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Low Accuracy 1. Reduce User's Dexterity by 1.
move.description: Stop. Hammer Arm time!

move.name: Sucker Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 6. *This move can only be used as a Late Reaction; and only if the Target used a Physical or Special Move, otherwise it will fail.
move.description: The Pokémon takes advantage of their foe preparing to attack to unleash a dirty surprise blow.

move.description: The Pokémon disappears in a poof of smoke. A decoy identical to the user takes their place in battle. The user keeps attacking from the shadows while the decoy serves as distraction.

name: Swampert (Mega Form)
description: The power of the Mega Stone increases its muscle strength; it would appear to be slower, but its skin is so slippy it allows it to quickly slide over puddles and mud. It also becomes a bit bolder and moody.

move.name: Protect
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokemon would receive from a Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Moves that target the user.
move.description: A mighty energy shield materializes in front of the user to to deflect attacks and dispel ill effects.

move.name: Wide Guard
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Reaction 3. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage the Targets would receive from Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Any Moves on the Targets.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their whole body to provide shelter and protection to everyone they can. They are the rock on which others stand.

move.name: Hydro Cannon
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge
move.description: Those who fear fire’s destructive power have forgotten that water triumphs over the flames every single time.

move.name: Avalanche
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 4. *If the User received damage from the target during this Turn add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool. *If Snowy Weather is active add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.
move.description: The user covers themselves with a heavy snow coat, if anything disturbs the snow, it will fall like a heavy avalanche.

move.name: Rock Smash
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Reduce the Target's Defense by 1.
move.description: A hit powerful enough to destroy rocks and crack armor.

move.name: Mud Sport
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Physical & Special Electric-Type Moves have Power 0. Pokemon weak to Electric-Type Moves won't receive Super-Effective Damage from them. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The user covers the whole field with mud. Electricity can’t flow properly, so Electric attacks will be severely impaired.

move.name: Rock Throw
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged.
move.description: Back in the day, this was a common form of amusement amongst Pokémon and children alike.

move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Recoil.
move.description: Through a reckless grapple, the Pokémon smashes the foe into the ground, usually falling along with it.

move.name: Supersonic
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Sound Move. Confuse the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a series of ultrasonic waves that mess with the foe by making it feel dizzy and disoriented.

move.name: Rock Slide
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch those affected.
move.description: Don’t worry, even if you are not the fastest one in the race, you can still win by a landslide.

move.name: Water Pulse
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target.
move.description: The user sends out a pulsing ring of water that blasts the foe with ultrasonic waves. For a while, everything seems as if reflected in the water ripples.

move.name: Surf
move.effect: Area Move. If a Target is out of range due to the Move "Dive", this Move hits anyways. Out of battle, allows the Pokemon to travel the sea for long distances.
move.description: The Pokémon calls forward a large wave of seawater to ride, most Pokémon get washed out as they did not bring a surfboard.

move.name: Whirlpool

move.description: The foe is swallowed inside of a violent swirling whirlpool. Trapping them on the violent currents, barely managing to stay afloat.

move.description: A mighty screech will make the target cover its ears instead of covering its flanks.

move.description: Stop. Hammer Arm time!

move.effect: Single Target. Roll Dice of Normal-Type Damage equal to the difference between the User's current HP and the Target's max HP. Ignore defenses. Up to 10 Dice may be rolled this way. This Damage cannot make the Target's HP go lower than the User's current HP.
move.description: Through sheer willpower the Pokémon manages to level the conditions of the battle despite their own injuries.

description: Inhabits cold water sources and only comes out during the evening when the land has cooled, to find something to eat. Under this ideal environment it has rarely been seen at its evolved stage.

abilityOne.description: The Pokemon's body is mostly made of water, it stores water inside itself and uses it for nourishment.
abilityOne.effect: When this Pokemon is hit by a Water-Type Move, you may restore 1 HP instead of receiving damage. Water-Type Moves do not deal damage to this Pokemon.

abilityTwo.name: Unaware
abilityTwo.description: The Pokemon is oblivious to many details in its surroundings, it will rarely take notice of things going on.
abilityTwo.effect: This Pokemon ignores any Increase or Reduction on the foe's Attributes. This effect applies when dealing and receiving damage from a foe.

move.description: The fastest water gun in town. No enemy will remain dry

move.description: A thick layer of mist cloaks a pack of pokémon, those with the intent to trick and weaken them will have to find them first.

move.name: Curse
move.effect: Single Target. Roll half of the User's HP as Typeless Damage Dice to itself, ignoring defenses. The Target will remove 1 success from all of their Rolls until the Curse if lifted.
move.description: The user mutters an evil incantation, misery will befall into the foe at the cost of the user’s soul. To get rid of the curse, perform an exorcism or get help at a Pokémon Center

move.name: Ice Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 1 Chance Dice to Freeze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon wears their ice gloves to punch the foe. Yes. Gloves made of ice.

move.name: Aqua Tail
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The user sways their tail to create a pocket whirlpool in which the foe gets sucked in by the spinning motion.

move.name: Haze
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Remove all Increased or Reduced Attributes and Traits of everyone on the battlefield.
move.description: The battlefield is filled with a cleansing cloud that takes away all impurities in the field. It can also work as concealment.

move.name: Yawn
move.effect: Single Target. *If the Target has not been removed from battle at the beginning of the next Round, put it to Sleep.
move.description: The user yawns, the foe yawns, the trainers yawn... everyone should take a nap.

move.name: Muddy Water
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 2. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of those affected.
move.description: When you can’t see what creatures lurk inside the water, that’s when you know they are the ones that went fishing.

move.name: Ancient Power
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Increase by 1 the User's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense and Sp. Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon calls forward an energy from the ancient past. This may infuse the user with a primal strength.

move.name: Toxic
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Badly Poison the Target.
move.description: This burning acid dissolves skin to enter the bloodstream directly. The poor victim feels like they are melting from the inside out. The clock is ticking.

move.name: Earthquake
move.effect: Area Move. Ranged. If the Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dig" this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The user calls the forces of nature. The earth shakes violently and everything crumbles to the ground.

move.name: Power-Up Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Increase User's Strength by 1.
move.description: A punch to test the impact’s surface and adjust the level of strength required to punch through it.

name: Yamask
description: This Pokémon arose from the spirit of a human or a Pokémon that died in the past and was buried with special ceremonies. Each one carries a mask that looks like the face it had in life. A sad Pokémon that weeps often.

abilityOne.name: Mummy
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon will curse whoever dares to inflict harm upon them, the curse may even last for generations and will need the aid of a medium to lift it.
abilityOne.effect: When this Pokemon hits or gets hit with a Non-Ranged Physical Move, the foe's Ability is changed to Mummy.

move.name: Astonish
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe.
move.description: The user sneaks behind their target to jump scare them.

move.name: Protect
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokemon would receive from a Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Moves that target the user.
move.description: A mighty energy shield materializes in front of the user to to deflect attacks and dispel ill effects.

move.name: Haze
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Remove all Increased or Reduced Attributes and Traits of everyone on the battlefield.
move.description: The battlefield is filled with a cleansing cloud that takes away all impurities in the field. It can also work as concealment.

move.name: Hex
move.effect: Single Target. *If the Target has an active Status Condition, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move.
move.description: The user casts a terrible hex over the target, the effects will be greater if the target is already burdened by an ailment.

move.name: Will-O-Wisp
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target. Using this Move against the same Target increases the Burn Degree.
move.description: The user calls upon an eerie blue flame made with the souls of the departed. They appear harmless until they have you surrounded.

move.name: Shadow Ball
move.effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: Dark matter and shadows are used as a projectile against the foe, bringing out memories of their deepest fears.

move.name: Fake Tears
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce foe's Sp. Defense by 2.
move.description: The user stops mid-combat to start crying; feeling incredibly guilty, the foe lowers its guard.

move.name: Nasty Plot
move.effect: Target Self. Increase User's Special by 2.
move.description: Rubbing both hands and laughing sinisterly the Pokémon rejoices in the evil plans they’ll soon carry out.

move.name: Role Play
move.effect: Single Target. Replace the User's Ability with the Target's. Whole Scene Duration. Unique Abilities can't be copied.
move.description: The Pokémon is a great actor. Their impersonations are really good! ...maybe a bit too good.

move.name: Night Shade
move.effect: Single Target. Roll Ghost-Type Damage Dice according to the User's Rank: Starter 1 Die / Rookie 2 Dice / Standard 4 Dice/ Advacned 6 Dice / Expert 8 Dice / Ace and forward 10 Dice. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The user casts a dark and frightening mirage surrounding the foe to give them a panic attack.

move.name: Disable
move.effect: Single Target. Disable the last Move performed by the Target. Only one Move may be Disabled at a time.
move.description: The Pokémon finds the right nerve to pull that will render a foe useless to perform their best Move.

move.name: Crafty Shield
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Reaction 3. Shield Move. Negate the Added Effects from Moves made against the Targets.
move.description: The Pokémon creates a magic shield to protect everyone from any tricks a foe has up their sleeve. Under this shield, everyone can see dishonesty and bad intentions

move.name: Mean Look
move.effect: Single Target. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: An intense and ever-vigilant stare that surveils all possible paths the foe has to escape.

move.name: Grudge
move.effect: Single Target. The User Faints. Reduce the Target's Will to 0 points and reset any effect it got from spending them. Roll Target's Loyalty at the end of the round, increase difficulty by 1 each round. Failing this roll faints the Target.
move.description: The last words of this Pokémon imprint their grudge and anger over their foe. Depleting the foe of their will to carry on in this world.

move.name: Curse
move.effect: Single Target. Roll half of the User's HP as Typeless Damage Dice to itself, ignoring defenses. The Target will remove 1 success from all of their Rolls until the Curse if lifted.
move.description: The user mutters an evil incantation, misery will befall into the foe at the cost of the user’s soul. To get rid of the curse, perform an exorcism or get help at a Pokémon Center

move.name: Ominous Wind
move.effect: Single Target. Wind Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Increase by 1 the User's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense and Sp. Defense.
move.description: The battlefield gets absolutely silent, the only noise is a cold wind draft that gives the target chills and goosebumps. Observing from the shadows, the user rejoices in the fear.

move.name: Dark Pulse
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: A haze of dark energy decends on the battlefield preying on those vulnerable to the obscure feelings and fears it provokes.

move.name: Guard Split
move.effect: Single Target. Average the User's Defense and Sp. Defense with the Target's, rounded down.
move.description: Through a mental link both Pokémon are aware of each other weaknesses, which end up evening the odds.

move.name: Power Split
move.effect: Single Target. Average the User's Strength and Special with the Target's, rounded down.
move.description: Through a mental link both Pokémon are aware of each other strengths, which ends up evening the odds.

move.name: Destiny Bond
move.effect: Target Self. If the user faints this Round due to damage frm a Physical or Special Move, the Pokemon who dealt the damage is dealt damage equal to their remaining Hp. This Move will fail if it was used the previous Round.
move.description: Through a mystical bond, everyone who brings disgrace to this Pokémon will suffer the exact same fate.

name: Nuzleaf
description: They live inside holes in big trees. Their leaves are played like flutes to strike fear and discomfort in lost people's hearts. They like to go out and startle people. Their noses are really sensitive and frail.

abilityOne.name: Chlorophyll
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon synthesizes sunlight to get energy, if it's kept in a sunny environment it will rarely need to eat.
abilityOne.effect: While Sunny Weather is active, Increase this Pokemon's Dexterity Attribute by 2.

abilityTwo.name: Early Bird
abilityTwo.description: Pokemon with this ability are light sleepers that will easily rise from slumber. They wake up full of energy with just a couple hours of sleep.
abilityTwo.effect: The time this Pokemon would be asleep is reduced by half and it will only need to score 2 successes on its Insight roll to wake up in battle. This effect does not apply for the Move "Rest".

hiddenAbility.name: Pickpocket
hiddenAbility.description: The Pokemon will instinctively steal from others. It takes whatever it can when people are not looking.
hiddenAbility.effect: If this Pokemon is not holding an Item it will steal the held Item of the foe it just hit with a Non-Ranged Physical Move.

move.name: Razor Leaf
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Cutter Move. Ranged. High Critical.
move.description: The user sends out a barrage of sharp razor-like leaves. “Death by a thousand cuts” would be the best depiction.

move.name: Nature Power
move.effect: Single Target. *The Type of this Move is determined by the environment or active Terrain. See more on p. 530
move.description: The Pokémon makes use of the terrain and asks for nature's aid in battle.

move.name: Fake Out
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Flinch the Target. This Move will only work on the First Round the User is out in battle. from the Second Round on, it will fail automatically.
move.description: The Pokémon pretends to be getting ready for the battle when they are actually prepairing a surprise attack on the foe.

move.name: Swagger
move.effect: Single Target. Increase the Target's Strength by 2. Confuse the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon’s arrogant and mocking attitude enrage their foe and make it lose focus in battle.

move.name: Extrasensory
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon alters their target’s senses, making it feel things that aren’t really there.

move.name: Foul Play
move.effect: Single Target. S.T.A.B. of the User and the Strength/Special of the foe are used for this Move's Damage Pool.
move.description: The user feints an attack that tricks the foe into hurting itself.

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Harden
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 1.
move.description: When life gets hard, do the same.

move.name: Bide
move.effect: Single Target. The User will not Evade or Clash the next 2 Physical or Special Moves targeting it. Once all damage has been dealt against the User, roll a number of Normal-Type Damage dice equal to twice the total amount of Damage the Target received. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The user puts up with being hit, waiting for the perfect opportunity to retaliate.

move.name: Absorb
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The user takes nutrients from the nearest source of life they find.

move.name: Astonish
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe.
move.description: The user sneaks behind their target to jump scare them.

move.name: Growth
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Special. If the Sunny Weather is active, increase by 2 Instead.
move.description: The Pokémon makes their body grow in size. They’ll get bigger and stronger in just a few seconds.

move.name: Rollout
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions. *If all 5 actions land successfully, add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of the last hit of this Move. If the Pokemon used the Move "Defense Curl" in the same round, this Move's base Power becomes 2.
move.description: When the foe sees this Pokémon rollin’ they’ll be hatin’.

move.name: Payback
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move if the User has already received Damage from the Target this Round.
move.description: Some say the best revenge is a successful and happy life, but not this Pokémon.

move.name: Air Cutter
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. High Critical. Wind Move. Cutter Move.
move.description: A sharp wide wave of wind is sent out , everyone can feel it slicing throught their midsection.

move.name: Mega Drain
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The user absorbs a big amount of vital energy and nutrients from the target to feed from.

move.name: Synthesis
move.effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will Point to activate. If Sunny Weather is in effect, this Move becomes a Complete Heal. If performed under Rain, Sandstorm, Hail or Snowy Weather, this Move is a Minor heal and only heals 1 HP.
move.description: The Pokémon gathers sunlight to re-energize themselves.

move.name: Sunny Day
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Activate Sunny Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The Pokémon will call for the sun to shine brighter, increasing the heat of the arena. This Move doesn’t work at night, indoors, or underground/water.

move.name: Torment
move.effect: Single Target. The Target cannot use any of the Moves it used during the last Round. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The Pokémon bullies their foe to the point of torment where they cannot keep using their strategy without feeling bad about it.

move.name: Leaf Blade
move.effect: Single Target. High Critical. Lethal. Cutter Move.
move.description: Danger lies not on the material’s toughness but on its edge’s sharpness.

move.name: Sucker Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 6. *This move can only be used as a Late Reaction; and only if the Target used a Physical or Special Move, otherwise it will fail.
move.description: The Pokémon takes advantage of their foe preparing to attack to unleash a dirty surprise blow.

move.name: Explosion
move.effect: Area Move. Ranged. Lethal. The User Faints.
move.description: Through a massive explosion the Pokémon destroys all they can before fainting. Sometimes the only way to get out of a bad situation is in bits and pieces.

move.name: Beat Up
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move for every ally Pokemon that spends an action in addition to this Move, up to 3 allies may join.
move.description: The user calls other Pokémon to aid it in battle, together they give a beating to the foe.

move.name: Grassy Terrain
move.effect: Target User's side of the field. Add 1 Extra Damage Dice to all Physical & Special Grass-Type Moves. Everyone on the User's side of the field heals 1 HP at the end of each Round. Spend 1 Will Point t activate. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A patch of grass grows in the area surrounding the user, through it nature grants her many blessings.

name: Rattata (Alolan Form)
description: Rattata first came to Alola through cargo ships. It thrived and almost destroyed the region's ecosystem. Attempts to exterminate this Pokémon made it more vicious than its regular counterpart.

abilityOne.name: Gluttony
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon eats all day long, it is always carrying food and has no problem to find food sources since it's not a picky eater. It, however, doesn't share.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon can eat any type of food, medicine or herbal medicine with no negative. This pokemon may have up to three berries as held item instead of just one. The berries must not be of the same effect.

abilityTwo.name: Hustle
abilityTwo.description: The Pokemon will perform everything in a hurry, it keeps itself busy, but it can be kind of sloppy when it rushes something out.
abilityTwo.effect: This Pokemon gets an Extra Low Accuracy 1 and adds 2 Extra Dice to the Damage pool for all its Physical Moves.

hiddenAbility.name: Thick Fat
hiddenAbility.description: This Pokemon's body has a thick layer of blubber that protects it against against harsh temperatures.
hiddenAbility.effect: Reduce by 1 the damage taken from Fire and Ice-Type moves.

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Tail Whip
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The Pokémon whips their tail in such an adorable way the foes let their guard down.

move.name: Quick Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Out of battle, double the Pokemon's movement speed.
move.description: An attackas fight as lightning.

move.name: Focus Energy
move.effect: Target Self. All of the user's Physical & Special Moves now have "High Critical". Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The Pokémon concentrates all their focus on the battle to make their attacks much more precise.

move.name: Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe
move.description: The user lands a vicious bite, leaving an ugly bruise.

move.name: Pursuit
move.effect: Single Target. *If a Target hit by this Move is recalled, attempts to Run Away, uses a Switcher Move or is the Target of a Switcher Move, Deal 2 Typeless Damage to it. Outside of battle, aid in catching a fleeing target.
move.description: The Pokémon is relentless in its pursuit of their target, striking it just as it believed it had escaped.

move.name: Hyper Fang
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Roll 1 Chance die to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon bites hard into the foe, leaving nasty teeth marks.

move.name: Sucker Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 6. *This move can only be used as a Late Reaction; and only if the Target used a Physical or Special Move, otherwise it will fail.
move.description: The Pokémon takes advantage of their foe preparing to attack to unleash a dirty surprise blow.

move.name: Assurance
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 2 extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move if the Target has already received Damage from the User this Round.
move.description: The user indentifies the weakest foe and charges against them.

move.name: Super Fang
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Bite Move. Roll Normal-Type Damage Dice equal to Half of the Target's remaining HP. Up to 10 Dice may be rolled this way. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The Pokémon jumps to bite a chunk off their Target with their mighty fangs. After each bite there’s less and less foe to take chunks off.

move.name: Endeavor
move.effect: Single Target. Roll Dice of Normal-Type Damage equal to the difference between the User's current HP and the Target's max HP. Ignore defenses. Up to 10 Dice may be rolled this way. This Damage cannot make the Target's HP go lower than the User's current HP.
move.description: Through sheer willpower the Pokémon manages to level the conditions of the battle despite their own injuries.

move.name: Reversal
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool for every missing HP the User has. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The user gathers their mettle to block away the pain and focus only on hitting harder.

move.name: Snatch
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 6. Remove any Increase/Reduction on the Foe's Attributes, Active Shield Moves, Healing effects on the Foe, or effects on its side of the field; and place them on the User instead. See p. 531 for more info.
move.description: The user takes notice of the good stuff on the other side and quickly takes it for themselves. Finders keepers, losers weepers!

move.name: Switcheroo
move.effect: Single Target. The User and the Target switch their Held Item. If only one Pokemon is holding an Item, it gives it away.
move.description: The Pokémon uses a bit of sleigh of hand to switch their Held Item with the target’s, who don’t even notice what happened.

move.name: Crunch
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Lethal. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the foe's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon viciously mauls, tears, and rips apart anything its fangs can come in contact with.

move.name: Fury Swipes
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions.
move.description: With their sharp claws, the Pokémon will swiftly scatch their foe, leaving its face full of small cuts.

move.name: Double-Edge
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil.
move.description: Without regard for their own safety, the Pokémon does a reckless attack against their foe.

move.name: Me First
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Copy Move. Support Moves can't be copied. Unique Moves can't be copied. You may choose another Target(s) for the copied Move.
move.description: The user anticipates the next Move the target will use and impatiently interrupts to be the first in line.

name: Squirtle
description: It is scarce in the wild. The shell is not just for protection - it also helps to minimize resistance in water, enabling Squirtle to swim at high speeds. It's usually a calm and easygoing Pokémon.

abilityOne.name: Torrent
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon builds up pressure to shoot water streams. When that pressure cannot be held in, it is released through uncontrollable torrents.
abilityOne.effect: Pain Penalization won't reduce successes from Accuracy or Damage rolls of Water-Type Moves used by this Pokemon. Water-Type Moves get 2 Extra dice to their Damage Pool when this Pokemon is at half HP or less.

abilityTwo.name: Rain Dish
abilityTwo.description: The Pokemon will store rain water for drink and nourishment.
abilityTwo.effect: While Rain Weather is active, you may restore 1 HP to this Pokemon at the end of each Round.

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Tail Whip
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The Pokémon whips their tail in such an adorable way the foes let their guard down.

move.name: Water Gun
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The fastest water gun in town. No enemy will remain dry

move.name: Withdraw
move.effect: Target Self. Increase User's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon withraw into their shell for increased protection and to avoid unwanted interactions.

move.name: Bubble
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: Dozens of bubbles are sent floating through the battlefield. The foes can’t resist the temptation to burst the pretty bubbles, only for the bubbles to explode for real when they do.

move.name: Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe
move.description: The user lands a vicious bite, leaving an ugly bruise.

move.name: Protect
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokemon would receive from a Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Moves that target the user.
move.description: A mighty energy shield materializes in front of the user to to deflect attacks and dispel ill effects.

move.name: Water Pulse
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target.
move.description: The user sends out a pulsing ring of water that blasts the foe with ultrasonic waves. For a while, everything seems as if reflected in the water ripples.

move.name: Aqua Tail
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The user sways their tail to create a pocket whirlpool in which the foe gets sucked in by the spinning motion.

move.name: Iron Defense
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
move.description: Iron body, iron will. This Pokémon is unbreakable.

move.name: Aqua Jet
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1.
move.description: The Pokémon propels themselves with a jet of pressured water.

move.name: Water Pledge
move.effect: Area Move. This Effect Targets the Battlefield: Add 2 Dice to all Chance Dice rolls of everyone in the field. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The Pokémon chants to invoke the power of water. Moisture in the air bends the light to create a rainbow to bring good fortune. Everyone in the field feels luckier for a while.

move.name: Icy Wind
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Wind Move. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: Polar winds sweep through the arena. Everyone starts to shiver and embrace themselves, trying to preserve a bit of warmth.

move.name: Rapid Spin
move.effect: Single Target. Increase the User's Dexterity by 1. Remove Entry Hazards, Terrains (ie Grassy Terrain, Misty Terrain), Ongoing Damage and Leech seed from the User and/or their side of the field.
move.description: The Pokémon makes a swift spin to strike at the foe and in the process everything laying close to the user is scattered out of the battlefield.

move.name: Rain Dance
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Activate Rain Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The Pokémon performs a peculiar dance in the middle of the field, everyone thinks it silly until the first thunder rumbles.

move.name: Flip Turn
move.effect: Single Target. Switcher Move for the User.
move.description: Charge at the foe as a cannon ball made out of water. The big splash causes bystanders to lose sight on the battlefield. When the splash settles, the user is gone.

move.name: Shell Smash
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 2 the User's Strength, Special and Dexterity. Reduce by 2 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon breaks off their own shell. The foe mistakenly believed the shell was for the Pokémon to protect themselves when it was actually there to protect the foes from what’s next.

move.name: Muddy Water
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 2. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of those affected.
move.description: When you can’t see what creatures lurk inside the water, that’s when you know they are the ones that went fishing.

move.name: Skull Bash
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. While this Move is charging, Increase the User's Defense by 1.
move.description: The user withdraws into their shell, after a few seconds of them not moving, the foe goes to inspect and the user pops their head out in in a devastating strike.

move.name: Hydro Pump
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2
move.description: Water works best under pressure.

name: Poliwag
description: They are most common near ponds and lakes during the summer. Its legs take some weeks to develop after it hatches, making it inept at walking. It is, however, a very fast swimmer.

abilityOne.name: Water Absorb
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon's body is mostly made of water, it stores water inside itself and uses it for nourishment.
abilityOne.effect: When this Pokemon is hit by a Water-Type Move, you may restore 1 HP instead of receiving damage. Water-Type Moves do not deal damage to this Pokemon.

abilityTwo.name: Damp
abilityTwo.description: The Pokemon gathers the humidity in the air around itself. Lighting a spark or keeping a fire on, will be almost impossible close to it.
abilityTwo.effect: No one in the field will be able to use the moves: Self-Destruct, Explosion, Misty Explosion, Mind Blown, and Burn Up while this Pokemon is in the field. The Ability Aftermath does not activate if this Pokemon is in the field.

hiddenAbility.name: Swift Swim
hiddenAbility.description: The Pokemon will move faster in water than on land, even a puddle-covered roadway will allow it to use its full speed.
hiddenAbility.effect: While Rain Weather is active, Increase this Pokemon's Dexterity Attribute by 2.

move.name: Water Sport
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Physical & Special Fire-Type Moves have Power 0. Pokemon weak to Fire-Type Moves won't receive Super-Effective Damage from them. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A single drop of water can’t put off a raging fire, but what is the ocean but a collection of drops.

move.name: Water Gun
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The fastest water gun in town. No enemy will remain dry

move.name: Hypnosis
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Put the Target to sleep. Dark-Type Pokemon are affected by this Move.
move.description: By staring at an hypnotic pendulum, the target is suggestioned to feel tired and close its eyelids.

move.name: Bubble
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: Dozens of bubbles are sent floating through the battlefield. The foes can’t resist the temptation to burst the pretty bubbles, only for the bubbles to explode for real when they do.

move.name: Double Slap
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Double Action.
move.description: The name is misleading as the user slaps withouth even counting how many slaps they have given already

move.name: Rain Dance
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Activate Rain Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The Pokémon performs a peculiar dance in the middle of the field, everyone thinks it silly until the first thunder rumbles.

move.name: Body Slam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The user charges against the foe using ther body to slam it down, leaving the target stunned.

move.name: Mud Shot
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 1.
move.description: By shooting a stream of mud at their target, the user manages to impair their movement.

move.name: Belly Drum
move.effect: Target Self. Roll half of the User's HP as Typeless Damage Dice to itself, ignore defenses. Increase User's Strengt by 3.
move.description: With an angry war cry the user hits their belly as drums of war.

move.name: Wake-Up Slap
move.effect: Single Target. *If the foe has the Sleep Status, Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool. Wake up the foe after dealing damage.
move.description: Wakey wakey, sleepy head!

move.name: Mud Bomb
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Projectile Move. Roll 3 Chance Die to Reduce 1 success to all Accuracy rolls of the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a ball of mud to burst on their victim’s face in an attempt to blind them.

move.name: Icy Wind
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Wind Move. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: Polar winds sweep through the arena. Everyone starts to shiver and embrace themselves, trying to preserve a bit of warmth.

move.name: Mind Reader
