move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Projectile Move. Successive Actions. *If all 5 actions land successfully, add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of the last hit of this Move. If the Pokemon used the Move "Defense Curl" in the same round, this Move's base Power becomes 2.
move.description: The Pokémon rolls into a snowball, getting bigger and bigger as they keep rolling

move.name: Body Slam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The user charges against the foe using ther body to slam it down, leaving the target stunned.

move.name: Aurora Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce target's Strength by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a beautiful shimmering beam that cools down a hot temper.

move.name: Rest
move.effect: Target Self. Complete Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Put the User to Sleep.
move.description: Yeah, this seems like a good spot to take a nap.

move.name: Snore
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. If the user is not asleep, this Move fails.
move.description: While the Pokémon is asleep they start snoring so loud it startles the foe.

move.name: Dive
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Scald/ Surf/ Whirlpool/ Freeze-Dry/ Sheer Cold. Out of battle allows the Pokemon to move underwater carrying someone without risk of drowning.
move.description: Just look at the world around you right here on the ocean floor, such wonderful things surround you. What more are you lookin’ for?

move.name: Endure
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. If a Physical or Special Move would cause the user to faint, they remain at 1 HP instead, remove this effect afterwards. The effect re-activates on the user's next Turn. Whole Round duration.
move.description: The Pokémon mentally prepares to receive a fatal blow, their spirit is stronger than their body so they endure to keep on fighting for as long as possible.

move.name: Rollout
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions. *If all 5 actions land successfully, add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of the last hit of this Move. If the Pokemon used the Move "Defense Curl" in the same round, this Move's base Power becomes 2.
move.description: When the foe sees this Pokémon rollin’ they’ll be hatin’.

move.name: Powder Snow
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Roll 1 Chance Die to Freeze those affected.
move.description: A light layer of snow flakes covers the foes, as the layers pile up the possibilities to be trapped into the snow increase.

move.name: Encore
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 3. The Target will repeat the exact same action sequence it had last Round. Target must have had an action sequence. Duration 1 Round. If used on the previous Round, this move fails. See more on p. 529.
move.description: The Pokémon makes a standing ovation at their target, prompting them to repeat everything they just did, exactly the way they did it.

move.name: Surf
move.effect: Area Move. If a Target is out of range due to the Move "Dive", this Move hits anyways. Out of battle, allows the Pokemon to travel the sea for long distances.
move.description: The Pokémon calls forward a large wave of seawater to ride, most Pokémon get washed out as they did not bring a surfboard.

move.name: Brine
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 3 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool if the Target is at half HP or less.
move.description: A splash of sea water that literally adds more and more salt to the foe’s wounds.

move.name: Hail
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Activate Hail Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The skies turn gray, and loud thunder rumbles, but what falls is not a gentle drizzle, but an endless stream of ice shards coming down at high speeds. Find shelter!

move.name: Blizzard
move.effect: All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Wind Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Freeze those affected. *Sunny Weather increases to Low Accuracy 4. **Hail/Snowy Weather remove Low Accuracy and adds the effect "Never Miss".
move.description: The user summons a turbulent and gelid wind that feels like ice daggers. A pleasant day may make it difficult to call upon, but beware if the temperatures go below zero.

move.name: Sheer Cold
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 5. Ranged. Deal Damage to the Target equal to its Remaining HP, plus 1 Lethal Damage.
move.description: The Pokémon reaches an absolute zero by being freezed from the inside out. Urgent medical attention is required.

move.name: Bulldoze
move.effect: Area Move. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: The user stomps and flattens the ground, pushing all the rubbish and leaving the surface ready for construction.

name: Sawk
description: This Pokémon is entirely dedicated to becoming stronger. Many have secluded in the mountains to train all day. Wild ones make their clothes out of plants and vines they find. Sawk and Throh train together.

abilityOne.name: Sturdy
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon's body is extremely resistant to damage, it can withstand almost anything.
abilityOne.effect: The first time this Pokemon would reach 0 HP due to damage from a Move, it will remain at 1 HP instead. Status Ailments/Conditions, Weather, and Self-inflicted damage do not trigger this effect. The Pokemon can only benefit from Sturdy once per scene.

abilityTwo.name: Inner Focus
abilityTwo.description: The Pokemon is extrmely serious and focused on everything it does. It remains calm and never backs down, even if it's getting severly injured.
abilityTwo.effect: This Pokemon does not Flinch. The Ability Intimidate does not have any effect against this Pokemon. Outside of battle this Pokemon is able to resist intimidation tactics, fear and stress better than others.

hiddenAbility.name: Mold Breaker
hiddenAbility.description: This Pokemon will find unusual ways to achieve its goals. They are inventive and go around problems.
hiddenAbility.effect: If a foe Pokemon has a Type, an immunity, or an Ability that would prevent this Pokemon from dealing Damage with a Move, ignore it.

move.name: Rock Smash
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Reduce the Target's Defense by 1.
move.description: A hit powerful enough to destroy rocks and crack armor.

move.name: Leer
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The vicious glare of a predator that triggers the flight response of their prey.

move.name: Bide
move.effect: Single Target. The User will not Evade or Clash the next 2 Physical or Special Moves targeting it. Once all damage has been dealt against the User, roll a number of Normal-Type Damage dice equal to twice the total amount of Damage the Target received. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The user puts up with being hit, waiting for the perfect opportunity to retaliate.

move.name: Focus Energy
move.effect: Target Self. All of the user's Physical & Special Moves now have "High Critical". Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The Pokémon concentrates all their focus on the battle to make their attacks much more precise.

move.name: Double Kick
move.effect: Single Target. Double Action.
move.description: The good old one-two but with a twist.

move.name: Low Sweep
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon crouches and spins with a kick to the foe’s legs. Leaving them with a limp for the rest of the fight.

move.name: Bulk Up
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon showcase their muscles through poses that highlight their fitness and bodybuilding discipline.

move.name: Dual Chop
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Double Action.
move.description: Two brutal blows are all this Pokémon needs to make the opponent yield to their might.

move.name: Helping Hand
move.effect: Target One Ally. Reaction 5. The Target Gets 2 Extra Dice on their next Skill Check/Accuracy Roll, and 2 Extra Dice on their next Damage Roll. This Effect does not Stack.
move.description: The Pokémon is the first to come and give a hand to their friend. A true bro.

move.name: Block
move.effect: Single Target. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: You don’t seem to understand. I’m not blocked in here with you... You are blocked in here with me!

move.name: Quick Guard
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Reaction 3. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage from a Physical or Special Move with Priority. Negate the Added effects of Reaction and late Reaction Moves targeting the User and Allies.
move.description: The user reacts instinctively and defends itself and its team mates, nullyfing the effects of the fastest attacks.

move.name: Retaliate
move.effect: Single Target. *If an Ally fainted during this or the previous Round, add Extra Dice to the damage pool, equal to the user's Loyalty. Up to 5 dice may be added this way. This effect only activates once per fainted Ally.
move.description: With tears of rage in their eyes, the Pokémon will not let the fall of a friend go without punishment.

move.name: Brick Break
move.effect: Single Target. *If there is a Force field on the Target's side of the field, destroy it and add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.
move.description: The Pokémon uses a karate technique to chop through tall piles of bricks. No matter how many layers you pile up, they’ll break regardless.

move.name: Counter
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 5. Can only be used if Target's last Move on User was a Physical Move. For damage, roll dice equal to Target's last damage pool rolled against the User plus 2 dice. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The Pokémon strikes back at their foe. Showing they can take a hit and punch even harder.

move.name: Karate Chop
move.effect: Single Target. High Critical.
move.description: A classic karate technique, thi chop that has been practiced and mastered.

move.name: Strength
move.effect: Outside of battle, using this move allows the Pokemon to lift double the normal weight it should be able to.
move.description: The Pokemon strains its muscles to go beyond their own limits.

move.name: Poison Jab
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon is set on injecting venom directly into the foe’s bloodstream. They can do it the easy way or the hard way.

move.name: Low Kick
move.effect: Single Target. Add 1 Extra Damage Dice for every 50kg of the weight on the foe, up to 4 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The Pokémon uses a kick to the sheen to throw the foe into the ground. The bigger they are, the harder they fall.

move.name: Endure
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. If a Physical or Special Move would cause the user to faint, they remain at 1 HP instead, remove this effect afterwards. The effect re-activates on the user's next Turn. Whole Round duration.
move.description: The Pokémon mentally prepares to receive a fatal blow, their spirit is stronger than their body so they endure to keep on fighting for as long as possible.

move.name: Reversal
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool for every missing HP the User has. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The user gathers their mettle to block away the pain and focus only on hitting harder.

move.name: Close Combat
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce by 1 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon gets close enough to deal devastating damage, but the same can be said for the foe.

name: Sentret
description: It lives underground with its family. It is cautious and nervous by nature. Sentret is always vigilant for any threat. It is very friendly among its kind and suffers a lot if separated from its pack.

abilityOne.name: Run Away
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon is a master of escape. It will be difficult to catch as it can squeeze through the tiniest gaps to get away.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon cannot be Blocked. It may also obtain bonus dice to escape from battle, Pokeballs or captivity at Storyteller's discretion.

abilityTwo.name: Keen Eye
abilityTwo.description: These Pokemon have an exceptional sight. Locating small or far away objects is a lot easier for them.
abilityTwo.effect: This Pokemon cannot have successes removed from its Accuracy rolls by Moves, Items or Abilities.

hiddenAbility.name: Frisk
hiddenAbility.description: This Pokemon can see the items others may be carrying, even if they are hidden.
hiddenAbility.effect: When this Pokemon enters the battlefield, Storyteller must reveal its trainer the held item of one foe.

move.name: Scratch
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their sharp claws to scratch the enemy. Nothing fancy but it works.

move.name: Defense Curl
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 1. Increase by 1 the Power of the Moves "Ice Ball" & "Rollout".
move.description: The user curls into a ball to protect themselves when they feel threatened.

move.name: Fury Swipes
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions.
move.description: With their sharp claws, the Pokémon will swiftly scatch their foe, leaving its face full of small cuts.

move.name: Helping Hand
move.effect: Target One Ally. Reaction 5. The Target Gets 2 Extra Dice on their next Skill Check/Accuracy Roll, and 2 Extra Dice on their next Damage Roll. This Effect does not Stack.
move.description: The Pokémon is the first to come and give a hand to their friend. A true bro.

move.name: Follow Me
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. All Foe's Moves able to do so will Target the user. Duration 1 Round.
move.description: The Pokemon draws everyone’s attention, provoking their foes to do their worse.

move.name: Slam
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1.
move.description: Everybody get up, it’s time to slam now.

move.name: Sucker Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 6. *This move can only be used as a Late Reaction; and only if the Target used a Physical or Special Move, otherwise it will fail.
move.description: The Pokémon takes advantage of their foe preparing to attack to unleash a dirty surprise blow.

move.name: Baton Pass
move.effect: Target Self. Switcher Move for the User. Any Attribute increase on the user is passed on the next Pokemon. The user can't increase its own Attributes again until the end of the scene or until the switched Pokemon faints.
move.description: The Pokémon rallies through the battle, setting up everything for the next companion as they know this is a team effort.

move.name: Me First
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Copy Move. Support Moves can't be copied. Unique Moves can't be copied. You may choose another Target(s) for the copied Move.
move.description: The user anticipates the next Move the target will use and impatiently interrupts to be the first in line.

move.name: Charm
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce Target's Strength by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon engages their foe in a charming interaction to reduce their aggressive intent.

move.name: Growl
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Reduce by 1 the Strength of those affected.
move.description: Either through a menacing attitude or an adorable demeanor, the foe will hesitate to attack the user at full power.

move.name: Foresight
move.effect: Single Target. The Foe cannot Evade Moves performed by the User. User ignores Ghost-Type immunity to Normal and Fight-Type Moves and vice versa.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their honed senses and mental agility to predict the next movement of their foe.

move.name: Quick Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Out of battle, double the Pokemon's movement speed.
move.description: An attackas fight as lightning.

move.name: Rest
move.effect: Target Self. Complete Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Put the User to Sleep.
move.description: Yeah, this seems like a good spot to take a nap.

move.name: Amnesia
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Sp. Defense by 2.
move.description: No thoughts. Head empty

move.name: Reversal
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool for every missing HP the User has. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The user gathers their mettle to block away the pain and focus only on hitting harder.

move.name: Hyper Voice
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move.
move.description: The user screeches or sings at such high frequencies that anything made of glass will break. The ears of the victims are left in no better state.

move.name: Cut
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Cutter Move. Out of battle it will help to easily cut down trees and obstacles.
move.description: A swift and precise cut that can even slice a tree in half.

move.name: Surf
move.effect: Area Move. If a Target is out of range due to the Move "Dive", this Move hits anyways. Out of battle, allows the Pokemon to travel the sea for long distances.
move.description: The Pokémon calls forward a large wave of seawater to ride, most Pokémon get washed out as they did not bring a surfboard.

name: Tepig
description: It blows fire through its nose. When it catches a cold, the fire becomes pitch-black smoke instead. Tepig loves to eat roasted berries and its keen sense of smell allows it to find them easily.

abilityOne.name: Blaze
abilityOne.description: The inner and outer fire on this Pokemon's body will burn incredibly fierce just before fading.
abilityOne.effect: Pain Penalization won't reduce successes from Accuracy or Damage rolls of Fire-Type Moves used by this Pokemon. Fire-Type Moves get 2 Extra dice to their Damage Pool when this Pokemon is at half HP or less.

abilityTwo.name: Thick Fat
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon's body has a thick layer of blubber that protects it against against harsh temperatures.
abilityTwo.effect: Reduce by 1 the damage taken from Fire and Ice-Type moves.

move.name: Tail Whip
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The Pokémon whips their tail in such an adorable way the foes let their guard down.

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Odor Sleuth
move.effect: Single Target. The Foe cannot Evade Moves performed by the User. User ignores Ghost-Type immunity to Normal and Fight-Type Moves and vice versa. Out of battle, Add successes of this Move to any roll for Tracking targets.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their keen sense of smell to corner the foe and find it when it tries to scurry away

move.name: Ember
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: A basic fire attack, but not any less dangerous. Even a small flame can grow out of control.

move.name: Defense Curl
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 1. Increase by 1 the Power of the Moves "Ice Ball" & "Rollout".
move.description: The user curls into a ball to protect themselves when they feel threatened.

move.name: Flame Charge
move.effect: Single Target. Increase the User's Dexterity by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon dashes so fast they leave a trail of fire behind.

move.name: Smog
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Roll 4 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon releases a stream of filthy gases. The foe may try to hold their breath, but for how long?

move.name: Rollout
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions. *If all 5 actions land successfully, add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of the last hit of this Move. If the Pokemon used the Move "Defense Curl" in the same round, this Move's base Power becomes 2.
move.description: When the foe sees this Pokémon rollin’ they’ll be hatin’.

move.name: Take Down
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Recoil.
move.description: Through a reckless grapple, the Pokémon smashes the foe into the ground, usually falling along with it.

move.name: Heat Crash
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die of Damage for every 50kgs the User is above the Target. Up to 4 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The Pokémon sets themselves ablaze and dives a cannonball against their foe.

move.name: Flamethrower
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 2nd Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: The most emblematic fire attack, a seeminly endless stream of fire that reduces everything and everyone to ashes.

move.name: Head Smash
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Recoil.
move.description: Pokémon, angry. Pokémon, smash!

move.name: Roar
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 6. Switcher Move for the Foe. In the wild, the battle may end.
move.description: With a potent roar, to make the foe reconsider their intentions.

move.name: Fire Pledge
move.effect: Area Move. This Effect Targets the Battle Field: At the End of the Round, Roll 2 Dice of Fire-Type Damage to everyone without immunity to Ground on the field ignoring defenses. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The Pokémon chants to invoke the power of fire, their pledge is heard and the flames come forward to aid them in battle.

move.name: Body Slam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The user charges against the foe using ther body to slam it down, leaving the target stunned.

move.name: Sucker Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 6. *This move can only be used as a Late Reaction; and only if the Target used a Physical or Special Move, otherwise it will fail.
move.description: The Pokémon takes advantage of their foe preparing to attack to unleash a dirty surprise blow.

move.name: Assurance
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 2 extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move if the Target has already received Damage from the User this Round.
move.description: The user indentifies the weakest foe and charges against them.

move.name: Flare Blitz
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil. Roll 1 Chance die to inflict 3rd Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: A reckless blazing charge against their foe, ends up with an explosive collision

name: Regigigas
description: A very old legend tells about the King of Giants, who could crush a mountain with its grip and mold living titans from the rubble.

abilityOne.name: Slow Start
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon has remained dormant for thousand of years, its movements are heavy and slow, run away before it unleashes its full power.
abilityOne.effect: During the first three Rounds of a battle, this Pokemon will always go last in the initiative order. After those Rounds are over, Increase its Strength and Dexterity Attributes by 2 and now it will always go first in the initiative order. This effect resets if the Pokemon is called out of combat.

move.name: Heavy Slam
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to he Damage Pool for every 50kg of weight the User is above the target's weight. Up to 4 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The foe is about to confirm if the Pokémon is thick-boned.

move.name: Crush Grip
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Unique. *If the foe has an HP higher than 4, add 1 Extra Die to the Damage pool for every exceeding point. Up to 9 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The Pokémon grips the foe and starts crushing it. Small targets are difficult to grasp but larger bodies will not be released until they break.

move.name: Fire Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 2nd Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: A fist powered by the fiery spirit of combat, the heat of the battle lights of for real as the punch hits the foe right where it hurts!

move.name: Ice Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 1 Chance Dice to Freeze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon wears their ice gloves to punch the foe. Yes. Gloves made of ice.

move.name: Thunder Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 1 Chance die to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A charged punch to deliver a shocking blow.

move.name: Dizzy Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon locates their enemy’s balance point and lands a swift punch that leaves the foe seeing a swirl of stars around its head.

move.name: Knock Off
move.effect: Single Target. *If the Target is holding an Item, Add 2 Dice to the Damage pool of this Move. The Target loses its Held Item afterwards.
move.description: The Pokémon rudely smacks what their foe was holding.

move.name: Confuse Ray
move.effect: Single Target. Confuse the Target.
move.description: The user flashes a sinister ray of bright light that others cannot help but go straight into it.

move.name: Foresight
move.effect: Single Target. The Foe cannot Evade Moves performed by the User. User ignores Ghost-Type immunity to Normal and Fight-Type Moves and vice versa.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their honed senses and mental agility to predict the next movement of their foe.

move.name: Revenge
move.effect: Single Target. *If the User has already received Damage this Round, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.
move.description: Best served cold.

move.name: Wide Guard
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Reaction 3. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage the Targets would receive from Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Any Moves on the Targets.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their whole body to provide shelter and protection to everyone they can. They are the rock on which others stand.

move.name: Zen Headbutt
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses both their mental and physical prowess in a questionable yet effective “psychic” strike.

move.name: Payback
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move if the User has already received Damage from the Target this Round.
move.description: Some say the best revenge is a successful and happy life, but not this Pokémon.

move.name: Hidden Power
move.effect: Single Target. This Move will always deal Super-Effective Damage against the Target. If used by the Pokemon #201 Unown. See p. 530
move.description: Inside every Pokémon lies the key to unlock all kinds of power.

move.name: Psych Up
move.effect: Single Target. The User gets the same Attribute/Trait Increases and Reductions the Target has.
move.description: The Pokémon mentalizes themselves stronger than anyone. They feel good. They can win. They. Can. Do. This!

move.name: Giga Impact
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge. Lethal.
move.description: The Pokémon strikes with such a brutal force they leave a crater just from the impact. Let them catch their breath afterwards.

move.name: Substitute
move.effect: Target Self. Deal 2 damage to the User. Put a Substitute Decoy with 2 HP and the same defenses as the user. See p. 531
move.description: The Pokémon disappears in a poof of smoke. A decoy identical to the user takes their place in battle. The user keeps attacking from the shadows while the decoy serves as distraction.

move.name: Strength
move.effect: Outside of battle, using this move allows the Pokemon to lift double the normal weight it should be able to.
move.description: The Pokemon strains its muscles to go beyond their own limits.

move.name: Superpower
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Reduce by 1 the User's Strength and Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon packs all their power in a single crushing strike. All this effort leaves them quite tired afterwards.

move.name: Protect
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokemon would receive from a Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Moves that target the user.
move.description: A mighty energy shield materializes in front of the user to to deflect attacks and dispel ill effects.

move.name: Headbutt
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Out of battle it may cause a Random encounter when hitting trees and make objects drop from high places.
move.description: The Pokémon rams against their foe with their head. This Move is perfect to shake down trees when looking for berries, but beware of wild Pokémon nesting at the treetops.

move.name: Bulldoze
move.effect: Area Move. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: The user stomps and flattens the ground, pushing all the rubbish and leaving the surface ready for construction.

move.name: Ancient Power
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Increase by 1 the User's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense and Sp. Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon calls forward an energy from the ancient past. This may infuse the user with a primal strength.

move.name: Iron Head
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon charges to cure the foe’s iron deficit.

move.name: Mega Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Fist Move.
move.description: The Pokémon packs everything into this punch to pulverize their foe with a single strike.

move.name: Hammer Arm
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Low Accuracy 1. Reduce User's Dexterity by 1.
move.description: Stop. Hammer Arm time!

move.name: Power Shift
move.effect: Target Self. Switch the User's Strength with its Defense and its Special with its Sp. Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon knows that sometimes the best defense is a good offense.

name: Tyrunt
description: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. If something happens that it doesn't like, it throws a tantrum and runs wild. Many of the researchers that brought it back were attacked by its powerful jaws.

abilityOne.name: Strong Jaw
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon's strong jaw gives it tremendous biting power. Its teeth can tear through almost anything.
abilityOne.effect: Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of all Bite Moves.

abilityTwo.name: Sturdy
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon's body is extremely resistant to damage, it can withstand almost anything.
abilityTwo.effect: The first time this Pokemon would reach 0 HP due to damage from a Move, it will remain at 1 HP instead. Status Ailments/Conditions, Weather, and Self-inflicted damage do not trigger this effect. The Pokemon can only benefit from Sturdy once per scene.

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Tail Whip
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The Pokémon whips their tail in such an adorable way the foes let their guard down.

move.name: Roar
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 6. Switcher Move for the Foe. In the wild, the battle may end.
move.description: With a potent roar, to make the foe reconsider their intentions.

move.name: Bide
move.effect: Single Target. The User will not Evade or Clash the next 2 Physical or Special Moves targeting it. Once all damage has been dealt against the User, roll a number of Normal-Type Damage dice equal to twice the total amount of Damage the Target received. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The user puts up with being hit, waiting for the perfect opportunity to retaliate.

move.name: Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe
move.description: The user lands a vicious bite, leaving an ugly bruise.

move.name: Charm
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce Target's Strength by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon engages their foe in a charming interaction to reduce their aggressive intent.

move.name: Dragon Tail
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Late Reaction 6. Switcher Move for the Foe. In the wild, the battle may end.
move.description: The Pokémon sends their opponent flying up to 100ft in the air with a strong flick of their tail.

move.name: Dragon Claw
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses its strong claws to deliver a fierce tearing blow.

move.name: Thrash
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
move.description: The Pokémon becomes a wild thing and the rumpus has started.

move.name: Fire Fang
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Bite Move. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon bites the foe with their mouth ablaze, tearing and searing their foe’s flesh in a single attack.

move.name: Thunder Fang
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Bite Move. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon bites the foe with charged fangs, basically injecting electricity right into the foe’s nervous system.

move.name: Ice Fang
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Bite Move. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Freeze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon bites their foe with sharp teeth and a geli breath to chill their bones directly

move.name: Ancient Power
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Increase by 1 the User's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense and Sp. Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon calls forward an energy from the ancient past. This may infuse the user with a primal strength.

move.name: Stomp
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Die to Flinch the Target. Targets under the effects of the Move "Minimize" are vulnerable.
move.description: Stomping the foe with strong feet. Perfect to squish nasty little bugs.

move.name: Rock Slide
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch those affected.
move.description: Don’t worry, even if you are not the fastest one in the race, you can still win by a landslide.

move.name: Crunch
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Lethal. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the foe's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon viciously mauls, tears, and rips apart anything its fangs can come in contact with.

move.name: Stealth Rock
move.effect: Target Foe's Side of the Field. Entry Hazard. Pokemon entering the battle Receive 1 Rock-Type Damage. This effect does not stack.
move.description: The Pokémon hides a trap of sharp rocks that are launched at the victim before they even realize what even happened.

move.name: Earthquake
move.effect: Area Move. Ranged. If the Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dig" this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The user calls the forces of nature. The earth shakes violently and everything crumbles to the ground.

move.name: Horn Drill
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 5. Deal Damage equal to the Target's Remaining HP, plus 1 Lethal Damage.
move.description: The Pokémon stabs the target with a spinning horn, drilling through them until they are critical condition. Hurry to the nearest Pokémon Center.

name: Chatot
description: It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them and prevent attacks. Chatot who live with humans learn words and phrases, but it's unknown it they really know their meaning. Their imitations are very convincing.

abilityOne.name: Keen Eye
abilityOne.description: These Pokemon have an exceptional sight. Locating small or far away objects is a lot easier for them.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon cannot have successes removed from its Accuracy rolls by Moves, Items or Abilities.

abilityTwo.name: Tangled Feet
abilityTwo.description: The Pokemon moves in a very strange and particular way when dizzy or confused, this usually works to its advantage.
abilityTwo.effect: While this Pokemon is Confused, Add Extra "Reduced Accuracy" to all of the foe's Moves that Target this Pokemon.

hiddenAbility.name: Big Pecks
hiddenAbility.description: This tenacious Pokemon uses its beak to cover its weak spots.
hiddenAbility.effect: This Pokemon cannot have its Defense reduced.

move.name: Peck
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: Raise crows and they’ll peck your foe’s eyes.

move.name: Chatter
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon parrots the voice of a human and starts issuing silly commands to the foe. This quickly becomes confusing for the foe.

move.name: Sing
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Sound Move. Put the Target to sleep.
move.description: The Pokémon sings a lullaby; the sound is so comforting that it evokes memories of being tucked in bed and kissed good night.

move.name: Fury Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions.
move.description: The Pokémon attacks in a fury, their attacks are uncoordinated but relentless.

move.name: Round
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. *If the user and an ally are able to use Round. Both may choose to do it at the same time. If they do, add 3 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of both Pokemon.
move.description: The user attacks the foe with the power of music, if another one joins the performance, the musical harmony will rock their public!

move.name: Mimic
move.effect: Single Target. Copy Move. Replace "Mimic" with the copied Move. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The Pokémon is a quick learner. They imitate their target’s movements and just like that they get a new set of powers.

move.name: Echoed Voice
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. This Move can be used many times in the same Round. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage pool of this move for each time you use it. Up to 8 Dice might be added this way. Reset this effect if the user performs another move, evasion or clash.
move.description: The Pokémon yells at the void. Their echo answers. The Pokémon yells louder and louder everytime the echo talks back.

move.name: Roost
move.effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Remove the User's Immunity to Ground-Type Moves. Duration 1 Round.
move.description: The Pokémon gathers some twigs and builds themselves a comfy nest on the floor to roost and relax.

move.name: Uproar
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Sound Move. This Effect Targets the Battle Field: Pokemon will be cured of the Sleep Status. Duration 1 Round.
move.description: Shouts, screams, and loud music... What does a Pokémon have to do here for a peaceful night of sleep?

move.name: Synchronoise
move.effect: Area Move. Sound Move. Choose one Type (Fire, Poison, Steel, etc.). This move only affects those with that Type.
move.description: Each type of energy is contained by a thin layer of particles. With the right vibration frequency, that thin layer can be shattered like glass.

move.name: Agility
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: Swift of body, swift of mind.

move.name: Boomburst
move.effect: Area Move. Sound Move.
move.description: The Pokémon creates a sudden explosive sound that deafens everyone around.

move.name: Nasty Plot
move.effect: Target Self. Increase User's Special by 2.
move.description: Rubbing both hands and laughing sinisterly the Pokémon rejoices in the evil plans they’ll soon carry out.

move.name: Growl
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Reduce by 1 the Strength of those affected.
move.description: Either through a menacing attitude or an adorable demeanor, the foe will hesitate to attack the user at full power.

move.name: Confide
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Special by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon tells a secret to the target. They giggle together but the foe loses its concentration on the battle.

move.name: Taunt
move.effect: Single Target. The Target cannot perform Support Moves (Support Maneuvers may still be performed). Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: Through tease and mockery, the foe is enraged to the point it stops thinking clearly.

move.name: Swift
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Never Miss.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a burst of star-shaped sparkles at a blinding speed.

move.name: Air Cutter
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. High Critical. Wind Move. Cutter Move.
move.description: A sharp wide wave of wind is sent out , everyone can feel it slicing throught their midsection.

move.name: Mirror Move
move.effect: Single Target. Copy Move. Unique Moves can't be copied. You may choose another Target(s) for the copied Move.
move.description: The Pokémon parrots the target cries and movements. In an almost perfect impersonation that manages to copy its powers.

move.name: Air Slash
move.effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: A compressed wind-slash, the change of pressure knocks out the target momentarily

move.name: Feather Dance
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Strength by 2.
move.description: A dance as soft as a feather. It soothes the hearts of the spectators and reduces all aggression.

move.name: Parting Shot
move.effect: Single Target. Switcher Move for the User. Reduce by 1 the Foe's Strength and Special.
move.description: The user throws one last threat against the foe before taking their leave. The foe is left too frightened to try to stand up against the user and their gang.

move.name: Hyper Voice
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move.
move.description: The user screeches or sings at such high frequencies that anything made of glass will break. The ears of the victims are left in no better state.

move.name: Play Rough
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 1 Chance Dice to Reduce Target's Strength by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon and their foe start a playful wrestle that soon escalates into a furious wrestling match.

move.name: Hurricane
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Wind Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target. Rain Weather eliminates Low Accuracy. Sunny Weather increases to Low Accuracy 4. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop", this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The Pokémon calls upon fierce gale winds. It’ll be difficult to summon the tempest on a clear day, but a little rain will enhance it into a typhoon. Other pokémon in the air are in most danger.

name: Shelgon
description: The body is covered in a powerful armor that resembles bones. It hides in caves awaiting evolution, enduring hunger and harm while its cells prepare for its final transformation.

abilityOne.name: Rock Head
abilityOne.description: The head and body of the Pokemon are so resistant that they barely feel anything. Careful as they bump into things without even noticing.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon will not receive damage from Recoil.

abilityTwo.name: Overcoat
abilityTwo.description: The Pokemon will have a protective coat surrounding its body that allows it to live under extreme weather conditions.
abilityTwo.effect: This Pokemon won't recieve damage from active weather.

move.name: Rage
move.effect: Single Target. If a foe damages the User with a Physical or Special Move in the same round after using this Move. Increase the User's Strength by 1. This effect can stack up to 3 Times.
move.description: The user gets angry and throws a tantrum against the foe. The more the battle continues the angrier the user gets.

move.name: Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe
move.description: The user lands a vicious bite, leaving an ugly bruise.

move.name: Ember
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: A basic fire attack, but not any less dangerous. Even a small flame can grow out of control.

move.name: Headbutt
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Out of battle it may cause a Random encounter when hitting trees and make objects drop from high places.
move.description: The Pokémon rams against their foe with their head. This Move is perfect to shake down trees when looking for berries, but beware of wild Pokémon nesting at the treetops.

move.name: Dragon Breath
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A mystical flame breath that feels strengely cold to the touch. It doesn’t burn in a conventional way.

move.name: Zen Headbutt
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses both their mental and physical prowess in a questionable yet effective “psychic” strike.

move.name: Scary Face
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: When a Pokémon looks at you like THAT, you know you gotta thread carefully around them.

move.name: Dragon Claw
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses its strong claws to deliver a fierce tearing blow.

move.name: Hydro Pump
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2
move.description: Water works best under pressure.

move.name: Dragon Pulse
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon sends out a powerful wave of energy through their mouth.

move.name: Iron Defense
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
move.description: Iron body, iron will. This Pokémon is unbreakable.

move.name: Leer
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The vicious glare of a predator that triggers the flight response of their prey.

move.name: Focus Energy
move.effect: Target Self. All of the user's Physical & Special Moves now have "High Critical". Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The Pokémon concentrates all their focus on the battle to make their attacks much more precise.

move.name: Protect
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokemon would receive from a Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Moves that target the user.
move.description: A mighty energy shield materializes in front of the user to to deflect attacks and dispel ill effects.

move.name: Crunch
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Lethal. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the foe's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon viciously mauls, tears, and rips apart anything its fangs can come in contact with.

move.name: Flamethrower
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 2nd Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: The most emblematic fire attack, a seeminly endless stream of fire that reduces everything and everyone to ashes.

move.name: Double-Edge
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil.
move.description: Without regard for their own safety, the Pokémon does a reckless attack against their foe.

move.name: Outrage
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
move.description: The true nature of dragon-types unleashed. The user is consumed by a primal fury that won’t stop until everything has ben razed to the ground. Afterwards the Pokémon is confused.

name: Swoobat
description: They communicate by emitting ultrasonic waves through their noses. This sound is not perceptible by humans, but it can affect their mood and emotions. It hunts bug Pokémon and loves fresh fruit.

abilityOne.name: Unaware
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon is oblivious to many details in its surroundings, it will rarely take notice of things going on.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon ignores any Increase or Reduction on the foe's Attributes. This effect applies when dealing and receiving damage from a foe.

abilityTwo.name: Simple
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon's ingenious mind is easily swayed by not only its own, but also outside influences. It often finds the most simple solution to a problem.
abilityTwo.effect: If this Pokemon gets an Attribute reduced, reduce it by 1 more Point. If this Pokemon gets an Attribute increased, increase it by 1 more Point.

move.name: Confusion
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Confuse the Target.
move.description: A basic mental assault that makes the foe believe they are being attacked by an invisible enemy.

move.name: Odor Sleuth
move.effect: Single Target. The Foe cannot Evade Moves performed by the User. User ignores Ghost-Type immunity to Normal and Fight-Type Moves and vice versa. Out of battle, Add successes of this Move to any roll for Tracking targets.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their keen sense of smell to corner the foe and find it when it tries to scurry away

move.name: Gust
move.effect: Single Target. Wind Move. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop", this Move hits anyway.
move.description: The Pokémon flaps their wings and strikes the foe with a swirl of wind. Pokémon in the air may get swept away

move.name: Heart Stamp
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon controls the emotions of their victims just as they start to feel loved and safe, the Pokémon strikes. The poor victim is left broken hearted for a few seconds.

move.name: Imprison
move.effect: Target Self. While the User is on the battlefield, Moves known by the User cannot be used by foes. This effect ends if the User is removed from battle.
move.description: This move blocks all shared parts of a memory the user is well aware of. Moves, techniques, names, places, people or situations, no one will be able to recall those imprisoned memories.

move.name: Air Slash
move.effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: A compressed wind-slash, the change of pressure knocks out the target momentarily

move.name: Roost
move.effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Remove the User's Immunity to Ground-Type Moves. Duration 1 Round.
move.description: The Pokémon gathers some twigs and builds themselves a comfy nest on the floor to roost and relax.

move.name: Heat Wave
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 1. Wind Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 1st Degree Burn on those affected.
move.description: A large wave of extra-hot air that can set fire to everything it touches.

move.name: Assurance
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 2 extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move if the Target has already received Damage from the User this Round.
move.description: The user indentifies the weakest foe and charges against them.

move.name: Charm
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce Target's Strength by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon engages their foe in a charming interaction to reduce their aggressive intent.

move.name: Defog
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Remove all Force Fields, Entry Hazards and Terrains (Misty Terrain, Electric Terrain, etc.) from the Battlefield.
move.description: A strong wind sweeps out the battle field, removing anything from bad weather to scattered objects and even invisible barriers.

move.name: Air Cutter
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. High Critical. Wind Move. Cutter Move.
move.description: A sharp wide wave of wind is sent out , everyone can feel it slicing throught their midsection.

move.name: Attract
move.effect: Single Target. Target is now In Love with the User.
move.description: Through their good looks and coquetish attitude, the Pokémon makes everyone develop a crush on them.

move.name: Amnesia
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Sp. Defense by 2.
move.description: No thoughts. Head empty

move.name: Calm Mind
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Special and Sp. Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon takes a deep breath to increase the mental fortitude required to face any problem.

move.name: Psychic
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: The most iconic Psychic attack, the foe starts floating in the air and its swayed around by telekinesis as their mental barrier crumbles.

move.name: Synchronoise
move.effect: Area Move. Sound Move. Choose one Type (Fire, Poison, Steel, etc.). This move only affects those with that Type.
move.description: Each type of energy is contained by a thin layer of particles. With the right vibration frequency, that thin layer can be shattered like glass.

move.name: Tailwind
move.effect: Target User's side of the Field. Wind Move. Increase by 2 the Dexterity of everyone on the User's side of the field. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: Flying Pokémon know better than anyone how to use the wind in their favor. Let its draft carry you to victory.

move.name: Endeavor
move.effect: Single Target. Roll Dice of Normal-Type Damage equal to the difference between the User's current HP and the Target's max HP. Ignore defenses. Up to 10 Dice may be rolled this way. This Damage cannot make the Target's HP go lower than the User's current HP.
move.description: Through sheer willpower the Pokémon manages to level the conditions of the battle despite their own injuries.

move.name: Future Sight
move.effect: Single Target. This Move's damage is dealt at the beginning of the next Round. Ignore Shield Moves, Force Field, Cover & Substitute. If the target restires or switches out from battle, the damage will be dealt to the next opponent or to one of its allies.
move.description: The Pokémon foresees something terrible happening. Although when it tries to see their own future, the images are ever changing.

move.name: Sky Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Charge Move. High Critical. Lethal. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: In a graceful but lethal strike, the Pokémon takes a deep dive towards the foe as if the sky was falling down right on top of it

move.name: Expanding Force
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. *If Psychic Terrain is active, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move and you may add another target to it.
move.description: Psychic energies form a bubble of light to damage the foe. Under Psychic Terrain, the energy is so big it turns into a tall pillar that crushes anyone inside.

name: Rotom
description: Its electric body can merge with certain machines to take control of them and cause mischief and chaos. It changes its form to that of an electric appliance, allowing it to become more powerful.

abilityOne.name: Levitate
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon floats to move around without ever touching the ground.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon has immunity to Ground-Type moves and effects active on the battlefield such as Terrains and certain Entry Hazards.

move.name: Thunder Wave
move.effect: Single Target. Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A series of electric waves hit the target, their voltage is too weak to cause much harm but muscles will get cramped for hours.

move.name: Astonish
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe.
move.description: The user sneaks behind their target to jump scare them.

move.name: Confuse Ray
move.effect: Single Target. Confuse the Target.
move.description: The user flashes a sinister ray of bright light that others cannot help but go straight into it.

move.name: Thunder Shock
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance die to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The most basic electric attack, charge, release, and shock! Just don’t point it to any electric device.

move.name: Double Team
move.effect: Target Self. The User can now make up to 5 Evasions per Round.
move.description: The Pokémon moves so fast they create a series of shadow copies of themselves. Trying to guess which one is the real one is a pain.

move.name: Shock Wave
move.effect: Single Target. Never Miss.
move.description: A series of lightning bolts rise through the floor towards the sky, it is impossible to predict where they are coming from.

move.name: Electro Ball
move.effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of the user for every Point on Dexterity it has that surpasses the Foe's. Up to 4 Dice might be added this way.
move.description: An orb of electricity is hurled against the target, the faster the user dashes, the more momentum the orb gets.

move.name: Hex
move.effect: Single Target. *If the Target has an active Status Condition, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move.
move.description: The user casts a terrible hex over the target, the effects will be greater if the target is already burdened by an ailment.

move.name: Discharge
move.effect: Area Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze those affected.
move.description: The user lets out an enormous discharge over the arena. Lightning does not distinguish friend from foe.

move.name: Charge
move.effect: Target Self. Add 2 Dice to the Damage Pool of thenext Damaging Electric-Type Move the User performs.
move.description: The user gathers electricity and stores it to make its attacks more powerful. You may also use them as a living battery for your phone.

move.name: Substitute
move.effect: Target Self. Deal 2 damage to the User. Put a Substitute Decoy with 2 HP and the same defenses as the user. See p. 531
move.description: The Pokémon disappears in a poof of smoke. A decoy identical to the user takes their place in battle. The user keeps attacking from the shadows while the decoy serves as distraction.

move.name: Trick
move.effect: Single Target. The User and the Target switch their Held Item. If only one Pokemon is holding an Item, it gives it away.
move.description: The user controls its target’s mind to make them do a simple non-hostile action, such as walking or handing an item. Although some Pokémon use simple sleigh of hand.

move.name: Thunderbolt
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance die to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A solid electric shock. A discharge of nearly 10,000 volts that can knock out most foes and destroy electrical devices.

move.name: Shadow Ball
move.effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: Dark matter and shadows are used as a projectile against the foe, bringing out memories of their deepest fears.

move.name: Uproar
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Sound Move. This Effect Targets the Battle Field: Pokemon will be cured of the Sleep Status. Duration 1 Round.
move.description: Shouts, screams, and loud music... What does a Pokémon have to do here for a peaceful night of sleep?

move.name: Dark Pulse
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: A haze of dark energy decends on the battlefield preying on those vulnerable to the obscure feelings and fears it provokes.

move.name: Thunder
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target. Rain Weather eliminates Low Accuracy. Sunny Weather increases it to Low Accuracy 4. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce", or "Sky Drop" this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The Pokémon commands the skies to send a giant lightning bolt to a specific point. Difficult to command under clear skies, lethal during a storm. Flying Pokémon are specially vulnerable.

move.name: Nasty Plot
move.effect: Target Self. Increase User's Special by 2.
move.description: Rubbing both hands and laughing sinisterly the Pokémon rejoices in the evil plans they’ll soon carry out.

move.name: Poltergeist
move.effect: Single Target. Can only be used if the Target is Holding an Item or if Items have been used on the Target's side of the field.
move.description: The Pokémon’s spirit possesses an Item and attacks with that cursed object. It is said that if the Pokémon lingers too long possesing an object, it’ll have trouble getting out.

move.name: Volt Switch
move.effect: Single Target. Switcher Move for the User.
move.description: The user shoots a wave of electric rings that allow it to reteat to safety at the speed of lightning.

move.name: Eerie Impulse
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce foe's Special by 2.
move.description: The user radiates electricity around itself so the foe will think twice about attacking.

name: Yamask (Galarian Form)
description: It's said that this Pokémon was formed when an ancient clay tablet was drawn to the dark energy of a spirit. The clay slab seems to be absorbing Yamask's power; that's why it is so pale.

abilityOne.name: Wandering Spirit
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon is a wandering ghost with a haunted expression on its face. It won't heed your call and might get lost floating aimlessly. Get to a medium to heal it.
abilityOne.effect: If this Pokemon hits a foe with a Non-Ranged Physical Move, switch its Ability with the foe's. Unique Abilities can't be switched.

move.name: Astonish
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe.
move.description: The user sneaks behind their target to jump scare them.

move.name: Protect
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokemon would receive from a Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Moves that target the user.
move.description: A mighty energy shield materializes in front of the user to to deflect attacks and dispel ill effects.

move.name: Haze
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Remove all Increased or Reduced Attributes and Traits of everyone on the battlefield.
move.description: The battlefield is filled with a cleansing cloud that takes away all impurities in the field. It can also work as concealment.

move.name: Night Shade
move.effect: Single Target. Roll Ghost-Type Damage Dice according to the User's Rank: Starter 1 Die / Rookie 2 Dice / Standard 4 Dice/ Advacned 6 Dice / Expert 8 Dice / Ace and forward 10 Dice. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The user casts a dark and frightening mirage surrounding the foe to give them a panic attack.

move.name: Disable
move.effect: Single Target. Disable the last Move performed by the Target. Only one Move may be Disabled at a time.
move.description: The Pokémon finds the right nerve to pull that will render a foe useless to perform their best Move.

move.name: Brutal Swing
move.effect: Target All foes in Range. Lethal.
move.description: The Pokémon starts attacking at full force with its claws, anyone unfortunate enough to be in its path will end up severely wounded.

move.name: Crafty Shield
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Reaction 3. Shield Move. Negate the Added Effects from Moves made against the Targets.
move.description: The Pokémon creates a magic shield to protect everyone from any tricks a foe has up their sleeve. Under this shield, everyone can see dishonesty and bad intentions

move.name: Hex
move.effect: Single Target. *If the Target has an active Status Condition, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move.
move.description: The user casts a terrible hex over the target, the effects will be greater if the target is already burdened by an ailment.

move.name: Mean Look
move.effect: Single Target. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: An intense and ever-vigilant stare that surveils all possible paths the foe has to escape.

move.name: Slam
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1.
move.description: Everybody get up, it’s time to slam now.

move.name: Earthquake
move.effect: Area Move. Ranged. If the Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dig" this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The user calls the forces of nature. The earth shakes violently and everything crumbles to the ground.

move.name: Power Split
move.effect: Single Target. Average the User's Strength and Special with the Target's, rounded down.
move.description: Through a mental link both Pokémon are aware of each other strengths, which ends up evening the odds.

move.name: Guard Split
move.effect: Single Target. Average the User's Defense and Sp. Defense with the Target's, rounded down.
move.description: Through a mental link both Pokémon are aware of each other weaknesses, which end up evening the odds.

move.name: Sandstorm
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Wind Move. Activate Sandstorm Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A fierce sandstorm starts raging all around the battlefield. Cover your eyes, nose and face! The rough sand will hurt you!

move.name: Psychic
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: The most iconic Psychic attack, the foe starts floating in the air and its swayed around by telekinesis as their mental barrier crumbles.

move.name: Memento
move.effect: Single Target. The User faints. Reduce by 2 the foe's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense, and Sp. Defense. Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon.
move.description: As they take their last breath, the Pokémon leaves behind an imprint of regret on their foe.

move.name: Curse
move.effect: Single Target. Roll half of the User's HP as Typeless Damage Dice to itself, ignoring defenses. The Target will remove 1 success from all of their Rolls until the Curse if lifted.
move.description: The user mutters an evil incantation, misery will befall into the foe at the cost of the user’s soul. To get rid of the curse, perform an exorcism or get help at a Pokémon Center

move.name: Shadow Ball
move.effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: Dark matter and shadows are used as a projectile against the foe, bringing out memories of their deepest fears.

move.name: Poltergeist
move.effect: Single Target. Can only be used if the Target is Holding an Item or if Items have been used on the Target's side of the field.
move.description: The Pokémon’s spirit possesses an Item and attacks with that cursed object. It is said that if the Pokémon lingers too long possesing an object, it’ll have trouble getting out.

move.name: Destiny Bond
move.effect: Target Self. If the user faints this Round due to damage frm a Physical or Special Move, the Pokemon who dealt the damage is dealt damage equal to their remaining Hp. This Move will fail if it was used the previous Round.
move.description: Through a mystical bond, everyone who brings disgrace to this Pokémon will suffer the exact same fate.

name: Ambipom
description: They live in large colonies on the tallest trees, linking their tails to show friendship among herd mates. It loves fresh fruit. Ambipom uses its two tails better than its own arms to swing around.

abilityOne.name: Technician
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon is meticulous and precise in tasks that everyone else would perform roughly and without care.
abilityOne.effect: Add 1 Extra die to the Damage pool of all Physical or Special Moves with Power 1 or 2 this Pokemon performs.

abilityTwo.name: Skill Link
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon can proficiently chain a flurry of attacks and it is one heck of a juggler. It also enjoys repetition and sequences.
abilityTwo.effect: Add 2 Extra Dice to the Accuracy roll of all Double, Triple, or Successive Actions this Pokemon use.

move.name: Scratch
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their sharp claws to scratch the enemy. Nothing fancy but it works.

move.name: Tail Whip
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The Pokémon whips their tail in such an adorable way the foes let their guard down.

move.name: Sand Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce by 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.
move.description: Sand to the eyes! A dirty tactic in more ways than one.

move.name: Astonish
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe.
move.description: The user sneaks behind their target to jump scare them.

move.name: Tickle
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce by 1 the Target's Strength and Defense.
move.description: Whoever said laughter is the best therapy lied.

move.name: Fury Swipes
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions.
move.description: With their sharp claws, the Pokémon will swiftly scatch their foe, leaving its face full of small cuts.

move.name: Fake Out
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Flinch the Target. This Move will only work on the First Round the User is out in battle. from the Second Round on, it will fail automatically.
move.description: The Pokémon pretends to be getting ready for the battle when they are actually prepairing a surprise attack on the foe.

move.name: Seed Bomb
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Projectile Move.
move.description: A giant seed is hurled against the target, the hit is not what knocks them down, the tree that explodes suddenly out of the seed is what does.

move.name: Ice Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 1 Chance Dice to Freeze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon wears their ice gloves to punch the foe. Yes. Gloves made of ice.

move.name: Dual Chop
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Double Action.
move.description: Two brutal blows are all this Pokémon needs to make the opponent yield to their might.

move.name: Baton Pass
move.effect: Target Self. Switcher Move for the User. Any Attribute increase on the user is passed on the next Pokemon. The user can't increase its own Attributes again until the end of the scene or until the switched Pokemon faints.
move.description: The Pokémon rallies through the battle, setting up everything for the next companion as they know this is a team effort.

move.name: Swift
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Never Miss.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a burst of star-shaped sparkles at a blinding speed.

move.name: Screech
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Reduce the Target's Defense by 2.
move.description: A mighty screech will make the target cover its ears instead of covering its flanks.

move.name: Agility
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: Swift of body, swift of mind.

move.name: Double Hit
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Double Action.
move.description: The Pokémon uses the true and tested “one-two”.

move.name: Fling
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. *If the User is holding an Item, Add up to 4 dice to the damage pool. User loses its Held Item. See p. 530
move.description: The Pokémon takes their held item, uses it as a weapon and the referee is somehow OK with this. The held item remains in the field and may be recovered after the battle.

move.name: Nasty Plot
move.effect: Target Self. Increase User's Special by 2.
move.description: Rubbing both hands and laughing sinisterly the Pokémon rejoices in the evil plans they’ll soon carry out.

move.name: Shadow Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Never Miss. Fist Move.
move.description: The Pokémon punches the air, inadvertently, their shadow delivers the punch through the foe’s own shadow. This move is impossible to predict.

move.name: Rock Smash
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Reduce the Target's Defense by 1.
move.description: A hit powerful enough to destroy rocks and crack armor.

move.name: Last Resort
move.effect: Single Target. This Move will fail if the User has not successfully performed all of its known Moves at least once during the battle.
move.description: The Pokémon may be out of energy, but never out of options.

name: Stantler
description: Their antlers create a distortion in space that causes confusion. They were hunted for their magnificent antlers, that were sold at high prices, nearly driving Stantler extinct. Their antlers don't grow as big as a result.

abilityOne.name: Frisk
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon can see the items others may be carrying, even if they are hidden.
abilityOne.effect: When this Pokemon enters the battlefield, Storyteller must reveal its trainer the held item of one foe.

abilityTwo.name: Intimidate
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon has an overwhelming presence that inspires both fear and respect from others.
abilityTwo.effect: When this Pokemon comes into battle, Reduce by 1 the Strength of All foes in Range. This effect will last for as long as this Pokemon is out. Outside of battle, wild Pokemon will avoid the party if this Pokemon is out.

hiddenAbility.name: Sap Sipper
hiddenAbility.description: This Pokemon's diet consists strickly of plants, it is particularly fond of sweet sap for nourishment.
hiddenAbility.effect: The first time this Pokemon is hit by a Grass-type attack, Increase its Strength Attribute by 1 instead of dealing damage. Grass-type moves do not deal damage to this Pokemon.

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Hypnosis
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Put the Target to sleep. Dark-Type Pokemon are affected by this Move.
move.description: By staring at an hypnotic pendulum, the target is suggestioned to feel tired and close its eyelids.

move.name: Stomp
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Die to Flinch the Target. Targets under the effects of the Move "Minimize" are vulnerable.
move.description: Stomping the foe with strong feet. Perfect to squish nasty little bugs.

move.name: Me First
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Copy Move. Support Moves can't be copied. Unique Moves can't be copied. You may choose another Target(s) for the copied Move.
move.description: The user anticipates the next Move the target will use and impatiently interrupts to be the first in line.

move.name: Confuse Ray
move.effect: Single Target. Confuse the Target.
move.description: The user flashes a sinister ray of bright light that others cannot help but go straight into it.

move.name: Calm Mind
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Special and Sp. Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon takes a deep breath to increase the mental fortitude required to face any problem.

move.name: Role Play
move.effect: Single Target. Replace the User's Ability with the Target's. Whole Scene Duration. Unique Abilities can't be copied.
move.description: The Pokémon is a great actor. Their impersonations are really good! ...maybe a bit too good.

move.name: Zen Headbutt
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses both their mental and physical prowess in a questionable yet effective “psychic” strike.

move.name: Jump Kick
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. If the Accuracy roll fails, Roll 4 Dice of Typeless Damage against the user, ignoring defenses.
move.description: The user launches itself up two stories high to pummel down with a powerful kick. Do not try it at home.

move.name: Imprison
move.effect: Target Self. While the User is on the battlefield, Moves known by the User cannot be used by foes. This effect ends if the User is removed from battle.
move.description: This move blocks all shared parts of a memory the user is well aware of. Moves, techniques, names, places, people or situations, no one will be able to recall those imprisoned memories.

move.name: Captivate
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 2 the Special of those affected.
move.description: The Pokémon shows off their attractiveness and even flirts with the opponents, those who fall for their charms can’t keep focus on the battle.

move.name: Thrash
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
move.description: The Pokémon becomes a wild thing and the rumpus has started.

move.name: Leer
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The vicious glare of a predator that triggers the flight response of their prey.

move.name: Astonish
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe.
move.description: The user sneaks behind their target to jump scare them.

move.name: Sand Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce by 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.
move.description: Sand to the eyes! A dirty tactic in more ways than one.

move.name: Take Down
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Recoil.
move.description: Through a reckless grapple, the Pokémon smashes the foe into the ground, usually falling along with it.

move.name: Lunge
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce Target's Strength by 1.
move.description: The user charges against the foe at full force, not just to knock it down but to restrain it with its many limbs.

move.name: Entrainment
move.effect: Single Target. Replace the Target's Ability with the User's. Unique Abilities can't be passed or replaced. Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon.
move.description: The Pokémon trains and teaches their best ability to their target. The target becomes a master of this ability in a record time.

move.name: Disable
move.effect: Single Target. Disable the last Move performed by the Target. Only one Move may be Disabled at a time.
move.description: The Pokémon finds the right nerve to pull that will render a foe useless to perform their best Move.

move.name: Light Screen
move.effect: Target the User's side of the field. Force Field. Activate a Force Field against Special Damage. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A barrier of light is created over half of the battlefield, all energy trying to go trough dissolves as it crosses it.

move.name: Reflect
move.effect: Target the User's side of the field. Force Field. Activate a Force Field against Physical Damage. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: An ethereal mirror-like wall cuts the battlefield in half, bouncing back the impact of most blows.

move.name: Double-Edge
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil.
move.description: Without regard for their own safety, the Pokémon does a reckless attack against their foe.

move.name: Megahorn
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal.
move.description: The Pokémon uses its strong horn(s) to pierce their foe and deal massive damage.

move.name: Bounce
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Thunder / Twister / Sky Uppercut / Gust / Hurricane / Smack Down. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon jumps at least 30 feet in the air before landing with a mighty stomp on top of the foe. While in the air it is safe from most treaths but its still vulnerable to bad weather.

move.name: Psyshield Bash
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Increase by 1 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense.
move.description: The user cloaks itself in a shield of psychic energy then rams into the foe.

name: Sylveon
description: This rare and adorable Pokémon emanates a soothing aura to calm disturbances. It is said that only the Trainers who form an unbreakable bond with their Eevee can ever see this Pokémon.

abilityOne.name: Cute Charm
abilityOne.description: It may be its twinkly eyes or its rosy cheeks, but other people and Pokemon will try to win this Pokemon's heart.
abilityOne.effect: If this Pokemon is hit with a Non-Ranged Physical Move, roll 3 Chance Dice to make the foe fall in Love.

abilityTwo.name: Pixilate
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon scatters fairy dust that brings happy thoughts to the mind. Everything it does looks incredibly adorable.
abilityTwo.effect: Normal-Type Moves that the Pokemon uses will deal damage as if they were Fairy-Type. Affecting STAB, weakness and resistance. Add 1 Extra die to the Damage Pool of Fairy Moves.

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Tail Whip
