move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions. *If all 5 actions land successfully, add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of the last hit of this Move. If the Pokemon used the Move "Defense Curl" in the same round, this Move's base Power becomes 2.
move.description: When the foe sees this Pokémon rollin’ they’ll be hatin’.

move.name: Slam
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1.
move.description: Everybody get up, it’s time to slam now.

move.name: Scary Face
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: When a Pokémon looks at you like THAT, you know you gotta thread carefully around them.

move.name: Counter
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 5. Can only be used if Target's last Move on User was a Physical Move. For damage, roll dice equal to Target's last damage pool rolled against the User plus 2 dice. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The Pokémon strikes back at their foe. Showing they can take a hit and punch even harder.

move.name: Ice Shard
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Ranged.
move.description: With extraordinary swiftness, the Pokémon shoots an ice bullet like the fastest gun in the North Pole.

move.name: Fissure
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 5. Ranged. Deal Damage to the Target equal to its Remaining HP, plus 1 Lethal Damge. If the Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dig" this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The earth rips apart underneath the target and swallows them whole. You’ll need a rescue team to recover the unlucky victim from the deep.

move.name: Defense Curl
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 1. Increase by 1 the Power of the Moves "Ice Ball" & "Rollout".
move.description: The user curls into a ball to protect themselves when they feel threatened.

move.name: Bulldoze
move.effect: Area Move. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: The user stomps and flattens the ground, pushing all the rubbish and leaving the surface ready for construction.

move.name: Odor Sleuth
move.effect: Single Target. The Foe cannot Evade Moves performed by the User. User ignores Ghost-Type immunity to Normal and Fight-Type Moves and vice versa. Out of battle, Add successes of this Move to any roll for Tracking targets.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their keen sense of smell to corner the foe and find it when it tries to scurry away

move.name: Rapid Spin
move.effect: Single Target. Increase the User's Dexterity by 1. Remove Entry Hazards, Terrains (ie Grassy Terrain, Misty Terrain), Ongoing Damage and Leech seed from the User and/or their side of the field.
move.description: The Pokémon makes a swift spin to strike at the foe and in the process everything laying close to the user is scattered out of the battlefield.

move.name: Take Down
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Recoil.
move.description: Through a reckless grapple, the Pokémon smashes the foe into the ground, usually falling along with it.

move.name: Fury Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions.
move.description: The Pokémon attacks in a fury, their attacks are uncoordinated but relentless.

move.name: Knock Off
move.effect: Single Target. *If the Target is holding an Item, Add 2 Dice to the Damage pool of this Move. The Target loses its Held Item afterwards.
move.description: The Pokémon rudely smacks what their foe was holding.

move.name: Magnitude
move.effect: Area Move. Ranged. Before you roll damage, Roll 1 die to determine this Move's Power. If the Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dig" this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The user shakes the tectonic plates underneath the battlefield, trying to find a fault, when they do, this Move is devastating.

move.name: Fire Fang
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Bite Move. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon bites the foe with their mouth ablaze, tearing and searing their foe’s flesh in a single attack.

move.name: Thunder Fang
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Bite Move. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon bites the foe with charged fangs, basically injecting electricity right into the foe’s nervous system.

move.name: Endure
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. If a Physical or Special Move would cause the user to faint, they remain at 1 HP instead, remove this effect afterwards. The effect re-activates on the user's next Turn. Whole Round duration.
move.description: The Pokémon mentally prepares to receive a fatal blow, their spirit is stronger than their body so they endure to keep on fighting for as long as possible.

move.name: Assurance
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 2 extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move if the Target has already received Damage from the User this Round.
move.description: The user indentifies the weakest foe and charges against them.

move.name: Double-Edge
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil.
move.description: Without regard for their own safety, the Pokémon does a reckless attack against their foe.

move.name: Last Resort
move.effect: Single Target. This Move will fail if the User has not successfully performed all of its known Moves at least once during the battle.
move.description: The Pokémon may be out of energy, but never out of options.

move.name: Earthquake
move.effect: Area Move. Ranged. If the Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dig" this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The user calls the forces of nature. The earth shakes violently and everything crumbles to the ground.

move.name: Giga Impact
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge. Lethal.
move.description: The Pokémon strikes with such a brutal force they leave a crater just from the impact. Let them catch their breath afterwards.

name: Fletchinder
description: From its beak, it expels embers to set tall grass on fire, then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass. Its body becomes engulfed in flames when it starts to battle. It is a fierce Pokémon.

abilityOne.name: Flame Body
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon can willingly ignite its body on fire, receiving no harm from it. Objects that come into contact with this Pokemon may catch fire.
abilityOne.effect: When hit by a Non-Ranged Physical Move, this Pokemon rolls 3 Chance Dice to inflict 2nd degree Burn on the foe.

abilityTwo.name: Gale Wings
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon's wings are perfectly designed to ride the roughest winds effortlessly.
abilityTwo.effect: Add the Effect "Reaction 1" to all Flying-Type Moves of this Pokemon.

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Growl
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Reduce by 1 the Strength of those affected.
move.description: Either through a menacing attitude or an adorable demeanor, the foe will hesitate to attack the user at full power.

move.name: Quick Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Out of battle, double the Pokemon's movement speed.
move.description: An attackas fight as lightning.

move.name: Peck
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: Raise crows and they’ll peck your foe’s eyes.

move.name: Flail
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of this Move for every missing Point of HP the user has. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The user flails around trying to stay alive, as they get closer to fainting, more adrenaline will fuel their efforts of survival.

move.name: Ember
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: A basic fire attack, but not any less dangerous. Even a small flame can grow out of control.

move.name: Razor Wind
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Charge Move. High Critical. Cutter Move.
move.description: The Pokémon sways the winds while charging what appears to be an invisible blade made of pressurized air. The wind slices everything it touches as if it were a razor.

move.name: Me First
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Copy Move. Support Moves can't be copied. Unique Moves can't be copied. You may choose another Target(s) for the copied Move.
move.description: The user anticipates the next Move the target will use and impatiently interrupts to be the first in line.

move.name: Tailwind
move.effect: Target User's side of the Field. Wind Move. Increase by 2 the Dexterity of everyone on the User's side of the field. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: Flying Pokémon know better than anyone how to use the wind in their favor. Let its draft carry you to victory.

move.name: Snatch
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 6. Remove any Increase/Reduction on the Foe's Attributes, Active Shield Moves, Healing effects on the Foe, or effects on its side of the field; and place them on the User instead. See p. 531 for more info.
move.description: The user takes notice of the good stuff on the other side and quickly takes it for themselves. Finders keepers, losers weepers!

move.name: Quick Guard
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Reaction 3. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage from a Physical or Special Move with Priority. Negate the Added effects of Reaction and late Reaction Moves targeting the User and Allies.
move.description: The user reacts instinctively and defends itself and its team mates, nullyfing the effects of the fastest attacks.

move.name: Acrobatics
move.effect: Single Target. *If the User has a Held Item, Reduce 2 Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move.
move.description: The Pokémon is quick and graceful, they cartwheel, contort and make a double back jump before landing onthe foe. Their best perfomance is done when they are unburdened.

move.name: Natural Gift
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. The User loes its held berry. *The Type of this Move changes according to the berry used. See more on p. 530
move.description: The user throws their held berry at the foe, the myriad of flavors has surprisingly different results.

move.name: Flame Charge
move.effect: Single Target. Increase the User's Dexterity by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon dashes so fast they leave a trail of fire behind.

move.name: Agility
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: Swift of body, swift of mind.

move.name: Aerial Ace
move.effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. Never Miss.
move.description: The Pokémon rises up in the air towards a light source, momentarily blinding the foe. then plummets quickly to attack the opponent

move.name: Steel Wing
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 1 Chance Die to Increase the User's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon has weather-proofed wings that cut flying times, cut through the air, and, most importantly, cut through their foes.

move.name: Roost
move.effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Remove the User's Immunity to Ground-Type Moves. Duration 1 Round.
move.description: The Pokémon gathers some twigs and builds themselves a comfy nest on the floor to roost and relax.

move.name: Fly
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Thunder / Twister / Sky Uppercut / Gust / Hurricane / Smack Down. Out of battle allows the Pokemon to fly long distances.
move.description: The Pokémon uses an action to fly up high, to asses the best angle to take a dive against the foe. Pokémon who know this Move can fly for long periods of time without rest.

move.name: Heat Wave
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 1. Wind Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 1st Degree Burn on those affected.
move.description: A large wave of extra-hot air that can set fire to everything it touches.

name: Ducklett
description: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They swim around in the water eating their favorite food: peat moss. They can shoot a spray of mist with their feathers to protect themselves from any predator that comes.

abilityOne.name: Keen Eye
abilityOne.description: These Pokemon have an exceptional sight. Locating small or far away objects is a lot easier for them.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon cannot have successes removed from its Accuracy rolls by Moves, Items or Abilities.

abilityTwo.name: Big Pecks
abilityTwo.description: This tenacious Pokemon uses its beak to cover its weak spots.
abilityTwo.effect: This Pokemon cannot have its Defense reduced.

hiddenAbility.name: Hydration
hiddenAbility.description: The body of the Pokemon absorbs water and uses its moisture to maintain a healthy state.
hiddenAbility.effect: When Rain weather is active, this Pokemon will cure all Status Ailments and Conditions it is affected with at the end of the round.

move.name: Water Gun
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The fastest water gun in town. No enemy will remain dry

move.name: Water Sport
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Physical & Special Fire-Type Moves have Power 0. Pokemon weak to Fire-Type Moves won't receive Super-Effective Damage from them. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A single drop of water can’t put off a raging fire, but what is the ocean but a collection of drops.

move.name: Defog
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Remove all Force Fields, Entry Hazards and Terrains (Misty Terrain, Electric Terrain, etc.) from the Battlefield.
move.description: A strong wind sweeps out the battle field, removing anything from bad weather to scattered objects and even invisible barriers.

move.name: Wing Attack
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: A classic flying technique, the user flies towards the foe and strikes using their wings.

move.name: Water Pulse
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target.
move.description: The user sends out a pulsing ring of water that blasts the foe with ultrasonic waves. For a while, everything seems as if reflected in the water ripples.

move.name: Aerial Ace
move.effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. Never Miss.
move.description: The Pokémon rises up in the air towards a light source, momentarily blinding the foe. then plummets quickly to attack the opponent

move.name: Bubble Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 1.
move.description: A powerful stream of foamy bubbles shot straight into the foe

move.name: Feather Dance
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Strength by 2.
move.description: A dance as soft as a feather. It soothes the hearts of the spectators and reduces all aggression.

move.name: Aqua Ring
move.effect: Target Self. The User heals 1 HP at the end of each Round. Spend 1 Will point to activate. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The Pokémon coats themselves in fresh water.

move.name: Air Slash
move.effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: A compressed wind-slash, the change of pressure knocks out the target momentarily

move.name: Rain Dance
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Activate Rain Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The Pokémon performs a peculiar dance in the middle of the field, everyone thinks it silly until the first thunder rumbles.

move.name: Tailwind
move.effect: Target User's side of the Field. Wind Move. Increase by 2 the Dexterity of everyone on the User's side of the field. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: Flying Pokémon know better than anyone how to use the wind in their favor. Let its draft carry you to victory.

move.name: Brave Bird
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil.
move.description: Back in the day humans relied on birds to send their messages and even go to war. Many earned medals for bravery.

move.name: Mud Sport
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Physical & Special Electric-Type Moves have Power 0. Pokemon weak to Electric-Type Moves won't receive Super-Effective Damage from them. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The user covers the whole field with mud. Electricity can’t flow properly, so Electric attacks will be severely impaired.

move.name: Steel Wing
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 1 Chance Die to Increase the User's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon has weather-proofed wings that cut flying times, cut through the air, and, most importantly, cut through their foes.

move.name: Mirror Move
move.effect: Single Target. Copy Move. Unique Moves can't be copied. You may choose another Target(s) for the copied Move.
move.description: The Pokémon parrots the target cries and movements. In an almost perfect impersonation that manages to copy its powers.

move.name: Roost
move.effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Remove the User's Immunity to Ground-Type Moves. Duration 1 Round.
move.description: The Pokémon gathers some twigs and builds themselves a comfy nest on the floor to roost and relax.

move.name: Hurricane
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Wind Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target. Rain Weather eliminates Low Accuracy. Sunny Weather increases to Low Accuracy 4. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop", this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The Pokémon calls upon fierce gale winds. It’ll be difficult to summon the tempest on a clear day, but a little rain will enhance it into a typhoon. Other pokémon in the air are in most danger.

name: Frogadier
description: It is incredibly hard to catch. It starts practicing its skills by throwing foam-covered pebbles at foes. Many trainers find this rebellious stage very challenging to handle and end up being its targets of practice.

abilityOne.name: Torrent
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon builds up pressure to shoot water streams. When that pressure cannot be held in, it is released through uncontrollable torrents.
abilityOne.effect: Pain Penalization won't reduce successes from Accuracy or Damage rolls of Water-Type Moves used by this Pokemon. Water-Type Moves get 2 Extra dice to their Damage Pool when this Pokemon is at half HP or less.

abilityTwo.name: Protean
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon's versitile body gives it profeciency on practically everything it sets out to do.
abilityTwo.effect: Before this Pokemon uses a Physical or Special Move, change its Type to that of the Move it intends to use. Use the appropriate STAB on the Damage Pool.

move.name: Pound
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user pounds the target’s head. Simple

move.name: Growl
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Reduce by 1 the Strength of those affected.
move.description: Either through a menacing attitude or an adorable demeanor, the foe will hesitate to attack the user at full power.

move.name: Bubble
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: Dozens of bubbles are sent floating through the battlefield. The foes can’t resist the temptation to burst the pretty bubbles, only for the bubbles to explode for real when they do.

move.name: Quick Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Out of battle, double the Pokemon's movement speed.
move.description: An attackas fight as lightning.

move.name: Water Pulse
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target.
move.description: The user sends out a pulsing ring of water that blasts the foe with ultrasonic waves. For a while, everything seems as if reflected in the water ripples.

move.name: Smokescreen
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon covers the foe in a cloud of smoke to impair their visibility to make it easier to hide and/or cover their escape.

move.name: Round
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. *If the user and an ally are able to use Round. Both may choose to do it at the same time. If they do, add 3 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of both Pokemon.
move.description: The user attacks the foe with the power of music, if another one joins the performance, the musical harmony will rock their public!

move.name: Double Team
move.effect: Target Self. The User can now make up to 5 Evasions per Round.
move.description: The Pokémon moves so fast they create a series of shadow copies of themselves. Trying to guess which one is the real one is a pain.

move.name: Mud Sport
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Physical & Special Electric-Type Moves have Power 0. Pokemon weak to Electric-Type Moves won't receive Super-Effective Damage from them. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The user covers the whole field with mud. Electricity can’t flow properly, so Electric attacks will be severely impaired.

move.name: Toxic Spikes
move.effect: Target Foe's side of the Field. Entry Hazard. Foes who enter the battlefield become Poisoned. Roll 1 Chance Die for them to become Badly Poisoned instead. Pokemon with immunity to Ground-Type Moves are not affected.
move.description: The Pokémon lays a trap of tiny venom-drenched spikes through the battlefield. The battle has not yet begun and the foes are already defeated.

move.name: Water Pledge
move.effect: Area Move. This Effect Targets the Battlefield: Add 2 Dice to all Chance Dice rolls of everyone in the field. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The Pokémon chants to invoke the power of water. Moisture in the air bends the light to create a rainbow to bring good fortune. Everyone in the field feels luckier for a while.

move.name: Lick
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon licks the foe. The foe is deeply disturbed by this creepy display of “affection”.

move.name: Fling
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. *If the User is holding an Item, Add up to 4 dice to the damage pool. User loses its Held Item. See p. 530
move.description: The Pokémon takes their held item, uses it as a weapon and the referee is somehow OK with this. The held item remains in the field and may be recovered after the battle.

move.name: Smack Down
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Remove the Target's immunity to Ground-Type Moves. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop", this Move hits anyways.
move.description: They say it’s great to get two birds with one stone, this Pokémon will give one bird ALL the stones.

move.name: Shadow Sneak
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1.
move.description: The user sneaks through the darkness and strikes by coming out of the target’s shadow. The Pokémon is able travel freely through the shadow realm.

move.name: Spikes
move.effect: Target Foe's Side of the Field. Entry Hazard. Pokemon entering the battle Receive 1 Typeless Damage. This effect does not stack. Pokemon with immunity to Ground-Type Moves are not affected.
move.description: Sharp and pointy spikes are scattered around the field, if you don’t watch your step the spikes will dig on your feet.

move.name: Substitute
move.effect: Target Self. Deal 2 damage to the User. Put a Substitute Decoy with 2 HP and the same defenses as the user. See p. 531
move.description: The Pokémon disappears in a poof of smoke. A decoy identical to the user takes their place in battle. The user keeps attacking from the shadows while the decoy serves as distraction.

move.name: Bounce
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Thunder / Twister / Sky Uppercut / Gust / Hurricane / Smack Down. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon jumps at least 30 feet in the air before landing with a mighty stomp on top of the foe. While in the air it is safe from most treaths but its still vulnerable to bad weather.

move.name: Hydro Pump
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2
move.description: Water works best under pressure.

name: Goodra
description: Definitely the friendliest of all Dragons. This Pokémon will hug its beloved Trainer, leaving them covered in sticky slime. In areas with heavy rainfall during the year, one or two may make an appearance.

abilityOne.name: Hydration
abilityOne.description: The body of the Pokemon absorbs water and uses its moisture to maintain a healthy state.
abilityOne.effect: When Rain weather is active, this Pokemon will cure all Status Ailments and Conditions it is affected with at the end of the round.

abilityTwo.name: Gooey
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon's sticky ooze will rub into anyone that touches it. This may become quite a burden. On the bright side, it is a natural and organic glue.
abilityTwo.effect: The first time a foe hits this Pokemon with a Non-Ranged Physical Move, reduce 1 Point to their Dexterity Attribute.

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Draco Meteor
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. lethal. Reduce User's Special by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon summons a meteor to fall from the sky directly into their foes, dealing a brutal amount of damage. An impressive display if power that demands a lot of energy.

move.name: Absorb
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The user takes nutrients from the nearest source of life they find.

move.name: Water Gun
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The fastest water gun in town. No enemy will remain dry

move.name: Dragon Breath
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A mystical flame breath that feels strengely cold to the touch. It doesn’t burn in a conventional way.

move.name: Acid Spray
move.effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 2.
move.description: Do not point at face or eyes. Keep away from children.

move.name: Acid Armor
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
move.description: Highly acidic goop oozes through the pores of this Pokémon. Touching it immediately causes a burning pain. Preventing foes from getting too close.

move.name: Protect
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokemon would receive from a Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Moves that target the user.
move.description: A mighty energy shield materializes in front of the user to to deflect attacks and dispel ill effects.

move.name: Bubble
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: Dozens of bubbles are sent floating through the battlefield. The foes can’t resist the temptation to burst the pretty bubbles, only for the bubbles to explode for real when they do.

move.name: Feint
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 1. This Move ignores the effects of any Shield Move active on the Target and removes their effects for the rest of the Round.
move.description: The user begins their attack, and as their target attempts to protect itself, the user feints the target to break their defense against their true strike.

move.name: Aqua Tail
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The user sways their tail to create a pocket whirlpool in which the foe gets sucked in by the spinning motion.

move.name: Water Pulse
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target.
move.description: The user sends out a pulsing ring of water that blasts the foe with ultrasonic waves. For a while, everything seems as if reflected in the water ripples.

move.name: Bide
move.effect: Single Target. The User will not Evade or Clash the next 2 Physical or Special Moves targeting it. Once all damage has been dealt against the User, roll a number of Normal-Type Damage dice equal to twice the total amount of Damage the Target received. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The user puts up with being hit, waiting for the perfect opportunity to retaliate.

move.name: Rain Dance
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Activate Rain Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The Pokémon performs a peculiar dance in the middle of the field, everyone thinks it silly until the first thunder rumbles.

move.name: Flail
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of this Move for every missing Point of HP the user has. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The user flails around trying to stay alive, as they get closer to fainting, more adrenaline will fuel their efforts of survival.

move.name: Dragon Pulse
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon sends out a powerful wave of energy through their mouth.

move.name: Curse
move.effect: Single Target. Roll half of the User's HP as Typeless Damage Dice to itself, ignoring defenses. The Target will remove 1 success from all of their Rolls until the Curse if lifted.
move.description: The user mutters an evil incantation, misery will befall into the foe at the cost of the user’s soul. To get rid of the curse, perform an exorcism or get help at a Pokémon Center

move.name: Body Slam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The user charges against the foe using ther body to slam it down, leaving the target stunned.

move.name: Power Whip
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2.
move.description: A thick vine full of thorns is waved as a whip against the enemy. As devastating as the blow would be, the incoming attack is easily percieved by the foe.

move.name: Outrage
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
move.description: The true nature of dragon-types unleashed. The user is consumed by a primal fury that won’t stop until everything has ben razed to the ground. Afterwards the Pokémon is confused.

move.name: Muddy Water
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 2. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of those affected.
move.description: When you can’t see what creatures lurk inside the water, that’s when you know they are the ones that went fishing.

move.name: Life Dew
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. User and Allies in Range heal 1 HP at the end of each Round. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The user creates a fresh-water dew that restores energy and heals wounds.

move.name: Focus Blast
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Projectile Move. Roll 1 Chance die to Reduce the foe's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: A powerful energy blast that requires the user to chant each syllabe of the technique’s name and release it by yelling “Haaaaa!”

name: Glalie (Mega Form)
description: The power of the Mega Stone bent its jaw at an unnatural angle. This helps it spew enormous blizzards, but leaves it unable to eat any prey it catches. This makes it angry and will weaken it if it stays in this form.

abilityOne.name: Refrigerate
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon's body works akin to a freezer, it can freeze things just by touching them.
abilityOne.effect: Normal-Type Moves that the Pokemon uses will deal damage as if they were Ice-Type. Affecting STAB, weakness and resistance. Add 1 Extra die to the Damage Pool of Ice moves.

move.name: Leer
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The vicious glare of a predator that triggers the flight response of their prey.

move.name: Icy Wind
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Wind Move. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: Polar winds sweep through the arena. Everyone starts to shiver and embrace themselves, trying to preserve a bit of warmth.

move.name: Protect
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokemon would receive from a Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Moves that target the user.
move.description: A mighty energy shield materializes in front of the user to to deflect attacks and dispel ill effects.

move.name: Frost Breath
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. This Move is always considered to be a Critical hit and gets the proper Bonus for it.
move.description: The user locates the most exposed parts of its foe and sends a gelid breath against it. The sudden chill goes right through the foe’s spine.

move.name: Hail
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Activate Hail Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The skies turn gray, and loud thunder rumbles, but what falls is not a gentle drizzle, but an endless stream of ice shards coming down at high speeds. Find shelter!

move.name: Crunch
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Lethal. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the foe's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon viciously mauls, tears, and rips apart anything its fangs can come in contact with.

move.name: Rollout
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions. *If all 5 actions land successfully, add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of the last hit of this Move. If the Pokemon used the Move "Defense Curl" in the same round, this Move's base Power becomes 2.
move.description: When the foe sees this Pokémon rollin’ they’ll be hatin’.

move.name: Astonish
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe.
move.description: The user sneaks behind their target to jump scare them.

move.name: Powder Snow
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Roll 1 Chance Die to Freeze those affected.
move.description: A light layer of snow flakes covers the foes, as the layers pile up the possibilities to be trapped into the snow increase.

move.name: Ice Shard
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Ranged.
move.description: With extraordinary swiftness, the Pokémon shoots an ice bullet like the fastest gun in the North Pole.

move.name: Double Team
move.effect: Target Self. The User can now make up to 5 Evasions per Round.
move.description: The Pokémon moves so fast they create a series of shadow copies of themselves. Trying to guess which one is the real one is a pain.

move.name: Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe
move.description: The user lands a vicious bite, leaving an ugly bruise.

move.name: Freeze Dry
move.effect: Single Target. Water-Type Pokemon receive Super-Effective Damage from this Move. If a Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dive" this Move hits anyways.
move.description: All moisture is frozen and then subjected to high pressure, evaporating it immediately. Water-type Pokémon suffer this Move the most.

move.name: Ice Fang
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Bite Move. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Freeze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon bites their foe with sharp teeth and a geli breath to chill their bones directly

move.name: Headbutt
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Out of battle it may cause a Random encounter when hitting trees and make objects drop from high places.
move.description: The Pokémon rams against their foe with their head. This Move is perfect to shake down trees when looking for berries, but beware of wild Pokémon nesting at the treetops.

move.name: Ice Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Freeze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a cold beam that reduces all warmth on the environment up to freezing point.

move.name: Blizzard
move.effect: All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Wind Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Freeze those affected. *Sunny Weather increases to Low Accuracy 4. **Hail/Snowy Weather remove Low Accuracy and adds the effect "Never Miss".
move.description: The user summons a turbulent and gelid wind that feels like ice daggers. A pleasant day may make it difficult to call upon, but beware if the temperatures go below zero.

move.name: Sheer Cold
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 5. Ranged. Deal Damage to the Target equal to its Remaining HP, plus 1 Lethal Damage.
move.description: The Pokémon reaches an absolute zero by being freezed from the inside out. Urgent medical attention is required.

move.name: Steel Roller
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Can't be used if there is no Active Terrain (Grassy Terrain, Electric Terrain, etc.) on the Battlefield. Remove any active Terrain on the Battlefield.
move.description: The Pokémon rolls into a wheel, destroying anything in their path. Buildings come crashing down, forests are swept away and the soil is left as a blank slate.

move.name: Explosion
move.effect: Area Move. Ranged. Lethal. The User Faints.
move.description: Through a massive explosion the Pokémon destroys all they can before fainting. Sometimes the only way to get out of a bad situation is in bits and pieces.

name: Floatzel
description: It floats using its well-developed sack. They roam close to fishing spots to steal an easy meal. People allow them to hang around their boats because they help whenever a person falls into the water.

abilityOne.name: Swift Swim
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon will move faster in water than on land, even a puddle-covered roadway will allow it to use its full speed.
abilityOne.effect: While Rain Weather is active, Increase this Pokemon's Dexterity Attribute by 2.

abilityTwo.name: Water Veil
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon is always wet and producing water to keep itself moist. Thanks to this, the Pokemon can stay away from a body of water for a long time.
abilityTwo.effect: The Pokemon is immune to all Burn degrees.

move.name: Sonic Boom
move.effect: Single Target. This Move always inflict 1 Typeless damage. Ignore Defenses, Force Fields, Shield Moves, Cover, Out of Range, Type or Ability that would prevent this damage.
move.description: The Pokémon makes use of a small but very destructive shock that goes through any wall, layer or wall.

move.name: Growl
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Reduce by 1 the Strength of those affected.
move.description: Either through a menacing attitude or an adorable demeanor, the foe will hesitate to attack the user at full power.

move.name: Water Sport
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Physical & Special Fire-Type Moves have Power 0. Pokemon weak to Fire-Type Moves won't receive Super-Effective Damage from them. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A single drop of water can’t put off a raging fire, but what is the ocean but a collection of drops.

move.name: Water Gun
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The fastest water gun in town. No enemy will remain dry

move.name: Aqua Tail
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The user sways their tail to create a pocket whirlpool in which the foe gets sucked in by the spinning motion.

move.name: Aqua Ring
move.effect: Target Self. The User heals 1 HP at the end of each Round. Spend 1 Will point to activate. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The Pokémon coats themselves in fresh water.

move.name: Tail Whip
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The Pokémon whips their tail in such an adorable way the foes let their guard down.

move.name: Quick Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Out of battle, double the Pokemon's movement speed.
move.description: An attackas fight as lightning.

move.name: Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe
move.description: The user lands a vicious bite, leaving an ugly bruise.

move.name: Ice Fang
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Bite Move. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Freeze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon bites their foe with sharp teeth and a geli breath to chill their bones directly

move.name: Pursuit
move.effect: Single Target. *If a Target hit by this Move is recalled, attempts to Run Away, uses a Switcher Move or is the Target of a Switcher Move, Deal 2 Typeless Damage to it. Outside of battle, aid in catching a fleeing target.
move.description: The Pokémon is relentless in its pursuit of their target, striking it just as it believed it had escaped.

move.name: Swift
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Never Miss.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a burst of star-shaped sparkles at a blinding speed.

move.name: Aqua Jet
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1.
move.description: The Pokémon propels themselves with a jet of pressured water.

move.name: Whirlpool
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion. Duration 4 Rounds. If a Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dive", this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The foe is swallowed inside of a violent swirling whirlpool. Trapping them on the violent currents, barely managing to stay afloat.

move.name: Double Hit
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Double Action.
move.description: The Pokémon uses the true and tested “one-two”.

move.name: Water Pulse
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target.
move.description: The user sends out a pulsing ring of water that blasts the foe with ultrasonic waves. For a while, everything seems as if reflected in the water ripples.

move.name: Razor Wind
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Charge Move. High Critical. Cutter Move.
move.description: The Pokémon sways the winds while charging what appears to be an invisible blade made of pressurized air. The wind slices everything it touches as if it were a razor.

move.name: Agility
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: Swift of body, swift of mind.

move.name: Waterfall
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon swims with such force and speed that it could even swim upwards in a waterfall.

move.name: Hydro Pump
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2
move.description: Water works best under pressure.

move.name: Bulk Up
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon showcase their muscles through poses that highlight their fitness and bodybuilding discipline.

move.name: Double Team
move.effect: Target Self. The User can now make up to 5 Evasions per Round.
move.description: The Pokémon moves so fast they create a series of shadow copies of themselves. Trying to guess which one is the real one is a pain.

name: Lillipup
description: Good with children and old people, this gentle Pokémon is a favorite to keep as pet. It is very brave and smart. It will protect its trainer against any threat. It uses the fur on its face to feel its surroundings.

abilityOne.name: Vital Spirit
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon is incredibly active and energetic. It needs constant activity and exercise or else it will act destructive. It never sleeps.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon is immune to the Sleep status. Moves or Items that self-inflict Sleep will fail.

abilityTwo.name: Pickup
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon will often gather objects and keep a small hoard of treasure it may share with you.
abilityTwo.effect: If this Pokemon was out of its Pokeball, at the end of the scene see what it found for you at Storyteller's discretion. The higher the Rank of this Pokemon the more valuable the items it will find.

hiddenAbility.name: Scrappy
hiddenAbility.description: This Pokemon does not believe in ghosts.
hiddenAbility.effect: This Pokemon can hit Ghost-type Pokemon with Normal and Fighting Type Moves. Apply resistances or weaknesses to the foe if it has a secondary type.

move.name: Leer
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The vicious glare of a predator that triggers the flight response of their prey.

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Odor Sleuth
move.effect: Single Target. The Foe cannot Evade Moves performed by the User. User ignores Ghost-Type immunity to Normal and Fight-Type Moves and vice versa. Out of battle, Add successes of this Move to any roll for Tracking targets.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their keen sense of smell to corner the foe and find it when it tries to scurry away

move.name: Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe
move.description: The user lands a vicious bite, leaving an ugly bruise.

move.name: Helping Hand
move.effect: Target One Ally. Reaction 5. The Target Gets 2 Extra Dice on their next Skill Check/Accuracy Roll, and 2 Extra Dice on their next Damage Roll. This Effect does not Stack.
move.description: The Pokémon is the first to come and give a hand to their friend. A true bro.

move.name: Take Down
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Recoil.
move.description: Through a reckless grapple, the Pokémon smashes the foe into the ground, usually falling along with it.

move.name: Work Up
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Special.
move.description: The Pokémon has spent a lot of time training and doesn’t miss the chance to show off their muscles and fitness. After the battle they share routines and tips with the other Pokémon.

move.name: Crunch
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Lethal. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the foe's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon viciously mauls, tears, and rips apart anything its fangs can come in contact with.

move.name: Roar
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 6. Switcher Move for the Foe. In the wild, the battle may end.
move.description: With a potent roar, to make the foe reconsider their intentions.

move.name: Reversal
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool for every missing HP the User has. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The user gathers their mettle to block away the pain and focus only on hitting harder.

move.name: Play Rough
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 1 Chance Dice to Reduce Target's Strength by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon and their foe start a playful wrestle that soon escalates into a furious wrestling match.

move.name: Lick
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon licks the foe. The foe is deeply disturbed by this creepy display of “affection”.

move.name: Endure
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. If a Physical or Special Move would cause the user to faint, they remain at 1 HP instead, remove this effect afterwards. The effect re-activates on the user's next Turn. Whole Round duration.
move.description: The Pokémon mentally prepares to receive a fatal blow, their spirit is stronger than their body so they endure to keep on fighting for as long as possible.

move.name: Yawn
move.effect: Single Target. *If the Target has not been removed from battle at the beginning of the next Round, put it to Sleep.
move.description: The user yawns, the foe yawns, the trainers yawn... everyone should take a nap.

move.name: Baby-Doll Eyes
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Reduce Target's Strength by 1.
move.description: The biggest and brightest eyes, spakling with unshed tears, how can you say “no” to that?!

move.name: Retaliate
move.effect: Single Target. *If an Ally fainted during this or the previous Round, add Extra Dice to the damage pool, equal to the user's Loyalty. Up to 5 dice may be added this way. This effect only activates once per fainted Ally.
move.description: With tears of rage in their eyes, the Pokémon will not let the fall of a friend go without punishment.

move.name: Giga Impact
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge. Lethal.
move.description: The Pokémon strikes with such a brutal force they leave a crater just from the impact. Let them catch their breath afterwards.

move.name: Last Resort
move.effect: Single Target. This Move will fail if the User has not successfully performed all of its known Moves at least once during the battle.
move.description: The Pokémon may be out of energy, but never out of options.

name: Drowzee
description: It eats the dreams of a sleeping person or Pokémon and shows fondness for the dreams of young children. Once the victim is deep in slumber, it will extract and eat the dream through the nose.

abilityOne.name: Insomnia
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon does not ever sleep, it will be awake no matter the hour. Maybe it doesn't need to or maybe it's just worried.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon is immune to the Sleep Status. Moves and Items that self-inflict Sleep will fail.

abilityTwo.name: Forewarn
abilityTwo.description: When this Pokemon feels bad intentions or disaster approaching, it will mentally warn its trainer. The trainer must make a roll of Insight to get the message.
abilityTwo.effect: In battle, this Pokemon will warn about the strongest move one of its foes has. Storyteller has to reveal it to the trainer of this Pokemon in secret.

hiddenAbility.name: Inner Focus
hiddenAbility.description: The Pokemon is extrmely serious and focused on everything it does. It remains calm and never backs down, even if it's getting severly injured.
hiddenAbility.effect: This Pokemon does not Flinch. The Ability Intimidate does not have any effect against this Pokemon. Outside of battle this Pokemon is able to resist intimidation tactics, fear and stress better than others.

move.name: Pound
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user pounds the target’s head. Simple

move.name: Poison Gas
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 1. Poison those affected.
move.description: A thick cloud of toxic gas that causes violent coughs and red eyes.

move.name: Psybeam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Confuse the Target.
move.description: The foe’s mind isassaulted by a mental ray, afterwards they may suffer from hallucinations.

move.name: Headbutt
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Out of battle it may cause a Random encounter when hitting trees and make objects drop from high places.
move.description: The Pokémon rams against their foe with their head. This Move is perfect to shake down trees when looking for berries, but beware of wild Pokémon nesting at the treetops.

move.name: Psych Up
move.effect: Single Target. The User gets the same Attribute/Trait Increases and Reductions the Target has.
move.description: The Pokémon mentalizes themselves stronger than anyone. They feel good. They can win. They. Can. Do. This!

move.name: Synchronoise
move.effect: Area Move. Sound Move. Choose one Type (Fire, Poison, Steel, etc.). This move only affects those with that Type.
move.description: Each type of energy is contained by a thin layer of particles. With the right vibration frequency, that thin layer can be shattered like glass.

move.name: Zen Headbutt
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses both their mental and physical prowess in a questionable yet effective “psychic” strike.

move.name: Psychic
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: The most iconic Psychic attack, the foe starts floating in the air and its swayed around by telekinesis as their mental barrier crumbles.

move.name: Nasty Plot
move.effect: Target Self. Increase User's Special by 2.
move.description: Rubbing both hands and laughing sinisterly the Pokémon rejoices in the evil plans they’ll soon carry out.

move.name: Psyshock
move.effect: Single Target. This Move is resisted with the Target's Defense instead of its Sp. Defense.
move.description: The shock is mental, the blow is real.

move.name: Thunder Wave
move.effect: Single Target. Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A series of electric waves hit the target, their voltage is too weak to cause much harm but muscles will get cramped for hours.

move.name: Substitute
move.effect: Target Self. Deal 2 damage to the User. Put a Substitute Decoy with 2 HP and the same defenses as the user. See p. 531
move.description: The Pokémon disappears in a poof of smoke. A decoy identical to the user takes their place in battle. The user keeps attacking from the shadows while the decoy serves as distraction.

move.name: Disable
move.effect: Single Target. Disable the last Move performed by the Target. Only one Move may be Disabled at a time.
move.description: The Pokémon finds the right nerve to pull that will render a foe useless to perform their best Move.

move.name: Hypnosis
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Put the Target to sleep. Dark-Type Pokemon are affected by this Move.
move.description: By staring at an hypnotic pendulum, the target is suggestioned to feel tired and close its eyelids.

move.name: Confusion
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Confuse the Target.
move.description: A basic mental assault that makes the foe believe they are being attacked by an invisible enemy.

move.name: Meditate
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Special and Sp. Defense.
move.description: Through meditation the Pokémon brings forward their mind’s strength into their body.

move.name: Swagger
move.effect: Single Target. Increase the Target's Strength by 2. Confuse the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon’s arrogant and mocking attitude enrage their foe and make it lose focus in battle.

move.name: Role Play
move.effect: Single Target. Replace the User's Ability with the Target's. Whole Scene Duration. Unique Abilities can't be copied.
move.description: The Pokémon is a great actor. Their impersonations are really good! ...maybe a bit too good.

move.name: Future Sight
move.effect: Single Target. This Move's damage is dealt at the beginning of the next Round. Ignore Shield Moves, Force Field, Cover & Substitute. If the target restires or switches out from battle, the damage will be dealt to the next opponent or to one of its allies.
move.description: The Pokémon foresees something terrible happening. Although when it tries to see their own future, the images are ever changing.

move.name: Psychic Terrain
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Add 1 Extra Damage Dice to all Physical & Special Psychic-Type Moves. Pokemon without immunity to Ground can't use Moves with Reaction or Late Reaction. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The arena becomes radiated by psychic waves. Everyone feels their mind slog due to the buzz in their heads, making all tasks take longer than they should.

name: Gourgeist
description: They wander in the town streets every new moon. It wraps its prey on its arms and sings joyfully as it observes the suffering of the victim. Hearing it sing will give you horrible nightmares.

abilityOne.name: Pickup
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon will often gather objects and keep a small hoard of treasure it may share with you.
abilityOne.effect: If this Pokemon was out of its Pokeball, at the end of the scene see what it found for you at Storyteller's discretion. The higher the Rank of this Pokemon the more valuable the items it will find.

abilityTwo.name: Insomnia
abilityTwo.description: The Pokemon does not ever sleep, it will be awake no matter the hour. Maybe it doesn't need to or maybe it's just worried.
abilityTwo.effect: This Pokemon is immune to the Sleep Status. Moves and Items that self-inflict Sleep will fail.

move.name: Astonish
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe.
move.description: The user sneaks behind their target to jump scare them.

move.name: Razor Leaf
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Cutter Move. Ranged. High Critical.
move.description: The user sends out a barrage of sharp razor-like leaves. “Death by a thousand cuts” would be the best depiction.

move.name: Leech Seed
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Spend 1 Will point to activate. At the end of each Round, Roll 2 Dice of Typeless Damage against the target ignoring defenses. The User heals 1 HP for every damage dealt this way. Grass-Type Pokémon are immune to this Effect. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The foe is infected with seed saplings taking root on their body. As the saplings grow, they'll absorb the vital energy of the foe and send it back to the user.

move.name: Bullet Seed
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Successive Actions. Projectile Moves.
move.description: The Pokémon starts shooting seed as if they were a machine gun.

move.name: Shadow Ball
move.effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: Dark matter and shadows are used as a projectile against the foe, bringing out memories of their deepest fears.

move.name: Synthesis
move.effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will Point to activate. If Sunny Weather is in effect, this Move becomes a Complete Heal. If performed under Rain, Sandstorm, Hail or Snowy Weather, this Move is a Minor heal and only heals 1 HP.
move.description: The Pokémon gathers sunlight to re-energize themselves.

move.name: Trick-Or-Treat
move.effect: Single Target. Add the Ghost Type to the Target's Type. (ie Pikachu will now be "Electric/Ghost", Charizard will not be "Fire/Flying/Ghost") If the Target already has a third Type attached, replace it.
move.description: The user invites their foe to go trick-or-treating. The foe puts on a ghost costume that cannot be removed without an exorcism or help from the Pokémon center.

move.name: Shadow Sneak
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1.
move.description: The user sneaks through the darkness and strikes by coming out of the target’s shadow. The Pokémon is able travel freely through the shadow realm.

move.name: Confuse Ray
move.effect: Single Target. Confuse the Target.
move.description: The user flashes a sinister ray of bright light that others cannot help but go straight into it.

move.name: Scary Face
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: When a Pokémon looks at you like THAT, you know you gotta thread carefully around them.

move.name: Worry Seed
move.effect: Single Target. Replace the Target's Ability with "Insomnia". Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon.
move.description: The user plants the seed of doubt and uncertainty on its foe. The foe becomes such a worrywart that they can’t even sleep at night.

move.name: Trick
move.effect: Single Target. The User and the Target switch their Held Item. If only one Pokemon is holding an Item, it gives it away.
move.description: The user controls its target’s mind to make them do a simple non-hostile action, such as walking or handing an item. Although some Pokémon use simple sleigh of hand.

move.name: Role Play
move.effect: Single Target. Replace the User's Ability with the Target's. Whole Scene Duration. Unique Abilities can't be copied.
move.description: The Pokémon is a great actor. Their impersonations are really good! ...maybe a bit too good.

move.name: Nature Power
move.effect: Single Target. *The Type of this Move is determined by the environment or active Terrain. See more on p. 530
move.description: The Pokémon makes use of the terrain and asks for nature's aid in battle.

move.name: Moonblast
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Reduce Target's Special by 1.
move.description: The user becomes a champion of lunar justice. In the name of the moon, they will right the wrongs and triumph over evil!

move.name: Seed Bomb
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Projectile Move.
move.description: A giant seed is hurled against the target, the hit is not what knocks them down, the tree that explodes suddenly out of the seed is what does.

move.name: Pain Split
move.effect: Single Target. Spend 1 Will Point to activate. *Deal up to 3 Typeless Damage to the Target, Heal 1 HP to the User for every Damage dealt this way. This Move Fails if the User has more than Half HP rounded down. This Move cannot reduce a Target to less than 1 HP.
move.description: The user channels their pain into the foe to relieve their agony. The foe gets to feel the burn of the damage it has caused.

move.name: Dark Pulse
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: A haze of dark energy decends on the battlefield preying on those vulnerable to the obscure feelings and fears it provokes.

move.name: Phantom Force
move.effect: Single Target. Charge move. Out of Range while Charging. Lethal. Ignore any Cover, Shield Moves, and/or Force Fields active on the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon disappears into a dark dimension to infiltrate even the most impenetrable fortress. It may reappear during its next action.

move.name: Destiny Bond
move.effect: Target Self. If the user faints this Round due to damage frm a Physical or Special Move, the Pokemon who dealt the damage is dealt damage equal to their remaining Hp. This Move will fail if it was used the previous Round.
move.description: Through a mystical bond, everyone who brings disgrace to this Pokémon will suffer the exact same fate.

move.name: Explosion
move.effect: Area Move. Ranged. Lethal. The User Faints.
move.description: Through a massive explosion the Pokémon destroys all they can before fainting. Sometimes the only way to get out of a bad situation is in bits and pieces.

move.name: Trick Room
move.effect: Target the Battlefield. Invert the order of Initiative. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: Reality inside the battlefielfield is distorted, time bends and flows differently for everyone. Those who don’t rush through manage to adapt easier.

move.name: Flame Charge
move.effect: Single Target. Increase the User's Dexterity by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon dashes so fast they leave a trail of fire behind.

name: Pidove
description: These Pokémon thrive in the cities. They are accustomed to people and they often gather in parks. They are forgetful and not very smart, but they always remember the way back home.

abilityOne.name: Big Pecks
abilityOne.description: This tenacious Pokemon uses its beak to cover its weak spots.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon cannot have its Defense reduced.

abilityTwo.name: Super Luck
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon has an incredible good luck, good things happen to it regularly.
abilityTwo.effect: All Physical and Special Moves of this Pokemon have "High Critical" as an Added Effect. If the Move already had "High Critical" the effect stacks and this Pokemon only requires 1 more Success on the Accuracy roll to land a Critical instead of 2.

hiddenAbility.name: Rivalry
hiddenAbility.description: The Pokemon will be very competitive with others to prove its position as the alpha of the group, however, it will try to gain the favor of possible mates.
hiddenAbility.effect: If this Pokemon targets a foe of the same gender, Increase its Strength Attribute by 1. If the targeted foe is the opposite gender, Reduce its Strength Attribute by 1.

move.name: Gust
move.effect: Single Target. Wind Move. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop", this Move hits anyway.
move.description: The Pokémon flaps their wings and strikes the foe with a swirl of wind. Pokémon in the air may get swept away

move.name: Growl
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Reduce by 1 the Strength of those affected.
move.description: Either through a menacing attitude or an adorable demeanor, the foe will hesitate to attack the user at full power.

move.name: Leer
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The vicious glare of a predator that triggers the flight response of their prey.

move.name: Quick Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Out of battle, double the Pokemon's movement speed.
move.description: An attackas fight as lightning.

move.name: Detect
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokemon would receive from a Physical or Special move. Negate the Added Effcts of Any Moves that target the user.
move.description: The Pokémon detects the intentions of the attacker and reacts just in time to minimize the damage.

move.name: Taunt
move.effect: Single Target. The Target cannot perform Support Moves (Support Maneuvers may still be performed). Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: Through tease and mockery, the foe is enraged to the point it stops thinking clearly.

move.name: Razor Wind
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Charge Move. High Critical. Cutter Move.
move.description: The Pokémon sways the winds while charging what appears to be an invisible blade made of pressurized air. The wind slices everything it touches as if it were a razor.

move.name: Feather Dance
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Strength by 2.
move.description: A dance as soft as a feather. It soothes the hearts of the spectators and reduces all aggression.

move.name: Facade
move.effect: Single Target. *If the User has a Status Ailment (Paralysis, Poison, Burn, etc.) Add 3 Extra Dice to the Damage pool.
move.description: The Pokémon puts on a brave face through the most difficult of situations.

move.name: Tailwind
move.effect: Target User's side of the Field. Wind Move. Increase by 2 the Dexterity of everyone on the User's side of the field. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: Flying Pokémon know better than anyone how to use the wind in their favor. Let its draft carry you to victory.

move.name: Lucky Chant
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Unique. Targets can Re-roll one un-successful die from all their rolls. Critical Hits do not grant Bonus dice against the Targets. Whole Scene Duration. Out of battle, good things happen at Storyteller's Discretion.
move.description: The magical incantation of an old priestess, through dance and song, good fortune and divine protection will come to you. This Move also removes evil spirits and curses.

move.name: Hypnosis
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Put the Target to sleep. Dark-Type Pokemon are affected by this Move.
move.description: By staring at an hypnotic pendulum, the target is suggestioned to feel tired and close its eyelids.

move.name: Air Cutter
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. High Critical. Wind Move. Cutter Move.
move.description: A sharp wide wave of wind is sent out , everyone can feel it slicing throught their midsection.

move.name: Swagger
move.effect: Single Target. Increase the Target's Strength by 2. Confuse the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon’s arrogant and mocking attitude enrage their foe and make it lose focus in battle.

move.name: Air Slash
move.effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: A compressed wind-slash, the change of pressure knocks out the target momentarily

move.name: Roost
move.effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Remove the User's Immunity to Ground-Type Moves. Duration 1 Round.
move.description: The Pokémon gathers some twigs and builds themselves a comfy nest on the floor to roost and relax.

move.name: Sky Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Charge Move. High Critical. Lethal. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: In a graceful but lethal strike, the Pokémon takes a deep dive towards the foe as if the sky was falling down right on top of it

move.name: Dual Wingbeat
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuarcy 1. Double action.
move.description: The Pokémon slams the foe from above. Each wing provides a good smacking.

name: Exeggcute
description: Even though it appears to be eggs of some sort, it is related more to a seed. It gathers in packs of six that have a mental link with each other. Each one of them has a different personality.

abilityOne.name: Chlorophyll
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon synthesizes sunlight to get energy, if it's kept in a sunny environment it will rarely need to eat.
abilityOne.effect: While Sunny Weather is active, Increase this Pokemon's Dexterity Attribute by 2.

abilityTwo.name: Harvest
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon will naturally produce edible fruits in a short period of time, if fed with berries it will start growing them too.
abilityTwo.effect: If this Pokemon uses a berry as a held item during a fight, the berry will grow back at the end of the battle.

move.name: Barrage
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged. Successive Actions. Projectile Move.
move.description: The Pokémon throws whatever objects they find, one after the other to overwhelm the foe.

move.name: Uproar
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Sound Move. This Effect Targets the Battle Field: Pokemon will be cured of the Sleep Status. Duration 1 Round.
move.description: Shouts, screams, and loud music... What does a Pokémon have to do here for a peaceful night of sleep?

move.name: Hypnosis
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Put the Target to sleep. Dark-Type Pokemon are affected by this Move.
move.description: By staring at an hypnotic pendulum, the target is suggestioned to feel tired and close its eyelids.

move.name: Leech Seed
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Spend 1 Will point to activate. At the end of each Round, Roll 2 Dice of Typeless Damage against the target ignoring defenses. The User heals 1 HP for every damage dealt this way. Grass-Type Pokémon are immune to this Effect. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The foe is infected with seed saplings taking root on their body. As the saplings grow, they'll absorb the vital energy of the foe and send it back to the user.

move.name: Bullet Seed
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Successive Actions. Projectile Moves.
move.description: The Pokémon starts shooting seed as if they were a machine gun.

move.name: Stun Spore
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Powder Move. Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A cloud of paralyzing pollen that affects the nerves and cramps the muscles of those who inhale it.

move.name: Poison Powder
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Powder Move. Poison the Target.
move.description: A cloud of noxius powder that immediately sends the target’s immune system into overdrive.

move.name: Sleep Powder
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Powder Move. Put the Target to Sleep.
move.description: The Pokémon spouts a cloud of somniferous pollen to know out their foe, the only problem is that the foe must inhale enough of the pollen for it to take effect.

move.name: Worry Seed
move.effect: Single Target. Replace the Target's Ability with "Insomnia". Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon.
move.description: The user plants the seed of doubt and uncertainty on its foe. The foe becomes such a worrywart that they can’t even sleep at night.

move.name: Natural Gift
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. The User loes its held berry. *The Type of this Move changes according to the berry used. See more on p. 530
move.description: The user throws their held berry at the foe, the myriad of flavors has surprisingly different results.

move.name: Solar Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. If Sunny Weather is active, you skip this Move's Charge action. If performed under Rain, Sandstorm or Hail/Snowy Weather, this Move takes two actions to Charge.
move.description: The Pokémon gathers sunlight but instead of being absorbed it is sot as a devastating beam of light instead.

move.name: Bestow
move.effect: Single Target. Can't be used if Target is not holding an Item. The User gives its Held Item to the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon offers their own item to the foe to show their good manners. The foe keeps it as they don’t want to be seem as impolite.

move.name: Ingrain
move.effect: Target Self. The User heals 1 HP at the end of each Round. Spend 1 Will point to activate. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The Pokémon roots themselves to absorb nutrients directly from the ground.

move.name: Absorb
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The user takes nutrients from the nearest source of life they find.

move.name: Reflect
move.effect: Target the User's side of the field. Force Field. Activate a Force Field against Physical Damage. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: An ethereal mirror-like wall cuts the battlefield in half, bouncing back the impact of most blows.

move.name: Confusion
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Confuse the Target.
move.description: A basic mental assault that makes the foe believe they are being attacked by an invisible enemy.

move.name: Egg Bomb
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Ranged. Projectile Move.
move.description: The target can’t take a yolk. Let’s make them laugh with an egg-cellent pun to crack them up.

move.name: Extrasensory
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon alters their target’s senses, making it feel things that aren’t really there.

move.name: Grassy Terrain
move.effect: Target User's side of the field. Add 1 Extra Damage Dice to all Physical & Special Grass-Type Moves. Everyone on the User's side of the field heals 1 HP at the end of each Round. Spend 1 Will Point t activate. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A patch of grass grows in the area surrounding the user, through it nature grants her many blessings.

move.name: Grassy Glide
move.effect: Single Target. *If Grassy Terrain is active, this Move has Reaction 1.
move.description: A single leaf can hold the entire weight of the Pokémon. When moving, it appears to glide over the grass.

name: Haunter
description: Haunter is a dangerous Pokémon. It will try to lick you with its tongue to steal your life away. If you get the feeling of being watched in darkness when nobody is around, it means a Haunter is there.

abilityOne.name: Levitate
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon floats to move around without ever touching the ground.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon has immunity to Ground-Type moves and effects active on the battlefield such as Terrains and certain Entry Hazards.

move.name: Lick
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon licks the foe. The foe is deeply disturbed by this creepy display of “affection”.

move.name: Mean Look
move.effect: Single Target. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: An intense and ever-vigilant stare that surveils all possible paths the foe has to escape.

move.name: Night Shade
move.effect: Single Target. Roll Ghost-Type Damage Dice according to the User's Rank: Starter 1 Die / Rookie 2 Dice / Standard 4 Dice/ Advacned 6 Dice / Expert 8 Dice / Ace and forward 10 Dice. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The user casts a dark and frightening mirage surrounding the foe to give them a panic attack.

move.name: Hypnosis
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Put the Target to sleep. Dark-Type Pokemon are affected by this Move.
move.description: By staring at an hypnotic pendulum, the target is suggestioned to feel tired and close its eyelids.

move.name: Sucker Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 6. *This move can only be used as a Late Reaction; and only if the Target used a Physical or Special Move, otherwise it will fail.
move.description: The Pokémon takes advantage of their foe preparing to attack to unleash a dirty surprise blow.

move.name: Dream Eater
move.effect: Single Target. Can only be used if the Target has the Sleep Condition, otherwise it will fail. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The Pokémon enters the dream world for a snack. The dreams of children and baby Pokémon are the tastiest.

move.name: Icy Wind
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Wind Move. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: Polar winds sweep through the arena. Everyone starts to shiver and embrace themselves, trying to preserve a bit of warmth.

move.name: Grudge
move.effect: Single Target. The User Faints. Reduce the Target's Will to 0 points and reset any effect it got from spending them. Roll Target's Loyalty at the end of the round, increase difficulty by 1 each round. Failing this roll faints the Target.
move.description: The last words of this Pokémon imprint their grudge and anger over their foe. Depleting the foe of their will to carry on in this world.

move.name: Trick
move.effect: Single Target. The User and the Target switch their Held Item. If only one Pokemon is holding an Item, it gives it away.
move.description: The user controls its target’s mind to make them do a simple non-hostile action, such as walking or handing an item. Although some Pokémon use simple sleigh of hand.

move.name: Confuse Ray
move.effect: Single Target. Confuse the Target.
move.description: The user flashes a sinister ray of bright light that others cannot help but go straight into it.

move.name: Curse
move.effect: Single Target. Roll half of the User's HP as Typeless Damage Dice to itself, ignoring defenses. The Target will remove 1 success from all of their Rolls until the Curse if lifted.
move.description: The user mutters an evil incantation, misery will befall into the foe at the cost of the user’s soul. To get rid of the curse, perform an exorcism or get help at a Pokémon Center

move.name: Spite
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Will to 1 point. Reset any effects it got from spending Will Points.
move.description: The target feels overwhelmend by feelings of dread.

move.name: Shadow Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Never Miss. Fist Move.
move.description: The Pokémon punches the air, inadvertently, their shadow delivers the punch through the foe’s own shadow. This move is impossible to predict.

move.name: Shadow Ball
move.effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: Dark matter and shadows are used as a projectile against the foe, bringing out memories of their deepest fears.

move.name: Payback
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move if the User has already received Damage from the Target this Round.
move.description: Some say the best revenge is a successful and happy life, but not this Pokémon.

move.name: Dark Pulse
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: A haze of dark energy decends on the battlefield preying on those vulnerable to the obscure feelings and fears it provokes.

move.name: Hex
move.effect: Single Target. *If the Target has an active Status Condition, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move.
move.description: The user casts a terrible hex over the target, the effects will be greater if the target is already burdened by an ailment.

move.name: Destiny Bond
move.effect: Target Self. If the user faints this Round due to damage frm a Physical or Special Move, the Pokemon who dealt the damage is dealt damage equal to their remaining Hp. This Move will fail if it was used the previous Round.
move.description: Through a mystical bond, everyone who brings disgrace to this Pokémon will suffer the exact same fate.

move.name: Nightmare
