move.description: With a charming but manipulative cry, the user deals emotional damage to their opponent by making them feel guilty.

name: Sceptile (Mega Form)
description: With the power of the Mega Stone, it allows itself to grow more feral in order to gain draconian powers. Its movements are swifter than ever, and when it attacks, it seems like the jungle has come to life.

abilityOne.name: Lightning Rod
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon will attract lightning and electricity to itself to charge its power. Great for preventing power surges. Bad for your electricity bill.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon is immune to Electric-Type Damage. If anyone on the field uses a Single-Target Electric-Type Move, it will be redirected towards this Pokemon. The first time this Pokemon is hit by an Electric-Type move, Increase its Special by 1.

move.name: Pound
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user pounds the target’s head. Simple

move.name: Leer
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The vicious glare of a predator that triggers the flight response of their prey.

move.name: Absorb
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The user takes nutrients from the nearest source of life they find.

move.name: Mega Drain
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The user absorbs a big amount of vital energy and nutrients from the target to feed from.

move.name: Screech
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Reduce the Target's Defense by 2.
move.description: A mighty screech will make the target cover its ears instead of covering its flanks.

move.name: Detect
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokemon would receive from a Physical or Special move. Negate the Added Effcts of Any Moves that target the user.
move.description: The Pokémon detects the intentions of the attacker and reacts just in time to minimize the damage.

move.name: Quick Guard
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Reaction 3. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage from a Physical or Special Move with Priority. Negate the Added effects of Reaction and late Reaction Moves targeting the User and Allies.
move.description: The user reacts instinctively and defends itself and its team mates, nullyfing the effects of the fastest attacks.

move.name: Thunder Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 1 Chance die to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A charged punch to deliver a shocking blow.

move.name: Frenzy Plant
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge.
move.description: The user roots down and calls upon the force of nature. Thorny roots and plants grow in a frenzy around the foe. This display of power leaves the user quite exhausted.

move.name: Leafage
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged.
move.description: The user throws leaf darts towards the foe.

move.name: Quick Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Out of battle, double the Pokemon's movement speed.
move.description: An attackas fight as lightning.

move.name: Pursuit
move.effect: Single Target. *If a Target hit by this Move is recalled, attempts to Run Away, uses a Switcher Move or is the Target of a Switcher Move, Deal 2 Typeless Damage to it. Outside of battle, aid in catching a fleeing target.
move.description: The Pokémon is relentless in its pursuit of their target, striking it just as it believed it had escaped.

move.name: Fury Cutter
move.effect: Single Target. Successive Actions. Cutter Move.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their claws or scythes to rapidly cut as if shredding paper.

move.name: Agility
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: Swift of body, swift of mind.

move.name: Slam
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1.
move.description: Everybody get up, it’s time to slam now.

move.name: Nature Power
move.effect: Single Target. *The Type of this Move is determined by the environment or active Terrain. See more on p. 530
move.description: The Pokémon makes use of the terrain and asks for nature's aid in battle.

move.name: Energy Ball
move.effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: Gathering nature’s energy from nearby plants, trees and roots, the Pokémon forms a ball to shoot at the enemy. Sadly, the surrounding plants will be dry afterwards.

move.name: False Swipe
move.effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. This Move's Damage can't make the Target go below 1 HP.
move.description: Through their most dramatic poses, the Pokémon pretends to slice up the foe (the blood is fake).

move.name: Double Team
move.effect: Target Self. The User can now make up to 5 Evasions per Round.
move.description: The Pokémon moves so fast they create a series of shadow copies of themselves. Trying to guess which one is the real one is a pain.

move.name: X-Scissor
move.effect: Single Target. Cutter Move.
move.description: The Pokémon uses its scythes or clawa as if they were a pair of scissors to cut through the foe.

move.name: Night Slash
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical. Cutter Move.
move.description: The user looks for a weak spot, tearing the soft flesh apart with a single vile slash of its claws.

move.name: Giga Drain
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The Pokémon drains most of the foe’s vital energy and feeds on the nutrients it managed to extract.

move.name: Endeavor
move.effect: Single Target. Roll Dice of Normal-Type Damage equal to the difference between the User's current HP and the Target's max HP. Ignore defenses. Up to 10 Dice may be rolled this way. This Damage cannot make the Target's HP go lower than the User's current HP.
move.description: Through sheer willpower the Pokémon manages to level the conditions of the battle despite their own injuries.

move.name: Dual Chop
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Double Action.
move.description: Two brutal blows are all this Pokémon needs to make the opponent yield to their might.

move.name: Leaf Storm
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Reduce the User's Special by 2.
move.description: A furious onslaught of sharp leaves blasting against the target. The user gives their all in this attack.

move.name: Synthesis
move.effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will Point to activate. If Sunny Weather is in effect, this Move becomes a Complete Heal. If performed under Rain, Sandstorm, Hail or Snowy Weather, this Move is a Minor heal and only heals 1 HP.
move.description: The Pokémon gathers sunlight to re-energize themselves.

move.name: Outrage
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
move.description: The true nature of dragon-types unleashed. The user is consumed by a primal fury that won’t stop until everything has ben razed to the ground. Afterwards the Pokémon is confused.

name: Ursaring
description: They are incredibly strong, great climbers and posses an amazing sense of smell. They snap trees and feed on their fruit as they eat quite a lot. A forest full of scratched trees marks the territory of Ursaring.

abilityOne.name: Guts
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon dares to do everything no one else dares to, and won't lose its determination easily, it may be a little reckless, though.
abilityOne.effect: While affected by a Status Ailment (Burn, Frozen, Paralysis, Poison, Sleep), Increase this Pokemon's Strength Attribute by 2.

abilityTwo.name: Quick Feet
abilityTwo.description: Most of the time this Pokemon will seem to be in a hurry. When pressured, it will move faster than normal.
abilityTwo.effect: While affected by a Status Ailment (Burn, Frozen, Paralysis, Poison, Sleep), Increase this Pokemon's Dexterity Attribute by 2. If inflicted by Paralysis, this Ability prevents its effects.

hiddenAbility.name: Unnerve
hiddenAbility.description: It may be its powerful gaze or its menacing presence, but others near this Pokemon become really nervous to the point where they lose their appetite.
hiddenAbility.effect: Foes cannot consume their held berry or recycled berries while this Pokemon is in the field.

move.name: Scratch
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their sharp claws to scratch the enemy. Nothing fancy but it works.

move.name: Feint Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Never Miss.
move.description: The user approaches inconspicuously, pretending to attack the foe directly, then actually hits the foe from behind.

move.name: Swords Dance
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Strength by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon dances with strong steps and a fierce attitude as a ritual to prepare for battle.

move.name: Gunk Shot
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
move.description: The target is covered heat to toe in sludge, filth and organic waste. It can’t even cry for help or all of it will go into its mouth.

move.name: Scary Face
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: When a Pokémon looks at you like THAT, you know you gotta thread carefully around them.

move.name: Lick
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon licks the foe. The foe is deeply disturbed by this creepy display of “affection”.

move.name: Fake Tears
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce foe's Sp. Defense by 2.
move.description: The user stops mid-combat to start crying; feeling incredibly guilty, the foe lowers its guard.

move.name: Covet
move.effect: Single Target. The User steals the Target's Held Item. If the User already has a Held Item, this effect fails.
move.description: The Pokémon is attracted to shiny and colorful items. They don’t understand when something is not theirs for the taking so they just take it when no one is looking.

move.name: Fling
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. *If the User is holding an Item, Add up to 4 dice to the damage pool. User loses its Held Item. See p. 530
move.description: The Pokémon takes their held item, uses it as a weapon and the referee is somehow OK with this. The held item remains in the field and may be recovered after the battle.

move.name: Fury Swipes
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions.
move.description: With their sharp claws, the Pokémon will swiftly scatch their foe, leaving its face full of small cuts.

move.name: Payback
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move if the User has already received Damage from the Target this Round.
move.description: Some say the best revenge is a successful and happy life, but not this Pokémon.

move.name: Play Nice
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Strength by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon starts to play with the foe. They are firendly, respectful, and thank the foe for the fun time. The foe does not want to fight, they want to keep playing.

move.name: Sweet Scent
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Those affected cannot Evade Moves. Out of Battle, it will attract wild Pokemon.
move.description: The Pokémon releases a sweet aroma that lulls their enemies into a false sense of security

move.name: Metal Claw
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 1 Chance Die to Increase the User's Strength by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon uses the foe as a whetstone.

move.name: Slash
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical. Cutter Move.
move.description: The Pokémon uses the sharpest part of their body as a blade to tear and slash with vicious intent.

move.name: Rest
move.effect: Target Self. Complete Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Put the User to Sleep.
move.description: Yeah, this seems like a good spot to take a nap.

move.name: Snore
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. If the user is not asleep, this Move fails.
move.description: While the Pokémon is asleep they start snoring so loud it startles the foe.

move.name: Hammer Arm
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Low Accuracy 1. Reduce User's Dexterity by 1.
move.description: Stop. Hammer Arm time!

move.name: Thrash
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
move.description: The Pokémon becomes a wild thing and the rumpus has started.

move.name: Mega Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Fist Move.
move.description: The Pokémon packs everything into this punch to pulverize their foe with a single strike.

name: Shelmet
description: When attacked, it defends itself by closing the lid of its shell or spits a sticky, poisonous liquid. It competes with Karrablast for food and shelter. If it loses its shell, the distress may kill it; only those who survive evolve.

abilityOne.name: Overcoat
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon will have a protective coat surrounding its body that allows it to live under extreme weather conditions.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon won't recieve damage from active weather.

abilityTwo.name: Shell Armor
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon's shell protects its vulnerable spots from its opponents.
abilityTwo.effect: Whenever a foe lands a Critical Hit on this Pokemon, it won't get Bonus Damage Dice for that attack.

move.name: Acid
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Roll 1 Chance die to Reduce by 1 the Sp. Defense of those affected.
move.description: The Pokémon spits an acidic gunk into the foe that immediately gives burning sensation. Keep away from the eyes and wash with abundant water.

move.name: Struggle Bug
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Special of those affected.
move.description: The Pokémon sends a distress signal through its antennae to interrupt the foe’s concentration.

move.name: Mega Drain
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The user absorbs a big amount of vital energy and nutrients from the target to feed from.

move.name: Yawn
move.effect: Single Target. *If the Target has not been removed from battle at the beginning of the next Round, put it to Sleep.
move.description: The user yawns, the foe yawns, the trainers yawn... everyone should take a nap.

move.name: Acid Armor
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
move.description: Highly acidic goop oozes through the pores of this Pokémon. Touching it immediately causes a burning pain. Preventing foes from getting too close.

move.name: Bug Buzz
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce by 1 the Sp. Defense of those affected.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their wings or a part of their bodies to emit distracting buzzes all around.

move.name: Recover
move.effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their energy to quickly mend wounds, their regenerative powers are beyond the imagination.

move.name: Guard Split
move.effect: Single Target. Average the User's Defense and Sp. Defense with the Target's, rounded down.
move.description: Through a mental link both Pokémon are aware of each other weaknesses, which end up evening the odds.

move.name: Gastro Acid
move.effect: Single Target. Negate any effect the Target's Ability would have. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The user spews their gastric juices on the foe. It’s so disgusting the foe can only concentrate on getting cleaned ASAP

move.name: Endure
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. If a Physical or Special Move would cause the user to faint, they remain at 1 HP instead, remove this effect afterwards. The effect re-activates on the user's next Turn. Whole Round duration.
move.description: The Pokémon mentally prepares to receive a fatal blow, their spirit is stronger than their body so they endure to keep on fighting for as long as possible.

move.name: Absorb
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The user takes nutrients from the nearest source of life they find.

move.name: Protect
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokemon would receive from a Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Moves that target the user.
move.description: A mighty energy shield materializes in front of the user to to deflect attacks and dispel ill effects.

move.name: Curse
move.effect: Single Target. Roll half of the User's HP as Typeless Damage Dice to itself, ignoring defenses. The Target will remove 1 success from all of their Rolls until the Curse if lifted.
move.description: The user mutters an evil incantation, misery will befall into the foe at the cost of the user’s soul. To get rid of the curse, perform an exorcism or get help at a Pokémon Center

move.name: Bide
move.effect: Single Target. The User will not Evade or Clash the next 2 Physical or Special Moves targeting it. Once all damage has been dealt against the User, roll a number of Normal-Type Damage dice equal to twice the total amount of Damage the Target received. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The user puts up with being hit, waiting for the perfect opportunity to retaliate.

move.name: Giga Drain
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The Pokémon drains most of the foe’s vital energy and feeds on the nutrients it managed to extract.

move.name: Leech Life
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The Pokémon clings to their foe, then bites in and starts to suck away its life force.

move.name: Guard Swap
move.effect: Single Target. Whole Scene Duration. Switch the User's Defense and Sp. Defense with the Target's.
move.description: The Pokémon enters their foe’s mind to steal its fortitude and implant on them the idea of their own weakness.

move.name: Body Slam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The user charges against the foe using ther body to slam it down, leaving the target stunned.

move.name: Final Gambit
move.effect: Single Target. Ignore Defenses. The user Faints after dealing Damage.
move.description: The Pokémon puts its last Strength into an all-or-nothing attack. After that, the user faints.

name: Slowbro (Mega Form)
description: With the power of the Mega Stone, the Shellder on its tail becomes a bulletproof armor that swallows its host's whole body. Slowbro doesn't seem to mind and looks pretty comfy nesting inside.

abilityOne.name: Shell Armor
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon's shell protects its vulnerable spots from its opponents.
abilityOne.effect: Whenever a foe lands a Critical Hit on this Pokemon, it won't get Bonus Damage Dice for that attack.

move.name: Yawn
move.effect: Single Target. *If the Target has not been removed from battle at the beginning of the next Round, put it to Sleep.
move.description: The user yawns, the foe yawns, the trainers yawn... everyone should take a nap.

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Curse
move.effect: Single Target. Roll half of the User's HP as Typeless Damage Dice to itself, ignoring defenses. The Target will remove 1 success from all of their Rolls until the Curse if lifted.
move.description: The user mutters an evil incantation, misery will befall into the foe at the cost of the user’s soul. To get rid of the curse, perform an exorcism or get help at a Pokémon Center

move.name: Growl
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Reduce by 1 the Strength of those affected.
move.description: Either through a menacing attitude or an adorable demeanor, the foe will hesitate to attack the user at full power.

move.name: Confusion
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Confuse the Target.
move.description: A basic mental assault that makes the foe believe they are being attacked by an invisible enemy.

move.name: Disable
move.effect: Single Target. Disable the last Move performed by the Target. Only one Move may be Disabled at a time.
move.description: The Pokémon finds the right nerve to pull that will render a foe useless to perform their best Move.

move.name: Headbutt
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Out of battle it may cause a Random encounter when hitting trees and make objects drop from high places.
move.description: The Pokémon rams against their foe with their head. This Move is perfect to shake down trees when looking for berries, but beware of wild Pokémon nesting at the treetops.

move.name: Psychic
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: The most iconic Psychic attack, the foe starts floating in the air and its swayed around by telekinesis as their mental barrier crumbles.

move.name: Aqua Tail
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The user sways their tail to create a pocket whirlpool in which the foe gets sucked in by the spinning motion.

move.name: Belly Drum
move.effect: Target Self. Roll half of the User's HP as Typeless Damage Dice to itself, ignore defenses. Increase User's Strengt by 3.
move.description: With an angry war cry the user hits their belly as drums of war.

move.name: Future Sight
move.effect: Single Target. This Move's damage is dealt at the beginning of the next Round. Ignore Shield Moves, Force Field, Cover & Substitute. If the target restires or switches out from battle, the damage will be dealt to the next opponent or to one of its allies.
move.description: The Pokémon foresees something terrible happening. Although when it tries to see their own future, the images are ever changing.

move.name: Water Gun
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The fastest water gun in town. No enemy will remain dry

move.name: Water Pulse
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target.
move.description: The user sends out a pulsing ring of water that blasts the foe with ultrasonic waves. For a while, everything seems as if reflected in the water ripples.

move.name: Zen Headbutt
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses both their mental and physical prowess in a questionable yet effective “psychic” strike.

move.name: Slack Off
move.effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate.
move.description: Some Pokémon fight by giving their maximum effort all the time, they are doing it wrong.

move.name: Withdraw
move.effect: Target Self. Increase User's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon withraw into their shell for increased protection and to avoid unwanted interactions.

move.name: Amnesia
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Sp. Defense by 2.
move.description: No thoughts. Head empty

move.name: Surf
move.effect: Area Move. If a Target is out of range due to the Move "Dive", this Move hits anyways. Out of battle, allows the Pokemon to travel the sea for long distances.
move.description: The Pokémon calls forward a large wave of seawater to ride, most Pokémon get washed out as they did not bring a surfboard.

move.name: Rain Dance
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Activate Rain Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The Pokémon performs a peculiar dance in the middle of the field, everyone thinks it silly until the first thunder rumbles.

move.name: Psych Up
move.effect: Single Target. The User gets the same Attribute/Trait Increases and Reductions the Target has.
move.description: The Pokémon mentalizes themselves stronger than anyone. They feel good. They can win. They. Can. Do. This!

move.name: Heal Pulse
move.effect: Target One Ally. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate.
move.description: Commanding the mind over the matter, the Pokémon speeds up the healing process on an ally.

name: Throh
description: When they encounter foes bigger than themselves, they try to throw them away. In the wild they always travel in packs of five and make their clothes and belts out of plants and vines.

abilityOne.name: Guts
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon dares to do everything no one else dares to, and won't lose its determination easily, it may be a little reckless, though.
abilityOne.effect: While affected by a Status Ailment (Burn, Frozen, Paralysis, Poison, Sleep), Increase this Pokemon's Strength Attribute by 2.

abilityTwo.name: Inner Focus
abilityTwo.description: The Pokemon is extrmely serious and focused on everything it does. It remains calm and never backs down, even if it's getting severly injured.
abilityTwo.effect: This Pokemon does not Flinch. The Ability Intimidate does not have any effect against this Pokemon. Outside of battle this Pokemon is able to resist intimidation tactics, fear and stress better than others.

hiddenAbility.name: Mold Breaker
hiddenAbility.description: This Pokemon will find unusual ways to achieve its goals. They are inventive and go around problems.
hiddenAbility.effect: If a foe Pokemon has a Type, an immunity, or an Ability that would prevent this Pokemon from dealing Damage with a Move, ignore it.

move.name: Bind
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Increase the Target's difficultty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion.
move.description: The Pokémon uses all their strength to restrain to the foe and keep them in place.

move.name: Leer
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The vicious glare of a predator that triggers the flight response of their prey.

move.name: Focus Energy
move.effect: Target Self. All of the user's Physical & Special Moves now have "High Critical". Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The Pokémon concentrates all their focus on the battle to make their attacks much more precise.

move.name: Bide
move.effect: Single Target. The User will not Evade or Clash the next 2 Physical or Special Moves targeting it. Once all damage has been dealt against the User, roll a number of Normal-Type Damage dice equal to twice the total amount of Damage the Target received. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The user puts up with being hit, waiting for the perfect opportunity to retaliate.

move.name: Revenge
move.effect: Single Target. *If the User has already received Damage this Round, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.
move.description: Best served cold.

move.name: Bulk Up
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon showcase their muscles through poses that highlight their fitness and bodybuilding discipline.

move.name: Fire Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 2nd Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: A fist powered by the fiery spirit of combat, the heat of the battle lights of for real as the punch hits the foe right where it hurts!

move.name: Ice Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 1 Chance Dice to Freeze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon wears their ice gloves to punch the foe. Yes. Gloves made of ice.

move.name: Thunder Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 1 Chance die to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A charged punch to deliver a shocking blow.

move.name: Circle Throw
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy -1. Late Reaction 1. Switcher Move for the foe.
move.description: Using their best sumo moves, the Pokémon throws the foe 60ft. out of the battlefield.

move.name: Wide Guard
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Reaction 3. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage the Targets would receive from Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Any Moves on the Targets.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their whole body to provide shelter and protection to everyone they can. They are the rock on which others stand.

move.name: Storm Throw
move.effect: Single Target. This Move is always considered to be a Critical Hit and gets the proper Bonus for it.
move.description: The user throws its foe with a special technique, the foe lands right on their weak spot.

move.name: Vital Throw
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 1. Never Miss.
move.description: You don’t need to go to the enemy, let them come to you.

move.name: Seismic Toss
move.effect: Single Target. Roll Fight-Type Damage Dice according to the User's Rank: Starter 1 Die / Rookie 2 Dice / Standard 4 Dice/ Advacned 6 Dice / Expert 8 Dice / Ace and forward 10 Dice. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The foe gets launched up to the sky, then falls face-first into the ground making it tremble. The stronger the user, the higher the launch.

move.name: Mat Block
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Shield Move. Reaction 1. Reduce 3 Damage from a Physical or Special Move.
move.description: The Pokémon uses a mat as a shield.

move.name: Strength
move.effect: Outside of battle, using this move allows the Pokemon to lift double the normal weight it should be able to.
move.description: The Pokemon strains its muscles to go beyond their own limits.

move.name: Bulldoze
move.effect: Area Move. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: The user stomps and flattens the ground, pushing all the rubbish and leaving the surface ready for construction.

move.name: Body Slam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The user charges against the foe using ther body to slam it down, leaving the target stunned.

move.name: Endure
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. If a Physical or Special Move would cause the user to faint, they remain at 1 HP instead, remove this effect afterwards. The effect re-activates on the user's next Turn. Whole Round duration.
move.description: The Pokémon mentally prepares to receive a fatal blow, their spirit is stronger than their body so they endure to keep on fighting for as long as possible.

move.name: Reversal
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool for every missing HP the User has. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The user gathers their mettle to block away the pain and focus only on hitting harder.

move.name: Superpower
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Reduce by 1 the User's Strength and Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon packs all their power in a single crushing strike. All this effort leaves them quite tired afterwards.

name: Torracat
description: The bell on its neck glows and chimes when it shoots fire through it. Although it acts spoiled with its trainer, it is a capable and relentless brawler. It will keep battling until its foes lose their fighting spirits.

abilityOne.name: Blaze
abilityOne.description: The inner and outer fire on this Pokemon's body will burn incredibly fierce just before fading.
abilityOne.effect: Pain Penalization won't reduce successes from Accuracy or Damage rolls of Fire-Type Moves used by this Pokemon. Fire-Type Moves get 2 Extra dice to their Damage Pool when this Pokemon is at half HP or less.

abilityTwo.name: Intimidate
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon has an overwhelming presence that inspires both fear and respect from others.
abilityTwo.effect: When this Pokemon comes into battle, Reduce by 1 the Strength of All foes in Range. This effect will last for as long as this Pokemon is out. Outside of battle, wild Pokemon will avoid the party if this Pokemon is out.

move.name: Scratch
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their sharp claws to scratch the enemy. Nothing fancy but it works.

move.name: Growl
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Reduce by 1 the Strength of those affected.
move.description: Either through a menacing attitude or an adorable demeanor, the foe will hesitate to attack the user at full power.

move.name: Roar
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 6. Switcher Move for the Foe. In the wild, the battle may end.
move.description: With a potent roar, to make the foe reconsider their intentions.

move.name: Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe
move.description: The user lands a vicious bite, leaving an ugly bruise.

move.name: Scary Face
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: When a Pokémon looks at you like THAT, you know you gotta thread carefully around them.

move.name: Fake Out
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Flinch the Target. This Move will only work on the First Round the User is out in battle. from the Second Round on, it will fail automatically.
move.description: The Pokémon pretends to be getting ready for the battle when they are actually prepairing a surprise attack on the foe.

move.name: Nasty Plot
move.effect: Target Self. Increase User's Special by 2.
move.description: Rubbing both hands and laughing sinisterly the Pokémon rejoices in the evil plans they’ll soon carry out.

move.name: Fire Pledge
move.effect: Area Move. This Effect Targets the Battle Field: At the End of the Round, Roll 2 Dice of Fire-Type Damage to everyone without immunity to Ground on the field ignoring defenses. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The Pokémon chants to invoke the power of fire, their pledge is heard and the flames come forward to aid them in battle.

move.name: Leer
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The vicious glare of a predator that triggers the flight response of their prey.

move.name: Ember
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: A basic fire attack, but not any less dangerous. Even a small flame can grow out of control.

move.name: Lick
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon licks the foe. The foe is deeply disturbed by this creepy display of “affection”.

move.name: Fury Swipes
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions.
move.description: With their sharp claws, the Pokémon will swiftly scatch their foe, leaving its face full of small cuts.

move.name: Double Kick
move.effect: Single Target. Double Action.
move.description: The good old one-two but with a twist.

move.name: Fire Fang
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Bite Move. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon bites the foe with their mouth ablaze, tearing and searing their foe’s flesh in a single attack.

move.name: Swagger
move.effect: Single Target. Increase the Target's Strength by 2. Confuse the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon’s arrogant and mocking attitude enrage their foe and make it lose focus in battle.

move.name: Flamethrower
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 2nd Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: The most emblematic fire attack, a seeminly endless stream of fire that reduces everything and everyone to ashes.

move.name: Thrash
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
move.description: The Pokémon becomes a wild thing and the rumpus has started.

move.name: Outrage
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
move.description: The true nature of dragon-types unleashed. The user is consumed by a primal fury that won’t stop until everything has ben razed to the ground. Afterwards the Pokémon is confused.

move.name: Flare Blitz
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil. Roll 1 Chance die to inflict 3rd Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: A reckless blazing charge against their foe, ends up with an explosive collision

name: Vanillite
description: These Pokémon were born from icicles bathed in the energy of the morning sun. It uses snow to cover its head and protect it from melting. They are playful and love to make snow fall around them.

abilityOne.name: Ice Body
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon's body is almost frozen, and can cool down enclosed areas in a few minutes. It feels most comfortable when temperatures are below zero.
abilityOne.effect: If Hail/Snow Weather is active, you may restore 1 HP to this Pokemon at the end of the Round. This Pokemon is immune to damage from Hail weather.

abilityTwo.name: Snow Cloak
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon's skin blends well with the surrounding snow and hail, you can barely see it.
abilityTwo.effect: While Hail/Snow Weather is active, this Pokemon can use the Evasion Maneuver up to 5 times per Round. The Pokemon is immune to damage from Hail/Snow weather.

hiddenAbility.name: Weak Armor
hiddenAbility.description: This Pokemon's protective outer layers can come off, allowing it to move freely and be more agile.
hiddenAbility.effect: The first time this Pokemon is hit by any Physical Move, Increase its Dexterity Attribute by 1 and Reduce its Defense by 1.

move.name: Harden
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 1.
move.description: When life gets hard, do the same.

move.name: Avalanche
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 4. *If the User received damage from the target during this Turn add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool. *If Snowy Weather is active add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.
move.description: The user covers themselves with a heavy snow coat, if anything disturbs the snow, it will fall like a heavy avalanche.

move.name: Acid Armor
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
move.description: Highly acidic goop oozes through the pores of this Pokémon. Touching it immediately causes a burning pain. Preventing foes from getting too close.

move.name: Mirror Coat
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 5. Can only be used if Target's last Move on User was a Special Move. For damage, roll dice equal to Target's last damage pool rolled against the User plus 2. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The user gathers the harmful energies around themselves and bounces them back to their source.

move.name: Blizzard
move.effect: All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Wind Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Freeze those affected. *Sunny Weather increases to Low Accuracy 4. **Hail/Snowy Weather remove Low Accuracy and adds the effect "Never Miss".
move.description: The user summons a turbulent and gelid wind that feels like ice daggers. A pleasant day may make it difficult to call upon, but beware if the temperatures go below zero.

move.name: Ice Shard
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Ranged.
move.description: With extraordinary swiftness, the Pokémon shoots an ice bullet like the fastest gun in the North Pole.

move.name: Autotomize
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Dexterity by 2. Halve the User's weight.
move.description: Rotating parts and tiny gears, the Pokémon works like a welloiled machine.

move.name: Water Pulse
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target.
move.description: The user sends out a pulsing ring of water that blasts the foe with ultrasonic waves. For a while, everything seems as if reflected in the water ripples.

move.name: Astonish
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe.
move.description: The user sneaks behind their target to jump scare them.

move.name: Mist
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Targets cannot have their Attributes or Traits Reduced. Previously Reduced Attributes and Traits remain. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A thick layer of mist cloaks a pack of pokémon, those with the intent to trick and weaken them will have to find them first.

move.name: Taunt
move.effect: Single Target. The Target cannot perform Support Moves (Support Maneuvers may still be performed). Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: Through tease and mockery, the foe is enraged to the point it stops thinking clearly.

move.name: Icy Wind
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Wind Move. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: Polar winds sweep through the arena. Everyone starts to shiver and embrace themselves, trying to preserve a bit of warmth.

move.name: Hail
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Activate Hail Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The skies turn gray, and loud thunder rumbles, but what falls is not a gentle drizzle, but an endless stream of ice shards coming down at high speeds. Find shelter!

move.name: Icicle Spear
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Successive Actions.
move.description: A barrage of icicles shot against the target. They are small but sharp and pointy

move.name: Uproar
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Sound Move. This Effect Targets the Battle Field: Pokemon will be cured of the Sleep Status. Duration 1 Round.
move.description: Shouts, screams, and loud music... What does a Pokémon have to do here for a peaceful night of sleep?

move.name: Mirror Shot
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target.
move.description: Through a series of reflective surfaces, the Pokémon redirects a beam through unexpected directions. The foe is at a loss; they don’t know if what they see is real or a reflection.

move.name: Ice Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Freeze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a cold beam that reduces all warmth on the environment up to freezing point.

move.name: Sheer Cold
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 5. Ranged. Deal Damage to the Target equal to its Remaining HP, plus 1 Lethal Damage.
move.description: The Pokémon reaches an absolute zero by being freezed from the inside out. Urgent medical attention is required.

name: Wormadam (Grass Form)
description: When Burmy evolved, its Grass cloak became a part of its body. For this reason there are many variations in body and type. It is a calm Pokémon that loves flowers. This Pokémon is female-only.

abilityOne.name: Anticipation
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon is always alert for threats and rarely sits to relax. If it perceives a potential danger it will get anxious and start shuddering.
abilityOne.effect: If any foe knows a Move that would deal Lethal or Super Effective damage against this Pokemon, it will alert its Trainer.

abilityTwo.name: Overcoat
abilityTwo.description: The Pokemon will have a protective coat surrounding its body that allows it to live under extreme weather conditions.
abilityTwo.effect: This Pokemon won't recieve damage from active weather.

move.name: Protect
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokemon would receive from a Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Moves that target the user.
move.description: A mighty energy shield materializes in front of the user to to deflect attacks and dispel ill effects.

move.name: Captivate
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 2 the Special of those affected.
move.description: The Pokémon shows off their attractiveness and even flirts with the opponents, those who fall for their charms can’t keep focus on the battle.

move.name: Flail
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of this Move for every missing Point of HP the user has. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The user flails around trying to stay alive, as they get closer to fainting, more adrenaline will fuel their efforts of survival.

move.name: Confusion
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Confuse the Target.
move.description: A basic mental assault that makes the foe believe they are being attacked by an invisible enemy.

move.name: Razor Leaf
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Cutter Move. Ranged. High Critical.
move.description: The user sends out a barrage of sharp razor-like leaves. “Death by a thousand cuts” would be the best depiction.

move.name: Growth
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Special. If the Sunny Weather is active, increase by 2 Instead.
move.description: The Pokémon makes their body grow in size. They’ll get bigger and stronger in just a few seconds.

move.name: Quiver Dance
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Dexterity, Special an Sp. Defense.
move.description: A mystical and beautiful dance that increases a Pokémon focus in combat.

move.name: Sucker Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 6. *This move can only be used as a Late Reaction; and only if the Target used a Physical or Special Move, otherwise it will fail.
move.description: The Pokémon takes advantage of their foe preparing to attack to unleash a dirty surprise blow.

move.name: Attract
move.effect: Single Target. Target is now In Love with the User.
move.description: Through their good looks and coquetish attitude, the Pokémon makes everyone develop a crush on them.

move.name: Psychic
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: The most iconic Psychic attack, the foe starts floating in the air and its swayed around by telekinesis as their mental barrier crumbles.

move.name: Synthesis
move.effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will Point to activate. If Sunny Weather is in effect, this Move becomes a Complete Heal. If performed under Rain, Sandstorm, Hail or Snowy Weather, this Move is a Minor heal and only heals 1 HP.
move.description: The Pokémon gathers sunlight to re-energize themselves.

move.name: Electroweb
move.effect: Target All foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: An electrified web is shot towards the target, shoking and tangling them at the same time.

move.name: Giga Drain
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The Pokémon drains most of the foe’s vital energy and feeds on the nutrients it managed to extract.

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Bug Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. If the target Pokemon is holding a berry, the User eats it and gains its effects.
move.description: The Pokémon nibbles at their foe in hopes of finding something tasty to snack on.

move.name: String Shot
move.effect: Targets All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: The foe gets tangled in a fine silk string shot by the user. This silk can also be used to make fine clothes.

move.name: Struggle Bug
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Special of those affected.
move.description: The Pokémon sends a distress signal through its antennae to interrupt the foe’s concentration.

move.name: Psybeam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Confuse the Target.
move.description: The foe’s mind isassaulted by a mental ray, afterwards they may suffer from hallucinations.

move.name: Hidden Power
move.effect: Single Target. This Move will always deal Super-Effective Damage against the Target. If used by the Pokemon #201 Unown. See p. 530
move.description: Inside every Pokémon lies the key to unlock all kinds of power.

move.name: Leaf Storm
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Reduce the User's Special by 2.
move.description: A furious onslaught of sharp leaves blasting against the target. The user gives their all in this attack.

move.name: Bug Buzz
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce by 1 the Sp. Defense of those affected.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their wings or a part of their bodies to emit distracting buzzes all around.

move.name: Infestation
move.effect: Single Target. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion.
move.description: The Pokémon summons a bothersome swarm to prevent the foe from escaping. The swarm will relentlessly attack the foe.

name: Servine
description: It moves by slithering along the ground. Its swift movements befuddle its foes before it attacks with a vine whip. It always keeps itself clean and it demands care from its trainer, otherwise it will misbehave.

abilityOne.name: Overgrow
abilityOne.description: When this Pokemon is hurt, it will grow huge plants on its body to defend itself, these plants are very strong but wither quickly.
abilityOne.effect: Pain Penalization won't reduce successes from Accuracy or Damage rolls of Grass-Type Moves used by this Pokemon. Grass-Type Moves get 2 Extra dice to their Damage Pool when this Pokemon is at half HP or less.

abilityTwo.name: Contrary
abilityTwo.description: Most of the time this pokemon will want to do the opposite of what you want. Sometimes it even contradicts itself.
abilityTwo.effect: If anything would reduce an Attribute of this Pokemon, increase it instead. If anything would increase an Attribute of this Pokemon, reduce it instead.

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Leer
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The vicious glare of a predator that triggers the flight response of their prey.

move.name: Vine Whip
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses its body vines to give the foe a good smack. These vines can be as long as 20 feet and quite surdy as ropes.

move.name: Wrap
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion.
move.description: The Pokémon swiftly entangles their foe in a squeezing lock to prevent their escape.

move.name: Growth
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Special. If the Sunny Weather is active, increase by 2 Instead.
move.description: The Pokémon makes their body grow in size. They’ll get bigger and stronger in just a few seconds.

move.name: Leaf Tornado
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Reduce 1 Success from all Accuracy Rolls of the foe.
move.description: A cluster of leaves and twigs swirls around the foe, getting in its eyes and making it difficult to aim properly

move.name: Giga Drain
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The Pokémon drains most of the foe’s vital energy and feeds on the nutrients it managed to extract.

move.name: Grass Pledge
move.effect: Area Move. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected. This Effect Targets the Battle Field: Entry Hazard. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of Target's that enter the battlefield. Pokemon with Immunity to Ground are not affected.
move.description: The Pokémon chants to invoke the power of grass, their pledge is heard and the ground crumbles as vegetation grapples and traps everyone in the field.

move.name: Synthesis
move.effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will Point to activate. If Sunny Weather is in effect, this Move becomes a Complete Heal. If performed under Rain, Sandstorm, Hail or Snowy Weather, this Move is a Minor heal and only heals 1 HP.
move.description: The Pokémon gathers sunlight to re-energize themselves.

move.name: Twister
move.effect: Target all foes in Range. Wind Move. Roll 2 Chance dice to Flinch those affected. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop" this Move hits anyways.
move.description: A raging twister embedded with a dragon’s fury. No one wants to be trapped in this fearsome spiral, which almost touches the sky.

move.name: Leech Seed
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Spend 1 Will point to activate. At the end of each Round, Roll 2 Dice of Typeless Damage against the target ignoring defenses. The User heals 1 HP for every damage dealt this way. Grass-Type Pokémon are immune to this Effect. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The foe is infected with seed saplings taking root on their body. As the saplings grow, they'll absorb the vital energy of the foe and send it back to the user.

move.name: Mega Drain
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The user absorbs a big amount of vital energy and nutrients from the target to feed from.

move.name: Slam
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1.
move.description: Everybody get up, it’s time to slam now.

move.name: Leaf Blade
move.effect: Single Target. High Critical. Lethal. Cutter Move.
move.description: Danger lies not on the material’s toughness but on its edge’s sharpness.

move.name: Coil
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Defense score and Accuracy Pools.
move.description: The Pokémon curls up into themselves. Foes soon realize this is not the position of a prey in hiding, but of a hunter about to spit their venom.

move.name: Wring Out
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. *Remove 1 Dice from the Damage Pool for every missing HP on the target. Up to 4 Dice may be removed this way.
move.description: The Pokémon quite literally squeezes the life out of their foe. But to do this effectively they require to be in top condition.

move.name: Gastro Acid
move.effect: Single Target. Negate any effect the Target's Ability would have. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The user spews their gastric juices on the foe. It’s so disgusting the foe can only concentrate on getting cleaned ASAP

move.name: Leaf Storm
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Reduce the User's Special by 2.
move.description: A furious onslaught of sharp leaves blasting against the target. The user gives their all in this attack.

name: Totodile
description: Despite its small body, Totodile's jaws are very powerful. While it may think it is just playfully nipping, its bite has enough strength to cause a serious injury. It needs proper discipline to control its biting urges.

abilityOne.name: Torrent
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon builds up pressure to shoot water streams. When that pressure cannot be held in, it is released through uncontrollable torrents.
abilityOne.effect: Pain Penalization won't reduce successes from Accuracy or Damage rolls of Water-Type Moves used by this Pokemon. Water-Type Moves get 2 Extra dice to their Damage Pool when this Pokemon is at half HP or less.

abilityTwo.name: Sheer Force
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon is only interested in showing off its incredible battle prowess.
abilityTwo.effect: Whenever this Pokemon uses a Physical or Special Move with Added Effects, you may choose to ignore them and add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool instead. Added Effects from Items trigger this effect but do not stack.

move.name: Scratch
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their sharp claws to scratch the enemy. Nothing fancy but it works.

move.name: Water Gun
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The fastest water gun in town. No enemy will remain dry

move.name: Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe
move.description: The user lands a vicious bite, leaving an ugly bruise.

move.name: Scary Face
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: When a Pokémon looks at you like THAT, you know you gotta thread carefully around them.

move.name: Ice Fang
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Bite Move. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Freeze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon bites their foe with sharp teeth and a geli breath to chill their bones directly

move.name: Flail
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of this Move for every missing Point of HP the user has. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The user flails around trying to stay alive, as they get closer to fainting, more adrenaline will fuel their efforts of survival.

move.name: Crunch
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Lethal. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the foe's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon viciously mauls, tears, and rips apart anything its fangs can come in contact with.

move.name: Slash
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical. Cutter Move.
move.description: The Pokémon uses the sharpest part of their body as a blade to tear and slash with vicious intent.

move.name: Thrash
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
move.description: The Pokémon becomes a wild thing and the rumpus has started.

move.name: Aqua Jet
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1.
move.description: The Pokémon propels themselves with a jet of pressured water.

move.name: Fake Tears
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce foe's Sp. Defense by 2.
move.description: The user stops mid-combat to start crying; feeling incredibly guilty, the foe lowers its guard.

move.name: Water Pledge
move.effect: Area Move. This Effect Targets the Battlefield: Add 2 Dice to all Chance Dice rolls of everyone in the field. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The Pokémon chants to invoke the power of water. Moisture in the air bends the light to create a rainbow to bring good fortune. Everyone in the field feels luckier for a while.

move.name: Tail Whip
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The Pokémon whips their tail in such an adorable way the foes let their guard down.

move.name: Mud Slap
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.
move.description: A mud ball splatters right into the foe’s face, reducing their field of vision.

move.name: Rage
move.effect: Single Target. If a foe damages the User with a Physical or Special Move in the same round after using this Move. Increase the User's Strength by 1. This effect can stack up to 3 Times.
move.description: The user gets angry and throws a tantrum against the foe. The more the battle continues the angrier the user gets.

move.name: Chip Away
move.effect: Single Target. Ignore Cover & Substitute decoys. Ignore Defenses. Remove effects that increase Evasion Actions from the Target (ie Moves like: Double Team, Minimize. Abilities like: Sand Veil)
move.description: Bit by bit the Pokémon finds an opening though all layers of defense their target has until there is nothing left to protect it from a direct strike.

move.name: Low Kick
move.effect: Single Target. Add 1 Extra Damage Dice for every 50kg of the weight on the foe, up to 4 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The Pokémon uses a kick to the sheen to throw the foe into the ground. The bigger they are, the harder they fall.

move.name: Screech
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Reduce the Target's Defense by 2.
move.description: A mighty screech will make the target cover its ears instead of covering its flanks.

move.name: Aqua Tail
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The user sways their tail to create a pocket whirlpool in which the foe gets sucked in by the spinning motion.

move.name: Superpower
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Reduce by 1 the User's Strength and Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon packs all their power in a single crushing strike. All this effort leaves them quite tired afterwards.

move.name: Hydro Pump
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2
move.description: Water works best under pressure.

name: Trevenant
description: Using its roots as a nervous system, it controls the trees in the forest. It's kind to the Pokémon that reside inside its body, but it is ruthless to anyone that harms its forest, turning them into haunted trees forever.

abilityOne.name: Natural Cure
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon's body will generate substances to heal itself. They can be used to create medicine.
abilityOne.effect: At the end of the Round, if this Pokemon has a Status Ailment or Condition, Roll 3 Chance Dice to heal it.

abilityTwo.name: Harvest
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon will naturally produce edible fruits in a short period of time, if fed with berries it will start growing them too.
abilityTwo.effect: If this Pokemon uses a berry as a held item during a fight, the berry will grow back at the end of the battle.

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Will-O-Wisp
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target. Using this Move against the same Target increases the Burn Degree.
move.description: The user calls upon an eerie blue flame made with the souls of the departed. They appear harmless until they have you surrounded.

move.name: Grudge
move.effect: Single Target. The User Faints. Reduce the Target's Will to 0 points and reset any effect it got from spending them. Roll Target's Loyalty at the end of the round, increase difficulty by 1 each round. Failing this roll faints the Target.
move.description: The last words of this Pokémon imprint their grudge and anger over their foe. Depleting the foe of their will to carry on in this world.

move.name: Astonish
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe.
move.description: The user sneaks behind their target to jump scare them.

move.name: Branch Poke
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon rudely starts poking its foe with a stick.

move.name: Leech Seed
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Spend 1 Will point to activate. At the end of each Round, Roll 2 Dice of Typeless Damage against the target ignoring defenses. The User heals 1 HP for every damage dealt this way. Grass-Type Pokémon are immune to this Effect. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The foe is infected with seed saplings taking root on their body. As the saplings grow, they'll absorb the vital energy of the foe and send it back to the user.

move.name: Confuse Ray
move.effect: Single Target. Confuse the Target.
move.description: The user flashes a sinister ray of bright light that others cannot help but go straight into it.

move.name: Hex
move.effect: Single Target. *If the Target has an active Status Condition, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move.
move.description: The user casts a terrible hex over the target, the effects will be greater if the target is already burdened by an ailment.

move.name: Growth
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Special. If the Sunny Weather is active, increase by 2 Instead.
move.description: The Pokémon makes their body grow in size. They’ll get bigger and stronger in just a few seconds.

move.name: Feint Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Never Miss.
move.description: The user approaches inconspicuously, pretending to attack the foe directly, then actually hits the foe from behind.

move.name: Horn Leech
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The user rams into the foe and uses the leaves growing on their horns to absorb nutrients from it.

move.name: Curse
move.effect: Single Target. Roll half of the User's HP as Typeless Damage Dice to itself, ignoring defenses. The Target will remove 1 success from all of their Rolls until the Curse if lifted.
move.description: The user mutters an evil incantation, misery will befall into the foe at the cost of the user’s soul. To get rid of the curse, perform an exorcism or get help at a Pokémon Center

move.name: Ingrain
move.effect: Target Self. The User heals 1 HP at the end of each Round. Spend 1 Will point to activate. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The Pokémon roots themselves to absorb nutrients directly from the ground.

move.name: Imprison
move.effect: Target Self. While the User is on the battlefield, Moves known by the User cannot be used by foes. This effect ends if the User is removed from battle.
move.description: This move blocks all shared parts of a memory the user is well aware of. Moves, techniques, names, places, people or situations, no one will be able to recall those imprisoned memories.

move.name: Disable
move.effect: Single Target. Disable the last Move performed by the Target. Only one Move may be Disabled at a time.
move.description: The Pokémon finds the right nerve to pull that will render a foe useless to perform their best Move.

move.name: Shadow Claw
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their ghostly claws to slash through their foe’s body tearing not their flesh but their soul directly.

move.name: Brutal Swing
move.effect: Target All foes in Range. Lethal.
move.description: The Pokémon starts attacking at full force with its claws, anyone unfortunate enough to be in its path will end up severely wounded.

move.name: Phantom Force
move.effect: Single Target. Charge move. Out of Range while Charging. Lethal. Ignore any Cover, Shield Moves, and/or Force Fields active on the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon disappears into a dark dimension to infiltrate even the most impenetrable fortress. It may reappear during its next action.

move.name: Wood Hammer
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil.
move.description: The Pokémon creates a giant wooden hamer and it uses it to smash the foe with such force the hammer also explodes into wood splinters.

move.name: Destiny Bond
move.effect: Target Self. If the user faints this Round due to damage frm a Physical or Special Move, the Pokemon who dealt the damage is dealt damage equal to their remaining Hp. This Move will fail if it was used the previous Round.
move.description: Through a mystical bond, everyone who brings disgrace to this Pokémon will suffer the exact same fate.

move.name: Forest's Curse
move.effect: Single Target. Add the Grass Type to the Target's Type. (ie Pikachu will now be "Electric/Grass", Charizard will not be "Fire/Flying/Grass") If the Target already has a third Type attached, replace it.
move.description: The user lays the forest’scurse upon the target, causing roots and branches to grow on its body until they are a haunted tree. Perform an exorcism or get to a Pokémon Center ASAP

move.name: Venom Drench
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. *If the affected are already Poisoned or becomes Poisoned in the same Round this Move was used, Reduce by 1 their Strength, Special and Dexterity.
move.description: The user weakens the foe’s already compromised immune systems.

move.name: Trick Room
move.effect: Target the Battlefield. Invert the order of Initiative. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: Reality inside the battlefielfield is distorted, time bends and flows differently for everyone. Those who don’t rush through manage to adapt easier.

name: Swanna
description: Swanna come out to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock. Despite their elegant and frail appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles.

abilityOne.name: Big Pecks
abilityOne.description: This tenacious Pokemon uses its beak to cover its weak spots.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon cannot have its Defense reduced.

abilityTwo.name: Hydration
abilityTwo.description: The body of the Pokemon absorbs water and uses its moisture to maintain a healthy state.
abilityTwo.effect: When Rain weather is active, this Pokemon will cure all Status Ailments and Conditions it is affected with at the end of the round.

move.name: Water Gun
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The fastest water gun in town. No enemy will remain dry

move.name: Water Sport
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Physical & Special Fire-Type Moves have Power 0. Pokemon weak to Fire-Type Moves won't receive Super-Effective Damage from them. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A single drop of water can’t put off a raging fire, but what is the ocean but a collection of drops.

move.name: Defog
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Remove all Force Fields, Entry Hazards and Terrains (Misty Terrain, Electric Terrain, etc.) from the Battlefield.
move.description: A strong wind sweeps out the battle field, removing anything from bad weather to scattered objects and even invisible barriers.

move.name: Wing Attack
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: A classic flying technique, the user flies towards the foe and strikes using their wings.

move.name: Water Pulse
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target.
move.description: The user sends out a pulsing ring of water that blasts the foe with ultrasonic waves. For a while, everything seems as if reflected in the water ripples.

move.name: Aerial Ace
move.effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. Never Miss.
move.description: The Pokémon rises up in the air towards a light source, momentarily blinding the foe. then plummets quickly to attack the opponent

move.name: Bubble Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 1.
move.description: A powerful stream of foamy bubbles shot straight into the foe

move.name: Feather Dance
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Strength by 2.
move.description: A dance as soft as a feather. It soothes the hearts of the spectators and reduces all aggression.

move.name: Mud Sport
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Physical & Special Electric-Type Moves have Power 0. Pokemon weak to Electric-Type Moves won't receive Super-Effective Damage from them. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The user covers the whole field with mud. Electricity can’t flow properly, so Electric attacks will be severely impaired.

move.name: Fly
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Thunder / Twister / Sky Uppercut / Gust / Hurricane / Smack Down. Out of battle allows the Pokemon to fly long distances.
move.description: The Pokémon uses an action to fly up high, to asses the best angle to take a dive against the foe. Pokémon who know this Move can fly for long periods of time without rest.

move.name: Mirror Move
move.effect: Single Target. Copy Move. Unique Moves can't be copied. You may choose another Target(s) for the copied Move.
move.description: The Pokémon parrots the target cries and movements. In an almost perfect impersonation that manages to copy its powers.

move.name: Attract
move.effect: Single Target. Target is now In Love with the User.
move.description: Through their good looks and coquetish attitude, the Pokémon makes everyone develop a crush on them.

move.name: Icy Wind
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Wind Move. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: Polar winds sweep through the arena. Everyone starts to shiver and embrace themselves, trying to preserve a bit of warmth.

move.name: Aqua Ring
move.effect: Target Self. The User heals 1 HP at the end of each Round. Spend 1 Will point to activate. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The Pokémon coats themselves in fresh water.

move.name: Air Slash
move.effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: A compressed wind-slash, the change of pressure knocks out the target momentarily

move.name: Roost
move.effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Remove the User's Immunity to Ground-Type Moves. Duration 1 Round.
move.description: The Pokémon gathers some twigs and builds themselves a comfy nest on the floor to roost and relax.

move.name: Rain Dance
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Activate Rain Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The Pokémon performs a peculiar dance in the middle of the field, everyone thinks it silly until the first thunder rumbles.

move.name: Brine
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 3 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool if the Target is at half HP or less.
move.description: A splash of sea water that literally adds more and more salt to the foe’s wounds.

move.name: Lucky Chant
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Unique. Targets can Re-roll one un-successful die from all their rolls. Critical Hits do not grant Bonus dice against the Targets. Whole Scene Duration. Out of battle, good things happen at Storyteller's Discretion.
move.description: The magical incantation of an old priestess, through dance and song, good fortune and divine protection will come to you. This Move also removes evil spirits and curses.

move.name: Tailwind
move.effect: Target User's side of the Field. Wind Move. Increase by 2 the Dexterity of everyone on the User's side of the field. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: Flying Pokémon know better than anyone how to use the wind in their favor. Let its draft carry you to victory.

move.name: Brave Bird
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil.
move.description: Back in the day humans relied on birds to send their messages and even go to war. Many earned medals for bravery.

move.name: Hurricane
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Wind Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target. Rain Weather eliminates Low Accuracy. Sunny Weather increases to Low Accuracy 4. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop", this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The Pokémon calls upon fierce gale winds. It’ll be difficult to summon the tempest on a clear day, but a little rain will enhance it into a typhoon. Other pokémon in the air are in most danger.

move.name: Liquidation
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Reduce the Target's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon strikes while bursting a full-force blast of pressurized water. The water may cut or dent through the target’s armor.

move.name: Secret Power
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Inflict Status determined by the environment or active Terrain. See more on p. 530
move.description: There’s energy all around us, hidden secretly in the most incospicuous places. This Move makes use of that energy bringing the secret to light.

name: Trumbeak
description: This Pokémon bends its beak to produce a variety of sounds, much to the annoyance of the neighbors. It also shoots a burst of berry seeds at its foes, prey, or an unsuspecting passerby.

abilityOne.name: Keen Eye
abilityOne.description: These Pokemon have an exceptional sight. Locating small or far away objects is a lot easier for them.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon cannot have successes removed from its Accuracy rolls by Moves, Items or Abilities.

abilityTwo.name: Skill Link
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon can proficiently chain a flurry of attacks and it is one heck of a juggler. It also enjoys repetition and sequences.
abilityTwo.effect: Add 2 Extra Dice to the Accuracy roll of all Double, Triple, or Successive Actions this Pokemon use.

hiddenAbility.name: Pickup
hiddenAbility.description: This Pokemon will often gather objects and keep a small hoard of treasure it may share with you.
hiddenAbility.effect: If this Pokemon was out of its Pokeball, at the end of the scene see what it found for you at Storyteller's discretion. The higher the Rank of this Pokemon the more valuable the items it will find.

move.name: Growl
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Reduce by 1 the Strength of those affected.
move.description: Either through a menacing attitude or an adorable demeanor, the foe will hesitate to attack the user at full power.

move.name: Peck
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: Raise crows and they’ll peck your foe’s eyes.

move.name: Rock Smash
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Reduce the Target's Defense by 1.
move.description: A hit powerful enough to destroy rocks and crack armor.

move.name: Echoed Voice
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. This Move can be used many times in the same Round. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage pool of this move for each time you use it. Up to 8 Dice might be added this way. Reset this effect if the user performs another move, evasion or clash.
move.description: The Pokémon yells at the void. Their echo answers. The Pokémon yells louder and louder everytime the echo talks back.

move.name: Supersonic
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Sound Move. Confuse the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a series of ultrasonic waves that mess with the foe by making it feel dizzy and disoriented.

move.name: Pluck
move.effect: Single Target. *If the Target is holding a Berry, Add 1 Die to the Damage pool of this Move. The User also eats the berry and gains its effects.
move.description: The Pokémon lands on top of the foe and starts pecking them in search for parasites or some other tasty treat to snack on.

move.name: Roost
move.effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Remove the User's Immunity to Ground-Type Moves. Duration 1 Round.
move.description: The Pokémon gathers some twigs and builds themselves a comfy nest on the floor to roost and relax.

move.name: Fury Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions.
move.description: The Pokémon attacks in a fury, their attacks are uncoordinated but relentless.

move.name: Drill Peck
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal.
move.description: A bird has no fangs, yet they can still can tear flesh.

move.name: Bullet Seed
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Successive Actions. Projectile Moves.
move.description: The Pokémon starts shooting seed as if they were a machine gun.

move.name: Feather Dance
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Strength by 2.
move.description: A dance as soft as a feather. It soothes the hearts of the spectators and reduces all aggression.

move.name: Uproar
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Sound Move. This Effect Targets the Battle Field: Pokemon will be cured of the Sleep Status. Duration 1 Round.
move.description: Shouts, screams, and loud music... What does a Pokémon have to do here for a peaceful night of sleep?

move.name: Tailwind
move.effect: Target User's side of the Field. Wind Move. Increase by 2 the Dexterity of everyone on the User's side of the field. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: Flying Pokémon know better than anyone how to use the wind in their favor. Let its draft carry you to victory.

move.name: Mirror Move
move.effect: Single Target. Copy Move. Unique Moves can't be copied. You may choose another Target(s) for the copied Move.
move.description: The Pokémon parrots the target cries and movements. In an almost perfect impersonation that manages to copy its powers.

move.name: Screech
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Reduce the Target's Defense by 2.
move.description: A mighty screech will make the target cover its ears instead of covering its flanks.

move.name: Rock Blast
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged. Successive Actions. Projectile Move.
move.description: A rock shrapnel, the user shoots tiny bullet-like pebbles.

move.name: Fly
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Thunder / Twister / Sky Uppercut / Gust / Hurricane / Smack Down. Out of battle allows the Pokemon to fly long distances.
move.description: The Pokémon uses an action to fly up high, to asses the best angle to take a dive against the foe. Pokémon who know this Move can fly for long periods of time without rest.

move.name: Flame Charge
move.effect: Single Target. Increase the User's Dexterity by 1.
