abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon will bring good luck as if it was blessed by the heavens. Its presence is soothing, it makes you feel calm and full of joy.
abilityTwo.effect: This Pokemon adds 2 Extra Chance Dice to all Moves with effects that use them. (e.g. A move has 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the foe, this Pokemon will roll 5 Dice)

move.name: Heal Bell
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Sound Move. Cure any Status Ailment on the Targets.
move.description: The soothing chime of a magical bell cleanses all impurities.

move.name: Seismic Toss
move.effect: Single Target. Roll Fight-Type Damage Dice according to the User's Rank: Starter 1 Die / Rookie 2 Dice / Standard 4 Dice/ Advacned 6 Dice / Expert 8 Dice / Ace and forward 10 Dice. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The foe gets launched up to the sky, then falls face-first into the ground making it tremble. The stronger the user, the higher the launch.

move.name: Present
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. *Target rolls 1 die with a 50-50 chance of dealing 2 Set Damage to the Target or Restoring 2 HP to the Target.
move.description: The user hands out a lovely present box. Time to find out if the foe has been naugthy or nice

move.description: The Pokémon whips their tail in such an adorable way the foes let their guard down.

name: Darmanitan
description: This Pokémon is shrouded in mystery. Old writings and mural paintings describe it as being blue and using psychic powers, but years of study have not seen these traits in this Pokémon, which relies on brute force.

abilityOne.name: Sheer Force
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon is only interested in showing off its incredible battle prowess.
abilityOne.effect: Whenever this Pokemon uses a Physical or Special Move with Added Effects, you may choose to ignore them and add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool instead. Added Effects from Items trigger this effect but do not stack.

abilityTwo.name: Zen Mode
abilityTwo.description: Under extreme stress, this Pokemon will unlock its hidden psychic abilities through the power of meditation, it will go back to normal the next day.
abilityTwo.effect: Only Darmanitan may use this Ability. When at half or less of its HP, change to Zen Mode Form at the end of the Round. Use its Zen Mode Form from then on. Adjust its Attributes according to the Rank and Limits it has for each Form. Unique Ability.

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Rage
move.effect: Single Target. If a foe damages the User with a Physical or Special Move in the same round after using this Move. Increase the User's Strength by 1. This effect can stack up to 3 Times.
move.description: The user gets angry and throws a tantrum against the foe. The more the battle continues the angrier the user gets.

move.name: Headbutt
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Out of battle it may cause a Random encounter when hitting trees and make objects drop from high places.
move.description: The Pokémon rams against their foe with their head. This Move is perfect to shake down trees when looking for berries, but beware of wild Pokémon nesting at the treetops.

move.name: Work Up
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Special.
move.description: The Pokémon has spent a lot of time training and doesn’t miss the chance to show off their muscles and fitness. After the battle they share routines and tips with the other Pokémon.

move.name: Thrash
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
move.description: The Pokémon becomes a wild thing and the rumpus has started.

move.name: Heat Wave
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 1. Wind Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 1st Degree Burn on those affected.
move.description: A large wave of extra-hot air that can set fire to everything it touches.

move.name: Ember
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: A basic fire attack, but not any less dangerous. Even a small flame can grow out of control.

move.name: Taunt
move.effect: Single Target. The Target cannot perform Support Moves (Support Maneuvers may still be performed). Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: Through tease and mockery, the foe is enraged to the point it stops thinking clearly.

move.name: Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe
move.description: The user lands a vicious bite, leaving an ugly bruise.

move.name: Incinerate
move.effect: Single Target. All Foes in Range. Destroy the held item of those affected.
move.description: A small blast of fire that instantly consumes small flammable objects.

move.name: Fire Fang
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Bite Move. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon bites the foe with their mouth ablaze, tearing and searing their foe’s flesh in a single attack.

move.name: Rollout
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions. *If all 5 actions land successfully, add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of the last hit of this Move. If the Pokemon used the Move "Defense Curl" in the same round, this Move's base Power becomes 2.
move.description: When the foe sees this Pokémon rollin’ they’ll be hatin’.

move.name: Yawn
move.effect: Single Target. *If the Target has not been removed from battle at the beginning of the next Round, put it to Sleep.
move.description: The user yawns, the foe yawns, the trainers yawn... everyone should take a nap.

move.name: Fire Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 2nd Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: A fist powered by the fiery spirit of combat, the heat of the battle lights of for real as the punch hits the foe right where it hurts!

move.name: Uproar
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Sound Move. This Effect Targets the Battle Field: Pokemon will be cured of the Sleep Status. Duration 1 Round.
move.description: Shouts, screams, and loud music... What does a Pokémon have to do here for a peaceful night of sleep?

move.name: Facade
move.effect: Single Target. *If the User has a Status Ailment (Paralysis, Poison, Burn, etc.) Add 3 Extra Dice to the Damage pool.
move.description: The Pokémon puts on a brave face through the most difficult of situations.

move.name: Belly Drum
move.effect: Target Self. Roll half of the User's HP as Typeless Damage Dice to itself, ignore defenses. Increase User's Strengt by 3.
move.description: With an angry war cry the user hits their belly as drums of war.

move.name: Fire Spin
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion.
move.description: The user creates a vortex of fire that remains spinning in the battlefield, trapping the foe within.

move.name: Hammer Arm
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Low Accuracy 1. Reduce User's Dexterity by 1.
move.description: Stop. Hammer Arm time!

move.name: Flare Blitz
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil. Roll 1 Chance die to inflict 3rd Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: A reckless blazing charge against their foe, ends up with an explosive collision

move.name: Superpower
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Reduce by 1 the User's Strength and Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon packs all their power in a single crushing strike. All this effort leaves them quite tired afterwards.

move.name: Overheat
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Lethal. Reduce User's Special by 2.
move.description: A furious scorching flame that turns everything on the user’s radius to ash. This incredible destructive display leaves the user exhausted.

move.name: Rock Slide
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch those affected.
move.description: Don’t worry, even if you are not the fastest one in the race, you can still win by a landslide.

name: Galvantula
description: They employ an electrically-charged web to trap their prey. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it. They usually live alone, but there have been cases of large swarms living together in caves.

abilityOne.name: Compound Eyes
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon has peripheral vision that allows it to locate its targets with great precision.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon gets 2 Extra Dice on the Accuracy Pool of any move with Low Accuracy.

abilityTwo.name: Swarm
abilityTwo.description: The Pokemon enters a hive mind state when its life is on the line, calling upon a swarm to aid it in battle.
abilityTwo.effect: Pain Penalization won't reduce successes from Accuracy or Damage rolls of Bug-Type Moves used by this Pokemon. Bug-Type Moves get 2 Extra dice to their Damage Pool when this Pokemon is at half HP or less.

move.name: Absorb
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The user takes nutrients from the nearest source of life they find.

move.name: String Shot
move.effect: Targets All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: The foe gets tangled in a fine silk string shot by the user. This silk can also be used to make fine clothes.

move.name: Spider Web
move.effect: Target Foe's Side of the Field. Entry Hazard. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The Pokémon moves stealthily and without raising suspicion. By the time the enemy realizes it, the entire field is covered in cobwebs.

move.name: Sticky Web
move.effect: Target's Foe's Side of the Field. Entry Hazard. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of Foes that enter the battlefield. Pokemon with Immunity to Ground are not affected.
move.description: The Pokémon quickly covers the arena with a sticky web, newly arrived foes will have trouble moving with ease.

move.name: Electroweb
move.effect: Target All foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: An electrified web is shot towards the target, shoking and tangling them at the same time.

move.name: Bug Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. If the target Pokemon is holding a berry, the User eats it and gains its effects.
move.description: The Pokémon nibbles at their foe in hopes of finding something tasty to snack on.

move.name: Agility
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: Swift of body, swift of mind.

move.name: Sucker Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 6. *This move can only be used as a Late Reaction; and only if the Target used a Physical or Special Move, otherwise it will fail.
move.description: The Pokémon takes advantage of their foe preparing to attack to unleash a dirty surprise blow.

move.name: Magnet Rise
move.effect: Target Self. The User gains Immunity against Ground-Type Moves. Whole Scene Duration
move.description: The Pokémon creates a magnetic field to repel themselves from the ground, allowing it to float for a short period of time.

move.name: Giga Drain
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The Pokémon drains most of the foe’s vital energy and feeds on the nutrients it managed to extract.

move.name: Fury Cutter
move.effect: Single Target. Successive Actions. Cutter Move.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their claws or scythes to rapidly cut as if shredding paper.

move.name: Infestation
move.effect: Single Target. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion.
move.description: The Pokémon summons a bothersome swarm to prevent the foe from escaping. The swarm will relentlessly attack the foe.

move.name: Thunder Wave
move.effect: Single Target. Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A series of electric waves hit the target, their voltage is too weak to cause much harm but muscles will get cramped for hours.

move.name: Electro Ball
move.effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of the user for every Point on Dexterity it has that surpasses the Foe's. Up to 4 Dice might be added this way.
move.description: An orb of electricity is hurled against the target, the faster the user dashes, the more momentum the orb gets.

move.name: Double Team
move.effect: Target Self. The User can now make up to 5 Evasions per Round.
move.description: The Pokémon moves so fast they create a series of shadow copies of themselves. Trying to guess which one is the real one is a pain.

move.name: Volt Switch
move.effect: Single Target. Switcher Move for the User.
move.description: The user shoots a wave of electric rings that allow it to reteat to safety at the speed of lightning.

move.name: Signal Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Confuse the foe.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a buzzing beam that leaves makes the foe head towards bright lights like a dazzled moth.

move.name: Slash
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical. Cutter Move.
move.description: The Pokémon uses the sharpest part of their body as a blade to tear and slash with vicious intent.

move.name: Discharge
move.effect: Area Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze those affected.
move.description: The user lets out an enormous discharge over the arena. Lightning does not distinguish friend from foe.

move.name: Screech
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Reduce the Target's Defense by 2.
move.description: A mighty screech will make the target cover its ears instead of covering its flanks.

move.name: Cross Poison
move.effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. High Critical. Roll 1 Chance Die to Poison the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon releases a powerful acidic gas that melts all inorganic matter in seconds.

move.name: Bug Buzz
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce by 1 the Sp. Defense of those affected.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their wings or a part of their bodies to emit distracting buzzes all around.

move.name: Gastro Acid
move.effect: Single Target. Negate any effect the Target's Ability would have. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The user spews their gastric juices on the foe. It’s so disgusting the foe can only concentrate on getting cleaned ASAP

move.name: Thunder
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target. Rain Weather eliminates Low Accuracy. Sunny Weather increases it to Low Accuracy 4. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce", or "Sky Drop" this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The Pokémon commands the skies to send a giant lightning bolt to a specific point. Difficult to command under clear skies, lethal during a storm. Flying Pokémon are specially vulnerable.

move.name: Bounce
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Thunder / Twister / Sky Uppercut / Gust / Hurricane / Smack Down. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon jumps at least 30 feet in the air before landing with a mighty stomp on top of the foe. While in the air it is safe from most treaths but its still vulnerable to bad weather.

name: Flapple
description: It grew inside a sour apple, and thus developed an acid that can cause chemical burns. It uses the discarded apple skin to fly or disguise itself as a rancid apple. They are loners as not many like how it looks or smells.

abilityOne.name: Ripen
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon can ripen fruits and berries in no time to make them Extra sweet and delicious, healing berries will have their effects boosted.
abilityOne.effect: Moves that use berries for Added Effects will have 2 Extra Dice on their Damage Pool (i.e. "Natural Gift" etc.) Increase the Healing properties of Berries at Storyteller's discretion.

abilityTwo.name: Hustle
abilityTwo.description: The Pokemon will perform everything in a hurry, it keeps itself busy, but it can be kind of sloppy when it rushes something out.
abilityTwo.effect: This Pokemon gets an Extra Low Accuracy 1 and adds 2 Extra Dice to the Damage pool for all its Physical Moves.

move.name: Withdraw
move.effect: Target Self. Increase User's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon withraw into their shell for increased protection and to avoid unwanted interactions.

move.name: Wing Attack
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: A classic flying technique, the user flies towards the foe and strikes using their wings.

move.name: Recycle
move.effect: Target Self. The Pokemon reuses an Item (Berries, Potions, Full Heal, etc.) that has already been spent during the battle on any side of the battlefield. Recycle can't be used more than 3 times per battle by the User.
move.description: One Pokémon’s trash is another one’s treasure.

move.name: Growth
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Special. If the Sunny Weather is active, increase by 2 Instead.
move.description: The Pokémon makes their body grow in size. They’ll get bigger and stronger in just a few seconds.

move.name: Twister
move.effect: Target all foes in Range. Wind Move. Roll 2 Chance dice to Flinch those affected. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop" this Move hits anyways.
move.description: A raging twister embedded with a dragon’s fury. No one wants to be trapped in this fearsome spiral, which almost touches the sky.

move.name: Acid Spray
move.effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 2.
move.description: Do not point at face or eyes. Keep away from children.

move.name: Acrobatics
move.effect: Single Target. *If the User has a Held Item, Reduce 2 Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move.
move.description: The Pokémon is quick and graceful, they cartwheel, contort and make a double back jump before landing onthe foe. Their best perfomance is done when they are unburdened.

move.name: Dragon Dance
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Dexterity.
move.description: The user performs a vigorous and mystical dance to boost their fighting spirit and reflexes.

move.name: Grav Apple
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Reduce the Target's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon rises on top of its foe and drops an apple on their head. The foe proceeds to eat the apple, distracting it from the fight.

move.name: Fly
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Thunder / Twister / Sky Uppercut / Gust / Hurricane / Smack Down. Out of battle allows the Pokemon to fly long distances.
move.description: The Pokémon uses an action to fly up high, to asses the best angle to take a dive against the foe. Pokémon who know this Move can fly for long periods of time without rest.

move.name: Outrage
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
move.description: The true nature of dragon-types unleashed. The user is consumed by a primal fury that won’t stop until everything has ben razed to the ground. Afterwards the Pokémon is confused.

move.name: Draco Meteor
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. lethal. Reduce User's Special by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon summons a meteor to fall from the sky directly into their foes, dealing a brutal amount of damage. An impressive display if power that demands a lot of energy.

move.name: Astonish
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe.
move.description: The user sneaks behind their target to jump scare them.

move.name: Leech Seed
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Spend 1 Will point to activate. At the end of each Round, Roll 2 Dice of Typeless Damage against the target ignoring defenses. The User heals 1 HP for every damage dealt this way. Grass-Type Pokémon are immune to this Effect. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The foe is infected with seed saplings taking root on their body. As the saplings grow, they'll absorb the vital energy of the foe and send it back to the user.

move.name: Protect
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokemon would receive from a Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Moves that target the user.
move.description: A mighty energy shield materializes in front of the user to to deflect attacks and dispel ill effects.

move.name: Sucker Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 6. *This move can only be used as a Late Reaction; and only if the Target used a Physical or Special Move, otherwise it will fail.
move.description: The Pokémon takes advantage of their foe preparing to attack to unleash a dirty surprise blow.

move.name: Dual Wingbeat
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuarcy 1. Double action.
move.description: The Pokémon slams the foe from above. Each wing provides a good smacking.

move.name: Dragon Breath
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A mystical flame breath that feels strengely cold to the touch. It doesn’t burn in a conventional way.

move.name: Iron Defense
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
move.description: Iron body, iron will. This Pokémon is unbreakable.

move.name: Dragon Pulse
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon sends out a powerful wave of energy through their mouth.

move.name: Dragon Rush
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon rushes to charge against their foe. Unlucky victims end up crushed into the ground.

move.name: Grassy Glide
move.effect: Single Target. *If Grassy Terrain is active, this Move has Reaction 1.
move.description: A single leaf can hold the entire weight of the Pokémon. When moving, it appears to glide over the grass.

name: Graveler (Alolan Form)
description: These Pokémon charge themselves by rolling around. It is dangerous if two of them collide: a loud noise and a flash of light will be seen and heard at great distance. They feed on golden dravite.

abilityOne.name: Magnet Pull
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon can activate a magnetic field around itself to attract all kinds of metals and disrupt electric devices.
abilityOne.effect: Other than the user, all Steel-Type Pokemon on the field are Blocked.

abilityTwo.name: Sturdy
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon's body is extremely resistant to damage, it can withstand almost anything.
abilityTwo.effect: The first time this Pokemon would reach 0 HP due to damage from a Move, it will remain at 1 HP instead. Status Ailments/Conditions, Weather, and Self-inflicted damage do not trigger this effect. The Pokemon can only benefit from Sturdy once per scene.

hiddenAbility.name: Galvanize
hiddenAbility.description: The body of this Pokemon is surrounded by electrical currents, this makes it very energized in everything it does.
hiddenAbility.effect: Normal-Type Moves that this Pokemon uses will deal damage as if they were Electric-Type, affecting STAB, weakness and resistance. Add 1 Extra Die of Damage to Electric Moves.

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Defense Curl
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 1. Increase by 1 the Power of the Moves "Ice Ball" & "Rollout".
move.description: The user curls into a ball to protect themselves when they feel threatened.

move.name: Charge
move.effect: Target Self. Add 2 Dice to the Damage Pool of thenext Damaging Electric-Type Move the User performs.
move.description: The user gathers electricity and stores it to make its attacks more powerful. You may also use them as a living battery for your phone.

move.name: Rock Polish
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: Smooth the rough edges, no need to grind about in life.

move.name: Spark
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The user engulfs itself with statc electricity then charges with a solid tackle against the foe. Sparks fly, very literally.

move.name: Rock Throw
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged.
move.description: Back in the day, this was a common form of amusement amongst Pokémon and children alike.

move.name: Discharge
move.effect: Area Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze those affected.
move.description: The user lets out an enormous discharge over the arena. Lightning does not distinguish friend from foe.

move.name: Rock Climb
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target. Out of battle it aids to climb cliffs and mountains with ease.
move.description: The Pokémon climbs over the foe and rests atop of their head as if it were the top of a mountain. This results confusing for the foe.

move.name: Wide Guard
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Reaction 3. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage the Targets would receive from Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Any Moves on the Targets.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their whole body to provide shelter and protection to everyone they can. They are the rock on which others stand.

move.name: Screech
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Reduce the Target's Defense by 2.
move.description: A mighty screech will make the target cover its ears instead of covering its flanks.

move.name: Rollout
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions. *If all 5 actions land successfully, add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of the last hit of this Move. If the Pokemon used the Move "Defense Curl" in the same round, this Move's base Power becomes 2.
move.description: When the foe sees this Pokémon rollin’ they’ll be hatin’.

move.name: Sandstorm
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Wind Move. Activate Sandstorm Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A fierce sandstorm starts raging all around the battlefield. Cover your eyes, nose and face! The rough sand will hurt you!

move.name: Smack Down
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Remove the Target's immunity to Ground-Type Moves. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop", this Move hits anyways.
move.description: They say it’s great to get two birds with one stone, this Pokémon will give one bird ALL the stones.

move.name: Rock Blast
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged. Successive Actions. Projectile Move.
move.description: A rock shrapnel, the user shoots tiny bullet-like pebbles.

move.name: Thunder Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 1 Chance die to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A charged punch to deliver a shocking blow.

move.name: Self Destruct
move.effect: Area Move. Lethal. Ranged. The User faints.
move.description: It’s not about winning or losing, some pokémon just want to see the world burn.

move.name: Stealth Rock
move.effect: Target Foe's Side of the Field. Entry Hazard. Pokemon entering the battle Receive 1 Rock-Type Damage. This effect does not stack.
move.description: The Pokémon hides a trap of sharp rocks that are launched at the victim before they even realize what even happened.

move.name: Double-Edge
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil.
move.description: Without regard for their own safety, the Pokémon does a reckless attack against their foe.

move.name: Explosion
move.effect: Area Move. Ranged. Lethal. The User Faints.
move.description: Through a massive explosion the Pokémon destroys all they can before fainting. Sometimes the only way to get out of a bad situation is in bits and pieces.

move.name: Stone Edge
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Ranged. Lethal. High Critical. Cutter Move.
move.description: Obsidian shards are sent out against the foe. This rock may be brittle but is the sharpest in the world.

name: Escavalier
description: Wearing the shell covering it stole from a Shelmet, it defends itself and attacks with two stings. It can fly to move around, but its wings are too small to carry its weight to high altitudes.

abilityOne.name: Overcoat
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon will have a protective coat surrounding its body that allows it to live under extreme weather conditions.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon won't recieve damage from active weather.

abilityTwo.name: Shell Armor
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon's shell protects its vulnerable spots from its opponents.
abilityTwo.effect: Whenever a foe lands a Critical Hit on this Pokemon, it won't get Bonus Damage Dice for that attack.

move.name: Peck
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: Raise crows and they’ll peck your foe’s eyes.

move.name: Leer
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The vicious glare of a predator that triggers the flight response of their prey.

move.name: Quick Guard
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Reaction 3. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage from a Physical or Special Move with Priority. Negate the Added effects of Reaction and late Reaction Moves targeting the User and Allies.
move.description: The user reacts instinctively and defends itself and its team mates, nullyfing the effects of the fastest attacks.

move.name: Fury Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions.
move.description: The Pokémon attacks in a fury, their attacks are uncoordinated but relentless.

move.name: False Swipe
move.effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. This Move's Damage can't make the Target go below 1 HP.
move.description: Through their most dramatic poses, the Pokémon pretends to slice up the foe (the blood is fake).

move.name: X-Scissor
move.effect: Single Target. Cutter Move.
move.description: The Pokémon uses its scythes or clawa as if they were a pair of scissors to cut through the foe.

move.name: Reversal
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool for every missing HP the User has. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The user gathers their mettle to block away the pain and focus only on hitting harder.

move.name: Swords Dance
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Strength by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon dances with strong steps and a fierce attitude as a ritual to prepare for battle.

move.name: Megahorn
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal.
move.description: The Pokémon uses its strong horn(s) to pierce their foe and deal massive damage.

move.name: Drill Run
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical.
move.description: The Pokémon holds their claws together and starts spinning as if they were a drill. They can puncture a hole into any surface from walls and floors to their foes.

move.name: Counter
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 5. Can only be used if Target's last Move on User was a Physical Move. For damage, roll dice equal to Target's last damage pool rolled against the User plus 2 dice. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The Pokémon strikes back at their foe. Showing they can take a hit and punch even harder.

move.name: Fury Cutter
move.effect: Single Target. Successive Actions. Cutter Move.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their claws or scythes to rapidly cut as if shredding paper.

move.name: Endure
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. If a Physical or Special Move would cause the user to faint, they remain at 1 HP instead, remove this effect afterwards. The effect re-activates on the user's next Turn. Whole Round duration.
move.description: The Pokémon mentally prepares to receive a fatal blow, their spirit is stronger than their body so they endure to keep on fighting for as long as possible.

move.name: Acid Spray
move.effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 2.
move.description: Do not point at face or eyes. Keep away from children.

move.name: Headbutt
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Out of battle it may cause a Random encounter when hitting trees and make objects drop from high places.
move.description: The Pokémon rams against their foe with their head. This Move is perfect to shake down trees when looking for berries, but beware of wild Pokémon nesting at the treetops.

move.name: Iron Defense
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
move.description: Iron body, iron will. This Pokémon is unbreakable.

move.name: Flail
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of this Move for every missing Point of HP the user has. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The user flails around trying to stay alive, as they get closer to fainting, more adrenaline will fuel their efforts of survival.

move.name: Scary Face
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: When a Pokémon looks at you like THAT, you know you gotta thread carefully around them.

move.name: Iron Head
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon charges to cure the foe’s iron deficit.

move.name: Slash
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical. Cutter Move.
move.description: The Pokémon uses the sharpest part of their body as a blade to tear and slash with vicious intent.

move.name: Bug Buzz
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce by 1 the Sp. Defense of those affected.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their wings or a part of their bodies to emit distracting buzzes all around.

move.name: Double-Edge
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil.
move.description: Without regard for their own safety, the Pokémon does a reckless attack against their foe.

move.name: Giga Impact
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge. Lethal.
move.description: The Pokémon strikes with such a brutal force they leave a crater just from the impact. Let them catch their breath afterwards.

move.name: Fell Stinger
move.effect: Single Target. *If used against a fainted Target ot if the Target faints due to damage from this Move, Increase the User’s Strength by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon stings the target, if the foe is too weakened to move, the user absorbs their power.

move.name: Metal Burst
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 5. Can only be used if Target's last Move on User was a Physical or Special Move. Roll dice equal to Target's last damage pool rolled against the User plus 2 Dice. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: Those who live by the sword will die by the sword, or, in this case, by an explosion.

name: Gurdurr
description: This Pokémon is very muscular and strongly-built. It likes to show off its strength and muscles. Years back, a famous wrestler got defeated in just a few seconds by one of these Pokémon.

abilityOne.name: Iron Fist
abilityOne.description: The hands of this Pokemon are very strong and heavy, when curled into fists they can go through anything.
abilityOne.effect: Add 1 Dice to the Damage Pool of Fist Based moves.

abilityTwo.name: Sheer Force
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon is only interested in showing off its incredible battle prowess.
abilityTwo.effect: Whenever this Pokemon uses a Physical or Special Move with Added Effects, you may choose to ignore them and add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool instead. Added Effects from Items trigger this effect but do not stack.

move.name: Pound
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user pounds the target’s head. Simple

move.name: Leer
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The vicious glare of a predator that triggers the flight response of their prey.

move.name: Bide
move.effect: Single Target. The User will not Evade or Clash the next 2 Physical or Special Moves targeting it. Once all damage has been dealt against the User, roll a number of Normal-Type Damage dice equal to twice the total amount of Damage the Target received. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The user puts up with being hit, waiting for the perfect opportunity to retaliate.

move.name: Rock Throw
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged.
move.description: Back in the day, this was a common form of amusement amongst Pokémon and children alike.

move.name: Bulk Up
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon showcase their muscles through poses that highlight their fitness and bodybuilding discipline.

move.name: Hammer Arm
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Low Accuracy 1. Reduce User's Dexterity by 1.
move.description: Stop. Hammer Arm time!

move.name: Stone Edge
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Ranged. Lethal. High Critical. Cutter Move.
move.description: Obsidian shards are sent out against the foe. This rock may be brittle but is the sharpest in the world.

move.name: Low Kick
move.effect: Single Target. Add 1 Extra Damage Dice for every 50kg of the weight on the foe, up to 4 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The Pokémon uses a kick to the sheen to throw the foe into the ground. The bigger they are, the harder they fall.

move.name: Focus Energy
move.effect: Target Self. All of the user's Physical & Special Moves now have "High Critical". Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The Pokémon concentrates all their focus on the battle to make their attacks much more precise.

move.name: Foresight
move.effect: Single Target. The Foe cannot Evade Moves performed by the User. User ignores Ghost-Type immunity to Normal and Fight-Type Moves and vice versa.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their honed senses and mental agility to predict the next movement of their foe.

move.name: Rock Slide
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch those affected.
move.description: Don’t worry, even if you are not the fastest one in the race, you can still win by a landslide.

move.name: Slam
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1.
move.description: Everybody get up, it’s time to slam now.

move.name: Scary Face
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: When a Pokémon looks at you like THAT, you know you gotta thread carefully around them.

move.name: Dynamic Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Fist Move. Confuse the Target.
move.description: A punch to a vital pressure point on the foe to disrupt their sense of balance

move.name: Chip Away
move.effect: Single Target. Ignore Cover & Substitute decoys. Ignore Defenses. Remove effects that increase Evasion Actions from the Target (ie Moves like: Double Team, Minimize. Abilities like: Sand Veil)
move.description: Bit by bit the Pokémon finds an opening though all layers of defense their target has until there is nothing left to protect it from a direct strike.

move.name: Wake-Up Slap
move.effect: Single Target. *If the foe has the Sleep Status, Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool. Wake up the foe after dealing damage.
move.description: Wakey wakey, sleepy head!

move.name: Superpower
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Reduce by 1 the User's Strength and Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon packs all their power in a single crushing strike. All this effort leaves them quite tired afterwards.

move.name: Focus Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Charge Move. The User Flinches if it is hit while Charging this Move.
move.description: The user must focus on delivering the greatest punch in history, if they succeed they’ll be known as the One-Punch Pokémon.

move.name: Fire Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 2nd Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: A fist powered by the fiery spirit of combat, the heat of the battle lights of for real as the punch hits the foe right where it hurts!

move.name: Ice Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 1 Chance Dice to Freeze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon wears their ice gloves to punch the foe. Yes. Gloves made of ice.

move.name: Thunder Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 1 Chance die to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A charged punch to deliver a shocking blow.

name: Mawile (Mega Form)
description: The power of the Mega Stone makes its back jaws develop a mind of their own; they are vicious and won't release anything they bite until it's crushed into pieces. They growl and howl in a haunting way.

abilityOne.name: Huge Power
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon has an unnatural strength that goes way beyond of what its physical appearance would suggest.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon has a permanent increase to its Strength Attribute. Ranks Starter, Beginner, Standard, and Advanced Increase Strength by 1. Rank Expert and higher Increase Strength by 2.

move.name: Astonish
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe.
move.description: The user sneaks behind their target to jump scare them.

move.name: Growl
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Reduce by 1 the Strength of those affected.
move.description: Either through a menacing attitude or an adorable demeanor, the foe will hesitate to attack the user at full power.

move.name: Fairy Wind
move.effect: Single Target. Wind Move.
move.description: The Pokémon let’s out sweet a breeze of glittery fairy dust. It gives a mild rash to those without happy thoughts.

move.name: Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe
move.description: The user lands a vicious bite, leaving an ugly bruise.

move.name: Sweet Scent
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Those affected cannot Evade Moves. Out of Battle, it will attract wild Pokemon.
move.description: The Pokémon releases a sweet aroma that lulls their enemies into a false sense of security

move.name: Vice Grip
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal.
move.description: The Pokémon traps the foe with its pincers or jaws and applies pressure that will leave a nasty bruise.

move.name: Spit Up
move.effect: Single Target. The user must have previously used the Move "Stockpile", otherwise this Move will fail. Reduce by 1 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense.
move.description: After stockpiling, the Pokémon spits the stored energy as a mighty beam. The user returns to their original size afterwards.

move.name: Swallow
move.effect: Target Self. The user must have previously used the Move "Stockpile", otherwise this Move will fail. Complete Heal, if successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Reduce by 1 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense.
move.description: After stockpiling, the Pokémon swallows the energy to restore their health, they go back to their normal size afterwards.

move.name: Fire Fang
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Bite Move. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon bites the foe with their mouth ablaze, tearing and searing their foe’s flesh in a single attack.

move.name: Poison Fang
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Badly Poison the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon goes for a quick bite, releasing the foe just as fast. Let the poison slowly consume the foe from the inside out. No need to spend more energy when a drop is more than enough.

move.name: Super Fang
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Bite Move. Roll Normal-Type Damage Dice equal to Half of the Target's remaining HP. Up to 10 Dice may be rolled this way. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The Pokémon jumps to bite a chunk off their Target with their mighty fangs. After each bite there’s less and less foe to take chunks off.

move.name: Snatch
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 6. Remove any Increase/Reduction on the Foe's Attributes, Active Shield Moves, Healing effects on the Foe, or effects on its side of the field; and place them on the User instead. See p. 531 for more info.
move.description: The user takes notice of the good stuff on the other side and quickly takes it for themselves. Finders keepers, losers weepers!

move.name: Taunt
move.effect: Single Target. The Target cannot perform Support Moves (Support Maneuvers may still be performed). Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: Through tease and mockery, the foe is enraged to the point it stops thinking clearly.

move.name: Fake Tears
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce foe's Sp. Defense by 2.
move.description: The user stops mid-combat to start crying; feeling incredibly guilty, the foe lowers its guard.

move.name: Feint Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Never Miss.
move.description: The user approaches inconspicuously, pretending to attack the foe directly, then actually hits the foe from behind.

move.name: Baton Pass
move.effect: Target Self. Switcher Move for the User. Any Attribute increase on the user is passed on the next Pokemon. The user can't increase its own Attributes again until the end of the scene or until the switched Pokemon faints.
move.description: The Pokémon rallies through the battle, setting up everything for the next companion as they know this is a team effort.

move.name: Crunch
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Lethal. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the foe's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon viciously mauls, tears, and rips apart anything its fangs can come in contact with.

move.name: Iron Defense
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
move.description: Iron body, iron will. This Pokémon is unbreakable.

move.name: Stockpile
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense. Enables the use of the Moves "Spit Up" and "Swallow".
move.description: The Pokémon swells up like a balloon by storing power within themselves. This helps them bounce back a bit of the damage.

move.name: Sucker Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 6. *This move can only be used as a Late Reaction; and only if the Target used a Physical or Special Move, otherwise it will fail.
move.description: The Pokémon takes advantage of their foe preparing to attack to unleash a dirty surprise blow.

move.name: Iron Head
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon charges to cure the foe’s iron deficit.

move.name: Play Rough
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 1 Chance Dice to Reduce Target's Strength by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon and their foe start a playful wrestle that soon escalates into a furious wrestling match.

name: Excadrill
description: They build maze-like nests deep underground. Humans make use of their drilling abilities to dig tunnels for subway trains. This Pokémon does not back away from foes and can be a formidable opponent.

abilityOne.name: Sand Rush
abilityOne.description: While sand whips across the battlefield, the Pokemon can paddle through it as if it was water.
abilityOne.effect: While Sandstorm Weather is active, increase the Dexterity Attibute of this Pokemon by 1. The Pokemon is immune to damage from Sandstorm Weather.

abilityTwo.name: Sand Force
abilityTwo.description: The Pokemon controls the particles of sand around the battlefield to give a boost to its attacks.
abilityTwo.effect: While Sandstorm Weather is active, if this Pokemon uses a Physical or Special Ground, Steel or Rock-Type Move, add 1 Extra die to the Damage Pool of that Move. The Pokemon is immune to damage from Sandstorm Weather.

hiddenAbility.name: Mold Breaker
hiddenAbility.description: This Pokemon will find unusual ways to achieve its goals. They are inventive and go around problems.
hiddenAbility.effect: If a foe Pokemon has a Type, an immunity, or an Ability that would prevent this Pokemon from dealing Damage with a Move, ignore it.

move.name: Mud Sport
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Physical & Special Electric-Type Moves have Power 0. Pokemon weak to Electric-Type Moves won't receive Super-Effective Damage from them. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The user covers the whole field with mud. Electricity can’t flow properly, so Electric attacks will be severely impaired.

move.name: Rapid Spin
move.effect: Single Target. Increase the User's Dexterity by 1. Remove Entry Hazards, Terrains (ie Grassy Terrain, Misty Terrain), Ongoing Damage and Leech seed from the User and/or their side of the field.
move.description: The Pokémon makes a swift spin to strike at the foe and in the process everything laying close to the user is scattered out of the battlefield.

move.name: Metal Claw
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 1 Chance Die to Increase the User's Strength by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon uses the foe as a whetstone.

move.name: Fury Swipes
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions.
move.description: With their sharp claws, the Pokémon will swiftly scatch their foe, leaving its face full of small cuts.

move.name: Hone Claws
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength score and Accuracy Pools.
move.description: Sharp claws make for more precise and deadly attacks.

move.name: Sandstorm
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Wind Move. Activate Sandstorm Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A fierce sandstorm starts raging all around the battlefield. Cover your eyes, nose and face! The rough sand will hurt you!

move.name: Drill Run
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical.
move.description: The Pokémon holds their claws together and starts spinning as if they were a drill. They can puncture a hole into any surface from walls and floors to their foes.

move.name: Iron Defense
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
move.description: Iron body, iron will. This Pokémon is unbreakable.

move.name: Smart Strike
move.effect: Single Target. Never Miss. Lethal.
move.description: The user stabs the foe using one of their sharp horns with astounding precision. The resulting wound is very deep and needs stitches immediately

move.name: Iron Head
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon charges to cure the foe’s iron deficit.

move.name: Mud Slap
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.
move.description: A mud ball splatters right into the foe’s face, reducing their field of vision.

move.name: Scratch
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their sharp claws to scratch the enemy. Nothing fancy but it works.

move.name: Crush Claw
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Reduce the Target's Defense by 2.
move.description: With a crushing grip against the foe, the user manages to break their armor.

move.name: Rock Slide
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch those affected.
move.description: Don’t worry, even if you are not the fastest one in the race, you can still win by a landslide.

move.name: Dig
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Earth Power/ Earthquake/ Fissure/ Magnitude/ Stomping Tantrum. Out of battle allows the Pokemon to burrow and make underground tunnels.
move.description: The user digs a tunnel on the ground and attacks by coming out from below its target. This move has been used to escape caves and gain access to highly surveiled places.

move.name: Rototiller
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Increase by 1 the Strength and Special of all Grass-Type Pokemon.
move.description: The Pokémon digs around the battlefield to soften the soil and make it ideal for harvest.

move.name: Swords Dance
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Strength by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon dances with strong steps and a fierce attitude as a ritual to prepare for battle.

move.name: Earthquake
move.effect: Area Move. Ranged. If the Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dig" this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The user calls the forces of nature. The earth shakes violently and everything crumbles to the ground.

move.name: Slash
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical. Cutter Move.
move.description: The Pokémon uses the sharpest part of their body as a blade to tear and slash with vicious intent.

move.name: Horn Drill
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 5. Deal Damage equal to the Target's Remaining HP, plus 1 Lethal Damage.
move.description: The Pokémon stabs the target with a spinning horn, drilling through them until they are critical condition. Hurry to the nearest Pokémon Center.

move.name: Fissure
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 5. Ranged. Deal Damage to the Target equal to its Remaining HP, plus 1 Lethal Damge. If the Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dig" this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The earth rips apart underneath the target and swallows them whole. You’ll need a rescue team to recover the unlucky victim from the deep.

name: Gothita
description: They often stare creepily at their Trainers and other Pokémon. Apparently, they are staring at something only they can see. The ribbon-like feelers on their body increase their Psychic power.

abilityOne.name: Frisk
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon can see the items others may be carrying, even if they are hidden.
abilityOne.effect: When this Pokemon enters the battlefield, Storyteller must reveal its trainer the held item of one foe.

abilityTwo.name: Competitive
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon's determination grows in the face of adversity. It is always trying to compete with those around it.
abilityTwo.effect: The first time this Pokemon gets an Attribute reduced by a foe during a battle, Increase its Special by 2.

hiddenAbility.name: Shadow Tag
hiddenAbility.description: The Pokemon can physically take a hold of shadows to make them act on their own or capture their victims.
hiddenAbility.effect: All Targets in Range become Blocked. Ghost-type Pokemon are immune to this effect. Pokemon with the same ability are immune to this effect.

move.name: Pound
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user pounds the target’s head. Simple

move.name: Confusion
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Confuse the Target.
move.description: A basic mental assault that makes the foe believe they are being attacked by an invisible enemy.

move.name: Tickle
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce by 1 the Target's Strength and Defense.
move.description: Whoever said laughter is the best therapy lied.

move.name: Play Nice
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Strength by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon starts to play with the foe. They are firendly, respectful, and thank the foe for the fun time. The foe does not want to fight, they want to keep playing.

move.name: Psybeam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Confuse the Target.
move.description: The foe’s mind isassaulted by a mental ray, afterwards they may suffer from hallucinations.

move.name: Feint Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Never Miss.
move.description: The user approaches inconspicuously, pretending to attack the foe directly, then actually hits the foe from behind.

move.name: Psyshock
move.effect: Single Target. This Move is resisted with the Target's Defense instead of its Sp. Defense.
move.description: The shock is mental, the blow is real.

move.name: Psychic
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: The most iconic Psychic attack, the foe starts floating in the air and its swayed around by telekinesis as their mental barrier crumbles.

move.name: Telekinesis
move.effect: Single Target. Target becomes immune to Ground-Type Moves. Target can't Evade. Duration 2 Rounds.
move.description: The target levitates from the ground as the user’s telekinetic powers prevent its movement.

move.name: Role Play
move.effect: Single Target. Replace the User's Ability with the Target's. Whole Scene Duration. Unique Abilities can't be copied.
move.description: The Pokémon is a great actor. Their impersonations are really good! ...maybe a bit too good.

move.name: Signal Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Confuse the foe.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a buzzing beam that leaves makes the foe head towards bright lights like a dazzled moth.

move.name: Snatch
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 6. Remove any Increase/Reduction on the Foe's Attributes, Active Shield Moves, Healing effects on the Foe, or effects on its side of the field; and place them on the User instead. See p. 531 for more info.
move.description: The user takes notice of the good stuff on the other side and quickly takes it for themselves. Finders keepers, losers weepers!

move.name: Double Slap
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Double Action.
move.description: The name is misleading as the user slaps withouth even counting how many slaps they have given already

move.name: Charm
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce Target's Strength by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon engages their foe in a charming interaction to reduce their aggressive intent.

move.name: Hypnosis
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Put the Target to sleep. Dark-Type Pokemon are affected by this Move.
move.description: By staring at an hypnotic pendulum, the target is suggestioned to feel tired and close its eyelids.

move.name: Fake Tears
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce foe's Sp. Defense by 2.
move.description: The user stops mid-combat to start crying; feeling incredibly guilty, the foe lowers its guard.

move.name: Psych Up
move.effect: Single Target. The User gets the same Attribute/Trait Increases and Reductions the Target has.
move.description: The Pokémon mentalizes themselves stronger than anyone. They feel good. They can win. They. Can. Do. This!

move.name: Embargo
move.effect: Single Target. The Target loses its Held Item. Target's Trainer & Partners can't use Items on the Target. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The user demands the held item of a Pokémon and the items in the bag of their trainer. Scared, both Pokémon and Trainer comply

move.name: Flatter
move.effect: Single Target. Increase the Target's Special by 1. Confuse the Target.
move.description: The user starts flattering and admiring its opponent. It sure makes them feel good about themselves but...why?!

move.name: Heal Block
move.effect: Area Move. Those affected can't restore HP. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: Through a massive mental onslaught, the Pokémon brings back the memories of pain on everyone around.

move.name: Future Sight
move.effect: Single Target. This Move's damage is dealt at the beginning of the next Round. Ignore Shield Moves, Force Field, Cover & Substitute. If the target restires or switches out from battle, the damage will be dealt to the next opponent or to one of its allies.
move.description: The Pokémon foresees something terrible happening. Although when it tries to see their own future, the images are ever changing.

move.name: Magic Room
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Held items lose their effects. No items can be used. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The entire battlefield becomes a room on which the laws of the material world are rendered useless.

name: Mandibuzz
description: They fly in circles around the sky when they spot prey. They carry the carcass back to their nest with ease. They like to look beautiful and create ornaments and jewelry using bone pieces.

abilityOne.name: Big Pecks
abilityOne.description: This tenacious Pokemon uses its beak to cover its weak spots.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon cannot have its Defense reduced.

abilityTwo.name: Overcoat
abilityTwo.description: The Pokemon will have a protective coat surrounding its body that allows it to live under extreme weather conditions.
abilityTwo.effect: This Pokemon won't recieve damage from active weather.

hiddenAbility.name: Weak Armor
hiddenAbility.description: This Pokemon's protective outer layers can come off, allowing it to move freely and be more agile.
hiddenAbility.effect: The first time this Pokemon is hit by any Physical Move, Increase its Dexterity Attribute by 1 and Reduce its Defense by 1.

move.name: Gust
move.effect: Single Target. Wind Move. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop", this Move hits anyway.
move.description: The Pokémon flaps their wings and strikes the foe with a swirl of wind. Pokémon in the air may get swept away

move.name: Leer
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The vicious glare of a predator that triggers the flight response of their prey.

move.name: Pluck
move.effect: Single Target. *If the Target is holding a Berry, Add 1 Die to the Damage pool of this Move. The User also eats the berry and gains its effects.
move.description: The Pokémon lands on top of the foe and starts pecking them in search for parasites or some other tasty treat to snack on.

move.name: Feint Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Never Miss.
move.description: The user approaches inconspicuously, pretending to attack the foe directly, then actually hits the foe from behind.

move.name: Tailwind
move.effect: Target User's side of the Field. Wind Move. Increase by 2 the Dexterity of everyone on the User's side of the field. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: Flying Pokémon know better than anyone how to use the wind in their favor. Let its draft carry you to victory.

move.name: Whirlwind
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 6. Wind Move. Switcher Move for the Foe. In the wild, the battle may end.
move.description: A strong whirlwind can send you flying away to who knows where. You better be wearing your red shoes.

move.name: Flatter
move.effect: Single Target. Increase the Target's Special by 1. Confuse the Target.
move.description: The user starts flattering and admiring its opponent. It sure makes them feel good about themselves but...why?!

move.name: Fury Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions.
move.description: The Pokémon attacks in a fury, their attacks are uncoordinated but relentless.

move.name: Embargo
move.effect: Single Target. The Target loses its Held Item. Target's Trainer & Partners can't use Items on the Target. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The user demands the held item of a Pokémon and the items in the bag of their trainer. Scared, both Pokémon and Trainer comply

move.name: Bone Rush
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions.
move.description: The foe is assaulted by a series of flurry strikes with a bone club.

move.name: Toxic
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Badly Poison the Target.
move.description: This burning acid dissolves skin to enter the bloodstream directly. The poor victim feels like they are melting from the inside out. The clock is ticking.

move.name: Punishment
move.effect: Single Target. *Add up to 7 Dice to the Damage Pool of the Move for every Attribute increase the target has. (ie The target has 2 increased points on Strength, add 2 Damage dice).
move.description: You shouldn’t have done that...

move.name: Knock Off
move.effect: Single Target. *If the Target is holding an Item, Add 2 Dice to the Damage pool of this Move. The Target loses its Held Item afterwards.
move.description: The Pokémon rudely smacks what their foe was holding.

move.name: Iron Defense
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
move.description: Iron body, iron will. This Pokémon is unbreakable.

move.name: Air Slash
move.effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: A compressed wind-slash, the change of pressure knocks out the target momentarily

move.name: Dark Pulse
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: A haze of dark energy decends on the battlefield preying on those vulnerable to the obscure feelings and fears it provokes.

move.name: Nasty Plot
move.effect: Target Self. Increase User's Special by 2.
move.description: Rubbing both hands and laughing sinisterly the Pokémon rejoices in the evil plans they’ll soon carry out.

move.name: Defog
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Remove all Force Fields, Entry Hazards and Terrains (Misty Terrain, Electric Terrain, etc.) from the Battlefield.
move.description: A strong wind sweeps out the battle field, removing anything from bad weather to scattered objects and even invisible barriers.

move.name: Mirror Move
move.effect: Single Target. Copy Move. Unique Moves can't be copied. You may choose another Target(s) for the copied Move.
move.description: The Pokémon parrots the target cries and movements. In an almost perfect impersonation that manages to copy its powers.

move.name: Attract
move.effect: Single Target. Target is now In Love with the User.
move.description: Through their good looks and coquetish attitude, the Pokémon makes everyone develop a crush on them.

move.name: Brave Bird
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil.
move.description: Back in the day humans relied on birds to send their messages and even go to war. Many earned medals for bravery.

move.name: Sky Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Charge Move. High Critical. Lethal. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: In a graceful but lethal strike, the Pokémon takes a deep dive towards the foe as if the sky was falling down right on top of it

move.name: Endure
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. If a Physical or Special Move would cause the user to faint, they remain at 1 HP instead, remove this effect afterwards. The effect re-activates on the user's next Turn. Whole Round duration.
move.description: The Pokémon mentally prepares to receive a fatal blow, their spirit is stronger than their body so they endure to keep on fighting for as long as possible.

move.name: Taunt
move.effect: Single Target. The Target cannot perform Support Moves (Support Maneuvers may still be performed). Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: Through tease and mockery, the foe is enraged to the point it stops thinking clearly.

move.name: Roost
move.effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Remove the User's Immunity to Ground-Type Moves. Duration 1 Round.
move.description: The Pokémon gathers some twigs and builds themselves a comfy nest on the floor to roost and relax.

name: Electivire
description: This Pokémon is reckless and has a short temper. As its electric charge amplifies, blue sparks begin to crackle between its horns. It has registered charge levels of over 20,000 volts.

abilityOne.name: Motor Drive
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon absorbs electricity and stores it as energy to run faster or to power up machinery. An electric car's best friend.
abilityOne.effect: The first time this Pokemon is hit by an Electric-type move, Increase 1 Point to its Dexterity Attribute. This Pokemon doesn't receive damage from Electric-type moves.

abilityTwo.name: Vital Spirit
abilityTwo.description: The Pokemon is incredibly active and energetic. It needs constant activity and exercise or else it will act destructive. It never sleeps.
abilityTwo.effect: This Pokemon is immune to the Sleep status. Moves or Items that self-inflict Sleep will fail.

move.name: Quick Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Out of battle, double the Pokemon's movement speed.
move.description: An attackas fight as lightning.

move.name: Leer
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The vicious glare of a predator that triggers the flight response of their prey.

move.name: Low Kick
move.effect: Single Target. Add 1 Extra Damage Dice for every 50kg of the weight on the foe, up to 4 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The Pokémon uses a kick to the sheen to throw the foe into the ground. The bigger they are, the harder they fall.

move.name: Thunder Shock
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance die to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The most basic electric attack, charge, release, and shock! Just don’t point it to any electric device.

move.name: Shock Wave
move.effect: Single Target. Never Miss.
move.description: A series of lightning bolts rise through the floor towards the sky, it is impossible to predict where they are coming from.

move.name: Electro Ball
move.effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of the user for every Point on Dexterity it has that surpasses the Foe's. Up to 4 Dice might be added this way.
move.description: An orb of electricity is hurled against the target, the faster the user dashes, the more momentum the orb gets.

move.name: Swift
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Never Miss.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a burst of star-shaped sparkles at a blinding speed.

move.name: Hammer Arm
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Low Accuracy 1. Reduce User's Dexterity by 1.
move.description: Stop. Hammer Arm time!

move.name: Ice Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 1 Chance Dice to Freeze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon wears their ice gloves to punch the foe. Yes. Gloves made of ice.

move.name: Dual Chop
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Double Action.
move.description: Two brutal blows are all this Pokémon needs to make the opponent yield to their might.

move.name: Charge
move.effect: Target Self. Add 2 Dice to the Damage Pool of thenext Damaging Electric-Type Move the User performs.
move.description: The user gathers electricity and stores it to make its attacks more powerful. You may also use them as a living battery for your phone.

move.name: Electric Terrain
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Add 1 Extra Damage Dice to all Physical & Special Electric-Type Moves. Pokemon without immunity to Ground will be cured of the Sleep Status. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The user electrifies the battlefield, making it impossible to relax around the sparks and live current.

move.name: Ion Deluge
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Damage from Normal-Type Moves will be considered to be Electric-Type. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The user electrifies all the particles in the environment with shocking results!

move.name: Thunder Wave
move.effect: Single Target. Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A series of electric waves hit the target, their voltage is too weak to cause much harm but muscles will get cramped for hours.

move.name: Thunder Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 1 Chance die to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A charged punch to deliver a shocking blow.

move.name: Fire Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 2nd Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: A fist powered by the fiery spirit of combat, the heat of the battle lights of for real as the punch hits the foe right where it hurts!

move.name: Light Screen
move.effect: Target the User's side of the field. Force Field. Activate a Force Field against Special Damage. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A barrier of light is created over half of the battlefield, all energy trying to go trough dissolves as it crosses it.

move.name: Screech
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Reduce the Target's Defense by 2.
move.description: A mighty screech will make the target cover its ears instead of covering its flanks.

move.name: Discharge
move.effect: Area Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze those affected.
move.description: The user lets out an enormous discharge over the arena. Lightning does not distinguish friend from foe.

move.name: Thunderbolt
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance die to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A solid electric shock. A discharge of nearly 10,000 volts that can knock out most foes and destroy electrical devices.

move.name: Thunder
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target. Rain Weather eliminates Low Accuracy. Sunny Weather increases it to Low Accuracy 4. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce", or "Sky Drop" this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The Pokémon commands the skies to send a giant lightning bolt to a specific point. Difficult to command under clear skies, lethal during a storm. Flying Pokémon are specially vulnerable.

move.name: Giga Impact
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge. Lethal.
move.description: The Pokémon strikes with such a brutal force they leave a crater just from the impact. Let them catch their breath afterwards.

move.name: Rising Voltage
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. *If Electric Terrain is active, add 3 Extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move.
move.description: A shockwave travels through the ground, then rises as a golden pillar of thunderbolts.

name: Gogoat
description: In the wild, they inhabit mountain regions with the leader of the herd decided by a battle of clashing horns. People rely on Gogoat to get them through harsh terrain as it always knows where you want to go.

abilityOne.name: Sap Sipper
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon's diet consists strickly of plants, it is particularly fond of sweet sap for nourishment.
abilityOne.effect: The first time this Pokemon is hit by a Grass-type attack, Increase its Strength Attribute by 1 instead of dealing damage. Grass-type moves do not deal damage to this Pokemon.

abilityTwo.name: Grass Pelt
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon has a lush coat of grass to protect its body, even if you cut it, it will regrow in a few days.
abilityTwo.effect: If Grassy Terrain is active, Increase this Pokemon's Defense by 2.

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Vine Whip
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses its body vines to give the foe a good smack. These vines can be as long as 20 feet and quite surdy as ropes.

move.name: Tail Whip
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The Pokémon whips their tail in such an adorable way the foes let their guard down.

move.name: Razor Leaf
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Cutter Move. Ranged. High Critical.
move.description: The user sends out a barrage of sharp razor-like leaves. “Death by a thousand cuts” would be the best depiction.

move.name: Leech Seed
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Spend 1 Will point to activate. At the end of each Round, Roll 2 Dice of Typeless Damage against the target ignoring defenses. The User heals 1 HP for every damage dealt this way. Grass-Type Pokémon are immune to this Effect. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The foe is infected with seed saplings taking root on their body. As the saplings grow, they'll absorb the vital energy of the foe and send it back to the user.

move.name: Zen Headbutt
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses both their mental and physical prowess in a questionable yet effective “psychic” strike.

move.name: Bounce
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Thunder / Twister / Sky Uppercut / Gust / Hurricane / Smack Down. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon jumps at least 30 feet in the air before landing with a mighty stomp on top of the foe. While in the air it is safe from most treaths but its still vulnerable to bad weather.

move.name: Superpower
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Reduce by 1 the User's Strength and Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon packs all their power in a single crushing strike. All this effort leaves them quite tired afterwards.

move.name: Growth
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Special. If the Sunny Weather is active, increase by 2 Instead.
move.description: The Pokémon makes their body grow in size. They’ll get bigger and stronger in just a few seconds.

move.name: Worry Seed
move.effect: Single Target. Replace the Target's Ability with "Insomnia". Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon.
move.description: The user plants the seed of doubt and uncertainty on its foe. The foe becomes such a worrywart that they can’t even sleep at night.

move.name: Aerial Ace
move.effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. Never Miss.
move.description: The Pokémon rises up in the air towards a light source, momentarily blinding the foe. then plummets quickly to attack the opponent

move.name: Grassy Terrain
move.effect: Target User's side of the field. Add 1 Extra Damage Dice to all Physical & Special Grass-Type Moves. Everyone on the User's side of the field heals 1 HP at the end of each Round. Spend 1 Will Point t activate. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A patch of grass grows in the area surrounding the user, through it nature grants her many blessings.

move.name: Synthesis
move.effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will Point to activate. If Sunny Weather is in effect, this Move becomes a Complete Heal. If performed under Rain, Sandstorm, Hail or Snowy Weather, this Move is a Minor heal and only heals 1 HP.
move.description: The Pokémon gathers sunlight to re-energize themselves.

move.name: Take Down
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Recoil.
move.description: Through a reckless grapple, the Pokémon smashes the foe into the ground, usually falling along with it.

move.name: Bulldoze
move.effect: Area Move. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: The user stomps and flattens the ground, pushing all the rubbish and leaving the surface ready for construction.

move.name: Seed Bomb
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Projectile Move.
move.description: A giant seed is hurled against the target, the hit is not what knocks them down, the tree that explodes suddenly out of the seed is what does.

move.name: Bulk Up
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon showcase their muscles through poses that highlight their fitness and bodybuilding discipline.

move.name: Milk Drink
move.effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Out of battle, this Move can be used on allies.
move.description: The Pokémon drinks a glass of milk. Full of calcium and vitamin D it is a healthy and delicious refreshment.

move.name: Horn Leech
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The user rams into the foe and uses the leaves growing on their horns to absorb nutrients from it.

move.name: Leaf Blade
move.effect: Single Target. High Critical. Lethal. Cutter Move.
move.description: Danger lies not on the material’s toughness but on its edge’s sharpness.

move.name: Double-Edge
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil.
move.description: Without regard for their own safety, the Pokémon does a reckless attack against their foe.

move.name: Earthquake
move.effect: Area Move. Ranged. If the Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dig" this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The user calls the forces of nature. The earth shakes violently and everything crumbles to the ground.

move.name: Rock Slide
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch those affected.
