move.description: Don’t worry, even if you are not the fastest one in the race, you can still win by a landslide.

name: Hitmonlee
description: Its legs freely stretch and contract. It bowls over foes with devastating kicks. It is very disciplined and trains every day. It is very rare in the wild, and it is mostly found in urban areas.

abilityOne.name: Limber
abilityOne.description: The muscles of this Pokemon are incredibly flexible and elastic. Easing their movement, agility, and grace.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon is immune to Paralysis Status Ailment.

abilityTwo.name: Reckless
abilityTwo.description: The Pokemon will often get into risky situations in order to get what it wants. They are prone to risk their lives without thinking of the consequences.
abilityTwo.effect: When this Pokemon performs a Move with Recoil as an Added Effect, Add 2 Extra dice to the Damage Pool of that Move.

hiddenAbility.name: Unburden
hiddenAbility.description: This Pokemon is most comfortable when it is freed from having to carry stuff around. It loves to be able to move without restrictions.
hiddenAbility.effect: The first time this Pokemon spends or loses its held item and is no longer holding any, Increase 2 Points to its Dexterity Attribute.

move.name: Double Kick
move.effect: Single Target. Double Action.
move.description: The good old one-two but with a twist.

move.name: Revenge
move.effect: Single Target. *If the User has already received Damage this Round, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.
move.description: Best served cold.

move.name: Meditate
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Special and Sp. Defense.
move.description: Through meditation the Pokémon brings forward their mind’s strength into their body.

move.name: Rolling Kick
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon jumps in the air and spins with one leg extended to land an impressive kick against their foe.

move.name: Brick Break
move.effect: Single Target. *If there is a Force field on the Target's side of the field, destroy it and add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.
move.description: The Pokémon uses a karate technique to chop through tall piles of bricks. No matter how many layers you pile up, they’ll break regardless.

move.name: Feint
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 1. This Move ignores the effects of any Shield Move active on the Target and removes their effects for the rest of the Round.
move.description: The user begins their attack, and as their target attempts to protect itself, the user feints the target to break their defense against their true strike.

move.name: Endure
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. If a Physical or Special Move would cause the user to faint, they remain at 1 HP instead, remove this effect afterwards. The effect re-activates on the user's next Turn. Whole Round duration.
move.description: The Pokémon mentally prepares to receive a fatal blow, their spirit is stronger than their body so they endure to keep on fighting for as long as possible.

move.name: Bounce
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Thunder / Twister / Sky Uppercut / Gust / Hurricane / Smack Down. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon jumps at least 30 feet in the air before landing with a mighty stomp on top of the foe. While in the air it is safe from most treaths but its still vulnerable to bad weather.

move.name: Rapid Spin
move.effect: Single Target. Increase the User's Dexterity by 1. Remove Entry Hazards, Terrains (ie Grassy Terrain, Misty Terrain), Ongoing Damage and Leech seed from the User and/or their side of the field.
move.description: The Pokémon makes a swift spin to strike at the foe and in the process everything laying close to the user is scattered out of the battlefield.

move.name: Jump Kick
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. If the Accuracy roll fails, Roll 4 Dice of Typeless Damage against the user, ignoring defenses.
move.description: The user launches itself up two stories high to pummel down with a powerful kick. Do not try it at home.

move.name: Low Sweep
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon crouches and spins with a kick to the foe’s legs. Leaving them with a limp for the rest of the fight.

move.name: Focus Energy
move.effect: Target Self. All of the user's Physical & Special Moves now have "High Critical". Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The Pokémon concentrates all their focus on the battle to make their attacks much more precise.

move.name: Mind Reader
move.effect: Single Target. The User has 2 automatic and unremovable successes on the next Accuracy or Evasion Roll against the Target.
move.description: In a split of second, the Pokémon reads the foe’s mind so they know exactly what to do next.

move.name: High Jump Kick
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. If the Accuracy roll fails, Roll 5 Dice of Typeless Damage against the user, ignoring defenses.
move.description: The user launches itself up three stories high to pummel down with a brutal kick. Let’s just trust it’s got a good aim from that distance.

move.name: Wide Guard
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Reaction 3. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage the Targets would receive from Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Any Moves on the Targets.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their whole body to provide shelter and protection to everyone they can. They are the rock on which others stand.

move.name: Foresight
move.effect: Single Target. The Foe cannot Evade Moves performed by the User. User ignores Ghost-Type immunity to Normal and Fight-Type Moves and vice versa.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their honed senses and mental agility to predict the next movement of their foe.

move.name: Blaze Kick
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. High Critical. Roll 2 Chance Dice to inflict 2nd Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: Setting their legs ablaze, the Pokémon throws a mighty kick that sears the sides of the foe.

move.name: Reversal
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool for every missing HP the User has. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The user gathers their mettle to block away the pain and focus only on hitting harder.

move.name: Mega Kick
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2.
move.description: A mighty kick. This sheer muscle-power strike can turn concrete pillars into rubble.

move.name: Close Combat
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce by 1 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon gets close enough to deal devastating damage, but the same can be said for the foe.

move.name: Coaching
move.effect: Target All Allies in Range. Increase by 1 the Strength and Defense of all Allies targeted. The User cannot target itself.
move.description: This Pokémon allies form a line and start doing squats and push-ups while the user corrects their form and gives them tips and a confidence boost to win this match.

name: Frosmoth
description: It shows no mercy to any who desecrates its snowfields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away. It is very regal and soft-mannered otherwise

abilityOne.name: Shield Dust
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon constantly generates specs of dust to shield and protect itself.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon is not affected by any effects triggered by Chance Dice of foes.

abilityTwo.name: Ice Scales
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon's body is covered by crystal scales made of ice. Always cold to the touch, it easily deflects most projectiles, energy and light on its surface.
abilityTwo.effect: Reduce by 2 the Damage dealt to this Pokemon by All Special Moves.

move.name: Powder Snow
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Roll 1 Chance Die to Freeze those affected.
move.description: A light layer of snow flakes covers the foes, as the layers pile up the possibilities to be trapped into the snow increase.

move.name: Struggle Bug
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Special of those affected.
move.description: The Pokémon sends a distress signal through its antennae to interrupt the foe’s concentration.

move.name: Icy Wind
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Wind Move. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: Polar winds sweep through the arena. Everyone starts to shiver and embrace themselves, trying to preserve a bit of warmth.

move.name: Helping Hand
move.effect: Target One Ally. Reaction 5. The Target Gets 2 Extra Dice on their next Skill Check/Accuracy Roll, and 2 Extra Dice on their next Damage Roll. This Effect does not Stack.
move.description: The Pokémon is the first to come and give a hand to their friend. A true bro.

move.name: Attract
move.effect: Single Target. Target is now In Love with the User.
move.description: Through their good looks and coquetish attitude, the Pokémon makes everyone develop a crush on them.

move.name: Stun Spore
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Powder Move. Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A cloud of paralyzing pollen that affects the nerves and cramps the muscles of those who inhale it.

move.name: Dazzling Gleam
move.effect: Target All foes in Range.
move.description: The Pokémon shines bright like a diamond. The powerful flash hurts the eyes of everyone watching.

move.name: Hurricane
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Wind Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target. Rain Weather eliminates Low Accuracy. Sunny Weather increases to Low Accuracy 4. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop", this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The Pokémon calls upon fierce gale winds. It’ll be difficult to summon the tempest on a clear day, but a little rain will enhance it into a typhoon. Other pokémon in the air are in most danger.

move.name: Fairy Wind
move.effect: Single Target. Wind Move.
move.description: The Pokémon let’s out sweet a breeze of glittery fairy dust. It gives a mild rash to those without happy thoughts.

move.name: Silver Wind
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Increase by 1 the User's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense, and Sp. Defense.
move.description: A beautiful but dangerous wind that blows a silver powder against the foe. The performance may give the user a big confidence boost.

move.name: Infestation
move.effect: Single Target. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion.
move.description: The Pokémon summons a bothersome swarm to prevent the foe from escaping. The swarm will relentlessly attack the foe.

move.name: Mist
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Targets cannot have their Attributes or Traits Reduced. Previously Reduced Attributes and Traits remain. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A thick layer of mist cloaks a pack of pokémon, those with the intent to trick and weaken them will have to find them first.

move.name: Defog
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Remove all Force Fields, Entry Hazards and Terrains (Misty Terrain, Electric Terrain, etc.) from the Battlefield.
move.description: A strong wind sweeps out the battle field, removing anything from bad weather to scattered objects and even invisible barriers.

move.name: Feather Dance
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Strength by 2.
move.description: A dance as soft as a feather. It soothes the hearts of the spectators and reduces all aggression.

move.name: Aurora Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce target's Strength by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a beautiful shimmering beam that cools down a hot temper.

move.name: Hail
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Activate Hail Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The skies turn gray, and loud thunder rumbles, but what falls is not a gentle drizzle, but an endless stream of ice shards coming down at high speeds. Find shelter!

move.name: Bug Buzz
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce by 1 the Sp. Defense of those affected.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their wings or a part of their bodies to emit distracting buzzes all around.

move.name: Aurora Veil
move.effect: Target User's Side of the Field. Force Field against Physical & Special Damage. This move will fail if not performed under Hail/Snowy Weather. Duration 4 Rounds, even if Hail or Snow Weather is over.
move.description: If the weather is cold enough, beautiful aurora lights will cover half of the battlefield, deflecting attacks.

move.name: Mirror Coat
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 5. Can only be used if Target's last Move on User was a Special Move. For damage, roll dice equal to Target's last damage pool rolled against the User plus 2. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The user gathers the harmful energies around themselves and bounces them back to their source.

move.name: Safeguard
move.effect: Target User's side of the Field. Force Field. Those affected are immune to all Status Ailements/Conditions. Previously inflicted Status Ailments/Conditions remain. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A force field covers half of the battlefield and filters out all impurities and ill intentions coming from the other side.

move.name: Blizzard
move.effect: All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Wind Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Freeze those affected. *Sunny Weather increases to Low Accuracy 4. **Hail/Snowy Weather remove Low Accuracy and adds the effect "Never Miss".
move.description: The user summons a turbulent and gelid wind that feels like ice daggers. A pleasant day may make it difficult to call upon, but beware if the temperatures go below zero.

move.name: Tailwind
move.effect: Target User's side of the Field. Wind Move. Increase by 2 the Dexterity of everyone on the User's side of the field. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: Flying Pokémon know better than anyone how to use the wind in their favor. Let its draft carry you to victory.

move.name: Wide Guard
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Reaction 3. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage the Targets would receive from Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Any Moves on the Targets.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their whole body to provide shelter and protection to everyone they can. They are the rock on which others stand.

move.name: Quiver Dance
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Dexterity, Special an Sp. Defense.
move.description: A mystical and beautiful dance that increases a Pokémon focus in combat.

move.name: Leech Life
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The Pokémon clings to their foe, then bites in and starts to suck away its life force.

name: Hoppip
description: This Pokémon drifts away by floating on the wind. Even the weakest current can lift them up. By the end of the winter you can see them flying above cities and fields. This means that spring is coming soon.

abilityOne.name: Chlorophyll
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon synthesizes sunlight to get energy, if it's kept in a sunny environment it will rarely need to eat.
abilityOne.effect: While Sunny Weather is active, Increase this Pokemon's Dexterity Attribute by 2.

abilityTwo.name: Leaf Guard
abilityTwo.description: The leaves on this Pokemon's body expand with the sun to completely cover and shield it from superficial damage. They may need to be pruned often.
abilityTwo.effect: While Sunny Weather is active, this Pokemon can't have any Status Ailments or Conditions inflicted. Previously inflicted ailments/conditions remain.

hiddenAbility.name: Infiltrator
hiddenAbility.description: The Pokemon is very stealthy with its movements, it is naturally harder to detect and can easily sneak in heavily guarded places.
hiddenAbility.effect: This Pokemon ignores all Shield Moves, Force Fields, Substitutes and Cover active on the foe's side of the field.

move.name: Splash
move.effect: Target Self. No effect.
move.description: Oh, for the love of Arceus...

move.name: Tail Whip
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The Pokémon whips their tail in such an adorable way the foes let their guard down.

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Poison Powder
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Powder Move. Poison the Target.
move.description: A cloud of noxius powder that immediately sends the target’s immune system into overdrive.

move.name: Stun Spore
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Powder Move. Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A cloud of paralyzing pollen that affects the nerves and cramps the muscles of those who inhale it.

move.name: Sleep Powder
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Powder Move. Put the Target to Sleep.
move.description: The Pokémon spouts a cloud of somniferous pollen to know out their foe, the only problem is that the foe must inhale enough of the pollen for it to take effect.

move.name: Bullet Seed
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Successive Actions. Projectile Moves.
move.description: The Pokémon starts shooting seed as if they were a machine gun.

move.name: Leech Seed
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Spend 1 Will point to activate. At the end of each Round, Roll 2 Dice of Typeless Damage against the target ignoring defenses. The User heals 1 HP for every damage dealt this way. Grass-Type Pokémon are immune to this Effect. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The foe is infected with seed saplings taking root on their body. As the saplings grow, they'll absorb the vital energy of the foe and send it back to the user.

move.name: Mega Drain
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The user absorbs a big amount of vital energy and nutrients from the target to feed from.

move.name: Worry Seed
move.effect: Single Target. Replace the Target's Ability with "Insomnia". Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon.
move.description: The user plants the seed of doubt and uncertainty on its foe. The foe becomes such a worrywart that they can’t even sleep at night.

move.name: Bounce
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Thunder / Twister / Sky Uppercut / Gust / Hurricane / Smack Down. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon jumps at least 30 feet in the air before landing with a mighty stomp on top of the foe. While in the air it is safe from most treaths but its still vulnerable to bad weather.

move.name: Seed Bomb
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Projectile Move.
move.description: A giant seed is hurled against the target, the hit is not what knocks them down, the tree that explodes suddenly out of the seed is what does.

move.name: Aromatherapy
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Cure Status Ailments (All Burn degrees, Freeze, Paralysis, All Poison & Sleep) on the Targets.
move.description: The Pokémon releases a series of essential oils and herbal scents to refresh themselves and their companions.

move.name: Absorb
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The user takes nutrients from the nearest source of life they find.

move.name: Fairy Wind
move.effect: Single Target. Wind Move.
move.description: The Pokémon let’s out sweet a breeze of glittery fairy dust. It gives a mild rash to those without happy thoughts.

move.name: Synthesis
move.effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will Point to activate. If Sunny Weather is in effect, this Move becomes a Complete Heal. If performed under Rain, Sandstorm, Hail or Snowy Weather, this Move is a Minor heal and only heals 1 HP.
move.description: The Pokémon gathers sunlight to re-energize themselves.

move.name: Rage Powder
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 2. Powder Move. All of the Foe's Physical and Special Moves will Target the user if able. Duration 1 Round.
move.description: The Pokémon releases an irritating powder that itches and enrages its foes into full-attack mode.

move.name: Acrobatics
move.effect: Single Target. *If the User has a Held Item, Reduce 2 Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move.
move.description: The Pokémon is quick and graceful, they cartwheel, contort and make a double back jump before landing onthe foe. Their best perfomance is done when they are unburdened.

move.name: Cotton Spore
move.effect: Single Target. Powder Move. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: The foe is covered head to toe in cotton fluff, disrupting its movement.

move.name: U-Turn
move.effect: Single Target. Switcher Move for User.
move.description: A bait and switch move, where the user strikes then makes a sudden u-turn back to safety.

move.name: Silver Wind
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Increase by 1 the User's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense, and Sp. Defense.
move.description: A beautiful but dangerous wind that blows a silver powder against the foe. The performance may give the user a big confidence boost.

move.name: Giga Drain
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The Pokémon drains most of the foe’s vital energy and feeds on the nutrients it managed to extract.

move.name: Memento
move.effect: Single Target. The User faints. Reduce by 2 the foe's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense, and Sp. Defense. Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon.
move.description: As they take their last breath, the Pokémon leaves behind an imprint of regret on their foe.

move.name: Sunny Day
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Activate Sunny Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The Pokémon will call for the sun to shine brighter, increasing the heat of the arena. This Move doesn’t work at night, indoors, or underground/water.

name: Latios
description: The legend tells about two Pokémon that could take human shapes, use psychic powers and become invisible. They were raised by an old couple as their own children. The boy was the oldest and wore a blue shirt.

abilityOne.name: Levitate
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon floats to move around without ever touching the ground.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon has immunity to Ground-Type moves and effects active on the battlefield such as Terrains and certain Entry Hazards.

move.name: Helping Hand
move.effect: Target One Ally. Reaction 5. The Target Gets 2 Extra Dice on their next Skill Check/Accuracy Roll, and 2 Extra Dice on their next Damage Roll. This Effect does not Stack.
move.description: The Pokémon is the first to come and give a hand to their friend. A true bro.

move.name: Safeguard
move.effect: Target User's side of the Field. Force Field. Those affected are immune to all Status Ailements/Conditions. Previously inflicted Status Ailments/Conditions remain. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A force field covers half of the battlefield and filters out all impurities and ill intentions coming from the other side.

move.name: Psywave
move.effect: Single Target. Roll Psychic-Type Damage Dice according to the User's Rank: Starter 1 Die / Rookie 2 Dice / Standard 4 Dice/ Advacned 6 Dice / Expert 8 Dice / Ace and forward 10 Dice. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: A powerful mental wave assault’s the target’s brain directly. Everything, from forgotten memories to the secrets of the universe bombard its mind in just a few seconds.

move.name: Heal Block
move.effect: Area Move. Those affected can't restore HP. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: Through a massive mental onslaught, the Pokémon brings back the memories of pain on everyone around.

move.name: Protect
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokemon would receive from a Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Moves that target the user.
move.description: A mighty energy shield materializes in front of the user to to deflect attacks and dispel ill effects.

move.name: Dragon Dance
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Dexterity.
move.description: The user performs a vigorous and mystical dance to boost their fighting spirit and reflexes.

move.name: Stored Power
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Die to the Damage Pool of this Move for each Attribute increase the User has, up to a maximum of 7 total Dice. (eg The User has 2 increased Points of Defense, add 2 Damage Dice.)
move.description: This move allows the user to release its power. If the user has any boosts, the damage is increased.

move.name: Refresh
move.effect: Target Self. The User heals itself from any Burn, Freeze, Poison and Paralysis. Sleep is not healed through this effect.
move.description: The Pokémon takes a few seconds to cool off, refocus, and get back in the game.

move.name: Heal Pulse
move.effect: Target One Ally. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate.
move.description: Commanding the mind over the matter, the Pokémon speeds up the healing process on an ally.

move.name: Dragon Breath
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A mystical flame breath that feels strengely cold to the touch. It doesn’t burn in a conventional way.

move.name: Luster Purge
move.effect: Single Target. Unique. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Reduce Sp. Defense by 1. *This effect can stack up to 3 times per Target.
move.description: The user engulfs itself in a blinding light and shoots a light beam at its foe, this light leaves the foe powerless to resist the assault.

move.name: Psycho Shift
move.effect: Single Target. Copy all of the User's Status Ailments into the Target. Afterwards, Heal the User from any Status Ailment.
move.description: Through sheer mental suggestion, the user actually makes their target feel their sickness. The user convinces themselves they are healed afterwards.

move.name: Recover
move.effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their energy to quickly mend wounds, their regenerative powers are beyond the imagination.

move.name: Telekinesis
move.effect: Single Target. Target becomes immune to Ground-Type Moves. Target can't Evade. Duration 2 Rounds.
move.description: The target levitates from the ground as the user’s telekinetic powers prevent its movement.

move.name: Zen Headbutt
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses both their mental and physical prowess in a questionable yet effective “psychic” strike.

move.name: Power Split
move.effect: Single Target. Average the User's Strength and Special with the Target's, rounded down.
move.description: Through a mental link both Pokémon are aware of each other strengths, which ends up evening the odds.

move.name: Psychic
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: The most iconic Psychic attack, the foe starts floating in the air and its swayed around by telekinesis as their mental barrier crumbles.

move.name: Dragon Pulse
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon sends out a powerful wave of energy through their mouth.

move.name: Memento
move.effect: Single Target. The User faints. Reduce by 2 the foe's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense, and Sp. Defense. Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon.
move.description: As they take their last breath, the Pokémon leaves behind an imprint of regret on their foe.

move.name: Camouflage
move.effect: Target Self. For the rest of the scene the User changes type to one that fits the terrain/ environment it is in (ie User is in a rocky cave, becoming rock type).
move.description: The Pokémon blends with their surroundings to increase their chances of survival.

move.name: Role Play
move.effect: Single Target. Replace the User's Ability with the Target's. Whole Scene Duration. Unique Abilities can't be copied.
move.description: The Pokémon is a great actor. Their impersonations are really good! ...maybe a bit too good.

name: Glalie
description: Its body is so hard it was thought to be made of rock. They can be aggressive if provoked. When they hunt, they freeze their prey solid before eating it. They can live in warm places without trouble.

abilityOne.name: Ice Body
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon's body is almost frozen, and can cool down enclosed areas in a few minutes. It feels most comfortable when temperatures are below zero.
abilityOne.effect: If Hail/Snow Weather is active, you may restore 1 HP to this Pokemon at the end of the Round. This Pokemon is immune to damage from Hail weather.

abilityTwo.name: Moody
abilityTwo.description: The Pokemon will have some severe mood swings, and be temperamental most of the time. Hopefully it's just a phase.
abilityTwo.effect: At the end of the Round, reset Attributes modified by Moody, then Reduce a random Attribute by 1 and Increase another random Attribute by 1.

move.name: Leer
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The vicious glare of a predator that triggers the flight response of their prey.

move.name: Icy Wind
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Wind Move. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: Polar winds sweep through the arena. Everyone starts to shiver and embrace themselves, trying to preserve a bit of warmth.

move.name: Protect
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokemon would receive from a Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Moves that target the user.
move.description: A mighty energy shield materializes in front of the user to to deflect attacks and dispel ill effects.

move.name: Frost Breath
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. This Move is always considered to be a Critical hit and gets the proper Bonus for it.
move.description: The user locates the most exposed parts of its foe and sends a gelid breath against it. The sudden chill goes right through the foe’s spine.

move.name: Hail
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Activate Hail Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The skies turn gray, and loud thunder rumbles, but what falls is not a gentle drizzle, but an endless stream of ice shards coming down at high speeds. Find shelter!

move.name: Crunch
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Lethal. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the foe's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon viciously mauls, tears, and rips apart anything its fangs can come in contact with.

move.name: Rollout
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions. *If all 5 actions land successfully, add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of the last hit of this Move. If the Pokemon used the Move "Defense Curl" in the same round, this Move's base Power becomes 2.
move.description: When the foe sees this Pokémon rollin’ they’ll be hatin’.

move.name: Astonish
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe.
move.description: The user sneaks behind their target to jump scare them.

move.name: Powder Snow
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Roll 1 Chance Die to Freeze those affected.
move.description: A light layer of snow flakes covers the foes, as the layers pile up the possibilities to be trapped into the snow increase.

move.name: Ice Shard
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Ranged.
move.description: With extraordinary swiftness, the Pokémon shoots an ice bullet like the fastest gun in the North Pole.

move.name: Double Team
move.effect: Target Self. The User can now make up to 5 Evasions per Round.
move.description: The Pokémon moves so fast they create a series of shadow copies of themselves. Trying to guess which one is the real one is a pain.

move.name: Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe
move.description: The user lands a vicious bite, leaving an ugly bruise.

move.name: Freeze Dry
move.effect: Single Target. Water-Type Pokemon receive Super-Effective Damage from this Move. If a Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dive" this Move hits anyways.
move.description: All moisture is frozen and then subjected to high pressure, evaporating it immediately. Water-type Pokémon suffer this Move the most.

move.name: Ice Fang
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Bite Move. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Freeze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon bites their foe with sharp teeth and a geli breath to chill their bones directly

move.name: Headbutt
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Out of battle it may cause a Random encounter when hitting trees and make objects drop from high places.
move.description: The Pokémon rams against their foe with their head. This Move is perfect to shake down trees when looking for berries, but beware of wild Pokémon nesting at the treetops.

move.name: Ice Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Freeze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a cold beam that reduces all warmth on the environment up to freezing point.

move.name: Blizzard
move.effect: All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Wind Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Freeze those affected. *Sunny Weather increases to Low Accuracy 4. **Hail/Snowy Weather remove Low Accuracy and adds the effect "Never Miss".
move.description: The user summons a turbulent and gelid wind that feels like ice daggers. A pleasant day may make it difficult to call upon, but beware if the temperatures go below zero.

move.name: Sheer Cold
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 5. Ranged. Deal Damage to the Target equal to its Remaining HP, plus 1 Lethal Damage.
move.description: The Pokémon reaches an absolute zero by being freezed from the inside out. Urgent medical attention is required.

move.name: Steel Roller
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Can't be used if there is no Active Terrain (Grassy Terrain, Electric Terrain, etc.) on the Battlefield. Remove any active Terrain on the Battlefield.
move.description: The Pokémon rolls into a wheel, destroying anything in their path. Buildings come crashing down, forests are swept away and the soil is left as a blank slate.

move.name: Explosion
move.effect: Area Move. Ranged. Lethal. The User Faints.
move.description: Through a massive explosion the Pokémon destroys all they can before fainting. Sometimes the only way to get out of a bad situation is in bits and pieces.

name: Kyurem (Black Form)
description: In the icy mountains at the east of Unova, you can hear the wails of a creature suffering as if it missed a part of its very soul. Dark clouds and lightning are sure to follow.

abilityOne.name: Teravolt
abilityOne.description: There's a ball of blue lightning coming out of this Pokemon that prevents its foes from being out of reach, no matter what you do, it will zap you.
abilityOne.effect: If a Type, Move, Item or Ability would prevent this Pokemon from targeting a foe or inflicting an effect, ignore it. (e.g. A Pokemon with Immunity can be Poisoned, Ground-Type Pokemon can be hit with Electric Moves, etc.) Unique Ability.

move.name: Icy Wind
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Wind Move. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: Polar winds sweep through the arena. Everyone starts to shiver and embrace themselves, trying to preserve a bit of warmth.

move.name: Dragon Rage
move.effect: Single Target. Set Damage. Deal 2 Dragon-Type Damage to the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon focuses their inner rage and makes it not-soinner anymore.

move.name: Imprison
move.effect: Target Self. While the User is on the battlefield, Moves known by the User cannot be used by foes. This effect ends if the User is removed from battle.
move.description: This move blocks all shared parts of a memory the user is well aware of. Moves, techniques, names, places, people or situations, no one will be able to recall those imprisoned memories.

move.name: Ancient Power
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Increase by 1 the User's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense and Sp. Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon calls forward an energy from the ancient past. This may infuse the user with a primal strength.

move.name: Ice Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Freeze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a cold beam that reduces all warmth on the environment up to freezing point.

move.name: Dragon Breath
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A mystical flame breath that feels strengely cold to the touch. It doesn’t burn in a conventional way.

move.name: Slash
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical. Cutter Move.
move.description: The Pokémon uses the sharpest part of their body as a blade to tear and slash with vicious intent.

move.name: Scary Face
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: When a Pokémon looks at you like THAT, you know you gotta thread carefully around them.

move.name: Glaciate
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Lethal. Unique. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those Affected. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Freeze those Affected.
move.description: The air is so cold it hurts to move, to see, to breath. Escaping should be your top priority, for every second you don’t your life will be at peril.

move.name: Dragon Pulse
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon sends out a powerful wave of energy through their mouth.

move.name: Noble Roar
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Reduce by 1 the Target's Strength and Special.
move.description: The mighty roar of a king. It commands respect and authority over anyone who listens.

move.name: Endeavor
move.effect: Single Target. Roll Dice of Normal-Type Damage equal to the difference between the User's current HP and the Target's max HP. Ignore defenses. Up to 10 Dice may be rolled this way. This Damage cannot make the Target's HP go lower than the User's current HP.
move.description: Through sheer willpower the Pokémon manages to level the conditions of the battle despite their own injuries.

move.name: Blizzard
move.effect: All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Wind Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Freeze those affected. *Sunny Weather increases to Low Accuracy 4. **Hail/Snowy Weather remove Low Accuracy and adds the effect "Never Miss".
move.description: The user summons a turbulent and gelid wind that feels like ice daggers. A pleasant day may make it difficult to call upon, but beware if the temperatures go below zero.

move.name: Outrage
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
move.description: The true nature of dragon-types unleashed. The user is consumed by a primal fury that won’t stop until everything has ben razed to the ground. Afterwards the Pokémon is confused.

move.name: Hyper Voice
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move.
move.description: The user screeches or sings at such high frequencies that anything made of glass will break. The ears of the victims are left in no better state.

move.name: Topsy-Turvy
move.effect: Single Target. Increased Attributes on the Target become Reductions instead and vice versa.
move.description: Though clever manipulation the Pokémon switches their foe’s morality compass. Bad things become good and bad things become bad.

move.name: Future Sight
move.effect: Single Target. This Move's damage is dealt at the beginning of the next Round. Ignore Shield Moves, Force Field, Cover & Substitute. If the target restires or switches out from battle, the damage will be dealt to the next opponent or to one of its allies.
move.description: The Pokémon foresees something terrible happening. Although when it tries to see their own future, the images are ever changing.

move.name: Recover
move.effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their energy to quickly mend wounds, their regenerative powers are beyond the imagination.

move.name: Fusion Bolt
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Unique. *If the Move "Fusion Flare" has already been used by anyone this Round, add 4 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move.
move.description: The Pokémon strikes with a devastating electric impact, said impact will grow larger and stronger if there’s a special kind of fire nearby.

move.name: Bolt Strike
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Unique. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Paralyze the foe.
move.description: Zekrom delivers a powerful tackle while discharging lightning through its body. The foe is rendered unable to move, either by the strike of the electricity.

move.name: Aurora Veil
move.effect: Target User's Side of the Field. Force Field against Physical & Special Damage. This move will fail if not performed under Hail/Snowy Weather. Duration 4 Rounds, even if Hail or Snow Weather is over.
move.description: If the weather is cold enough, beautiful aurora lights will cover half of the battlefield, deflecting attacks.

move.name: Mist
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Targets cannot have their Attributes or Traits Reduced. Previously Reduced Attributes and Traits remain. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A thick layer of mist cloaks a pack of pokémon, those with the intent to trick and weaken them will have to find them first.

move.name: Haze
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Remove all Increased or Reduced Attributes and Traits of everyone on the battlefield.
move.description: The battlefield is filled with a cleansing cloud that takes away all impurities in the field. It can also work as concealment.

move.name: Substitute
move.effect: Target Self. Deal 2 damage to the User. Put a Substitute Decoy with 2 HP and the same defenses as the user. See p. 531
move.description: The Pokémon disappears in a poof of smoke. A decoy identical to the user takes their place in battle. The user keeps attacking from the shadows while the decoy serves as distraction.

move.description: The Pokémon reaches an absolute zero by being freezed from the inside out. Urgent medical attention is required.

move.name: Draco Meteor
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. lethal. Reduce User's Special by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon summons a meteor to fall from the sky directly into their foes, dealing a brutal amount of damage. An impressive display if power that demands a lot of energy.

name: Latias (Mega Form)
description: Latias is very in sync with human emotions; it can communicate using telepathy. With the power of the Mega Stone, all of its capabilities are enhanced, although its personality becomes more distant than usual.

move.description: When you wish upon a star it makes no difference who you are, anything your heart desires will come to you.

move.name: Water Sport
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Physical & Special Fire-Type Moves have Power 0. Pokemon weak to Fire-Type Moves won't receive Super-Effective Damage from them. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A single drop of water can’t put off a raging fire, but what is the ocean but a collection of drops.

move.description: The Pokémon engages their foe in a charming interaction to reduce their aggressive intent.

move.name: Water Sport

move.description: A single drop of water can’t put off a raging fire, but what is the ocean but a collection of drops.

move.name: Scratch

move.description: The Pokémon showcase their muscles through poses that highlight their fitness and bodybuilding discipline.

move.name: Cross Chop
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. High Critical.
move.description: The Pokémon delivers a chop with crossed arms, a quite impractical but extremely cool technique.

move.name: Scary Face
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: When a Pokémon looks at you like THAT, you know you gotta thread carefully around them.

move.name: Meditate
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Special and Sp. Defense.
move.description: Through meditation the Pokémon brings forward their mind’s strength into their body.

move.name: Bullet Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Fist Move.
move.description: You cannot outrun a bullet.

move.name: Ice Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 1 Chance Dice to Freeze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon wears their ice gloves to punch the foe. Yes. Gloves made of ice.

move.name: Strength
move.effect: Outside of battle, using this move allows the Pokemon to lift double the normal weight it should be able to.
move.description: The Pokemon strains its muscles to go beyond their own limits.

move.name: Submission
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Recoil.
move.description: The Pokémon wrestles their foe to subdue it, but the foe will put up a fight before they let it happen.

move.name: Dual Chop
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Double Action.
move.description: Two brutal blows are all this Pokémon needs to make the opponent yield to their might.

move.name: Wake-Up Slap
move.effect: Single Target. *If the foe has the Sleep Status, Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool. Wake up the foe after dealing damage.
move.description: Wakey wakey, sleepy head!

move.name: Double-Edge
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil.
move.description: Without regard for their own safety, the Pokémon does a reckless attack against their foe.

move.name: Dynamic Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Fist Move. Confuse the Target.
move.description: A punch to a vital pressure point on the foe to disrupt their sense of balance

name: Gothitelle
description: They can predict the future from the placement and movement of the stars. They get restless if someone they know will be in danger. They are empathic creatures that can understand human emotion.

abilityOne.name: Competitive
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon's determination grows in the face of adversity. It is always trying to compete with those around it.
abilityOne.effect: The first time this Pokemon gets an Attribute reduced by a foe during a battle, Increase its Special by 2.

abilityTwo.name: Shadow Tag
abilityTwo.description: The Pokemon can physically take a hold of shadows to make them act on their own or capture their victims.
abilityTwo.effect: All Targets in Range become Blocked. Ghost-type Pokemon are immune to this effect. Pokemon with the same ability are immune to this effect.

move.name: Pound
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user pounds the target’s head. Simple

move.name: Confusion
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Confuse the Target.
move.description: A basic mental assault that makes the foe believe they are being attacked by an invisible enemy.

move.name: Tickle
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce by 1 the Target's Strength and Defense.
move.description: Whoever said laughter is the best therapy lied.

move.name: Play Nice
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Strength by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon starts to play with the foe. They are firendly, respectful, and thank the foe for the fun time. The foe does not want to fight, they want to keep playing.

move.name: Double Slap
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Double Action.
move.description: The name is misleading as the user slaps withouth even counting how many slaps they have given already

move.name: Psybeam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Confuse the Target.
move.description: The foe’s mind isassaulted by a mental ray, afterwards they may suffer from hallucinations.

move.name: Psyshock
move.effect: Single Target. This Move is resisted with the Target's Defense instead of its Sp. Defense.
move.description: The shock is mental, the blow is real.

move.name: Telekinesis
move.effect: Single Target. Target becomes immune to Ground-Type Moves. Target can't Evade. Duration 2 Rounds.
move.description: The target levitates from the ground as the user’s telekinetic powers prevent its movement.

move.name: Heal Pulse
move.effect: Target One Ally. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate.
move.description: Commanding the mind over the matter, the Pokémon speeds up the healing process on an ally.

move.name: Dark Pulse
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: A haze of dark energy decends on the battlefield preying on those vulnerable to the obscure feelings and fears it provokes.

move.name: Charm
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce Target's Strength by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon engages their foe in a charming interaction to reduce their aggressive intent.

move.name: Hypnosis
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Put the Target to sleep. Dark-Type Pokemon are affected by this Move.
move.description: By staring at an hypnotic pendulum, the target is suggestioned to feel tired and close its eyelids.

move.name: Fake Tears
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce foe's Sp. Defense by 2.
move.description: The user stops mid-combat to start crying; feeling incredibly guilty, the foe lowers its guard.

move.name: Cosmic Power
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon elevates their cosmos to enhance their physical and mental fortitude.

move.name: Energy Ball
move.effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: Gathering nature’s energy from nearby plants, trees and roots, the Pokémon forms a ball to shoot at the enemy. Sadly, the surrounding plants will be dry afterwards.

move.name: Feint Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Never Miss.
move.description: The user approaches inconspicuously, pretending to attack the foe directly, then actually hits the foe from behind.

move.name: Psych Up
move.effect: Single Target. The User gets the same Attribute/Trait Increases and Reductions the Target has.
move.description: The Pokémon mentalizes themselves stronger than anyone. They feel good. They can win. They. Can. Do. This!

move.name: Embargo
move.effect: Single Target. The Target loses its Held Item. Target's Trainer & Partners can't use Items on the Target. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The user demands the held item of a Pokémon and the items in the bag of their trainer. Scared, both Pokémon and Trainer comply

move.name: Flatter
move.effect: Single Target. Increase the Target's Special by 1. Confuse the Target.
move.description: The user starts flattering and admiring its opponent. It sure makes them feel good about themselves but...why?!

move.name: Psychic
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: The most iconic Psychic attack, the foe starts floating in the air and its swayed around by telekinesis as their mental barrier crumbles.

move.name: Dream Eater
move.effect: Single Target. Can only be used if the Target has the Sleep Condition, otherwise it will fail. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The Pokémon enters the dream world for a snack. The dreams of children and baby Pokémon are the tastiest.

move.name: Mirror Coat
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 5. Can only be used if Target's last Move on User was a Special Move. For damage, roll dice equal to Target's last damage pool rolled against the User plus 2. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The user gathers the harmful energies around themselves and bounces them back to their source.

move.name: Heal Block
move.effect: Area Move. Those affected can't restore HP. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: Through a massive mental onslaught, the Pokémon brings back the memories of pain on everyone around.

move.name: Future Sight
move.effect: Single Target. This Move's damage is dealt at the beginning of the next Round. Ignore Shield Moves, Force Field, Cover & Substitute. If the target restires or switches out from battle, the damage will be dealt to the next opponent or to one of its allies.
move.description: The Pokémon foresees something terrible happening. Although when it tries to see their own future, the images are ever changing.

move.name: Magic Room
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Held items lose their effects. No items can be used. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The entire battlefield becomes a room on which the laws of the material world are rendered useless.

move.name: Nasty Plot
move.effect: Target Self. Increase User's Special by 2.
move.description: Rubbing both hands and laughing sinisterly the Pokémon rejoices in the evil plans they’ll soon carry out.

name: Hakamo-o
description: The scales on its body are shed and regrow sharper each time. It is a courageous and diligent Pokémon who always lets out a war cry before the battle. Any marks on its scale armor is worn with pride.

abilityOne.name: Overcoat
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon will have a protective coat surrounding its body that allows it to live under extreme weather conditions.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon won't recieve damage from active weather.

abilityTwo.name: Soundproof
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon's body is structured to protect it from noises that might disturb its peace and focus. So it's not ignoring you, it just can't hear you.
abilityTwo.effect: This Pokemon is immune to the Damage and Added Effects of all Sound-based moves.

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Leer
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The vicious glare of a predator that triggers the flight response of their prey.

move.name: Bide
move.effect: Single Target. The User will not Evade or Clash the next 2 Physical or Special Moves targeting it. Once all damage has been dealt against the User, roll a number of Normal-Type Damage dice equal to twice the total amount of Damage the Target received. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The user puts up with being hit, waiting for the perfect opportunity to retaliate.

move.name: Protect
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokemon would receive from a Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Moves that target the user.
move.description: A mighty energy shield materializes in front of the user to to deflect attacks and dispel ill effects.

move.name: Dragon Tail
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Late Reaction 6. Switcher Move for the Foe. In the wild, the battle may end.
move.description: The Pokémon sends their opponent flying up to 100ft in the air with a strong flick of their tail.

move.name: Scary Face
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: When a Pokémon looks at you like THAT, you know you gotta thread carefully around them.

move.name: Headbutt
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Out of battle it may cause a Random encounter when hitting trees and make objects drop from high places.
move.description: The Pokémon rams against their foe with their head. This Move is perfect to shake down trees when looking for berries, but beware of wild Pokémon nesting at the treetops.

move.name: Noble Roar
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Reduce by 1 the Target's Strength and Special.
move.description: The mighty roar of a king. It commands respect and authority over anyone who listens.

move.name: Autotomize
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Dexterity by 2. Halve the User's weight.
move.description: Rotating parts and tiny gears, the Pokémon works like a welloiled machine.

move.name: Dragon Dance
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Dexterity.
move.description: The user performs a vigorous and mystical dance to boost their fighting spirit and reflexes.

move.name: Counter
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 5. Can only be used if Target's last Move on User was a Physical Move. For damage, roll dice equal to Target's last damage pool rolled against the User plus 2 dice. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The Pokémon strikes back at their foe. Showing they can take a hit and punch even harder.

move.name: Dragon Breath
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A mystical flame breath that feels strengely cold to the touch. It doesn’t burn in a conventional way.

move.name: Work Up
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Special.
move.description: The Pokémon has spent a lot of time training and doesn’t miss the chance to show off their muscles and fitness. After the battle they share routines and tips with the other Pokémon.

move.name: Screech
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Reduce the Target's Defense by 2.
move.description: A mighty screech will make the target cover its ears instead of covering its flanks.

move.name: Iron Defense
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
move.description: Iron body, iron will. This Pokémon is unbreakable.

move.name: Dragon Claw
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses its strong claws to deliver a fierce tearing blow.

move.name: Scale Shot
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged. Successive Actions. *If all 5 actions land successfully, Increase the User's Dexterity by 1, and lower the User's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon’s scales burst out as if they were shrapnel from a grenade.

move.name: Sky Uppercut
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Low Accuracy 1. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop" this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The user attacks with an uppercut, throwing the foe skyward with lots of force. Even flyers are not safe from this attack.

move.name: Outrage
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
move.description: The true nature of dragon-types unleashed. The user is consumed by a primal fury that won’t stop until everything has ben razed to the ground. Afterwards the Pokémon is confused.

move.name: Close Combat
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce by 1 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon gets close enough to deal devastating damage, but the same can be said for the foe.

move.name: Uproar
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Sound Move. This Effect Targets the Battle Field: Pokemon will be cured of the Sleep Status. Duration 1 Round.
move.description: Shouts, screams, and loud music... What does a Pokémon have to do here for a peaceful night of sleep?

name: Kyurem (White Form)
description: In the icy mountains at the west of Unova, you can hear the wails of a creature suffering as if it missed a part of its very soul. Explosions and blue fires are sure to follow.

abilityOne.name: Turboblaze
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon surrounds everything with a giant ball of swirling flames that prevents its foes from being out of reach, there is no escaping the heat.
abilityOne.effect: If a Type, Move, Item or Ability would prevent this Pokemon from targeting a foe or inflicting an effect, ignore it. (e.g. A Pokemon with Immunity can be Poisoned, Ground-Type Pokemon can be hit with Electric Moves, etc.) Unique Ability.

move.name: Icy Wind
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Wind Move. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: Polar winds sweep through the arena. Everyone starts to shiver and embrace themselves, trying to preserve a bit of warmth.

move.name: Dragon Rage
move.effect: Single Target. Set Damage. Deal 2 Dragon-Type Damage to the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon focuses their inner rage and makes it not-soinner anymore.

move.name: Imprison
move.effect: Target Self. While the User is on the battlefield, Moves known by the User cannot be used by foes. This effect ends if the User is removed from battle.
move.description: This move blocks all shared parts of a memory the user is well aware of. Moves, techniques, names, places, people or situations, no one will be able to recall those imprisoned memories.

move.name: Ancient Power
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Increase by 1 the User's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense and Sp. Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon calls forward an energy from the ancient past. This may infuse the user with a primal strength.

move.name: Ice Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Freeze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a cold beam that reduces all warmth on the environment up to freezing point.

move.name: Dragon Breath
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A mystical flame breath that feels strengely cold to the touch. It doesn’t burn in a conventional way.

move.name: Slash
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical. Cutter Move.
move.description: The Pokémon uses the sharpest part of their body as a blade to tear and slash with vicious intent.

move.name: Scary Face
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: When a Pokémon looks at you like THAT, you know you gotta thread carefully around them.

move.name: Glaciate
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Lethal. Unique. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those Affected. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Freeze those Affected.
move.description: The air is so cold it hurts to move, to see, to breath. Escaping should be your top priority, for every second you don’t your life will be at peril.

move.name: Dragon Pulse
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon sends out a powerful wave of energy through their mouth.

move.name: Noble Roar
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Reduce by 1 the Target's Strength and Special.
move.description: The mighty roar of a king. It commands respect and authority over anyone who listens.

move.name: Endeavor
move.effect: Single Target. Roll Dice of Normal-Type Damage equal to the difference between the User's current HP and the Target's max HP. Ignore defenses. Up to 10 Dice may be rolled this way. This Damage cannot make the Target's HP go lower than the User's current HP.
move.description: Through sheer willpower the Pokémon manages to level the conditions of the battle despite their own injuries.

move.name: Blizzard
move.effect: All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Wind Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Freeze those affected. *Sunny Weather increases to Low Accuracy 4. **Hail/Snowy Weather remove Low Accuracy and adds the effect "Never Miss".
move.description: The user summons a turbulent and gelid wind that feels like ice daggers. A pleasant day may make it difficult to call upon, but beware if the temperatures go below zero.

move.name: Outrage
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
move.description: The true nature of dragon-types unleashed. The user is consumed by a primal fury that won’t stop until everything has ben razed to the ground. Afterwards the Pokémon is confused.

move.name: Hyper Voice
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move.
move.description: The user screeches or sings at such high frequencies that anything made of glass will break. The ears of the victims are left in no better state.

move.name: Topsy-Turvy
move.effect: Single Target. Increased Attributes on the Target become Reductions instead and vice versa.
move.description: Though clever manipulation the Pokémon switches their foe’s morality compass. Bad things become good and bad things become bad.

move.name: Lucky Chant
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Unique. Targets can Re-roll one un-successful die from all their rolls. Critical Hits do not grant Bonus dice against the Targets. Whole Scene Duration. Out of battle, good things happen at Storyteller's Discretion.
move.description: The magical incantation of an old priestess, through dance and song, good fortune and divine protection will come to you. This Move also removes evil spirits and curses.

move.name: Recover
move.effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their energy to quickly mend wounds, their regenerative powers are beyond the imagination.

move.name: Fusion Flare
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Unique. *If the Move "Fusion Bolt" has already been used by anyone this Round, add 4 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move.
move.description: The Pokémon sets ablaze a swirling pillar upon the target, said pillar will grow taller and swirl faster if there’s a special kind of charge nearby.

move.name: Blue Flare
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Unique. Roll 2 Chance Dice to inflict 3rd Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: Reshiram surrounds itself with giant blue flame that is unleashed with an earth shattering explosion. Receiving this attack directly might competely engulf you in fire.

move.name: Freeze Dry
move.effect: Single Target. Water-Type Pokemon receive Super-Effective Damage from this Move. If a Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dive" this Move hits anyways.
move.description: All moisture is frozen and then subjected to high pressure, evaporating it immediately. Water-type Pokémon suffer this Move the most.

move.name: Hail
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Activate Hail Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The skies turn gray, and loud thunder rumbles, but what falls is not a gentle drizzle, but an endless stream of ice shards coming down at high speeds. Find shelter!

move.name: Aurora Veil
move.effect: Target User's Side of the Field. Force Field against Physical & Special Damage. This move will fail if not performed under Hail/Snowy Weather. Duration 4 Rounds, even if Hail or Snow Weather is over.
move.description: If the weather is cold enough, beautiful aurora lights will cover half of the battlefield, deflecting attacks.

move.name: Mist
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Targets cannot have their Attributes or Traits Reduced. Previously Reduced Attributes and Traits remain. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A thick layer of mist cloaks a pack of pokémon, those with the intent to trick and weaken them will have to find them first.

move.name: Haze
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Remove all Increased or Reduced Attributes and Traits of everyone on the battlefield.
move.description: The battlefield is filled with a cleansing cloud that takes away all impurities in the field. It can also work as concealment.

move.name: Substitute
move.effect: Target Self. Deal 2 damage to the User. Put a Substitute Decoy with 2 HP and the same defenses as the user. See p. 531
move.description: The Pokémon disappears in a poof of smoke. A decoy identical to the user takes their place in battle. The user keeps attacking from the shadows while the decoy serves as distraction.

move.name: Sheer Cold
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 5. Ranged. Deal Damage to the Target equal to its Remaining HP, plus 1 Lethal Damage.
move.description: The Pokémon reaches an absolute zero by being freezed from the inside out. Urgent medical attention is required.

move.name: Draco Meteor
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. lethal. Reduce User's Special by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon summons a meteor to fall from the sky directly into their foes, dealing a brutal amount of damage. An impressive display if power that demands a lot of energy.

name: Magcargo
description: Their shell is molten body that cooled off and hardened. It may appear solid, but it may burst into flames with a single touch. Water vaporizes on contact and rain turns into a cloud of steam.

abilityOne.name: Flame Body
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon can willingly ignite its body on fire, receiving no harm from it. Objects that come into contact with this Pokemon may catch fire.
abilityOne.effect: When hit by a Non-Ranged Physical Move, this Pokemon rolls 3 Chance Dice to inflict 2nd degree Burn on the foe.

abilityTwo.name: Magma Armor
abilityTwo.description: The body of the Pokemon is always hot to the touch, it can heat a large room just by standing inside and can also endure high temperatures.
abilityTwo.effect: This Pokemon is immune to the Frozen Status Ailment.

hiddenAbility.name: Weak Armor
hiddenAbility.description: This Pokemon's protective outer layers can come off, allowing it to move freely and be more agile.
hiddenAbility.effect: The first time this Pokemon is hit by any Physical Move, Increase its Dexterity Attribute by 1 and Reduce its Defense by 1.

move.name: Yawn
move.effect: Single Target. *If the Target has not been removed from battle at the beginning of the next Round, put it to Sleep.
move.description: The user yawns, the foe yawns, the trainers yawn... everyone should take a nap.

move.name: Smog
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Roll 4 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon releases a stream of filthy gases. The foe may try to hold their breath, but for how long?

move.name: Rock Throw
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged.
move.description: Back in the day, this was a common form of amusement amongst Pokémon and children alike.

move.name: Ember
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: A basic fire attack, but not any less dangerous. Even a small flame can grow out of control.

move.name: Harden
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 1.
move.description: When life gets hard, do the same.

move.name: Incinerate
move.effect: Single Target. All Foes in Range. Destroy the held item of those affected.
move.description: A small blast of fire that instantly consumes small flammable objects.

move.name: Recover
move.effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their energy to quickly mend wounds, their regenerative powers are beyond the imagination.

move.name: Clear Smog
move.effect: Single Target. Never Miss. Reset all Increased or Reduced Attributes on the Foe.
move.description: The user shoots a blast of venomous pins that inject venom into the foe, this venom is specially potent against those already compromised.

move.name: Shell Smash
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 2 the User's Strength, Special and Dexterity. Reduce by 2 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon breaks off their own shell. The foe mistakenly believed the shell was for the Pokémon to protect themselves when it was actually there to protect the foes from what’s next.

move.name: Self Destruct
move.effect: Area Move. Lethal. Ranged. The User faints.
move.description: It’s not about winning or losing, some pokémon just want to see the world burn.

move.name: Tar Shot
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 1. For the Whole Scene, Fire-Type Moves deal Super-Effective damage against the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon gushes a blob of black tar over its foe. The unfortunate victim can barely move afterwards, keep it away from fire sources, tar is extremely flammable.

move.name: Ancient Power
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Increase by 1 the User's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense and Sp. Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon calls forward an energy from the ancient past. This may infuse the user with a primal strength.

move.name: Flame Burst
move.effect: Single Target. After dealing damage, the User may roll 1 die of Fire-Type Damage against two other targets, ignoring defenses.
move.description: A compact fireball that bursts just as it hits the foe, scattering smaller flames to unsuspecting bystanders.

move.name: Amnesia
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Sp. Defense by 2.
move.description: No thoughts. Head empty

move.name: Flamethrower
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 2nd Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: The most emblematic fire attack, a seeminly endless stream of fire that reduces everything and everyone to ashes.

move.name: Body Slam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The user charges against the foe using ther body to slam it down, leaving the target stunned.

move.name: Lava Plume
move.effect: Area Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to inflict 1st Degree Burn on those affected.
move.description: The floor is lava. The sky is lava. Everywhere is lava. Hundreds of lava bits start raining scattered around the field.

move.name: Rock Slide
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch those affected.
move.description: Don’t worry, even if you are not the fastest one in the race, you can still win by a landslide.

move.name: Earth Power
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: The user sends out a subterranean wave that bursts the ground below the target. It’s as if the earth bends to the user’s will.

move.name: Scorching Sands
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the foe.
move.description: The sand around the user heats to scorching temperatures as it is thrown against their foe.

move.name: Burn Up
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. After damage is dealt, the user loses its Fire-Type. If its only type was Fire, it is now Typeless. User's Physical & Special Fire-Type Moves have Power 0. Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the User.
move.description: The User unleashes all of its might through a massive blast of raging fire. Although the damage is devastating the Pokémon is left unable to produce more fire for a while.

name: Liepard
description: It's difficult to see one in the wild. These Pokémon vanish and appear, attacking unexpectedly. Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful fur and elegant appeal, but they can be quite dangerous.

abilityOne.name: Limber
abilityOne.description: The muscles of this Pokemon are incredibly flexible and elastic. Easing their movement, agility, and grace.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon is immune to Paralysis Status Ailment.

abilityTwo.name: Prankster
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon will always have a mischievous twinkle in its eyes, no one around will be safe from its pranks.
abilityTwo.effect: All Support Moves used by this Pokemon are considered to have: "Reaction 1" as Added Effect.

move.name: Scratch
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their sharp claws to scratch the enemy. Nothing fancy but it works.

move.name: Growl
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Reduce by 1 the Strength of those affected.
move.description: Either through a menacing attitude or an adorable demeanor, the foe will hesitate to attack the user at full power.

move.name: Assist
move.effect: Target One Ally. Copy Move. Choose one Move known by an Ally or member of your party, who may or may not be active in battle. You may choose another Target(s) for the Move. Unique Moves can't be copied.
move.description: The user hurriedly remembers actions performed by others and mimics them. Some Pokémon can even imitate human tasks and help carry them out.

move.name: Sand Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce by 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.
move.description: Sand to the eyes! A dirty tactic in more ways than one.

move.name: Fury Swipes
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions.
move.description: With their sharp claws, the Pokémon will swiftly scatch their foe, leaving its face full of small cuts.

move.name: Pursuit
move.effect: Single Target. *If a Target hit by this Move is recalled, attempts to Run Away, uses a Switcher Move or is the Target of a Switcher Move, Deal 2 Typeless Damage to it. Outside of battle, aid in catching a fleeing target.
move.description: The Pokémon is relentless in its pursuit of their target, striking it just as it believed it had escaped.

move.name: Torment
move.effect: Single Target. The Target cannot use any of the Moves it used during the last Round. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The Pokémon bullies their foe to the point of torment where they cannot keep using their strategy without feeling bad about it.

move.name: Fake Out
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Flinch the Target. This Move will only work on the First Round the User is out in battle. from the Second Round on, it will fail automatically.
move.description: The Pokémon pretends to be getting ready for the battle when they are actually prepairing a surprise attack on the foe.

move.name: Sucker Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 6. *This move can only be used as a Late Reaction; and only if the Target used a Physical or Special Move, otherwise it will fail.
move.description: The Pokémon takes advantage of their foe preparing to attack to unleash a dirty surprise blow.

move.name: Charm
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce Target's Strength by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon engages their foe in a charming interaction to reduce their aggressive intent.

move.name: Fake Tears
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce foe's Sp. Defense by 2.
move.description: The user stops mid-combat to start crying; feeling incredibly guilty, the foe lowers its guard.

move.name: Assurance
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 2 extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move if the Target has already received Damage from the User this Round.
move.description: The user indentifies the weakest foe and charges against them.

move.name: Hone Claws
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength score and Accuracy Pools.
move.description: Sharp claws make for more precise and deadly attacks.

move.name: Captivate
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 2 the Special of those affected.
move.description: The Pokémon shows off their attractiveness and even flirts with the opponents, those who fall for their charms can’t keep focus on the battle.

move.name: Attract
move.effect: Single Target. Target is now In Love with the User.
move.description: Through their good looks and coquetish attitude, the Pokémon makes everyone develop a crush on them.

move.name: Snarl
move.effect: Target all foes in Range. Sound Move. Reduce by 1 the Special of those affected
move.description: The Pokémon viciously snarls showing its teeth to the foes. This menacing look will make everyone cower in fear.

move.name: Snatch
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 6. Remove any Increase/Reduction on the Foe's Attributes, Active Shield Moves, Healing effects on the Foe, or effects on its side of the field; and place them on the User instead. See p. 531 for more info.
move.description: The user takes notice of the good stuff on the other side and quickly takes it for themselves. Finders keepers, losers weepers!

move.name: Nasty Plot
move.effect: Target Self. Increase User's Special by 2.
