move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Sp. Defense by 2.
move.description: No thoughts. Head empty

move.name: Recycle
move.effect: Target Self. The Pokemon reuses an Item (Berries, Potions, Full Heal, etc.) that has already been spent during the battle on any side of the battlefield. Recycle can't be used more than 3 times per battle by the User.
move.description: One Pokémon’s trash is another one’s treasure.

move.name: Covet
move.effect: Single Target. The User steals the Target's Held Item. If the User already has a Held Item, this effect fails.
move.description: The Pokémon is attracted to shiny and colorful items. They don’t understand when something is not theirs for the taking so they just take it when no one is looking.

move.name: Metronome
move.effect: Single Target. Copy Move. Roll a die to determine Physical or Special category, roll a die to determine this Move's Power. The appearance, Type and added effects of this Move becomes the same of a Physical or Special Move of the same Power at Storyteller's Discretion.
move.description: The Pokémon waves their hands following a specific rythm, the energy around follows the cadence and manifests as a Move at random.

move.name: Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe
move.description: The user lands a vicious bite, leaving an ugly bruise.

move.name: Swallow
move.effect: Target Self. The user must have previously used the Move "Stockpile", otherwise this Move will fail. Complete Heal, if successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Reduce by 1 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense.
move.description: After stockpiling, the Pokémon swallows the energy to restore their health, they go back to their normal size afterwards.

move.name: Body Slam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The user charges against the foe using ther body to slam it down, leaving the target stunned.

move.name: Rollout
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions. *If all 5 actions land successfully, add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of the last hit of this Move. If the Pokemon used the Move "Defense Curl" in the same round, this Move's base Power becomes 2.
move.description: When the foe sees this Pokémon rollin’ they’ll be hatin’.

move.name: Belch
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Sound Move. The user must eat a berry or something similar during the Round before using this Move, otherwise it will fail. This effect only works once per berry/food eaten.
move.description: The user shoots a blast of venomous pins that inject venom into the foe, this venom is specially potent against those already compromised.

move.name: Fling
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. *If the User is holding an Item, Add up to 4 dice to the damage pool. User loses its Held Item. See p. 530
move.description: The Pokémon takes their held item, uses it as a weapon and the referee is somehow OK with this. The held item remains in the field and may be recovered after the battle.

move.name: Flail
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of this Move for every missing Point of HP the user has. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The user flails around trying to stay alive, as they get closer to fainting, more adrenaline will fuel their efforts of survival.

move.name: Belly Drum
move.effect: Target Self. Roll half of the User's HP as Typeless Damage Dice to itself, ignore defenses. Increase User's Strengt by 3.
move.description: With an angry war cry the user hits their belly as drums of war.

move.name: Last Resort
move.effect: Single Target. This Move will fail if the User has not successfully performed all of its known Moves at least once during the battle.
move.description: The Pokémon may be out of energy, but never out of options.

move.name: Power-Up Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Increase User's Strength by 1.
move.description: A punch to test the impact’s surface and adjust the level of strength required to punch through it.

name: Sandile
description: They live hidden under the desert sands with only their eyes and nostrils visible. They don't prey on anything bigger than themselves but can be troublesome if they are being lead by one of their evolved forms.

abilityOne.name: Intimidate
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon has an overwhelming presence that inspires both fear and respect from others.
abilityOne.effect: When this Pokemon comes into battle, Reduce by 1 the Strength of All foes in Range. This effect will last for as long as this Pokemon is out. Outside of battle, wild Pokemon will avoid the party if this Pokemon is out.

abilityTwo.name: Moxie
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon is naturally fierce and will try to get to a position of power by defeating the alphas in the pack.
abilityTwo.effect: If a foe faints because of a Physical or Special Move used by this Pokemon, Increase its Strength Attribute by 1. Up to 3 points can be increased this way.

hiddenAbility.name: Anger Point
hiddenAbility.description: The Pokemon will easily get aggressive. Little to no provocation is needed for it to start throwing a tantrum and ripping everything to shreds.
hiddenAbility.effect: If a foe lands a Critical Hit on this Pokemon, increase this Pokemon's Strength Attribute by 3.

move.name: Leer
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The vicious glare of a predator that triggers the flight response of their prey.

move.name: Sand Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce by 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.
move.description: Sand to the eyes! A dirty tactic in more ways than one.

move.name: Sand Tomb
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Ranged. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion.
move.description: The Pokémon creates a pit of shifting sand around the foe to bury it alive. The poor victim struggles for air as the sand keeps sinking it lower and lower.

move.name: Mud Slap
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.
move.description: A mud ball splatters right into the foe’s face, reducing their field of vision.

move.name: Swagger
move.effect: Single Target. Increase the Target's Strength by 2. Confuse the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon’s arrogant and mocking attitude enrage their foe and make it lose focus in battle.

move.name: Dig
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Earth Power/ Earthquake/ Fissure/ Magnitude/ Stomping Tantrum. Out of battle allows the Pokemon to burrow and make underground tunnels.
move.description: The user digs a tunnel on the ground and attacks by coming out from below its target. This move has been used to escape caves and gain access to highly surveiled places.

move.name: Scary Face
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: When a Pokémon looks at you like THAT, you know you gotta thread carefully around them.

move.name: Foul Play
move.effect: Single Target. S.T.A.B. of the User and the Strength/Special of the foe are used for this Move's Damage Pool.
move.description: The user feints an attack that tricks the foe into hurting itself.

move.name: Sandstorm
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Wind Move. Activate Sandstorm Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A fierce sandstorm starts raging all around the battlefield. Cover your eyes, nose and face! The rough sand will hurt you!

move.name: Beat Up
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move for every ally Pokemon that spends an action in addition to this Move, up to 3 allies may join.
move.description: The user calls other Pokémon to aid it in battle, together they give a beating to the foe.

move.name: Thunder Fang
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Bite Move. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon bites the foe with charged fangs, basically injecting electricity right into the foe’s nervous system.

move.name: Aqua Tail
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The user sways their tail to create a pocket whirlpool in which the foe gets sucked in by the spinning motion.

move.name: Power Trip
move.effect: Single Target. *Add up to 7 Dice to the Damage Pool of this move for every Attribute increase the user has. (ie The user has 2 increased points on Defense, add 2 Damage dice).
move.description: In the heat of the battle, the Pokémon gets carried away, reveling on their own power.

move.name: Rage
move.effect: Single Target. If a foe damages the User with a Physical or Special Move in the same round after using this Move. Increase the User's Strength by 1. This effect can stack up to 3 Times.
move.description: The user gets angry and throws a tantrum against the foe. The more the battle continues the angrier the user gets.

move.name: Hone Claws
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength score and Accuracy Pools.
move.description: Sharp claws make for more precise and deadly attacks.

move.name: Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe
move.description: The user lands a vicious bite, leaving an ugly bruise.

move.name: Torment
move.effect: Single Target. The Target cannot use any of the Moves it used during the last Round. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The Pokémon bullies their foe to the point of torment where they cannot keep using their strategy without feeling bad about it.

move.name: Crunch
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Lethal. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the foe's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon viciously mauls, tears, and rips apart anything its fangs can come in contact with.

move.name: Assurance
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 2 extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move if the Target has already received Damage from the User this Round.
move.description: The user indentifies the weakest foe and charges against them.

move.name: Embargo
move.effect: Single Target. The Target loses its Held Item. Target's Trainer & Partners can't use Items on the Target. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The user demands the held item of a Pokémon and the items in the bag of their trainer. Scared, both Pokémon and Trainer comply

move.name: Thrash
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
move.description: The Pokémon becomes a wild thing and the rumpus has started.

move.name: Earthquake
move.effect: Area Move. Ranged. If the Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dig" this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The user calls the forces of nature. The earth shakes violently and everything crumbles to the ground.

name: Plusle
description: They are often seen cheerleading their friends. When someone they like does a great job, they shower the field with sparks, but when they lose, Plusles cry loudly. This Pokémon drains power from telephone poles.

abilityOne.name: Plus
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon has a natural Positive charge. It will attract negative charge and repel other positive charge. It has a red blush all the time.
abilityOne.effect: If an ally Pokemon has the ability "Minus", Increase by 2 the Special Attribute of this Pokemon.

abilityTwo.name: Lightning Rod
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon will attract lightning and electricity to itself to charge its power. Great for preventing power surges. Bad for your electricity bill.
abilityTwo.effect: This Pokemon is immune to Electric-Type Damage. If anyone on the field uses a Single-Target Electric-Type Move, it will be redirected towards this Pokemon. The first time this Pokemon is hit by an Electric-Type move, Increase its Special by 1.

move.name: Growl
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Reduce by 1 the Strength of those affected.
move.description: Either through a menacing attitude or an adorable demeanor, the foe will hesitate to attack the user at full power.

move.name: Nuzzle
move.effect: Single Target. Paralyze the foe.
move.description: The Pokémon gives a cute nuzzle at their target, it looks adorable until you see the sparks.

move.name: Quick Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Out of battle, double the Pokemon's movement speed.
move.description: An attackas fight as lightning.

move.name: Spark
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The user engulfs itself with statc electricity then charges with a solid tackle against the foe. Sparks fly, very literally.

move.name: Encore
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 3. The Target will repeat the exact same action sequence it had last Round. Target must have had an action sequence. Duration 1 Round. If used on the previous Round, this move fails. See more on p. 529.
move.description: The Pokémon makes a standing ovation at their target, prompting them to repeat everything they just did, exactly the way they did it.

move.name: Copycat
move.effect: Single Target. Copy Move. Unique Moves can't be copied. You may choose another Target(s) for the copied Move.
move.description: The user is incredibly observant and has a talent for impersonations, no one will tell the difference!

move.name: Electro Ball
move.effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of the user for every Point on Dexterity it has that surpasses the Foe's. Up to 4 Dice might be added this way.
move.description: An orb of electricity is hurled against the target, the faster the user dashes, the more momentum the orb gets.

move.name: Swift
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Never Miss.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a burst of star-shaped sparkles at a blinding speed.

move.name: Baton Pass
move.effect: Target Self. Switcher Move for the User. Any Attribute increase on the user is passed on the next Pokemon. The user can't increase its own Attributes again until the end of the scene or until the switched Pokemon faints.
move.description: The Pokémon rallies through the battle, setting up everything for the next companion as they know this is a team effort.

move.name: Agility
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: Swift of body, swift of mind.

move.name: Wish
move.effect: Target Self / Target One Ally. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. This move has its effect at the beginning of the Next Round. If the User is switched it will heal whoever takes their place.
move.description: When you wish upon a star it makes no difference who you are, anything your heart desires will come to you.

move.name: Mimic
move.effect: Single Target. Copy Move. Replace "Mimic" with the copied Move. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The Pokémon is a quick learner. They imitate their target’s movements and just like that they get a new set of powers.

move.name: Thunder Wave
move.effect: Single Target. Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A series of electric waves hit the target, their voltage is too weak to cause much harm but muscles will get cramped for hours.

move.name: Play Nice
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Strength by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon starts to play with the foe. They are firendly, respectful, and thank the foe for the fun time. The foe does not want to fight, they want to keep playing.

move.name: Helping Hand
move.effect: Target One Ally. Reaction 5. The Target Gets 2 Extra Dice on their next Skill Check/Accuracy Roll, and 2 Extra Dice on their next Damage Roll. This Effect does not Stack.
move.description: The Pokémon is the first to come and give a hand to their friend. A true bro.

move.name: Skill Swap
move.effect: Single Target. Switch the User's Ability with the Target's. Whole Scene Duration. This affect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon. Unique Abilities can't be switched.
move.description: The Pokémon enters their foe’s mind to assimilate the traits of that species while make the foe think it is a member from another species. The foe gets an identity crisis afterwards.

move.name: Charm
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce Target's Strength by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon engages their foe in a charming interaction to reduce their aggressive intent.

move.name: Fake Tears
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce foe's Sp. Defense by 2.
move.description: The user stops mid-combat to start crying; feeling incredibly guilty, the foe lowers its guard.

move.name: Discharge
move.effect: Area Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze those affected.
move.description: The user lets out an enormous discharge over the arena. Lightning does not distinguish friend from foe.

move.name: Charge
move.effect: Target Self. Add 2 Dice to the Damage Pool of thenext Damaging Electric-Type Move the User performs.
move.description: The user gathers electricity and stores it to make its attacks more powerful. You may also use them as a living battery for your phone.

move.name: Nasty Plot
move.effect: Target Self. Increase User's Special by 2.
move.description: Rubbing both hands and laughing sinisterly the Pokémon rejoices in the evil plans they’ll soon carry out.

move.name: Entrainment
move.effect: Single Target. Replace the Target's Ability with the User's. Unique Abilities can't be passed or replaced. Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon.
move.description: The Pokémon trains and teaches their best ability to their target. The target becomes a master of this ability in a record time.

move.name: Last Resort
move.effect: Single Target. This Move will fail if the User has not successfully performed all of its known Moves at least once during the battle.
move.description: The Pokémon may be out of energy, but never out of options.

move.name: Thunder
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target. Rain Weather eliminates Low Accuracy. Sunny Weather increases it to Low Accuracy 4. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce", or "Sky Drop" this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The Pokémon commands the skies to send a giant lightning bolt to a specific point. Difficult to command under clear skies, lethal during a storm. Flying Pokémon are specially vulnerable.

move.name: Reflect
move.effect: Target the User's side of the field. Force Field. Activate a Force Field against Physical Damage. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: An ethereal mirror-like wall cuts the battlefield in half, bouncing back the impact of most blows.

name: Reuniclus
description: These intelligent Pokémon fight by controlling their arms with psychic energy. They have been seen forming networks of many Reuniclus holding hands and unleashing an incredible psychic wave.

abilityOne.name: Magic Guard
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon is covered by a faint energy that stops any minor harm that comes its way. This gives the pokemon a bit of an ethereal glow in the dark.
abilityOne.effect: The Pokemon only receives damage from Physical and Special Moves, Ongoing Damage, Confusion status, Pain Split, Destiny Bond, Perish Song & Self-Damaging Moves. Immune to damage from: Abilities, Status Ailments, Entry Hazards, Recoil, Held Items, or Weather. It can still have Status Ailments inflicted.

abilityTwo.name: Regenerator
abilityTwo.description: The body of this Pokemon will regenerate from damage really quick, wounds that would take days to heal will get better in a few hours.
abilityTwo.effect: This Pokemon may Heal up to 4 HP or up to 2 HP in case of Lethal Damage on its own every day. The Pokemon must be out of combat to benefit from this effect.

move.name: Recover
move.effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their energy to quickly mend wounds, their regenerative powers are beyond the imagination.

move.name: Endeavor
move.effect: Single Target. Roll Dice of Normal-Type Damage equal to the difference between the User's current HP and the Target's max HP. Ignore defenses. Up to 10 Dice may be rolled this way. This Damage cannot make the Target's HP go lower than the User's current HP.
move.description: Through sheer willpower the Pokémon manages to level the conditions of the battle despite their own injuries.

move.name: Confusion
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Confuse the Target.
move.description: A basic mental assault that makes the foe believe they are being attacked by an invisible enemy.

move.name: Psywave
move.effect: Single Target. Roll Psychic-Type Damage Dice according to the User's Rank: Starter 1 Die / Rookie 2 Dice / Standard 4 Dice/ Advacned 6 Dice / Expert 8 Dice / Ace and forward 10 Dice. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: A powerful mental wave assault’s the target’s brain directly. Everything, from forgotten memories to the secrets of the universe bombard its mind in just a few seconds.

move.name: Protect
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokemon would receive from a Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Moves that target the user.
move.description: A mighty energy shield materializes in front of the user to to deflect attacks and dispel ill effects.

move.name: Dizzy Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon locates their enemy’s balance point and lands a swift punch that leaves the foe seeing a swirl of stars around its head.

move.name: Telekinesis
move.effect: Single Target. Target becomes immune to Ground-Type Moves. Target can't Evade. Duration 2 Rounds.
move.description: The target levitates from the ground as the user’s telekinetic powers prevent its movement.

move.name: Psybeam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Confuse the Target.
move.description: The foe’s mind isassaulted by a mental ray, afterwards they may suffer from hallucinations.

move.name: Charm
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce Target's Strength by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon engages their foe in a charming interaction to reduce their aggressive intent.

move.name: Psyshock
move.effect: Single Target. This Move is resisted with the Target's Defense instead of its Sp. Defense.
move.description: The shock is mental, the blow is real.

move.name: Light Screen
move.effect: Target the User's side of the field. Force Field. Activate a Force Field against Special Damage. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A barrier of light is created over half of the battlefield, all energy trying to go trough dissolves as it crosses it.

move.name: Reflect
move.effect: Target the User's side of the field. Force Field. Activate a Force Field against Physical Damage. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: An ethereal mirror-like wall cuts the battlefield in half, bouncing back the impact of most blows.

move.name: Rollout
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions. *If all 5 actions land successfully, add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of the last hit of this Move. If the Pokemon used the Move "Defense Curl" in the same round, this Move's base Power becomes 2.
move.description: When the foe sees this Pokémon rollin’ they’ll be hatin’.

move.name: Snatch
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 6. Remove any Increase/Reduction on the Foe's Attributes, Active Shield Moves, Healing effects on the Foe, or effects on its side of the field; and place them on the User instead. See p. 531 for more info.
move.description: The user takes notice of the good stuff on the other side and quickly takes it for themselves. Finders keepers, losers weepers!

move.name: Hidden Power
move.effect: Single Target. This Move will always deal Super-Effective Damage against the Target. If used by the Pokemon #201 Unown. See p. 530
move.description: Inside every Pokémon lies the key to unlock all kinds of power.

move.name: Ally Switch
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 3. Switcher Move for the User. If successful, restore the Action this Move costed and the switched ally may use a Reaction when they enter the field.
move.description: The user vanishes just as they were about to be hit, and suddenly there’s another Pokémon in their place. Di-Did the user disappear? Or was it never there to begin with?

move.name: Pain Split
move.effect: Single Target. Spend 1 Will Point to activate. *Deal up to 3 Typeless Damage to the Target, Heal 1 HP to the User for every Damage dealt this way. This Move Fails if the User has more than Half HP rounded down. This Move cannot reduce a Target to less than 1 HP.
move.description: The user channels their pain into the foe to relieve their agony. The foe gets to feel the burn of the damage it has caused.

move.name: Psychic
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: The most iconic Psychic attack, the foe starts floating in the air and its swayed around by telekinesis as their mental barrier crumbles.

move.name: Skill Swap
move.effect: Single Target. Switch the User's Ability with the Target's. Whole Scene Duration. This affect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon. Unique Abilities can't be switched.
move.description: The Pokémon enters their foe’s mind to assimilate the traits of that species while make the foe think it is a member from another species. The foe gets an identity crisis afterwards.

move.name: Heal Block
move.effect: Area Move. Those affected can't restore HP. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: Through a massive mental onslaught, the Pokémon brings back the memories of pain on everyone around.

move.name: Hammer Arm
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Low Accuracy 1. Reduce User's Dexterity by 1.
move.description: Stop. Hammer Arm time!

move.name: Wonder Room
move.effect: Target the Battlefield. Everyone on the Battlefield will have their Defense and Sp. Defense calculated with Insight instead of Vitality. If using Insight as Sp. Defense optional rule, swap the calculation. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The battlefield is now a space that puts the mind to the test. A resilient mind will be a resilient body, but if the mind is weak the body will feel frail and feeble.

move.name: Future Sight
move.effect: Single Target. This Move's damage is dealt at the beginning of the next Round. Ignore Shield Moves, Force Field, Cover & Substitute. If the target restires or switches out from battle, the damage will be dealt to the next opponent or to one of its allies.
move.description: The Pokémon foresees something terrible happening. Although when it tries to see their own future, the images are ever changing.

move.name: Substitute
move.effect: Target Self. Deal 2 damage to the User. Put a Substitute Decoy with 2 HP and the same defenses as the user. See p. 531
move.description: The Pokémon disappears in a poof of smoke. A decoy identical to the user takes their place in battle. The user keeps attacking from the shadows while the decoy serves as distraction.

move.name: Psychic Terrain
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Add 1 Extra Damage Dice to all Physical & Special Psychic-Type Moves. Pokemon without immunity to Ground can't use Moves with Reaction or Late Reaction. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The arena becomes radiated by psychic waves. Everyone feels their mind slog due to the buzz in their heads, making all tasks take longer than they should.

move.name: Expanding Force
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. *If Psychic Terrain is active, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move and you may add another target to it.
move.description: Psychic energies form a bubble of light to damage the foe. Under Psychic Terrain, the energy is so big it turns into a tall pillar that crushes anyone inside.

name: Rhydon
description: It has a horn that serves as a drill for destroying rocks and boulders. Rhydon occasionally goes for a swim in rivers and even magma pools. Its great resistance prevents it from taking any damage.

abilityOne.name: Rock Head
abilityOne.description: The head and body of the Pokemon are so resistant that they barely feel anything. Careful as they bump into things without even noticing.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon will not receive damage from Recoil.

abilityTwo.name: Lightning Rod
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon will attract lightning and electricity to itself to charge its power. Great for preventing power surges. Bad for your electricity bill.
abilityTwo.effect: This Pokemon is immune to Electric-Type Damage. If anyone on the field uses a Single-Target Electric-Type Move, it will be redirected towards this Pokemon. The first time this Pokemon is hit by an Electric-Type move, Increase its Special by 1.

hiddenAbility.name: Reckless
hiddenAbility.description: The Pokemon will often get into risky situations in order to get what it wants. They are prone to risk their lives without thinking of the consequences.
hiddenAbility.effect: When this Pokemon performs a Move with Recoil as an Added Effect, Add 2 Extra dice to the Damage Pool of that Move.

move.name: Horn Attack
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user has horns. Did you not expect they’ll use them?

move.name: Tail Whip
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The Pokémon whips their tail in such an adorable way the foes let their guard down.

move.name: Stomp
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Die to Flinch the Target. Targets under the effects of the Move "Minimize" are vulnerable.
move.description: Stomping the foe with strong feet. Perfect to squish nasty little bugs.

move.name: Fury Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions.
move.description: The Pokémon attacks in a fury, their attacks are uncoordinated but relentless.

move.name: Scary Face
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: When a Pokémon looks at you like THAT, you know you gotta thread carefully around them.

move.name: Rock Blast
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged. Successive Actions. Projectile Move.
move.description: A rock shrapnel, the user shoots tiny bullet-like pebbles.

move.name: Bulldoze
move.effect: Area Move. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: The user stomps and flattens the ground, pushing all the rubbish and leaving the surface ready for construction.

move.name: Hammer Arm
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Low Accuracy 1. Reduce User's Dexterity by 1.
move.description: Stop. Hammer Arm time!

move.name: Dragon Rush
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon rushes to charge against their foe. Unlucky victims end up crushed into the ground.

move.name: Skull Bash
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. While this Move is charging, Increase the User's Defense by 1.
move.description: The user withdraws into their shell, after a few seconds of them not moving, the foe goes to inspect and the user pops their head out in in a devastating strike.

move.name: Smart Strike
move.effect: Single Target. Never Miss. Lethal.
move.description: The user stabs the foe using one of their sharp horns with astounding precision. The resulting wound is very deep and needs stitches immediately

move.name: Smack Down
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Remove the Target's immunity to Ground-Type Moves. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop", this Move hits anyways.
move.description: They say it’s great to get two birds with one stone, this Pokémon will give one bird ALL the stones.

move.name: Chip Away
move.effect: Single Target. Ignore Cover & Substitute decoys. Ignore Defenses. Remove effects that increase Evasion Actions from the Target (ie Moves like: Double Team, Minimize. Abilities like: Sand Veil)
move.description: Bit by bit the Pokémon finds an opening though all layers of defense their target has until there is nothing left to protect it from a direct strike.

move.name: Take Down
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Recoil.
move.description: Through a reckless grapple, the Pokémon smashes the foe into the ground, usually falling along with it.

move.name: Drill Run
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical.
move.description: The Pokémon holds their claws together and starts spinning as if they were a drill. They can puncture a hole into any surface from walls and floors to their foes.

move.name: Earthquake
move.effect: Area Move. Ranged. If the Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dig" this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The user calls the forces of nature. The earth shakes violently and everything crumbles to the ground.

move.name: Stone Edge
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Ranged. Lethal. High Critical. Cutter Move.
move.description: Obsidian shards are sent out against the foe. This rock may be brittle but is the sharpest in the world.

move.name: Megahorn
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal.
move.description: The Pokémon uses its strong horn(s) to pierce their foe and deal massive damage.

move.name: Horn Drill
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 5. Deal Damage equal to the Target's Remaining HP, plus 1 Lethal Damage.
move.description: The Pokémon stabs the target with a spinning horn, drilling through them until they are critical condition. Hurry to the nearest Pokémon Center.

name: Sableye
description: Feared for stealing the souls of people with their sinister eyes glowing in the dark. They lurk deep inside caves, eating rocks, gemstones, and crystals. Luckily, Sableye are rarely seen. They love jewels and treasure.

abilityOne.name: Stall
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon is indecisive and always lets others act first before making its mind on what action to take.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon always goes last in the the initiative order.

abilityTwo.name: Prankster
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon will always have a mischievous twinkle in its eyes, no one around will be safe from its pranks.
abilityTwo.effect: All Support Moves used by this Pokemon are considered to have: "Reaction 1" as Added Effect.

move.name: Leer
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The vicious glare of a predator that triggers the flight response of their prey.

move.name: Scratch
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their sharp claws to scratch the enemy. Nothing fancy but it works.

move.name: Fake Out
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Flinch the Target. This Move will only work on the First Round the User is out in battle. from the Second Round on, it will fail automatically.
move.description: The Pokémon pretends to be getting ready for the battle when they are actually prepairing a surprise attack on the foe.

move.name: Detect
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokemon would receive from a Physical or Special move. Negate the Added Effcts of Any Moves that target the user.
move.description: The Pokémon detects the intentions of the attacker and reacts just in time to minimize the damage.

move.name: Shadow Sneak
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1.
move.description: The user sneaks through the darkness and strikes by coming out of the target’s shadow. The Pokémon is able travel freely through the shadow realm.

move.name: Moonlight
move.effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Night Time and Sunny Weather increase it to Complete Heal. Rain, Sandstorm and Hail Weather reduceto Minor Heal of 1 HP.
move.description: The Pokémon uses the moon’s power to heal their injuries.

move.name: Astonish
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe.
move.description: The user sneaks behind their target to jump scare them.

move.name: Confuse Ray
move.effect: Single Target. Confuse the Target.
move.description: The user flashes a sinister ray of bright light that others cannot help but go straight into it.

move.name: Mean Look
move.effect: Single Target. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: An intense and ever-vigilant stare that surveils all possible paths the foe has to escape.

move.name: Disable
move.effect: Single Target. Disable the last Move performed by the Target. Only one Move may be Disabled at a time.
move.description: The Pokémon finds the right nerve to pull that will render a foe useless to perform their best Move.

move.name: Night Shade
move.effect: Single Target. Roll Ghost-Type Damage Dice according to the User's Rank: Starter 1 Die / Rookie 2 Dice / Standard 4 Dice/ Advacned 6 Dice / Expert 8 Dice / Ace and forward 10 Dice. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The user casts a dark and frightening mirage surrounding the foe to give them a panic attack.

move.name: Fury Swipes
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions.
move.description: With their sharp claws, the Pokémon will swiftly scatch their foe, leaving its face full of small cuts.

move.name: Knock Off
move.effect: Single Target. *If the Target is holding an Item, Add 2 Dice to the Damage pool of this Move. The Target loses its Held Item afterwards.
move.description: The Pokémon rudely smacks what their foe was holding.

move.name: Quash
move.effect: Single Target. Target's will go last in the Initiative Order. Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon. If used again, the previous Target has their order in the initiative restored.
move.description: The user represses the foe through intimidation so it thinks twice before acting.

move.name: Shadow Claw
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their ghostly claws to slash through their foe’s body tearing not their flesh but their soul directly.

move.name: Feint Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Never Miss.
move.description: The user approaches inconspicuously, pretending to attack the foe directly, then actually hits the foe from behind.

move.name: Power Gem
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: With a crystal gem, the Pokémon will always save the day!

move.name: Zen Headbutt
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses both their mental and physical prowess in a questionable yet effective “psychic” strike.

move.name: Shadow Ball
move.effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: Dark matter and shadows are used as a projectile against the foe, bringing out memories of their deepest fears.

move.name: Punishment
move.effect: Single Target. *Add up to 7 Dice to the Damage Pool of the Move for every Attribute increase the target has. (ie The target has 2 increased points on Strength, add 2 Damage dice).
move.description: You shouldn’t have done that...

move.name: Foul Play
move.effect: Single Target. S.T.A.B. of the User and the Strength/Special of the foe are used for this Move's Damage Pool.
move.description: The user feints an attack that tricks the foe into hurting itself.

move.name: Lash Out
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 3 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move if any of the user's Attributes/Traits was lowered this Round.
move.description: The user fulminates the foe with the power of its frustration and a shriek of despair.

move.name: Nasty Plot
move.effect: Target Self. Increase User's Special by 2.
move.description: Rubbing both hands and laughing sinisterly the Pokémon rejoices in the evil plans they’ll soon carry out.

name: Snorlax
description: Snorlax's typical day consists of eating and sleeping. It is such a docile Pokémon that children use its big belly as a place to play. It only attacks when it's awoken harshly. Fortunately it is a heavy sleeper.

abilityOne.name: Immunity
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon has a very strong immune system and will rarely get sick. It could even eat rotten food without getting sick.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon does not receive damage from Poison and Badly Poisoned Status Ailments.

abilityTwo.name: Thick Fat
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon's body has a thick layer of blubber that protects it against against harsh temperatures.
abilityTwo.effect: Reduce by 1 the damage taken from Fire and Ice-Type moves.

hiddenAbility.name: Gluttony
hiddenAbility.description: This Pokemon eats all day long, it is always carrying food and has no problem to find food sources since it's not a picky eater. It, however, doesn't share.
hiddenAbility.effect: This Pokemon can eat any type of food, medicine or herbal medicine with no negative. This pokemon may have up to three berries as held item instead of just one. The berries must not be of the same effect.

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Defense Curl
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 1. Increase by 1 the Power of the Moves "Ice Ball" & "Rollout".
move.description: The user curls into a ball to protect themselves when they feel threatened.

move.name: Lick
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon licks the foe. The foe is deeply disturbed by this creepy display of “affection”.

move.name: Chip Away
move.effect: Single Target. Ignore Cover & Substitute decoys. Ignore Defenses. Remove effects that increase Evasion Actions from the Target (ie Moves like: Double Team, Minimize. Abilities like: Sand Veil)
move.description: Bit by bit the Pokémon finds an opening though all layers of defense their target has until there is nothing left to protect it from a direct strike.

move.name: Outrage
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
move.description: The true nature of dragon-types unleashed. The user is consumed by a primal fury that won’t stop until everything has ben razed to the ground. Afterwards the Pokémon is confused.

move.name: Gunk Shot
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
move.description: The target is covered heat to toe in sludge, filth and organic waste. It can’t even cry for help or all of it will go into its mouth.

move.name: Self Destruct
move.effect: Area Move. Lethal. Ranged. The User faints.
move.description: It’s not about winning or losing, some pokémon just want to see the world burn.

move.name: Block
move.effect: Single Target. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: You don’t seem to understand. I’m not blocked in here with you... You are blocked in here with me!

move.name: Yawn
move.effect: Single Target. *If the Target has not been removed from battle at the beginning of the next Round, put it to Sleep.
move.description: The user yawns, the foe yawns, the trainers yawn... everyone should take a nap.

move.name: Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe
move.description: The user lands a vicious bite, leaving an ugly bruise.

move.name: Amnesia
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Sp. Defense by 2.
move.description: No thoughts. Head empty

move.name: Rest
move.effect: Target Self. Complete Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Put the User to Sleep.
move.description: Yeah, this seems like a good spot to take a nap.

move.name: Snore
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. If the user is not asleep, this Move fails.
move.description: While the Pokémon is asleep they start snoring so loud it startles the foe.

move.name: Sleep Talk
move.effect: If the user is not asleep, this Move fails. Instead of making a roll to try to wake up, the user may choose to use Sleep Talk instead. Choose a Move on the user's Move set at random and Target Random foe with it. Sleep Talk can be repeated up to 5 times per Round.
move.description: Despite being asleep, the Pokémon keeps dreaming about the battle. They talk incoherences and even sleep walk.

move.name: Rollout
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions. *If all 5 actions land successfully, add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of the last hit of this Move. If the Pokemon used the Move "Defense Curl" in the same round, this Move's base Power becomes 2.
move.description: When the foe sees this Pokémon rollin’ they’ll be hatin’.

move.name: Body Slam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The user charges against the foe using ther body to slam it down, leaving the target stunned.

move.name: Crunch
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Lethal. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the foe's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon viciously mauls, tears, and rips apart anything its fangs can come in contact with.

move.name: Belch
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Sound Move. The user must eat a berry or something similar during the Round before using this Move, otherwise it will fail. This effect only works once per berry/food eaten.
move.description: The user shoots a blast of venomous pins that inject venom into the foe, this venom is specially potent against those already compromised.

move.name: Belly Drum
move.effect: Target Self. Roll half of the User's HP as Typeless Damage Dice to itself, ignore defenses. Increase User's Strengt by 3.
move.description: With an angry war cry the user hits their belly as drums of war.

move.name: High Horsepower
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1.
move.description: The Pokémon tramples their foe without mercy. Their powerful body could pull a traction vehicle for very long distances.

move.name: Heavy Slam
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to he Damage Pool for every 50kg of weight the User is above the target's weight. Up to 4 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The foe is about to confirm if the Pokémon is thick-boned.

move.name: Hammer Arm
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Low Accuracy 1. Reduce User's Dexterity by 1.
move.description: Stop. Hammer Arm time!

move.name: Giga Impact
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge. Lethal.
move.description: The Pokémon strikes with such a brutal force they leave a crater just from the impact. Let them catch their breath afterwards.

name: Shellder
description: It lives at the bottom of the sea and rivers. It feeds on algae but it's attracted to sweet substances. When frightened it will shut its clam and lock it to be almost impossible to open.

abilityOne.name: Shell Armor
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon's shell protects its vulnerable spots from its opponents.
abilityOne.effect: Whenever a foe lands a Critical Hit on this Pokemon, it won't get Bonus Damage Dice for that attack.

abilityTwo.name: Skill Link
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon can proficiently chain a flurry of attacks and it is one heck of a juggler. It also enjoys repetition and sequences.
abilityTwo.effect: Add 2 Extra Dice to the Accuracy roll of all Double, Triple, or Successive Actions this Pokemon use.

hiddenAbility.name: Overcoat
hiddenAbility.description: The Pokemon will have a protective coat surrounding its body that allows it to live under extreme weather conditions.
hiddenAbility.effect: This Pokemon won't recieve damage from active weather.

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Protect
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokemon would receive from a Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Moves that target the user.
move.description: A mighty energy shield materializes in front of the user to to deflect attacks and dispel ill effects.

move.name: Supersonic
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Sound Move. Confuse the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a series of ultrasonic waves that mess with the foe by making it feel dizzy and disoriented.

move.name: Icicle Spear
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Successive Actions.
move.description: A barrage of icicles shot against the target. They are small but sharp and pointy

move.name: Withdraw
move.effect: Target Self. Increase User's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon withraw into their shell for increased protection and to avoid unwanted interactions.

move.name: Leer
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The vicious glare of a predator that triggers the flight response of their prey.

move.name: Clamp
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Block both User and Target. Ongoing Damage. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: Lured by a beautiful pearl, the target is clamped by the user’s sturdy shell. The user will not release the target until they no longer feel movement.

move.name: Ice Shard
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Ranged.
move.description: With extraordinary swiftness, the Pokémon shoots an ice bullet like the fastest gun in the North Pole.

move.name: Razor Shell
move.effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon sharpens a seashell to use as a cutting tool, when this shell manages to cut through the foe’s armor, they’ll finally will have mastered the craft.

move.name: Iron Defense
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
move.description: Iron body, iron will. This Pokémon is unbreakable.

move.name: Ice Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Freeze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a cold beam that reduces all warmth on the environment up to freezing point.

move.name: Shell Smash
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 2 the User's Strength, Special and Dexterity. Reduce by 2 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon breaks off their own shell. The foe mistakenly believed the shell was for the Pokémon to protect themselves when it was actually there to protect the foes from what’s next.

move.name: Aqua Ring
move.effect: Target Self. The User heals 1 HP at the end of each Round. Spend 1 Will point to activate. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The Pokémon coats themselves in fresh water.

move.name: Rock Blast
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged. Successive Actions. Projectile Move.
move.description: A rock shrapnel, the user shoots tiny bullet-like pebbles.

move.name: Rapid Spin
move.effect: Single Target. Increase the User's Dexterity by 1. Remove Entry Hazards, Terrains (ie Grassy Terrain, Misty Terrain), Ongoing Damage and Leech seed from the User and/or their side of the field.
move.description: The Pokémon makes a swift spin to strike at the foe and in the process everything laying close to the user is scattered out of the battlefield.

move.name: Water Gun
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The fastest water gun in town. No enemy will remain dry

move.name: Aurora Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce target's Strength by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a beautiful shimmering beam that cools down a hot temper.

move.name: Whirlpool
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion. Duration 4 Rounds. If a Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dive", this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The foe is swallowed inside of a violent swirling whirlpool. Trapping them on the violent currents, barely managing to stay afloat.

move.name: Brine
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 3 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool if the Target is at half HP or less.
move.description: A splash of sea water that literally adds more and more salt to the foe’s wounds.

move.name: Hydro Pump
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2
move.description: Water works best under pressure.

name: Tyranitar (Mega Form)
description: The power of the Mega Stone is so overwhelming it splits its back open. It becomes overwhelmed by its ferocious instincts and it's unclear if it can even hear its trainer through the pain and rage.

abilityOne.name: Sand Stream
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon can activate a raging sandstorm around itself that will last for as long as it wants.
abilityOne.effect: When this Pokemon comes out, it automatically starts the effects of Sandstorm Weather. The effects end when the Pokemon leaves the battle. (In case of stalemate the Pokemon with higher Will, might keep the dominant weather)

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Leer
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The vicious glare of a predator that triggers the flight response of their prey.

move.name: Chip Away
move.effect: Single Target. Ignore Cover & Substitute decoys. Ignore Defenses. Remove effects that increase Evasion Actions from the Target (ie Moves like: Double Team, Minimize. Abilities like: Sand Veil)
move.description: Bit by bit the Pokémon finds an opening though all layers of defense their target has until there is nothing left to protect it from a direct strike.

move.name: Rock Slide
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch those affected.
move.description: Don’t worry, even if you are not the fastest one in the race, you can still win by a landslide.

move.name: Dragon Dance
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Dexterity.
move.description: The user performs a vigorous and mystical dance to boost their fighting spirit and reflexes.

move.name: Outrage
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
move.description: The true nature of dragon-types unleashed. The user is consumed by a primal fury that won’t stop until everything has ben razed to the ground. Afterwards the Pokémon is confused.

move.name: Superpower
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Reduce by 1 the User's Strength and Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon packs all their power in a single crushing strike. All this effort leaves them quite tired afterwards.

move.name: Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe
move.description: The user lands a vicious bite, leaving an ugly bruise.

move.name: Rock Throw
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged.
move.description: Back in the day, this was a common form of amusement amongst Pokémon and children alike.

move.name: Sandstorm
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Wind Move. Activate Sandstorm Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A fierce sandstorm starts raging all around the battlefield. Cover your eyes, nose and face! The rough sand will hurt you!

move.name: Screech
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Reduce the Target's Defense by 2.
move.description: A mighty screech will make the target cover its ears instead of covering its flanks.

move.name: Fire Fang
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Bite Move. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon bites the foe with their mouth ablaze, tearing and searing their foe’s flesh in a single attack.

move.name: Thunder Fang
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Bite Move. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon bites the foe with charged fangs, basically injecting electricity right into the foe’s nervous system.

move.name: Ice Fang
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Bite Move. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Freeze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon bites their foe with sharp teeth and a geli breath to chill their bones directly

move.name: Scary Face
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: When a Pokémon looks at you like THAT, you know you gotta thread carefully around them.

move.name: Thrash
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
move.description: The Pokémon becomes a wild thing and the rumpus has started.

move.name: Stomping Tantrum
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move if the User failed the Accuracy roll of the last Move it performed. If the Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dig", this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The Pokémon throws a tantrum and stomps all over the place, it becomes worse if something has previously frustrated them.

move.name: Dark Pulse
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: A haze of dark energy decends on the battlefield preying on those vulnerable to the obscure feelings and fears it provokes.

move.name: Iron Defense
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
move.description: Iron body, iron will. This Pokémon is unbreakable.

move.name: Crunch
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Lethal. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the foe's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon viciously mauls, tears, and rips apart anything its fangs can come in contact with.

move.name: Payback
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move if the User has already received Damage from the Target this Round.
move.description: Some say the best revenge is a successful and happy life, but not this Pokémon.

move.name: Stone Edge
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Ranged. Lethal. High Critical. Cutter Move.
move.description: Obsidian shards are sent out against the foe. This rock may be brittle but is the sharpest in the world.

move.name: Earthquake
move.effect: Area Move. Ranged. If the Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dig" this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The user calls the forces of nature. The earth shakes violently and everything crumbles to the ground.

move.name: Hyper Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge. Lethal.
move.description: A devastating beam, a path of destruction that can extend for miles is the unmistakable proof someone used this Move. Let the user rest before trying to use it again.

move.name: Giga Impact
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge. Lethal.
move.description: The Pokémon strikes with such a brutal force they leave a crater just from the impact. Let them catch their breath afterwards.

move.name: Foul Play
move.effect: Single Target. S.T.A.B. of the User and the Strength/Special of the foe are used for this Move's Damage Pool.
move.description: The user feints an attack that tricks the foe into hurting itself.

name: Sandslash
description: It's less shy than its first stage. It curls up in a ball to protect itself from enemy attacks. Surprisingly, it is a good climber that uses its sharp claws for grip and drilling tunnels underground.

abilityOne.name: Sand Veil
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon's body is easily concealed by sand particles in the air.
abilityOne.effect: While Sandstorm Weather is active, this Pokemon can use the Evasion Maneuver up to 5 times per Round. The Pokemon is immune to damage from Sandstorm weather.

abilityTwo.name: Sand Rush
abilityTwo.description: While sand whips across the battlefield, the Pokemon can paddle through it as if it was water.
abilityTwo.effect: While Sandstorm Weather is active, increase the Dexterity Attibute of this Pokemon by 1. The Pokemon is immune to damage from Sandstorm Weather.

move.name: Scratch
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their sharp claws to scratch the enemy. Nothing fancy but it works.

move.name: Defense Curl
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 1. Increase by 1 the Power of the Moves "Ice Ball" & "Rollout".
move.description: The user curls into a ball to protect themselves when they feel threatened.

move.name: Sand Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce by 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.
move.description: Sand to the eyes! A dirty tactic in more ways than one.

move.name: Poison Sting
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
move.description: A tiny stab that causes big troubles.

move.name: Rapid Spin
move.effect: Single Target. Increase the User's Dexterity by 1. Remove Entry Hazards, Terrains (ie Grassy Terrain, Misty Terrain), Ongoing Damage and Leech seed from the User and/or their side of the field.
move.description: The Pokémon makes a swift spin to strike at the foe and in the process everything laying close to the user is scattered out of the battlefield.

move.name: Fury Cutter
move.effect: Single Target. Successive Actions. Cutter Move.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their claws or scythes to rapidly cut as if shredding paper.

move.name: Slash
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical. Cutter Move.
move.description: The Pokémon uses the sharpest part of their body as a blade to tear and slash with vicious intent.

move.name: Stealth Rock
move.effect: Target Foe's Side of the Field. Entry Hazard. Pokemon entering the battle Receive 1 Rock-Type Damage. This effect does not stack.
move.description: The Pokémon hides a trap of sharp rocks that are launched at the victim before they even realize what even happened.

move.name: Rollout
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions. *If all 5 actions land successfully, add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of the last hit of this Move. If the Pokemon used the Move "Defense Curl" in the same round, this Move's base Power becomes 2.
move.description: When the foe sees this Pokémon rollin’ they’ll be hatin’.

move.name: Bulldoze
move.effect: Area Move. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: The user stomps and flattens the ground, pushing all the rubbish and leaving the surface ready for construction.

move.name: Magnitude
move.effect: Area Move. Ranged. Before you roll damage, Roll 1 die to determine this Move's Power. If the Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dig" this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The user shakes the tectonic plates underneath the battlefield, trying to find a fault, when they do, this Move is devastating.

move.name: Fury Swipes
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions.
move.description: With their sharp claws, the Pokémon will swiftly scatch their foe, leaving its face full of small cuts.

move.name: Swift
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Never Miss.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a burst of star-shaped sparkles at a blinding speed.

move.name: Dig
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Earth Power/ Earthquake/ Fissure/ Magnitude/ Stomping Tantrum. Out of battle allows the Pokemon to burrow and make underground tunnels.
move.description: The user digs a tunnel on the ground and attacks by coming out from below its target. This move has been used to escape caves and gain access to highly surveiled places.

move.name: Crush Claw
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Reduce the Target's Defense by 2.
move.description: With a crushing grip against the foe, the user manages to break their armor.

move.name: Sand Tomb
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Ranged. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion.
move.description: The Pokémon creates a pit of shifting sand around the foe to bury it alive. The poor victim struggles for air as the sand keeps sinking it lower and lower.

move.name: Sandstorm
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Wind Move. Activate Sandstorm Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A fierce sandstorm starts raging all around the battlefield. Cover your eyes, nose and face! The rough sand will hurt you!

move.name: Agility
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: Swift of body, swift of mind.

move.name: Night Slash
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical. Cutter Move.
move.description: The user looks for a weak spot, tearing the soft flesh apart with a single vile slash of its claws.

move.name: Swords Dance
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Strength by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon dances with strong steps and a fierce attitude as a ritual to prepare for battle.

move.name: Earthquake
move.effect: Area Move. Ranged. If the Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dig" this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The user calls the forces of nature. The earth shakes violently and everything crumbles to the ground.

move.name: Gyro Ball
move.effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of this Move for every point on Dexterity the Target has that surpasses the User's. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a projectile. Correction: the Pokémon IS the projectile.

move.name: Steel Roller
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Can't be used if there is no Active Terrain (Grassy Terrain, Electric Terrain, etc.) on the Battlefield. Remove any active Terrain on the Battlefield.
move.description: The Pokémon rolls into a wheel, destroying anything in their path. Buildings come crashing down, forests are swept away and the soil is left as a blank slate.

move.name: Scorching Sands
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the foe.
move.description: The sand around the user heats to scorching temperatures as it is thrown against their foe.

name: Torkoal
description: They constantly search for coal to add to their shell, digging mountains tirelessly because it is the source of their power. If they run out of coal, they grow weak. They are commonly found in abandoned coal mines.

abilityOne.name: White Smoke
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon is constantly releasing fumes of white smoke making it difficult to be seen. It uses the smoke to conceal itself.
abilityOne.effect: Other Pokemon cannot reduce the Attributes of this Pokemon. This Pokemon can still Reduce its own Attributes.

abilityTwo.name: Drought
abilityTwo.description: The Sunlight will be harsly bright, and the heat will increase in the field for as long as this Pokemon wants to.
abilityTwo.effect: When this Pokemon comes out, it automatically starts the effects of Sunny Weather. The effects end when the Pokemon leaves the battle. (In case of stalemate the Pokemon with higher Will might keep the dominant weather)

hiddenAbility.name: Shell Armor
hiddenAbility.description: This Pokemon's shell protects its vulnerable spots from its opponents.
hiddenAbility.effect: Whenever a foe lands a Critical Hit on this Pokemon, it won't get Bonus Damage Dice for that attack.

move.name: Ember
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: A basic fire attack, but not any less dangerous. Even a small flame can grow out of control.

move.name: Smog
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Roll 4 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon releases a stream of filthy gases. The foe may try to hold their breath, but for how long?

move.name: Withdraw
move.effect: Target Self. Increase User's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon withraw into their shell for increased protection and to avoid unwanted interactions.

move.name: Fire Spin
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion.
move.description: The user creates a vortex of fire that remains spinning in the battlefield, trapping the foe within.

move.name: Flame Wheel
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: The user surrounds themselves with fire, then curl into a ball and runs over the target in a fiery spin.

move.name: Body Slam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The user charges against the foe using ther body to slam it down, leaving the target stunned.

move.name: Protect
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokemon would receive from a Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Moves that target the user.
move.description: A mighty energy shield materializes in front of the user to to deflect attacks and dispel ill effects.

move.name: Amnesia
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Sp. Defense by 2.
move.description: No thoughts. Head empty

move.name: Flail
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of this Move for every missing Point of HP the user has. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The user flails around trying to stay alive, as they get closer to fainting, more adrenaline will fuel their efforts of survival.

move.name: Heat Wave
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 1. Wind Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 1st Degree Burn on those affected.
move.description: A large wave of extra-hot air that can set fire to everything it touches.

move.name: Superpower
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Reduce by 1 the User's Strength and Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon packs all their power in a single crushing strike. All this effort leaves them quite tired afterwards.

move.name: Fissure
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 5. Ranged. Deal Damage to the Target equal to its Remaining HP, plus 1 Lethal Damge. If the Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dig" this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The earth rips apart underneath the target and swallows them whole. You’ll need a rescue team to recover the unlucky victim from the deep.

move.name: Rapid Spin
move.effect: Single Target. Increase the User's Dexterity by 1. Remove Entry Hazards, Terrains (ie Grassy Terrain, Misty Terrain), Ongoing Damage and Leech seed from the User and/or their side of the field.
move.description: The Pokémon makes a swift spin to strike at the foe and in the process everything laying close to the user is scattered out of the battlefield.

move.name: Smokescreen
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon covers the foe in a cloud of smoke to impair their visibility to make it easier to hide and/or cover their escape.

move.name: Clear Smog
move.effect: Single Target. Never Miss. Reset all Increased or Reduced Attributes on the Foe.
move.description: The user shoots a blast of venomous pins that inject venom into the foe, this venom is specially potent against those already compromised.

move.name: Curse
move.effect: Single Target. Roll half of the User's HP as Typeless Damage Dice to itself, ignoring defenses. The Target will remove 1 success from all of their Rolls until the Curse if lifted.
move.description: The user mutters an evil incantation, misery will befall into the foe at the cost of the user’s soul. To get rid of the curse, perform an exorcism or get help at a Pokémon Center

move.name: Iron Defense
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
move.description: Iron body, iron will. This Pokémon is unbreakable.

move.name: Lava Plume
move.effect: Area Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to inflict 1st Degree Burn on those affected.
move.description: The floor is lava. The sky is lava. Everywhere is lava. Hundreds of lava bits start raining scattered around the field.

move.name: Flamethrower
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 2nd Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: The most emblematic fire attack, a seeminly endless stream of fire that reduces everything and everyone to ashes.

move.name: Shell Smash
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 2 the User's Strength, Special and Dexterity. Reduce by 2 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon breaks off their own shell. The foe mistakenly believed the shell was for the Pokémon to protect themselves when it was actually there to protect the foes from what’s next.

move.name: Inferno
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Lethal. Inflict 3rd Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: The user sets their target on fire with unforgiving flames. Abandon all hope.

move.name: Eruption
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Lethal. *Reduce 1 Dice from the Damage Pool for every missing HP the User has. Up to 5 dice may be removed this way.
move.description: A fierce burst of lava comes out from the Pokémon at full force, charring whatever comes in contact with it. The lava flow diminishes as the rage subsides.

move.name: Scorching Sands
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the foe.
move.description: The sand around the user heats to scorching temperatures as it is thrown against their foe.

name: Ralts
description: They sense the emotions of people and Pokémon, usually sharing the mood of anyone nearby. They show if they feel joy and cheer, but hide if they sense hostility. They dislike fighting and negativity.

abilityOne.name: Synchronize
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon can share its mood, feelings and sensations with others, specially with those who caused it pain.
abilityOne.effect: Whenever a foe inflicts a Status Ailment or Condition to this Pokemon, the same Status is inflicted into the foe. this Ability does not ignore a foe's immunity to certain Status Ailments/Conditions.

abilityTwo.name: Trace
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon mimics the special characteristics of the others, making them look as if they were its own.
abilityTwo.effect: This Pokemon copies the Ability of a random foe when it comes out. The effect ends if this Pokemon is removed from the battle. Unique Abilities can't be copied.

hiddenAbility.name: Telepathy
hiddenAbility.description: This Pokemon can communicate using telepathy. It can send messages to other minds but it cannot receive messages back.
hiddenAbility.effect: This Pokemon won't receive damage from Moves performed by its allies.

move.name: Growl
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Reduce by 1 the Strength of those affected.
move.description: Either through a menacing attitude or an adorable demeanor, the foe will hesitate to attack the user at full power.

move.name: Confusion
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Confuse the Target.
move.description: A basic mental assault that makes the foe believe they are being attacked by an invisible enemy.

move.name: Lucky Chant
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Unique. Targets can Re-roll one un-successful die from all their rolls. Critical Hits do not grant Bonus dice against the Targets. Whole Scene Duration. Out of battle, good things happen at Storyteller's Discretion.
move.description: The magical incantation of an old priestess, through dance and song, good fortune and divine protection will come to you. This Move also removes evil spirits and curses.

move.name: Draining Kiss
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The Pokémon blows a flirtatious kiss; the foe catches it believing to have found love, but it turns out to be a trick to steal its life energy.

move.name: Calm Mind
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Special and Sp. Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon takes a deep breath to increase the mental fortitude required to face any problem.

move.name: Charm
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce Target's Strength by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon engages their foe in a charming interaction to reduce their aggressive intent.

move.name: Dream Eater
move.effect: Single Target. Can only be used if the Target has the Sleep Condition, otherwise it will fail. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The Pokémon enters the dream world for a snack. The dreams of children and baby Pokémon are the tastiest.

move.name: Stored Power
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Die to the Damage Pool of this Move for each Attribute increase the User has, up to a maximum of 7 total Dice. (eg The User has 2 increased Points of Defense, add 2 Damage Dice.)
move.description: This move allows the user to release its power. If the user has any boosts, the damage is increased.

move.name: Helping Hand
move.effect: Target One Ally. Reaction 5. The Target Gets 2 Extra Dice on their next Skill Check/Accuracy Roll, and 2 Extra Dice on their next Damage Roll. This Effect does not Stack.
move.description: The Pokémon is the first to come and give a hand to their friend. A true bro.

move.name: Telekinesis
move.effect: Single Target. Target becomes immune to Ground-Type Moves. Target can't Evade. Duration 2 Rounds.
move.description: The target levitates from the ground as the user’s telekinetic powers prevent its movement.

move.name: Mean Look
move.effect: Single Target. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: An intense and ever-vigilant stare that surveils all possible paths the foe has to escape.

move.name: Disarming Voice
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Never Miss.
move.description: With a charming but manipulative cry, the user deals emotional damage to their opponent by making them feel guilty.

move.name: Double Team
move.effect: Target Self. The User can now make up to 5 Evasions per Round.
move.description: The Pokémon moves so fast they create a series of shadow copies of themselves. Trying to guess which one is the real one is a pain.

move.name: Hypnosis
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Put the Target to sleep. Dark-Type Pokemon are affected by this Move.
move.description: By staring at an hypnotic pendulum, the target is suggestioned to feel tired and close its eyelids.

move.name: Teleport
move.effect: Target Self. Switcher Move for the User. Out of battle, Teleportation distances and limitations are determined by the User's Special Score and Storyteller's discretion.
move.description: Now you see me. Now you don’t.

move.name: Psybeam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Confuse the Target.
move.description: The foe’s mind isassaulted by a mental ray, afterwards they may suffer from hallucinations.

move.name: Life Dew
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. User and Allies in Range heal 1 HP at the end of each Round. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The user creates a fresh-water dew that restores energy and heals wounds.

move.name: Magical Leaf
move.effect: Single Target. Never Miss.
move.description: The user sends out a floating leaf that will pursue the target until it hits.

move.name: Psychic
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: The most iconic Psychic attack, the foe starts floating in the air and its swayed around by telekinesis as their mental barrier crumbles.

move.name: Imprison
move.effect: Target Self. While the User is on the battlefield, Moves known by the User cannot be used by foes. This effect ends if the User is removed from battle.
