move.description: This move blocks all shared parts of a memory the user is well aware of. Moves, techniques, names, places, people or situations, no one will be able to recall those imprisoned memories.

move.name: Heal Pulse
move.effect: Target One Ally. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate.
move.description: Commanding the mind over the matter, the Pokémon speeds up the healing process on an ally.

move.name: Future Sight
move.effect: Single Target. This Move's damage is dealt at the beginning of the next Round. Ignore Shield Moves, Force Field, Cover & Substitute. If the target restires or switches out from battle, the damage will be dealt to the next opponent or to one of its allies.
move.description: The Pokémon foresees something terrible happening. Although when it tries to see their own future, the images are ever changing.

name: Seel
description: A Pokémon that lives on icebergs. It swims in the sea using the point on its head to break up the ice. It sleeps a lot during the day, being most active at dawn when the temperature starts to cool.

abilityOne.name: Thick Fat
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon's body has a thick layer of blubber that protects it against against harsh temperatures.
abilityOne.effect: Reduce by 1 the damage taken from Fire and Ice-Type moves.

abilityTwo.name: Hydration
abilityTwo.description: The body of the Pokemon absorbs water and uses its moisture to maintain a healthy state.
abilityTwo.effect: When Rain weather is active, this Pokemon will cure all Status Ailments and Conditions it is affected with at the end of the round.

hiddenAbility.name: Ice Body
hiddenAbility.description: The Pokemon's body is almost frozen, and can cool down enclosed areas in a few minutes. It feels most comfortable when temperatures are below zero.
hiddenAbility.effect: If Hail/Snow Weather is active, you may restore 1 HP to this Pokemon at the end of the Round. This Pokemon is immune to damage from Hail weather.

move.name: Growl
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Reduce by 1 the Strength of those affected.
move.description: Either through a menacing attitude or an adorable demeanor, the foe will hesitate to attack the user at full power.

move.name: Encore
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 3. The Target will repeat the exact same action sequence it had last Round. Target must have had an action sequence. Duration 1 Round. If used on the previous Round, this move fails. See more on p. 529.
move.description: The Pokémon makes a standing ovation at their target, prompting them to repeat everything they just did, exactly the way they did it.

move.name: Ice Shard
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Ranged.
move.description: With extraordinary swiftness, the Pokémon shoots an ice bullet like the fastest gun in the North Pole.

move.name: Rest
move.effect: Target Self. Complete Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Put the User to Sleep.
move.description: Yeah, this seems like a good spot to take a nap.

move.name: Aqua Ring
move.effect: Target Self. The User heals 1 HP at the end of each Round. Spend 1 Will point to activate. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The Pokémon coats themselves in fresh water.

move.name: Aurora Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce target's Strength by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a beautiful shimmering beam that cools down a hot temper.

move.name: Aqua Tail
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The user sways their tail to create a pocket whirlpool in which the foe gets sucked in by the spinning motion.

move.name: Ice Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Freeze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a cold beam that reduces all warmth on the environment up to freezing point.

move.name: Safeguard
move.effect: Target User's side of the Field. Force Field. Those affected are immune to all Status Ailements/Conditions. Previously inflicted Status Ailments/Conditions remain. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A force field covers half of the battlefield and filters out all impurities and ill intentions coming from the other side.

move.name: Fake Out
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Flinch the Target. This Move will only work on the First Round the User is out in battle. from the Second Round on, it will fail automatically.
move.description: The Pokémon pretends to be getting ready for the battle when they are actually prepairing a surprise attack on the foe.

move.name: Lick
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon licks the foe. The foe is deeply disturbed by this creepy display of “affection”.

move.name: Headbutt
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Out of battle it may cause a Random encounter when hitting trees and make objects drop from high places.
move.description: The Pokémon rams against their foe with their head. This Move is perfect to shake down trees when looking for berries, but beware of wild Pokémon nesting at the treetops.

move.name: Water Sport
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Physical & Special Fire-Type Moves have Power 0. Pokemon weak to Fire-Type Moves won't receive Super-Effective Damage from them. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A single drop of water can’t put off a raging fire, but what is the ocean but a collection of drops.

move.name: Water Gun
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The fastest water gun in town. No enemy will remain dry

move.name: Icy Wind
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Wind Move. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: Polar winds sweep through the arena. Everyone starts to shiver and embrace themselves, trying to preserve a bit of warmth.

move.name: Take Down
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Recoil.
move.description: Through a reckless grapple, the Pokémon smashes the foe into the ground, usually falling along with it.

move.name: Aqua Jet
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1.
move.description: The Pokémon propels themselves with a jet of pressured water.

move.name: Brine
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 3 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool if the Target is at half HP or less.
move.description: A splash of sea water that literally adds more and more salt to the foe’s wounds.

move.name: Dive
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Scald/ Surf/ Whirlpool/ Freeze-Dry/ Sheer Cold. Out of battle allows the Pokemon to move underwater carrying someone without risk of drowning.
move.description: Just look at the world around you right here on the ocean floor, such wonderful things surround you. What more are you lookin’ for?

move.name: Hail
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Activate Hail Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The skies turn gray, and loud thunder rumbles, but what falls is not a gentle drizzle, but an endless stream of ice shards coming down at high speeds. Find shelter!

move.name: Entrainment
move.effect: Single Target. Replace the Target's Ability with the User's. Unique Abilities can't be passed or replaced. Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon.
move.description: The Pokémon trains and teaches their best ability to their target. The target becomes a master of this ability in a record time.

name: Stoutland
description: For many years this Pokémon has helped with rescue missions in hostile places. Its outer coat is hard on the exterior but soft and silky on the inside. They keep people safe and warm while help is on the way.

abilityOne.name: Intimidate
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon has an overwhelming presence that inspires both fear and respect from others.
abilityOne.effect: When this Pokemon comes into battle, Reduce by 1 the Strength of All foes in Range. This effect will last for as long as this Pokemon is out. Outside of battle, wild Pokemon will avoid the party if this Pokemon is out.

abilityTwo.name: Sand Rush
abilityTwo.description: While sand whips across the battlefield, the Pokemon can paddle through it as if it was water.
abilityTwo.effect: While Sandstorm Weather is active, increase the Dexterity Attibute of this Pokemon by 1. The Pokemon is immune to damage from Sandstorm Weather.

hiddenAbility.name: Scrappy
hiddenAbility.description: This Pokemon does not believe in ghosts.
hiddenAbility.effect: This Pokemon can hit Ghost-type Pokemon with Normal and Fighting Type Moves. Apply resistances or weaknesses to the foe if it has a secondary type.

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Leer
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The vicious glare of a predator that triggers the flight response of their prey.

move.name: Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe
move.description: The user lands a vicious bite, leaving an ugly bruise.

move.name: Odor Sleuth
move.effect: Single Target. The Foe cannot Evade Moves performed by the User. User ignores Ghost-Type immunity to Normal and Fight-Type Moves and vice versa. Out of battle, Add successes of this Move to any roll for Tracking targets.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their keen sense of smell to corner the foe and find it when it tries to scurry away

move.name: Ice Fang
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Bite Move. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Freeze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon bites their foe with sharp teeth and a geli breath to chill their bones directly

move.name: Fire Fang
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Bite Move. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon bites the foe with their mouth ablaze, tearing and searing their foe’s flesh in a single attack.

move.name: Thunder Fang
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Bite Move. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon bites the foe with charged fangs, basically injecting electricity right into the foe’s nervous system.

move.name: Helping Hand
move.effect: Target One Ally. Reaction 5. The Target Gets 2 Extra Dice on their next Skill Check/Accuracy Roll, and 2 Extra Dice on their next Damage Roll. This Effect does not Stack.
move.description: The Pokémon is the first to come and give a hand to their friend. A true bro.

move.name: Reversal
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool for every missing HP the User has. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The user gathers their mettle to block away the pain and focus only on hitting harder.

move.name: Psychic Fangs
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. If there is a Force Field on the Target's side of the field, destroy it.
move.description: The Pokémon bares its fangs to bite the foe, psychic energy begins piercing before the actual fangs make contact.

move.name: Iron Head
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon charges to cure the foe’s iron deficit.

move.name: Superpower
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Reduce by 1 the User's Strength and Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon packs all their power in a single crushing strike. All this effort leaves them quite tired afterwards.

move.name: Take Down
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Recoil.
move.description: Through a reckless grapple, the Pokémon smashes the foe into the ground, usually falling along with it.

move.name: Work Up
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Special.
move.description: The Pokémon has spent a lot of time training and doesn’t miss the chance to show off their muscles and fitness. After the battle they share routines and tips with the other Pokémon.

move.name: Crunch
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Lethal. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the foe's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon viciously mauls, tears, and rips apart anything its fangs can come in contact with.

move.name: Roar
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 6. Switcher Move for the Foe. In the wild, the battle may end.
move.description: With a potent roar, to make the foe reconsider their intentions.

move.name: Retaliate
move.effect: Single Target. *If an Ally fainted during this or the previous Round, add Extra Dice to the damage pool, equal to the user's Loyalty. Up to 5 dice may be added this way. This effect only activates once per fainted Ally.
move.description: With tears of rage in their eyes, the Pokémon will not let the fall of a friend go without punishment.

move.name: After You
move.effect: Target One Ally. Reaction 1. The Target will go First in the Initiative Order. If used again, the previous target reverts to their original Initiative order. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The user bows and courteously lets a friend go first.

move.name: Rest
move.effect: Target Self. Complete Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Put the User to Sleep.
move.description: Yeah, this seems like a good spot to take a nap.

move.name: Play Rough
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 1 Chance Dice to Reduce Target's Strength by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon and their foe start a playful wrestle that soon escalates into a furious wrestling match.

move.name: Giga Impact
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge. Lethal.
move.description: The Pokémon strikes with such a brutal force they leave a crater just from the impact. Let them catch their breath afterwards.

move.name: Last Resort
move.effect: Single Target. This Move will fail if the User has not successfully performed all of its known Moves at least once during the battle.
move.description: The Pokémon may be out of energy, but never out of options.

name: Tyrantrum
description: Nothing could stop this Pokémon 100 million years ago; it was a prehistoric king. Thanks to its giant jaws, which could shred thick metal plates as if they were paper, this Pokémon takes orders from no one.

abilityOne.name: Strong Jaw
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon's strong jaw gives it tremendous biting power. Its teeth can tear through almost anything.
abilityOne.effect: Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of all Bite Moves.

abilityTwo.name: Rock Head
abilityTwo.description: The head and body of the Pokemon are so resistant that they barely feel anything. Careful as they bump into things without even noticing.
abilityTwo.effect: This Pokemon will not receive damage from Recoil.

move.name: Tail Whip
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The Pokémon whips their tail in such an adorable way the foes let their guard down.

move.name: Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe
move.description: The user lands a vicious bite, leaving an ugly bruise.

move.name: Charm
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce Target's Strength by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon engages their foe in a charming interaction to reduce their aggressive intent.

move.name: Dragon Tail
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Late Reaction 6. Switcher Move for the Foe. In the wild, the battle may end.
move.description: The Pokémon sends their opponent flying up to 100ft in the air with a strong flick of their tail.

move.name: Rock Slide
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch those affected.
move.description: Don’t worry, even if you are not the fastest one in the race, you can still win by a landslide.

move.name: Poison Fang
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Badly Poison the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon goes for a quick bite, releasing the foe just as fast. Let the poison slowly consume the foe from the inside out. No need to spend more energy when a drop is more than enough.

move.name: Outrage
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
move.description: The true nature of dragon-types unleashed. The user is consumed by a primal fury that won’t stop until everything has ben razed to the ground. Afterwards the Pokémon is confused.

move.name: Strength
move.effect: Outside of battle, using this move allows the Pokemon to lift double the normal weight it should be able to.
move.description: The Pokemon strains its muscles to go beyond their own limits.

move.name: Roar
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 6. Switcher Move for the Foe. In the wild, the battle may end.
move.description: With a potent roar, to make the foe reconsider their intentions.

move.name: Ancient Power
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Increase by 1 the User's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense and Sp. Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon calls forward an energy from the ancient past. This may infuse the user with a primal strength.

move.name: Bide
move.effect: Single Target. The User will not Evade or Clash the next 2 Physical or Special Moves targeting it. Once all damage has been dealt against the User, roll a number of Normal-Type Damage dice equal to twice the total amount of Damage the Target received. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The user puts up with being hit, waiting for the perfect opportunity to retaliate.

move.name: Stomp
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Die to Flinch the Target. Targets under the effects of the Move "Minimize" are vulnerable.
move.description: Stomping the foe with strong feet. Perfect to squish nasty little bugs.

move.name: Dragon Claw
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses its strong claws to deliver a fierce tearing blow.

move.name: Crunch
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Lethal. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the foe's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon viciously mauls, tears, and rips apart anything its fangs can come in contact with.

move.name: Dragon Dance
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Dexterity.
move.description: The user performs a vigorous and mystical dance to boost their fighting spirit and reflexes.

move.name: Stealth Rock
move.effect: Target Foe's Side of the Field. Entry Hazard. Pokemon entering the battle Receive 1 Rock-Type Damage. This effect does not stack.
move.description: The Pokémon hides a trap of sharp rocks that are launched at the victim before they even realize what even happened.

move.name: Thrash
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
move.description: The Pokémon becomes a wild thing and the rumpus has started.

move.name: Iron Defense
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
move.description: Iron body, iron will. This Pokémon is unbreakable.

move.name: Earthquake
move.effect: Area Move. Ranged. If the Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dig" this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The user calls the forces of nature. The earth shakes violently and everything crumbles to the ground.

move.name: Horn Drill
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 5. Deal Damage equal to the Target's Remaining HP, plus 1 Lethal Damage.
move.description: The Pokémon stabs the target with a spinning horn, drilling through them until they are critical condition. Hurry to the nearest Pokémon Center.

move.name: Head Smash
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Recoil.
move.description: Pokémon, angry. Pokémon, smash!

move.name: Giga Impact
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge. Lethal.
move.description: The Pokémon strikes with such a brutal force they leave a crater just from the impact. Let them catch their breath afterwards.

move.name: Psychic Fangs
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. If there is a Force Field on the Target's side of the field, destroy it.
move.description: The Pokémon bares its fangs to bite the foe, psychic energy begins piercing before the actual fangs make contact.

move.name: Draco Meteor
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. lethal. Reduce User's Special by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon summons a meteor to fall from the sky directly into their foes, dealing a brutal amount of damage. An impressive display if power that demands a lot of energy.

name: Dragonite
description: Very few people have ever seen this Pokémon. Its intelligence matches that of humans. There are records of a Pokémon with a similar description that helped rescue a ship full of people during a hurricane.

abilityOne.name: Inner Focus
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon is extrmely serious and focused on everything it does. It remains calm and never backs down, even if it's getting severly injured.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon does not Flinch. The Ability Intimidate does not have any effect against this Pokemon. Outside of battle this Pokemon is able to resist intimidation tactics, fear and stress better than others.

abilityTwo.name: Multiscale
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon is covered by two layers of hard scales, if one layer is damaged it will be shed and regrown later.
abilityTwo.effect: While this Pokemon at full health, Reduce by 1 the damage taken by the next Physical or Special Move it receives.

move.name: Leer
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The vicious glare of a predator that triggers the flight response of their prey.

move.name: Wrap
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion.
move.description: The Pokémon swiftly entangles their foe in a squeezing lock to prevent their escape.

move.name: Twister
move.effect: Target all foes in Range. Wind Move. Roll 2 Chance dice to Flinch those affected. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop" this Move hits anyways.
move.description: A raging twister embedded with a dragon’s fury. No one wants to be trapped in this fearsome spiral, which almost touches the sky.

move.name: Thunder Wave
move.effect: Single Target. Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A series of electric waves hit the target, their voltage is too weak to cause much harm but muscles will get cramped for hours.

move.name: Fire Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 2nd Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: A fist powered by the fiery spirit of combat, the heat of the battle lights of for real as the punch hits the foe right where it hurts!

move.name: Thunder Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 1 Chance die to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A charged punch to deliver a shocking blow.

move.name: Dragon Rage
move.effect: Single Target. Set Damage. Deal 2 Dragon-Type Damage to the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon focuses their inner rage and makes it not-soinner anymore.

move.name: Slam
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1.
move.description: Everybody get up, it’s time to slam now.

move.name: Extreme Speed
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 2. Out of battle, triple the Pokemon's movement speed.
move.description: Gotta go extremely fast.

move.name: Draco Meteor
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. lethal. Reduce User's Special by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon summons a meteor to fall from the sky directly into their foes, dealing a brutal amount of damage. An impressive display if power that demands a lot of energy.

move.name: Tailwind
move.effect: Target User's side of the Field. Wind Move. Increase by 2 the Dexterity of everyone on the User's side of the field. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: Flying Pokémon know better than anyone how to use the wind in their favor. Let its draft carry you to victory.

move.name: Wing Attack
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: A classic flying technique, the user flies towards the foe and strikes using their wings.

move.name: Dragon Tail
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Late Reaction 6. Switcher Move for the Foe. In the wild, the battle may end.
move.description: The Pokémon sends their opponent flying up to 100ft in the air with a strong flick of their tail.

move.name: Agility
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: Swift of body, swift of mind.

move.name: Dragon Rush
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon rushes to charge against their foe. Unlucky victims end up crushed into the ground.

move.name: Aqua Tail
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The user sways their tail to create a pocket whirlpool in which the foe gets sucked in by the spinning motion.

move.name: Rain Dance
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Activate Rain Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The Pokémon performs a peculiar dance in the middle of the field, everyone thinks it silly until the first thunder rumbles.

move.name: Safeguard
move.effect: Target User's side of the Field. Force Field. Those affected are immune to all Status Ailements/Conditions. Previously inflicted Status Ailments/Conditions remain. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A force field covers half of the battlefield and filters out all impurities and ill intentions coming from the other side.

move.name: Roost
move.effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Remove the User's Immunity to Ground-Type Moves. Duration 1 Round.
move.description: The Pokémon gathers some twigs and builds themselves a comfy nest on the floor to roost and relax.

move.name: Dragon Dance
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Dexterity.
move.description: The user performs a vigorous and mystical dance to boost their fighting spirit and reflexes.

move.name: Outrage
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
move.description: The true nature of dragon-types unleashed. The user is consumed by a primal fury that won’t stop until everything has ben razed to the ground. Afterwards the Pokémon is confused.

move.name: Hyper Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge. Lethal.
move.description: A devastating beam, a path of destruction that can extend for miles is the unmistakable proof someone used this Move. Let the user rest before trying to use it again.

move.name: Hurricane
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Wind Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target. Rain Weather eliminates Low Accuracy. Sunny Weather increases to Low Accuracy 4. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop", this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The Pokémon calls upon fierce gale winds. It’ll be difficult to summon the tempest on a clear day, but a little rain will enhance it into a typhoon. Other pokémon in the air are in most danger.

move.name: Focus Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Charge Move. The User Flinches if it is hit while Charging this Move.
move.description: The user must focus on delivering the greatest punch in history, if they succeed they’ll be known as the One-Punch Pokémon.

name: Sceptile
description: They raise trees with love and care and protect the jungles with their lives. Their tails can restore a plant's beauty. Sceptile's power is truly unmatched in their habitats. They are very proud, though.

abilityOne.name: Overgrow
abilityOne.description: When this Pokemon is hurt, it will grow huge plants on its body to defend itself, these plants are very strong but wither quickly.
abilityOne.effect: Pain Penalization won't reduce successes from Accuracy or Damage rolls of Grass-Type Moves used by this Pokemon. Grass-Type Moves get 2 Extra dice to their Damage Pool when this Pokemon is at half HP or less.

abilityTwo.name: Unburden
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon is most comfortable when it is freed from having to carry stuff around. It loves to be able to move without restrictions.
abilityTwo.effect: The first time this Pokemon spends or loses its held item and is no longer holding any, Increase 2 Points to its Dexterity Attribute.

move.name: Pound
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user pounds the target’s head. Simple

move.name: Leer
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The vicious glare of a predator that triggers the flight response of their prey.

move.name: Absorb
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The user takes nutrients from the nearest source of life they find.

move.name: Mega Drain
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The user absorbs a big amount of vital energy and nutrients from the target to feed from.

move.name: Screech
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Reduce the Target's Defense by 2.
move.description: A mighty screech will make the target cover its ears instead of covering its flanks.

move.name: Detect
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokemon would receive from a Physical or Special move. Negate the Added Effcts of Any Moves that target the user.
move.description: The Pokémon detects the intentions of the attacker and reacts just in time to minimize the damage.

move.name: Quick Guard
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Reaction 3. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage from a Physical or Special Move with Priority. Negate the Added effects of Reaction and late Reaction Moves targeting the User and Allies.
move.description: The user reacts instinctively and defends itself and its team mates, nullyfing the effects of the fastest attacks.

move.name: Thunder Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 1 Chance die to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A charged punch to deliver a shocking blow.

move.name: Frenzy Plant
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge.
move.description: The user roots down and calls upon the force of nature. Thorny roots and plants grow in a frenzy around the foe. This display of power leaves the user quite exhausted.

move.name: Leafage
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged.
move.description: The user throws leaf darts towards the foe.

move.name: Quick Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Out of battle, double the Pokemon's movement speed.
move.description: An attackas fight as lightning.

move.name: Pursuit
move.effect: Single Target. *If a Target hit by this Move is recalled, attempts to Run Away, uses a Switcher Move or is the Target of a Switcher Move, Deal 2 Typeless Damage to it. Outside of battle, aid in catching a fleeing target.
move.description: The Pokémon is relentless in its pursuit of their target, striking it just as it believed it had escaped.

move.name: Fury Cutter
move.effect: Single Target. Successive Actions. Cutter Move.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their claws or scythes to rapidly cut as if shredding paper.

move.name: Leaf Blade
move.effect: Single Target. High Critical. Lethal. Cutter Move.
move.description: Danger lies not on the material’s toughness but on its edge’s sharpness.

move.name: Agility
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: Swift of body, swift of mind.

move.name: Slam
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1.
move.description: Everybody get up, it’s time to slam now.

move.name: Nature Power
move.effect: Single Target. *The Type of this Move is determined by the environment or active Terrain. See more on p. 530
move.description: The Pokémon makes use of the terrain and asks for nature's aid in battle.

move.name: Energy Ball
move.effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: Gathering nature’s energy from nearby plants, trees and roots, the Pokémon forms a ball to shoot at the enemy. Sadly, the surrounding plants will be dry afterwards.

move.name: False Swipe
move.effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. This Move's Damage can't make the Target go below 1 HP.
move.description: Through their most dramatic poses, the Pokémon pretends to slice up the foe (the blood is fake).

move.name: Double Team
move.effect: Target Self. The User can now make up to 5 Evasions per Round.
move.description: The Pokémon moves so fast they create a series of shadow copies of themselves. Trying to guess which one is the real one is a pain.

move.name: X-Scissor
move.effect: Single Target. Cutter Move.
move.description: The Pokémon uses its scythes or clawa as if they were a pair of scissors to cut through the foe.

move.name: Night Slash
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical. Cutter Move.
move.description: The user looks for a weak spot, tearing the soft flesh apart with a single vile slash of its claws.

move.name: Giga Drain
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The Pokémon drains most of the foe’s vital energy and feeds on the nutrients it managed to extract.

move.name: Endeavor
move.effect: Single Target. Roll Dice of Normal-Type Damage equal to the difference between the User's current HP and the Target's max HP. Ignore defenses. Up to 10 Dice may be rolled this way. This Damage cannot make the Target's HP go lower than the User's current HP.
move.description: Through sheer willpower the Pokémon manages to level the conditions of the battle despite their own injuries.

move.name: Dual Chop
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Double Action.
move.description: Two brutal blows are all this Pokémon needs to make the opponent yield to their might.

move.name: Leaf Storm
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Reduce the User's Special by 2.
move.description: A furious onslaught of sharp leaves blasting against the target. The user gives their all in this attack.

move.name: Synthesis
move.effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will Point to activate. If Sunny Weather is in effect, this Move becomes a Complete Heal. If performed under Rain, Sandstorm, Hail or Snowy Weather, this Move is a Minor heal and only heals 1 HP.
move.description: The Pokémon gathers sunlight to re-energize themselves.

move.name: Outrage
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
move.description: The true nature of dragon-types unleashed. The user is consumed by a primal fury that won’t stop until everything has ben razed to the ground. Afterwards the Pokémon is confused.

name: Skuntank
description: It sprays a reeking fluid from its tail. The fluid smells worse the longer it is allowed to fester. It is vulnerable to attacks that come from above due to its exuberant tail. When it's relaxed it doesn't smell bad.

abilityOne.name: Aftermath
abilityOne.description: When hurt or upset, the Pokemon will prepare to burst. If hit hard enough, it will explode on contact. They also tend to hold grudges.
abilityOne.effect: If this Pokemon faints due to a Non-Ranged Physical Move, the User of that attack is dealt 2 Damage.

abilityTwo.name: Stench
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon can emit a smell so unpleasant it repels other people and Pokemon.
abilityTwo.effect: Reduce the chance of wild Pokemon encounters at Storyteller's discretion. Whenever this Pokemon is hit with a Non-Ranged Physical Move, Roll 1 Chance Die to Flinch the foe.

hiddenAbility.name: Keen Eye
hiddenAbility.description: These Pokemon have an exceptional sight. Locating small or far away objects is a lot easier for them.
hiddenAbility.effect: This Pokemon cannot have successes removed from its Accuracy rolls by Moves, Items or Abilities.

move.name: Scratch
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their sharp claws to scratch the enemy. Nothing fancy but it works.

move.name: Poison Gas
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 1. Poison those affected.
move.description: A thick cloud of toxic gas that causes violent coughs and red eyes.

move.name: Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe
move.description: The user lands a vicious bite, leaving an ugly bruise.

move.name: Acid Spray
move.effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 2.
move.description: Do not point at face or eyes. Keep away from children.

move.name: Feint
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 1. This Move ignores the effects of any Shield Move active on the Target and removes their effects for the rest of the Round.
move.description: The user begins their attack, and as their target attempts to protect itself, the user feints the target to break their defense against their true strike.

move.name: Smokescreen
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon covers the foe in a cloud of smoke to impair their visibility to make it easier to hide and/or cover their escape.

move.name: Fury Swipes
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions.
move.description: With their sharp claws, the Pokémon will swiftly scatch their foe, leaving its face full of small cuts.

move.name: Focus Energy
move.effect: Target Self. All of the user's Physical & Special Moves now have "High Critical". Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The Pokémon concentrates all their focus on the battle to make their attacks much more precise.

move.name: Venoshock
move.effect: Single Target. *If the Target is already Poisoned, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.
move.description: The Pokémon identifies the weakest prey and makes an opportunistic shot.

move.name: Screech
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Reduce the Target's Defense by 2.
move.description: A mighty screech will make the target cover its ears instead of covering its flanks.

move.name: Toxic
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Badly Poison the Target.
move.description: This burning acid dissolves skin to enter the bloodstream directly. The poor victim feels like they are melting from the inside out. The clock is ticking.

move.name: Sucker Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 6. *This move can only be used as a Late Reaction; and only if the Target used a Physical or Special Move, otherwise it will fail.
move.description: The Pokémon takes advantage of their foe preparing to attack to unleash a dirty surprise blow.

move.name: Slash
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical. Cutter Move.
move.description: The Pokémon uses the sharpest part of their body as a blade to tear and slash with vicious intent.

move.name: Flamethrower
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 2nd Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: The most emblematic fire attack, a seeminly endless stream of fire that reduces everything and everyone to ashes.

move.name: Venom Drench
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. *If the affected are already Poisoned or becomes Poisoned in the same Round this Move was used, Reduce by 1 their Strength, Special and Dexterity.
move.description: The user weakens the foe’s already compromised immune systems.

move.name: Night Slash
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical. Cutter Move.
move.description: The user looks for a weak spot, tearing the soft flesh apart with a single vile slash of its claws.

move.name: Poison Jab
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon is set on injecting venom directly into the foe’s bloodstream. They can do it the easy way or the hard way.

move.name: Belch
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Sound Move. The user must eat a berry or something similar during the Round before using this Move, otherwise it will fail. This effect only works once per berry/food eaten.
move.description: The user shoots a blast of venomous pins that inject venom into the foe, this venom is specially potent against those already compromised.

move.name: Memento
move.effect: Single Target. The User faints. Reduce by 2 the foe's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense, and Sp. Defense. Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon.
move.description: As they take their last breath, the Pokémon leaves behind an imprint of regret on their foe.

move.name: Explosion
move.effect: Area Move. Ranged. Lethal. The User Faints.
move.description: Through a massive explosion the Pokémon destroys all they can before fainting. Sometimes the only way to get out of a bad situation is in bits and pieces.

move.name: Hyper Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge. Lethal.
move.description: A devastating beam, a path of destruction that can extend for miles is the unmistakable proof someone used this Move. Let the user rest before trying to use it again.

move.name: Lash Out
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 3 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move if any of the user's Attributes/Traits was lowered this Round.
move.description: The user fulminates the foe with the power of its frustration and a shriek of despair.

move.name: Corrosive Gas
move.effect: Area Attack. Those affected lose their held item.
move.description: The Pokémon releases a powerful acidic gas that melts all inorganic matter in seconds.

name: Tentacool
description: It lives in the seas all around the world. They release a toxic ink if startled. It is a surprisingly intelligent Pokémon and can use its tentacles to briefly establish a link between its mind and another creature.

abilityOne.name: Clear Body
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon is completely aware of all its body surroundings, trying to sneak on it will be incredibly difficult.
abilityOne.effect: Other Pokemon cannot Increase or Reduce the Attributes of this Pokemon. This Pokemon can still Increase or Reduce its own Attributes.

abilityTwo.name: Liquid Ooze
abilityTwo.description: The Pokemon produces a pestilent and toxic ooze within its body. Do not attempt to eat it.
abilityTwo.effect: If this Pokemon is hit by a Move that would asborb it's vital energy (Leech Seed, Mega Drain, Dream Eater, Drain Punch, etc.) it will deal damage to the foe instead of healing

hiddenAbility.name: Rain Dish
hiddenAbility.description: The Pokemon will store rain water for drink and nourishment.
hiddenAbility.effect: While Rain Weather is active, you may restore 1 HP to this Pokemon at the end of each Round.

move.name: Poison Sting
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
move.description: A tiny stab that causes big troubles.

move.name: Supersonic
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Sound Move. Confuse the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a series of ultrasonic waves that mess with the foe by making it feel dizzy and disoriented.

move.name: Constrict
move.effect: Single Target. This Move deals Typeless damage. Roll 1 chance die to reduce the Target's Dexterity by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon tightens their hold on the foe to keep them locked in a squeeze.

move.name: Acid
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Roll 1 Chance die to Reduce by 1 the Sp. Defense of those affected.
move.description: The Pokémon spits an acidic gunk into the foe that immediately gives burning sensation. Keep away from the eyes and wash with abundant water.

move.name: Toxic Spikes
move.effect: Target Foe's side of the Field. Entry Hazard. Foes who enter the battlefield become Poisoned. Roll 1 Chance Die for them to become Badly Poisoned instead. Pokemon with immunity to Ground-Type Moves are not affected.
move.description: The Pokémon lays a trap of tiny venom-drenched spikes through the battlefield. The battle has not yet begun and the foes are already defeated.

move.name: Bubble Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 1.
move.description: A powerful stream of foamy bubbles shot straight into the foe

move.name: Wrap
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion.
move.description: The Pokémon swiftly entangles their foe in a squeezing lock to prevent their escape.

move.name: Acid Spray
move.effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 2.
move.description: Do not point at face or eyes. Keep away from children.

move.name: Barrier
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
move.description: Whenever a foe attempts to to get too close to the user, they suddenly stop as if something ...or someone, prevented their movement.

move.name: Water Pulse
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target.
move.description: The user sends out a pulsing ring of water that blasts the foe with ultrasonic waves. For a while, everything seems as if reflected in the water ripples.

move.name: Brine
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 3 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool if the Target is at half HP or less.
move.description: A splash of sea water that literally adds more and more salt to the foe’s wounds.

move.name: Screech
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Reduce the Target's Defense by 2.
move.description: A mighty screech will make the target cover its ears instead of covering its flanks.

move.name: Hex
move.effect: Single Target. *If the Target has an active Status Condition, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move.
move.description: The user casts a terrible hex over the target, the effects will be greater if the target is already burdened by an ailment.

move.name: Sludge Wave
move.effect: Area Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Poison those affected.
move.description: A wave of black water spouts all around the user. It’s knee-high and rising. Fighting in such unsanitary conditions is not a good idea.

move.name: Aurora Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce target's Strength by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a beautiful shimmering beam that cools down a hot temper.

move.name: Confuse Ray
move.effect: Single Target. Confuse the Target.
move.description: The user flashes a sinister ray of bright light that others cannot help but go straight into it.

move.name: Magic Coat
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 4. Support Moves that would target the user or its side of the field are inflicted to the foe performing the Move or that foe's side of the field instead.
move.description: Through a swift mind trick the Pokémon trick the foe into pouring their ill intent on itself.

move.name: Water Gun
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The fastest water gun in town. No enemy will remain dry

move.name: Poison Jab
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon is set on injecting venom directly into the foe’s bloodstream. They can do it the easy way or the hard way.

move.name: Acid Armor
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
move.description: Highly acidic goop oozes through the pores of this Pokémon. Touching it immediately causes a burning pain. Preventing foes from getting too close.

move.name: Surf
move.effect: Area Move. If a Target is out of range due to the Move "Dive", this Move hits anyways. Out of battle, allows the Pokemon to travel the sea for long distances.
move.description: The Pokémon calls forward a large wave of seawater to ride, most Pokémon get washed out as they did not bring a surfboard.

move.name: Wring Out
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. *Remove 1 Dice from the Damage Pool for every missing HP on the target. Up to 4 Dice may be removed this way.
move.description: The Pokémon quite literally squeezes the life out of their foe. But to do this effectively they require to be in top condition.

move.name: Hydro Pump
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2
move.description: Water works best under pressure.

name: Whirlipede
description: It is usually motionless. When it is attacked, it rotates at high speed and then crashes into its opponent with its body covered in poison spikes. Inside, it is storing energy for evolving, which normally takes a few months.

abilityOne.name: Poison Point
abilityOne.description: The pointy thorns and scales on this Pokemon release a venom that will infect anyone who touches them roughly. Wear gloves when handling them.
abilityOne.effect: If this Pokemon is hit by a Non-Ranged Physical Move, Roll 3 Chance Dice to inflict Poison on the foe.

abilityTwo.name: Swarm
abilityTwo.description: The Pokemon enters a hive mind state when its life is on the line, calling upon a swarm to aid it in battle.
abilityTwo.effect: Pain Penalization won't reduce successes from Accuracy or Damage rolls of Bug-Type Moves used by this Pokemon. Bug-Type Moves get 2 Extra dice to their Damage Pool when this Pokemon is at half HP or less.

hiddenAbility.name: Speed Boost
hiddenAbility.description: This Pokemon will start maneuvering at an accelerated rate, it will move as if it blinked from place to place.
hiddenAbility.effect: At the end of the Round, Increase this Pokemon's Dexterity Attribute by 1. Up to 3 Points might be added this way.

move.name: Defense Curl
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 1. Increase by 1 the Power of the Moves "Ice Ball" & "Rollout".
move.description: The user curls into a ball to protect themselves when they feel threatened.

move.name: Protect
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokemon would receive from a Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Moves that target the user.
move.description: A mighty energy shield materializes in front of the user to to deflect attacks and dispel ill effects.

move.name: Poison Tail
move.effect: Single Target. High Critical. Roll 1 Chance Die to Poison the Target.
move.description: A sharp edge dipped in venom—an attack in bad blood in all senses of the word.

move.name: Iron Defense
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
move.description: Iron body, iron will. This Pokémon is unbreakable.

move.name: Venoshock
move.effect: Single Target. *If the Target is already Poisoned, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.
move.description: The Pokémon identifies the weakest prey and makes an opportunistic shot.

move.name: Rock Climb
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target. Out of battle it aids to climb cliffs and mountains with ease.
move.description: The Pokémon climbs over the foe and rests atop of their head as if it were the top of a mountain. This results confusing for the foe.

move.name: Toxic Spikes
move.effect: Target Foe's side of the Field. Entry Hazard. Foes who enter the battlefield become Poisoned. Roll 1 Chance Die for them to become Badly Poisoned instead. Pokemon with immunity to Ground-Type Moves are not affected.
move.description: The Pokémon lays a trap of tiny venom-drenched spikes through the battlefield. The battle has not yet begun and the foes are already defeated.

move.name: Spikes
move.effect: Target Foe's Side of the Field. Entry Hazard. Pokemon entering the battle Receive 1 Typeless Damage. This effect does not stack. Pokemon with immunity to Ground-Type Moves are not affected.
move.description: Sharp and pointy spikes are scattered around the field, if you don’t watch your step the spikes will dig on your feet.

move.name: Poison Sting
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
move.description: A tiny stab that causes big troubles.

move.name: Rollout
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions. *If all 5 actions land successfully, add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of the last hit of this Move. If the Pokemon used the Move "Defense Curl" in the same round, this Move's base Power becomes 2.
move.description: When the foe sees this Pokémon rollin’ they’ll be hatin’.

move.name: Pursuit
move.effect: Single Target. *If a Target hit by this Move is recalled, attempts to Run Away, uses a Switcher Move or is the Target of a Switcher Move, Deal 2 Typeless Damage to it. Outside of battle, aid in catching a fleeing target.
move.description: The Pokémon is relentless in its pursuit of their target, striking it just as it believed it had escaped.

move.name: Screech
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Reduce the Target's Defense by 2.
move.description: A mighty screech will make the target cover its ears instead of covering its flanks.

move.name: Bug Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. If the target Pokemon is holding a berry, the User eats it and gains its effects.
move.description: The Pokémon nibbles at their foe in hopes of finding something tasty to snack on.

move.name: Take Down
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Recoil.
move.description: Through a reckless grapple, the Pokémon smashes the foe into the ground, usually falling along with it.

move.name: Agility
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: Swift of body, swift of mind.

move.name: Toxic
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Badly Poison the Target.
move.description: This burning acid dissolves skin to enter the bloodstream directly. The poor victim feels like they are melting from the inside out. The clock is ticking.

move.name: Venom Drench
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. *If the affected are already Poisoned or becomes Poisoned in the same Round this Move was used, Reduce by 1 their Strength, Special and Dexterity.
move.description: The user weakens the foe’s already compromised immune systems.

move.name: Double-Edge
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil.
move.description: Without regard for their own safety, the Pokémon does a reckless attack against their foe.

move.name: Steamroller
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch Target.
move.description: The user curls up and rolls at full speed against the foe with the intention to swat them on the ground.

move.name: Steel Roller
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Can't be used if there is no Active Terrain (Grassy Terrain, Electric Terrain, etc.) on the Battlefield. Remove any active Terrain on the Battlefield.
move.description: The Pokémon rolls into a wheel, destroying anything in their path. Buildings come crashing down, forests are swept away and the soil is left as a blank slate.

name: Absol
description: It is said that this Pokémon can live for 100 years. It has a bad reputation: whenever one is seen, a disaster is soon to follow - earthquakes, forest fires, and tidal waves. Absol lead a lonely life.

abilityOne.name: Pressure
abilityOne.description: Being around this Pokemon will be very stressing and demanding, only the bravest dare to face them one-on-one.
abilityOne.effect: When this Pokemon comes out, All foes in Range spend half (rounded up) of their remaining Will Points without gaining any effect for it. This effect does not stack.

abilityTwo.name: Super Luck
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon has an incredible good luck, good things happen to it regularly.
abilityTwo.effect: All Physical and Special Moves of this Pokemon have "High Critical" as an Added Effect. If the Move already had "High Critical" the effect stacks and this Pokemon only requires 1 more Success on the Accuracy roll to land a Critical instead of 2.

hiddenAbility.name: Justified
hiddenAbility.description: This Pokemon has an innate sense of justice, wrongdoings will make them really angry.
hiddenAbility.effect: If a Dark-Type Move hits this Pokemon, Increase its Strength by 1. Up to 3 points can be increased this way.

move.name: Scratch
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their sharp claws to scratch the enemy. Nothing fancy but it works.

move.name: Me First
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Copy Move. Support Moves can't be copied. Unique Moves can't be copied. You may choose another Target(s) for the copied Move.
move.description: The user anticipates the next Move the target will use and impatiently interrupts to be the first in line.

move.name: Pursuit
move.effect: Single Target. *If a Target hit by this Move is recalled, attempts to Run Away, uses a Switcher Move or is the Target of a Switcher Move, Deal 2 Typeless Damage to it. Outside of battle, aid in catching a fleeing target.
move.description: The Pokémon is relentless in its pursuit of their target, striking it just as it believed it had escaped.

move.name: Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe
move.description: The user lands a vicious bite, leaving an ugly bruise.

move.name: Double Team
move.effect: Target Self. The User can now make up to 5 Evasions per Round.
move.description: The Pokémon moves so fast they create a series of shadow copies of themselves. Trying to guess which one is the real one is a pain.

move.name: Night Slash
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical. Cutter Move.
move.description: The user looks for a weak spot, tearing the soft flesh apart with a single vile slash of its claws.

move.name: Sucker Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 6. *This move can only be used as a Late Reaction; and only if the Target used a Physical or Special Move, otherwise it will fail.
move.description: The Pokémon takes advantage of their foe preparing to attack to unleash a dirty surprise blow.

move.name: Hex
move.effect: Single Target. *If the Target has an active Status Condition, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move.
move.description: The user casts a terrible hex over the target, the effects will be greater if the target is already burdened by an ailment.

move.name: Play Rough
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 1 Chance Dice to Reduce Target's Strength by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon and their foe start a playful wrestle that soon escalates into a furious wrestling match.

move.name: Spite
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Will to 1 point. Reset any effects it got from spending Will Points.
move.description: The target feels overwhelmend by feelings of dread.

move.name: Quick Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Out of battle, double the Pokemon's movement speed.
move.description: An attackas fight as lightning.

move.name: Leer
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The vicious glare of a predator that triggers the flight response of their prey.

move.name: Knock Off
move.effect: Single Target. *If the Target is holding an Item, Add 2 Dice to the Damage pool of this Move. The Target loses its Held Item afterwards.
move.description: The Pokémon rudely smacks what their foe was holding.

move.name: Taunt
move.effect: Single Target. The Target cannot perform Support Moves (Support Maneuvers may still be performed). Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: Through tease and mockery, the foe is enraged to the point it stops thinking clearly.

move.name: Feint
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 1. This Move ignores the effects of any Shield Move active on the Target and removes their effects for the rest of the Round.
move.description: The user begins their attack, and as their target attempts to protect itself, the user feints the target to break their defense against their true strike.

move.name: Detect
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokemon would receive from a Physical or Special move. Negate the Added Effcts of Any Moves that target the user.
move.description: The Pokémon detects the intentions of the attacker and reacts just in time to minimize the damage.

move.name: Razor Wind
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Charge Move. High Critical. Cutter Move.
move.description: The Pokémon sways the winds while charging what appears to be an invisible blade made of pressurized air. The wind slices everything it touches as if it were a razor.

move.name: Slash
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical. Cutter Move.
move.description: The Pokémon uses the sharpest part of their body as a blade to tear and slash with vicious intent.

move.name: Focus Energy
move.effect: Target Self. All of the user's Physical & Special Moves now have "High Critical". Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The Pokémon concentrates all their focus on the battle to make their attacks much more precise.

move.name: Swords Dance
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Strength by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon dances with strong steps and a fierce attitude as a ritual to prepare for battle.

move.name: Megahorn
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal.
move.description: The Pokémon uses its strong horn(s) to pierce their foe and deal massive damage.

move.name: Psycho Cut
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. High Critical. Cutter Move.
move.description: The user sends out an invisible sword made with psychic energy that slashes targets even if they are far away

move.name: Perish Song
move.effect: Area Move. Sound Move. Three Rounds after this Move is used, deal damage to those affected equal to their remaining HP. Removing from battle prevents this effect.
move.description: A song for mourning the departed. Although it sounds beautiful, it fills the heart with grief and despair, making the listeners feel as if they were laying on their death bed.

move.name: Future Sight
move.effect: Single Target. This Move's damage is dealt at the beginning of the next Round. Ignore Shield Moves, Force Field, Cover & Substitute. If the target restires or switches out from battle, the damage will be dealt to the next opponent or to one of its allies.
move.description: The Pokémon foresees something terrible happening. Although when it tries to see their own future, the images are ever changing.

name: Claydol
description: It is made entirely of clay. The first one was discovered in ruins from 20,000 years ago. A strange light is said to be the source of its life and Psychic abilities. Its eight eyes are always alert and always watching.

abilityOne.name: Levitate
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon floats to move around without ever touching the ground.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon has immunity to Ground-Type moves and effects active on the battlefield such as Terrains and certain Entry Hazards.

move.name: Harden
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 1.
move.description: When life gets hard, do the same.

move.name: Rapid Spin
move.effect: Single Target. Increase the User's Dexterity by 1. Remove Entry Hazards, Terrains (ie Grassy Terrain, Misty Terrain), Ongoing Damage and Leech seed from the User and/or their side of the field.
move.description: The Pokémon makes a swift spin to strike at the foe and in the process everything laying close to the user is scattered out of the battlefield.

move.name: Heal Block
move.effect: Area Move. Those affected can't restore HP. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: Through a massive mental onslaught, the Pokémon brings back the memories of pain on everyone around.

move.name: Earth Power
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: The user sends out a subterranean wave that bursts the ground below the target. It’s as if the earth bends to the user’s will.

move.name: Stealth Rock
move.effect: Target Foe's Side of the Field. Entry Hazard. Pokemon entering the battle Receive 1 Rock-Type Damage. This effect does not stack.
move.description: The Pokémon hides a trap of sharp rocks that are launched at the victim before they even realize what even happened.

move.name: Mud Slap
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.
move.description: A mud ball splatters right into the foe’s face, reducing their field of vision.

move.name: Confusion
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Confuse the Target.
move.description: A basic mental assault that makes the foe believe they are being attacked by an invisible enemy.

move.name: Teleport
move.effect: Target Self. Switcher Move for the User. Out of battle, Teleportation distances and limitations are determined by the User's Special Score and Storyteller's discretion.
move.description: Now you see me. Now you don’t.

move.name: Imprison
move.effect: Target Self. While the User is on the battlefield, Moves known by the User cannot be used by foes. This effect ends if the User is removed from battle.
move.description: This move blocks all shared parts of a memory the user is well aware of. Moves, techniques, names, places, people or situations, no one will be able to recall those imprisoned memories.

move.name: Rock Tomb
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 1.
move.description: The pokémon buries their foe prematurely, but it’ll be good practice for the real thing.

move.name: Psybeam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Confuse the Target.
move.description: The foe’s mind isassaulted by a mental ray, afterwards they may suffer from hallucinations.

move.name: Power Trick
move.effect: Target Self. Switch the User's Strength with their Defense and Special with their Sp. Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon tricks their own mind to believe their vitality is their power and vice versa.

move.name: Ancient Power
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Increase by 1 the User's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense and Sp. Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon calls forward an energy from the ancient past. This may infuse the user with a primal strength.

move.name: Cosmic Power
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon elevates their cosmos to enhance their physical and mental fortitude.

move.name: Extrasensory
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon alters their target’s senses, making it feel things that aren’t really there.

move.name: Self Destruct
move.effect: Area Move. Lethal. Ranged. The User faints.
move.description: It’s not about winning or losing, some pokémon just want to see the world burn.

move.name: Power Split
move.effect: Single Target. Average the User's Strength and Special with the Target's, rounded down.
move.description: Through a mental link both Pokémon are aware of each other strengths, which ends up evening the odds.

move.name: Guard Split
move.effect: Single Target. Average the User's Defense and Sp. Defense with the Target's, rounded down.
move.description: Through a mental link both Pokémon are aware of each other weaknesses, which end up evening the odds.

move.name: Sandstorm
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Wind Move. Activate Sandstorm Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A fierce sandstorm starts raging all around the battlefield. Cover your eyes, nose and face! The rough sand will hurt you!

move.name: Explosion
move.effect: Area Move. Ranged. Lethal. The User Faints.
move.description: Through a massive explosion the Pokémon destroys all they can before fainting. Sometimes the only way to get out of a bad situation is in bits and pieces.

move.name: Hyper Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge. Lethal.
move.description: A devastating beam, a path of destruction that can extend for miles is the unmistakable proof someone used this Move. Let the user rest before trying to use it again.

move.name: Scorching Sands
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the foe.
move.description: The sand around the user heats to scorching temperatures as it is thrown against their foe.

move.name: Stored Power
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Die to the Damage Pool of this Move for each Attribute increase the User has, up to a maximum of 7 total Dice. (eg The User has 2 increased Points of Defense, add 2 Damage Dice.)
move.description: This move allows the user to release its power. If the user has any boosts, the damage is increased.

name: Gothorita
description: Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using floating stones. According to many old tales, it creates friends for itself by controlling sleeping children on starry nights.

abilityOne.name: Frisk
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon can see the items others may be carrying, even if they are hidden.
abilityOne.effect: When this Pokemon enters the battlefield, Storyteller must reveal its trainer the held item of one foe.

abilityTwo.name: Competitive
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon's determination grows in the face of adversity. It is always trying to compete with those around it.
abilityTwo.effect: The first time this Pokemon gets an Attribute reduced by a foe during a battle, Increase its Special by 2.

hiddenAbility.name: Shadow Tag
hiddenAbility.description: The Pokemon can physically take a hold of shadows to make them act on their own or capture their victims.
hiddenAbility.effect: All Targets in Range become Blocked. Ghost-type Pokemon are immune to this effect. Pokemon with the same ability are immune to this effect.

move.name: Pound
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user pounds the target’s head. Simple

move.name: Confusion
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Confuse the Target.
move.description: A basic mental assault that makes the foe believe they are being attacked by an invisible enemy.

move.name: Tickle
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce by 1 the Target's Strength and Defense.
move.description: Whoever said laughter is the best therapy lied.

move.name: Play Nice
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Strength by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon starts to play with the foe. They are firendly, respectful, and thank the foe for the fun time. The foe does not want to fight, they want to keep playing.

move.name: Double Slap
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Double Action.
move.description: The name is misleading as the user slaps withouth even counting how many slaps they have given already

move.name: Psybeam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Confuse the Target.
move.description: The foe’s mind isassaulted by a mental ray, afterwards they may suffer from hallucinations.

move.name: Psyshock
move.effect: Single Target. This Move is resisted with the Target's Defense instead of its Sp. Defense.
move.description: The shock is mental, the blow is real.

move.name: Telekinesis
move.effect: Single Target. Target becomes immune to Ground-Type Moves. Target can't Evade. Duration 2 Rounds.
move.description: The target levitates from the ground as the user’s telekinetic powers prevent its movement.

move.name: Role Play
move.effect: Single Target. Replace the User's Ability with the Target's. Whole Scene Duration. Unique Abilities can't be copied.
move.description: The Pokémon is a great actor. Their impersonations are really good! ...maybe a bit too good.

move.name: Charm
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce Target's Strength by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon engages their foe in a charming interaction to reduce their aggressive intent.

move.name: Hypnosis
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Put the Target to sleep. Dark-Type Pokemon are affected by this Move.
move.description: By staring at an hypnotic pendulum, the target is suggestioned to feel tired and close its eyelids.

move.name: Fake Tears
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce foe's Sp. Defense by 2.
move.description: The user stops mid-combat to start crying; feeling incredibly guilty, the foe lowers its guard.

move.name: Feint Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Never Miss.
move.description: The user approaches inconspicuously, pretending to attack the foe directly, then actually hits the foe from behind.

move.name: Psych Up
move.effect: Single Target. The User gets the same Attribute/Trait Increases and Reductions the Target has.
move.description: The Pokémon mentalizes themselves stronger than anyone. They feel good. They can win. They. Can. Do. This!

move.name: Embargo
move.effect: Single Target. The Target loses its Held Item. Target's Trainer & Partners can't use Items on the Target. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The user demands the held item of a Pokémon and the items in the bag of their trainer. Scared, both Pokémon and Trainer comply

move.name: Flatter
move.effect: Single Target. Increase the Target's Special by 1. Confuse the Target.
move.description: The user starts flattering and admiring its opponent. It sure makes them feel good about themselves but...why?!

move.name: Psychic
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: The most iconic Psychic attack, the foe starts floating in the air and its swayed around by telekinesis as their mental barrier crumbles.

move.name: Heal Block
move.effect: Area Move. Those affected can't restore HP. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: Through a massive mental onslaught, the Pokémon brings back the memories of pain on everyone around.

move.name: Future Sight
move.effect: Single Target. This Move's damage is dealt at the beginning of the next Round. Ignore Shield Moves, Force Field, Cover & Substitute. If the target restires or switches out from battle, the damage will be dealt to the next opponent or to one of its allies.
move.description: The Pokémon foresees something terrible happening. Although when it tries to see their own future, the images are ever changing.

move.name: Magic Room
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Held items lose their effects. No items can be used. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The entire battlefield becomes a room on which the laws of the material world are rendered useless.

move.name: Helping Hand
move.effect: Target One Ally. Reaction 5. The Target Gets 2 Extra Dice on their next Skill Check/Accuracy Roll, and 2 Extra Dice on their next Damage Roll. This Effect does not Stack.
move.description: The Pokémon is the first to come and give a hand to their friend. A true bro.

move.name: Fake Out
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Flinch the Target. This Move will only work on the First Round the User is out in battle. from the Second Round on, it will fail automatically.
move.description: The Pokémon pretends to be getting ready for the battle when they are actually prepairing a surprise attack on the foe.

name: Trapinch
description: Their nest is like a bowl pit dug in sand. Trapinch wait for prey to tumble down their pit, later to be crushed between this Pokémon's jaws. Beware of them, as their bite can cause serious damage.

abilityOne.name: Hyper Cutter
abilityOne.description: The claws of this Pokemon are very sharp. Their edge can't be dulled.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon can't have its Strength Attribute reduced by Moves, Abilities, or Items. This Pokemon can still Reduce its own Strength Attribute.

abilityTwo.name: Arena Trap
abilityTwo.description: The ground around this Pokemon becomes really soft and hard to walk in. When in danger, it will sink the ground around itself creating a shifting sand pit.
abilityTwo.effect: Pokemon entering or already on the foe's side of the field become blocked as long as this Pokemon is on the field. Pokemon with immunity to Ground-Type Moves are not affected.

hiddenAbility.name: Sheer Force
hiddenAbility.description: This Pokemon is only interested in showing off its incredible battle prowess.
hiddenAbility.effect: Whenever this Pokemon uses a Physical or Special Move with Added Effects, you may choose to ignore them and add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool instead. Added Effects from Items trigger this effect but do not stack.

move.name: Sand Tomb
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Ranged. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion.
move.description: The Pokémon creates a pit of shifting sand around the foe to bury it alive. The poor victim struggles for air as the sand keeps sinking it lower and lower.

move.name: Mud Slap
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.
move.description: A mud ball splatters right into the foe’s face, reducing their field of vision.

move.name: Bide
move.effect: Single Target. The User will not Evade or Clash the next 2 Physical or Special Moves targeting it. Once all damage has been dealt against the User, roll a number of Normal-Type Damage dice equal to twice the total amount of Damage the Target received. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The user puts up with being hit, waiting for the perfect opportunity to retaliate.

move.name: Bulldoze
move.effect: Area Move. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: The user stomps and flattens the ground, pushing all the rubbish and leaving the surface ready for construction.

move.name: Sandstorm
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Wind Move. Activate Sandstorm Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A fierce sandstorm starts raging all around the battlefield. Cover your eyes, nose and face! The rough sand will hurt you!

move.name: Superpower
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Reduce by 1 the User's Strength and Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon packs all their power in a single crushing strike. All this effort leaves them quite tired afterwards.

move.name: Bug Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. If the target Pokemon is holding a berry, the User eats it and gains its effects.
move.description: The Pokémon nibbles at their foe in hopes of finding something tasty to snack on.

move.name: Giga Drain
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The Pokémon drains most of the foe’s vital energy and feeds on the nutrients it managed to extract.

move.name: Astonish
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe.
move.description: The user sneaks behind their target to jump scare them.

move.name: Sand Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce by 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.
move.description: Sand to the eyes! A dirty tactic in more ways than one.

move.name: Laser Focus
move.effect: Target Self. If the next Physical or Special Move the user performs gets 5 more successes required on the Accuracy Roll, ignore the Target's defenses on the Damage roll.
move.description: Through its incredible awarenes the Pokémon finds a straight path into a weak point of the foe. The attack that follows is devastating.

move.name: Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe
move.description: The user lands a vicious bite, leaving an ugly bruise.

move.name: Feint
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 1. This Move ignores the effects of any Shield Move active on the Target and removes their effects for the rest of the Round.
move.description: The user begins their attack, and as their target attempts to protect itself, the user feints the target to break their defense against their true strike.

move.name: Feint Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Never Miss.
move.description: The user approaches inconspicuously, pretending to attack the foe directly, then actually hits the foe from behind.

move.name: Dig
