move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Earth Power/ Earthquake/ Fissure/ Magnitude/ Stomping Tantrum. Out of battle allows the Pokemon to burrow and make underground tunnels.
move.description: The user digs a tunnel on the ground and attacks by coming out from below its target. This move has been used to escape caves and gain access to highly surveiled places.

move.name: Earth Power
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: The user sends out a subterranean wave that bursts the ground below the target. It’s as if the earth bends to the user’s will.

move.name: Rock Slide
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch those affected.
move.description: Don’t worry, even if you are not the fastest one in the race, you can still win by a landslide.

move.name: Crunch
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Lethal. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the foe's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon viciously mauls, tears, and rips apart anything its fangs can come in contact with.

move.name: Hyper Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge. Lethal.
move.description: A devastating beam, a path of destruction that can extend for miles is the unmistakable proof someone used this Move. Let the user rest before trying to use it again.

move.name: Earthquake
move.effect: Area Move. Ranged. If the Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dig" this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The user calls the forces of nature. The earth shakes violently and everything crumbles to the ground.

move.name: Fissure
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 5. Ranged. Deal Damage to the Target equal to its Remaining HP, plus 1 Lethal Damge. If the Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dig" this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The earth rips apart underneath the target and swallows them whole. You’ll need a rescue team to recover the unlucky victim from the deep.

move.name: Strength
move.effect: Outside of battle, using this move allows the Pokemon to lift double the normal weight it should be able to.
move.description: The Pokemon strains its muscles to go beyond their own limits.

name: Vespiquen
description: This Pokémon is female only. It raises grubs in the holes in its body and secretes pheromones to control Combee to fight and gather honey for it. It is a royal Pokémon that won't take orders from anyone.

abilityOne.name: Unnerve
abilityOne.description: It may be its powerful gaze or its menacing presence, but others near this Pokemon become really nervous to the point where they lose their appetite.
abilityOne.effect: Foes cannot consume their held berry or recycled berries while this Pokemon is in the field.

abilityTwo.name: Pressure
abilityTwo.description: Being around this Pokemon will be very stressing and demanding, only the bravest dare to face them one-on-one.
abilityTwo.effect: When this Pokemon comes out, All foes in Range spend half (rounded up) of their remaining Will Points without gaining any effect for it. This effect does not stack.

move.name: Sweet Scent
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Those affected cannot Evade Moves. Out of Battle, it will attract wild Pokemon.
move.description: The Pokémon releases a sweet aroma that lulls their enemies into a false sense of security

move.name: Gust
move.effect: Single Target. Wind Move. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop", this Move hits anyway.
move.description: The Pokémon flaps their wings and strikes the foe with a swirl of wind. Pokémon in the air may get swept away

move.name: Poison Sting
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
move.description: A tiny stab that causes big troubles.

move.name: Confuse Ray
move.effect: Single Target. Confuse the Target.
move.description: The user flashes a sinister ray of bright light that others cannot help but go straight into it.

move.name: Fell Stinger
move.effect: Single Target. *If used against a fainted Target ot if the Target faints due to damage from this Move, Increase the User’s Strength by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon stings the target, if the foe is too weakened to move, the user absorbs their power.

move.name: Fury Swipes
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions.
move.description: With their sharp claws, the Pokémon will swiftly scatch their foe, leaving its face full of small cuts.

move.name: Air Slash
move.effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: A compressed wind-slash, the change of pressure knocks out the target momentarily

move.name: Captivate
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 2 the Special of those affected.
move.description: The Pokémon shows off their attractiveness and even flirts with the opponents, those who fall for their charms can’t keep focus on the battle.

move.name: Fury Cutter
move.effect: Single Target. Successive Actions. Cutter Move.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their claws or scythes to rapidly cut as if shredding paper.

move.name: Pursuit
move.effect: Single Target. *If a Target hit by this Move is recalled, attempts to Run Away, uses a Switcher Move or is the Target of a Switcher Move, Deal 2 Typeless Damage to it. Outside of battle, aid in catching a fleeing target.
move.description: The Pokémon is relentless in its pursuit of their target, striking it just as it believed it had escaped.

move.name: Aromatic Mist
move.effect: Target One Ally. Increase by 1 the Defense and Sp. Defense of the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon sprays an ally with a delicate aroma that makes everyone pull their punches against it.

move.name: Swagger
move.effect: Single Target. Increase the Target's Strength by 2. Confuse the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon’s arrogant and mocking attitude enrage their foe and make it lose focus in battle.

move.name: Pin Missile
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged. Successive Actions.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a barrage of stingers or spikes that pierce like needles.

move.name: Silver Wind
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Increase by 1 the User's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense, and Sp. Defense.
move.description: A beautiful but dangerous wind that blows a silver powder against the foe. The performance may give the user a big confidence boost.

move.name: Aromatherapy
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Cure Status Ailments (All Burn degrees, Freeze, Paralysis, All Poison & Sleep) on the Targets.
move.description: The Pokémon releases a series of essential oils and herbal scents to refresh themselves and their companions.

move.name: Power Gem
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: With a crystal gem, the Pokémon will always save the day!

move.name: Toxic
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Badly Poison the Target.
move.description: This burning acid dissolves skin to enter the bloodstream directly. The poor victim feels like they are melting from the inside out. The clock is ticking.

move.name: Slash
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical. Cutter Move.
move.description: The Pokémon uses the sharpest part of their body as a blade to tear and slash with vicious intent.

move.name: Attack Order
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. High Critical.
move.description: The queen calls her swarm an heeds them to charge against you. No matter where you run, they will surround you. Hope you are not allergic to bees.

move.name: Defend Order
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense and Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: A swarm of bugs flies around the user, creating a barrier to protect their swarm queen from damage.

move.name: Heal Order
move.effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate.
move.description: The queen commands the swarm to bring her healing honey.

move.name: Destiny Bond
move.effect: Target Self. If the user faints this Round due to damage frm a Physical or Special Move, the Pokemon who dealt the damage is dealt damage equal to their remaining Hp. This Move will fail if it was used the previous Round.
move.description: Through a mystical bond, everyone who brings disgrace to this Pokémon will suffer the exact same fate.

move.name: Hyper Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge. Lethal.
move.description: A devastating beam, a path of destruction that can extend for miles is the unmistakable proof someone used this Move. Let the user rest before trying to use it again.

move.name: Giga Impact
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge. Lethal.
move.description: The Pokémon strikes with such a brutal force they leave a crater just from the impact. Let them catch their breath afterwards.

move.name: Infestation
move.effect: Single Target. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion.
move.description: The Pokémon summons a bothersome swarm to prevent the foe from escaping. The swarm will relentlessly attack the foe.

name: Solgaleo
description: There are legends about a being who radiated as if it was the sun made flesh. This radiant Pokémon made its light shine for all living things. On its forehead, a third eye linking it to another dimension.

abilityOne.name: Full Metal Body
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon's body is a thick metal armor, its shiny coat cannot be muddled. Look inside of it and you may be blinded by the sun's brightness.
abilityOne.effect: Other Pokemon cannot Reduce the Attributes of this Pokemon. This Pokemon can still Reduce its own Attributes. Unique Ability.

move.name: Sunsteel Strike
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Unique. If anything on the foe's side would prevent this move frm dealing (Pokemon Type, Abilities, Shield Moves, Weather or Force Fields), ignore it. This Move cannot be Clashed.
move.description: You suddenly stop in your tracks as you see a bright and blinding light coming towards you at great speed. You do not see what hits you before it’s all darkness.

move.name: Cosmic Power
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon elevates their cosmos to enhance their physical and mental fortitude.

move.name: Wake-Up Slap
move.effect: Single Target. *If the foe has the Sleep Status, Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool. Wake up the foe after dealing damage.
move.description: Wakey wakey, sleepy head!

move.name: Teleport
move.effect: Target Self. Switcher Move for the User. Out of battle, Teleportation distances and limitations are determined by the User's Special Score and Storyteller's discretion.
move.description: Now you see me. Now you don’t.

move.name: Metal Claw
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 1 Chance Die to Increase the User's Strength by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon uses the foe as a whetstone.

move.name: Iron Head
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon charges to cure the foe’s iron deficit.

move.name: Zen Headbutt
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses both their mental and physical prowess in a questionable yet effective “psychic” strike.

move.name: Flash Cannon
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: Through shiny metal parts of their body, the Pokémon reflects a light beam straight into the foe’s eyes.

move.name: Morning Sun
move.effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. If Sunny Weather is in effect, this Move becomes a Complete Heal. If performed under Rain, Sandstorm, Hail or Snowy Weather, this Move is a Minor heal only heals 1 HP.
move.description: The Pokémon feels revitalized with the bright sun early in the mornings.

move.name: Crunch
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Lethal. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the foe's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon viciously mauls, tears, and rips apart anything its fangs can come in contact with.

move.name: Metal Burst
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 5. Can only be used if Target's last Move on User was a Physical or Special Move. Roll dice equal to Target's last damage pool rolled against the User plus 2 Dice. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: Those who live by the sword will die by the sword, or, in this case, by an explosion.

move.name: Solar Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. If Sunny Weather is active, you skip this Move's Charge action. If performed under Rain, Sandstorm or Hail/Snowy Weather, this Move takes two actions to Charge.
move.description: The Pokémon gathers sunlight but instead of being absorbed it is sot as a devastating beam of light instead.

move.name: Noble Roar
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Reduce by 1 the Target's Strength and Special.
move.description: The mighty roar of a king. It commands respect and authority over anyone who listens.

move.name: Flare Blitz
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil. Roll 1 Chance die to inflict 3rd Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: A reckless blazing charge against their foe, ends up with an explosive collision

move.name: Wide Guard
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Reaction 3. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage the Targets would receive from Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Any Moves on the Targets.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their whole body to provide shelter and protection to everyone they can. They are the rock on which others stand.

move.name: Giga Impact
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge. Lethal.
move.description: The Pokémon strikes with such a brutal force they leave a crater just from the impact. Let them catch their breath afterwards.

move.name: Sunny Day
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Activate Sunny Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The Pokémon will call for the sun to shine brighter, increasing the heat of the arena. This Move doesn’t work at night, indoors, or underground/water.

move.name: Light Screen
move.effect: Target the User's side of the field. Force Field. Activate a Force Field against Special Damage. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A barrier of light is created over half of the battlefield, all energy trying to go trough dissolves as it crosses it.

move.name: Outrage
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
move.description: The true nature of dragon-types unleashed. The user is consumed by a primal fury that won’t stop until everything has ben razed to the ground. Afterwards the Pokémon is confused.

move.name: Flame Charge
move.effect: Single Target. Increase the User's Dexterity by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon dashes so fast they leave a trail of fire behind.

move.name: Metal Sound
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 2.
move.description: A horrible screeching sound rumbles in the foe’s ears. Some people will try to convince you that this is good music.

move.name: Wild Charge
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil. Roll 1 Chance die to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon surrounds itself with lightning then recklessly charges against their target.

move.name: Iron Defense
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
move.description: Iron body, iron will. This Pokémon is unbreakable.

name: Trubbish
description: The combination of garbage bags and industrial waste caused the chemical reaction that created this Pokémon. It belches a poison gas; breathing it will leave you sick in bed for a week. It loves filthy places.

abilityOne.name: Stench
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon can emit a smell so unpleasant it repels other people and Pokemon.
abilityOne.effect: Reduce the chance of wild Pokemon encounters at Storyteller's discretion. Whenever this Pokemon is hit with a Non-Ranged Physical Move, Roll 1 Chance Die to Flinch the foe.

abilityTwo.name: Sticky Hold
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon's body is always oozing adhesive substances, if something gets glued, it will be very difficult to remove.
abilityTwo.effect: This Pokemon's Held Item cannot be removed, stolen or swapped by Moves or Abilities.

hiddenAbility.name: Aftermath
hiddenAbility.description: When hurt or upset, the Pokemon will prepare to burst. If hit hard enough, it will explode on contact. They also tend to hold grudges.
hiddenAbility.effect: If this Pokemon faints due to a Non-Ranged Physical Move, the User of that attack is dealt 2 Damage.

move.name: Pound
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user pounds the target’s head. Simple

move.name: Poison Gas
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 1. Poison those affected.
move.description: A thick cloud of toxic gas that causes violent coughs and red eyes.

move.name: Recycle
move.effect: Target Self. The Pokemon reuses an Item (Berries, Potions, Full Heal, etc.) that has already been spent during the battle on any side of the battlefield. Recycle can't be used more than 3 times per battle by the User.
move.description: One Pokémon’s trash is another one’s treasure.

move.name: Sludge
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
move.description: What is it with these Poison Types and covering their victims with all kinds of organic waste?!

move.name: Stockpile
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense. Enables the use of the Moves "Spit Up" and "Swallow".
move.description: The Pokémon swells up like a balloon by storing power within themselves. This helps them bounce back a bit of the damage.

move.name: Swallow
move.effect: Target Self. The user must have previously used the Move "Stockpile", otherwise this Move will fail. Complete Heal, if successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Reduce by 1 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense.
move.description: After stockpiling, the Pokémon swallows the energy to restore their health, they go back to their normal size afterwards.

move.name: Clear Smog
move.effect: Single Target. Never Miss. Reset all Increased or Reduced Attributes on the Foe.
move.description: The user shoots a blast of venomous pins that inject venom into the foe, this venom is specially potent against those already compromised.

move.name: Belch
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Sound Move. The user must eat a berry or something similar during the Round before using this Move, otherwise it will fail. This effect only works once per berry/food eaten.
move.description: The user shoots a blast of venomous pins that inject venom into the foe, this venom is specially potent against those already compromised.

move.name: Drain Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: A solid punch that weakens the foes and revitalizes the user with each hit.

move.name: Spikes
move.effect: Target Foe's Side of the Field. Entry Hazard. Pokemon entering the battle Receive 1 Typeless Damage. This effect does not stack. Pokemon with immunity to Ground-Type Moves are not affected.
move.description: Sharp and pointy spikes are scattered around the field, if you don’t watch your step the spikes will dig on your feet.

move.name: Rollout
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions. *If all 5 actions land successfully, add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of the last hit of this Move. If the Pokemon used the Move "Defense Curl" in the same round, this Move's base Power becomes 2.
move.description: When the foe sees this Pokémon rollin’ they’ll be hatin’.

move.name: Acid Spray
move.effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 2.
move.description: Do not point at face or eyes. Keep away from children.

move.name: Amnesia
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Sp. Defense by 2.
move.description: No thoughts. Head empty

move.name: Toxic Spikes
move.effect: Target Foe's side of the Field. Entry Hazard. Foes who enter the battlefield become Poisoned. Roll 1 Chance Die for them to become Badly Poisoned instead. Pokemon with immunity to Ground-Type Moves are not affected.
move.description: The Pokémon lays a trap of tiny venom-drenched spikes through the battlefield. The battle has not yet begun and the foes are already defeated.

move.name: Take Down
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Recoil.
move.description: Through a reckless grapple, the Pokémon smashes the foe into the ground, usually falling along with it.

move.name: Sludge Bomb
move.effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
move.description: An explosive burst of organic waste directly into the target’s face. Nerves of steel are required not to throw your breakfast afterwards.

move.name: Toxic
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Badly Poison the Target.
move.description: This burning acid dissolves skin to enter the bloodstream directly. The poor victim feels like they are melting from the inside out. The clock is ticking.

move.name: Pain Split
move.effect: Single Target. Spend 1 Will Point to activate. *Deal up to 3 Typeless Damage to the Target, Heal 1 HP to the User for every Damage dealt this way. This Move Fails if the User has more than Half HP rounded down. This Move cannot reduce a Target to less than 1 HP.
move.description: The user channels their pain into the foe to relieve their agony. The foe gets to feel the burn of the damage it has caused.

move.name: Gunk Shot
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
move.description: The target is covered heat to toe in sludge, filth and organic waste. It can’t even cry for help or all of it will go into its mouth.

move.name: Explosion
move.effect: Area Move. Ranged. Lethal. The User Faints.
move.description: Through a massive explosion the Pokémon destroys all they can before fainting. Sometimes the only way to get out of a bad situation is in bits and pieces.

name: Beartic
description: They love the cold northern seas and create pathways across the ocean's water by freezing their own breath. They dive in the sea to catch prey. They are not used to humans as they rarely see one.

abilityOne.name: Snow Cloak
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon's skin blends well with the surrounding snow and hail, you can barely see it.
abilityOne.effect: While Hail/Snow Weather is active, this Pokemon can use the Evasion Maneuver up to 5 times per Round. The Pokemon is immune to damage from Hail/Snow weather.

abilityTwo.name: Slush Rush
abilityTwo.description: The Pokemon is used to run and hunt on icy terrain, moving swiftly through the snow during blizzards and ice storms.
abilityTwo.effect: While Hail/Snow Weather is active, increase the Dexterity Attribute of this Pokemon by 1. The Pokemon is immune to damage from Hail/Snow Weather.

hiddenAbility.name: Swift Swim
hiddenAbility.description: The Pokemon will move faster in water than on land, even a puddle-covered roadway will allow it to use its full speed.
hiddenAbility.effect: While Rain Weather is active, Increase this Pokemon's Dexterity Attribute by 2.

move.name: Growl
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Reduce by 1 the Strength of those affected.
move.description: Either through a menacing attitude or an adorable demeanor, the foe will hesitate to attack the user at full power.

move.name: Powder Snow
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Roll 1 Chance Die to Freeze those affected.
move.description: A light layer of snow flakes covers the foes, as the layers pile up the possibilities to be trapped into the snow increase.

move.name: Bide
move.effect: Single Target. The User will not Evade or Clash the next 2 Physical or Special Moves targeting it. Once all damage has been dealt against the User, roll a number of Normal-Type Damage dice equal to twice the total amount of Damage the Target received. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The user puts up with being hit, waiting for the perfect opportunity to retaliate.

move.name: Icy Wind
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Wind Move. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: Polar winds sweep through the arena. Everyone starts to shiver and embrace themselves, trying to preserve a bit of warmth.

move.name: Icicle Crash
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Lethal. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon creates a big stalactite on top of the foe and lets it fall on top of it. Sometimes they manage to impale the foe to the ground.

move.name: Aqua Jet
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1.
move.description: The Pokémon propels themselves with a jet of pressured water.

move.name: Fury Swipes
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions.
move.description: With their sharp claws, the Pokémon will swiftly scatch their foe, leaving its face full of small cuts.

move.name: Night Slash
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical. Cutter Move.
move.description: The user looks for a weak spot, tearing the soft flesh apart with a single vile slash of its claws.

move.name: Endure
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. If a Physical or Special Move would cause the user to faint, they remain at 1 HP instead, remove this effect afterwards. The effect re-activates on the user's next Turn. Whole Round duration.
move.description: The Pokémon mentally prepares to receive a fatal blow, their spirit is stronger than their body so they endure to keep on fighting for as long as possible.

move.name: Play Nice
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Strength by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon starts to play with the foe. They are firendly, respectful, and thank the foe for the fun time. The foe does not want to fight, they want to keep playing.

move.name: Brine
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 3 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool if the Target is at half HP or less.
move.description: A splash of sea water that literally adds more and more salt to the foe’s wounds.

move.name: Frost Breath
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. This Move is always considered to be a Critical hit and gets the proper Bonus for it.
move.description: The user locates the most exposed parts of its foe and sends a gelid breath against it. The sudden chill goes right through the foe’s spine.

move.name: Slash
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical. Cutter Move.
move.description: The Pokémon uses the sharpest part of their body as a blade to tear and slash with vicious intent.

move.name: Flail
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of this Move for every missing Point of HP the user has. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The user flails around trying to stay alive, as they get closer to fainting, more adrenaline will fuel their efforts of survival.

move.name: Scary Face
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: When a Pokémon looks at you like THAT, you know you gotta thread carefully around them.

move.name: Hail
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Activate Hail Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The skies turn gray, and loud thunder rumbles, but what falls is not a gentle drizzle, but an endless stream of ice shards coming down at high speeds. Find shelter!

move.name: Thrash
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
move.description: The Pokémon becomes a wild thing and the rumpus has started.

move.name: Rest
move.effect: Target Self. Complete Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Put the User to Sleep.
move.description: Yeah, this seems like a good spot to take a nap.

move.name: Avalanche
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 4. *If the User received damage from the target during this Turn add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool. *If Snowy Weather is active add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.
move.description: The user covers themselves with a heavy snow coat, if anything disturbs the snow, it will fall like a heavy avalanche.

move.name: Liquidation
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Reduce the Target's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon strikes while bursting a full-force blast of pressurized water. The water may cut or dent through the target’s armor.

move.name: Blizzard
move.effect: All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Wind Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Freeze those affected. *Sunny Weather increases to Low Accuracy 4. **Hail/Snowy Weather remove Low Accuracy and adds the effect "Never Miss".
move.description: The user summons a turbulent and gelid wind that feels like ice daggers. A pleasant day may make it difficult to call upon, but beware if the temperatures go below zero.

move.name: Sheer Cold
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 5. Ranged. Deal Damage to the Target equal to its Remaining HP, plus 1 Lethal Damage.
move.description: The Pokémon reaches an absolute zero by being freezed from the inside out. Urgent medical attention is required.

move.name: Superpower
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Reduce by 1 the User's Strength and Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon packs all their power in a single crushing strike. All this effort leaves them quite tired afterwards.

move.name: Heavy Slam
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to he Damage Pool for every 50kg of weight the User is above the target's weight. Up to 4 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The foe is about to confirm if the Pokémon is thick-boned.

move.name: Swords Dance
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Strength by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon dances with strong steps and a fierce attitude as a ritual to prepare for battle.

name: Sirfetch'd
description: Only Farfetch'd that have survived many battles can go through this evolution. They are very proud of their leek spear and leafen shield. When this Pokémon's leek withers, it will retire from combat.

abilityOne.name: Steadfast
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon may have a stern exterior but it is reliable and even more when adversity strikes.
abilityOne.effect: The first time this Pokemon is affected by Flinch, Increase its Dexterity Attribute by 1.

abilityTwo.name: Scrappy
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon does not believe in ghosts.
abilityTwo.effect: This Pokemon can hit Ghost-type Pokemon with Normal and Fighting Type Moves. Apply resistances or weaknesses to the foe if it has a secondary type.

move.name: Peck
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: Raise crows and they’ll peck your foe’s eyes.

move.name: Sand Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce by 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.
move.description: Sand to the eyes! A dirty tactic in more ways than one.

move.name: Leer
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The vicious glare of a predator that triggers the flight response of their prey.

move.name: Fury Cutter
move.effect: Single Target. Successive Actions. Cutter Move.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their claws or scythes to rapidly cut as if shredding paper.

move.name: Rock Smash
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Reduce the Target's Defense by 1.
move.description: A hit powerful enough to destroy rocks and crack armor.

move.name: Brutal Swing
move.effect: Target All foes in Range. Lethal.
move.description: The Pokémon starts attacking at full force with its claws, anyone unfortunate enough to be in its path will end up severely wounded.

move.name: Detect
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokemon would receive from a Physical or Special move. Negate the Added Effcts of Any Moves that target the user.
move.description: The Pokémon detects the intentions of the attacker and reacts just in time to minimize the damage.

move.name: Knock Off
move.effect: Single Target. *If the Target is holding an Item, Add 2 Dice to the Damage pool of this Move. The Target loses its Held Item afterwards.
move.description: The Pokémon rudely smacks what their foe was holding.

move.name: Swords Dance
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Strength by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon dances with strong steps and a fierce attitude as a ritual to prepare for battle.

move.name: First Impression
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 2. This Move will only work on the First Round the User is out in battle. From the second round on, it will fail automatically.
move.description: The Pokémon makes a dramatic entrance to the battlefield, taking the foe by surprise.

move.name: Iron Defense
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
move.description: Iron body, iron will. This Pokémon is unbreakable.

move.name: Simple Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Change the Target's Ability to "Simple". Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon.
move.description: A weak mental beam that doesn’t hurt or confuse the target but it does change their view of life as they start to take a simpler apporach to things.

move.name: Endure
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. If a Physical or Special Move would cause the user to faint, they remain at 1 HP instead, remove this effect afterwards. The effect re-activates on the user's next Turn. Whole Round duration.
move.description: The Pokémon mentally prepares to receive a fatal blow, their spirit is stronger than their body so they endure to keep on fighting for as long as possible.

move.name: Focus Energy
move.effect: Target Self. All of the user's Physical & Special Moves now have "High Critical". Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The Pokémon concentrates all their focus on the battle to make their attacks much more precise.

move.name: Defog
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Remove all Force Fields, Entry Hazards and Terrains (Misty Terrain, Electric Terrain, etc.) from the Battlefield.
move.description: A strong wind sweeps out the battle field, removing anything from bad weather to scattered objects and even invisible barriers.

move.name: Brick Break
move.effect: Single Target. *If there is a Force field on the Target's side of the field, destroy it and add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.
move.description: The Pokémon uses a karate technique to chop through tall piles of bricks. No matter how many layers you pile up, they’ll break regardless.

move.name: Slam
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1.
move.description: Everybody get up, it’s time to slam now.

move.name: Leaf Blade
move.effect: Single Target. High Critical. Lethal. Cutter Move.
move.description: Danger lies not on the material’s toughness but on its edge’s sharpness.

move.name: Final Gambit
move.effect: Single Target. Ignore Defenses. The user Faints after dealing Damage.
move.description: The Pokémon puts its last Strength into an all-or-nothing attack. After that, the user faints.

move.name: Brave Bird
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil.
move.description: Back in the day humans relied on birds to send their messages and even go to war. Many earned medals for bravery.

move.name: Meteor Assault
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Lethal. Must Recharge.
move.description: The Pokémon will make an incredible jump to the sky, then lunge towards the foe at a staggering speed, crashing the ground upon impact. The user is left very tired.

name: Voltorb
description: They live near factories and electric generators. It bears an uncanny and unexplained resemblance to a Poké Ball. Since it explodes at the slightest provocation, even veteran trainers treat it with caution.

abilityOne.name: Static
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon's body is always ready to let off a jolt of static electricity at the slightest touch.
abilityOne.effect: When hit by a Non-Ranged Physical Move, this Pokemon rolls 3 Chance Dice to inflict Paralysis on the foe.

abilityTwo.name: Soundproof
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon's body is structured to protect it from noises that might disturb its peace and focus. So it's not ignoring you, it just can't hear you.
abilityTwo.effect: This Pokemon is immune to the Damage and Added Effects of all Sound-based moves.

hiddenAbility.name: Aftermath
hiddenAbility.description: When hurt or upset, the Pokemon will prepare to burst. If hit hard enough, it will explode on contact. They also tend to hold grudges.
hiddenAbility.effect: If this Pokemon faints due to a Non-Ranged Physical Move, the User of that attack is dealt 2 Damage.

move.name: Charge
move.effect: Target Self. Add 2 Dice to the Damage Pool of thenext Damaging Electric-Type Move the User performs.
move.description: The user gathers electricity and stores it to make its attacks more powerful. You may also use them as a living battery for your phone.

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Sonic Boom
move.effect: Single Target. This Move always inflict 1 Typeless damage. Ignore Defenses, Force Fields, Shield Moves, Cover, Out of Range, Type or Ability that would prevent this damage.
move.description: The Pokémon makes use of a small but very destructive shock that goes through any wall, layer or wall.

move.name: Eerie Impulse
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce foe's Special by 2.
move.description: The user radiates electricity around itself so the foe will think twice about attacking.

move.name: Rollout
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions. *If all 5 actions land successfully, add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of the last hit of this Move. If the Pokemon used the Move "Defense Curl" in the same round, this Move's base Power becomes 2.
move.description: When the foe sees this Pokémon rollin’ they’ll be hatin’.

move.name: Screech
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Reduce the Target's Defense by 2.
move.description: A mighty screech will make the target cover its ears instead of covering its flanks.

move.name: Charge Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Increase User's Special by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon releases an electric beam, if any charge remains unused, it will make use of it to boost its power.

move.name: Light Screen
move.effect: Target the User's side of the field. Force Field. Activate a Force Field against Special Damage. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A barrier of light is created over half of the battlefield, all energy trying to go trough dissolves as it crosses it.

move.name: Electro Ball
move.effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of the user for every Point on Dexterity it has that surpasses the Foe's. Up to 4 Dice might be added this way.
move.description: An orb of electricity is hurled against the target, the faster the user dashes, the more momentum the orb gets.

move.name: Magnet Rise
move.effect: Target Self. The User gains Immunity against Ground-Type Moves. Whole Scene Duration
move.description: The Pokémon creates a magnetic field to repel themselves from the ground, allowing it to float for a short period of time.

move.name: Gyro Ball
move.effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of this Move for every point on Dexterity the Target has that surpasses the User's. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a projectile. Correction: the Pokémon IS the projectile.

move.name: Mirror Coat
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 5. Can only be used if Target's last Move on User was a Special Move. For damage, roll dice equal to Target's last damage pool rolled against the User plus 2. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The user gathers the harmful energies around themselves and bounces them back to their source.

move.name: Endure
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. If a Physical or Special Move would cause the user to faint, they remain at 1 HP instead, remove this effect afterwards. The effect re-activates on the user's next Turn. Whole Round duration.
move.description: The Pokémon mentally prepares to receive a fatal blow, their spirit is stronger than their body so they endure to keep on fighting for as long as possible.

move.name: Sucker Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 6. *This move can only be used as a Late Reaction; and only if the Target used a Physical or Special Move, otherwise it will fail.
move.description: The Pokémon takes advantage of their foe preparing to attack to unleash a dirty surprise blow.

move.name: Foul Play
move.effect: Single Target. S.T.A.B. of the User and the Strength/Special of the foe are used for this Move's Damage Pool.
move.description: The user feints an attack that tricks the foe into hurting itself.

move.name: Thunder Shock
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance die to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The most basic electric attack, charge, release, and shock! Just don’t point it to any electric device.

move.name: Flash
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon glows with a bright light to temporarily blind and dazzle their foe. It’s also perfect to light up dark places.

move.name: Spark
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The user engulfs itself with statc electricity then charges with a solid tackle against the foe. Sparks fly, very literally.

move.name: Self Destruct
move.effect: Area Move. Lethal. Ranged. The User faints.
move.description: It’s not about winning or losing, some pokémon just want to see the world burn.

move.name: Swift
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Never Miss.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a burst of star-shaped sparkles at a blinding speed.

move.name: Discharge
move.effect: Area Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze those affected.
move.description: The user lets out an enormous discharge over the arena. Lightning does not distinguish friend from foe.

move.name: Explosion
move.effect: Area Move. Ranged. Lethal. The User Faints.
move.description: Through a massive explosion the Pokémon destroys all they can before fainting. Sometimes the only way to get out of a bad situation is in bits and pieces.

name: Dewgong
description: Its body is covered with a pure white fur. The colder the weather, the more active it becomes. It hunts at night and it's excellent at catching fish Pokémon. It is also very intelligent and playful.

abilityOne.name: Thick Fat
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon's body has a thick layer of blubber that protects it against against harsh temperatures.
abilityOne.effect: Reduce by 1 the damage taken from Fire and Ice-Type moves.

abilityTwo.name: Ice Body
abilityTwo.description: The Pokemon's body is almost frozen, and can cool down enclosed areas in a few minutes. It feels most comfortable when temperatures are below zero.
abilityTwo.effect: If Hail/Snow Weather is active, you may restore 1 HP to this Pokemon at the end of the Round. This Pokemon is immune to damage from Hail weather.

move.description: The Pokémon makes a standing ovation at their target, prompting them to repeat everything they just did, exactly the way they did it.

move.name: Ice Shard
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Ranged.
move.description: With extraordinary swiftness, the Pokémon shoots an ice bullet like the fastest gun in the North Pole.

move.name: Perish Song
move.effect: Area Move. Sound Move. Three Rounds after this Move is used, deal damage to those affected equal to their remaining HP. Removing from battle prevents this effect.
move.description: A song for mourning the departed. Although it sounds beautiful, it fills the heart with grief and despair, making the listeners feel as if they were laying on their death bed.

move.name: Horn Drill
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 5. Deal Damage equal to the Target's Remaining HP, plus 1 Lethal Damage.
move.description: The Pokémon stabs the target with a spinning horn, drilling through them until they are critical condition. Hurry to the nearest Pokémon Center.

move.name: Headbutt
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Out of battle it may cause a Random encounter when hitting trees and make objects drop from high places.
move.description: The Pokémon rams against their foe with their head. This Move is perfect to shake down trees when looking for berries, but beware of wild Pokémon nesting at the treetops.

move.name: Water Gun
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The fastest water gun in town. No enemy will remain dry

move.name: Take Down
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Recoil.
move.description: Through a reckless grapple, the Pokémon smashes the foe into the ground, usually falling along with it.

move.description: The Pokémon shoots a beautiful shimmering beam that cools down a hot temper.

move.description: Just look at the world around you right here on the ocean floor, such wonderful things surround you. What more are you lookin’ for?

move.description: The user sways their tail to create a pocket whirlpool in which the foe gets sucked in by the spinning motion.

move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Successive Actions.
move.description: A barrage of icicles shot against the target. They are small but sharp and pointy

move.description: The Pokémon reaches an absolute zero by being freezed from the inside out. Urgent medical attention is required.

name: Dugtrio
description: Because the triplets originally split from one body, they think exactly alike. They work together to dig endlessly through the ground. They are known for destroying the foundations of roads and buildings.

abilityOne.name: Sand Force
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon controls the particles of sand around the battlefield to give a boost to its attacks.
abilityOne.effect: While Sandstorm Weather is active, if this Pokemon uses a Physical or Special Ground, Steel or Rock-Type Move, add 1 Extra die to the Damage Pool of that Move. The Pokemon is immune to damage from Sandstorm Weather.

abilityTwo.name: Arena Trap
abilityTwo.description: The ground around this Pokemon becomes really soft and hard to walk in. When in danger, it will sink the ground around itself creating a shifting sand pit.
abilityTwo.effect: Pokemon entering or already on the foe's side of the field become blocked as long as this Pokemon is on the field. Pokemon with immunity to Ground-Type Moves are not affected.

move.name: Scratch
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their sharp claws to scratch the enemy. Nothing fancy but it works.

move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe.

move.description: The user shakes the tectonic plates underneath the battlefield, trying to find a fault, when they do, this Move is devastating.

move.name: Bulldoze
move.effect: Area Move. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: The user stomps and flattens the ground, pushing all the rubbish and leaving the surface ready for construction.

move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Projectile Move. Roll 3 Chance Die to Reduce 1 success to all Accuracy rolls of the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a ball of mud to burst on their victim’s face in an attempt to blind them.

move.effect: Target Battlefield. Increase by 1 the Strength and Special of all Grass-Type Pokemon.
move.description: The Pokémon digs around the battlefield to soften the soil and make it ideal for harvest.

move.name: Sand Tomb
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Ranged. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion.
move.description: The Pokémon creates a pit of shifting sand around the foe to bury it alive. The poor victim struggles for air as the sand keeps sinking it lower and lower.
