move.description: The Pokémon enters the dream world for a snack. The dreams of children and baby Pokémon are the tastiest.

move.name: Moonblast
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Reduce Target's Special by 1.
move.description: The user becomes a champion of lunar justice. In the name of the moon, they will right the wrongs and triumph over evil!

move.name: Future Sight
move.effect: Single Target. This Move's damage is dealt at the beginning of the next Round. Ignore Shield Moves, Force Field, Cover & Substitute. If the target restires or switches out from battle, the damage will be dealt to the next opponent or to one of its allies.
move.description: The Pokémon foresees something terrible happening. Although when it tries to see their own future, the images are ever changing.

move.name: Heal Pulse
move.effect: Target One Ally. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate.
move.description: Commanding the mind over the matter, the Pokémon speeds up the healing process on an ally.

move.name: Healing Wish
move.effect: Target Self. The user faints. One allied Target restores its full HP and it is cured from any Status Condition. If the chosen Target is not in-battle, it is called out and ready to fight with the same remaining actions as the user.
move.description: In a display of true selflessness, the user makes the ultimate sacrifice for the well-being of others.

move.name: Destiny Bond
move.effect: Target Self. If the user faints this Round due to damage frm a Physical or Special Move, the Pokemon who dealt the damage is dealt damage equal to their remaining Hp. This Move will fail if it was used the previous Round.
move.description: Through a mystical bond, everyone who brings disgrace to this Pokémon will suffer the exact same fate.

move.name: Expanding Force
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. *If Psychic Terrain is active, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move and you may add another target to it.
move.description: Psychic energies form a bubble of light to damage the foe. Under Psychic Terrain, the energy is so big it turns into a tall pillar that crushes anyone inside.

move.name: Memento
move.effect: Single Target. The User faints. Reduce by 2 the foe's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense, and Sp. Defense. Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon.
move.description: As they take their last breath, the Pokémon leaves behind an imprint of regret on their foe.

name: Hoopa (Unbound Form)
description: There is a story of an old demon whose power unleashed horrors from other dimensions onto earth. Ripping the fabric of existence, it opened portals to bring evil upon all.

abilityOne.name: Magician
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon excells at performing simple magic tricks that amaze others, such as conjuring and vanishing objects nearby in the blink of an eye.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon will steal the Held Item of a foe it just hit with a Physical or Special Move. If it already has a Held Item you may choose to switch it for the one it stole. For information on held Items see p.83.

move.name: Trick
move.effect: Single Target. The User and the Target switch their Held Item. If only one Pokemon is holding an Item, it gives it away.
move.description: The user controls its target’s mind to make them do a simple non-hostile action, such as walking or handing an item. Although some Pokémon use simple sleigh of hand.

move.name: Destiny Bond
move.effect: Target Self. If the user faints this Round due to damage frm a Physical or Special Move, the Pokemon who dealt the damage is dealt damage equal to their remaining Hp. This Move will fail if it was used the previous Round.
move.description: Through a mystical bond, everyone who brings disgrace to this Pokémon will suffer the exact same fate.

move.name: Ally Switch
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 3. Switcher Move for the User. If successful, restore the Action this Move costed and the switched ally may use a Reaction when they enter the field.
move.description: The user vanishes just as they were about to be hit, and suddenly there’s another Pokémon in their place. Di-Did the user disappear? Or was it never there to begin with?

move.name: Confusion
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Confuse the Target.
move.description: A basic mental assault that makes the foe believe they are being attacked by an invisible enemy.

move.name: Astonish
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe.
move.description: The user sneaks behind their target to jump scare them.

move.name: Magic Coat
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 4. Support Moves that would target the user or its side of the field are inflicted to the foe performing the Move or that foe's side of the field instead.
move.description: Through a swift mind trick the Pokémon trick the foe into pouring their ill intent on itself.

move.name: Light Screen
move.effect: Target the User's side of the field. Force Field. Activate a Force Field against Special Damage. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A barrier of light is created over half of the battlefield, all energy trying to go trough dissolves as it crosses it.

move.name: Psybeam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Confuse the Target.
move.description: The foe’s mind isassaulted by a mental ray, afterwards they may suffer from hallucinations.

move.name: Skill Swap
move.effect: Single Target. Switch the User's Ability with the Target's. Whole Scene Duration. This affect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon. Unique Abilities can't be switched.
move.description: The Pokémon enters their foe’s mind to assimilate the traits of that species while make the foe think it is a member from another species. The foe gets an identity crisis afterwards.

move.name: Power Split
move.effect: Single Target. Average the User's Strength and Special with the Target's, rounded down.
move.description: Through a mental link both Pokémon are aware of each other strengths, which ends up evening the odds.

move.name: Guard Split
move.effect: Single Target. Average the User's Defense and Sp. Defense with the Target's, rounded down.
move.description: Through a mental link both Pokémon are aware of each other weaknesses, which end up evening the odds.

move.name: Knock Off
move.effect: Single Target. *If the Target is holding an Item, Add 2 Dice to the Damage pool of this Move. The Target loses its Held Item afterwards.
move.description: The Pokémon rudely smacks what their foe was holding.

move.name: Zen Headbutt
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses both their mental and physical prowess in a questionable yet effective “psychic” strike.

move.name: Wonder Room
move.effect: Target the Battlefield. Everyone on the Battlefield will have their Defense and Sp. Defense calculated with Insight instead of Vitality. If using Insight as Sp. Defense optional rule, swap the calculation. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The battlefield is now a space that puts the mind to the test. A resilient mind will be a resilient body, but if the mind is weak the body will feel frail and feeble.

move.name: Trick Room
move.effect: Target the Battlefield. Invert the order of Initiative. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: Reality inside the battlefielfield is distorted, time bends and flows differently for everyone. Those who don’t rush through manage to adapt easier.

move.name: Dark Pulse
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: A haze of dark energy decends on the battlefield preying on those vulnerable to the obscure feelings and fears it provokes.

move.name: Nasty Plot
move.effect: Target Self. Increase User's Special by 2.
move.description: Rubbing both hands and laughing sinisterly the Pokémon rejoices in the evil plans they’ll soon carry out.

move.name: Psychic
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: The most iconic Psychic attack, the foe starts floating in the air and its swayed around by telekinesis as their mental barrier crumbles.

move.name: Hyperspace Hole
move.effect: Single Target. Never Miss. Unique. Ignore Defenses. Ignore Shield Moves and Force Field.
move.description: The laws of physics forbid one object from being in many places at once and from occupying the same space as other bodies. But the user disregards their autorithy.

move.name: Telekinesis
move.effect: Single Target. Target becomes immune to Ground-Type Moves. Target can't Evade. Duration 2 Rounds.
move.description: The target levitates from the ground as the user’s telekinetic powers prevent its movement.

move.name: Magic Room
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Held items lose their effects. No items can be used. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The entire battlefield becomes a room on which the laws of the material world are rendered useless.

move.name: Hyper Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge. Lethal.
move.description: A devastating beam, a path of destruction that can extend for miles is the unmistakable proof someone used this Move. Let the user rest before trying to use it again.

move.name: Snatch
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 6. Remove any Increase/Reduction on the Foe's Attributes, Active Shield Moves, Healing effects on the Foe, or effects on its side of the field; and place them on the User instead. See p. 531 for more info.
move.description: The user takes notice of the good stuff on the other side and quickly takes it for themselves. Finders keepers, losers weepers!

move.name: Throat Chop
move.effect: Single Target. The target cannot use any "Sound Based" Move. Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon.
move.description: A heinous attack to a Pokémon’s throat that will leave them unable to make a sound for hours.

name: Togetic
description: Although there have been very few sightings of this Pokémon in the wild, it is known to appear before kind-hearted people and grant them happiness. It is very energetic and friendly.

abilityOne.name: Serene Grace
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon will bring good luck as if it was blessed by the heavens. Its presence is soothing, it makes you feel calm and full of joy.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon adds 2 Extra Chance Dice to all Moves with effects that use them. (e.g. A move has 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the foe, this Pokemon will roll 5 Dice)

abilityTwo.name: Super Luck
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon has an incredible good luck, good things happen to it regularly.
abilityTwo.effect: All Physical and Special Moves of this Pokemon have "High Critical" as an Added Effect. If the Move already had "High Critical" the effect stacks and this Pokemon only requires 1 more Success on the Accuracy roll to land a Critical instead of 2.

move.name: Sweet Kiss
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Confuse the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon timidly approaches the foe and plants a delicate kiss on its cheek then quickly retreats giggling. The foe struggles to understand the meaning of this.

move.name: Metronome
move.effect: Single Target. Copy Move. Roll a die to determine Physical or Special category, roll a die to determine this Move's Power. The appearance, Type and added effects of this Move becomes the same of a Physical or Special Move of the same Power at Storyteller's Discretion.
move.description: The Pokémon waves their hands following a specific rythm, the energy around follows the cadence and manifests as a Move at random.

move.name: Magical Leaf
move.effect: Single Target. Never Miss.
move.description: The user sends out a floating leaf that will pursue the target until it hits.

move.name: Yawn
move.effect: Single Target. *If the Target has not been removed from battle at the beginning of the next Round, put it to Sleep.
move.description: The user yawns, the foe yawns, the trainers yawn... everyone should take a nap.

move.name: Fairy Wind
move.effect: Single Target. Wind Move.
move.description: The Pokémon let’s out sweet a breeze of glittery fairy dust. It gives a mild rash to those without happy thoughts.

move.name: Encore
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 3. The Target will repeat the exact same action sequence it had last Round. Target must have had an action sequence. Duration 1 Round. If used on the previous Round, this move fails. See more on p. 529.
move.description: The Pokémon makes a standing ovation at their target, prompting them to repeat everything they just did, exactly the way they did it.

move.name: After You
move.effect: Target One Ally. Reaction 1. The Target will go First in the Initiative Order. If used again, the previous target reverts to their original Initiative order. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The user bows and courteously lets a friend go first.

move.name: Lucky Chant
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Unique. Targets can Re-roll one un-successful die from all their rolls. Critical Hits do not grant Bonus dice against the Targets. Whole Scene Duration. Out of battle, good things happen at Storyteller's Discretion.
move.description: The magical incantation of an old priestess, through dance and song, good fortune and divine protection will come to you. This Move also removes evil spirits and curses.

move.name: Nasty Plot
move.effect: Target Self. Increase User's Special by 2.
move.description: Rubbing both hands and laughing sinisterly the Pokémon rejoices in the evil plans they’ll soon carry out.

move.name: Extrasensory
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon alters their target’s senses, making it feel things that aren’t really there.

move.name: Pound
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user pounds the target’s head. Simple

move.name: Charm
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce Target's Strength by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon engages their foe in a charming interaction to reduce their aggressive intent.

move.name: Life Dew
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. User and Allies in Range heal 1 HP at the end of each Round. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The user creates a fresh-water dew that restores energy and heals wounds.

move.name: Aerial Ace
move.effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. Never Miss.
move.description: The Pokémon rises up in the air towards a light source, momentarily blinding the foe. then plummets quickly to attack the opponent

move.name: Follow Me
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. All Foe's Moves able to do so will Target the user. Duration 1 Round.
move.description: The Pokemon draws everyone’s attention, provoking their foes to do their worse.

move.name: Baton Pass
move.effect: Target Self. Switcher Move for the User. Any Attribute increase on the user is passed on the next Pokemon. The user can't increase its own Attributes again until the end of the scene or until the switched Pokemon faints.
move.description: The Pokémon rallies through the battle, setting up everything for the next companion as they know this is a team effort.

move.name: Bestow
move.effect: Single Target. Can't be used if Target is not holding an Item. The User gives its Held Item to the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon offers their own item to the foe to show their good manners. The foe keeps it as they don’t want to be seem as impolite.

move.name: Safeguard
move.effect: Target User's side of the Field. Force Field. Those affected are immune to all Status Ailements/Conditions. Previously inflicted Status Ailments/Conditions remain. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A force field covers half of the battlefield and filters out all impurities and ill intentions coming from the other side.

move.name: Ancient Power
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Increase by 1 the User's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense and Sp. Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon calls forward an energy from the ancient past. This may infuse the user with a primal strength.

move.name: Double-Edge
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil.
move.description: Without regard for their own safety, the Pokémon does a reckless attack against their foe.

move.name: Last Resort
move.effect: Single Target. This Move will fail if the User has not successfully performed all of its known Moves at least once during the battle.
move.description: The Pokémon may be out of energy, but never out of options.

move.name: Wish
move.effect: Target Self / Target One Ally. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. This move has its effect at the beginning of the Next Round. If the User is switched it will heal whoever takes their place.
move.description: When you wish upon a star it makes no difference who you are, anything your heart desires will come to you.

name: Aggron
description: Aggron claim ownership of entire mountains, mercilessly beating up anything that crosses their path. Aggron are violent and patrol their territory at all times, but also plant trees, stop fires, and protect nature.

abilityOne.name: Rock Head
abilityOne.description: The head and body of the Pokemon are so resistant that they barely feel anything. Careful as they bump into things without even noticing.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon will not receive damage from Recoil.

abilityTwo.name: Sturdy
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon's body is extremely resistant to damage, it can withstand almost anything.
abilityTwo.effect: The first time this Pokemon would reach 0 HP due to damage from a Move, it will remain at 1 HP instead. Status Ailments/Conditions, Weather, and Self-inflicted damage do not trigger this effect. The Pokemon can only benefit from Sturdy once per scene.

hiddenAbility.name: Heavy Metal
hiddenAbility.description: The metal covering the body of the Pokemon is so thick that it can double and sometimes triple the average weight of the Pokemon.
hiddenAbility.effect: Increase the Pokemon's weight at the storyteller's discretion. Moves with damage based on the weight get their Damage Pool modified according to the increased weight of the user.

move.name: Harden
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 1.
move.description: When life gets hard, do the same.

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Mud Slap
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.
move.description: A mud ball splatters right into the foe’s face, reducing their field of vision.

move.name: Take Down
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Recoil.
move.description: Through a reckless grapple, the Pokémon smashes the foe into the ground, usually falling along with it.

move.name: Rock Tomb
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 1.
move.description: The pokémon buries their foe prematurely, but it’ll be good practice for the real thing.

move.name: Roar
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 6. Switcher Move for the Foe. In the wild, the battle may end.
move.description: With a potent roar, to make the foe reconsider their intentions.

move.name: Headbutt
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Out of battle it may cause a Random encounter when hitting trees and make objects drop from high places.
move.description: The Pokémon rams against their foe with their head. This Move is perfect to shake down trees when looking for berries, but beware of wild Pokémon nesting at the treetops.

move.name: Autotomize
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Dexterity by 2. Halve the User's weight.
move.description: Rotating parts and tiny gears, the Pokémon works like a welloiled machine.

move.name: Head Smash
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Recoil.
move.description: Pokémon, angry. Pokémon, smash!

move.name: Dragon Rush
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon rushes to charge against their foe. Unlucky victims end up crushed into the ground.

move.name: Metal Claw
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 1 Chance Die to Increase the User's Strength by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon uses the foe as a whetstone.

move.name: Protect
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokemon would receive from a Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Moves that target the user.
move.description: A mighty energy shield materializes in front of the user to to deflect attacks and dispel ill effects.

move.name: Iron Head
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon charges to cure the foe’s iron deficit.

move.name: Metal Sound
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 2.
move.description: A horrible screeching sound rumbles in the foe’s ears. Some people will try to convince you that this is good music.

move.name: Iron Tail
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Reduce the Target's Defense by 1.
move.description: With a hardened tail, the Pokémon swings against the foe to make a dent in their armor.

move.name: Iron Defense
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
move.description: Iron body, iron will. This Pokémon is unbreakable.

move.name: Rock Slide
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch those affected.
move.description: Don’t worry, even if you are not the fastest one in the race, you can still win by a landslide.

move.name: Metal Burst
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 5. Can only be used if Target's last Move on User was a Physical or Special Move. Roll dice equal to Target's last damage pool rolled against the User plus 2 Dice. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: Those who live by the sword will die by the sword, or, in this case, by an explosion.

move.name: Heavy Slam
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to he Damage Pool for every 50kg of weight the User is above the target's weight. Up to 4 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The foe is about to confirm if the Pokémon is thick-boned.

move.name: Double-Edge
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil.
move.description: Without regard for their own safety, the Pokémon does a reckless attack against their foe.

move.name: Body Press
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon makes a judo maneuver, using its body mass instead of its strength against the target.

name: Exploud
description: It is said that some tremors are caused by the roars of this Pokémon. They communicate with soft noises, raising their voice only in battle. They can emit many different kinds of sounds.

abilityOne.name: Soundproof
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon's body is structured to protect it from noises that might disturb its peace and focus. So it's not ignoring you, it just can't hear you.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon is immune to the Damage and Added Effects of all Sound-based moves.

abilityTwo.name: Scrappy
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon does not believe in ghosts.
abilityTwo.effect: This Pokemon can hit Ghost-type Pokemon with Normal and Fighting Type Moves. Apply resistances or weaknesses to the foe if it has a secondary type.

move.name: Pound
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user pounds the target’s head. Simple

move.name: Howl
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Sound Move. Increase by 1 the Strength of those affected.
move.description: If you hear the howl, the pack has already surrounded you.

move.name: Ice Fang
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Bite Move. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Freeze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon bites their foe with sharp teeth and a geli breath to chill their bones directly

move.name: Fire Fang
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Bite Move. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon bites the foe with their mouth ablaze, tearing and searing their foe’s flesh in a single attack.

move.name: Thunder Fang
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Bite Move. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon bites the foe with charged fangs, basically injecting electricity right into the foe’s nervous system.

move.name: Echoed Voice
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. This Move can be used many times in the same Round. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage pool of this move for each time you use it. Up to 8 Dice might be added this way. Reset this effect if the user performs another move, evasion or clash.
move.description: The Pokémon yells at the void. Their echo answers. The Pokémon yells louder and louder everytime the echo talks back.

move.name: Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe
move.description: The user lands a vicious bite, leaving an ugly bruise.

move.name: Rest
move.effect: Target Self. Complete Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Put the User to Sleep.
move.description: Yeah, this seems like a good spot to take a nap.

move.name: Outrage
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
move.description: The true nature of dragon-types unleashed. The user is consumed by a primal fury that won’t stop until everything has ben razed to the ground. Afterwards the Pokémon is confused.

move.name: Circle Throw
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy -1. Late Reaction 1. Switcher Move for the foe.
move.description: Using their best sumo moves, the Pokémon throws the foe 60ft. out of the battlefield.

move.name: Astonish
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe.
move.description: The user sneaks behind their target to jump scare them.

move.name: Sleep Talk
move.effect: If the user is not asleep, this Move fails. Instead of making a roll to try to wake up, the user may choose to use Sleep Talk instead. Choose a Move on the user's Move set at random and Target Random foe with it. Sleep Talk can be repeated up to 5 times per Round.
move.description: Despite being asleep, the Pokémon keeps dreaming about the battle. They talk incoherences and even sleep walk.

move.name: Stomp
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Die to Flinch the Target. Targets under the effects of the Move "Minimize" are vulnerable.
move.description: Stomping the foe with strong feet. Perfect to squish nasty little bugs.

move.name: Roar
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 6. Switcher Move for the Foe. In the wild, the battle may end.
move.description: With a potent roar, to make the foe reconsider their intentions.

move.name: Crunch
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Lethal. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the foe's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon viciously mauls, tears, and rips apart anything its fangs can come in contact with.

move.name: Screech
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Reduce the Target's Defense by 2.
move.description: A mighty screech will make the target cover its ears instead of covering its flanks.

move.name: Supersonic
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Sound Move. Confuse the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a series of ultrasonic waves that mess with the foe by making it feel dizzy and disoriented.

move.name: Uproar
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Sound Move. This Effect Targets the Battle Field: Pokemon will be cured of the Sleep Status. Duration 1 Round.
move.description: Shouts, screams, and loud music... What does a Pokémon have to do here for a peaceful night of sleep?

move.name: Hyper Voice
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move.
move.description: The user screeches or sings at such high frequencies that anything made of glass will break. The ears of the victims are left in no better state.

move.name: Synchronoise
move.effect: Area Move. Sound Move. Choose one Type (Fire, Poison, Steel, etc.). This move only affects those with that Type.
move.description: Each type of energy is contained by a thin layer of particles. With the right vibration frequency, that thin layer can be shattered like glass.

move.name: Hyper Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge. Lethal.
move.description: A devastating beam, a path of destruction that can extend for miles is the unmistakable proof someone used this Move. Let the user rest before trying to use it again.

move.name: Boomburst
move.effect: Area Move. Sound Move.
move.description: The Pokémon creates a sudden explosive sound that deafens everyone around.

move.name: Psych Up
move.effect: Single Target. The User gets the same Attribute/Trait Increases and Reductions the Target has.
move.description: The Pokémon mentalizes themselves stronger than anyone. They feel good. They can win. They. Can. Do. This!

name: Zygarde 50%
description: Underground tunnels have been found all over the Kalos Region. There are rumors of a creature that lives in them that attacks people damaging the ecosystem.

abilityOne.name: Aura Break
abilityOne.description: Anyone emitting a particularly evil aura will be purified, anyone with an aura of purity will be corrupted by evil, just for coming close to this Pokemon.
abilityOne.effect: Invert the effects that the Abilities Dark Aura and Fairy Aura have on their users. If said Abilities would increase a Dice Pool for their User, reduce it instead. Unique Ability.

abilityTwo.name: Power Construct
abilityTwo.description: Small cells gather around this Pokemon and are absorbed into its body. It grows bigger and stronger as more cells come together.
abilityTwo.effect: At the end of the Round, if this Pokemon has half or less of its HP, change its Form to the next one. When this Pokemon changes Form, remove Status Ailments & restore its full HP & Will. Unique Ability.

move.name: Glare
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Paralyze the Target.
move.description: With just one look, the target knows it is about to be someone else’s lunch, fear has them immobilized.

move.name: Bulldoze
move.effect: Area Move. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: The user stomps and flattens the ground, pushing all the rubbish and leaving the surface ready for construction.

move.name: Dragon Breath
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A mystical flame breath that feels strengely cold to the touch. It doesn’t burn in a conventional way.

move.name: Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe
move.description: The user lands a vicious bite, leaving an ugly bruise.

move.name: Safeguard
move.effect: Target User's side of the Field. Force Field. Those affected are immune to all Status Ailements/Conditions. Previously inflicted Status Ailments/Conditions remain. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A force field covers half of the battlefield and filters out all impurities and ill intentions coming from the other side.

move.name: Dig
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Earth Power/ Earthquake/ Fissure/ Magnitude/ Stomping Tantrum. Out of battle allows the Pokemon to burrow and make underground tunnels.
move.description: The user digs a tunnel on the ground and attacks by coming out from below its target. This move has been used to escape caves and gain access to highly surveiled places.

move.name: Bind
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Increase the Target's difficultty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion.
move.description: The Pokémon uses all their strength to restrain to the foe and keep them in place.

move.name: Land's Wrath
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Ranged. Lethal. Unique.
move.description: The earth moves on its own, no attacker in sight. The floor crumbles and the ground shakes engulfing its victims. From the rubble, lush trees emerge a short time after.

move.name: Sandstorm
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Wind Move. Activate Sandstorm Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A fierce sandstorm starts raging all around the battlefield. Cover your eyes, nose and face! The rough sand will hurt you!

move.name: Haze
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Remove all Increased or Reduced Attributes and Traits of everyone on the battlefield.
move.description: The battlefield is filled with a cleansing cloud that takes away all impurities in the field. It can also work as concealment.

move.name: Crunch
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Lethal. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the foe's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon viciously mauls, tears, and rips apart anything its fangs can come in contact with.

move.name: Earthquake
move.effect: Area Move. Ranged. If the Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dig" this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The user calls the forces of nature. The earth shakes violently and everything crumbles to the ground.

move.name: Camouflage
move.effect: Target Self. For the rest of the scene the User changes type to one that fits the terrain/ environment it is in (ie User is in a rocky cave, becoming rock type).
move.description: The Pokémon blends with their surroundings to increase their chances of survival.

move.name: Dragon Pulse
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon sends out a powerful wave of energy through their mouth.

move.name: Coil
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Defense score and Accuracy Pools.
move.description: The Pokémon curls up into themselves. Foes soon realize this is not the position of a prey in hiding, but of a hunter about to spit their venom.

move.name: Outrage
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
move.description: The true nature of dragon-types unleashed. The user is consumed by a primal fury that won’t stop until everything has ben razed to the ground. Afterwards the Pokémon is confused.

move.name: Extreme Speed
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 2. Out of battle, triple the Pokemon's movement speed.
move.description: Gotta go extremely fast.

move.name: Dragon Dance
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Dexterity.
move.description: The user performs a vigorous and mystical dance to boost their fighting spirit and reflexes.

move.name: Thousand Waves
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Ranged. Unique. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: Solid ground becomes a sandtrap, cracked earth will close to ensnare your feet. It’s as if the land itself wanted to trap you. There is no attacker nor escape in sight.

move.name: Thousand Arrows
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Ranged. Lethal. Unique. Ignore the Target's immunity to Ground. Remove the immunity to Ground-Type Moves of those affected. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: Out of nowhere, pointy shards come raining from the sky towards the foes. Even flying creatures will fall to the ground if they are knocked by them. Take cover, this is gonna hurt.

move.name: Core Enforcer
move.effect: Single Target. If the User has already received Damage from the Target this Round, Remove the Target's Ability for the rest of the scene. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon. Unique Abilities are not affected by this effect.
move.description: Zygarde shoots a beam that fractures the target to its core, rendering it unable to sustain even their own essence.

move.name: Stomping Tantrum
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move if the User failed the Accuracy roll of the last Move it performed. If the Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dig", this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The Pokémon throws a tantrum and stomps all over the place, it becomes worse if something has previously frustrated them.

name: Bronzong
description: Ancient people revered Bronzong for bringing the rain and sun at will. One became a news sensation recently when it was dug up at a construction site after a 2000-year sleep.

abilityOne.name: Levitate
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon floats to move around without ever touching the ground.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon has immunity to Ground-Type moves and effects active on the battlefield such as Terrains and certain Entry Hazards.

abilityTwo.name: Heatproof
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon can resist very high temperatures without trouble.
abilityTwo.effect: 1st and 2nd Degree Burns deal no Damage to this Pokemon. If this Pokemon is hit by a Fire-Type Move, Reduce the total damage dealt by 2.

hiddenAbility.name: Heavy Metal
hiddenAbility.description: The metal covering the body of the Pokemon is so thick that it can double and sometimes triple the average weight of the Pokemon.
hiddenAbility.effect: Increase the Pokemon's weight at the storyteller's discretion. Moves with damage based on the weight get their Damage Pool modified according to the increased weight of the user.

move.name: Sunny Day
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Activate Sunny Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The Pokémon will call for the sun to shine brighter, increasing the heat of the arena. This Move doesn’t work at night, indoors, or underground/water.

move.name: Rain Dance
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Activate Rain Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The Pokémon performs a peculiar dance in the middle of the field, everyone thinks it silly until the first thunder rumbles.

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Confusion
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Confuse the Target.
move.description: A basic mental assault that makes the foe believe they are being attacked by an invisible enemy.

move.name: Confuse Ray
move.effect: Single Target. Confuse the Target.
move.description: The user flashes a sinister ray of bright light that others cannot help but go straight into it.

move.name: Block
move.effect: Single Target. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: You don’t seem to understand. I’m not blocked in here with you... You are blocked in here with me!

move.name: Gyro Ball
move.effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of this Move for every point on Dexterity the Target has that surpasses the User's. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a projectile. Correction: the Pokémon IS the projectile.

move.name: Extrasensory
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon alters their target’s senses, making it feel things that aren’t really there.

move.name: Psywave
move.effect: Single Target. Roll Psychic-Type Damage Dice according to the User's Rank: Starter 1 Die / Rookie 2 Dice / Standard 4 Dice/ Advacned 6 Dice / Expert 8 Dice / Ace and forward 10 Dice. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: A powerful mental wave assault’s the target’s brain directly. Everything, from forgotten memories to the secrets of the universe bombard its mind in just a few seconds.

move.name: Payback
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move if the User has already received Damage from the Target this Round.
move.description: Some say the best revenge is a successful and happy life, but not this Pokémon.

move.name: Imprison
move.effect: Target Self. While the User is on the battlefield, Moves known by the User cannot be used by foes. This effect ends if the User is removed from battle.
move.description: This move blocks all shared parts of a memory the user is well aware of. Moves, techniques, names, places, people or situations, no one will be able to recall those imprisoned memories.

move.name: Hypnosis
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Put the Target to sleep. Dark-Type Pokemon are affected by this Move.
move.description: By staring at an hypnotic pendulum, the target is suggestioned to feel tired and close its eyelids.

move.name: Safeguard
move.effect: Target User's side of the Field. Force Field. Those affected are immune to all Status Ailements/Conditions. Previously inflicted Status Ailments/Conditions remain. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A force field covers half of the battlefield and filters out all impurities and ill intentions coming from the other side.

move.name: Iron Defense
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
move.description: Iron body, iron will. This Pokémon is unbreakable.

move.name: Feint Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Never Miss.
move.description: The user approaches inconspicuously, pretending to attack the foe directly, then actually hits the foe from behind.

move.name: Skill Swap
move.effect: Single Target. Switch the User's Ability with the Target's. Whole Scene Duration. This affect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon. Unique Abilities can't be switched.
move.description: The Pokémon enters their foe’s mind to assimilate the traits of that species while make the foe think it is a member from another species. The foe gets an identity crisis afterwards.

move.name: Heal Block
move.effect: Area Move. Those affected can't restore HP. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: Through a massive mental onslaught, the Pokémon brings back the memories of pain on everyone around.

move.name: Metal Sound
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 2.
move.description: A horrible screeching sound rumbles in the foe’s ears. Some people will try to convince you that this is good music.

move.name: Flash Cannon
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: Through shiny metal parts of their body, the Pokémon reflects a light beam straight into the foe’s eyes.

move.name: Hex
move.effect: Single Target. *If the Target has an active Status Condition, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move.
move.description: The user casts a terrible hex over the target, the effects will be greater if the target is already burdened by an ailment.

move.name: Future Sight
move.effect: Single Target. This Move's damage is dealt at the beginning of the next Round. Ignore Shield Moves, Force Field, Cover & Substitute. If the target restires or switches out from battle, the damage will be dealt to the next opponent or to one of its allies.
move.description: The Pokémon foresees something terrible happening. Although when it tries to see their own future, the images are ever changing.

move.name: Heavy Slam
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to he Damage Pool for every 50kg of weight the User is above the target's weight. Up to 4 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The foe is about to confirm if the Pokémon is thick-boned.

move.name: Steel Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Recoil.
move.description: A concentrated ray of light that is capable of melting even the thickest steel plates. Unfortunately, the user is also made of steel.

move.name: Trick Room
move.effect: Target the Battlefield. Invert the order of Initiative. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: Reality inside the battlefielfield is distorted, time bends and flows differently for everyone. Those who don’t rush through manage to adapt easier.

move.name: Body Press
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon makes a judo maneuver, using its body mass instead of its strength against the target.

name: Audino
description: Its auditory sense is astounding: using the feelers on its ears, it can know the health state of others. It is a caring Pokémon with a sweet disposition to help, but it is not too common to see in the wild.

abilityOne.name: Healer
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon has healing powers, and will use them without hesitation to aid others.
abilityOne.effect: If an Ally on the battle field has a Status Ailment, at the End of the Round this Pokemon rolls 3 Chance Dice to heal it. Outside of battle it can heal Status Ailments by spending 1 Will Point.

abilityTwo.name: Regenerator
abilityTwo.description: The body of this Pokemon will regenerate from damage really quick, wounds that would take days to heal will get better in a few hours.
abilityTwo.effect: This Pokemon may Heal up to 4 HP or up to 2 HP in case of Lethal Damage on its own every day. The Pokemon must be out of combat to benefit from this effect.

hiddenAbility.name: Klutz
hiddenAbility.description: This Pokemon does not understand how to use tools correctly, usually using them in unexpected ways.
hiddenAbility.effect: Held items won't have any effect on this Pokemon. Items that allow the Pokemon to Mega Evolve, use Z-Moves, go Dynamax/Gigantamax or Change type are not affected.

move.name: Play Nice
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Strength by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon starts to play with the foe. They are firendly, respectful, and thank the foe for the fun time. The foe does not want to fight, they want to keep playing.

move.name: Pound
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user pounds the target’s head. Simple

move.name: Baby-Doll Eyes
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Reduce Target's Strength by 1.
move.description: The biggest and brightest eyes, spakling with unshed tears, how can you say “no” to that?!

move.name: Take Down
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Recoil.
move.description: Through a reckless grapple, the Pokémon smashes the foe into the ground, usually falling along with it.

move.name: Simple Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Change the Target's Ability to "Simple". Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon.
move.description: A weak mental beam that doesn’t hurt or confuse the target but it does change their view of life as they start to take a simpler apporach to things.

move.name: Draining Kiss
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The Pokémon blows a flirtatious kiss; the foe catches it believing to have found love, but it turns out to be a trick to steal its life energy.

move.name: Heal Bell
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Sound Move. Cure any Status Ailment on the Targets.
move.description: The soothing chime of a magical bell cleanses all impurities.

move.name: Disarming Voice
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Never Miss.
move.description: With a charming but manipulative cry, the user deals emotional damage to their opponent by making them feel guilty.

move.name: Helping Hand
move.effect: Target One Ally. Reaction 5. The Target Gets 2 Extra Dice on their next Skill Check/Accuracy Roll, and 2 Extra Dice on their next Damage Roll. This Effect does not Stack.
move.description: The Pokémon is the first to come and give a hand to their friend. A true bro.

move.name: Growl
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Reduce by 1 the Strength of those affected.
move.description: Either through a menacing attitude or an adorable demeanor, the foe will hesitate to attack the user at full power.

move.name: Zen Headbutt
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses both their mental and physical prowess in a questionable yet effective “psychic” strike.

move.name: Life Dew
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. User and Allies in Range heal 1 HP at the end of each Round. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The user creates a fresh-water dew that restores energy and heals wounds.

move.name: After You
move.effect: Target One Ally. Reaction 1. The Target will go First in the Initiative Order. If used again, the previous target reverts to their original Initiative order. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The user bows and courteously lets a friend go first.

move.name: Double Slap
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Double Action.
move.description: The name is misleading as the user slaps withouth even counting how many slaps they have given already

move.name: Hyper Voice
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move.
move.description: The user screeches or sings at such high frequencies that anything made of glass will break. The ears of the victims are left in no better state.

move.name: Attract
move.effect: Single Target. Target is now In Love with the User.
move.description: Through their good looks and coquetish attitude, the Pokémon makes everyone develop a crush on them.

move.name: Refresh
move.effect: Target Self. The User heals itself from any Burn, Freeze, Poison and Paralysis. Sleep is not healed through this effect.
move.description: The Pokémon takes a few seconds to cool off, refocus, and get back in the game.

move.name: Secret Power
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Inflict Status determined by the environment or active Terrain. See more on p. 530
move.description: There’s energy all around us, hidden secretly in the most incospicuous places. This Move makes use of that energy bringing the secret to light.

move.name: Heal Pulse
move.effect: Target One Ally. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate.
move.description: Commanding the mind over the matter, the Pokémon speeds up the healing process on an ally.

move.name: Double-Edge
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil.
move.description: Without regard for their own safety, the Pokémon does a reckless attack against their foe.

move.name: Entrainment
move.effect: Single Target. Replace the Target's Ability with the User's. Unique Abilities can't be passed or replaced. Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon.
move.description: The Pokémon trains and teaches their best ability to their target. The target becomes a master of this ability in a record time.

move.name: Misty Terrain
move.effect: Target Battlefield. All Status Ailments and Conditions are cured and no more can be inflicted. Physical & Special Dragon-Type Moves have Power 0. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The battlefield is shrouded by a pink mist that feels protective and soothing. This mist is able to render even the fiercest beasts into calm.

move.name: Last Resort
move.effect: Single Target. This Move will fail if the User has not successfully performed all of its known Moves at least once during the battle.
move.description: The Pokémon may be out of energy, but never out of options.

move.name: Healing Wish
move.effect: Target Self. The user faints. One allied Target restores its full HP and it is cured from any Status Condition. If the chosen Target is not in-battle, it is called out and ready to fight with the same remaining actions as the user.
move.description: In a display of true selflessness, the user makes the ultimate sacrifice for the well-being of others.

name: Dragapult
description: When it isn't battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes in its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles. The smaller Pokémon appear happy to be shot and will reload themselves.

abilityOne.name: Cursed Body
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon carries a curse within itself. Crossing this Pokemon is not a good idea.
abilityOne.effect: Whenever this Pokemon is dealt damage with a Physical or Special Move, Roll 3 Chance Dice to Disable that Move. Up to 3 Moves may be disabled this way.

abilityTwo.name: Infiltrator
abilityTwo.description: The Pokemon is very stealthy with its movements, it is naturally harder to detect and can easily sneak in heavily guarded places.
abilityTwo.effect: This Pokemon ignores all Shield Moves, Force Fields, Substitutes and Cover active on the foe's side of the field.

move.name: Astonish
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe.
move.description: The user sneaks behind their target to jump scare them.

move.name: Infestation
move.effect: Single Target. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion.
move.description: The Pokémon summons a bothersome swarm to prevent the foe from escaping. The swarm will relentlessly attack the foe.

move.name: Quick Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Out of battle, double the Pokemon's movement speed.
move.description: An attackas fight as lightning.

move.name: Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe
move.description: The user lands a vicious bite, leaving an ugly bruise.

move.name: Lock-On
move.effect: Target Self. The Next Move the User Performs has 2 automatic successes added on their Accuracy Roll.
move.description: The Pokémon’s eyes zoom into a moving target to strike with precision at the next opportunity.

move.name: Assurance
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 2 extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move if the Target has already received Damage from the User this Round.
move.description: The user indentifies the weakest foe and charges against them.

move.name: Hex
move.effect: Single Target. *If the Target has an active Status Condition, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move.
move.description: The user casts a terrible hex over the target, the effects will be greater if the target is already burdened by an ailment.

move.name: Agility
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: Swift of body, swift of mind.

move.name: Draco Meteor
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. lethal. Reduce User's Special by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon summons a meteor to fall from the sky directly into their foes, dealing a brutal amount of damage. An impressive display if power that demands a lot of energy.

move.name: Double Hit
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Double Action.
move.description: The Pokémon uses the true and tested “one-two”.

move.name: U-Turn
move.effect: Single Target. Switcher Move for User.
move.description: A bait and switch move, where the user strikes then makes a sudden u-turn back to safety.

move.name: Light Screen
move.effect: Target the User's side of the field. Force Field. Activate a Force Field against Special Damage. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A barrier of light is created over half of the battlefield, all energy trying to go trough dissolves as it crosses it.

move.name: Reflect
move.effect: Target the User's side of the field. Force Field. Activate a Force Field against Physical Damage. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: An ethereal mirror-like wall cuts the battlefield in half, bouncing back the impact of most blows.

move.name: Dragon Dance
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Dexterity.
move.description: The user performs a vigorous and mystical dance to boost their fighting spirit and reflexes.

move.name: Dragon Breath
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A mystical flame breath that feels strengely cold to the touch. It doesn’t burn in a conventional way.

move.name: Dragon Darts
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Double Action.
move.description: The Pokémon’s head is a nest for its less evolved forms, the younglings will sometimes be used as projectiles.

move.name: Sucker Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 6. *This move can only be used as a Late Reaction; and only if the Target used a Physical or Special Move, otherwise it will fail.
move.description: The Pokémon takes advantage of their foe preparing to attack to unleash a dirty surprise blow.

move.name: Dragon Pulse
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon sends out a powerful wave of energy through their mouth.

move.name: Tri Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Freeze the Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The foe has three problems and this Move is all of them.

move.name: Phantom Force
move.effect: Single Target. Charge move. Out of Range while Charging. Lethal. Ignore any Cover, Shield Moves, and/or Force Fields active on the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon disappears into a dark dimension to infiltrate even the most impenetrable fortress. It may reappear during its next action.

move.name: Beat Up
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move for every ally Pokemon that spends an action in addition to this Move, up to 3 allies may join.
move.description: The user calls other Pokémon to aid it in battle, together they give a beating to the foe.

move.name: Dragon Rush
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon rushes to charge against their foe. Unlucky victims end up crushed into the ground.

move.name: Double-Edge
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil.
move.description: Without regard for their own safety, the Pokémon does a reckless attack against their foe.

move.name: Last Resort
move.effect: Single Target. This Move will fail if the User has not successfully performed all of its known Moves at least once during the battle.
move.description: The Pokémon may be out of energy, but never out of options.

move.name: Psychic Fangs
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. If there is a Force Field on the Target's side of the field, destroy it.
move.description: The Pokémon bares its fangs to bite the foe, psychic energy begins piercing before the actual fangs make contact.

move.name: Substitute
move.effect: Target Self. Deal 2 damage to the User. Put a Substitute Decoy with 2 HP and the same defenses as the user. See p. 531
move.description: The Pokémon disappears in a poof of smoke. A decoy identical to the user takes their place in battle. The user keeps attacking from the shadows while the decoy serves as distraction.

name: Greninja
description: It appears and vanishes with a ninja's grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, then slices them by throwing sharp water stars. If it was not properly disciplined, it will never listen any master.

abilityOne.name: Torrent
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon builds up pressure to shoot water streams. When that pressure cannot be held in, it is released through uncontrollable torrents.
abilityOne.effect: Pain Penalization won't reduce successes from Accuracy or Damage rolls of Water-Type Moves used by this Pokemon. Water-Type Moves get 2 Extra dice to their Damage Pool when this Pokemon is at half HP or less.

abilityTwo.name: Protean
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon's versitile body gives it profeciency on practically everything it sets out to do.
abilityTwo.effect: Before this Pokemon uses a Physical or Special Move, change its Type to that of the Move it intends to use. Use the appropriate STAB on the Damage Pool.

move.name: Growl
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Reduce by 1 the Strength of those affected.
move.description: Either through a menacing attitude or an adorable demeanor, the foe will hesitate to attack the user at full power.

move.name: Pound
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user pounds the target’s head. Simple

move.name: Quick Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Out of battle, double the Pokemon's movement speed.
move.description: An attackas fight as lightning.

move.name: Bubble
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: Dozens of bubbles are sent floating through the battlefield. The foes can’t resist the temptation to burst the pretty bubbles, only for the bubbles to explode for real when they do.

move.name: Haze
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Remove all Increased or Reduced Attributes and Traits of everyone on the battlefield.
move.description: The battlefield is filled with a cleansing cloud that takes away all impurities in the field. It can also work as concealment.

move.name: Water Pulse
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target.
move.description: The user sends out a pulsing ring of water that blasts the foe with ultrasonic waves. For a while, everything seems as if reflected in the water ripples.

move.name: Smokescreen
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon covers the foe in a cloud of smoke to impair their visibility to make it easier to hide and/or cover their escape.

move.name: Ice Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 1 Chance Dice to Freeze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon wears their ice gloves to punch the foe. Yes. Gloves made of ice.

move.name: Gunk Shot
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
move.description: The target is covered heat to toe in sludge, filth and organic waste. It can’t even cry for help or all of it will go into its mouth.

move.name: Hydro Cannon
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge
move.description: Those who fear fire’s destructive power have forgotten that water triumphs over the flames every single time.

move.name: Lick
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon licks the foe. The foe is deeply disturbed by this creepy display of “affection”.

move.name: Feint Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Never Miss.
move.description: The user approaches inconspicuously, pretending to attack the foe directly, then actually hits the foe from behind.

move.name: Smack Down
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Remove the Target's immunity to Ground-Type Moves. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop", this Move hits anyways.
move.description: They say it’s great to get two birds with one stone, this Pokémon will give one bird ALL the stones.

move.name: Shadow Sneak
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1.
move.description: The user sneaks through the darkness and strikes by coming out of the target’s shadow. The Pokémon is able travel freely through the shadow realm.

move.name: Spikes
move.effect: Target Foe's Side of the Field. Entry Hazard. Pokemon entering the battle Receive 1 Typeless Damage. This effect does not stack. Pokemon with immunity to Ground-Type Moves are not affected.
move.description: Sharp and pointy spikes are scattered around the field, if you don’t watch your step the spikes will dig on your feet.

move.name: Extrasensory
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon alters their target’s senses, making it feel things that aren’t really there.

move.name: Role Play
move.effect: Single Target. Replace the User's Ability with the Target's. Whole Scene Duration. Unique Abilities can't be copied.
move.description: The Pokémon is a great actor. Their impersonations are really good! ...maybe a bit too good.

move.name: Snatch
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 6. Remove any Increase/Reduction on the Foe's Attributes, Active Shield Moves, Healing effects on the Foe, or effects on its side of the field; and place them on the User instead. See p. 531 for more info.
move.description: The user takes notice of the good stuff on the other side and quickly takes it for themselves. Finders keepers, losers weepers!

move.name: Mat Block
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Shield Move. Reaction 1. Reduce 3 Damage from a Physical or Special Move.
move.description: The Pokémon uses a mat as a shield.

move.name: Water Shuriken
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Successive Actions.
move.description: The best ninjas attack swiftly and undetected, after the deed is done, no evidence is left but an inconspicuous puddle of water.

move.name: Substitute
move.effect: Target Self. Deal 2 damage to the User. Put a Substitute Decoy with 2 HP and the same defenses as the user. See p. 531
move.description: The Pokémon disappears in a poof of smoke. A decoy identical to the user takes their place in battle. The user keeps attacking from the shadows while the decoy serves as distraction.

move.name: Double Team
move.effect: Target Self. The User can now make up to 5 Evasions per Round.
move.description: The Pokémon moves so fast they create a series of shadow copies of themselves. Trying to guess which one is the real one is a pain.

move.name: Hydro Pump
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2
move.description: Water works best under pressure.

move.name: Night Slash
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical. Cutter Move.
move.description: The user looks for a weak spot, tearing the soft flesh apart with a single vile slash of its claws.

move.name: Mind Reader
move.effect: Single Target. The User has 2 automatic and unremovable successes on the next Accuracy or Evasion Roll against the Target.
move.description: In a split of second, the Pokémon reads the foe’s mind so they know exactly what to do next.

name: Spinarak
description: It sets a trap by spinning a web of thin but strong silk. Then it waits for the prey to arrive. It recognizes what kind of prey has fallen on its web by the vibrations received by each one of its eight legs.

abilityOne.name: Swarm
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon enters a hive mind state when its life is on the line, calling upon a swarm to aid it in battle.
abilityOne.effect: Pain Penalization won't reduce successes from Accuracy or Damage rolls of Bug-Type Moves used by this Pokemon. Bug-Type Moves get 2 Extra dice to their Damage Pool when this Pokemon is at half HP or less.

abilityTwo.name: Insomnia
abilityTwo.description: The Pokemon does not ever sleep, it will be awake no matter the hour. Maybe it doesn't need to or maybe it's just worried.
abilityTwo.effect: This Pokemon is immune to the Sleep Status. Moves and Items that self-inflict Sleep will fail.

hiddenAbility.name: Sniper
hiddenAbility.description: This Pokemon will stealthily locate itself in an advantageous position to strike its foe's weak spots.
hiddenAbility.effect: When this Pokemon lands a Critical Hit, it will get 3 Bonus Dice to the Damage Pool of its Move instead of the regular 2.

move.name: Poison Sting
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
move.description: A tiny stab that causes big troubles.

move.name: String Shot
move.effect: Targets All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: The foe gets tangled in a fine silk string shot by the user. This silk can also be used to make fine clothes.

move.name: Absorb
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The user takes nutrients from the nearest source of life they find.

move.name: Infestation
move.effect: Single Target. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion.
move.description: The Pokémon summons a bothersome swarm to prevent the foe from escaping. The swarm will relentlessly attack the foe.

move.name: Night Shade
move.effect: Single Target. Roll Ghost-Type Damage Dice according to the User's Rank: Starter 1 Die / Rookie 2 Dice / Standard 4 Dice/ Advacned 6 Dice / Expert 8 Dice / Ace and forward 10 Dice. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The user casts a dark and frightening mirage surrounding the foe to give them a panic attack.

move.name: Shadow Sneak
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1.
move.description: The user sneaks through the darkness and strikes by coming out of the target’s shadow. The Pokémon is able travel freely through the shadow realm.

move.name: Fury Swipes
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions.
move.description: With their sharp claws, the Pokémon will swiftly scatch their foe, leaving its face full of small cuts.

move.name: Sucker Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 6. *This move can only be used as a Late Reaction; and only if the Target used a Physical or Special Move, otherwise it will fail.
move.description: The Pokémon takes advantage of their foe preparing to attack to unleash a dirty surprise blow.

move.name: Spider Web
move.effect: Target Foe's Side of the Field. Entry Hazard. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The Pokémon moves stealthily and without raising suspicion. By the time the enemy realizes it, the entire field is covered in cobwebs.

move.name: Psychic
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: The most iconic Psychic attack, the foe starts floating in the air and its swayed around by telekinesis as their mental barrier crumbles.

move.name: Sticky Web
move.effect: Target's Foe's Side of the Field. Entry Hazard. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of Foes that enter the battlefield. Pokemon with Immunity to Ground are not affected.
move.description: The Pokémon quickly covers the arena with a sticky web, newly arrived foes will have trouble moving with ease.

move.name: Toxic Thread
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce Target's Dexterity by 1. Poison the Foe.
move.description: The user shoots a sticky thread that entangles around the foe, the thread is also laced with a potent toxin that will poison the foe on contact.

move.name: Electroweb
move.effect: Target All foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: An electrified web is shot towards the target, shoking and tangling them at the same time.

move.name: Toxic Spikes
move.effect: Target Foe's side of the Field. Entry Hazard. Foes who enter the battlefield become Poisoned. Roll 1 Chance Die for them to become Badly Poisoned instead. Pokemon with immunity to Ground-Type Moves are not affected.
move.description: The Pokémon lays a trap of tiny venom-drenched spikes through the battlefield. The battle has not yet begun and the foes are already defeated.

move.name: Leech Life
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The Pokémon clings to their foe, then bites in and starts to suck away its life force.

move.name: Constrict
move.effect: Single Target. This Move deals Typeless damage. Roll 1 chance die to reduce the Target's Dexterity by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon tightens their hold on the foe to keep them locked in a squeeze.

move.name: Scary Face
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: When a Pokémon looks at you like THAT, you know you gotta thread carefully around them.

move.name: Agility
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: Swift of body, swift of mind.

move.name: Pin Missile
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged. Successive Actions.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a barrage of stingers or spikes that pierce like needles.

move.name: Poison Jab
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon is set on injecting venom directly into the foe’s bloodstream. They can do it the easy way or the hard way.

move.name: Cross Poison
move.effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. High Critical. Roll 1 Chance Die to Poison the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon releases a powerful acidic gas that melts all inorganic matter in seconds.

move.name: Lunge
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce Target's Strength by 1.
move.description: The user charges against the foe at full force, not just to knock it down but to restrain it with its many limbs.

name: Vulpix
description: It is born with just one tail. As it grows, its single white tail gains color and splits into six. It is quite warm and cuddly - very popular with the ladies. It is, however, uncommon to see one in the wild.

abilityOne.name: Flash Fire
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon is capable of consuming other fire sources and adding them to its own. Walking through embers, fire, lava and hell feel like a breeze to it.
abilityOne.effect: The first time this Pokemon is hit by a Fire-Type move, add 1 Extra die to the Damage Pool of Fire-type Moves this Pokemon uses until the end of the scene. Fire-type moves do not deal damage to this Pokemon.

abilityTwo.name: Drought
abilityTwo.description: The Sunlight will be harsly bright, and the heat will increase in the field for as long as this Pokemon wants to.
abilityTwo.effect: When this Pokemon comes out, it automatically starts the effects of Sunny Weather. The effects end when the Pokemon leaves the battle. (In case of stalemate the Pokemon with higher Will might keep the dominant weather)

move.name: Ember
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: A basic fire attack, but not any less dangerous. Even a small flame can grow out of control.

move.name: Tail Whip
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The Pokémon whips their tail in such an adorable way the foes let their guard down.

move.name: Roar
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 6. Switcher Move for the Foe. In the wild, the battle may end.
move.description: With a potent roar, to make the foe reconsider their intentions.

move.name: Baby-Doll Eyes
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Reduce Target's Strength by 1.
move.description: The biggest and brightest eyes, spakling with unshed tears, how can you say “no” to that?!

move.name: Quick Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Out of battle, double the Pokemon's movement speed.
move.description: An attackas fight as lightning.

move.name: Fire Spin
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion.
move.description: The user creates a vortex of fire that remains spinning in the battlefield, trapping the foe within.

move.name: Confuse Ray
move.effect: Single Target. Confuse the Target.
move.description: The user flashes a sinister ray of bright light that others cannot help but go straight into it.

move.name: Imprison
move.effect: Target Self. While the User is on the battlefield, Moves known by the User cannot be used by foes. This effect ends if the User is removed from battle.
move.description: This move blocks all shared parts of a memory the user is well aware of. Moves, techniques, names, places, people or situations, no one will be able to recall those imprisoned memories.

move.name: Feint Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Never Miss.
move.description: The user approaches inconspicuously, pretending to attack the foe directly, then actually hits the foe from behind.

move.name: Flame Burst
move.effect: Single Target. After dealing damage, the User may roll 1 die of Fire-Type Damage against two other targets, ignoring defenses.
move.description: A compact fireball that bursts just as it hits the foe, scattering smaller flames to unsuspecting bystanders.

move.name: Will-O-Wisp
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target. Using this Move against the same Target increases the Burn Degree.
move.description: The user calls upon an eerie blue flame made with the souls of the departed. They appear harmless until they have you surrounded.

move.name: Safeguard
move.effect: Target User's side of the Field. Force Field. Those affected are immune to all Status Ailements/Conditions. Previously inflicted Status Ailments/Conditions remain. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A force field covers half of the battlefield and filters out all impurities and ill intentions coming from the other side.

move.name: Flamethrower
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 2nd Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: The most emblematic fire attack, a seeminly endless stream of fire that reduces everything and everyone to ashes.

move.name: Captivate
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 2 the Special of those affected.
move.description: The Pokémon shows off their attractiveness and even flirts with the opponents, those who fall for their charms can’t keep focus on the battle.

move.name: Grudge
move.effect: Single Target. The User Faints. Reduce the Target's Will to 0 points and reset any effect it got from spending them. Roll Target's Loyalty at the end of the round, increase difficulty by 1 each round. Failing this roll faints the Target.
move.description: The last words of this Pokémon imprint their grudge and anger over their foe. Depleting the foe of their will to carry on in this world.

move.name: Pain Split
move.effect: Single Target. Spend 1 Will Point to activate. *Deal up to 3 Typeless Damage to the Target, Heal 1 HP to the User for every Damage dealt this way. This Move Fails if the User has more than Half HP rounded down. This Move cannot reduce a Target to less than 1 HP.
move.description: The user channels their pain into the foe to relieve their agony. The foe gets to feel the burn of the damage it has caused.

move.name: Spite
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Will to 1 point. Reset any effects it got from spending Will Points.
move.description: The target feels overwhelmend by feelings of dread.

move.name: Heat Wave
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 1. Wind Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 1st Degree Burn on those affected.
move.description: A large wave of extra-hot air that can set fire to everything it touches.

move.name: Hex
move.effect: Single Target. *If the Target has an active Status Condition, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move.
move.description: The user casts a terrible hex over the target, the effects will be greater if the target is already burdened by an ailment.

move.name: Payback
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move if the User has already received Damage from the Target this Round.
move.description: Some say the best revenge is a successful and happy life, but not this Pokémon.

move.name: Extrasensory
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon alters their target’s senses, making it feel things that aren’t really there.

move.name: Fire Blast
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Roll 3 Chance Dice to inflict 3rd Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a giant fireball that explodes as soon as it touches their target. Blasting fire in all directions.

move.name: Inferno
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Lethal. Inflict 3rd Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: The user sets their target on fire with unforgiving flames. Abandon all hope.

name: Hypno
description: Old children stories tell of an Hypno who takes away naughty kids and feasts on their dreams until they are old men. They have an urge to eat the dreams of others since they cannot sleep themselves.

abilityOne.name: Insomnia
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon does not ever sleep, it will be awake no matter the hour. Maybe it doesn't need to or maybe it's just worried.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon is immune to the Sleep Status. Moves and Items that self-inflict Sleep will fail.

abilityTwo.name: Forewarn
