move.description: The Pokémon finds the right nerve to pull that will render a foe useless to perform their best Move.

move.name: Leech Seed
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Spend 1 Will point to activate. At the end of each Round, Roll 2 Dice of Typeless Damage against the target ignoring defenses. The User heals 1 HP for every damage dealt this way. Grass-Type Pokémon are immune to this Effect. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The foe is infected with seed saplings taking root on their body. As the saplings grow, they'll absorb the vital energy of the foe and send it back to the user.

move.name: Mega Drain
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The user absorbs a big amount of vital energy and nutrients from the target to feed from.

move.name: Whirlwind
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 6. Wind Move. Switcher Move for the Foe. In the wild, the battle may end.
move.description: A strong whirlwind can send you flying away to who knows where. You better be wearing your red shoes.

move.name: Horn Attack
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user has horns. Did you not expect they’ll use them?

move.name: Scary Face
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: When a Pokémon looks at you like THAT, you know you gotta thread carefully around them.

move.name: Zen Headbutt
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses both their mental and physical prowess in a questionable yet effective “psychic” strike.

move.name: Horn Leech
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The user rams into the foe and uses the leaves growing on their horns to absorb nutrients from it.

move.name: Rototiller
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Increase by 1 the Strength and Special of all Grass-Type Pokemon.
move.description: The Pokémon digs around the battlefield to soften the soil and make it ideal for harvest.

move.name: Iron Defense
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
move.description: Iron body, iron will. This Pokémon is unbreakable.

move.name: Dual Chop
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Double Action.
move.description: Two brutal blows are all this Pokémon needs to make the opponent yield to their might.

move.name: Giga Drain
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The Pokémon drains most of the foe’s vital energy and feeds on the nutrients it managed to extract.

move.name: Superpower
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Reduce by 1 the User's Strength and Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon packs all their power in a single crushing strike. All this effort leaves them quite tired afterwards.

move.name: Mean Look
move.effect: Single Target. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: An intense and ever-vigilant stare that surveils all possible paths the foe has to escape.

move.name: Nature's Madness
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Damage Roll is Half of the Target's remaining HP (up to 10 Dice) Rounded down. If the remaining HP of the Target is 1, this move fails. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The forces of nature attack as if they had a will of their own. Water will try to drown you, plants will trap you, lightning will come out of nowhere, even your own body will fail you.

move.name: Megahorn
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal.
move.description: The Pokémon uses its strong horn(s) to pierce their foe and deal massive damage.

move.name: Focus Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Charge Move. The User Flinches if it is hit while Charging this Move.
move.description: The user must focus on delivering the greatest punch in history, if they succeed they’ll be known as the One-Punch Pokémon.

move.name: Worry Seed
move.effect: Single Target. Replace the Target's Ability with "Insomnia". Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon.
move.description: The user plants the seed of doubt and uncertainty on its foe. The foe becomes such a worrywart that they can’t even sleep at night.

move.name: Skull Bash
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. While this Move is charging, Increase the User's Defense by 1.
move.description: The user withdraws into their shell, after a few seconds of them not moving, the foe goes to inspect and the user pops their head out in in a devastating strike.

move.name: Grassy Terrain
move.effect: Target User's side of the field. Add 1 Extra Damage Dice to all Physical & Special Grass-Type Moves. Everyone on the User's side of the field heals 1 HP at the end of each Round. Spend 1 Will Point t activate. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A patch of grass grows in the area surrounding the user, through it nature grants her many blessings.

name: Manaphy
description: It is said that after the war for land and sea was over, a tiny Pokémon was born from the bottom of the ocean to bond with all the creatures as a sign of peace.

abilityOne.name: Hydration
abilityOne.description: The body of the Pokemon absorbs water and uses its moisture to maintain a healthy state.
abilityOne.effect: When Rain weather is active, this Pokemon will cure all Status Ailments and Conditions it is affected with at the end of the round.

move.name: Tail Glow
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Special by 3.
move.description: The user emits a strong light. This Pokémon will stare at its own brightness to enter a trance.

move.name: Water Gun
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The fastest water gun in town. No enemy will remain dry

move.name: Water Sport
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Physical & Special Fire-Type Moves have Power 0. Pokemon weak to Fire-Type Moves won't receive Super-Effective Damage from them. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A single drop of water can’t put off a raging fire, but what is the ocean but a collection of drops.

move.name: Charm
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce Target's Strength by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon engages their foe in a charming interaction to reduce their aggressive intent.

move.name: Bubble
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: Dozens of bubbles are sent floating through the battlefield. The foes can’t resist the temptation to burst the pretty bubbles, only for the bubbles to explode for real when they do.

move.name: Confusion
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Confuse the Target.
move.description: A basic mental assault that makes the foe believe they are being attacked by an invisible enemy.

move.name: Supersonic
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Sound Move. Confuse the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a series of ultrasonic waves that mess with the foe by making it feel dizzy and disoriented.

move.name: Whirlpool
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion. Duration 4 Rounds. If a Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dive", this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The foe is swallowed inside of a violent swirling whirlpool. Trapping them on the violent currents, barely managing to stay afloat.

move.name: Acid Armor
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
move.description: Highly acidic goop oozes through the pores of this Pokémon. Touching it immediately causes a burning pain. Preventing foes from getting too close.

move.name: Water Pulse
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target.
move.description: The user sends out a pulsing ring of water that blasts the foe with ultrasonic waves. For a while, everything seems as if reflected in the water ripples.

move.name: Aqua Ring
move.effect: Target Self. The User heals 1 HP at the end of each Round. Spend 1 Will point to activate. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The Pokémon coats themselves in fresh water.

move.name: Zen Headbutt
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses both their mental and physical prowess in a questionable yet effective “psychic” strike.

move.name: Dive
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Scald/ Surf/ Whirlpool/ Freeze-Dry/ Sheer Cold. Out of battle allows the Pokemon to move underwater carrying someone without risk of drowning.
move.description: Just look at the world around you right here on the ocean floor, such wonderful things surround you. What more are you lookin’ for?

move.name: Bubble Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 1.
move.description: A powerful stream of foamy bubbles shot straight into the foe

move.name: Moonblast
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Reduce Target's Special by 1.
move.description: The user becomes a champion of lunar justice. In the name of the moon, they will right the wrongs and triumph over evil!

move.name: Take Heart
move.effect: Target Self. Heal any Status Ailment on the User. Increase by 1 the User's Special and Sp. Defense.
move.description: There’s something only you can do so that this blue planet doesn’t lose it’s light. Believe in yourself and show your brave heart.

move.name: Rain Dance
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Activate Rain Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The Pokémon performs a peculiar dance in the middle of the field, everyone thinks it silly until the first thunder rumbles.

move.name: Surf
move.effect: Area Move. If a Target is out of range due to the Move "Dive", this Move hits anyways. Out of battle, allows the Pokemon to travel the sea for long distances.
move.description: The Pokémon calls forward a large wave of seawater to ride, most Pokémon get washed out as they did not bring a surfboard.

move.name: Liquidation
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Reduce the Target's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon strikes while bursting a full-force blast of pressurized water. The water may cut or dent through the target’s armor.

move.name: Bounce
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Thunder / Twister / Sky Uppercut / Gust / Hurricane / Smack Down. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon jumps at least 30 feet in the air before landing with a mighty stomp on top of the foe. While in the air it is safe from most treaths but its still vulnerable to bad weather.

move.name: Heart Swap
move.effect: Single Target. Switch the User's Trait and Attribute Increases and Reductions with those on the Target's.
move.description: The User enters the mind of the foe to give implant them with their own feelings of insecurity and take the foe’s feelings of confidence in itself.

move.name: Hyper Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge. Lethal.
move.description: A devastating beam, a path of destruction that can extend for miles is the unmistakable proof someone used this Move. Let the user rest before trying to use it again.

move.name: Energy Ball
move.effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: Gathering nature’s energy from nearby plants, trees and roots, the Pokémon forms a ball to shoot at the enemy. Sadly, the surrounding plants will be dry afterwards.

move.name: Icy Wind
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Wind Move. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: Polar winds sweep through the arena. Everyone starts to shiver and embrace themselves, trying to preserve a bit of warmth.

name: Palafin (Hero Form)
description: When true danger comes, this hero rises from the sea to save the day. This hero will come to the rescue of anyone crying for help. No one knows their secret identity, as they disappear after danger passes.

abilityOne.name: Zero to Hero
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon has a secret super-hero identity that even its trainer is unaware of as they conveniently retreat when the super-hero arrives.
abilityOne.effect: Only Palafin may use this Ability. After switching out, change to Hero Form. Use its Hero Form when it switches back in. Adjust its Attributes according to the Rank and Limits it has for each Form. Unique Ability.

move.name: Water Gun
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The fastest water gun in town. No enemy will remain dry

move.name: Supersonic
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Sound Move. Confuse the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a series of ultrasonic waves that mess with the foe by making it feel dizzy and disoriented.

move.name: Astonish
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe.
move.description: The user sneaks behind their target to jump scare them.

move.name: Focus Energy
move.effect: Target Self. All of the user's Physical & Special Moves now have "High Critical". Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The Pokémon concentrates all their focus on the battle to make their attacks much more precise.

move.name: Counter
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 5. Can only be used if Target's last Move on User was a Physical Move. For damage, roll dice equal to Target's last damage pool rolled against the User plus 2 dice. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The Pokémon strikes back at their foe. Showing they can take a hit and punch even harder.

move.name: Double Hit
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Double Action.
move.description: The Pokémon uses the true and tested “one-two”.

move.name: Aqua Jet
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1.
move.description: The Pokémon propels themselves with a jet of pressured water.

move.name: Flip Turn
move.effect: Single Target. Switcher Move for the User.
move.description: Charge at the foe as a cannon ball made out of water. The big splash causes bystanders to lose sight on the battlefield. When the splash settles, the user is gone.

move.name: Agility
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: Swift of body, swift of mind.

move.name: Charm
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce Target's Strength by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon engages their foe in a charming interaction to reduce their aggressive intent.

move.name: Dive
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Scald/ Surf/ Whirlpool/ Freeze-Dry/ Sheer Cold. Out of battle allows the Pokemon to move underwater carrying someone without risk of drowning.
move.description: Just look at the world around you right here on the ocean floor, such wonderful things surround you. What more are you lookin’ for?

move.name: Encore
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 3. The Target will repeat the exact same action sequence it had last Round. Target must have had an action sequence. Duration 1 Round. If used on the previous Round, this move fails. See more on p. 529.
move.description: The Pokémon makes a standing ovation at their target, prompting them to repeat everything they just did, exactly the way they did it.

move.name: Haze
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Remove all Increased or Reduced Attributes and Traits of everyone on the battlefield.
move.description: The battlefield is filled with a cleansing cloud that takes away all impurities in the field. It can also work as concealment.

move.name: Mist
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Targets cannot have their Attributes or Traits Reduced. Previously Reduced Attributes and Traits remain. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A thick layer of mist cloaks a pack of pokémon, those with the intent to trick and weaken them will have to find them first.

move.name: Jet Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Fist Move.
move.description: The fist of justice strikes true, swift...and wet!

move.name: Aqua Tail
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The user sways their tail to create a pocket whirlpool in which the foe gets sucked in by the spinning motion.

move.name: Bounce
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Thunder / Twister / Sky Uppercut / Gust / Hurricane / Smack Down. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon jumps at least 30 feet in the air before landing with a mighty stomp on top of the foe. While in the air it is safe from most treaths but its still vulnerable to bad weather.

move.name: Protect
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokemon would receive from a Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Moves that target the user.
move.description: A mighty energy shield materializes in front of the user to to deflect attacks and dispel ill effects.

move.name: Hydro Pump
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2
move.description: Water works best under pressure.

move.name: Focus Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Charge Move. The User Flinches if it is hit while Charging this Move.
move.description: The user must focus on delivering the greatest punch in history, if they succeed they’ll be known as the One-Punch Pokémon.

move.name: Wave Crash
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil. Reduce User's Dexterity by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon rides a tsunami-like wave an slams it against its target. The crash is very destructive and the Pokémon may end up falling from the ride.

move.name: Outrage
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
move.description: The true nature of dragon-types unleashed. The user is consumed by a primal fury that won’t stop until everything has ben razed to the ground. Afterwards the Pokémon is confused.

move.name: Substitute
move.effect: Target Self. Deal 2 damage to the User. Put a Substitute Decoy with 2 HP and the same defenses as the user. See p. 531
move.description: The Pokémon disappears in a poof of smoke. A decoy identical to the user takes their place in battle. The user keeps attacking from the shadows while the decoy serves as distraction.

move.name: Drain Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: A solid punch that weakens the foes and revitalizes the user with each hit.

name: Qwilfish (Hisuian Form)
description: In ancient times, Qwilfish migrated to Hisuian regions to lay their eggs and evolve. People saw them as vermin, as they polluted their fishing waters. Overhunting happened and Qwilfish was forced to adapt.

abilityOne.name: Poison Point
abilityOne.description: The pointy thorns and scales on this Pokemon release a venom that will infect anyone who touches them roughly. Wear gloves when handling them.
abilityOne.effect: If this Pokemon is hit by a Non-Ranged Physical Move, Roll 3 Chance Dice to inflict Poison on the foe.

abilityTwo.name: Intimidate
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon has an overwhelming presence that inspires both fear and respect from others.
abilityTwo.effect: When this Pokemon comes into battle, Reduce by 1 the Strength of All foes in Range. This effect will last for as long as this Pokemon is out. Outside of battle, wild Pokemon will avoid the party if this Pokemon is out.

move.name: Poison Sting
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
move.description: A tiny stab that causes big troubles.

move.name: Harden
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 1.
move.description: When life gets hard, do the same.

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Supersonic
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Sound Move. Confuse the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a series of ultrasonic waves that mess with the foe by making it feel dizzy and disoriented.

move.name: Fell Stinger
move.effect: Single Target. *If used against a fainted Target ot if the Target faints due to damage from this Move, Increase the User’s Strength by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon stings the target, if the foe is too weakened to move, the user absorbs their power.

move.name: Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe
move.description: The user lands a vicious bite, leaving an ugly bruise.

move.name: Spikes
move.effect: Target Foe's Side of the Field. Entry Hazard. Pokemon entering the battle Receive 1 Typeless Damage. This effect does not stack. Pokemon with immunity to Ground-Type Moves are not affected.
move.description: Sharp and pointy spikes are scattered around the field, if you don’t watch your step the spikes will dig on your feet.

move.name: Toxic Spikes
move.effect: Target Foe's side of the Field. Entry Hazard. Foes who enter the battlefield become Poisoned. Roll 1 Chance Die for them to become Badly Poisoned instead. Pokemon with immunity to Ground-Type Moves are not affected.
move.description: The Pokémon lays a trap of tiny venom-drenched spikes through the battlefield. The battle has not yet begun and the foes are already defeated.

move.name: Barb Barrage
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target. *If the Target already has an active Status Condition, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move.
move.description: The user shoots a blast of venomous pins that inject venom into the foe, this venom is specially potent against those already compromised.

move.name: Pin Missile
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged. Successive Actions.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a barrage of stingers or spikes that pierce like needles.

move.name: Stockpile
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense. Enables the use of the Moves "Spit Up" and "Swallow".
move.description: The Pokémon swells up like a balloon by storing power within themselves. This helps them bounce back a bit of the damage.

move.name: Spit Up
move.effect: Single Target. The user must have previously used the Move "Stockpile", otherwise this Move will fail. Reduce by 1 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense.
move.description: After stockpiling, the Pokémon spits the stored energy as a mighty beam. The user returns to their original size afterwards.

move.name: Minimize
move.effect: Target Self. The User can now make up to 5 Evasions per Round. Reduce the User's Height and Weight in half. The user is now Vulernable to: Stomp. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The Pokémon compacts their body. Becoming a much smaller target to be difficult to hit. But a well placed stomp may leave them squished on the floor, though.

move.name: Brine
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 3 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool if the Target is at half HP or less.
move.description: A splash of sea water that literally adds more and more salt to the foe’s wounds.

move.name: Revenge
move.effect: Single Target. *If the User has already received Damage this Round, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.
move.description: Best served cold.

move.name: Toxic
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Badly Poison the Target.
move.description: This burning acid dissolves skin to enter the bloodstream directly. The poor victim feels like they are melting from the inside out. The clock is ticking.

move.name: Acupressure
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 one of the User's Attributes or Traits at Random (Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense, Sp. Defense, Accuracy, Evasion). If this Move is used again, the previous Attribute increase is removed.
move.description: The user begins pushing pressure points on their body to unlock a hidden potential they didn’t even knew they had.

move.name: Poison Jab
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon is set on injecting venom directly into the foe’s bloodstream. They can do it the easy way or the hard way.

move.name: Crunch
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Lethal. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the foe's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon viciously mauls, tears, and rips apart anything its fangs can come in contact with.

move.name: Destiny Bond
move.effect: Target Self. If the user faints this Round due to damage frm a Physical or Special Move, the Pokemon who dealt the damage is dealt damage equal to their remaining Hp. This Move will fail if it was used the previous Round.
move.description: Through a mystical bond, everyone who brings disgrace to this Pokémon will suffer the exact same fate.

move.name: Mud Shot
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 1.
move.description: By shooting a stream of mud at their target, the user manages to impair their movement.

move.name: Self Destruct
move.effect: Area Move. Lethal. Ranged. The User faints.
move.description: It’s not about winning or losing, some pokémon just want to see the world burn.

move.name: Aqua Jet
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1.
move.description: The Pokémon propels themselves with a jet of pressured water.

name: Tapu Lele
description: It is said that an innocent but cruel spirit guards Akala Island. When the spirit is feeling benevolent it scatters some of its scales around; these scales have healing powers.

abilityOne.name: Psychic Surge
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon can surround itself with a psychic field that makes everyone pause, hearing things that are not there.
abilityOne.effect: When this Pokemon comes out, it automatically starts the effects of the Move Psychic Terrain. (In case of stalemate the Pokemon with higher Will might keep the dominant Terrain)

abilityTwo.name: Telepathy
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon can communicate using telepathy. It can send messages to other minds but it cannot receive messages back.
abilityTwo.effect: This Pokemon won't receive damage from Moves performed by its allies.

move.name: Astonish
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe.
move.description: The user sneaks behind their target to jump scare them.

move.name: Confusion
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Confuse the Target.
move.description: A basic mental assault that makes the foe believe they are being attacked by an invisible enemy.

move.name: Withdraw
move.effect: Target Self. Increase User's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon withraw into their shell for increased protection and to avoid unwanted interactions.

move.name: Aromatherapy
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Cure Status Ailments (All Burn degrees, Freeze, Paralysis, All Poison & Sleep) on the Targets.
move.description: The Pokémon releases a series of essential oils and herbal scents to refresh themselves and their companions.

move.name: Draining Kiss
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The Pokémon blows a flirtatious kiss; the foe catches it believing to have found love, but it turns out to be a trick to steal its life energy.

move.name: Psywave
move.effect: Single Target. Roll Psychic-Type Damage Dice according to the User's Rank: Starter 1 Die / Rookie 2 Dice / Standard 4 Dice/ Advacned 6 Dice / Expert 8 Dice / Ace and forward 10 Dice. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: A powerful mental wave assault’s the target’s brain directly. Everything, from forgotten memories to the secrets of the universe bombard its mind in just a few seconds.

move.name: Flatter
move.effect: Single Target. Increase the Target's Special by 1. Confuse the Target.
move.description: The user starts flattering and admiring its opponent. It sure makes them feel good about themselves but...why?!

move.name: Aromatic Mist
move.effect: Target One Ally. Increase by 1 the Defense and Sp. Defense of the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon sprays an ally with a delicate aroma that makes everyone pull their punches against it.

move.name: Sweet Scent
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Those affected cannot Evade Moves. Out of Battle, it will attract wild Pokemon.
move.description: The Pokémon releases a sweet aroma that lulls their enemies into a false sense of security

move.name: Screech
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Reduce the Target's Defense by 2.
move.description: A mighty screech will make the target cover its ears instead of covering its flanks.

move.name: Extrasensory
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon alters their target’s senses, making it feel things that aren’t really there.

move.name: Tickle
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce by 1 the Target's Strength and Defense.
move.description: Whoever said laughter is the best therapy lied.

move.name: Iron Defense
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
move.description: Iron body, iron will. This Pokémon is unbreakable.

move.name: Magic Room
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Held items lose their effects. No items can be used. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The entire battlefield becomes a room on which the laws of the material world are rendered useless.

move.name: Telekinesis
move.effect: Single Target. Target becomes immune to Ground-Type Moves. Target can't Evade. Duration 2 Rounds.
move.description: The target levitates from the ground as the user’s telekinetic powers prevent its movement.

move.name: Psyshock
move.effect: Single Target. This Move is resisted with the Target's Defense instead of its Sp. Defense.
move.description: The shock is mental, the blow is real.

move.name: Mean Look
move.effect: Single Target. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: An intense and ever-vigilant stare that surveils all possible paths the foe has to escape.

move.name: Nature's Madness
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Damage Roll is Half of the Target's remaining HP (up to 10 Dice) Rounded down. If the remaining HP of the Target is 1, this move fails. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The forces of nature attack as if they had a will of their own. Water will try to drown you, plants will trap you, lightning will come out of nowhere, even your own body will fail you.

move.name: Moonblast
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Reduce Target's Special by 1.
move.description: The user becomes a champion of lunar justice. In the name of the moon, they will right the wrongs and triumph over evil!

move.name: Wonder Room
move.effect: Target the Battlefield. Everyone on the Battlefield will have their Defense and Sp. Defense calculated with Insight instead of Vitality. If using Insight as Sp. Defense optional rule, swap the calculation. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The battlefield is now a space that puts the mind to the test. A resilient mind will be a resilient body, but if the mind is weak the body will feel frail and feeble.

move.name: Skill Swap
move.effect: Single Target. Switch the User's Ability with the Target's. Whole Scene Duration. This affect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon. Unique Abilities can't be switched.
move.description: The Pokémon enters their foe’s mind to assimilate the traits of that species while make the foe think it is a member from another species. The foe gets an identity crisis afterwards.

move.name: Future Sight
move.effect: Single Target. This Move's damage is dealt at the beginning of the next Round. Ignore Shield Moves, Force Field, Cover & Substitute. If the target restires or switches out from battle, the damage will be dealt to the next opponent or to one of its allies.
move.description: The Pokémon foresees something terrible happening. Although when it tries to see their own future, the images are ever changing.

move.name: Psychic Terrain
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Add 1 Extra Damage Dice to all Physical & Special Psychic-Type Moves. Pokemon without immunity to Ground can't use Moves with Reaction or Late Reaction. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The arena becomes radiated by psychic waves. Everyone feels their mind slog due to the buzz in their heads, making all tasks take longer than they should.

name: Tapu Koko
description: People on Melemele Island talk about a guardian spirit who punishes the evil doers with lightning strikes. If it appears in front of you who knows what its intentions may be.

abilityOne.name: Electric Surge
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon can surround itself with an electric field that fills the air with tension and keeps everyone on edge.
abilityOne.effect: When this Pokemon comes out, it automatically starts the effects of the Move Electric Terrain. (In case of stalemate the Pokemon with higher Will might keep the dominant Terrain)

abilityTwo.name: Telepathy
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon can communicate using telepathy. It can send messages to other minds but it cannot receive messages back.
abilityTwo.effect: This Pokemon won't receive damage from Moves performed by its allies.

move.name: Quick Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Out of battle, double the Pokemon's movement speed.
move.description: An attackas fight as lightning.

move.name: Thunder Shock
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance die to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The most basic electric attack, charge, release, and shock! Just don’t point it to any electric device.

move.name: Withdraw
move.effect: Target Self. Increase User's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon withraw into their shell for increased protection and to avoid unwanted interactions.

move.name: Fairy Wind
move.effect: Single Target. Wind Move.
move.description: The Pokémon let’s out sweet a breeze of glittery fairy dust. It gives a mild rash to those without happy thoughts.

move.name: False Swipe
move.effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. This Move's Damage can't make the Target go below 1 HP.
move.description: Through their most dramatic poses, the Pokémon pretends to slice up the foe (the blood is fake).

move.name: Spark
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The user engulfs itself with statc electricity then charges with a solid tackle against the foe. Sparks fly, very literally.

move.name: Shock Wave
move.effect: Single Target. Never Miss.
move.description: A series of lightning bolts rise through the floor towards the sky, it is impossible to predict where they are coming from.

move.name: Charge
move.effect: Target Self. Add 2 Dice to the Damage Pool of thenext Damaging Electric-Type Move the User performs.
move.description: The user gathers electricity and stores it to make its attacks more powerful. You may also use them as a living battery for your phone.

move.name: Agility
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: Swift of body, swift of mind.

move.name: Screech
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Reduce the Target's Defense by 2.
move.description: A mighty screech will make the target cover its ears instead of covering its flanks.

move.name: Electro Ball
move.effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of the user for every Point on Dexterity it has that surpasses the Foe's. Up to 4 Dice might be added this way.
move.description: An orb of electricity is hurled against the target, the faster the user dashes, the more momentum the orb gets.

move.name: Defog
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Remove all Force Fields, Entry Hazards and Terrains (Misty Terrain, Electric Terrain, etc.) from the Battlefield.
move.description: A strong wind sweeps out the battle field, removing anything from bad weather to scattered objects and even invisible barriers.

move.name: Iron Defense
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
move.description: Iron body, iron will. This Pokémon is unbreakable.

move.name: Mirror Move
move.effect: Single Target. Copy Move. Unique Moves can't be copied. You may choose another Target(s) for the copied Move.
move.description: The Pokémon parrots the target cries and movements. In an almost perfect impersonation that manages to copy its powers.

move.name: Telekinesis
move.effect: Single Target. Target becomes immune to Ground-Type Moves. Target can't Evade. Duration 2 Rounds.
move.description: The target levitates from the ground as the user’s telekinetic powers prevent its movement.

move.name: Discharge
move.effect: Area Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze those affected.
move.description: The user lets out an enormous discharge over the arena. Lightning does not distinguish friend from foe.

move.name: Mean Look
move.effect: Single Target. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: An intense and ever-vigilant stare that surveils all possible paths the foe has to escape.

move.name: Nature's Madness
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Damage Roll is Half of the Target's remaining HP (up to 10 Dice) Rounded down. If the remaining HP of the Target is 1, this move fails. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The forces of nature attack as if they had a will of their own. Water will try to drown you, plants will trap you, lightning will come out of nowhere, even your own body will fail you.

move.name: Wild Charge
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil. Roll 1 Chance die to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon surrounds itself with lightning then recklessly charges against their target.

move.name: Brave Bird
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil.
move.description: Back in the day humans relied on birds to send their messages and even go to war. Many earned medals for bravery.

move.name: Power Swap
move.effect: Single Target. Whole Scene Duration. Switch the User's Strength and Special with the Target's.
move.description: The Pokémon enters their foe’s mind to steal its power and implant on them the idea of their own frailty.

move.name: Sky Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Charge Move. High Critical. Lethal. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: In a graceful but lethal strike, the Pokémon takes a deep dive towards the foe as if the sky was falling down right on top of it

move.name: Electric Terrain
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Add 1 Extra Damage Dice to all Physical & Special Electric-Type Moves. Pokemon without immunity to Ground will be cured of the Sleep Status. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The user electrifies the battlefield, making it impossible to relax around the sparks and live current.

name: Tinkaton
description: The Tinkatuff with the biggest and strongest hammer evolves into this intelligent and daring Pokémon. They hunt Corviknight by knocking rocks into the sky with their giant hammers. Cute but dangerous.

abilityOne.name: Mold Breaker
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon will find unusual ways to achieve its goals. They are inventive and go around problems.
abilityOne.effect: If a foe Pokemon has a Type, an immunity, or an Ability that would prevent this Pokemon from dealing Damage with a Move, ignore it.

abilityTwo.name: Own Tempo
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon will do everything at its own pace, peer pressure will be ignored. Its behavior reflexive and calm... maybe too calm.
abilityTwo.effect: This Pokemon is not affected by the Confused Status Condition.

move.name: Astonish
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe.
move.description: The user sneaks behind their target to jump scare them.

move.name: Fairy Wind
move.effect: Single Target. Wind Move.
move.description: The Pokémon let’s out sweet a breeze of glittery fairy dust. It gives a mild rash to those without happy thoughts.

move.name: Baby-Doll Eyes
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Reduce Target's Strength by 1.
move.description: The biggest and brightest eyes, spakling with unshed tears, how can you say “no” to that?!

move.name: Metal Claw
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 1 Chance Die to Increase the User's Strength by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon uses the foe as a whetstone.

move.name: Covet
move.effect: Single Target. The User steals the Target's Held Item. If the User already has a Held Item, this effect fails.
move.description: The Pokémon is attracted to shiny and colorful items. They don’t understand when something is not theirs for the taking so they just take it when no one is looking.

move.name: Rock Smash
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Reduce the Target's Defense by 1.
move.description: A hit powerful enough to destroy rocks and crack armor.

move.name: Draining Kiss
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The Pokémon blows a flirtatious kiss; the foe catches it believing to have found love, but it turns out to be a trick to steal its life energy.

move.name: Sweet Kiss
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Confuse the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon timidly approaches the foe and plants a delicate kiss on its cheek then quickly retreats giggling. The foe struggles to understand the meaning of this.

move.name: Brutal Swing
move.effect: Target All foes in Range. Lethal.
move.description: The Pokémon starts attacking at full force with its claws, anyone unfortunate enough to be in its path will end up severely wounded.

move.name: Slam
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1.
move.description: Everybody get up, it’s time to slam now.

move.name: Flash Cannon
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: Through shiny metal parts of their body, the Pokémon reflects a light beam straight into the foe’s eyes.

move.name: Knock Off
move.effect: Single Target. *If the Target is holding an Item, Add 2 Dice to the Damage pool of this Move. The Target loses its Held Item afterwards.
move.description: The Pokémon rudely smacks what their foe was holding.

move.name: Fake Out
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Flinch the Target. This Move will only work on the First Round the User is out in battle. from the Second Round on, it will fail automatically.
move.description: The Pokémon pretends to be getting ready for the battle when they are actually prepairing a surprise attack on the foe.

move.name: Flatter
move.effect: Single Target. Increase the Target's Special by 1. Confuse the Target.
move.description: The user starts flattering and admiring its opponent. It sure makes them feel good about themselves but...why?!

move.name: Skitter Smack
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Special by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon stalks and strikes the foe, usually from behind bushes or any sort of cover.

move.name: Play Rough
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 1 Chance Dice to Reduce Target's Strength by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon and their foe start a playful wrestle that soon escalates into a furious wrestling match.

move.name: Swords Dance
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Strength by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon dances with strong steps and a fierce attitude as a ritual to prepare for battle.

move.name: Smack Down
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Remove the Target's immunity to Ground-Type Moves. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop", this Move hits anyways.
move.description: They say it’s great to get two birds with one stone, this Pokémon will give one bird ALL the stones.

move.name: Heavy Slam
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to he Damage Pool for every 50kg of weight the User is above the target's weight. Up to 4 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The foe is about to confirm if the Pokémon is thick-boned.

move.name: Gigaton Hammer
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. This Move will fail if it was used the previous Round. *This Move may deal 2 Extra Damage Dice to Steel-Type Pokemon at Storyteller's Discretion.
move.description: When you have a hammer everything is a nail.

move.name: Brick Break
move.effect: Single Target. *If there is a Force field on the Target's side of the field, destroy it and add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.
move.description: The Pokémon uses a karate technique to chop through tall piles of bricks. No matter how many layers you pile up, they’ll break regardless.

move.name: Reflect
move.effect: Target the User's side of the field. Force Field. Activate a Force Field against Physical Damage. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: An ethereal mirror-like wall cuts the battlefield in half, bouncing back the impact of most blows.

move.name: Light Screen
move.effect: Target the User's side of the field. Force Field. Activate a Force Field against Special Damage. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A barrier of light is created over half of the battlefield, all energy trying to go trough dissolves as it crosses it.

name: Celesteela
description: Finally some progress from the excavation site. What we thought was a 200 year-old relic turned out to be a creature capable of blasting itself into the air. We managed to restrain it; more research is due.

abilityOne.name: Beast Boost
abilityOne.description: A wicked satisfaction grows as this creature brings out destruction, for it becomes more savage with every foe that falls to its power.
abilityOne.effect: If a foe faints because of an attack dealt by this Ultra-Beast, Increase by 1 their highest Attribute. Up to 3 points can be increased this way. Unique Ability.

move.name: Absorb
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The user takes nutrients from the nearest source of life they find.

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Harden
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 1.
move.description: When life gets hard, do the same.

move.name: Wide Guard
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Reaction 3. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage the Targets would receive from Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Any Moves on the Targets.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their whole body to provide shelter and protection to everyone they can. They are the rock on which others stand.

move.name: Mega Drain
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The user absorbs a big amount of vital energy and nutrients from the target to feed from.

move.name: Smack Down
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Remove the Target's immunity to Ground-Type Moves. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop", this Move hits anyways.
move.description: They say it’s great to get two birds with one stone, this Pokémon will give one bird ALL the stones.

move.name: Ingrain
move.effect: Target Self. The User heals 1 HP at the end of each Round. Spend 1 Will point to activate. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The Pokémon roots themselves to absorb nutrients directly from the ground.

move.name: Autotomize
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Dexterity by 2. Halve the User's weight.
move.description: Rotating parts and tiny gears, the Pokémon works like a welloiled machine.

move.name: Iron Head
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon charges to cure the foe’s iron deficit.

move.name: Flash Cannon
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: Through shiny metal parts of their body, the Pokémon reflects a light beam straight into the foe’s eyes.

move.name: Giga Drain
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The Pokémon drains most of the foe’s vital energy and feeds on the nutrients it managed to extract.

move.name: Metal Sound
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 2.
move.description: A horrible screeching sound rumbles in the foe’s ears. Some people will try to convince you that this is good music.

move.name: Iron Defense
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
move.description: Iron body, iron will. This Pokémon is unbreakable.

move.name: Seed Bomb
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Projectile Move.
move.description: A giant seed is hurled against the target, the hit is not what knocks them down, the tree that explodes suddenly out of the seed is what does.

move.name: Leech Seed
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Spend 1 Will point to activate. At the end of each Round, Roll 2 Dice of Typeless Damage against the target ignoring defenses. The User heals 1 HP for every damage dealt this way. Grass-Type Pokémon are immune to this Effect. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The foe is infected with seed saplings taking root on their body. As the saplings grow, they'll absorb the vital energy of the foe and send it back to the user.

move.name: Air Slash
move.effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: A compressed wind-slash, the change of pressure knocks out the target momentarily

move.name: Flame Charge
move.effect: Single Target. Increase the User's Dexterity by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon dashes so fast they leave a trail of fire behind.

move.name: Fly
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Thunder / Twister / Sky Uppercut / Gust / Hurricane / Smack Down. Out of battle allows the Pokemon to fly long distances.
move.description: The Pokémon uses an action to fly up high, to asses the best angle to take a dive against the foe. Pokémon who know this Move can fly for long periods of time without rest.

move.name: Gyro Ball
move.effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of this Move for every point on Dexterity the Target has that surpasses the User's. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a projectile. Correction: the Pokémon IS the projectile.

move.name: Steel Roller
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Can't be used if there is no Active Terrain (Grassy Terrain, Electric Terrain, etc.) on the Battlefield. Remove any active Terrain on the Battlefield.
move.description: The Pokémon rolls into a wheel, destroying anything in their path. Buildings come crashing down, forests are swept away and the soil is left as a blank slate.

move.name: Smart Strike
move.effect: Single Target. Never Miss. Lethal.
move.description: The user stabs the foe using one of their sharp horns with astounding precision. The resulting wound is very deep and needs stitches immediately

move.name: Heavy Slam
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to he Damage Pool for every 50kg of weight the User is above the target's weight. Up to 4 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The foe is about to confirm if the Pokémon is thick-boned.

move.name: Double-Edge
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil.
move.description: Without regard for their own safety, the Pokémon does a reckless attack against their foe.

move.name: Steel Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Recoil.
move.description: A concentrated ray of light that is capable of melting even the thickest steel plates. Unfortunately, the user is also made of steel.

move.name: Skull Bash
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. While this Move is charging, Increase the User's Defense by 1.
move.description: The user withdraws into their shell, after a few seconds of them not moving, the foe goes to inspect and the user pops their head out in in a devastating strike.

name: Tapu Fini
description: The people on Poni Island are proud of the clean water on their land; for that, they thank their guardian spirit who is said to be the ocean itself.

abilityOne.name: Misty Surge
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon can surround itself with a Misty Field that is eerily quiet, it feels peaceful and soothing but also lonesome and isolated.
abilityOne.effect: When this Pokemon comes out, it automatically starts the effects of the Move Misty Terrain. (In case of stalemate the Pokemon with higher Will might keep the dominant Terrain)

abilityTwo.name: Telepathy
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon can communicate using telepathy. It can send messages to other minds but it cannot receive messages back.
abilityTwo.effect: This Pokemon won't receive damage from Moves performed by its allies.

move.name: Disarming Voice
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Never Miss.
move.description: With a charming but manipulative cry, the user deals emotional damage to their opponent by making them feel guilty.

move.name: Water Gun
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The fastest water gun in town. No enemy will remain dry

move.name: Withdraw
move.effect: Target Self. Increase User's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon withraw into their shell for increased protection and to avoid unwanted interactions.

move.name: Mist
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Targets cannot have their Attributes or Traits Reduced. Previously Reduced Attributes and Traits remain. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A thick layer of mist cloaks a pack of pokémon, those with the intent to trick and weaken them will have to find them first.

move.name: Haze
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Remove all Increased or Reduced Attributes and Traits of everyone on the battlefield.
move.description: The battlefield is filled with a cleansing cloud that takes away all impurities in the field. It can also work as concealment.

move.name: Aqua Ring
move.effect: Target Self. The User heals 1 HP at the end of each Round. Spend 1 Will point to activate. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The Pokémon coats themselves in fresh water.

move.name: Water Pulse
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target.
move.description: The user sends out a pulsing ring of water that blasts the foe with ultrasonic waves. For a while, everything seems as if reflected in the water ripples.

move.name: Whirlpool
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion. Duration 4 Rounds. If a Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dive", this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The foe is swallowed inside of a violent swirling whirlpool. Trapping them on the violent currents, barely managing to stay afloat.

move.name: Heal Pulse
move.effect: Target One Ally. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate.
move.description: Commanding the mind over the matter, the Pokémon speeds up the healing process on an ally.

move.name: Refresh
move.effect: Target Self. The User heals itself from any Burn, Freeze, Poison and Paralysis. Sleep is not healed through this effect.
move.description: The Pokémon takes a few seconds to cool off, refocus, and get back in the game.

move.name: Knock Off
move.effect: Single Target. *If the Target is holding an Item, Add 2 Dice to the Damage pool of this Move. The Target loses its Held Item afterwards.
move.description: The Pokémon rudely smacks what their foe was holding.

move.description: A strong wind sweeps out the battle field, removing anything from bad weather to scattered objects and even invisible barriers.

move.name: Iron Defense
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
move.description: Iron body, iron will. This Pokémon is unbreakable.

move.name: Wonder Room
move.effect: Target the Battlefield. Everyone on the Battlefield will have their Defense and Sp. Defense calculated with Insight instead of Vitality. If using Insight as Sp. Defense optional rule, swap the calculation. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The battlefield is now a space that puts the mind to the test. A resilient mind will be a resilient body, but if the mind is weak the body will feel frail and feeble.

move.name: Brine
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 3 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool if the Target is at half HP or less.
move.description: A splash of sea water that literally adds more and more salt to the foe’s wounds.

move.name: Icy Wind
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Wind Move. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: Polar winds sweep through the arena. Everyone starts to shiver and embrace themselves, trying to preserve a bit of warmth.

move.name: Mean Look
move.effect: Single Target. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: An intense and ever-vigilant stare that surveils all possible paths the foe has to escape.

move.name: Nature's Madness
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Damage Roll is Half of the Target's remaining HP (up to 10 Dice) Rounded down. If the remaining HP of the Target is 1, this move fails. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The forces of nature attack as if they had a will of their own. Water will try to drown you, plants will trap you, lightning will come out of nowhere, even your own body will fail you.

move.name: Moonblast
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Reduce Target's Special by 1.
move.description: The user becomes a champion of lunar justice. In the name of the moon, they will right the wrongs and triumph over evil!

move.name: Surf
move.effect: Area Move. If a Target is out of range due to the Move "Dive", this Move hits anyways. Out of battle, allows the Pokemon to travel the sea for long distances.
move.description: The Pokémon calls forward a large wave of seawater to ride, most Pokémon get washed out as they did not bring a surfboard.

move.name: Soak
move.effect: Single Target. Change the Target's Type to Water. (ie Charizard was Fire/Flying, after this Move their Type will be Water) Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon.
move.description: The foe gets soaking wet, they should stay away from electric outlets and thirsty plants.

move.name: Hydro Pump
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2
move.description: Water works best under pressure.

move.name: Misty Terrain
move.effect: Target Battlefield. All Status Ailments and Conditions are cured and no more can be inflicted. Physical & Special Dragon-Type Moves have Power 0. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The battlefield is shrouded by a pink mist that feels protective and soothing. This mist is able to render even the fiercest beasts into calm.

name: Dudunsparce
description: It builds nests within solid bedrock by using its tail. Gentle in nature, it will carry any Pokémon who wander into its home and guide them back to the exit. Enemies will be driven out by a blast of air from its lungs.

abilityOne.name: Rattled
abilityOne.description: When this scaredy Pokemon becomes startled or scared it will make haste to get away from danger.
abilityOne.effect: The first time this Pokemon is hit by a Bug, Dark, or Ghost-Type Move, or if a foe has the Ability "Intimidate", Increase its Dexterity Attribute by 1.

abilityTwo.name: Serene Grace
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon will bring good luck as if it was blessed by the heavens. Its presence is soothing, it makes you feel calm and full of joy.
abilityTwo.effect: This Pokemon adds 2 Extra Chance Dice to all Moves with effects that use them. (e.g. A move has 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the foe, this Pokemon will roll 5 Dice)

move.name: Flail
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of this Move for every missing Point of HP the user has. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The user flails around trying to stay alive, as they get closer to fainting, more adrenaline will fuel their efforts of survival.

move.name: Defense Curl
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 1. Increase by 1 the Power of the Moves "Ice Ball" & "Rollout".
move.description: The user curls into a ball to protect themselves when they feel threatened.

move.name: Rollout
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions. *If all 5 actions land successfully, add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of the last hit of this Move. If the Pokemon used the Move "Defense Curl" in the same round, this Move's base Power becomes 2.
move.description: When the foe sees this Pokémon rollin’ they’ll be hatin’.

move.name: Mud Slap
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.
move.description: A mud ball splatters right into the foe’s face, reducing their field of vision.

move.name: Glare
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Paralyze the Target.
move.description: With just one look, the target knows it is about to be someone else’s lunch, fear has them immobilized.

move.name: Screech
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Reduce the Target's Defense by 2.
move.description: A mighty screech will make the target cover its ears instead of covering its flanks.

move.name: Ancient Power
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Increase by 1 the User's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense and Sp. Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon calls forward an energy from the ancient past. This may infuse the user with a primal strength.

move.name: Spite
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Will to 1 point. Reset any effects it got from spending Will Points.
move.description: The target feels overwhelmend by feelings of dread.

move.name: Drill Run
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical.
move.description: The Pokémon holds their claws together and starts spinning as if they were a drill. They can puncture a hole into any surface from walls and floors to their foes.

move.name: Dig
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Earth Power/ Earthquake/ Fissure/ Magnitude/ Stomping Tantrum. Out of battle allows the Pokemon to burrow and make underground tunnels.
move.description: The user digs a tunnel on the ground and attacks by coming out from below its target. This move has been used to escape caves and gain access to highly surveiled places.

move.name: Yawn

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Growl
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Reduce by 1 the Strength of those affected.
move.description: Either through a menacing attitude or an adorable demeanor, the foe will hesitate to attack the user at full power.

move.name: Leafage
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged.
move.description: The user throws leaf darts towards the foe.

move.name: Rock Smash
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Reduce the Target's Defense by 1.
move.description: A hit powerful enough to destroy rocks and crack armor.

move.name: Gust
move.effect: Single Target. Wind Move. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop", this Move hits anyway.
move.description: The Pokémon flaps their wings and strikes the foe with a swirl of wind. Pokémon in the air may get swept away

move.name: Aura Sphere
move.effect: Single Target. Never Miss. Projectile Move.
move.description: By channeling their own aura, the user launches an energy sphere that causes harm on an spiritual level more than a physical one.

move.name: Foresight
move.effect: Single Target. The Foe cannot Evade Moves performed by the User. User ignores Ghost-Type immunity to Normal and Fight-Type Moves and vice versa.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their honed senses and mental agility to predict the next movement of their foe.

move.name: Razor Leaf
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Cutter Move. Ranged. High Critical.
move.description: The user sends out a barrage of sharp razor-like leaves. “Death by a thousand cuts” would be the best depiction.

move.name: Spikes
move.effect: Target Foe's Side of the Field. Entry Hazard. Pokemon entering the battle Receive 1 Typeless Damage. This effect does not stack. Pokemon with immunity to Ground-Type Moves are not affected.
move.description: Sharp and pointy spikes are scattered around the field, if you don’t watch your step the spikes will dig on your feet.

move.name: Aerial Ace
move.effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. Never Miss.
move.description: The Pokémon rises up in the air towards a light source, momentarily blinding the foe. then plummets quickly to attack the opponent

move.name: Synthesis
move.effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will Point to activate. If Sunny Weather is in effect, this Move becomes a Complete Heal. If performed under Rain, Sandstorm, Hail or Snowy Weather, this Move is a Minor heal and only heals 1 HP.
move.description: The Pokémon gathers sunlight to re-energize themselves.

move.name: Triple Arrows
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Triple Action. Reduce the foe's Defense by 1. *If All 3 hits land, all of the User's Physical and Special Moves now have the "High Critical" Effect, this effect has a whole scene duration.
move.description: Three fast arrows shot in succession. The Pokémon who manages to land all three in the exact same spot has become a true sniper.

move.name: Fury Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions.
move.description: The Pokémon attacks in a fury, their attacks are uncoordinated but relentless.

move.name: Bulk Up
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon showcase their muscles through poses that highlight their fitness and bodybuilding discipline.

move.name: Double Kick
move.effect: Single Target. Double Action.
move.description: The good old one-two but with a twist.

move.name: Leaf Blade
move.effect: Single Target. High Critical. Lethal. Cutter Move.
move.description: Danger lies not on the material’s toughness but on its edge’s sharpness.

move.name: Sucker Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 6. *This move can only be used as a Late Reaction; and only if the Target used a Physical or Special Move, otherwise it will fail.
move.description: The Pokémon takes advantage of their foe preparing to attack to unleash a dirty surprise blow.

move.name: Substitute
move.effect: Target Self. Deal 2 damage to the User. Put a Substitute Decoy with 2 HP and the same defenses as the user. See p. 531
move.description: The Pokémon disappears in a poof of smoke. A decoy identical to the user takes their place in battle. The user keeps attacking from the shadows while the decoy serves as distraction.

move.name: Steel Wing
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 1 Chance Die to Increase the User's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon has weather-proofed wings that cut flying times, cut through the air, and, most importantly, cut through their foes.

move.name: Brave Bird
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil.
move.description: Back in the day humans relied on birds to send their messages and even go to war. Many earned medals for bravery.

move.name: Psycho Cut
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. High Critical. Cutter Move.
move.description: The user sends out an invisible sword made with psychic energy that slashes targets even if they are far away

move.name: Focus Blast
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Projectile Move. Roll 1 Chance die to Reduce the foe's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: A powerful energy blast that requires the user to chant each syllabe of the technique’s name and release it by yelling “Haaaaa!”

move.name: U-Turn
move.effect: Single Target. Switcher Move for User.
move.description: A bait and switch move, where the user strikes then makes a sudden u-turn back to safety.

move.name: Frenzy Plant
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge.
move.description: The user roots down and calls upon the force of nature. Thorny roots and plants grow in a frenzy around the foe. This display of power leaves the user quite exhausted.

name: Braviary (Hisuian Form)
description: Hundreds of years ago, the Hisuian mountaintops were the home of this regional variant. Its battle cry was ferocious and it thrived in lakes. They were hunted to extinction to obtain their beautiful feathers.

abilityOne.name: Keen Eye
abilityOne.description: These Pokemon have an exceptional sight. Locating small or far away objects is a lot easier for them.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon cannot have successes removed from its Accuracy rolls by Moves, Items or Abilities.

abilityTwo.name: Sheer Force
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon is only interested in showing off its incredible battle prowess.
abilityTwo.effect: Whenever this Pokemon uses a Physical or Special Move with Added Effects, you may choose to ignore them and add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool instead. Added Effects from Items trigger this effect but do not stack.

hiddenAbility.name: Defiant
hiddenAbility.description: This Pokemon will not yield, the harder the situation gets, the higher its fighting spirit will grow. It may, however, be a bit of a rebel.
hiddenAbility.effect: The first time this Pokemon has an Attribute reduced during a battle, Increase its Strength by 2.

move.name: Peck
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: Raise crows and they’ll peck your foe’s eyes.

move.name: Leer
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The vicious glare of a predator that triggers the flight response of their prey.

move.name: Hone Claws

move.description: Sharp claws make for more precise and deadly attacks.

move.name: Wing Attack
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: A classic flying technique, the user flies towards the foe and strikes using their wings.

move.name: Tailwind
move.effect: Target User's side of the Field. Wind Move. Increase by 2 the Dexterity of everyone on the User's side of the field. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: Flying Pokémon know better than anyone how to use the wind in their favor. Let its draft carry you to victory.

move.name: Scary Face
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: When a Pokémon looks at you like THAT, you know you gotta thread carefully around them.

move.effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. Never Miss.

move.description: The foe’s mind isassaulted by a mental ray, afterwards they may suffer from hallucinations.

move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 6. Wind Move. Switcher Move for the Foe. In the wild, the battle may end.
move.description: A strong whirlwind can send you flying away to who knows where. You better be wearing your red shoes.

move.name: Crush Claw
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Reduce the Target's Defense by 2.
move.description: With a crushing grip against the foe, the user manages to break their armor.

move.name: Air Slash
move.effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: A compressed wind-slash, the change of pressure knocks out the target momentarily

move.name: Dazzling Gleam
move.effect: Target All foes in Range.
move.description: The Pokémon shines bright like a diamond. The powerful flash hurts the eyes of everyone watching.

move.name: Shadow Claw
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their ghostly claws to slash through their foe’s body tearing not their flesh but their soul directly.

move.name: Zen Headbutt
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses both their mental and physical prowess in a questionable yet effective “psychic” strike.

move.name: Defog
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Remove all Force Fields, Entry Hazards and Terrains (Misty Terrain, Electric Terrain, etc.) from the Battlefield.
move.description: A strong wind sweeps out the battle field, removing anything from bad weather to scattered objects and even invisible barriers.

move.name: Esper Wing
move.effect: Single Target. High Critical. Increase the User's Dexterity by 1.
move.description: The User slashes the foe with psychic energy channeled through their wings. This energy also allows it to cut through the air and fly faster.

move.name: Superpower
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Reduce by 1 the User's Strength and Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon packs all their power in a single crushing strike. All this effort leaves them quite tired afterwards.

move.name: Hurricane
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Wind Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target. Rain Weather eliminates Low Accuracy. Sunny Weather increases to Low Accuracy 4. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop", this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The Pokémon calls upon fierce gale winds. It’ll be difficult to summon the tempest on a clear day, but a little rain will enhance it into a typhoon. Other pokémon in the air are in most danger.

move.name: Thrash
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
move.description: The Pokémon becomes a wild thing and the rumpus has started.

move.name: Sky Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Charge Move. High Critical. Lethal. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: In a graceful but lethal strike, the Pokémon takes a deep dive towards the foe as if the sky was falling down right on top of it

move.name: Night Shade
move.effect: Single Target. Roll Ghost-Type Damage Dice according to the User's Rank: Starter 1 Die / Rookie 2 Dice / Standard 4 Dice/ Advacned 6 Dice / Expert 8 Dice / Ace and forward 10 Dice. Ignore Defenses.

move.name: Roost
move.effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Remove the User's Immunity to Ground-Type Moves. Duration 1 Round.

move.name: Hyper Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge. Lethal.
move.description: A devastating beam, a path of destruction that can extend for miles is the unmistakable proof someone used this Move. Let the user rest before trying to use it again.

name: Dachsbun
description: Dachsbun is every wheat farmer's best friend, as the delicious aroma it emanates helps the fields grow with golden grains. Their body can harden when exposed to heat, and they are excellent vermin hunters.

abilityOne.effect: The first time this Pokemon is hit by a Fire-Type Move, Increase its Defense by 2. Fire-type moves do not deal damage to this Pokemon.

abilityTwo.name: Aroma Veil

move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 6. Switcher Move for the Foe. In the wild, the battle may end.

move.name: Double-Edge
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil.
move.description: Without regard for their own safety, the Pokémon does a reckless attack against their foe.

move.name: Crunch
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Lethal. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the foe's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon viciously mauls, tears, and rips apart anything its fangs can come in contact with.

move.name: Nasty Plot
move.effect: Target Self. Increase User's Special by 2.
move.description: Rubbing both hands and laughing sinisterly the Pokémon rejoices in the evil plans they’ll soon carry out.

move.name: Twin Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Double Action.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a beam, and as if had a mind of its own, another part of their body also shoots a beam along.

move.name: Psychic Fangs
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. If there is a Force Field on the Target's side of the field, destroy it.
move.description: The Pokémon bares its fangs to bite the foe, psychic energy begins piercing before the actual fangs make contact.

move.name: Hyper Voice
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move.
move.description: The user screeches or sings at such high frequencies that anything made of glass will break. The ears of the victims are left in no better state.

move.name: Future Sight
move.effect: Single Target. This Move's damage is dealt at the beginning of the next Round. Ignore Shield Moves, Force Field, Cover & Substitute. If the target restires or switches out from battle, the damage will be dealt to the next opponent or to one of its allies.
move.description: The Pokémon foresees something terrible happening. Although when it tries to see their own future, the images are ever changing.

move.name: Foul Play
move.effect: Single Target. S.T.A.B. of the User and the Strength/Special of the foe are used for this Move's Damage Pool.
move.description: The user feints an attack that tricks the foe into hurting itself.

move.name: Mirror Coat
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 5. Can only be used if Target's last Move on User was a Special Move. For damage, roll dice equal to Target's last damage pool rolled against the User plus 2. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The user gathers the harmful energies around themselves and bounces them back to their source.

move.name: Wish
move.effect: Target Self / Target One Ally. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. This move has its effect at the beginning of the Next Round. If the User is switched it will heal whoever takes their place.
move.description: When you wish upon a star it makes no difference who you are, anything your heart desires will come to you.

name: Kartana
description: Its paper-thin body and agility make it too dangerous to approach without serious risk of injury. Our team managed to immobilize it using a heat chamber, though I swear I feel its resentment to us.

abilityOne.name: Beast Boost
abilityOne.description: A wicked satisfaction grows as this creature brings out destruction, for it becomes more savage with every foe that falls to its power.
abilityOne.effect: If a foe faints because of an attack dealt by this Ultra-Beast, Increase by 1 their highest Attribute. Up to 3 points can be increased this way. Unique Ability.

move.name: Fury Cutter
move.effect: Single Target. Successive Actions. Cutter Move.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their claws or scythes to rapidly cut as if shredding paper.

move.name: Vacuum Wave
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1.
move.description: Using their chi as a vacuum, the Pokémon pulls the foe closer, the foe gets hurt by the sudden force wave on its body

move.name: Razor Leaf
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Cutter Move. Ranged. High Critical.
move.description: The user sends out a barrage of sharp razor-like leaves. “Death by a thousand cuts” would be the best depiction.

move.name: False Swipe
move.effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. This Move's Damage can't make the Target go below 1 HP.
move.description: Through their most dramatic poses, the Pokémon pretends to slice up the foe (the blood is fake).

move.name: Cut
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Cutter Move. Out of battle it will help to easily cut down trees and obstacles.
move.description: A swift and precise cut that can even slice a tree in half.

move.name: Air Cutter
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. High Critical. Wind Move. Cutter Move.
move.description: A sharp wide wave of wind is sent out , everyone can feel it slicing throught their midsection.

move.name: Defog
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Remove all Force Fields, Entry Hazards and Terrains (Misty Terrain, Electric Terrain, etc.) from the Battlefield.
