move.description: A strong wind sweeps out the battle field, removing anything from bad weather to scattered objects and even invisible barriers.

move.name: Aerial Ace
move.effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. Never Miss.
move.description: The Pokémon rises up in the air towards a light source, momentarily blinding the foe. then plummets quickly to attack the opponent

move.name: Detect
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokemon would receive from a Physical or Special move. Negate the Added Effcts of Any Moves that target the user.
move.description: The Pokémon detects the intentions of the attacker and reacts just in time to minimize the damage.

move.name: Air Slash
move.effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: A compressed wind-slash, the change of pressure knocks out the target momentarily

move.name: Tailwind
move.effect: Target User's side of the Field. Wind Move. Increase by 2 the Dexterity of everyone on the User's side of the field. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: Flying Pokémon know better than anyone how to use the wind in their favor. Let its draft carry you to victory.

move.name: Knock Off
move.effect: Single Target. *If the Target is holding an Item, Add 2 Dice to the Damage pool of this Move. The Target loses its Held Item afterwards.
move.description: The Pokémon rudely smacks what their foe was holding.

move.name: Night Slash
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical. Cutter Move.
move.description: The user looks for a weak spot, tearing the soft flesh apart with a single vile slash of its claws.

move.name: Synthesis
move.effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will Point to activate. If Sunny Weather is in effect, this Move becomes a Complete Heal. If performed under Rain, Sandstorm, Hail or Snowy Weather, this Move is a Minor heal and only heals 1 HP.
move.description: The Pokémon gathers sunlight to re-energize themselves.

move.name: Laser Focus
move.effect: Target Self. If the next Physical or Special Move the user performs gets 5 more successes required on the Accuracy Roll, ignore the Target's defenses on the Damage roll.
move.description: Through its incredible awarenes the Pokémon finds a straight path into a weak point of the foe. The attack that follows is devastating.

move.name: Leaf Blade
move.effect: Single Target. High Critical. Lethal. Cutter Move.
move.description: Danger lies not on the material’s toughness but on its edge’s sharpness.

move.name: Iron Defense
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
move.description: Iron body, iron will. This Pokémon is unbreakable.

move.name: Swords Dance
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Strength by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon dances with strong steps and a fierce attitude as a ritual to prepare for battle.

move.name: X-Scissor
move.effect: Single Target. Cutter Move.
move.description: The Pokémon uses its scythes or clawa as if they were a pair of scissors to cut through the foe.

move.name: Smart Strike
move.effect: Single Target. Never Miss. Lethal.
move.description: The user stabs the foe using one of their sharp horns with astounding precision. The resulting wound is very deep and needs stitches immediately

move.name: Double Team
move.effect: Target Self. The User can now make up to 5 Evasions per Round.
move.description: The Pokémon moves so fast they create a series of shadow copies of themselves. Trying to guess which one is the real one is a pain.

move.name: Psycho Cut
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. High Critical. Cutter Move.
move.description: The user sends out an invisible sword made with psychic energy that slashes targets even if they are far away

move.name: Solar Blade
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Cutter Move. If Sunny Weather is active, you skip this Move's Charge action. If performed under Rain, Sandstorm or Hail/Snowy Weather, this Move takes two actions to Charge.
move.description: The Pokémon focuses the sunlight on its sharp leaves, then releases the energy with a shattering cut.

move.name: Sacred Sword
move.effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The user slashes at its target with a mighty blade. Theres no hide nor armor thick enough to resist its valorous steel.

move.name: Guillotine
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 5. Deal Damage equal to the Target's Remaining HP, plus 1 Lethal Damage.
move.description: Fueled by the spirit of revolution the Pokémon sentences their foe to be reduced at the neck. This devastating attack requires an emergency trip to the Pokémon Center...and a basket.

name: Greninja (Battle Bond Form)
description: The mysteries of the Pokémon world are vast. There is something called 'The Bond Phenomenon' where a Pokémon and its trainer share a connection so strong that the Pokémon changes due to it.

abilityOne.name: Protean
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon's versitile body gives it profeciency on practically everything it sets out to do.
abilityOne.effect: Before this Pokemon uses a Physical or Special Move, change its Type to that of the Move it intends to use. Use the appropriate STAB on the Damage Pool.

move.name: Pound
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user pounds the target’s head. Simple

move.name: Growl
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Reduce by 1 the Strength of those affected.
move.description: Either through a menacing attitude or an adorable demeanor, the foe will hesitate to attack the user at full power.

move.name: Bubble
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: Dozens of bubbles are sent floating through the battlefield. The foes can’t resist the temptation to burst the pretty bubbles, only for the bubbles to explode for real when they do.

move.name: Quick Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Out of battle, double the Pokemon's movement speed.
move.description: An attackas fight as lightning.

move.name: Lick
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon licks the foe. The foe is deeply disturbed by this creepy display of “affection”.

move.name: Water Pulse
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target.
move.description: The user sends out a pulsing ring of water that blasts the foe with ultrasonic waves. For a while, everything seems as if reflected in the water ripples.

move.name: Smokescreen
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon covers the foe in a cloud of smoke to impair their visibility to make it easier to hide and/or cover their escape.

move.name: Haze
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Remove all Increased or Reduced Attributes and Traits of everyone on the battlefield.
move.description: The battlefield is filled with a cleansing cloud that takes away all impurities in the field. It can also work as concealment.

move.name: Feint Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Never Miss.
move.description: The user approaches inconspicuously, pretending to attack the foe directly, then actually hits the foe from behind.

move.name: Smack Down
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Remove the Target's immunity to Ground-Type Moves. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop", this Move hits anyways.
move.description: They say it’s great to get two birds with one stone, this Pokémon will give one bird ALL the stones.

move.name: Shadow Sneak
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1.
move.description: The user sneaks through the darkness and strikes by coming out of the target’s shadow. The Pokémon is able travel freely through the shadow realm.

move.name: Spikes
move.effect: Target Foe's Side of the Field. Entry Hazard. Pokemon entering the battle Receive 1 Typeless Damage. This effect does not stack. Pokemon with immunity to Ground-Type Moves are not affected.
move.description: Sharp and pointy spikes are scattered around the field, if you don’t watch your step the spikes will dig on your feet.

move.name: Extrasensory
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon alters their target’s senses, making it feel things that aren’t really there.

move.name: Role Play
move.effect: Single Target. Replace the User's Ability with the Target's. Whole Scene Duration. Unique Abilities can't be copied.
move.description: The Pokémon is a great actor. Their impersonations are really good! ...maybe a bit too good.

move.name: Snatch
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 6. Remove any Increase/Reduction on the Foe's Attributes, Active Shield Moves, Healing effects on the Foe, or effects on its side of the field; and place them on the User instead. See p. 531 for more info.
move.description: The user takes notice of the good stuff on the other side and quickly takes it for themselves. Finders keepers, losers weepers!

move.name: Mat Block
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Shield Move. Reaction 1. Reduce 3 Damage from a Physical or Special Move.
move.description: The Pokémon uses a mat as a shield.

move.name: Water Shuriken
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Successive Actions.
move.description: The best ninjas attack swiftly and undetected, after the deed is done, no evidence is left but an inconspicuous puddle of water.

move.name: Substitute
move.effect: Target Self. Deal 2 damage to the User. Put a Substitute Decoy with 2 HP and the same defenses as the user. See p. 531
move.description: The Pokémon disappears in a poof of smoke. A decoy identical to the user takes their place in battle. The user keeps attacking from the shadows while the decoy serves as distraction.

move.name: Double Team
move.effect: Target Self. The User can now make up to 5 Evasions per Round.
move.description: The Pokémon moves so fast they create a series of shadow copies of themselves. Trying to guess which one is the real one is a pain.

move.name: Hydro Pump
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2
move.description: Water works best under pressure.

move.name: Night Slash
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical. Cutter Move.
move.description: The user looks for a weak spot, tearing the soft flesh apart with a single vile slash of its claws.

move.name: Gunk Shot
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
move.description: The target is covered heat to toe in sludge, filth and organic waste. It can’t even cry for help or all of it will go into its mouth.

move.name: Ice Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 1 Chance Dice to Freeze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon wears their ice gloves to punch the foe. Yes. Gloves made of ice.

move.name: Mind Reader
move.effect: Single Target. The User has 2 automatic and unremovable successes on the next Accuracy or Evasion Roll against the Target.
move.description: In a split of second, the Pokémon reads the foe’s mind so they know exactly what to do next.

move.name: Hydro Cannon
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge
move.description: Those who fear fire’s destructive power have forgotten that water triumphs over the flames every single time.

name: Oinkologne (Female Form)
description: Despite their appearance, these Pokémon smell like flowers. Females have thick, strong and well-developed legs, which makes them able to jump up to 16 feet in the air and the best selection for aged hams.

abilityOne.name: Aroma Veil
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon lets off a nice smell that helps you to stay relaxed and focused even under stressful situations
abilityOne.effect: User and Allies in Range are immune to the "Love" Status Condition and the effects of the moves: Taunt, Torment, Spite, Attract, Disable, Encore, and Heal Block.

abilityTwo.name: Thick Fat
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon's body has a thick layer of blubber that protects it against against harsh temperatures.
abilityTwo.effect: Reduce by 1 the damage taken from Fire and Ice-Type moves.

hiddenAbility.name: Gluttony
hiddenAbility.description: This Pokemon eats all day long, it is always carrying food and has no problem to find food sources since it's not a picky eater. It, however, doesn't share.
hiddenAbility.effect: This Pokemon can eat any type of food, medicine or herbal medicine with no negative. This pokemon may have up to three berries as held item instead of just one. The berries must not be of the same effect.

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Tail Whip
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The Pokémon whips their tail in such an adorable way the foes let their guard down.

move.name: Disarming Voice
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Never Miss.
move.description: With a charming but manipulative cry, the user deals emotional damage to their opponent by making them feel guilty.

move.name: Echoed Voice
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. This Move can be used many times in the same Round. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage pool of this move for each time you use it. Up to 8 Dice might be added this way. Reset this effect if the user performs another move, evasion or clash.
move.description: The Pokémon yells at the void. Their echo answers. The Pokémon yells louder and louder everytime the echo talks back.

move.name: Mud Shot
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 1.
move.description: By shooting a stream of mud at their target, the user manages to impair their movement.

move.name: Sweet Scent
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Those affected cannot Evade Moves. Out of Battle, it will attract wild Pokemon.
move.description: The Pokémon releases a sweet aroma that lulls their enemies into a false sense of security

move.name: Dig
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Earth Power/ Earthquake/ Fissure/ Magnitude/ Stomping Tantrum. Out of battle allows the Pokemon to burrow and make underground tunnels.
move.description: The user digs a tunnel on the ground and attacks by coming out from below its target. This move has been used to escape caves and gain access to highly surveiled places.

move.name: Headbutt
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Out of battle it may cause a Random encounter when hitting trees and make objects drop from high places.
move.description: The Pokémon rams against their foe with their head. This Move is perfect to shake down trees when looking for berries, but beware of wild Pokémon nesting at the treetops.

move.name: Stockpile
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense. Enables the use of the Moves "Spit Up" and "Swallow".
move.description: The Pokémon swells up like a balloon by storing power within themselves. This helps them bounce back a bit of the damage.

move.name: Swallow
move.effect: Target Self. The user must have previously used the Move "Stockpile", otherwise this Move will fail. Complete Heal, if successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Reduce by 1 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense.
move.description: After stockpiling, the Pokémon swallows the energy to restore their health, they go back to their normal size afterwards.

move.name: Spit Up
move.effect: Single Target. The user must have previously used the Move "Stockpile", otherwise this Move will fail. Reduce by 1 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense.
move.description: After stockpiling, the Pokémon spits the stored energy as a mighty beam. The user returns to their original size afterwards.

move.name: Take Down
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Recoil.
move.description: Through a reckless grapple, the Pokémon smashes the foe into the ground, usually falling along with it.

move.name: Yawn
move.effect: Single Target. *If the Target has not been removed from battle at the beginning of the next Round, put it to Sleep.
move.description: The user yawns, the foe yawns, the trainers yawn... everyone should take a nap.

move.name: Body Press
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon makes a judo maneuver, using its body mass instead of its strength against the target.

move.name: Work Up
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Special.
move.description: The Pokémon has spent a lot of time training and doesn’t miss the chance to show off their muscles and fitness. After the battle they share routines and tips with the other Pokémon.

move.name: Uproar
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Sound Move. This Effect Targets the Battle Field: Pokemon will be cured of the Sleep Status. Duration 1 Round.
move.description: Shouts, screams, and loud music... What does a Pokémon have to do here for a peaceful night of sleep?

move.name: Double-Edge
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil.
move.description: Without regard for their own safety, the Pokémon does a reckless attack against their foe.

move.name: Stomping Tantrum
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move if the User failed the Accuracy roll of the last Move it performed. If the Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dig", this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The Pokémon throws a tantrum and stomps all over the place, it becomes worse if something has previously frustrated them.

move.name: Belch
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Sound Move. The user must eat a berry or something similar during the Round before using this Move, otherwise it will fail. This effect only works once per berry/food eaten.
move.description: The user shoots a blast of venomous pins that inject venom into the foe, this venom is specially potent against those already compromised.

move.name: Giga Impact
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge. Lethal.
move.description: The Pokémon strikes with such a brutal force they leave a crater just from the impact. Let them catch their breath afterwards.

move.name: Iron Head
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon charges to cure the foe’s iron deficit.

move.name: Substitute
move.effect: Target Self. Deal 2 damage to the User. Put a Substitute Decoy with 2 HP and the same defenses as the user. See p. 531
move.description: The Pokémon disappears in a poof of smoke. A decoy identical to the user takes their place in battle. The user keeps attacking from the shadows while the decoy serves as distraction.

move.name: Endure
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. If a Physical or Special Move would cause the user to faint, they remain at 1 HP instead, remove this effect afterwards. The effect re-activates on the user's next Turn. Whole Round duration.
move.description: The Pokémon mentally prepares to receive a fatal blow, their spirit is stronger than their body so they endure to keep on fighting for as long as possible.

name: Marshadow
description: There is an old children's story about a boy who lost his shadow and the shadow became a Pokémon. There is a debate to which Pokémon the story is referring.

abilityOne.name: Technician
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon is meticulous and precise in tasks that everyone else would perform roughly and without care.
abilityOne.effect: Add 1 Extra die to the Damage pool of all Physical or Special Moves with Power 1 or 2 this Pokemon performs.

move.name: Fire Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 2nd Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: A fist powered by the fiery spirit of combat, the heat of the battle lights of for real as the punch hits the foe right where it hurts!

move.name: Ice Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 1 Chance Dice to Freeze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon wears their ice gloves to punch the foe. Yes. Gloves made of ice.

move.name: Thunder Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 1 Chance die to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A charged punch to deliver a shocking blow.

move.name: Copycat
move.effect: Single Target. Copy Move. Unique Moves can't be copied. You may choose another Target(s) for the copied Move.
move.description: The user is incredibly observant and has a talent for impersonations, no one will tell the difference!

move.name: Shadow Sneak
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1.
move.description: The user sneaks through the darkness and strikes by coming out of the target’s shadow. The Pokémon is able travel freely through the shadow realm.

move.name: Feint
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 1. This Move ignores the effects of any Shield Move active on the Target and removes their effects for the rest of the Round.
move.description: The user begins their attack, and as their target attempts to protect itself, the user feints the target to break their defense against their true strike.

move.name: Rolling Kick
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon jumps in the air and spins with one leg extended to land an impressive kick against their foe.

move.name: Dizzy Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon locates their enemy’s balance point and lands a swift punch that leaves the foe seeing a swirl of stars around its head.

move.name: Pursuit
move.effect: Single Target. *If a Target hit by this Move is recalled, attempts to Run Away, uses a Switcher Move or is the Target of a Switcher Move, Deal 2 Typeless Damage to it. Outside of battle, aid in catching a fleeing target.
move.description: The Pokémon is relentless in its pursuit of their target, striking it just as it believed it had escaped.

move.name: Counter
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 5. Can only be used if Target's last Move on User was a Physical Move. For damage, roll dice equal to Target's last damage pool rolled against the User plus 2 dice. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The Pokémon strikes back at their foe. Showing they can take a hit and punch even harder.

move.name: Role Play
move.effect: Single Target. Replace the User's Ability with the Target's. Whole Scene Duration. Unique Abilities can't be copied.
move.description: The Pokémon is a great actor. Their impersonations are really good! ...maybe a bit too good.

move.name: Shadow Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Never Miss. Fist Move.
move.description: The Pokémon punches the air, inadvertently, their shadow delivers the punch through the foe’s own shadow. This move is impossible to predict.

move.name: Force Palm
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A powerful open-palm hit that knocks the foe several feet away and may leave them unable to move.

move.name: Assurance
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 2 extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move if the Target has already received Damage from the User this Round.
move.description: The user indentifies the weakest foe and charges against them.

move.name: Sucker Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 6. *This move can only be used as a Late Reaction; and only if the Target used a Physical or Special Move, otherwise it will fail.
move.description: The Pokémon takes advantage of their foe preparing to attack to unleash a dirty surprise blow.

move.name: Drain Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: A solid punch that weakens the foes and revitalizes the user with each hit.

move.name: Psych Up
move.effect: Single Target. The User gets the same Attribute/Trait Increases and Reductions the Target has.
move.description: The Pokémon mentalizes themselves stronger than anyone. They feel good. They can win. They. Can. Do. This!

move.name: Spectral Thief
move.effect: Single Target. Unique. Before the User deals damage with this Move, steal all Attribute Increases the Target may have. Reduced Attributes on the Target remain.
move.description: Through the shadows, the user sneaks on its target to steal its life force and consume it, leaving the victim with a sense of grief and loss.

move.name: Laser Focus
move.effect: Target Self. If the next Physical or Special Move the user performs gets 5 more successes required on the Accuracy Roll, ignore the Target's defenses on the Damage roll.
move.description: Through its incredible awarenes the Pokémon finds a straight path into a weak point of the foe. The attack that follows is devastating.

move.name: Jump Kick
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. If the Accuracy roll fails, Roll 4 Dice of Typeless Damage against the user, ignoring defenses.
move.description: The user launches itself up two stories high to pummel down with a powerful kick. Do not try it at home.

move.name: Endeavor
move.effect: Single Target. Roll Dice of Normal-Type Damage equal to the difference between the User's current HP and the Target's max HP. Ignore defenses. Up to 10 Dice may be rolled this way. This Damage cannot make the Target's HP go lower than the User's current HP.
move.description: Through sheer willpower the Pokémon manages to level the conditions of the battle despite their own injuries.

move.name: Close Combat
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce by 1 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon gets close enough to deal devastating damage, but the same can be said for the foe.

move.name: Poison Jab
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon is set on injecting venom directly into the foe’s bloodstream. They can do it the easy way or the hard way.

move.name: Throat Chop
move.effect: Single Target. The target cannot use any "Sound Based" Move. Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon.
move.description: A heinous attack to a Pokémon’s throat that will leave them unable to make a sound for hours.

move.name: Superpower
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Reduce by 1 the User's Strength and Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon packs all their power in a single crushing strike. All this effort leaves them quite tired afterwards.

name: Guzzlord
description: One disaster after another. This time we lost an entire facility. UB-05 is a monster, there is no other way to say it. It swallowed documents, vehicles, and even an entire building. There is no end to its hunger.

abilityOne.name: Beast Boost
abilityOne.description: A wicked satisfaction grows as this creature brings out destruction, for it becomes more savage with every foe that falls to its power.
abilityOne.effect: If a foe faints because of an attack dealt by this Ultra-Beast, Increase by 1 their highest Attribute. Up to 3 points can be increased this way. Unique Ability.

move.name: Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe
move.description: The user lands a vicious bite, leaving an ugly bruise.

move.name: Dragon Tail
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Late Reaction 6. Switcher Move for the Foe. In the wild, the battle may end.
move.description: The Pokémon sends their opponent flying up to 100ft in the air with a strong flick of their tail.

move.name: Swallow
move.effect: Target Self. The user must have previously used the Move "Stockpile", otherwise this Move will fail. Complete Heal, if successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Reduce by 1 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense.
move.description: After stockpiling, the Pokémon swallows the energy to restore their health, they go back to their normal size afterwards.

move.name: Stockpile
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense. Enables the use of the Moves "Spit Up" and "Swallow".
move.description: The Pokémon swells up like a balloon by storing power within themselves. This helps them bounce back a bit of the damage.

move.name: Knock Off
move.effect: Single Target. *If the Target is holding an Item, Add 2 Dice to the Damage pool of this Move. The Target loses its Held Item afterwards.
move.description: The Pokémon rudely smacks what their foe was holding.

move.name: Stomp
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Die to Flinch the Target. Targets under the effects of the Move "Minimize" are vulnerable.
move.description: Stomping the foe with strong feet. Perfect to squish nasty little bugs.

move.name: Stomping Tantrum
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move if the User failed the Accuracy roll of the last Move it performed. If the Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dig", this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The Pokémon throws a tantrum and stomps all over the place, it becomes worse if something has previously frustrated them.

move.name: Dragon Rage
move.effect: Single Target. Set Damage. Deal 2 Dragon-Type Damage to the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon focuses their inner rage and makes it not-soinner anymore.

move.name: Crunch
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Lethal. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the foe's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon viciously mauls, tears, and rips apart anything its fangs can come in contact with.

move.name: Body Slam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The user charges against the foe using ther body to slam it down, leaving the target stunned.

move.name: Gastro Acid
move.effect: Single Target. Negate any effect the Target's Ability would have. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The user spews their gastric juices on the foe. It’s so disgusting the foe can only concentrate on getting cleaned ASAP

move.name: Iron Tail
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Reduce the Target's Defense by 1.
move.description: With a hardened tail, the Pokémon swings against the foe to make a dent in their armor.

move.name: Wide Guard
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Reaction 3. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage the Targets would receive from Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Any Moves on the Targets.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their whole body to provide shelter and protection to everyone they can. They are the rock on which others stand.

move.name: Steamroller
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch Target.
move.description: The user curls up and rolls at full speed against the foe with the intention to swat them on the ground.

move.name: Brutal Swing
move.effect: Target All foes in Range. Lethal.
move.description: The Pokémon starts attacking at full force with its claws, anyone unfortunate enough to be in its path will end up severely wounded.

move.name: Wring Out
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. *Remove 1 Dice from the Damage Pool for every missing HP on the target. Up to 4 Dice may be removed this way.
move.description: The Pokémon quite literally squeezes the life out of their foe. But to do this effectively they require to be in top condition.

move.name: Heat Wave
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 1. Wind Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 1st Degree Burn on those affected.
move.description: A large wave of extra-hot air that can set fire to everything it touches.

move.name: Hammer Arm
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Low Accuracy 1. Reduce User's Dexterity by 1.
move.description: Stop. Hammer Arm time!

move.name: Heavy Slam
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to he Damage Pool for every 50kg of weight the User is above the target's weight. Up to 4 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The foe is about to confirm if the Pokémon is thick-boned.

move.name: Dragon Rush
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon rushes to charge against their foe. Unlucky victims end up crushed into the ground.

move.name: Thrash
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
move.description: The Pokémon becomes a wild thing and the rumpus has started.

move.name: Belch
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Sound Move. The user must eat a berry or something similar during the Round before using this Move, otherwise it will fail. This effect only works once per berry/food eaten.
move.description: The user shoots a blast of venomous pins that inject venom into the foe, this venom is specially potent against those already compromised.

move.name: Outrage
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
move.description: The true nature of dragon-types unleashed. The user is consumed by a primal fury that won’t stop until everything has ben razed to the ground. Afterwards the Pokémon is confused.

move.name: Draco Meteor
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. lethal. Reduce User's Special by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon summons a meteor to fall from the sky directly into their foes, dealing a brutal amount of damage. An impressive display if power that demands a lot of energy.

move.name: Giga Impact
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge. Lethal.
move.description: The Pokémon strikes with such a brutal force they leave a crater just from the impact. Let them catch their breath afterwards.

name: Nihilego
description: We are unable to determine if the creature is sentient or not; it adapts its behavior depending on its last host. It hasn't stopped behaving like a little girl since then. It's both unsettling and fascinating.

abilityOne.name: Beast Boost
abilityOne.description: A wicked satisfaction grows as this creature brings out destruction, for it becomes more savage with every foe that falls to its power.
abilityOne.effect: If a foe faints because of an attack dealt by this Ultra-Beast, Increase by 1 their highest Attribute. Up to 3 points can be increased this way. Unique Ability.

move.name: Constrict
move.effect: Single Target. This Move deals Typeless damage. Roll 1 chance die to reduce the Target's Dexterity by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon tightens their hold on the foe to keep them locked in a squeeze.

move.name: Pound
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user pounds the target’s head. Simple

move.name: Acid
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Roll 1 Chance die to Reduce by 1 the Sp. Defense of those affected.
move.description: The Pokémon spits an acidic gunk into the foe that immediately gives burning sensation. Keep away from the eyes and wash with abundant water.

move.name: Tickle
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce by 1 the Target's Strength and Defense.
move.description: Whoever said laughter is the best therapy lied.

move.name: Corrosive Gas
move.effect: Area Attack. Those affected lose their held item.
move.description: The Pokémon releases a powerful acidic gas that melts all inorganic matter in seconds.

move.name: Rock Tomb
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 1.
move.description: The pokémon buries their foe prematurely, but it’ll be good practice for the real thing.

move.name: Acid Spray
move.effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 2.
move.description: Do not point at face or eyes. Keep away from children.

move.name: Clear Smog
move.effect: Single Target. Never Miss. Reset all Increased or Reduced Attributes on the Foe.
move.description: The user shoots a blast of venomous pins that inject venom into the foe, this venom is specially potent against those already compromised.

move.name: Power Split
move.effect: Single Target. Average the User's Strength and Special with the Target's, rounded down.
move.description: Through a mental link both Pokémon are aware of each other strengths, which ends up evening the odds.

move.name: Guard Split
move.effect: Single Target. Average the User's Defense and Sp. Defense with the Target's, rounded down.
move.description: Through a mental link both Pokémon are aware of each other weaknesses, which end up evening the odds.

move.name: Venoshock
move.effect: Single Target. *If the Target is already Poisoned, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.
move.description: The Pokémon identifies the weakest prey and makes an opportunistic shot.

move.name: Psywave
move.effect: Single Target. Roll Psychic-Type Damage Dice according to the User's Rank: Starter 1 Die / Rookie 2 Dice / Standard 4 Dice/ Advacned 6 Dice / Expert 8 Dice / Ace and forward 10 Dice. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: A powerful mental wave assault’s the target’s brain directly. Everything, from forgotten memories to the secrets of the universe bombard its mind in just a few seconds.

move.name: Headbutt
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Out of battle it may cause a Random encounter when hitting trees and make objects drop from high places.
move.description: The Pokémon rams against their foe with their head. This Move is perfect to shake down trees when looking for berries, but beware of wild Pokémon nesting at the treetops.

move.name: Safeguard
move.effect: Target User's side of the Field. Force Field. Those affected are immune to all Status Ailements/Conditions. Previously inflicted Status Ailments/Conditions remain. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A force field covers half of the battlefield and filters out all impurities and ill intentions coming from the other side.

move.name: Toxic Spikes
move.effect: Target Foe's side of the Field. Entry Hazard. Foes who enter the battlefield become Poisoned. Roll 1 Chance Die for them to become Badly Poisoned instead. Pokemon with immunity to Ground-Type Moves are not affected.
move.description: The Pokémon lays a trap of tiny venom-drenched spikes through the battlefield. The battle has not yet begun and the foes are already defeated.

move.name: Venom Drench
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. *If the affected are already Poisoned or becomes Poisoned in the same Round this Move was used, Reduce by 1 their Strength, Special and Dexterity.
move.description: The user weakens the foe’s already compromised immune systems.

move.name: Power Gem
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: With a crystal gem, the Pokémon will always save the day!

move.name: Stealth Rock
move.effect: Target Foe's Side of the Field. Entry Hazard. Pokemon entering the battle Receive 1 Rock-Type Damage. This effect does not stack.
move.description: The Pokémon hides a trap of sharp rocks that are launched at the victim before they even realize what even happened.

move.name: Role Play
move.effect: Single Target. Replace the User's Ability with the Target's. Whole Scene Duration. Unique Abilities can't be copied.
move.description: The Pokémon is a great actor. Their impersonations are really good! ...maybe a bit too good.

move.name: Pain Split
move.effect: Single Target. Spend 1 Will Point to activate. *Deal up to 3 Typeless Damage to the Target, Heal 1 HP to the User for every Damage dealt this way. This Move Fails if the User has more than Half HP rounded down. This Move cannot reduce a Target to less than 1 HP.
move.description: The user channels their pain into the foe to relieve their agony. The foe gets to feel the burn of the damage it has caused.

move.name: Mirror Coat
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 5. Can only be used if Target's last Move on User was a Special Move. For damage, roll dice equal to Target's last damage pool rolled against the User plus 2. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: The user gathers the harmful energies around themselves and bounces them back to their source.

move.name: Wonder Room
move.effect: Target the Battlefield. Everyone on the Battlefield will have their Defense and Sp. Defense calculated with Insight instead of Vitality. If using Insight as Sp. Defense optional rule, swap the calculation. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The battlefield is now a space that puts the mind to the test. A resilient mind will be a resilient body, but if the mind is weak the body will feel frail and feeble.

move.name: Gunk Shot
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
move.description: The target is covered heat to toe in sludge, filth and organic waste. It can’t even cry for help or all of it will go into its mouth.

move.name: Head Smash
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Recoil.
move.description: Pokémon, angry. Pokémon, smash!

move.name: Meteor Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Increase the User's Special by 1 the moment it begins charging.
move.description: The user overflows with galactic energy while summoning a small meteor to impact the foe. A theory suggests this move might have caused the extintion of prehistoric Pokémon.

name: Oinkologne (Male Form)
description: Males are proud creatures, they emit a lingering perfumated scent rom the tip of their tails. Their skin is also very glossy and it loves to keep it clean. This delicious aroma also lingers beautifully well in bacon.

abilityOne.name: Lingering Aroma
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon has a very strong smell, it may be pleasant or disgusting, but the smell will impregnate into everything and be very difficult to remove.
abilityOne.effect: If this Pokemon hits or gets hit with a Non-Ranged Physical Move, the foe's ability is changed to Lingering Aroma.

abilityTwo.name: Thick Fat
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon's body has a thick layer of blubber that protects it against against harsh temperatures.
abilityTwo.effect: Reduce by 1 the damage taken from Fire and Ice-Type moves.

hiddenAbility.name: Gluttony
hiddenAbility.description: This Pokemon eats all day long, it is always carrying food and has no problem to find food sources since it's not a picky eater. It, however, doesn't share.
hiddenAbility.effect: This Pokemon can eat any type of food, medicine or herbal medicine with no negative. This pokemon may have up to three berries as held item instead of just one. The berries must not be of the same effect.

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Tail Whip
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The Pokémon whips their tail in such an adorable way the foes let their guard down.

move.name: Disarming Voice
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Never Miss.
move.description: With a charming but manipulative cry, the user deals emotional damage to their opponent by making them feel guilty.

move.name: Echoed Voice
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. This Move can be used many times in the same Round. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage pool of this move for each time you use it. Up to 8 Dice might be added this way. Reset this effect if the user performs another move, evasion or clash.
move.description: The Pokémon yells at the void. Their echo answers. The Pokémon yells louder and louder everytime the echo talks back.

move.name: Mud Shot
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 1.
move.description: By shooting a stream of mud at their target, the user manages to impair their movement.

move.name: Sweet Scent
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Those affected cannot Evade Moves. Out of Battle, it will attract wild Pokemon.
move.description: The Pokémon releases a sweet aroma that lulls their enemies into a false sense of security

move.name: Dig
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Earth Power/ Earthquake/ Fissure/ Magnitude/ Stomping Tantrum. Out of battle allows the Pokemon to burrow and make underground tunnels.
move.description: The user digs a tunnel on the ground and attacks by coming out from below its target. This move has been used to escape caves and gain access to highly surveiled places.

move.name: Headbutt
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Out of battle it may cause a Random encounter when hitting trees and make objects drop from high places.
move.description: The Pokémon rams against their foe with their head. This Move is perfect to shake down trees when looking for berries, but beware of wild Pokémon nesting at the treetops.

move.name: Stockpile
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense. Enables the use of the Moves "Spit Up" and "Swallow".
move.description: The Pokémon swells up like a balloon by storing power within themselves. This helps them bounce back a bit of the damage.

move.name: Swallow
move.effect: Target Self. The user must have previously used the Move "Stockpile", otherwise this Move will fail. Complete Heal, if successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Reduce by 1 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense.
move.description: After stockpiling, the Pokémon swallows the energy to restore their health, they go back to their normal size afterwards.

move.name: Spit Up
move.effect: Single Target. The user must have previously used the Move "Stockpile", otherwise this Move will fail. Reduce by 1 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense.
move.description: After stockpiling, the Pokémon spits the stored energy as a mighty beam. The user returns to their original size afterwards.

move.name: Take Down
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Recoil.
move.description: Through a reckless grapple, the Pokémon smashes the foe into the ground, usually falling along with it.

move.name: Yawn
move.effect: Single Target. *If the Target has not been removed from battle at the beginning of the next Round, put it to Sleep.
move.description: The user yawns, the foe yawns, the trainers yawn... everyone should take a nap.

move.name: Body Press
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon makes a judo maneuver, using its body mass instead of its strength against the target.

move.name: Work Up
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Special.
move.description: The Pokémon has spent a lot of time training and doesn’t miss the chance to show off their muscles and fitness. After the battle they share routines and tips with the other Pokémon.

move.name: Uproar
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Sound Move. This Effect Targets the Battle Field: Pokemon will be cured of the Sleep Status. Duration 1 Round.
move.description: Shouts, screams, and loud music... What does a Pokémon have to do here for a peaceful night of sleep?

move.name: Double-Edge
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil.
move.description: Without regard for their own safety, the Pokémon does a reckless attack against their foe.

move.name: Earth Power
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: The user sends out a subterranean wave that bursts the ground below the target. It’s as if the earth bends to the user’s will.

move.name: Belch
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Sound Move. The user must eat a berry or something similar during the Round before using this Move, otherwise it will fail. This effect only works once per berry/food eaten.
move.description: The user shoots a blast of venomous pins that inject venom into the foe, this venom is specially potent against those already compromised.

move.name: Hyper Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge. Lethal.
move.description: A devastating beam, a path of destruction that can extend for miles is the unmistakable proof someone used this Move. Let the user rest before trying to use it again.

move.name: Energy Ball
move.effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: Gathering nature’s energy from nearby plants, trees and roots, the Pokémon forms a ball to shoot at the enemy. Sadly, the surrounding plants will be dry afterwards.

move.name: Substitute
move.effect: Target Self. Deal 2 damage to the User. Put a Substitute Decoy with 2 HP and the same defenses as the user. See p. 531
move.description: The Pokémon disappears in a poof of smoke. A decoy identical to the user takes their place in battle. The user keeps attacking from the shadows while the decoy serves as distraction.

move.name: Endure
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. If a Physical or Special Move would cause the user to faint, they remain at 1 HP instead, remove this effect afterwards. The effect re-activates on the user's next Turn. Whole Round duration.
move.description: The Pokémon mentally prepares to receive a fatal blow, their spirit is stronger than their body so they endure to keep on fighting for as long as possible.

name: Moltres
description: The legend speaks of a bird who came flying from the south. Its fiery body melted the snow and brought the spring along. A children's book depicts a similar Pokémon living inside of a volcano.

abilityOne.name: Pressure
abilityOne.description: Being around this Pokemon will be very stressing and demanding, only the bravest dare to face them one-on-one.
abilityOne.effect: When this Pokemon comes out, All foes in Range spend half (rounded up) of their remaining Will Points without gaining any effect for it. This effect does not stack.

abilityTwo.name: Flame Body
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon can willingly ignite its body on fire, receiving no harm from it. Objects that come into contact with this Pokemon may catch fire.
abilityTwo.effect: When hit by a Non-Ranged Physical Move, this Pokemon rolls 3 Chance Dice to inflict 2nd degree Burn on the foe.

move.name: Gust
move.effect: Single Target. Wind Move. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop", this Move hits anyway.
move.description: The Pokémon flaps their wings and strikes the foe with a swirl of wind. Pokémon in the air may get swept away

move.name: Leer
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The vicious glare of a predator that triggers the flight response of their prey.

move.name: Ember
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: A basic fire attack, but not any less dangerous. Even a small flame can grow out of control.

move.name: Safeguard
move.effect: Target User's side of the Field. Force Field. Those affected are immune to all Status Ailements/Conditions. Previously inflicted Status Ailments/Conditions remain. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A force field covers half of the battlefield and filters out all impurities and ill intentions coming from the other side.

move.name: Wing Attack
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: A classic flying technique, the user flies towards the foe and strikes using their wings.

move.name: Flame Charge
move.effect: Single Target. Increase the User's Dexterity by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon dashes so fast they leave a trail of fire behind.

move.name: Ancient Power
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Increase by 1 the User's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense and Sp. Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon calls forward an energy from the ancient past. This may infuse the user with a primal strength.

move.name: Agility
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: Swift of body, swift of mind.

move.name: Air Slash
move.effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: A compressed wind-slash, the change of pressure knocks out the target momentarily

move.name: Incinerate
move.effect: Single Target. All Foes in Range. Destroy the held item of those affected.
move.description: A small blast of fire that instantly consumes small flammable objects.

move.name: Flamethrower
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 2nd Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: The most emblematic fire attack, a seeminly endless stream of fire that reduces everything and everyone to ashes.

move.name: After You
move.effect: Target One Ally. Reaction 1. The Target will go First in the Initiative Order. If used again, the previous target reverts to their original Initiative order. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The user bows and courteously lets a friend go first.

move.name: Heat Wave
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 1. Wind Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 1st Degree Burn on those affected.
move.description: A large wave of extra-hot air that can set fire to everything it touches.

move.name: Fire Spin
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion.
move.description: The user creates a vortex of fire that remains spinning in the battlefield, trapping the foe within.

move.name: Hurricane
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Wind Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target. Rain Weather eliminates Low Accuracy. Sunny Weather increases to Low Accuracy 4. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop", this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The Pokémon calls upon fierce gale winds. It’ll be difficult to summon the tempest on a clear day, but a little rain will enhance it into a typhoon. Other pokémon in the air are in most danger.

move.name: Sunny Day
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Activate Sunny Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The Pokémon will call for the sun to shine brighter, increasing the heat of the arena. This Move doesn’t work at night, indoors, or underground/water.

move.name: Will-O-Wisp
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target. Using this Move against the same Target increases the Burn Degree.
move.description: The user calls upon an eerie blue flame made with the souls of the departed. They appear harmless until they have you surrounded.

move.name: Endure
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. If a Physical or Special Move would cause the user to faint, they remain at 1 HP instead, remove this effect afterwards. The effect re-activates on the user's next Turn. Whole Round duration.
move.description: The Pokémon mentally prepares to receive a fatal blow, their spirit is stronger than their body so they endure to keep on fighting for as long as possible.

move.name: Fire Blast
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Roll 3 Chance Dice to inflict 3rd Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a giant fireball that explodes as soon as it touches their target. Blasting fire in all directions.

move.name: Sky Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Charge Move. High Critical. Lethal. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: In a graceful but lethal strike, the Pokémon takes a deep dive towards the foe as if the sky was falling down right on top of it

move.name: Burn Up
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. After damage is dealt, the user loses its Fire-Type. If its only type was Fire, it is now Typeless. User's Physical & Special Fire-Type Moves have Power 0. Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the User.
move.description: The User unleashes all of its might through a massive blast of raging fire. Although the damage is devastating the Pokémon is left unable to produce more fire for a while.

move.name: Swift
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Never Miss.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a burst of star-shaped sparkles at a blinding speed.

move.name: Solar Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. If Sunny Weather is active, you skip this Move's Charge action. If performed under Rain, Sandstorm or Hail/Snowy Weather, this Move takes two actions to Charge.
move.description: The Pokémon gathers sunlight but instead of being absorbed it is sot as a devastating beam of light instead.

move.name: Burning Jealousy
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. *Inflict 1st Degree Burn on all affected Targets with Increased Attributes.
move.description: The user can’t stand the idea that others are better than them. Their jealousy manifests in the form of a fiery aura that sticks to those the user despises de most.

name: Pawmot
description: Pawmot's fluffy fur acts as a battery, able to power an electric car for hundreds of miles on a single charge. They are patient and hard to anger, but once they are in the mood for a fight, they won't back down.

abilityOne.name: Volt Absorb
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon's body is practically a battery that is always happy to become charged to full capacity.
abilityOne.effect: When this Pokemon is hit by an Electric-Type Move, you may restore 1 HP instead of receiving damage. Electric-Type Moves do not deal damage to this Pokemon.

abilityTwo.name: Iron Fist
abilityTwo.description: The hands of this Pokemon are very strong and heavy, when curled into fists they can go through anything.
abilityTwo.effect: Add 1 Dice to the Damage Pool of Fist Based moves.

move.name: Scratch
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their sharp claws to scratch the enemy. Nothing fancy but it works.

move.name: Growl
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Reduce by 1 the Strength of those affected.
move.description: Either through a menacing attitude or an adorable demeanor, the foe will hesitate to attack the user at full power.

move.name: Thunder Shock
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance die to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The most basic electric attack, charge, release, and shock! Just don’t point it to any electric device.

move.name: Quick Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Out of battle, double the Pokemon's movement speed.
move.description: An attackas fight as lightning.

move.name: Charge
move.effect: Target Self. Add 2 Dice to the Damage Pool of thenext Damaging Electric-Type Move the User performs.
move.description: The user gathers electricity and stores it to make its attacks more powerful. You may also use them as a living battery for your phone.

move.name: Nuzzle
move.effect: Single Target. Paralyze the foe.
move.description: The Pokémon gives a cute nuzzle at their target, it looks adorable until you see the sparks.

move.name: Dig
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Earth Power/ Earthquake/ Fissure/ Magnitude/ Stomping Tantrum. Out of battle allows the Pokemon to burrow and make underground tunnels.
move.description: The user digs a tunnel on the ground and attacks by coming out from below its target. This move has been used to escape caves and gain access to highly surveiled places.

move.name: Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe
move.description: The user lands a vicious bite, leaving an ugly bruise.

move.name: Arm Thrust
move.effect: Single Target. Successive Actions.
move.description: A quick and relentless series of open-palmed thrusts against the foe.

move.name: Spark
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The user engulfs itself with statc electricity then charges with a solid tackle against the foe. Sparks fly, very literally.

move.name: Thunder Wave
move.effect: Single Target. Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A series of electric waves hit the target, their voltage is too weak to cause much harm but muscles will get cramped for hours.

move.name: Slam
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1.
move.description: Everybody get up, it’s time to slam now.

move.name: Entrainment
move.effect: Single Target. Replace the Target's Ability with the User's. Unique Abilities can't be passed or replaced. Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon.
move.description: The Pokémon trains and teaches their best ability to their target. The target becomes a master of this ability in a record time.

move.name: Agility
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: Swift of body, swift of mind.

move.name: Low Sweep
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon crouches and spins with a kick to the foe’s legs. Leaving them with a limp for the rest of the fight.

move.name: Mach Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Fist Move.
move.description: The user launches a punch so quickly that it’s barely seen.

move.name: Wild Charge
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil. Roll 1 Chance die to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon surrounds itself with lightning then recklessly charges against their target.

move.name: Discharge
move.effect: Area Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze those affected.
move.description: The user lets out an enormous discharge over the arena. Lightning does not distinguish friend from foe.

move.name: Close Combat
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce by 1 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon gets close enough to deal devastating damage, but the same can be said for the foe.

move.name: Revival Blessing
move.effect: Target One Ally. The User must spend all of their remaining Will points, if the user has no remaining Will points, this Move fails. Restore conciousness and 2 HP to a fainted ally. If no Ally is fainted this Move fails. The ally does not need to be active in combat.
move.description: The Pokémon prays to the skies with such selfless fervor and devotion that a miracle is granted.

move.name: Double Shock
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. After damage is dealt, the user loses its Electric-Type. If its only type was Electric, it is now Typeless. User's Physical & Special Electric-Type Moves have Power 0. Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the User.
move.description: The user lets out a colossal discharge of electricity, lightning connecting the sky and earth for way too long. However, the effort effectively depletes the energy reserves of the user.

move.name: Thunder Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 1 Chance die to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A charged punch to deliver a shocking blow.

move.name: Fire Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 2nd Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: A fist powered by the fiery spirit of combat, the heat of the battle lights of for real as the punch hits the foe right where it hurts!

move.name: Ice Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 1 Chance Dice to Freeze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon wears their ice gloves to punch the foe. Yes. Gloves made of ice.

name: Pheromosa
description: This one also appears to be unable to enter a Pokéball, the rays just won't surround them. This one has refused to touch anything we give to it and appears displeased by my mere presence.

abilityOne.name: Beast Boost
abilityOne.description: A wicked satisfaction grows as this creature brings out destruction, for it becomes more savage with every foe that falls to its power.
abilityOne.effect: If a foe faints because of an attack dealt by this Ultra-Beast, Increase by 1 their highest Attribute. Up to 3 points can be increased this way. Unique Ability.

move.name: Feint
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 1. This Move ignores the effects of any Shield Move active on the Target and removes their effects for the rest of the Round.
move.description: The user begins their attack, and as their target attempts to protect itself, the user feints the target to break their defense against their true strike.

move.name: Rapid Spin
move.effect: Single Target. Increase the User's Dexterity by 1. Remove Entry Hazards, Terrains (ie Grassy Terrain, Misty Terrain), Ongoing Damage and Leech seed from the User and/or their side of the field.
move.description: The Pokémon makes a swift spin to strike at the foe and in the process everything laying close to the user is scattered out of the battlefield.

move.name: Leer
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The vicious glare of a predator that triggers the flight response of their prey.

move.name: Quick Guard
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Reaction 3. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage from a Physical or Special Move with Priority. Negate the Added effects of Reaction and late Reaction Moves targeting the User and Allies.
move.description: The user reacts instinctively and defends itself and its team mates, nullyfing the effects of the fastest attacks.

move.name: Bug Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. If the target Pokemon is holding a berry, the User eats it and gains its effects.
move.description: The Pokémon nibbles at their foe in hopes of finding something tasty to snack on.

move.name: Low Kick
move.effect: Single Target. Add 1 Extra Damage Dice for every 50kg of the weight on the foe, up to 4 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The Pokémon uses a kick to the sheen to throw the foe into the ground. The bigger they are, the harder they fall.

move.name: Double Kick
move.effect: Single Target. Double Action.
move.description: The good old one-two but with a twist.

move.name: Triple Kick
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Triple Action. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of the third hit.
move.description: The good ol’ one-two with an even better twist! They never see that last hit coming.

move.name: Jump Kick
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. If the Accuracy roll fails, Roll 4 Dice of Typeless Damage against the user, ignoring defenses.
move.description: The user launches itself up two stories high to pummel down with a powerful kick. Do not try it at home.

move.name: Stomp
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Die to Flinch the Target. Targets under the effects of the Move "Minimize" are vulnerable.
move.description: Stomping the foe with strong feet. Perfect to squish nasty little bugs.

move.name: Agility
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: Swift of body, swift of mind.

move.name: Silver Wind
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Increase by 1 the User's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense, and Sp. Defense.
move.description: A beautiful but dangerous wind that blows a silver powder against the foe. The performance may give the user a big confidence boost.

move.name: Lunge
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce Target's Strength by 1.
move.description: The user charges against the foe at full force, not just to knock it down but to restrain it with its many limbs.

move.name: Swift
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Never Miss.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a burst of star-shaped sparkles at a blinding speed.

move.name: Throat Chop
move.effect: Single Target. The target cannot use any "Sound Based" Move. Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon.
move.description: A heinous attack to a Pokémon’s throat that will leave them unable to make a sound for hours.

move.name: Shock Wave
move.effect: Single Target. Never Miss.
move.description: A series of lightning bolts rise through the floor towards the sky, it is impossible to predict where they are coming from.

move.name: Bounce
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Thunder / Twister / Sky Uppercut / Gust / Hurricane / Smack Down. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon jumps at least 30 feet in the air before landing with a mighty stomp on top of the foe. While in the air it is safe from most treaths but its still vulnerable to bad weather.

move.name: Speed Swap
move.effect: Single Target. Switch the User's Dexterity with the Target's.
move.description: This move allows the user to release its power. If the user has any boosts, the damage is increased.

move.name: Me First
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Copy Move. Support Moves can't be copied. Unique Moves can't be copied. You may choose another Target(s) for the copied Move.
move.description: The user anticipates the next Move the target will use and impatiently interrupts to be the first in line.

move.name: Bug Buzz
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce by 1 the Sp. Defense of those affected.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their wings or a part of their bodies to emit distracting buzzes all around.

move.name: Outrage
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
move.description: The true nature of dragon-types unleashed. The user is consumed by a primal fury that won’t stop until everything has ben razed to the ground. Afterwards the Pokémon is confused.

move.name: Triple Axel
move.effect: Single Target. Triple Action. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage of the 2nd hit and 2 Extra Dice to the Damage of the 3rd hit. **Second hit has Low Accuracy 1. ***Third hit has Low Accuracy 2.
move.description: A series of cold-blooded kicks that break bone as they would break brittle ice.

move.name: U-Turn
move.effect: Single Target. Switcher Move for User.
move.description: A bait and switch move, where the user strikes then makes a sudden u-turn back to safety.

move.name: Quiver Dance
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Dexterity, Special an Sp. Defense.
move.description: A mystical and beautiful dance that increases a Pokémon focus in combat.

move.name: High Jump Kick
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. If the Accuracy roll fails, Roll 5 Dice of Typeless Damage against the user, ignoring defenses.
move.description: The user launches itself up three stories high to pummel down with a brutal kick. Let’s just trust it’s got a good aim from that distance.

name: Terapagos (Stellar Form)
description: An old expedition journal states the sight of this Pokémon, describing it as an underground floating planet. But no other sighting has ever been reported.

abilityOne.name: Teraform Zero
abilityOne.description: In this form, Terapagos once held the newly-created world on top of itself. It is well within its power to restore it to its most ancient state.
abilityOne.effect: Only Terapagos may use this Ability. Remove all Active Effects on the battlefield and negate any Effect on the Battlefield while this Pokemon is out. (Force Fields, Entry Hazards, Terrain, Weather, Abilities etc.) Unique Ability.

move.name: Withdraw
move.effect: Target Self. Increase User's Defense by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon withraw into their shell for increased protection and to avoid unwanted interactions.

move.name: Rapid Spin
move.effect: Single Target. Increase the User's Dexterity by 1. Remove Entry Hazards, Terrains (ie Grassy Terrain, Misty Terrain), Ongoing Damage and Leech seed from the User and/or their side of the field.
move.description: The Pokémon makes a swift spin to strike at the foe and in the process everything laying close to the user is scattered out of the battlefield.

move.name: Headbutt
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Out of battle it may cause a Random encounter when hitting trees and make objects drop from high places.
move.description: The Pokémon rams against their foe with their head. This Move is perfect to shake down trees when looking for berries, but beware of wild Pokémon nesting at the treetops.

move.name: Ancient Power
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Increase by 1 the User's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense and Sp. Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon calls forward an energy from the ancient past. This may infuse the user with a primal strength.

move.name: Tri Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Freeze the Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The foe has three problems and this Move is all of them.

move.name: Protect
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokemon would receive from a Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Moves that target the user.
move.description: A mighty energy shield materializes in front of the user to to deflect attacks and dispel ill effects.

move.name: Sunny Day
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Activate Sunny Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The Pokémon will call for the sun to shine brighter, increasing the heat of the arena. This Move doesn’t work at night, indoors, or underground/water.

move.name: Rain Dance
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Activate Rain Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The Pokémon performs a peculiar dance in the middle of the field, everyone thinks it silly until the first thunder rumbles.

move.name: Dazzling Gleam
move.effect: Target All foes in Range.
move.description: The Pokémon shines bright like a diamond. The powerful flash hurts the eyes of everyone watching.

move.name: Flash Cannon
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: Through shiny metal parts of their body, the Pokémon reflects a light beam straight into the foe’s eyes.

move.name: Scorching Sands
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the foe.
move.description: The sand around the user heats to scorching temperatures as it is thrown against their foe.

move.name: Heavy Slam
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to he Damage Pool for every 50kg of weight the User is above the target's weight. Up to 4 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The foe is about to confirm if the Pokémon is thick-boned.

move.name: Gyro Ball
move.effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of this Move for every point on Dexterity the Target has that surpasses the User's. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a projectile. Correction: the Pokémon IS the projectile.

move.name: Double-Edge
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil.
move.description: Without regard for their own safety, the Pokémon does a reckless attack against their foe.

move.name: Rock Polish
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: Smooth the rough edges, no need to grind about in life.

move.name: Tera Blast
move.effect: Single Target. *If the User is actively Terastallized, the Type of this Move changes to match that of the Tera-Type. This affects Weaknesses, Resistances and STAB accordingly.
move.description: A blast of sharp crystals and Tera energy, if the Pokémon is Terastallized the energy’s type will change. It is something beautiful to witness.

move.name: Meteor Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Increase the User's Special by 1 the moment it begins charging.
move.description: The user overflows with galactic energy while summoning a small meteor to impact the foe. A theory suggests this move might have caused the extintion of prehistoric Pokémon.

move.name: Ice Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Freeze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon shoots a cold beam that reduces all warmth on the environment up to freezing point.

move.name: Thunder
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target. Rain Weather eliminates Low Accuracy. Sunny Weather increases it to Low Accuracy 4. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce", or "Sky Drop" this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The Pokémon commands the skies to send a giant lightning bolt to a specific point. Difficult to command under clear skies, lethal during a storm. Flying Pokémon are specially vulnerable.

move.name: Solar Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. If Sunny Weather is active, you skip this Move's Charge action. If performed under Rain, Sandstorm or Hail/Snowy Weather, this Move takes two actions to Charge.
move.description: The Pokémon gathers sunlight but instead of being absorbed it is sot as a devastating beam of light instead.

move.name: Flare Blitz
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil. Roll 1 Chance die to inflict 3rd Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: A reckless blazing charge against their foe, ends up with an explosive collision

move.name: Surf
move.effect: Area Move. If a Target is out of range due to the Move "Dive", this Move hits anyways. Out of battle, allows the Pokemon to travel the sea for long distances.
move.description: The Pokémon calls forward a large wave of seawater to ride, most Pokémon get washed out as they did not bring a surfboard.

move.name: Endure
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. If a Physical or Special Move would cause the user to faint, they remain at 1 HP instead, remove this effect afterwards. The effect re-activates on the user's next Turn. Whole Round duration.
move.description: The Pokémon mentally prepares to receive a fatal blow, their spirit is stronger than their body so they endure to keep on fighting for as long as possible.

move.name: Hyper Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge. Lethal.
move.description: A devastating beam, a path of destruction that can extend for miles is the unmistakable proof someone used this Move. Let the user rest before trying to use it again.

move.name: Tera Starstorm
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Unique Move. *If the User is actively Terastallized, the Type of this Move changes to match that of the Tera-Type, this affects Weaknesses, Resistances and STAB accordingly. Change the type of those affected at random.
move.description: Tera crystals full of energy fall from the sky as meteors. A beautiful but extemely chaotic scene follows as all Pokémon absorb the Tera Energy without control.

name: Raikou
description: Johto legends tell about a Pokémon born from lightning, with a roar like crashing thunder, soaring the lands, sending resounding shockwaves as it walks.

abilityOne.name: Pressure
abilityOne.description: Being around this Pokemon will be very stressing and demanding, only the bravest dare to face them one-on-one.
abilityOne.effect: When this Pokemon comes out, All foes in Range spend half (rounded up) of their remaining Will Points without gaining any effect for it. This effect does not stack.

abilityTwo.name: Inner Focus
abilityTwo.description: The Pokemon is extrmely serious and focused on everything it does. It remains calm and never backs down, even if it's getting severly injured.
abilityTwo.effect: This Pokemon does not Flinch. The Ability Intimidate does not have any effect against this Pokemon. Outside of battle this Pokemon is able to resist intimidation tactics, fear and stress better than others.

move.name: Bite
move.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe
move.description: The user lands a vicious bite, leaving an ugly bruise.

move.name: Leer
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The vicious glare of a predator that triggers the flight response of their prey.

move.name: Thunder Shock
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance die to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: The most basic electric attack, charge, release, and shock! Just don’t point it to any electric device.

move.name: Roar
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 6. Switcher Move for the Foe. In the wild, the battle may end.
move.description: With a potent roar, to make the foe reconsider their intentions.
