move.name: Double-Edge
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil.
move.description: Without regard for their own safety, the Pokémon does a reckless attack against their foe.

move.name: Mega Drain
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The user absorbs a big amount of vital energy and nutrients from the target to feed from.

move.name: Confusion
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Confuse the Target.
move.description: A basic mental assault that makes the foe believe they are being attacked by an invisible enemy.

move.name: Growth
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Special. If the Sunny Weather is active, increase by 2 Instead.
move.description: The Pokémon makes their body grow in size. They’ll get bigger and stronger in just a few seconds.

move.name: Life Dew
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. User and Allies in Range heal 1 HP at the end of each Round. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The user creates a fresh-water dew that restores energy and heals wounds.

move.name: Giga Drain
move.effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
move.description: The Pokémon drains most of the foe’s vital energy and feeds on the nutrients it managed to extract.

move.name: Psyshock
move.effect: Single Target. This Move is resisted with the Target's Defense instead of its Sp. Defense.
move.description: The shock is mental, the blow is real.

move.name: Helping Hand
move.effect: Target One Ally. Reaction 5. The Target Gets 2 Extra Dice on their next Skill Check/Accuracy Roll, and 2 Extra Dice on their next Damage Roll. This Effect does not Stack.
move.description: The Pokémon is the first to come and give a hand to their friend. A true bro.

move.name: Aromatherapy
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Cure Status Ailments (All Burn degrees, Freeze, Paralysis, All Poison & Sleep) on the Targets.
move.description: The Pokémon releases a series of essential oils and herbal scents to refresh themselves and their companions.

move.name: Energy Ball
move.effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: Gathering nature’s energy from nearby plants, trees and roots, the Pokémon forms a ball to shoot at the enemy. Sadly, the surrounding plants will be dry afterwards.

move.name: Psychic
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: The most iconic Psychic attack, the foe starts floating in the air and its swayed around by telekinesis as their mental barrier crumbles.

move.name: Leech Seed
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Spend 1 Will point to activate. At the end of each Round, Roll 2 Dice of Typeless Damage against the target ignoring defenses. The User heals 1 HP for every damage dealt this way. Grass-Type Pokémon are immune to this Effect. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The foe is infected with seed saplings taking root on their body. As the saplings grow, they'll absorb the vital energy of the foe and send it back to the user.

move.name: Heal Pulse
move.effect: Target One Ally. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate.
move.description: Commanding the mind over the matter, the Pokémon speeds up the healing process on an ally.

move.name: Solar Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. If Sunny Weather is active, you skip this Move's Charge action. If performed under Rain, Sandstorm or Hail/Snowy Weather, this Move takes two actions to Charge.
move.description: The Pokémon gathers sunlight but instead of being absorbed it is sot as a devastating beam of light instead.

move.name: Future Sight
move.effect: Single Target. This Move's damage is dealt at the beginning of the next Round. Ignore Shield Moves, Force Field, Cover & Substitute. If the target restires or switches out from battle, the damage will be dealt to the next opponent or to one of its allies.
move.description: The Pokémon foresees something terrible happening. Although when it tries to see their own future, the images are ever changing.

move.name: Expanding Force
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. *If Psychic Terrain is active, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move and you may add another target to it.
move.description: Psychic energies form a bubble of light to damage the foe. Under Psychic Terrain, the energy is so big it turns into a tall pillar that crushes anyone inside.

move.name: Phantom Force
move.effect: Single Target. Charge move. Out of Range while Charging. Lethal. Ignore any Cover, Shield Moves, and/or Force Fields active on the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon disappears into a dark dimension to infiltrate even the most impenetrable fortress. It may reappear during its next action.

name: Ogerpon (Hearthflame Mask Form)
description: Ancient myths and legends remain alive to this day. It is said Kitakami is visited by an angry creature during the festival of masks. The creature looks menacing and sets the town's decoration on fire.

abilityOne.name: Mold Breaker
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon will find unusual ways to achieve its goals. They are inventive and go around problems.
abilityOne.effect: If a foe Pokemon has a Type, an immunity, or an Ability that would prevent this Pokemon from dealing Damage with a Move, ignore it.

abilityTwo.name: Embody Aspect
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon's emotions are deeply affected by the masks it wears, its personality changing completely depending on which one it is using.
abilityTwo.effect: Increase by 2 an Attribute of this Pokemon depending on the mask it wears. Teal & Wellspring Mask - Dexterity / Heartflame & Cornerstone Mask - Strength. Unique Ability.

move.name: Vine Whip
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses its body vines to give the foe a good smack. These vines can be as long as 20 feet and quite surdy as ropes.

move.name: Leech Seed
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Spend 1 Will point to activate. At the end of each Round, Roll 2 Dice of Typeless Damage against the target ignoring defenses. The User heals 1 HP for every damage dealt this way. Grass-Type Pokémon are immune to this Effect. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The foe is infected with seed saplings taking root on their body. As the saplings grow, they'll absorb the vital energy of the foe and send it back to the user.

move.name: Quick Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Out of battle, double the Pokemon's movement speed.
move.description: An attackas fight as lightning.

move.name: Follow Me
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. All Foe's Moves able to do so will Target the user. Duration 1 Round.
move.description: The Pokemon draws everyone’s attention, provoking their foes to do their worse.

move.name: Focus Energy
move.effect: Target Self. All of the user's Physical & Special Moves now have "High Critical". Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The Pokémon concentrates all their focus on the battle to make their attacks much more precise.

move.name: Growth
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Special. If the Sunny Weather is active, increase by 2 Instead.
move.description: The Pokémon makes their body grow in size. They’ll get bigger and stronger in just a few seconds.

move.name: Double Kick
move.effect: Single Target. Double Action.
move.description: The good old one-two but with a twist.

move.name: Taunt
move.effect: Single Target. The Target cannot perform Support Moves (Support Maneuvers may still be performed). Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: Through tease and mockery, the foe is enraged to the point it stops thinking clearly.

move.name: U-Turn
move.effect: Single Target. Switcher Move for User.
move.description: A bait and switch move, where the user strikes then makes a sudden u-turn back to safety.

move.name: Charm
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce Target's Strength by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon engages their foe in a charming interaction to reduce their aggressive intent.

move.name: Scary Face
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: When a Pokémon looks at you like THAT, you know you gotta thread carefully around them.

move.name: Low Sweep
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon crouches and spins with a kick to the foe’s legs. Leaving them with a limp for the rest of the fight.

move.name: Slam
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1.
move.description: Everybody get up, it’s time to slam now.

move.name: Throat Chop
move.effect: Single Target. The target cannot use any "Sound Based" Move. Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon.
move.description: A heinous attack to a Pokémon’s throat that will leave them unable to make a sound for hours.

move.name: Protect
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokemon would receive from a Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Moves that target the user.
move.description: A mighty energy shield materializes in front of the user to to deflect attacks and dispel ill effects.

move.name: Spiky Shield
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 3. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokemon would receive from a Damaging Move. If the Foe used a non-ranged Physical Move. Roll 2 Dice of Typeless Damage against it, ignore defenses.
move.description: The Pokémon bunkers themselves inside a shield of thorned brambles sprouting from the ground. Anyone who gets too close will get tangled in the spiky vines.

move.name: Sunny Day
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Activate Sunny Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The Pokémon will call for the sun to shine brighter, increasing the heat of the arena. This Move doesn’t work at night, indoors, or underground/water.

move.name: Superpower
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Reduce by 1 the User's Strength and Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon packs all their power in a single crushing strike. All this effort leaves them quite tired afterwards.

move.name: Synthesis
move.effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will Point to activate. If Sunny Weather is in effect, this Move becomes a Complete Heal. If performed under Rain, Sandstorm, Hail or Snowy Weather, this Move is a Minor heal and only heals 1 HP.
move.description: The Pokémon gathers sunlight to re-energize themselves.

move.name: Ivy Cudgel
move.effect: Single Target. *The Type of this Move becomes the same as the User's Secondary Type if possible Otherwise their Main Type. This affects Weakness, Resistances, and STAB accordingly.
move.description: The Pokémon creates a club out of thorny ivy vines, this club is infused with the power of nature, everchanging.

move.name: Power Whip
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2.
move.description: A thick vine full of thorns is waved as a whip against the enemy. As devastating as the blow would be, the incoming attack is easily percieved by the foe.

move.name: Wood Hammer
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil.
move.description: The Pokémon creates a giant wooden hamer and it uses it to smash the foe with such force the hammer also explodes into wood splinters.

move.name: Solar Blade
move.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Cutter Move. If Sunny Weather is active, you skip this Move's Charge action. If performed under Rain, Sandstorm or Hail/Snowy Weather, this Move takes two actions to Charge.
move.description: The Pokémon focuses the sunlight on its sharp leaves, then releases the energy with a shattering cut.

move.name: Blaze Kick
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. High Critical. Roll 2 Chance Dice to inflict 2nd Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: Setting their legs ablaze, the Pokémon throws a mighty kick that sears the sides of the foe.

name: Giratina (Origin Form)
description: Plot Device

abilityOne.name: Levitate
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon floats to move around without ever touching the ground.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon has immunity to Ground-Type moves and effects active on the battlefield such as Terrains and certain Entry Hazards.

move.name: Dragon Breath
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A mystical flame breath that feels strengely cold to the touch. It doesn’t burn in a conventional way.

move.name: Scary Face
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: When a Pokémon looks at you like THAT, you know you gotta thread carefully around them.

move.name: Ominous Wind
move.effect: Single Target. Wind Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Increase by 1 the User's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense and Sp. Defense.
move.description: The battlefield gets absolutely silent, the only noise is a cold wind draft that gives the target chills and goosebumps. Observing from the shadows, the user rejoices in the fear.

move.name: Ancient Power
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Increase by 1 the User's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense and Sp. Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon calls forward an energy from the ancient past. This may infuse the user with a primal strength.

move.name: Slash
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical. Cutter Move.
move.description: The Pokémon uses the sharpest part of their body as a blade to tear and slash with vicious intent.

move.name: Shadow Sneak
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1.
move.description: The user sneaks through the darkness and strikes by coming out of the target’s shadow. The Pokémon is able travel freely through the shadow realm.

move.name: Shadow Claw
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their ghostly claws to slash through their foe’s body tearing not their flesh but their soul directly.

move.name: Dragon Claw
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses its strong claws to deliver a fierce tearing blow.

move.name: Destiny Bond
move.effect: Target Self. If the user faints this Round due to damage frm a Physical or Special Move, the Pokemon who dealt the damage is dealt damage equal to their remaining Hp. This Move will fail if it was used the previous Round.
move.description: Through a mystical bond, everyone who brings disgrace to this Pokémon will suffer the exact same fate.

move.name: Aura Sphere
move.effect: Single Target. Never Miss. Projectile Move.
move.description: By channeling their own aura, the user launches an energy sphere that causes harm on an spiritual level more than a physical one.

move.name: Earth Power
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: The user sends out a subterranean wave that bursts the ground below the target. It’s as if the earth bends to the user’s will.

move.name: Pain Split
move.effect: Single Target. Spend 1 Will Point to activate. *Deal up to 3 Typeless Damage to the Target, Heal 1 HP to the User for every Damage dealt this way. This Move Fails if the User has more than Half HP rounded down. This Move cannot reduce a Target to less than 1 HP.
move.description: The user channels their pain into the foe to relieve their agony. The foe gets to feel the burn of the damage it has caused.

move.name: Icy Wind
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Wind Move. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
move.description: Polar winds sweep through the arena. Everyone starts to shiver and embrace themselves, trying to preserve a bit of warmth.

move.name: Protect
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokemon would receive from a Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Moves that target the user.
move.description: A mighty energy shield materializes in front of the user to to deflect attacks and dispel ill effects.

move.name: Trick Room
move.effect: Target the Battlefield. Invert the order of Initiative. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: Reality inside the battlefielfield is distorted, time bends and flows differently for everyone. Those who don’t rush through manage to adapt easier.

move.name: Hidden Power
move.effect: Single Target. This Move will always deal Super-Effective Damage against the Target. If used by the Pokemon #201 Unown. See p. 530
move.description: Inside every Pokémon lies the key to unlock all kinds of power.

move.name: Spite
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Will to 1 point. Reset any effects it got from spending Will Points.
move.description: The target feels overwhelmend by feelings of dread.

move.name: Psych Up
move.effect: Single Target. The User gets the same Attribute/Trait Increases and Reductions the Target has.
move.description: The Pokémon mentalizes themselves stronger than anyone. They feel good. They can win. They. Can. Do. This!

move.name: Dragon Pulse
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon sends out a powerful wave of energy through their mouth.

move.name: Shadow Ball
move.effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
move.description: Dark matter and shadows are used as a projectile against the foe, bringing out memories of their deepest fears.

move.name: Dark Pulse
move.effect: Target Random Foe. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
move.description: A haze of dark energy decends on the battlefield preying on those vulnerable to the obscure feelings and fears it provokes.

move.name: Gravity
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Remove the immunity to Ground-Type Moves for everyone in the field. Moves that require jumping or flying get an Extra "Low Accuracy 2". Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: An invisisible force pulls everyone to the floor keeps them from taking off the ground.

move.name: Draco Meteor
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. lethal. Reduce User's Special by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon summons a meteor to fall from the sky directly into their foes, dealing a brutal amount of damage. An impressive display if power that demands a lot of energy.

move.name: Hyper Beam
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge. Lethal.
move.description: A devastating beam, a path of destruction that can extend for miles is the unmistakable proof someone used this Move. Let the user rest before trying to use it again.

move.name: Hex
move.effect: Single Target. *If the Target has an active Status Condition, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move.
move.description: The user casts a terrible hex over the target, the effects will be greater if the target is already burdened by an ailment.

move.name: Shadow Force
move.effect: Single Target. Charge move. Out of Range while Charging. Lethal. Unique. Ignore Defenses and any Shield Moves and Force Fields active on the Target. Damage dealt by this Move cannot be healed for 24 hrs.
move.description: The Pokémon dissapears into a dark dimension to strike its foe at the next opportunity. The blow will hurt the target not on their body but directly into their soul.

name: Garganacl
description: They look like salt formations and other Pokémon come close to it to lick their mineral-rich salt. It takes a lot to make them attack. Strangely, wounds made by these Pokémon heal quickly and rarely leave scars.

abilityOne.name: Purifying Salt
abilityOne.description: The Pokemon produces a high quality salt that wards off against any bacteria, impurity, and even keep those pesky evil spirits at bay.
abilityOne.effect: This Pokemon can't have any Status Ailment infliced on them. Previously inflicted Ailments remain. Ghost-Type Moves used against this Pokemon have their total Damage Reduced by 3.

abilityTwo.name: Sturdy
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon's body is extremely resistant to damage, it can withstand almost anything.
abilityTwo.effect: The first time this Pokemon would reach 0 HP due to damage from a Move, it will remain at 1 HP instead. Status Ailments/Conditions, Weather, and Self-inflicted damage do not trigger this effect. The Pokemon can only benefit from Sturdy once per scene.

move.name: Tackle
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

move.name: Harden
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 1.
move.description: When life gets hard, do the same.

move.name: Rock Throw
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged.
move.description: Back in the day, this was a common form of amusement amongst Pokémon and children alike.

move.name: Mud Shot
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 1.
move.description: By shooting a stream of mud at their target, the user manages to impair their movement.

move.name: Rock Blast
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged. Successive Actions. Projectile Move.
move.description: A rock shrapnel, the user shoots tiny bullet-like pebbles.

move.name: Salt Cure
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Steel-Type and Water-Type Pokemon receive Super-Effective Damage from this Move and 1 Extra Damage from the Ongoing Damage.
move.description: The user covers the foe with a salt crust, the salt irritates the skin and drehydrates the victim. It can even rust metal in a few seconds.

move.name: Smelling Salts
move.effect: Single Target. *If the Target is Paralyzed, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move. After dealing damage, cure the Target's Paralysis
move.description: The Pokémon uses strong smelling salts to purify the arena or to throw into the foe’s face. Any paralized Pokémon gets a sudden jolt at the powerfull smell.

move.name: Block
move.effect: Single Target. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: You don’t seem to understand. I’m not blocked in here with you... You are blocked in here with me!

move.name: Rock Polish
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: Smooth the rough edges, no need to grind about in life.

move.name: Fire Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 2nd Degree Burn on the Target.
move.description: A fist powered by the fiery spirit of combat, the heat of the battle lights of for real as the punch hits the foe right where it hurts!

move.name: Ice Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 1 Chance Dice to Freeze the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon wears their ice gloves to punch the foe. Yes. Gloves made of ice.

move.name: Thunder Punch
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 1 Chance die to Paralyze the Target.
move.description: A charged punch to deliver a shocking blow.

move.name: Stealth Rock
move.effect: Target Foe's Side of the Field. Entry Hazard. Pokemon entering the battle Receive 1 Rock-Type Damage. This effect does not stack.
move.description: The Pokémon hides a trap of sharp rocks that are launched at the victim before they even realize what even happened.

move.name: Brick Break
move.effect: Single Target. *If there is a Force field on the Target's side of the field, destroy it and add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.
move.description: The Pokémon uses a karate technique to chop through tall piles of bricks. No matter how many layers you pile up, they’ll break regardless.

move.name: Iron Head
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon charges to cure the foe’s iron deficit.

move.name: Rock Slide
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch those affected.
move.description: Don’t worry, even if you are not the fastest one in the race, you can still win by a landslide.

move.name: Recover
move.effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their energy to quickly mend wounds, their regenerative powers are beyond the imagination.

move.name: Heavy Slam
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to he Damage Pool for every 50kg of weight the User is above the target's weight. Up to 4 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The foe is about to confirm if the Pokémon is thick-boned.

move.name: Hammer Arm
move.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Low Accuracy 1. Reduce User's Dexterity by 1.
move.description: Stop. Hammer Arm time!

move.name: Wide Guard
move.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Reaction 3. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage the Targets would receive from Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Any Moves on the Targets.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their whole body to provide shelter and protection to everyone they can. They are the rock on which others stand.

move.name: Earthquake
move.effect: Area Move. Ranged. If the Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dig" this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The user calls the forces of nature. The earth shakes violently and everything crumbles to the ground.

move.name: Stone Edge
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Ranged. Lethal. High Critical. Cutter Move.
move.description: Obsidian shards are sent out against the foe. This rock may be brittle but is the sharpest in the world.

move.name: Explosion
move.effect: Area Move. Ranged. Lethal. The User Faints.
move.description: Through a massive explosion the Pokémon destroys all they can before fainting. Sometimes the only way to get out of a bad situation is in bits and pieces.

move.name: Avalanche
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 4. *If the User received damage from the target during this Turn add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool. *If Snowy Weather is active add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.
move.description: The user covers themselves with a heavy snow coat, if anything disturbs the snow, it will fall like a heavy avalanche.

move.name: Body Press
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon makes a judo maneuver, using its body mass instead of its strength against the target.

move.name: Fissure
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 5. Ranged. Deal Damage to the Target equal to its Remaining HP, plus 1 Lethal Damge. If the Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dig" this Move hits anyways.
move.description: The earth rips apart underneath the target and swallows them whole. You’ll need a rescue team to recover the unlucky victim from the deep.

name: Ogerpon (Cornerstone Mask Form)
description: Ancient myths and legends remain alive to this day. It is said Kitakami is visited by a destructive creature during the festival of masks. The creature thrashes the place and destroys all festive decorations.

abilityOne.name: Sturdy
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon's body is extremely resistant to damage, it can withstand almost anything.
abilityOne.effect: The first time this Pokemon would reach 0 HP due to damage from a Move, it will remain at 1 HP instead. Status Ailments/Conditions, Weather, and Self-inflicted damage do not trigger this effect. The Pokemon can only benefit from Sturdy once per scene.

abilityTwo.name: Embody Aspect
abilityTwo.description: This Pokemon's emotions are deeply affected by the masks it wears, its personality changing completely depending on which one it is using.
abilityTwo.effect: Increase by 2 an Attribute of this Pokemon depending on the mask it wears. Teal & Wellspring Mask - Dexterity / Heartflame & Cornerstone Mask - Strength. Unique Ability.

move.name: Vine Whip
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses its body vines to give the foe a good smack. These vines can be as long as 20 feet and quite surdy as ropes.

move.name: Leech Seed
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Spend 1 Will point to activate. At the end of each Round, Roll 2 Dice of Typeless Damage against the target ignoring defenses. The User heals 1 HP for every damage dealt this way. Grass-Type Pokémon are immune to this Effect. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The foe is infected with seed saplings taking root on their body. As the saplings grow, they'll absorb the vital energy of the foe and send it back to the user.

move.name: Quick Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Out of battle, double the Pokemon's movement speed.
move.description: An attackas fight as lightning.

move.name: Follow Me
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. All Foe's Moves able to do so will Target the user. Duration 1 Round.
move.description: The Pokemon draws everyone’s attention, provoking their foes to do their worse.

move.name: Focus Energy
move.effect: Target Self. All of the user's Physical & Special Moves now have "High Critical". Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The Pokémon concentrates all their focus on the battle to make their attacks much more precise.

move.name: Growth
move.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Special. If the Sunny Weather is active, increase by 2 Instead.
move.description: The Pokémon makes their body grow in size. They’ll get bigger and stronger in just a few seconds.

move.name: Double Kick
move.effect: Single Target. Double Action.
move.description: The good old one-two but with a twist.

move.name: Taunt
move.effect: Single Target. The Target cannot perform Support Moves (Support Maneuvers may still be performed). Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: Through tease and mockery, the foe is enraged to the point it stops thinking clearly.

move.name: U-Turn
move.effect: Single Target. Switcher Move for User.
move.description: A bait and switch move, where the user strikes then makes a sudden u-turn back to safety.

move.name: Charm
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce Target's Strength by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon engages their foe in a charming interaction to reduce their aggressive intent.

move.name: Scary Face
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: When a Pokémon looks at you like THAT, you know you gotta thread carefully around them.

move.name: Low Sweep
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon crouches and spins with a kick to the foe’s legs. Leaving them with a limp for the rest of the fight.

move.name: Slam
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1.
move.description: Everybody get up, it’s time to slam now.

move.name: Throat Chop
move.effect: Single Target. The target cannot use any "Sound Based" Move. Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon.
move.description: A heinous attack to a Pokémon’s throat that will leave them unable to make a sound for hours.

move.name: Protect
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokemon would receive from a Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Moves that target the user.
move.description: A mighty energy shield materializes in front of the user to to deflect attacks and dispel ill effects.

move.name: Spiky Shield
move.effect: Target Self. Reaction 3. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokemon would receive from a Damaging Move. If the Foe used a non-ranged Physical Move. Roll 2 Dice of Typeless Damage against it, ignore defenses.
move.description: The Pokémon bunkers themselves inside a shield of thorned brambles sprouting from the ground. Anyone who gets too close will get tangled in the spiky vines.

move.name: Sandstorm
move.effect: Target Battlefield. Wind Move. Activate Sandstorm Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: A fierce sandstorm starts raging all around the battlefield. Cover your eyes, nose and face! The rough sand will hurt you!

move.name: Superpower
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Reduce by 1 the User's Strength and Defense.
move.description: The Pokémon packs all their power in a single crushing strike. All this effort leaves them quite tired afterwards.

move.name: Synthesis
move.effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will Point to activate. If Sunny Weather is in effect, this Move becomes a Complete Heal. If performed under Rain, Sandstorm, Hail or Snowy Weather, this Move is a Minor heal and only heals 1 HP.
move.description: The Pokémon gathers sunlight to re-energize themselves.

move.name: Ivy Cudgel
move.effect: Single Target. *The Type of this Move becomes the same as the User's Secondary Type if possible Otherwise their Main Type. This affects Weakness, Resistances, and STAB accordingly.
move.description: The Pokémon creates a club out of thorny ivy vines, this club is infused with the power of nature, everchanging.

move.name: Power Whip
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2.
move.description: A thick vine full of thorns is waved as a whip against the enemy. As devastating as the blow would be, the incoming attack is easily percieved by the foe.

move.name: Wood Hammer
move.effect: Single Target. Recoil.
move.description: The Pokémon creates a giant wooden hamer and it uses it to smash the foe with such force the hammer also explodes into wood splinters.

move.name: Land's Wrath
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Ranged. Lethal. Unique.
move.description: The earth moves on its own, no attacker in sight. The floor crumbles and the ground shakes engulfing its victims. From the rubble, lush trees emerge a short time after.

move.name: Head Smash
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Recoil.
move.description: Pokémon, angry. Pokémon, smash!

name: Kingambit
description: Only a Bisharp able to face an army can evolve into Kingambit. While it commands a legion of followers, it's not skilled at devising complex strategies, seeking to win through brute strength alone.

abilityOne.name: Supreme Overlord
abilityOne.description: This Pokemon has a commanding aura and is obsessively ridden with the need to rule over everything, even the ashes of a kingdom.
abilityOne.effect: When this Pokemon comes into battle, Increase its Strength and Special Attributes by 1 for every Ally that has Fainted in-battle. Up to 3 points can be increased this way.

abilityTwo.name: Pressure
abilityTwo.description: Being around this Pokemon will be very stressing and demanding, only the bravest dare to face them one-on-one.
abilityTwo.effect: When this Pokemon comes out, All foes in Range spend half (rounded up) of their remaining Will Points without gaining any effect for it. This effect does not stack.

move.name: Scratch
move.effect: Single Target.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their sharp claws to scratch the enemy. Nothing fancy but it works.

move.name: Leer
move.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
move.description: The vicious glare of a predator that triggers the flight response of their prey.

move.name: Fury Cutter
move.effect: Single Target. Successive Actions. Cutter Move.
move.description: The Pokémon uses their claws or scythes to rapidly cut as if shredding paper.

move.name: Metal Claw
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 1 Chance Die to Increase the User's Strength by 1.
move.description: The Pokémon uses the foe as a whetstone.

move.name: Feint Attack
move.effect: Single Target. Never Miss.
move.description: The user approaches inconspicuously, pretending to attack the foe directly, then actually hits the foe from behind.

move.name: Torment
move.effect: Single Target. The Target cannot use any of the Moves it used during the last Round. Duration 4 Rounds.
move.description: The Pokémon bullies their foe to the point of torment where they cannot keep using their strategy without feeling bad about it.

move.name: Scary Face
move.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 2.
move.description: When a Pokémon looks at you like THAT, you know you gotta thread carefully around them.

move.name: Assurance
move.effect: Single Target. *Add 2 extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move if the Target has already received Damage from the User this Round.
move.description: The user indentifies the weakest foe and charges against them.

move.name: Dual Chop
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Double Action.
move.description: Two brutal blows are all this Pokémon needs to make the opponent yield to their might.

move.name: Low Kick
move.effect: Single Target. Add 1 Extra Damage Dice for every 50kg of the weight on the foe, up to 4 Dice may be added this way.
move.description: The Pokémon uses a kick to the sheen to throw the foe into the ground. The bigger they are, the harder they fall.

move.name: Embargo
move.effect: Single Target. The Target loses its Held Item. Target's Trainer & Partners can't use Items on the Target. Whole Scene Duration.
move.description: The user demands the held item of a Pokémon and the items in the bag of their trainer. Scared, both Pokémon and Trainer comply

move.name: Metal Sound
move.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 2.
move.description: A horrible screeching sound rumbles in the foe’s ears. Some people will try to convince you that this is good music.

move.name: Slash
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical. Cutter Move.
move.description: The Pokémon uses the sharpest part of their body as a blade to tear and slash with vicious intent.

move.name: Night Slash
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical. Cutter Move.
move.description: The user looks for a weak spot, tearing the soft flesh apart with a single vile slash of its claws.

move.name: Iron Defense
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
move.description: Iron body, iron will. This Pokémon is unbreakable.

move.name: Retaliate
move.effect: Single Target. *If an Ally fainted during this or the previous Round, add Extra Dice to the damage pool, equal to the user's Loyalty. Up to 5 dice may be added this way. This effect only activates once per fainted Ally.
move.description: With tears of rage in their eyes, the Pokémon will not let the fall of a friend go without punishment.

move.name: Iron Head
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to flinch the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon charges to cure the foe’s iron deficit.

move.name: Swords Dance
move.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Strength by 2.
move.description: The Pokémon dances with strong steps and a fierce attitude as a ritual to prepare for battle.

move.name: X-Scissor
move.effect: Single Target. Cutter Move.
move.description: The Pokémon uses its scythes or clawa as if they were a pair of scissors to cut through the foe.

move.name: Metal Burst
move.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 5. Can only be used if Target's last Move on User was a Physical or Special Move. Roll dice equal to Target's last damage pool rolled against the User plus 2 Dice. Ignore Defenses.
move.description: Those who live by the sword will die by the sword, or, in this case, by an explosion.

move.name: Kowtow Cleave
move.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Cutter Move. Never Miss.
move.description: The user gets on their knees and bows to its foe, then as the foe accepts this courtesy, a treacherous slash reveals the evil intent of the ruse.

move.name: Stone Edge
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Ranged. Lethal. High Critical. Cutter Move.
move.description: Obsidian shards are sent out against the foe. This rock may be brittle but is the sharpest in the world.

move.name: Guillotine
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 5. Deal Damage equal to the Target's Remaining HP, plus 1 Lethal Damage.
move.description: Fueled by the spirit of revolution the Pokémon sentences their foe to be reduced at the neck. This devastating attack requires an emergency trip to the Pokémon Center...and a basket.

move.name: Giga Impact
move.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge. Lethal.
move.description: The Pokémon strikes with such a brutal force they leave a crater just from the impact. Let them catch their breath afterwards.

move.name: Psycho Cut
move.effect: Single Target. Ranged. High Critical. Cutter Move.
move.description: The user sends out an invisible sword made with psychic energy that slashes targets even if they are far away

move.name: Poison Jab
move.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
move.description: The Pokémon is set on injecting venom directly into the foe’s bloodstream. They can do it the easy way or the hard way.

name: Ogerpon (Teal Mask Form)
description: Ancient myths and legends remain alive to this day. It is said Kitakami is visited by a mischievous creature during the festival of masks. The creature appears playful & wears a mask as disguise to steal snacks.

abilityOne.description: This Pokemon will not yield, the harder the situation gets, the higher its fighting spirit will grow. It may, however, be a bit of a rebel.
abilityOne.effect: The first time this Pokemon has an Attribute reduced during a battle, Increase its Strength by 2.
